pmid-42705594.summary_ja: 反復・多発性の家族性卵巣成熟奇形腫の家系で全エクソーム解析を行い、生殖系列TXNIPミスセンス変異(p.Pro350Leu)を同定した。変異型TXNIPは蓄積が少なく分解が速く、K48型ユビキチン化が増強していた。家族性腫瘍ではTXNIP染色が弱くGLUT1染色が強かった。TXNIP欠損はGLUT1の細胞膜移行、糖取り込み、PI3K/mTOR経路の活性化を促し、感受性遺伝子の候補と考えられた。
pmid-42705594.summary_en: Whole-exome sequencing in a family with recurrent multifocal ovarian mature teratoma identified a rare germline TXNIP missense variant, p.Pro350Leu. The variant showed lower protein abundance, faster decay, and greater K48-linked polyubiquitination. Familial tumors had weaker TXNIP and stronger GLUT1 staining than sporadic ones. TXNIP depletion increased GLUT1 membrane localization, glucose uptake, lactate production, and PI3K/mTOR signaling, suggesting TXNIP as a candidate susceptibility gene.

pmid-42699898.summary_ja: 縦隔に浸潤した右上葉気管支内奇形腫の稀な症例報告。
pmid-42699898.summary_en: Case report of a rare endobronchial teratoma of the right upper lobe invading the mediastinum, treated with en bloc thymectomy and lobectomy.

pmid-42699474.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫による抗NMDA受容体自己免疫性脳炎を発症した17歳女性の症例報告と文献レビュー。
pmid-42699474.summary_en: Case report and literature review of anti-NMDA receptor autoimmune encephalitis due to ovarian teratoma in a 17-year-old woman.

pmid-40395097.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化の男性334例を後方視的に検討した研究です。生検を受けた137例中10例（7.3%）で胚細胞腫瘍in situ病変が見つかり、いずれも精巣萎縮を伴っていました。中央値4.7年の追跡で精巣がんは3例（0.9%）に発生しました。精巣萎縮がある場合にのみ生検を考慮すべきと結論されています。
pmid-40395097.summary_en: A retrospective review of 334 men diagnosed with testicular microlithiasis at a tertiary center from 2013 to 2023. Among 137 men who underwent biopsy, germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS) was found in 10 (7.3%), all in testes with both microlithiasis and hypotrophy. Testicular cancer developed in three men (0.9%) over a median follow-up of 4.7 years. The authors conclude that biopsy should be considered in men with incidental microlithiasis only when testicular size is reduced, given the low subsequent cancer risk.

pmid-40494333.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の治療を総説した。シスプラチン併用化学療法で高い治癒率が得られ、組織型、病変の広がり、国際分類に基づくリスクに応じて治療を調整する。非セミノーマでは化学療法後の残存腫瘤切除が重要である。多重再発・プラチナ抵抗性例に対する新規治療、減量戦略、生存者プログラムの必要性を強調している。
pmid-40494333.summary_en: This review summarizes management of advanced germ cell tumors, which are highly curable with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. Treatment is tailored to primary histology, disease spread and International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group risk. Bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin is the most common regimen, and post-chemotherapy residual mass resection is key for non-seminomas. Platinum-based conventional or high-dose chemotherapy can cure about half of patients who relapse after first-line treatment. The authors call for de-escalation strategies, survivorship programs and new treatments for multiply relapsed, platinum-resistant disease.

pmid-40513041.summary_ja: 病期II精巣セミノーマに対し、若年患者の毒性軽減を目指す新たな治療戦略（シスプラチン減量療法、化学放射線療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清）を評価した総説。小規模研究では有望だが長期成績は不足。標準治療の治癒率を損なわないことの重要性を強調。
pmid-40513041.summary_en: This review examines emerging strategies for stage II testicular seminoma, aiming to reduce treatment toxicity in young patients without compromising cure. It discusses cisplatin-sparing chemotherapy, combined chemoradiotherapy, and primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Small studies report promising efficacy with minimal toxicity, but long-term follow-up is lacking. The authors argue that standard cisplatin-based chemotherapy and radiotherapy achieve excellent cure rates that should not be taken for granted, and they weigh each approach against both harm prevention and disease control.

pmid-40590132.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う高分化型卵巣神経内分泌腫瘍の1例を報告した。[68Ga]Ga-DOTATATE PET/CTで神経内分泌成分のソマトスタチン受容体発現を評価でき、奇形腫の形態評価と併せて有用であった。治療診断（セラノスティクス）への応用の可能性にも言及している。
pmid-40590132.summary_en: This clinical nuclear medicine report describes a well-differentiated ovarian neuroendocrine tumor associated with a mature cystic teratoma in a single patient. Histologic diagnosis of such combined lesions is challenging because no defined guidelines exist. The authors show that [68Ga]Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT can evaluate somatostatin receptor expression of the neuroendocrine component while morphologic features assist in identifying the teratoma. They also note the potential for theranostic treatment approaches for these rare tumors.

pmid-40620063.summary_ja: 精巣と腎に生じた原発性泌尿生殖器神経内分泌腫瘍の2例を報告した症例報告。精巣NETは偶然発見され、当初は通常型の胚細胞腫瘍と考えられたが、低異型度のカルチノイド形態を示し、奇形腫や胚細胞内腫瘍は認められなかった。純粋な精巣NETは、12p等染色体を欠く単一胚葉性奇形腫として論じられている。
pmid-40620063.summary_en: This report presents two patients with primary genitourinary neuroendocrine tumors, one testicular and one renal. The testicular NET was incidentally found and initially thought to be a conventional germ cell tumor, but showed pure low-grade carcinoid morphology without teratoma or germ cell neoplasia in situ. The authors discuss pure testicular NET as a prepubertal-type monodermal teratoma lacking isochromosome 12p. The renal NET metastasized to liver, lymph node and bone and carried an ERCC2 alteration, highlighting the need to recognize NETs at unusual sites.

pmid-40628611.summary_ja: PSTT患者63例を対象に、妊孕性温存治療を扱った文献16編をシステマティックレビューで解析した。大半はFIGO病期I期であった。再発率は13.8%で、再発例はすべて子宮摘出術を受けた。全妊娠率は患者あたり36.5%であった。適切な症例では妊孕性温存治療が実行可能で安全と結論している。
pmid-40628611.summary_en: This systematic review of PubMed, Scopus and Cochrane Library identified 16 articles covering 63 patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor treated with fertility-sparing management. Most patients were FIGO stage I. The overall recurrence rate was 13.8%, and all recurrences were treated with hysterectomy. Among the cohort, 23 full-term pregnancies were reported, corresponding to a 36.5% fertility rate per patient. The authors conclude that fertility-sparing management is feasible and oncologically safe in selected patients with PSTT.

pmid-40658795.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症患者の精巣体細胞を単一細胞RNAシーケンス解析し、公開データと統合した。非遺伝性の非閉塞性無精子症で、セミノーマ微小環境関連遺伝子の発現が最も高かった。テストステロン/エストラジオール比の低下が胚細胞がんの予後と関連した。
pmid-40658795.summary_en: This study performed single-cell RNA sequencing of testicular somatic cells from a patient with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome and integrated published datasets from normal testis, non-obstructive azoospermia, Klinefelter syndrome and germinal testicular cancer. Leydig cells were immature and senescent across conditions, and those in non-genetic non-obstructive azoospermia with primary hypogonadism showed the highest expression of seminoma-microenvironment and estrogen-responsive transcripts. In 343 testicular cancer patients and other cohorts, a decreasing testosterone-to-estradiol ratio carried prognostic value for germ cell cancer in non-genetic azoospermia. The authors suggest this ratio may guide aromatase inhibitor eligibility.

pmid-40686340.summary_ja: 小児三次施設で卵巣腫瘤に対し手術を受けた女性患者409例を後方視的に検討し、悪性または境界悪性31例(7.6%)を抽出。胚細胞腫瘍が最多(51.6%)で、未熟奇形腫が最も多かった。病期IまたはIIが大半で、術前腫瘍マーカーが未測定の例が21%あった。化学療法13例、再発4例、死亡7例。長期フォローアップと成人移行後の婦人科医の理解の重要性を指摘。
pmid-40686340.summary_en: This retrospective chart review of female patients who underwent surgery for ovarian masses at a pediatric tertiary center identified 31 of 409 (7.6%) with malignant or borderline masses. Germ cell tumors were the most common histology (51.6%), with immature teratoma the most frequent subtype. Most patients presented at stage I or II, and 21% had no tumor markers drawn preoperatively. Thirteen received chemotherapy, four recurred, and seven died. The authors stress the need for long-term surveillance and for gynecologists to be familiar with these patients as they transition from pediatric care.

pmid-40694856.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値と生検で確定した前縦隔セミノーマの30歳男性の症例報告。治療前の初期病期分類として18F-FDG PET/CTと68Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CTの両方を実施し、FAPIイメージングの有用性を検討した。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍は縦隔腫瘍の1~4%を占める。
pmid-40694856.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with elevated human chorionic gonadotropin and biopsy-proven seminoma of the anterior mediastinum. Before treatment, he underwent both 18F-FDG PET/CT and 68Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CT for primary staging, to examine whether FAPI imaging has a role in treatment-naive mediastinal seminoma. The report notes that germ cell tumors make up 1% to 4% of mediastinal tumors and that seminomas are less frequent than non-seminomatous tumors, providing the rationale for comparing these tracers in this rare setting.

pmid-40704674.summary_ja: 女性骨盤内の稀少腫瘍を放射線科医の視点から臓器別に解説した総説。卵巣では脂質に乏しい奇形腫、卵巣甲状腺腫、未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマを扱う。画像所見の理解を通じて治療計画への貢献を目指す。
pmid-40704674.summary_en: This review addresses rare tumors of the female pelvis from a radiologist's perspective, organized by organ. Covered entities include uterine leiomyosarcoma, endometrial stromal sarcoma, carcinosarcoma, cervical gastric-type adenocarcinoma, and ovarian tumors such as lipid-poor teratoma, struma ovarii, immature teratoma and dysgerminoma. Lymphoma, neuroendocrine tumors, aggressive angiomyxoma and metastases occurring at multiple sites are also discussed. The authors aim to increase radiologists' familiarity with these uncommon entities so they can better inform treatment planning.

pmid-40705524.summary_ja: 28歳女性の無症候性腹部腫瘤で、造影MRIとPET/CTから傍神経節腫が疑われた。しかし術後病理で甲状腺組織を含む奇形腫と確定した。甲状腺組織のソマトスタチン受容体発現が偽陽性の68Ga-DOTATATE集積の原因と考えられた。
pmid-40705524.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman presented with an incidentally found asymptomatic abdominal mass. Contrast-enhanced MRI showed a retroperitoneal lesion with arterial hyperenhancement and washout, suggesting paraganglioma. 18F-FDG PET/CT showed mild, heterogeneous uptake, while 68Ga-DOTATATE PET/CT showed intense uptake, further supporting that diagnosis. Postoperative pathology, however, confirmed a teratoma containing thyroid tissue that expressed somatostatin receptor subtypes 2 and 5. This ectopic thyroid tissue likely explained the false-positive 68Ga-DOTATATE uptake. The report highlights this pitfall when evaluating retroperitoneal masses with high somatostatin receptor tracer uptake.

pmid-40716419.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍63例の90腫瘍成分でENPP1の免疫組織化学染色を行った研究です。胎児性癌で発現が最も高く、セミノーマも他の組織型より高値でした。転移巣は原発巣より低値でした。正常精巣の胚細胞では発現がなく、ENPP1阻害薬による標的治療の可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-40716419.summary_en: An immunohistochemical study of ENPP1 expression in 90 tumor components from 63 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, with comparison to normal testis and in silico TCGA and Human Protein Atlas analyses. ENPP1 was highest in embryonal carcinoma and significantly higher in seminoma than in other subtypes, and was lower in metastatic than in primary tumors. It was absent in normal testicular germ cells. The authors suggest that TGCTs, especially embryonal carcinoma, may respond to ENPP1 inhibitors, with low fertility-related toxicity risk.

pmid-40820051.summary_ja: 化学療法後に生じる血管形成性間葉系病変（VML）のFOXA2とHNF1β発現を免疫組織化学で検討した基礎研究。VMLでは発現が乏しく、卵黄嚢腫瘍から間葉系表現型への転換の機序が示唆された。
pmid-40820051.summary_en: This laboratory study examined FOXA2 and HNF1β expression in vasculogenic mesenchymal lesions (VMLs), rare germ cell tumor-derived phenotypes that typically arise after chemotherapy for mediastinal yolk sac tumor. VMLs lacked significant FOXA2 and HNF1β expression, unlike conventional yolk sac tumors, which express them strongly. The findings suggest that combined downregulation of these transcription factors may underlie the transformation of yolk sac tumor into mesenchymal phenotypes, resembling the pathway of sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor, although the factors that determine the final phenotype remain unclear.

pmid-40820398.summary_ja: 2歳男児の左頬部(咬筋間隙)に4.6cm大の無痛性腫脹があり、頭蓋内病変は認められなかった。組織学的に脈絡叢様の乳頭状増殖を伴う嚢胞性奇形腫で、神経外胚葉成分を免疫染色で確認した。頬部での初報告である。
pmid-40820398.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with a slowly growing left facial swelling in the masseteric space measuring 4.6 × 3.6 × 3.7 cm, with no intracranial involvement. Histology showed cystic cavities lined by flat cells with focal choroid plexus-like papillary proliferations and a capsule of glial fibrillary material, without dermoid, epidermoid, bone or cartilage. Immunohistochemistry for GFAP, keratin, vimentin and S100 confirmed neuroectodermal components. The final diagnosis was cystic teratoma with neuroectodermal cyst, which the authors describe as the first such case in the cheek.

pmid-40820406.summary_ja: 妊娠20週で診断された巨大な胎児心膜内奇形腫の症例報告。胎児心エコーと超音波検査で経過を追跡した。急速な胎児水腫と母体のミラー症候群を契機に、EXIT手技で胎盤循環下に奇形腫を完全切除し、母児ともに良好な転帰を得た。連続的な胎児心エコーが重要な出生前ツールであり、EXIT下の切除は安全な選択肢と結論づけている。
pmid-40820406.summary_en: This case report describes a large fetal intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed at 20 weeks' gestation and followed with serial fetal echocardiography and ultrasound. Sudden progression to fetal hydrops with maternal mirror syndrome prompted delivery by ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) to resection, during which the teratoma was completely removed while on placental-fetal circulation. Both mother and baby had successful outcomes. The authors conclude that serial fetal echocardiography is a key prenatal tool, and EXIT-to-resection is a safe option for large pericardial teratomas.

pmid-40927896.summary_ja: 35歳男性の前縦隔腫瘤(9.2cm)による縦隔圧迫例で、超音波ガイド下穿刺細胞診により体細胞型腺癌が奇形腫に伴うと示唆された。切除標本の病理組織学的検査で確定した。良性腸上皮成分が奇形腫起源を強く示した。
pmid-40927896.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with mediastinal compression from a 9.2 cm heterogeneous anterior mediastinal mass. Ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration cytology showed malignant epithelial clusters with mucin and benign intestinal epithelial cells, suggesting somatic-type adenocarcinoma arising in a teratoma. Histopathology of the excised mass confirmed the cytological diagnosis. The authors note that the benign intestinal component strongly favored a teratomatous origin over primary aerodigestive or metastatic adenocarcinoma. They conclude that imaging-guided cytology is a minimally invasive and effective tool for early diagnosis in acute mediastinal obstruction.

pmid-40936013.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍46例でNectin-4の免疫組織化学染色を行った予備的研究です。膜発現は全体の15.7%に限られましたが、絨毛癌と孤立性合胞栄養細胞では有意に高値でした。化学療法後の転移性再発例にも陽性例がありました。絨毛癌や再発例がエンホルツマブ・ベドチンの適応候補となりうると示唆されています。
pmid-40936013.summary_en: A preliminary immunohistochemical study of Nectin-4 expression in 46 testicular germ cell tumor cases, mostly chemo-naive primary tumors plus four post-chemotherapy metastatic recurrences. Membrane Nectin-4 was positive in only 15.7% of components, but choriocarcinoma and isolated syncytiotrophoblast cells showed significantly higher expression than other components. Two of four post-chemotherapy recurrences and three embryonal carcinomas showed weak membrane positivity. The authors suggest aggressive subtypes, especially choriocarcinoma and post-chemotherapy recurrences, may be candidates for enfortumab vedotin, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting Nectin-4.

pmid-40944935.summary_ja: 2015~2023年に単施設で治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍133例を後方視的に解析し、ナポリ予後スコア(NPS)の予後的意義を検討した。高NPS群は非セミノーマ、進行病期、腫瘍マーカー高値、転移を示す頻度が高く、全生存期間が不良だった。臨床病期とは独立した予後因子であり、前向きな検証を経てリスク層別化への応用が提案されている。
pmid-40944935.summary_en: This retrospective study assessed the Naples Prognostic Score in 133 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated at a single center from 2015 to 2023. NPS was calculated from albumin, cholesterol, neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and lymphocyte-to-monocyte ratio, and patients were divided into low and high score groups. High NPS was associated with non-seminomatous histology, advanced stage, elevated tumor markers and metastasis, and it independently predicted worse overall survival alongside clinical stage (hazard ratio about 8.4). The authors propose NPS for risk stratification, pending prospective validation.

pmid-40946924.summary_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清と同時に精巣摘除術を受けた57例を後方視的に解析した。両検体の組織像の一致は50.9%であった。ブレオマイシン投与などの因子は、精巣内の奇形腫の予測因子とならなかった。精巣腫瘤の約60%に壊死を認めた。化学療法後の精巣摘除術の遅延は標準治療として維持すべきと結論している。
pmid-40946924.summary_en: This retrospective institutional study examined 57 patients who had orchiectomy concurrently with post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Histology concordance between the two specimens was observed in 50.9% of patients. None of the assessed factors, including bleomycin receipt, testis mass size, age and chemotherapy timing, significantly predicted teratoma in the orchiectomy specimen. Necrosis was present in about 60% of testicular masses, and ITGCN occurred in 1.5%. The authors conclude delayed orchiectomy after upfront chemotherapy should remain standard care.

pmid-40965760.summary_ja: 奇形腫の各種モダリティにおける特徴的な画像所見を、全身の部位にわたり概説した。捻転、破裂、出血、二次感染、悪性転化、自己免疫性脳炎などの救急で重要な合併症に焦点を当てている。合併症の迅速な認識と標準治療の要点を示す。
pmid-40965760.summary_en: This pictorial review describes the characteristic imaging appearances of teratomas across multiple modalities and body sites. It focuses on emergency presentations and complications, including torsion, rupture, hemorrhage, secondary infection, malignant transformation and autoimmune encephalitis. The authors emphasize timely recognition of these complications and summarize current standard of care. The review is intended to help radiologists identify teratomas and their complications promptly, particularly in emergency settings.

pmid-40982754.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫と診断された乳児の症例報告。入院5日目に完全切除を行ったが、Enterobacter cloacaeによる創感染と創離開が生じた。先進的ドレッシング材と陰圧閉鎖療法の併用で創治癒が進み、18日目に上皮化を認めて退院した。3か月の電話による経過観察では瘢痕形成のみで合併症はなかった。大型仙尾部奇形腫切除後の創管理の参考となる。
pmid-40982754.summary_en: This case report describes an infant with sacrococcygeal teratoma who underwent complete surgical resection on day 5 of admission. The wound became infected with Enterobacter cloacae and dehisced. Advanced dressings combined with vacuum sealing drainage promoted healing, with good epithelialization by day 18 and discharge. Three months of telephone follow-up showed scar formation without complications. The report highlights wound management strategies after resection of large sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-40999839.summary_ja: 横行結腸間膜から発生した原発性腸間膜悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍の34歳女性の症例報告。無症候性腹部腫瘤でAFPが31,252ng/mLと著明に上昇。腹腔鏡下切除で診断された。術前診断の困難さと予後不良を指摘。
pmid-40999839.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with primary mesenteric malignant yolk sac tumor arising from the transverse mesocolon. She presented with an asymptomatic abdominal mass and markedly elevated AFP of 31,252 ng/mL. Imaging showed a well-circumscribed solid mass, and laparoscopic resection with pathological examination confirmed the diagnosis. The authors discuss the diagnostic strategies, treatment debates, and prognosis of this rare tumor, noting that preoperative diagnosis is difficult and outcomes are poor.

pmid-41021390.summary_ja: 51歳男性で消化器症状があり、盲腸と上行結腸に大きな潰瘍浸潤性腫瘤を認めた。生検では当初大腸腺癌が疑われたが、セミノーマの浸潤であった。右停留精巣が判明し、右半結腸切除で回盲部の残存精巣と大腸浸潤を確認した。
pmid-41021390.summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old man with gastrointestinal symptoms and a large ulcero-infiltrative caecal and ascending colon mass. Biopsy was initially suspected to be colonic adenocarcinoma but showed seminoma infiltration. Clinicoradiological evaluation revealed right cryptorchidism. Right hemicolectomy showed an adherent remnant cryptorchid testis at the ileocaecal junction and colonic infiltration by seminoma. The authors conclude that accurate biopsy diagnosis is decisive for planning timely surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy when seminoma presents at an unusual site.

pmid-41077518.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の術後15例を後方視的に評価。平均8.5年の追跡で13例が完全な尿失禁の改善を示した。便秘は3例に見られ、機能障害は主にAltman IV型に限られた。非侵襲的検査の優先を提案。
pmid-41077518.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated lower urinary tract and bowel function in 15 patients who underwent surgery for sacrococcygeal teratoma, with a mean follow-up of 8.5 years. Most had Altman type I or II tumors. Thirteen of 15 achieved full urinary continence, and ultrasound and most urodynamic findings were normal. Constipation occurred in three patients, and bowel control was generally satisfactory. Dysfunction was mainly seen in the type IV patient, and the authors suggest noninvasive testing should be prioritized for types I and II.

pmid-41083654.summary_ja: 1994～2023年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍277例を、10年ごとの3期間で後方視的に解析した。病期I、40歳以上の割合が増え、セミノーマは倍増した。積極的監視が増加し、補助化学療法は減少した。原病特異的10年生存率は改善した。
pmid-41083654.summary_en: This retrospective single-centre study analysed 277 patients with testicular germ cell tumours treated from 1994 to 2023 across three 10-year periods. Incidence and the proportion of stage I disease and patients aged 40 or older increased significantly, and seminoma incidence doubled. Active surveillance increased while adjuvant chemotherapy declined. Recurrence rates decreased without statistical significance. Cause-specific 10-year survival improved from 95% to 97.2%, while overall survival remained around 94%. Second primary malignancies, including contralateral testicular cancer and second malignant neoplasms, and non-cancer mortality were notable, supporting long-term survivorship care.

pmid-41087724.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の9例を病理組織学、免疫組織化学、次世代シーケンサーで解析した症例集積です。全例が片側性の病期I、奇形腫性卵巣に生じた甲状腺型癌でした。RAS様とBRAF様に分類され、WHO 2022分類の有用性が示唆されました。術後は全例が無病で経過しています。
pmid-41087724.summary_en: A series of nine malignant struma ovarii cases analyzed by histopathology, immunohistochemistry, and targeted next-generation sequencing. All tumors were unilateral FIGO stage I thyroid-type carcinomas arising within teratomatous ovaries, mostly papillary or follicular types. NRAS/HRAS Q61 and BRAF mutations were found in several cases, and novel EIF1AX, PTEN, KMT2C, and BRCA1 alterations were identified. Tumors were classified as RAS-like or BRAF-like per WHO 2022 criteria, supporting that framework for risk stratification. All patients remained disease-free after surgery over 4 to 120 months of follow-up.

pmid-41088975.summary_ja: 組織学的に確定した卵巣甲状腺腫16例の超音波所見と臨床的特徴を後方視的に解析した研究。大きな嚢胞成分、石灰化、Doppler血流パターンが特徴的で、他の付属器腫瘤との鑑別に有用と考えられた。O-RADS 3-5の腫瘤では本疾患を鑑別に挙げることを提案している。
pmid-41088975.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed ultrasound and clinical features of 16 histologically confirmed struma ovarii cases, a thyroid-tissue-predominant ovarian teratoma. Key parameters included size, echo pattern, calcification, Adler Doppler grade and pelvic effusion. Half the patients were postmenopausal, and most tumors were incidental. Large cystic components with regular margins, calcified and vascularized solid elements, and specific Doppler patterns were characteristic and distinguished struma ovarii from other adnexal masses. The authors recommend considering it in O-RADS 3-5 adnexal masses with these features.

pmid-41092443.summary_ja: 現役米軍兵士2例の精巣がん関連死亡を報告した。1例は解剖で大動脈を圧排する骨盤内転移性混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。もう1例はβ-hCG高値と広範転移を示し、精巣摘除の遅れと化学療法後に肺出血で死亡した。軍人特有の要因が診療に与える影響を考察している。
pmid-41092443.summary_en: This article presents two case reports of active-duty U.S. military members who died from testicular cancer complications. Case 1 was found dead, and autopsy revealed a pelvic mass disrupting the aorta, later identified as metastatic mixed germ cell tumor. Case 2 presented with a testicular mass and widespread metastases, serum beta-hCG above 250,000, and died from pulmonary hemorrhage after delayed orchiectomy and chemotherapy. The authors discuss how military-specific factors may affect testicular cancer care and suggest areas for improvement.

pmid-41118662.summary_ja: 17施設とIOTAデータベースから原発性卵巣未熟奇形腫64例を集め、術前超音波所見を後方視的に記述した研究。多くは片側性で大きな固形成分を伴い、中等度の血流を示した。固形成分の不均一で奇異な高エコー像が特徴的で、評価可能例の84.2%に認められた。術前の疑いが妊孕性温存手術の判断に役立つと述べている。
pmid-41118662.summary_en: This retrospective study with sonographic review collected 64 women with primary ovarian immature teratoma, without other germ cell components, from 17 ultrasound centers and the IOTA database. Most tumors were unilateral, multilocular-solid or solid, and large, with a median diameter of about 150 mm and moderate vascularity. The most typical feature was heterogeneous, bizarre echogenicity of solid components with hyperechogenic areas, cystic spaces and acoustic shadows, present in 84.2% of assessable cases. The authors suggest this pattern can guide preoperative suspicion and fertility-sparing surgery planning.

pmid-41128509.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の過剰治療、奇形腫の鑑別、再発予測、シスプラチン耐性などの課題を概説した。マイクロRNAのmiR-371a-3pは非侵襲的診断で高い感度と特異度を示し、臨床導入が近い。FOXA2は卵黄嚢腫瘍の免疫組織化学的マーカーとして有望である。
pmid-41128509.summary_en: This review of testicular germ cell tumours summarises challenges including overtreatment, discrimination of teratoma, prediction of relapse and cisplatin resistance. MicroRNAs, particularly miR-371a-3p, show high sensitivity and specificity for noninvasive diagnosis and are approaching clinical implementation. FOXA2 is a novel immunohistochemical marker for yolk sac tumour diagnosis. Circulating tumour DNA is promising for minimal residual disease detection. The authors conclude that miR-371a-3p remains the most promising biomarker, while future liquid biopsy studies should address teratoma detection and relapse prediction.

pmid-41150616.summary_ja: 化学療法後に残存腫瘤を有する精巣がん患者を対象に、両側神経温存の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を開発し施行した報告。献体での訓練を経て10例に実施し、全例で腰部内臓神経を温存した。射精機能は9例で保たれた。
pmid-41150616.summary_en: The authors developed a bilateral nerve-sparing laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer patients with small residual masses after chemotherapy. The technique was first practiced on Thiel-fixed cadavers to identify and preserve the lumbar splanchnic nerves. Ten patients, six with non-seminoma and four with seminoma, underwent the procedure with low blood loss. Nerves were preserved in all cases, ejaculatory function was retained in nine, and grade 1 chyle leakage occurred in five patients, all managed conservatively. Long-term oncologic follow-up is still required.

pmid-41193406.summary_ja: 5名の専門病理医が、非定型胎盤部結節、胎盤部結節、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍の50症例を評価した。合意は96%で得られたが、索引診断との一致は75%、Fleissのκは0.46で、非定型胎盤部結節で最も低かった。3項目以上の懸念所見が過剰診断の回避に有用と考えられた。
pmid-41193406.summary_en: This interobserver reproducibility study assessed how five expert pathologists classified 50 cases of atypical placental site nodule (APSN), placental site nodule (PSN) or epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) using whole slide images. Consensus was reached in 96% of cases, but agreement with the index diagnosis was 75%, with a Fleiss kappa of 0.46, lowest for APSN. Extensive lesional tissue and Ki-67 showed substantial agreement. Most APSN had 3 to 6 worrisome features, PSN usually fewer than two, and ETT six or more. The authors suggest that three or more worrisome features may be a reasonable threshold to limit APSN overdiagnosis.

pmid-41203136.summary_ja: 卵巣神経外胚葉性腫瘍15例を対象に、DNAメチル化解析、EWSR1 FISH、免疫組織化学を用いた後方視的研究。73%に奇形腫成分を伴っていた。メチル化分類と形態診断の一致は30%に過ぎず、新規のETMR非C19MC変異型が3例で見つかった。この亜型や不一致例は予後が極めて不良であった。中枢神経系腫瘍の分類器を卵巣由来の腫瘍の分子亜型分類と予後層別化に応用する可能性を示した。
pmid-41203136.summary_en: This retrospective study of 15 patients with ovarian neuroectodermal tumors applied DNA methylation profiling, EWSR1 FISH, and immunohistochemistry. A teratoma background was present in 73%. Methylation classification matched morphology in only 30%, and a novel ETMR non-C19MC-altered subtype was found in three patients. Tumors with that subtype or unmatched classification had very poor outcomes, with 80% mortality within 12 months. The authors suggest CNS-tumor methylation classifiers may support molecular subtyping and prognosis of ovarian NETs.

pmid-41212998.summary_ja: 臨床病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍207例に対する初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清の後方視的研究です。腫瘍マーカー上昇例は31%で、5年再発非発生率は75%（マーカー陰性例は93%）でした。外科的合併症率は両群で差がありませんでした。マーカー陽性例でも約75%が長期的に制御されました。
pmid-41212998.summary_en: A retrospective review of 207 patients with clinical stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection between 1983 and 2022. Sixty-five patients (31%) had elevated tumor markers, which were associated with higher relapse risk: 5-year relapse-free survival was 75% versus 93% in marker-negative patients. Cancer-specific survival was 96% versus 100%, and surgical complication rates were similar. Primary RPLND achieved long-term disease control in about 75% of marker-positive patients, a option to weigh against chemotherapy morbidity.

pmid-41215548.summary_ja: 男性に生じた巨大な右副腎奇形腫の症例報告。副腎奇形腫は稀な胚細胞腫瘍で、非特異的な症状のため見逃されやすい。超音波検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の所見を整理し、代表例を提示しながら鑑別診断の方針を示す。画像所見に基づく術前評価の重要性を強調している。
pmid-41215548.summary_en: This case report describes a large right adrenal teratoma in a male patient, a rare germ cell neoplasm often underrecognized due to nonspecific symptoms. The article summarizes its ultrasonographic and computed tomography features and proposes evidence-based strategies for differential diagnosis, illustrated by a representative case. It highlights how imaging characteristics can guide radiologic characterization and help distinguish adrenal teratoma from other adrenal masses to support accurate preoperative assessment.

pmid-41217379.summary_ja: 子宮内膜症性嚢胞と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の併存する卵巣衝突腫瘍の新規19例に、既報30例を加えた計49例を検討した。腹痛が最多の症状で、多くで嚢胞摘出術が行われた。妊孕性温存を希望した10例中、自然妊娠に至ったのは1例のみであった。組織診断と卵巣予備能の温存の重要性を強調している。
pmid-41217379.summary_en: This case series and literature review describes 19 new cases of ovarian collision tumors combining endometriomas and mature cystic teratomas, along with 30 previously reported cases, for a total of 49 patients. Mean age was 32.3 years, abdominal pain was the most common symptom, and most patients underwent cystectomy. Ten of the new patients desired fertility preservation, and only one achieved spontaneous pregnancy. The authors emphasize that tissue diagnosis excludes malignancy and that ovarian reserve preservation is equally important.

pmid-41233203.summary_ja: 2012～2023年にテキサス州バクサー郡で診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍297例を後方視的に解析した。社会経済的困難度が高いほど進行期診断が多く、無増悪生存期間も不良であった。非セミノーマで特に顕著で、経済的・地理的な障壁の解消が必要と結論された。
pmid-41233203.summary_en: This retrospective county-wide audit included 297 testicular germ cell tumour patients diagnosed in Bexar County, Texas, from 2012 to 2023. Greater socioeconomic hardship on the hardship index was significantly associated with late-stage diagnosis, and uninsured patients and those living farther from hospitals were more likely to present late. Uninsured patients had longer treatment delays. Greater hardship was associated with higher progression risk and poorer progression-free survival in the overall cohort and in non-seminoma patients, but not in seminoma patients. The authors call for interventions addressing economic, educational and geographic barriers.

pmid-41259847.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う腹膜神経膠腫症23例の多施設症例集積。大部分は高悪性度の未熟奇形腫で、87%が妊孕性温存手術を受けた。再発の多くは成熟型で、全例が生存し3例が生児を得た。
pmid-41259847.summary_en: This international multicenter retrospective case series describes 23 women with gliomatosis peritonei associated with ovarian teratoma, mostly immature and high-grade, in young patients. Most tumors were early stage, and fertility-sparing surgery was performed in 87%. Twelve patients relapsed, but only two relapses contained immature components, suggesting most recurrences are mature. All patients were alive at median follow-up of 81 months, and three had live births. The authors suggest fertility-sparing treatment may be considered in premenopausal patients.

pmid-41263775.summary_ja: 2005～2024年に施行された小型精巣腫瘤135例の凍結切片検査を解析した。感度100%、特異度96.3%、一致率97.7%であった。良性診断により81例の根治的精巣摘除術を回避でき、偽陰性はなかった。小型病変の管理に有用である。
pmid-41263775.summary_en: This single-institution study reported 135 frozen section examinations on excisional biopsies of small testicular masses performed between 2005 and 2024. The most common frozen diagnoses were Leydig cell hyperplasia or tumour and seminoma. Sensitivity and specificity for malignancy were 100% and 96.3%, with concordance of 97.7% after excluding three indeterminate cases. Benign diagnoses avoided 81 unnecessary radical orchidectomies. There were three false-positive diagnoses and no false negatives. The authors conclude that frozen section examination is accurate for managing small testicular lesions and should be used more widely.

pmid-41292152.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍56例(ディスジャーミノーマ23、卵黄嚢腫瘍14、未熟奇形腫19)の腫瘍微小環境を免疫組織化学・トランスクリプトーム・多重免疫蛍光で解析。ディスジャーミノーマは免疫応答が活発な「ホット」型、未熟奇形腫は「コールド」型、卵黄嚢腫瘍はM2マクロファージが優勢であった。全亜型でMHCクラスIの消失を認め、その回復がディスジャーミノーマの免疫療法を強化しうる。
pmid-41292152.summary_en: This study analyzed 56 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (23 dysgerminomas, 14 yolk sac tumors, 19 immature teratomas) using immunohistochemistry, transcriptomics, and multiplex immunofluorescence. Dysgerminomas were immunologically 'hot', with abundant T, B, and M1 macrophage infiltration and tertiary lymphoid structures, and upregulated checkpoint molecules. Yolk sac tumors were dominated by M2 macrophages, and immature teratomas were 'cold'. All subtypes showed loss of MHC class I, suggesting that restoring MHC class I could improve T-cell immunotherapy in dysgerminoma.

pmid-41297847.summary_ja: PRISMAに準拠し、小児卵巣類皮嚢腫の腹腔鏡手術と開腹手術を比較したシステマティックレビューとメタ解析である（6研究）。腹腔鏡では術中嚢胞破裂リスクが有意に高かった（RR 2.47）。再発に差はなく、化学性腹膜炎も認められなかった。
pmid-41297847.summary_en: This PRISMA-guided systematic review and meta-analysis compared laparoscopy and laparotomy for ovarian dermoid cysts in children and adolescents, based on six included studies. Laparoscopy was associated with a significantly higher risk of intraoperative cyst rupture (RR 2.47). Cyst recurrence did not differ between approaches (RR 0.92), and no chemical peritonitis was observed. The authors conclude that laparoscopy may carry greater rupture risk but postoperative outcomes such as peritonitis and recurrence were similar.

pmid-41317312.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の新生児5例の後方視的症例集積。4例が出生前診断され、胎児MRIが超音波を補完してリスク評価と分娩計画に役立った。全例で尾骨切除術を施行し、8～36か月の経過観察で再発はなかった。
pmid-41317312.summary_en: This retrospective case series reviews five neonates treated for sacrococcygeal teratoma, four diagnosed prenatally. Fetal MRI complemented ultrasound in risk stratification and delivery planning. One patient required in utero intervention for hydrops, and one tumor was reclassified to a higher Altman type during surgery. All underwent coccygectomy, and two needed plastic closure. Pathology showed mature or immature teratoma. Follow-up of 8 to 36 months showed no recurrence and good cosmetic and functional results, emphasizing prenatal diagnosis and multidisciplinary care.

pmid-41317416.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清検体における卵黄嚢腫瘍の変異型、トロホブラスト腫瘍、体細胞型悪性腫瘍の形態学的スペクトラムをレビューした。化学療法後には、卵黄嚢腫瘍での腺様、肝様、壁側、肉腫様分化が増える。病理組織学、免疫組織化学、臨床情報の統合が不可欠である。
pmid-41317416.summary_en: This review examines the morphologic spectrum of yolk sac tumor variants, trophoblastic tumors and somatic-type malignancies in postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimens from patients with testicular germ cell tumors. The authors highlight increased frequency after chemotherapy of glandular, hepatoid, parietal and sarcomatoid differentiation in yolk sac tumors, and of cystic, epithelioid and placental site trophoblastic tumors, sarcomas, adenocarcinomas and embryonal-type neuroectodermal tumors. They emphasize that integrating histopathology, immunohistochemistry, clinical history and imaging is essential, since these entities carry distinct prognostic implications and affect management decisions.

pmid-41317609.summary_ja: 46,XYのSwyer症候群でディスジャーミノーマまたは性腺芽腫を発症した女性表現型の思春期患者2例の症例集積です。妊孕性温存手術と補助化学療法の後、個別化したホルモン補充を行い、6年および10年の経過観察で再発はありませんでした。文献レビューでは妊娠関連合併症は多いものの新生児転帰は概ね良好でした。長期のホルモン補充は安全と結論されています。
pmid-41317609.summary_en: A case series of two adolescents with Swyer syndrome (46,XY) and dysgerminoma or gonadoblastoma, treated with fertility-sparing surgery, adjuvant chemotherapy, and individualized hormone replacement therapy. Over 6 and 10 years of follow-up, neither patient had recurrence or significant HRT-related adverse events, and uterine size approached normal adult dimensions. A systematic review of 17 studies (24 patients, 30 pregnancies) reported high pregnancy-related complications but favorable neonatal outcomes. The authors conclude long-term HRT is safe after curative treatment and call for large prospective studies.

pmid-41319368.summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者4例から採取した末梢血と腫瘍内NK細胞を解析し、17例の組織で阻害性リガンドHLA-Eの発現を免疫組織化学で確認した基礎研究。腫瘍組織ではNK細胞が血液より多く、JAR細胞との共培養でHLA-Eが上昇した。HLA-E抑制はNK細胞傷害を増強し、NK細胞を介した免疫回避にHLA-Eが関与すると示唆された。
pmid-41319368.summary_en: This translational study isolated NK cells from choriocarcinoma tissue and peripheral blood of four patients and examined inhibitory ligand expression in tissues from 17 patients. NK cells were more abundant in tumor tissue than in blood, and HLA-E was expressed. Coculture of JAR choriocarcinoma cells with interleukin-2-stimulated NK cells upregulated HLA-E and activated cytokine pathways. HLA-E knockdown increased NK-mediated cytotoxicity, while interferon-gamma increased HLA-E and tumor cell survival. The authors propose that HLA-E mediates NK-related immune evasion in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-41335548.summary_ja: 10.8歳男児が急速な思春期進行とβ-hCG高値で受診し、ゴナドトロピン非依存性思春期早発症と診断された。6年間の経過観察後、β-hCGが上昇し、縦隔に5 cm腫瘤が見つかった。切除の結果、混合型胚細胞腫瘍であった。β-hCGの起源は長期間判明しないことがあり、継続的な経過観察が重要である。
pmid-41335548.summary_en: This case report describes a 10.8-year-old boy with rapidly advancing puberty, suppressed gonadotropins and elevated beta-hCG, initially diagnosed with gonadotropin-independent precocious puberty. Extensive workup including pituitary, testicular and thymic evaluations was unrevealing. After six years of surveillance, beta-hCG rose to 2,039 mIU/mL and CT revealed a 5 cm mediastinal mass, which was resected and identified as a mixed germ cell tumor. The authors emphasize that the source of beta-hCG can remain hidden for years and that ongoing surveillance is essential.

pmid-41354280.summary_ja: 精巣摘除後に監視療法を受けた臨床病期IAのセミノーマの43歳男性の症例報告。従来の腫瘍マーカーとコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は18か月間陰性だったが、21か月時点でmiR-371a-3pおよびmiR-372-3pが陽性化し、24か月のCTで右総腸骨リンパ節転移が判明した。化学療法で完全奏効した。miRNA検査が再発の前臨床期検出に有用かもしれないと示唆する。
pmid-41354280.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with clinical stage IA pure seminoma managed with surveillance after orchiectomy, who participated in a prospective serial miRNA study. Conventional tumor markers stayed normal and imaging was negative for 18 months, but miR-371a-3p and miR-372-3p testing turned positive at 21 months, preceding a 4.3 cm iliac nodal metastasis detected on CT at 24 months. Chemotherapy produced complete response. The authors suggest miRNA-informed surveillance could detect relapse earlier and reduce repeated imaging, while calling for prospective standardized protocols.

pmid-41385930.summary_ja: 1994~2023年に治療された病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生存者169例を単施設で後方視的に追跡し、競合リスクを考慮して二次悪性腫瘍と対側精巣腫瘍の絶対リスクを推定した。25年時点の累積発生率はそれぞれ約11%と約8%だった。監視療法と補助療法で差はなく、過去の高線量放射線療法の報告より低いリスクであった。
pmid-41385930.summary_en: This retrospective single-center cohort followed 169 survivors of stage I testicular germ cell tumor treated from 1994 to 2023, estimating competing-risk absolute risks of non-germ-cell second malignancies and contralateral testicular tumors. Second malignancies occurred in 9 patients and contralateral tumors in 8, with cumulative incidence of about 11% and 8% at 25 years. No TGCT-related deaths occurred. Risks did not differ between surveillance and adjuvant therapy, and absolute late risks were lower than in historical high-dose radiotherapy series, supporting targeted survivorship plans.

pmid-41386099.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫58例の後方視的解析。補助化学療法、病期II-III、残存病変不明が再発因子で、病期Iでは補助化学療法が経過観察より無再発生存に優れた。AFP 25.67ng/mL超は未熟型再発の予測因子とされた。
pmid-41386099.summary_en: This retrospective study of 58 patients with ovarian immature teratoma identified adjuvant chemotherapy, stage II-III disease, and unknown residual lesions as risk factors for recurrence. In stage I patients, adjuvant chemotherapy was associated with better recurrence-free survival than surveillance. Serum AFP was significantly higher in immature than mature recurrences, and a cutoff of 25.67 ng/mL predicted immature recurrence with 100% specificity but 53.3% sensitivity. The authors conclude that surveillance does not replace adjuvant chemotherapy in stage I disease and that elevated AFP may predict immature recurrence.

pmid-41392512.summary_ja: 青年期患者の卵巣悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、肝転移を合併した症例を報告した。腹痛、膨満感、骨盤内腫瘤が主な症状で、超音波検査では充実性低エコーの付属器腫瘤と豊富な血流を示した。
pmid-41392512.summary_en: This case report describes an adolescent patient with a malignant mixed germ cell tumour of the ovary complicated by hepatic metastasis. The authors review the clinical presentation, typically abdominal pain, bloating and pelvic mass in children and adolescents, and the role of ultrasound, which usually shows a solid hypoechoic adnexal mass with abundant blood flow. The report illustrates the imaging and clinical features of this rare malignancy in a teenage patient. It emphasises the need for prompt evaluation of adolescent ovarian masses.

pmid-41400990.summary_ja: 13歳女児の仙骨前腫瘤による異所性ACTH依存性クッシング症候群の症例である。PET/MRIで腫瘤はソマトスタチン受容体陽性で、脂肪と嚢胞成分から奇形腫が示唆された。手術で成熟奇形腫内にACTH産生NET（G1）が確認された。
pmid-41400990.summary_en: This nuclear medicine case report describes a 13-year-old girl with ectopic ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome caused by a presacral lesion. FDG PET/CT showed bilateral adrenal hyperplasia, and 68Ga-DOTA-NOC PET/MRI revealed intense somatostatin receptor uptake and MRI showed fat and cystic components suggestive of teratoma. Surgery confirmed a mature teratoma harboring an ACTH-secreting grade 1 neuroendocrine tumor. The authors conclude that complementary imaging can help exclude malignancy while identifying the functional tumor source in pediatric presacral masses.

pmid-41407594.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、奇胎後腫瘍、絨毛癌を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断と治療をまとめた総説。FIGO予後スコアに基づく治療と難治例への免疫チェックポイント阻害薬を解説。経胎盤感染による新生児絨毛癌にも焦点を当てる。
pmid-41407594.summary_en: This review summarizes the diagnosis and treatment of gestational trophoblastic diseases, including hydatidiform moles, post-molar tumors, and choriocarcinoma. It explains that post-molar tumors can be diagnosed from elevated hCG without histology, while PSTT and ETT need histological confirmation and are often chemoresistant. Management follows FIGO prognostic scoring, and immune checkpoint inhibitors are emerging for refractory disease. The article focuses on gestational choriocarcinoma and its rare neonatal form, which results from transplacental transmission and presents with hemorrhagic visceral metastases.

pmid-41423507.summary_ja: スウェーデンとノルウェーの胚細胞腫瘍患者7,322例のうち、大量化学療法を受けた80例を解析したSWENOTECA研究。適応は腫瘍マーカーの低下遅延、進行、再発。5年全生存率55%、無増悪生存率43%で、マーカー低下遅延群は全生存率75%と最良。治療関連死は4例で、いずれもマーカー低下遅延群ではなかった。大量化学療法は実施可能で有望と結論。
pmid-41423507.summary_en: This SWENOTECA cohort analyzed 80 of 7,322 germ cell cancer patients in Sweden and Norway (2011-2021) who received high-dose chemotherapy with two cycles of carboplatin/etoposide and autologous stem-cell support. Indications were delayed tumor-marker decline, progressive disease, or relapse. Five-year overall survival was 55% and progression-free survival 43%, with the best results (OS 75%) in patients with delayed marker decline. Four patients died from HDCT-related complications, none in the marker-decline group. Grade 3-4 infections were common. The authors conclude that HDCT is feasible and promising.

pmid-41435655.summary_ja: 米国の全国がんデータベースを用い、進行期悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍622例を解析した。術後4週を超える補助化学療法の遅延は36.8%に認められた。遅延群では5年全生存率が低く、調整後のハザード比は1.99であった。特に非ディスジャーミノーマ組織型では、早期の補助化学療法を強く検討すべきと結論づけた。
pmid-41435655.summary_en: This National Cancer Database study of 622 patients with stage III-IV malignant ovarian germ cell tumors examined whether delayed adjuvant chemotherapy affects survival. Delay beyond four weeks occurred in 36.8%. Delayed administration was associated with worse overall survival, with five-year rates of 77.6% versus 87.5%. After adjustment, delay carried a hazard ratio of 1.99. The authors conclude that early adjuvant chemotherapy should be strongly considered, especially for non-dysgerminoma histology, given its potential survival benefit.

pmid-41437971.summary_ja: 1歳男児で左停留精巣があり、発熱と下腹部膨隆を呈した症例報告である。画像で脂肪と石灰化を含む大きな嚢胞性病変と、捻転を示す渦巻き徴候を認めた。緊急開腹で捻転解除と切除を行い、思春期前型の精巣奇形腫と判明した。停留精巣の捻転は腹部腫瘤として発症し得るため、迅速な手術と適切な時期の精巣固定術が重要とされる。
pmid-41437971.summary_en: This case report describes a one-year-old boy with a known left undescended testis who presented with fever, abdominal distension, and a firm lower-abdominal mass. Imaging showed a large cystic lesion containing fat and calcifications, with a whirlpool sign suggesting torsion of the left pedicle. Urgent laparotomy achieved detorsion and excision, which revealed a prepubertal-type testicular teratoma. The authors highlight that torsion of an undescended testis can present as an abdominal mass, and emphasize the value of prompt surgery and timely orchiopexy for cryptorchidism.

pmid-41438535.summary_ja: 女性の原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍3例の症例集積。前縦隔の成熟奇形腫2例は完全切除により長期無病生存を得た。混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の1例は、複数回の切除と白金製剤化学療法にもかかわらず、胸腔内および中枢神経系へ再発し、診断後7年半で死亡した。
pmid-41438535.summary_en: This descriptive case series reports three women with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors, a presentation rare in females. Two patients with large anterior mature teratomas underwent complete surgical resection and remain disease-free after long-term follow-up. The third had a mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with yolk sac tumor, mature teratoma, and immature teratoma. She received multiple resections and platinum-based chemotherapy, then developed recurrent intrathoracic and CNS metastases and died seven and a half years after diagnosis. The authors highlight the curability of resected mature teratomas and the poor outcomes of nonseminomatous tumors.

pmid-41448116.summary_ja: 米国の全国がんデータベースを用い、病期I悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の女性1,345例を解析した。卵巣嚢腫摘出術は11.2%で施行され、年々減少していた。調整後の全生存率は、卵巣嚢腫摘出術と卵管卵巣摘出術で有意差がなかった。組織型や年齢による層別解析でも差は認められなかった。
pmid-41448116.summary_en: This National Cancer Database study compared ovarian cystectomy with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy in 1,345 women under 50 with stage I malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Cystectomy was used in 11.2% and declined over time. Adjusted two- and five-year survival did not differ significantly between groups, with a hazard ratio of 0.70 for cystectomy. Survival was similar across histologic subtypes and age strata. Cystectomy patients were less likely to undergo lymphadenectomy, while adjuvant chemotherapy use was similar. The authors conclude that cystectomy does not appear to compromise overall survival.

pmid-41455287.summary_ja: SEERデータ13,597例と中国多施設コホート288例の解析で、悪性胚細胞腫瘍では右側発生例の予後が良好でした（SEERのCSSでHR 0.51、中国コホートのDFSでHR 0.18）。他の卵巣癌組織型では差がありませんでした。側性に基づく個別化治療の可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-41455287.summary_en: This study evaluated whether tumor laterality affects prognosis across ovarian cancer subtypes using SEER data (13,597 patients) and a Chinese multicenter cohort of 288 patients with malignant germ cell tumors. In SEER, right-sided MGCT was associated with better cancer-specific survival than left-sided disease (HR 0.51). In the Chinese cohort, right-sided disease was associated with better disease-free survival (HR 0.18). No laterality effect was observed in other subtypes. The authors suggest laterality-based personalized treatment may be warranted in malignant germ cell tumors.

pmid-41456400.summary_ja: 抗NMDAR脳炎に未熟卵巣奇形腫を合併した3症例の報告。この組み合わせは成熟奇形腫が多いため稀である。婦人科と神経科の連携による診断と管理について多職種による推奨を示し、臨床家に実用的な指針を提供している。
pmid-41456400.summary_en: This report describes three patients with anti-NMDA receptor autoimmune encephalitis associated with immature ovarian teratomas, a rare association since most cases involve mature teratomas. The authors summarize the clinical course and then review diagnosis and management of immature ovarian teratomas in this setting. They present multidisciplinary recommendations for workup and treatment, coordinated between gynecology and neurology. The report provides practical guidance for clinicians managing this uncommon paraneoplastic presentation of germ cell tumors.

pmid-41469291.summary_ja: 臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍で監視療法を受けた285例の多施設研究です。骨盤・鼠径リンパ節再発は15%でしたが、孤立性の骨盤のみの再発は1.7%と稀でした。CT骨盤の省略で被曝量と費用を削減でき、定期的な骨盤画像検査の価値は限定的と結論づけています。
pmid-41469291.summary_en: This multi-institutional study of 285 patients with clinical stage I germ cell tumor on surveillance evaluated whether routine pelvic imaging can be safely omitted. Pelvic or inguinal nodal recurrence occurred in 15%, and 37% of those were detectable only by imaging. In most such cases, disease was also visible on abdominal CT or had simultaneous retroperitoneal recurrence. Isolated pelvis-only recurrence was rare (1.7%). Omitting CT pelvis would reduce radiation dose by 2.31 to 3.46 mSv over five years and save 700 to 800 USD per patient. The authors conclude routine pelvic imaging has limited value, with imaging protocols varying among centers as a limitation.

pmid-41469292.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍226例を、同一施設の安全網病院と三次医療病院で後方視的に比較した研究です。保険加入が不十分な患者は進行病期で発症しやすく、IGCCG予後分類も不良でした。一次化学療法後の再発率は同等でしたが、癌特異的生存率は保険未加入例で劣りました。地域への啓発と教育的介入の必要性が示されています。
pmid-41469292.summary_en: A retrospective dual-site study of 226 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated at a safety-net and a tertiary hospital under one institution. Underinsured patients were more often treated at the safety-net site, more often Hispanic, and presented with worse IGCCCG risk. Recurrence after first-line chemotherapy was similar between groups, but cancer-specific survival was worse in uninsured patients. A poorer presentation risk group also predicted worse survival. The authors call for community outreach and educational interventions targeting safety-net populations.

pmid-41476805.summary_ja: タンザニアのムヒンビリ国立病院から、新生児の巨大仙尾部奇形腫が自然破裂した症例を報告しています。腫瘍内または腹腔内への出血により、急激な腹部膨隆、貧血、ショックを来しました。大きな仙尾部奇形腫を診る臨床医はこの重篤な合併症を認識すべきと強調しています。
pmid-41476805.summary_en: This case report from Muhimbili National Hospital in Tanzania describes a rare, potentially fatal neonatal emergency: spontaneous rupture of a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma. Rupture leads to abrupt abdominal distension, anemia, and shock from hemorrhage into the tumor or peritoneal cavity. The authors emphasize that early detection and rapid surgical intervention are essential to reduce mortality. They note that clinicians caring for infants with large sacrococcygeal teratomas must be aware of this serious complication.

pmid-41476812.summary_ja: 7歳女児の右副腎部の大きな成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。画像で脂肪、液体、石灰化を含む腫瘤を認め、開腹で完全切除された。術後に創離開と肥厚性瘢痕を認めたが、6か月の経過観察で再発はなかった。小児の副腎腫瘤の鑑別に奇形腫を含める必要性を強調している。
pmid-41476812.summary_en: This case report describes a seven-year-old girl from Nepal with a large right suprarenal mass that ultrasound and contrast-enhanced computed tomography showed to contain fat, fluid, and calcifications. Laparotomy achieved complete excision of the encapsulated mass, which was histologically diagnosed as mature cystic teratoma. Postoperative wound dehiscence required secondary suturing, and a later hypertrophic scar was treated with intralesional triamcinolone. At six-month follow-up the patient was asymptomatic without recurrence. The authors emphasize that adrenal teratoma, though rare and usually benign, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of suprarenal masses in children.

pmid-41480952.summary_ja: 34週で前期破水のため分娩した25歳女性の症例報告である。胎盤に3.5cmの胎盤内混合性充実・嚢胞性病変があり、病理組織学的に軟骨、神経節細胞、脈絡叢、線毛上皮を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。臍帯や胚性構造がないことから、無心体双胎やTRAP配列と区別される。胎盤奇形腫は良性で単胎妊娠に生じ、再発リスクはないとされている。
pmid-41480952.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman who delivered at 34 weeks after preterm premature rupture of membranes. Placental examination revealed a 3.5 cm intraplacental mixed solid and cystic lesion without a pedicle, which histology showed to be a mature cystic teratoma with cartilage, ganglion cells, choroid plexus, and ciliated epithelium. The authors note that the absence of an umbilical cord and embryonic organization distinguishes it from an acardiac twin or TRAP sequence. Placental teratomas are benign, occur in singleton pregnancies, and carry no recurrence risk.

pmid-41483138.summary_ja: 根治的子宮摘出術または仙尾部奇形腫切除後に神経因性膀胱を来した11例に対する、閉鎖神経から骨盤神経への再配線術の報告です。9例で自排尿が回復し、排尿量や残尿量、排尿筋圧が改善しました。合併症は報告されませんでした。骨盤神経損傷後の膀胱機能回復に有望とされています。
pmid-41483138.summary_en: A clinical study of 11 patients (aged 4 to 58) with neurogenic bladder after radical hysterectomy or sacrococcygeal teratoma resection, treated with obturator-to-pelvic nerve rerouting. Nine regained voluntary voiding, with increased voiding volume, reduced residual urine, improved detrusor pressure, and fewer urinary infections. Creatinine normalized in three of four patients with elevated values. No complications were reported. The authors conclude that this somatic-to-autonomic nerve regeneration technique can restore bladder function after pelvic nerve injury.

pmid-41485106.summary_ja: 米軍兵士を対象としたSTEEDスタディの症例対照解析で、診断前の血清ホルモンを517例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者と790例の対照で比較した。LHの低値、FSHの低値と高値はいずれもリスク上昇と関連した。セミノーマでは3α-diol Gの低値も関連した。ゴナドトロピンの撹乱が発症の重要な事象である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-41485106.summary_en: This nested case-control analysis of the US Servicemen's Testicular Tumor Environmental and Endocrine Determinants study measured prediagnostic serum hormones in 517 men who later developed testicular germ cell tumors and 790 comparison men. Low LH and both low and high FSH were associated with increased TGCT risk. Low 3α-diol G was associated with seminoma. Nonseminoma risk was linked to low LH and both low and high FSH. The authors suggest that gonadotropin disruption may be a critical event in TGCT development.

pmid-41486498.summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の患者由来異種移植（PDX）モデルを樹立した基礎研究です。形態学的、機能的、増殖的特徴が安定して再現されることが示されています。侵襲性の高い本腫瘍に対する新規治療法の探索と検証のための生体内プラットフォームとして提案されています。
pmid-41486498.summary_en: This short report describes the establishment of a patient-derived xenograft (PDX) model of human testicular yolk sac tumor. The model stably and reproducibly retains the morphological, functional, and proliferative characteristics of the original tumor. The authors propose it as an in vivo platform for discovering and validating novel therapeutic strategies for this aggressive malignancy, with the goal of improving prognosis. The abstract provides no quantitative data on engraftment rates or treatment responses.

pmid-41491201.summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後、腫瘍マーカーは正常化したが縦隔腫瘤が増大したgrowing teratoma syndromeの症例報告である。クラムシェル開胸と心肺バイパスで上大静脈を含め一塊切除し、血管グラフトで再建した。病理は成熟奇形腫で切除断端は陰性であった。完全切除が唯一の根治的治療であると述べている。
pmid-41491201.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with a mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor treated with platinum chemotherapy. His tumor markers normalized, but the anterior mediastinal mass grew from 16.7 to 22 cm, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. He underwent clamshell thoracosternotomy with cardiopulmonary bypass, en bloc resection of the mass with lung preservation, and venous graft reconstruction of the superior vena cava and innominate vein. Final pathology showed mature teratoma with negative margins. The authors argue that complete surgical resection is the only curative option and that early surgical referral and multidisciplinary planning are essential.

pmid-41491402.summary_ja: 子宮原発の非妊娠性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)5例を報告。形態および免疫組織化学的所見は妊娠性PSTTと類似していたが、STR解析で非患者由来のアレルを認めず、非妊娠起源と判定された。5例中2例が原病死し、独立した疾患単位として扱うべきと提唱している。
pmid-41491402.summary_en: This report describes five cases of primary uterine nongestational placental site trophoblastic tumor, which were morphologically and immunohistochemically similar to gestational PSTT but lacked nonpatient alleles on STR genotyping. Three of five patients had metastatic disease at presentation, and two died of disease. Median progression-free survival was 18 months. The authors propose that nongestational PSTT be considered a distinct entity, analogous to nongestational choriocarcinoma, and offer recommendations for diagnosis and staging.

pmid-41492249.summary_ja: フロリダ州の登録データを用い、1981～2020年に絨毛癌と診断された女性262例を解析した。黒人女性は白人女性より遠隔転移での発症が多かった。出生地、人種、民族は全生存率と関連しなかった。高齢と外科的治療が独立して生存と関連した。
pmid-41492249.summary_en: This Florida registry study of 262 women with choriocarcinoma (1981-2020) examined how race, ethnicity, and nativity relate to presentation and survival. Black women more often presented with distant disease than White women (63.8% vs 46.2%). Non-US-born women were older at diagnosis and received fewer surgical and radiation treatments. Nativity, ethnicity, and race were not associated with overall survival. Older age and surgical treatment were independently associated with survival. The authors suggest that differences after treatment may reflect either biology or broader disparities.

pmid-41498302.summary_ja: 29～60歳の子宮原発奇形腫5例の臨床病理学的検討です。2例に未熟神経組織を含み未熟奇形腫（グレード2）と判定されました。i(12p)は検出されず、中央値13年の観察で4例が無病でした。子宮の未熟奇形腫は卵巣より仙尾部奇形腫に近い可能性を示しています。
pmid-41498302.summary_en: This study describes clinicopathological features of five uterine teratomas in patients aged 29 to 60, with three treated by hysterectomy and two by conservative cervical excision. Tumors were uterine-confined, mostly cervical. Three were purely mature, and two contained immature neural tissue, consistent with grade 2 immature teratoma. Isochromosome 12p was not detected in tested tumors. Genetic analyses showed varied patterns, including loss of heterozygosity. With median follow-up of 13 years, four patients remained disease-free. The authors suggest uterine immature teratomas resemble sacrococcygeal rather than ovarian teratomas.

pmid-41500718.summary_ja: 母子に同時期に転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍が生じた稀な症例報告である。乳児は肝腫大、多発肝病変、肺結節を呈し、死後の肝生検で転移性病変と確定した。母親は後に神経症状を呈し、転移性絨毛癌と診断された。非典型的な肝・肺病変を有する乳児では、直前の母体妊娠を踏まえて本疾患を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-41500718.summary_en: This case report describes the simultaneous presentation of metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia in an infant and her mother. The infant had hepatomegaly, large bilobar hepatic lesions, and pulmonary nodules on imaging, and died despite supportive care. Post-mortem liver biopsy confirmed metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. The mother later developed neurological symptoms, with brain MRI showing a hemorrhagic lesion, and elevated beta-hCG confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma. The authors highlight that this neoplasia should be considered in infants with atypical hepatic and pulmonary lesions, especially after a recent maternal pregnancy, and stress early beta-hCG testing and timely imaging.

pmid-41502348.summary_ja: 小児外科と婦人科のいずれで治療された卵巣悪性腫瘍52例を後方視的に比較した。小児群では未熟奇形腫が最多で、早期病期が多かった。再発・死亡率や生存成績は両群で同程度であり、若年患者に対する小児外科と婦人科の連携の有用性が示唆された。
pmid-41502348.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective study compared 52 patients with ovarian malignancies managed by paediatric surgeons (Group A, median age 10) or gynaecologists (Group B, median age 31). Immature teratoma was most common in Group A (45%), while borderline tumors predominated in Group B. Group A more often had early-stage disease (93% vs 30%) and underwent laparotomy, whereas Group B used laparoscopy. Relapse occurred in three paediatric and four adult patients, and two died of progression. Disease-free and overall survival were comparable between groups, supporting integrated paediatric and gynaecological management of young patients.

pmid-41520625.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫を伴う卵巣粘液性腫瘍34例のCT・MRI所見を後方視的に検討。大きな多房性嚢胞性腫瘤で脂肪成分を高率に伴い、MRIではステンドグラス様所見が多く認められた。脂肪内の結節状石灰化も特徴的で、術前の認識に役立つと結論づけている。
pmid-41520625.summary_en: This retrospective imaging study evaluates CT and MRI features of 34 patients with ovarian mucinous tumors associated with mature teratomas, including collision tumors and tumors arising from teratomas. Histology included mucinous cystadenoma in 22, borderline tumor in 10, and carcinoma in two. Typical findings were large, multilocular, predominantly cystic masses with fatty components (88%) and a stained glass appearance on MRI (69%). Nodular calcifications within fat were seen in 57% on CT. Pseudomyxoma peritonei occurred in 9%, all in borderline tumors. The authors conclude these features can help recognize this combination preoperatively.

pmid-41523223.summary_ja: 22歳女性が発熱と急性腹痛を呈し、急性胆管炎を合併した肝十二指腸間膜の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例である。報告例は20例未満とまれで、本例は症状を伴う初の報告とされる。門脈三つ組を温存して切除に成功した。若年成人の急性熱性疾患では本疾患も考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-41523223.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with fever and acute abdominal pain due to a mature cystic teratoma of the hepatoduodenal ligament, presenting with acute cholangitis. This is described as the first case of such presentation for this rare tumor, of which fewer than 20 cases have been reported. Earlier adult cases were incidental findings. The mass was successfully removed without damaging the portal triad structures. The authors highlight that this diagnosis should be considered in young adults with febrile illness and suggestive imaging.

pmid-41523302.summary_ja: AFP高値の単発肝腫瘤で肝細胞癌を疑われた34歳女性例です。右肝切除で卵黄嚢腫瘍と判明し、BEP療法とEP療法を行い、PET-CTで完全奏効を得ました。5年以上無病で、若年女性の肝腫瘤における鑑別と早期生検の重要性を示しています。
pmid-41523302.summary_en: The authors describe a 34-year-old woman with a single hepatic mass and elevated AFP, initially suspected to be hepatocellular carcinoma. Right hepatectomy revealed an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor. After four cycles of BEP chemotherapy with partial response, two cycles of EP were given, and PET-CT showed complete response. At more than five years of follow-up she remains disease-free with normal tumor markers. The report highlights primary hepatic yolk sac tumor as a key differential of HCC in young women without cirrhosis with markedly elevated AFP, and the value of early biopsy and multidisciplinary care.

pmid-41525035.summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の患者由来異種移植(PDX)モデルを免疫不全マウスに樹立した基礎研究。組織構造やAFP・SALL4の発現が原発腫瘍を再現し、JEB療法に高い感受性を示した。小児胚細胞腫瘍の前臨床研究と新規治療薬の評価に有用なモデルと結論づけている。
pmid-41525035.summary_en: This translational study establishes a patient-derived xenograft model of testicular yolk sac tumor in NPG and BALB/c nude mice. The xenografts were serially passaged, preserved yolk sac morphology including Schiller-Duval bodies, and maintained AFP and SALL4 expression. Human origin was confirmed by PCR, excluding murine lymphoma. The JEB regimen (carboplatin, etoposide, bleomycin) showed marked sensitivity in histoculture drug sensitivity testing and induced significant tumor regression in vivo without clinically relevant weight loss. The authors propose this model as a valuable platform for studying yolk sac tumor biology and evaluating new therapeutics.

pmid-41525298.summary_ja: ドイツの症例対照研究（症例268例、対照797例）で、測定値に基づく溶接ヒューム曝露マトリクスを用いて精巣胚細胞腫瘍との関連を検討した。定期的な溶接はリスク上昇と関連したが（OR 2.26、95%CI 0.92–5.53）、統計的有意差はなかった。非セミノーマでは関連が強く示唆されたものの曝露例が少ない。用量反応関係は認められなかった。
pmid-41525298.summary_en: This German case-control study of 268 testicular germ cell tumour cases and 797 controls examined occupational exposure to welding fumes using a measurement-based exposure matrix. Regular welding was associated with elevated risk (OR 2.26, 95% CI 0.92–5.53), while occasional welding showed OR 1.14. Among non-seminoma cases, regular welders and non-welders exposed to metal-working fluids showed stronger associations, though based on few exposed cases. No dose-response relationship was observed, and year-specific exposure values did not reproduce the association.

pmid-41526726.summary_ja: 鼠径部腫瘤と血清AFP高値を示した40歳男性は、当初卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され標準化学療法を受けたが反応は不十分だった。再検討で卵黄嚢腫瘍様の所見がみられたが、SMARCB1は完全に欠失していた。FISHで12p異常は認めず、NGSに基づくアルゴリズムは99%の確率で胚細胞腫瘍と予測したが、著者らは不正確と考えている。卵黄嚢腫瘍様の性腺外腫瘍の鑑別にSMARCB1欠損癌を含めるべきと注意喚起している。
pmid-41526726.summary_en: A 40-year-old man with an inguinal mass and elevated AFP was initially diagnosed with a yolk sac tumor and treated with standard chemotherapy, with suboptimal response. Review showed YST-like features but complete SMARCB1 loss. FISH found no 12p abnormality, and NGS predicted germ cell tumor with 99% probability, which the authors consider inaccurate. The authors caution that SMARCB1-deficient carcinoma should be included in the differential of extragonadal tumors with YST-like features.

pmid-41528533.summary_ja: PRISMAに準拠しPROSPEROに登録されたシステマティックレビューで、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍後の後腹膜GTSに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の15研究・156例を統合した。全生存率は73.7〜100％、術後合併症は12.5〜44％であった。後腹膜リンパ節郭清は複雑だが腫瘍学的に有効と結論し、多施設レジストリの必要性を指摘した。
pmid-41528533.summary_en: This PRISMA-guided systematic review, registered in PROSPERO, synthesizes 15 studies comprising 156 patients with retroperitoneal growing teratoma syndrome treated with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Reported incidence ranged from 2.8 to 7.6 percent, and disease-free survival from 41.7 to 100 percent, with overall survival of 73.7 to 100 percent. Postoperative complications occurred in 12.5 to 44 percent, and Clavien-Dindo grade III or higher in 12.5 to 25 percent. The authors conclude that RPLND is a complex but oncologically effective procedure for growing teratoma syndrome, and call for multicentric registries to generate standardized data.

pmid-41531187.summary_ja: 本研究は、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化（MTMCT）由来細胞株を用いたゲノムワイドCRISPRスクリーニングにより、治療標的を探索した基礎研究です。SOD1が同定され、阻害薬LCS-1は酸化ストレスを介して増殖を抑制し、患者由来異種移植モデルでも腫瘍増殖を抑制しました。
pmid-41531187.summary_en: This translational study used a genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 knockout screen in an MTMCT-derived cell line to find vulnerabilities in malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. SOD1 and NDUFB4 were prioritized, and SOD1 was selected for further study. Knockdown and the inhibitor LCS-1 suppressed proliferation by inducing oxidative stress, which N-acetylcysteine reversed. Oral LCS-1 suppressed tumor growth in patient-derived xenografts. The authors propose SOD1 as a therapeutic target and redox modulation as a strategy for this chemoresistant disease.

pmid-41536570.summary_ja: 2010～2025年に治療した精巣胚細胞腫瘍860例のうち、15cmを超える巨大腫瘍は4例（0.5%）であった。腫瘍径の中央値は全体で32mmであり、臨床病期I以外では大きい傾向があった。文献上の40例では80%が治癒していた。診断の遅れが巨大化の主因であり、啓発の重要性を強調する。
pmid-41536570.summary_en: This study reports four giant testicular germ cell tumors (over 15 cm) among 860 patients treated from 2010 to 2025, representing 0.5% of cases. Median tumor size was 32 mm overall, and larger in clinical stage above I. A literature survey of 40 previously reported giant tumors found a median age of 36 years, 62% left-sided, and 80% cure. Diagnostic delay appeared the main cause of excessive growth. The authors highlight the need for public awareness campaigns, especially among socioeconomically disadvantaged men, to shorten diagnostic delay.

pmid-41545048.summary_ja: 小児仙尾部奇形腫の外科的治療に関するコアアウトカムセット（COS）の開発計画を示すプロトコールである。報告されたアウトカムを調べるシステマティックレビュー、臨床家・研究者・患者代表を対象とした国際デルファイ調査、最終的な合意形成会議の3段階からなる。アウトカム報告の標準化と国際的な治療ガイドライン策定を目指している。
pmid-41545048.summary_en: This protocol describes a three-phase project to develop a core outcome set for surgical treatment of sacrococcygeal teratoma in children. Phases include a systematic review of reported outcomes, an international Delphi survey among clinicians, researchers and patient representatives, and a final consensus meeting. It follows COMET, COS-STAD and COS-STAR guidance. The authors aim to standardize outcome reporting and support international treatment guidelines.

pmid-41547236.summary_ja: 腹痛とCA-125高値を呈した46歳女性の卵巣甲状腺腫症例。手術後の病理組織学的検査で、卵巣甲状腺腫が濾胞性甲状腺癌へ悪性転化していたことが確認された。術後PET-CTとホルモン検査で残存病変は認められず、現在も定期的にフォローアップされている。広範な組織採取と多職種連携の重要性を強調している。
pmid-41547236.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old woman with abdominal pain and a solid-cystic ovarian mass with elevated CA-125. Histopathology after surgery confirmed malignant transformation of struma ovarii into follicular thyroid carcinoma, an exceptionally rare variant. Post-operative PET-CT and hormone assessments showed no residual disease, and she remains under regular follow-up. The authors note that most malignant struma ovarii are papillary thyroid carcinomas. They emphasize extensive tissue sampling and multidisciplinary care, given the absence of standardized treatment guidelines for this condition.

pmid-41547710.summary_ja: 1994年から2023年に単施設で治療した臨床病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍169例の後方視的コホート研究である。初期管理は監視52.1%、補助化学療法46.2%であった。全体の再発率は10.1%で、補助化学療法は再発リスクを低下させた。監視群のセミノーマでは精巣網浸潤が再発を予測した。10年全生存率は94.4%であった。
pmid-41547710.summary_en: This single-center retrospective cohort of 169 clinical stage I testicular germ cell tumor patients (1994-2023) describes risk-adapted management and identifies histopathologic relapse predictors. Initial management was surveillance in 52.1% and adjuvant chemotherapy in 46.2%. Overall relapse was 10.1% over a median follow-up of 87 months. Adjuvant chemotherapy reduced relapse risk. In surveilled seminomas, rete testis invasion predicted relapse. Ten-year overall and cancer-specific survival were 94.4% and 99.3%. The authors conclude histopathologic stratification can support individualized, de-escalated treatment strategies.

pmid-41550053.summary_ja: 3歳女児の嚢胞性前縦隔奇形腫が破裂し、胸水として発症した症例です。腫瘍マーカーは陰性でした。外科的に完全切除され、膵組織を含む成熟奇形腫と診断されました。膵酵素の分泌が破裂に関与した可能性を推察し、非定型的な提示様式への注意を促しています。
pmid-41550053.summary_en: The authors report a 3-year-old girl with a cystic anterior mediastinal teratoma that ruptured and presented as pleural effusion. Tumor markers were negative. Surgery achieved complete resection of this heterogeneous tumor, which was adherent to adjacent structures. Histopathology showed a mature teratoma containing pancreatic tissue, and the authors suggest pancreatic enzyme secretion may have contributed to rupture. The report concludes that cystic mediastinal teratomas can present as pleural effusion and clinicians should be aware of this atypical presentation.

pmid-41551439.summary_ja: 家族性Swyer症候群と診断されていた19歳女性が、腹部膨満と腹痛で受診した症例である。姉の診断後も、COVID-19の影響で性腺摘出が延期されていた。手術でFIGO病期IIICのディスジャーミノーマと確定した。性腺摘除の早期実施と、弟妹のスクリーニングの重要性を述べる。
pmid-41551439.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with familial Swyer syndrome who presented with abdominal distension and pain. She had not undergone gonadectomy after the karyotype was diagnosed in her older sibling, owing to the COVID-19 pandemic. Surgical debulking revealed FIGO stage IIIC dysgerminoma. The authors emphasize that individuals with Swyer syndrome have a high risk of gonadal malignancy and that prepubertal siblings should be screened. Early diagnosis and prophylactic gonadectomy may allow conservative treatment and improve survival.

pmid-41551963.summary_ja: 61歳男性の後腹膜腫瘤例です。CTとPET-CTで左腎門部近傍の軟部結節を認め、外科的切除によりセミノーマと診断されました。陰嚢超音波検査で精巣病変がなく、原発性後腹膜セミノーマと確定しています。後腹膜腫瘤の鑑別に本疾患を考慮すべきと述べています。
pmid-41551963.summary_en: A 61-year-old man was found to have a retroperitoneal mass on routine examination. CT and PET-CT showed a soft-tissue nodule near the left renal hilum. Surgical resection was performed, and histopathology confirmed seminoma. Scrotal ultrasonography showed no testicular abnormality, which excluded metastasis from a testicular primary and supported a diagnosis of primary retroperitoneal seminoma. The authors emphasize that this rare extragonadal germ cell tumor should be considered in the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal masses.

pmid-41553048.summary_ja: 性分化疾患が疑われた7例の性腺病理を報告した症例集積である。混合性性腺異形成の4例中、ディスジャーミノーマや性腺芽腫を合併した例があった。性腺形態は卵精巣から条線状性腺、異形成精巣まで多様であった。胚細胞腫瘍のリスクから、早期診断と分類が重要とされる。
pmid-41553048.summary_en: This case series describes seven patients with disorders of sexual development who presented with ambiguous genitalia, primary amenorrhea, or abdominal masses. Four were diagnosed with mixed gonadal dysgenesis, including one with dysgerminoma, one with both dysgerminoma and gonadoblastoma, and one with bilateral gonadoblastoma. The remaining three had ovotesticular DSD. Gonadal specimens ranged from ovotestis to streak gonad and dysgenetic testis. The authors emphasize that early diagnosis and categorization of dysgenetic gonads are crucial to prevent adverse outcomes and to ensure optimal management, given the associated germ cell neoplasia risk.

pmid-41553136.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性25例を前向きに登録し、精巣摘除術の前後で精液パラメータを比較した研究です。精子総数の中央値は術前52.8百万/射精から術後26.5百万へ低下し、濃度と運動率も有意に低下しました。一方、術後に精子数が増加した例もみられました。術前の精子凍結保存を常に行うべきと結論し、術後凍結の対象を同定する多施設研究を提案しています。
pmid-41553136.summary_en: This prospective study enrolled 25 men with testicular germ cell tumors who underwent semen cryopreservation before orchiectomy and provided samples within eight weeks afterward. Median total sperm count fell from 52.8 to 26.5 million per ejaculate, and sperm concentration and motility declined significantly, although the change in total count did not reach statistical significance. Some patients showed higher counts after surgery. The authors conclude that cryopreservation should always be performed before orchiectomy, and suggest a multicenter study to identify subgroups who may benefit from post-surgical cryopreservation.

pmid-41553149.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株EP2102とGCT27およびそのシスプラチン耐性株で、HMGA2のsiRNAによる抑制効果を検討しました。増殖の抑制、S期停止、アポトーシスの増加、遊走の低下が認められました。HMGA2はシスプラチン耐性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療標的となりうると示唆しています。
pmid-41553149.summary_en: This study tested whether HMGA2 knockdown affects proliferation, survival, and migration in human embryonal carcinoma cell lines EP2102 and GCT27 and their cisplatin-resistant derivatives. siRNA-mediated HMGA2 silencing markedly reduced proliferation in both parental and resistant lines, caused S-phase arrest, increased apoptosis (especially in cisplatin-resistant cells), and decreased migration. The authors conclude that HMGA2 supports malignant features of embryonal carcinoma and chemoresistance, and may be a therapeutic target to improve outcomes in cisplatin-resistant testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-41553324.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、進行した混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する20歳と28歳の男性2例を提示したものです。1例は脳梗塞と心筋梗塞を発症し、もう1例は多発性の心雑音を呈しました。経胸壁心エコーで房室弁と流出路に腫瘤を認め、心臓転移と診断されました。
pmid-41553324.summary_en: This case series report describes two young men (aged 20 and 28) with advanced mixed testicular germ cell tumors that metastasized to the heart. One had an acute ischemic stroke and myocardial infarction, while the other presented with a multifocal murmur. Both had elevated AFP and β-hCG and pulmonary nodules, and transthoracic echocardiography revealed masses on atrioventricular valves and outflow tracts. The authors note that left-sided cardiac involvement may cause embolic events while right-sided involvement may be silent. Management focuses on tumor resection and platinum-based chemotherapy.

pmid-41555284.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍96例の単施設後方視的研究。喫煙、リンパ管侵襲、4cm以上の腫瘍径が進行期との独立した関連因子だった一方、BMIには有意な関連が認められなかった。病理学的因子と生活習慣因子を組み合わせることで、個別化されたリスク層別化が向上する可能性を示した。
pmid-41555284.summary_en: This single-center retrospective study of 96 patients with testicular germ cell tumors examines factors associated with advanced-stage presentation. Smoking, lymphovascular invasion, and tumor size of 4 cm or larger were independently associated with advanced disease in multivariable logistic regression, while body mass index was not. Recurrence occurred in 13.5% of patients, more frequently among smokers and those with lymphovascular invasion, though not statistically significant. The authors suggest combining pathological and lifestyle factors may refine individualized risk stratification.

pmid-41559359.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌21例を対象に、Nectin-4の免疫組織化学的発現を解析した多施設研究です。原発巣の大半で陽性で、細胞質発現はβ-hCG高値と関連しました。化学療法後の転移病変で膜発現が最も強く、エンホルツマブ ベドチンの標的となりうると示唆しています。
pmid-41559359.summary_en: This multi-institutional study examined Nectin-4 expression by immunohistochemistry in 21 testicular choriocarcinomas, a target for enfortumab vedotin. Cytoplasmic staining was present in 17 of 20 primary tumors, and membrane staining in 16. Cytoplasmic expression correlated with higher percentage of choriocarcinoma and serum beta-hCG, and moderate or strong expression with younger age. The single post-chemotherapy metastatic specimen showed the highest membrane expression. Staining was mainly in syncytiotrophoblasts. The authors conclude testicular choriocarcinoma expresses Nectin-4 and may be a candidate for enfortumab vedotin, pending further study.

pmid-41561792.summary_ja: 妊娠12週の37歳女性で、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の捻転に伴う小腸軸捻転を緊急開腹で切除。卵巣壊死を伴う。術後の経過は良好で、6か月後に健康な新生児を出産。妊娠初期での本症の初例と報告。
pmid-41561792.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old woman at 12 weeks of gestation who presented with acute abdominal pain, vomiting, and peritonitis. Emergency laparotomy revealed a torsed adnexal mass with a gangrenous right ovary and a segment of small bowel volvulus, which were resected. The torsed mass was a mature cystic teratoma. The patient recovered well and later delivered a healthy infant. The authors note this as the first documented case of small bowel volvulus with ovarian cyst torsion occurring in the first trimester.

pmid-41563443.summary_ja: 子宮・卵巣の混合型卵黄嚢腫瘍・癌/癌肉腫9例の分子解析である。TP53、PIK3CA、PTENの体細胞変異が認められ、体細胞由来であることが示された。成分間で共通の幹変異を持ちつつ異なる変化を示し、クローン起源が示唆された。PARP阻害薬や抗HER2薬で奏効した例があった。
pmid-41563443.summary_en: This molecular and clinicopathologic study analyzed nine cases of mixed yolk sac tumor with carcinoma or carcinosarcoma arising in the uterus and ovary, using immunohistochemistry, fluorescence in situ hybridization, and targeted next-generation sequencing. Recurrent somatic mutations included TP53 in eight cases, PIK3CA in three, and PTEN in two, with absence of i(12p), supporting a somatic origin. Multi-region sequencing showed shared truncal mutations but divergent alterations between components, consistent with clonal origin. Actionable alterations were common, and two patients benefited from matched PARP inhibitors or anti-HER2 antibody-drug conjugates.

pmid-41565739.summary_ja: 新生児に最も多い腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫8例を一細胞核RNA-seqと空間トランスクリプトーム解析で解析した研究である。間質、上皮、内皮、神経外胚葉、免疫の5系統を同定した。多能性細胞は検出されなかった。女性腫瘍ではX染色体の両アレル発現が認められ、X不活性化の異常が示唆された。
pmid-41565739.summary_en: This study applies single-nuclei RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics to eight sacrococcygeal teratomas, the most common neonatal tumors. Five lineages were identified: stroma, epithelia, endothelia, neuroectoderm, and immune. Pluripotent populations were not detected despite the proposed origin. In female tumors, a subset of cells showed biallelic X-linked gene expression, suggesting X-inactivation failure. These cells were enriched for developmental and neuronal programs, which may favor tumor cell survival and contribute to the female predominance of these tumors.

pmid-41572104.summary_ja: 男性の原発性肺絨毛癌の症例報告で、化学療法と免疫療法（チスレリズマブ）を併用した。本疾患は性腺外に生じる極めて稀な悪性栄養膜腫瘍で、誤診されやすい。標準治療が確立されていないため、文献的検討と治療戦略の検討を行っている。
pmid-41572104.summary_en: This case report describes a male patient with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare extragonadal malignant trophoblastic tumor that often mimics more common conditions and is frequently misdiagnosed. The patient was treated with chemotherapy combined with the anti-PD-1 antibody tislelizumab. The authors also provide a literature review on this rare entity to improve early diagnostic accuracy and to explore potential therapeutic strategies. Because no standardized treatment guidelines exist and the tumor metastasizes early, they emphasize the value of accumulating case experience.

pmid-41579581.summary_ja: 72歳閉経後女性に生じた、卵巣の純粋な非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例です。同一卵巣に明細胞腺線維腫と子宮内膜症を伴っていました。妊娠性と非妊娠性、純粋型と混合型の鑑別の重要性を文献とともに論じ、胚細胞腫瘍と上皮性腫瘍の共存にも言及しています。
pmid-41579581.summary_en: The authors report a 72-year-old postmenopausal woman with pure non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma coexisting in the same ovary with a clear cell adenofibroma and endometriosis foci. Non-gestational choriocarcinoma usually occurs in premenarchal girls, so this case is unusual. The report reviews how to distinguish gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma and pure from mixed forms, which affects prognosis and treatment. It also discusses the rare coexistence of germ cell and epithelial ovarian tumors.

pmid-41589224.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、7.9cmの卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の破裂により肉芽腫性腹膜炎を生じ、腹膜偽粘液腫と誤診された48歳女性例を報告したものです。術中に多数の粘液性微小結節を認めましたが、病理学的に悪性所見はなく、異物型肉芽腫を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定しました。
pmid-41589224.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old woman whose ruptured 7.9 cm ovarian mature cystic teratoma caused granulomatous peritonitis that mimicked pseudomyxoma peritonei. Laparotomy found more than 50 mucoid micronodular lesions, and cytoreductive surgery with HIPEC was initially considered. Frozen sections and histopathology showed no malignancy, only mature cystic teratoma with multifocal foreign body granulomas. The authors suggest multiple silent ruptures caused the inflammatory response. They caution that such granulomatous reactions could lead to unnecessary aggressive treatment.

pmid-41591767.summary_ja: 精巣がんの既往がある単精巣患者81例の後方視的研究で、凍結切片診断と精巣温存手術の可能性を検討しました。凍結切片で胚細胞腫瘍が65.4%に認められ、確定診断との一致率は98.3%でした。精巣温存手術は13例で行われ、再発は認められませんでした。
