pmid-41591767.summary_en: This retrospective series of 81 monorchid patients with testicular nodules after prior testis cancer assessed frozen sections (FS) during surgical exploration and their impact on testis-sparing surgery (TSS). FS were performed in 59 patients and showed germ cell tumor in 53 (65.4%). Definitive histology confirmed FS in 98.3% of cases. TSS was performed in 13 patients (16%), including seven with seminomatous GCT, and none of those had relapse. Older age was associated with lower odds of GCT. The authors conclude that FS are feasible and reliable, although TSS is rarely possible because most nodules prove to be GCT.

pmid-41593694.summary_ja: 小児の悪性精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、発生学と比較の観点からまとめた総説である。思春期前は卵黄嚢腫瘍が多く、思春期後は上皮内胚細胞腫瘍から生じる混合型胚細胞腫瘍が多い。診断には病理組織学と免疫組織化学が中心である。12p等染色体は予後に重要である。
pmid-41593694.summary_en: This review examines malignant testicular germ cell tumors in pediatric patients from a developmental and comparative perspective. Prepubertal patients more often develop yolk sac tumors, whereas postpubertal adolescents more often present with mixed germ cell tumors arising from germ cell neoplasia in situ. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry remain central to diagnosis. Molecular findings, particularly isochromosome 12p, are important for prognosis. The authors highlight the developmental origins and heterogeneity of these tumors and contrast pediatric and adult disease.

pmid-41596688.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫組織と末梢血のGEOデータを統合し、抗NMDAR脳炎の免疫関連制御ネットワークを機械学習などで解析した計算機研究。ACVR2BとMX1が候補遺伝子として抽出され、患者で発現が低下し好中球浸潤と負の相関を示した。ACVR2B-miR-22-3p-lncRNAの制御軸が仮説として提示された。公開データと小規模サンプルという限界がある。
pmid-41596688.summary_en: Integrating three GEO datasets covering ovarian teratoma tissue and peripheral blood, the authors used WGCNA, immune deconvolution, and machine learning to study anti-NMDAR encephalitis. They identified 2001 consistently dysregulated mRNAs, with ACVR2B and MX1 prioritized and downregulated in patients and negatively correlated with neutrophil infiltration. A putative ACVR2B-miR-22-3p-lncRNA regulatory axis was proposed. JAK-STAT and PI3K-Akt pathways converged with neuronal communication modules. Limitations include reliance on public datasets and a small sample size.

pmid-41597411.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍と後腹膜リンパ節病変に対する放射線オミクスとAIの系統的レビューで、18研究を対象としました。MRIで精度80.7～97.9%と高く、化学療法後残存腫瘤での奇形腫と生存腫瘍の鑑別にも一定の能力が示されました。標準化と多施設前向き検証の必要性を指摘しています。
pmid-41597411.summary_en: This systematic review of 18 studies evaluated radiomics and artificial intelligence applied to ultrasound, MRI, and CT for primary testicular tumors and retroperitoneal nodal disease, including post-chemotherapy residual masses. Reported accuracies were 74-82% for ultrasound, 80.7-97.9% for MRI, and 71.7-85.3% for CT. CT radiomics showed moderate ability to distinguish necrosis, teratoma, and viable germ cell tumor in residual masses. Multimodal models combining radiomics with clinical variables or circulating microRNAs improved accuracy. Heterogeneous methods and limited external validation hinder reproducibility, and the authors call for standardized protocols and multicenter prospective validation.

pmid-41606050.summary_ja: GEOおよびプロテオミクスデータのバイオインフォマティクス解析と、精巣胚細胞腫瘍191例の免疫組織化学を組み合わせた研究である。Talin1の発現低下は、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形腫において高いpT病期と関連した。胎児性癌では静脈侵襲や精巣鞘膜浸潤とも関連した。細胞質Talin1の低下は予後バイオマーカーとなり得る。
pmid-41606050.summary_en: This study combined bioinformatics analysis of GEO and proteomics datasets with immunohistochemistry on 191 testicular germ cell tumor tissues to evaluate Talin1 expression. Reduced Talin1 was associated with higher pT stage in seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and teratoma. In embryonal carcinoma, low expression correlated with venous and tunica vaginalis invasion. In yolk sac tumors, it was linked to hilum involvement and tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes. The authors conclude decreased cytoplasmic Talin1 correlates with aggressive behavior and may serve as a prognostic biomarker, although functional studies are needed.

pmid-41607262.summary_ja: オーストラリアの登録データを用いた後方視的解析で、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の男性33例を検討。縦隔および後腹膜が主な発生部位で、多くがBEP化学療法を受けた。縦隔非セミノーマが唯一の死亡例を含み、最も予後が不良であった。後腹膜およびセミノーマは良好な転帰を示した。
pmid-41607262.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of the Australian iTestis registry describes 33 male patients with extracranial, extragonadal germ cell tumors. Mediastinal (55%) and retroperitoneal (42%) sites predominated, and 64% had non-seminoma. Most received upfront BEP chemotherapy, and surgery followed in many. At median follow-up of 22.7 months, deaths occurred only in mediastinal non-seminoma patients. Estimated 24-month overall survival was 71% for mediastinal non-seminoma and 79% for IGCCCG poor-risk disease. Primary mediastinal non-seminoma had the worst outcome, while retroperitoneal and mediastinal seminomas had excellent outcomes.

pmid-41608343.summary_ja: 2005～2020年に手術を受けた成人の成熟嚢胞性仙尾部奇形腫64例の後方視的研究です。3つの手術法で転帰に差はありませんでした。腫瘍径10 cm以上、Altman III/IV型、出血量400 mL以上が機能障害の危険因子で、尾骨を温存すると再発の独立した危険因子でした。
pmid-41608343.summary_en: This retrospective single-center study analyzed 64 adults with mature cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma treated surgically between 2005 and 2020. Three approaches were compared: anterior laparoscopic-assisted, posterior, and combined laparoscopic-posterior. Surgical approach did not significantly affect outcomes. Maximum tumor diameter of at least 10 cm, Altman type III/IV, and blood loss of at least 400 mL were risk factors for postoperative dysfunction. Leaving the sacrococcyx unresected was an independent risk factor for recurrence. The authors conclude that larger tumors, advanced Altman type, blood loss, and retained sacrococcyx increase the risk of dysfunction and recurrence.

pmid-41611604.summary_ja: 北京大学腫瘍病院で2009〜2024年に治療した原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍37例の後方視的コホート研究である。セミノーマは9例、非セミノーマは28例であった。セミノーマは非セミノーマより無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)と全生存期間(全生存率)が良好であった。非セミノーマでは縦隔放射線療法を行った症例で全生存期間(全生存率)が延長した（HR 5.943）。組織型に基づく予後層別化の重要性が示された。
pmid-41611604.summary_en: This single-centre retrospective cohort from Peking University Cancer Hospital analyzed 37 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumours treated between 2009 and 2024. Nine had seminoma and 28 non-seminoma; all received chemotherapy, 21 mediastinal radiotherapy, and 10 surgery. Seminoma patients had markedly better progression-free and overall survival than non-seminoma patients. In non-seminoma, mediastinal radiotherapy was associated with longer overall survival (HR 5.943), and first-line tumor reduction correlated with progression-free survival. The authors conclude that histology should guide prognostic stratification and management.

pmid-41611787.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ細胞株NCCITとNT2/D1およびそのシスプラチン耐性亜株を用いたWEE1阻害薬アダベセルチブの前臨床研究です。単剤で用量依存的に細胞生存率を低下させ、DNA損傷と細胞死を誘導しました。シスプラチンとの併用は耐性株を含む全モデルで効果を高めました。標準化学療法との併用が、非セミノーマ性精巣がんのシスプラチン耐性克服に有望と結論づけています。
pmid-41611787.summary_en: This preclinical study tested the WEE1 inhibitor adavosertib in two non-seminoma cell lines, NCCIT and NT2/D1, and their cisplatin-resistant subclones. Adavosertib reduced viability in a dose-dependent manner in 2D and 3D cultures, with low micromolar IC50 values, and induced S-phase accumulation, replication stress, mitotic catastrophe, and apoptosis. Combination with cisplatin enhanced efficacy across all models, including resistant lines. The authors conclude that WEE1 inhibition combined with standard chemotherapy is a promising strategy to overcome cisplatin resistance in non-seminomatous testicular cancer.

pmid-41612690.summary_ja: 出生4時間以内に死亡したヤギの新生児に認めた先天性口咽頭奇形腫(epignathus)の症例報告。臨床所見、肉眼所見、細胞診、病理組織学的所見を記載する。獣医領域における性腺外奇形腫の稀な症例を簡潔にレビューする。腫瘍性の奇形腫であり、性腺外の腫瘍として位置づけられる。
pmid-41612690.summary_en: The authors describe a congenital oropharyngeal teratoma (epignathus) in a Boer × Nigerian Dwarf goat kid that died within 4 hours of birth. Clinical, gross, cytologic, and histopathologic features are reported. The paper also briefly reviews extragonadal teratomas in veterinary species, which are rare. Although it is a veterinary case, the lesion is a neoplastic teratoma rather than a non-oncologic use of the term.

pmid-41617447.summary_ja: 閉経後の75歳女性で、骨盤内腫瘤と腹膜・肝臓への広範な浸潤を認め、FIGO病期IVBの卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された症例報告である。病理組織学的に混合構築と限局性のクロモグラニンA発現を認め、神経内分泌への分化が示唆された。年齢と全身状態に合わせて減量したブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる初回化学療法を開始した。予後は不良とされる。
pmid-41617447.summary_en: This case report describes a 75-year-old postmenopausal woman with a pelvic mass and diffuse peritoneal and hepatic involvement, diagnosed as FIGO stage IVB ovarian yolk sac tumor. Histopathology showed mixed architecture with focal chromogranin A expression, indicating neuroendocrine differentiation. She began first-line dose-adjusted bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy tailored to her age and general condition. The authors emphasize early recognition and individualized treatment, while noting that prognosis remains poor in this setting.

pmid-41618299.summary_ja: 48歳糖尿病女性が急性下腹部痛と発熱で受診し、両側卵管卵巣膿瘍が疑われた症例です。腹腔鏡検査で右卵巣の嚢胞性腫瘤が見つかり、右側卵管卵巣摘出と左側卵管開窓術が行われました。病理組織学的に卵巣甲状腺腫と診断され、術後6か月で再発はありませんでした。急性感染の状況でも複雑な付属器腫瘤では稀な病態を考慮すべきと述べています。
pmid-41618299.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old diabetic woman with acute lower abdominal pain and fever, initially suspected of bilateral tubo-ovarian abscesses. Emergency laparoscopy confirmed the abscesses and revealed a right ovarian cystic mass, which was removed by salpingo-oophorectomy. Histopathology identified struma ovarii, a monodermal ovarian teratoma composed predominantly of thyroid tissue. Postoperative thyroid function was normal, and there was no recurrence at six-month follow-up. The authors highlight the importance of considering rare entities such as struma ovarii when evaluating complex adnexal masses in acute infectious settings.

pmid-41620733.summary_ja: 上大静脈、腕頭静脈、大動脈、右横隔神経に接する巨大な前縦隔成熟奇形腫を有する22歳男性の症例報告である。両側胸腔鏡下（VATS）に一塊として切除し、手術時間は450分、推定出血量は400mLであった。術後2日目に退院し、3か月と6か月のCTで再発はなかった。解剖学的に複雑な症例でも、適切に選択し十分な準備と技術があれば低侵襲手術の利点が得られると述べている。
pmid-41620733.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with a large anterior mediastinal mature teratoma abutting the superior vena cava, brachiocephalic veins, aorta, and right phrenic nerve. Successful en bloc resection was achieved through bilateral video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery, which took 450 minutes with an estimated blood loss of 400 mL. The patient was discharged on postoperative day 2, and CT at three and six months showed no recurrence. The authors suggest that carefully selected patients with complex anatomy may benefit from minimally invasive surgery when expertise is available.

pmid-41622830.summary_ja: 思春期後型精巣胚細胞腫瘍に合併する体細胞型腫瘍様新生物の理解の変遷をまとめた総説である。奇形腫成分や卵黄嚢腫瘍成分に由来する可能性、関連する胚細胞腫瘍との分子生物学的関係、肉腫様・癌腫様などの組織像を論じる。転移部位ではシスプラチン併用化学療法への反応が乏しく、外科的切除が根治の最良の機会となり得ると述べる。
pmid-41622830.summary_en: This review summarizes the evolving understanding of somatic tumor-like neoplasms arising with postpubertal-type testicular germ cell tumors, which occur mainly at metastatic sites and often after treatment. The authors discuss their proposed derivation from teratomatous and yolk sac tumor components, their molecular relationship to the associated germ cell tumor, and histologic patterns such as sarcoma-like and carcinoma-like tumors. Metastatic lesions are often poorly responsive to cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and surgical resection may offer the best chance of cure.

pmid-41627371.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)に対する免疫療法を概説した叙述的総説である。絨毛性腫瘍ではPD-L1が高発現しており、PD-1/PD-L1阻害の臨床経験がまとめられている。多剤耐性GTNの患者の約70〜80%で、ペムブロリズマブやアベルマブ、カムレリズマブとアパチニブの併用により持続的な完全奏効が報告されている。併用療法の最適化とバイオマーカーの精緻化が今後の課題とされる。
pmid-41627371.summary_en: This narrative review summarizes immunotherapy in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN), covering the high PD-L1 expression of trophoblastic tumors and clinical experience with PD-1/PD-L1 blockade. Checkpoint inhibitors such as pembrolizumab and avelumab, or camrelizumab plus apatinib, reportedly produce complete and durable responses in about 70–80% of patients with multidrug-resistant GTN, with acceptable safety and preserved fertility. The authors highlight the need to optimize combinations, refine biomarkers, and ensure global access, while noting that much of the evidence comes from small studies.

pmid-41630888.summary_ja: 産後3か月の絨毛癌患者が、腫瘍性の中大脳動脈瘤破裂によるくも膜下出血を発症した症例。髄液を含むβ-hCGの上昇が確認された。顕微鏡下トラッピング、フロー・ダイバージョン、早期化学療法を組み合わせて治療し、6か月後に動脈瘤の縮小を確認した。腫瘍性動脈瘤の破裂例に対してフロー・ダイバージョンを用いた初の報告である。
pmid-41630888.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-month postpartum woman with choriocarcinoma who developed subarachnoid hemorrhage from a neoplastic middle cerebral artery aneurysm. Elevated serum and CSF beta-hCG supported the diagnosis. After rerupture, she underwent emergent craniectomy with microsurgical trapping and biopsy, followed by flow diversion of the unruptured segment. Low-dose etoposide and cisplatin induction was started, then EMA-CO-type chemotherapy. Her hCG normalized, and at 6 months she had mild disability with resolved aneurysmal dilatation. The authors describe this as the first ruptured neoplastic aneurysm treated with flow diversion.

pmid-41631280.summary_ja: BEP療法後に進行し、GEMOX療法およびPD-L1阻害療法の臨床試験にも反応しなかった21歳男性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例である。遺伝子解析でKRAS増幅が見つかり、ソラフェニブ併用化学療法を施行、耐性出現後にBEP療法を再投与した。5年間の経過観察で無病生存を維持し、生活の質も正常であった。
pmid-41631280.summary_en: This N-of-1 case report describes a 21-year-old man with widely metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumor who progressed after BEP chemotherapy, GEMOX, and a PD-L1 blockade trial. Molecular profiling identified KRAS amplification among 22 alterations, and an off-label carboplatin, paclitaxel, and sorafenib regimen was given, followed by BEP rechallenge after resistance developed. The patient remained disease-free at five-year follow-up with normal quality of life. The authors highlight iterative molecular profiling, molecular tumor board guidance, and long-term follow-up for personalized management.

pmid-41632323.summary_ja: 嚢胞性線維症と肝硬変を有し、多剤併用による薬物相互作用がある転移性セミノーマ患者の症例報告。肝障害と相互作用のため、エトポシドは初回を標準量の50%で開始した。血中濃度モニタリングで曝露が増えないことを確認し、100%に増量した後、骨髄抑制に応じて調整した。BEP療法を完遂し完全奏効を得た。
pmid-41632323.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with cystic fibrosis, liver cirrhosis, pancytopenia and multiple CYP3A4 and P-gp interacting drugs who presented with metastatic seminoma. The initial etoposide dose was reduced to 50% because of hepatic impairment and interactions. Plasma monitoring showed that total exposure was not increased, so the dose was raised to 100% and then adjusted for tolerability. Dose reduction was needed after grade 4 pancytopenia. The patient completed the BEP regimen with a complete response, and the authors support therapeutic drug monitoring in complex cases.

pmid-41632559.summary_ja: 抗凝固療法にもかかわらず再発性肺血栓塞栓症を来した38歳女性の症例報告である。PET/CTで血栓に一致する高代謝集積を認めた。カテーテル誘導下の吸引血栓除去術で、非妊娠性の肺動脈原発絨毛癌と確定された。腫瘍学的治療に良好に反応した。文献検索では既報は12例のみであった。生殖年齢の女性で再発性肺塞栓症と血清β-hCG高値がある場合には、本疾患を疑うべきと強調されている。
pmid-41632559.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old woman with recurrent pulmonary thromboemboli despite anticoagulation, in whom PET/CT showed hypermetabolic thrombi suggesting tumour emboli. Catheter-guided aspiration thrombectomy confirmed non-gestational choriocarcinoma arising from the pulmonary arteries, and she responded well to oncologic treatment. The authors performed a literature search that identified only 12 previously reported cases. They emphasize that primary pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma should be suspected in reproductive-age women with recurrent pulmonary embolism and elevated serum β-hCG.

pmid-41633558.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎(抗NMDAR脳炎)を伴う卵巣奇形腫に対し、vNOTES補助下経膣付属器切除術を施行した2例の報告です。腹腔内圧が低く、手術時間の短縮、腹部瘢痕の回避、疼痛軽減、回復の速さなどの利点が挙げられています。腹腔鏡手術に代わる選択肢となりうるが、標準化にはランダム化データが必要と結論づけています。
pmid-41633558.summary_en: This report describes the first two cases of vaginal NOTES (vNOTES)-assisted vaginal adnexectomy performed to remove ovarian teratomas associated with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. The authors note advantages over conventional laparoscopy, including low insufflation pressure, shorter operative time, avoidance of abdominal scarring, lower pain scores, and faster recovery. Early teratoma excision is known to improve recovery in this paraneoplastic condition. The authors suggest the vNOTES route may be feasible as an alternative to laparoscopy, but randomized data are needed before it becomes standard practice.

pmid-41639005.summary_ja: カリフォルニアの精巣胚細胞腫瘍196例と対照190例で、出生時の新生児血フタル酸エステルを測定した症例対照研究。単一物質では有意差なし。混合物解析で曲線的な関連があり、ラテン系で境界域の関連が示された。
pmid-41639005.summary_en: This case-control study measured birth blood phthalate levels in 196 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 190 controls from California. No single phthalate was significantly associated with risk. Weighted quantile sum analysis suggested a curvilinear mixture effect dominated by MECPP and MEHP at lower concentrations. The association was borderline among Latinos, driven by MEHP. Repeated holdout analyses showed good reproducibility. The authors suggest prenatal phthalate mixture exposure may increase later TGCT risk, with variation by ethnicity.

pmid-41640125.summary_ja: 小児頭頸部奇形腫の管理に関する最近の知見をまとめた総説である。胎児超音波検査とMRIによる早期発見、気道リスクを予測する気管食道偏位指数(TEDI)、EXIT手技や胎児内視鏡下気管挿管(FETI)が紹介されている。未熟奇形腫の悪性度は従来考えられていたほど高くない可能性がある。完全な外科的切除が治療の基本であり、補助化学療法の有効性は限られるとされている。
pmid-41640125.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in managing paediatric head and neck teratomas, including prenatal ultrasound and MRI detection, the tracheoesophageal displacement index for airway risk prediction, and the EXIT procedure and fetal endoscopic tracheal intubation for airway control. It notes that histologically immature teratomas may not carry higher malignant potential than previously thought, that complete surgical resection with nerve monitoring remains central, and that the role of adjuvant chemotherapy in immature tumours is unclear. Outcomes are generally favourable.

pmid-41641404.summary_ja: 2015年から2024年に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍46例の後方視的コホート研究。5年全生存率は予後良好群から不良群で100%から86.2%、無再発生存率は予後不良群で73.3%だった。予後不良群の再発率が最も高かった(23.5%)が、統計学的有意差は認められなかった。
pmid-41641404.summary_en: This single-center retrospective cohort study evaluated 46 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection between 2015 and 2024. Most had mixed NSGCT (84.8%). Five-year overall survival was 100%, 93.3%, and 86.2% for good, intermediate, and poor-risk groups. Five-year recurrence-free survival was 100%, 92.3%, and 73.3%. Pathology showed teratoma in 54.3% of specimens. Recurrence was highest in the poor-risk group (23.5%), though the difference was not statistically significant. The authors conclude that outcomes are excellent and that multidisciplinary care is essential.

pmid-41653711.summary_ja: 本研究は、SEERデータベースから非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍13,679例を抽出し、年齢と精巣がん特異的死亡の関連を検討したものです。40歳未満と比較して年齢が高いほどハザード比が段階的に上昇し、この傾向は病期I、II、IIIのいずれでも認められました。
pmid-41653711.summary_en: This SEER-based cohort study of 13,679 men with non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor (2004-2018) examined whether age shows a dose-response effect on testis cancer-specific mortality. Compared with patients under 40, the risk of mortality rose across age tertiles, with hazard ratios of 1.4, 1.9, and 3.6 in the overall analysis. The association persisted within each stage (I, II, III), with the oldest tertile showing the highest risk. The authors conclude that increasing age within the ≥40 group is associated with progressively higher cancer-specific mortality.

pmid-41655861.summary_ja: 良性卵巣甲状腺腫23例に次世代シーケンシングを施行した後方視的研究。2例に特徴的な変異が認められ、1例はDICER1の2種類の変異、もう1例はPOLD1変異であった。BRAF変異は全例で認められず、良性卵巣甲状腺腫にはBRAF変異がないことが示唆された。
pmid-41655861.summary_en: This retrospective study performed next-generation sequencing on 23 benign ovarian struma ovarii specimens. Two tumors harbored notable alterations: one with two DICER1 variants in an adult, and another with a POLD1 variant. None of the tumors carried BRAF mutations, suggesting benign struma ovarii lack BRAF alterations. The authors conclude that DICER1 and POLD1 variants warrant further investigation in this tumor type. The findings add to limited molecular data on benign struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma, and may help refine classification.

pmid-41658518.summary_ja: MEN1の女性患者が奇形腫と診断された症例を報告した。MEN1と奇形腫の併発は極めてまれである。遺伝子検査で意義不明の変異が見つかり、家系内の複数の成員にも認められた。病原性の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-41658518.summary_en: The authors report a female patient with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (MEN1) who was diagnosed with teratoma, a combination rarely reported. Genetic testing identified an NM_130799.2 c.512G>A (p.Arg171Gln) variant classified as a variant of uncertain significance. Testing of seven relatives showed the variant in several family members, some with MEN1, suggesting possible pathogenicity. The authors state that further research and longer follow-up are needed to confirm this.

pmid-41661109.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、後腹膜および縦隔に性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を生じた10歳児が、高リスク化学療法とともに残存病変に対する腹腔鏡下肝切除を受けた後に生じた肝管狭窄を報告したものです。経皮的胆道ドレナージとバルーン胆管形成術により、胆道開通と肝機能の正常化が得られました。
pmid-41661109.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old child with a retroperitoneal and mediastinal extragonadal germ cell tumor treated with high-risk chemotherapy (GALOP 2017) and multiple surgeries, including laparoscopic atypical left hepatectomy for residual disease. Afterwards, the child developed main hepatic duct stenosis with jaundice and cholestasis. Percutaneous biliary drainage and balloon cholangioplasty restored biliary patency and normalized liver function without immediate complications. The authors suggest that post-hepatectomy biliary stenosis should be considered in children with jaundice, and that percutaneous management is a safe alternative to open reoperation.

pmid-41664786.summary_ja: 片側セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術を受けた3年後から、緩徐に進行する対麻痺と軽度のCK高値を呈した60歳男性の症例です。筋MRIで筋炎を認め、筋生検では封入体筋炎が示唆されました。抗体検査では抗cN1A抗体が著明に上昇していました。セミノーマ後にcN1A抗体関連封入体筋炎が生じうると報告し、診断には筋MRI・生検・抗体検査が有用と述べています。
pmid-41664786.summary_en: This case report describes a 60-year-old man who developed slowly progressive paraparesis and mild hyper-CK-emia three years after orchiectomy for unilateral seminoma. Muscle MRI showed myositis, biopsy suggested inclusion body myositis, and antibody testing revealed markedly increased cN1A antibodies. The diagnosis took years to establish, and electromyography was normal. The authors conclude that cN1A antibody-associated inclusion body myositis can follow seminoma, and that muscle MRI, biopsy, and antibody testing can aid diagnosis, whereas electromyography may not.

pmid-41671822.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の卵巣類皮嚢腫および成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の超音波評価を論じた総説である。良性でも充実性を示すことがあり悪性との鑑別が問題となる。術前超音波での「卵巣クレセントサイン」の確認と明瞭な報告が重要とされる。正常卵巣の浮腫は捻転の早期認識に役立つ。
pmid-41671822.summary_en: This narrative review examines the ultrasonographic assessment of ovarian dermoid cysts and mature cystic teratomas in paediatric and adolescent patients. Although these lesions are benign, they can occasionally be solid and mimic malignancy, and surgical outcomes and ovarian preservation vary considerably. The authors highlight the Ovarian Crescent Sign, the visualisation of normal ovarian tissue around the lesion on preoperative ultrasound, which supports ovarian-sparing surgery and should be reported explicitly. They also note that oedema of the normal ovarian tissue can aid early recognition of torsion in otherwise benign tumours.

pmid-41674621.summary_ja: 本研究は、UK BiobankとTECACコンソーシアムの全ゲノムシーケンスデータ、欧州系男性198,306例（精巣胚細胞腫瘍2,231例）を用いて、Y染色体gr/gr欠失と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討した遺伝学的関連解析です。統合オッズ比は1.24で有意な関連はみられませんでした。
pmid-41674621.summary_en: This genetic association study analyzed whole-genome sequencing data from 198,306 European-like men (2,231 with TGCT) in UK Biobank and the TECAC consortium to test whether Y-chromosomal gr/gr deletions predict testicular germ cell tumor risk. Using Firth's logistic regression and random-effects meta-analysis, the combined odds ratio was 1.24 (95% CI 0.74-2.07), with no significant association. Stratification by seminoma and non-seminoma/mixed histology also showed no association. The authors conclude that gr/gr deletion status alone is unlikely to predict TGCT risk at population scale.

pmid-41676193.summary_ja: 62歳女性の卵巣粘液性癌で、未分化領域と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を併せ持つ症例。6コースの化学療法後も術後62日で再発した。文献上の8例をレビューし、75%が1年以内に再発または死亡しており、極めて侵襲性が高いと結論づけた。
pmid-41676193.summary_en: This case report describes a 62-year-old woman with a 20 cm pelvic mass containing cystic, solid and microcystic areas. Immunohistochemistry supported a diagnosis of anaplastic ovarian mucinous carcinoma with yolk sac tumor differentiation. Despite six cycles of chemotherapy, the tumor recurred at 62 days and filled the abdominal cavity, with the patient still alive but in poor condition. The authors review eight reported cases, noting gene alterations such as CDKN2A/CDKN2B deletion and KRAS and TP53 mutation, and that six of eight cases recurred or died within one year.

pmid-41684192.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の分子病態、2022年WHO分類(BRAF様型とRAS様型)、診断と治療をまとめた総説です。甲状腺癌に類似した遺伝子変異パターンと、BRAF/MEK、RET、NTRKの各阻害薬などの遺伝子型に基づく標的療法を紹介しています。局所病変では外科的切除が根治的ですが、晩期再発もあるため長期のフォローアップが必要としています。
pmid-41684192.summary_en: This comprehensive review of malignant struma ovarii synthesizes molecular pathogenesis, the 2022 WHO classification into BRAF-like and RAS-like subtypes, and diagnostic approaches. It highlights next-generation sequencing findings that mirror primary thyroid cancer and emerging genotype-guided targeted therapies such as BRAF/MEK, RET, and NTRK inhibitors. Surgical excision is curative for localized disease, while thyroidectomy with radioactive iodine is reserved for high-risk tumors. The authors stress long-term surveillance because late recurrences occur, and integrate their own case series with published data.

pmid-41685051.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、エチオピアのアディスアベバにおける5年間の非上皮性卵巣癌（NEOC）を解析したものです。卵巣癌264例中80例（17.3%）を占め、胚細胞腫瘍は43.8%でした。胚細胞腫瘍では卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も多い組織型でした。患者の27%が妊孕性温存手術を受けました。
pmid-41685051.summary_en: This five-year retrospective review from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, examined nonepithelial ovarian cancers (NEOC), which accounted for 17.3% of 264 ovarian cancers. Sex cord-stromal tumors (46.2%) and germ cell tumors (43.8%) were the main types, with yolk sac tumor as the most common germ cell histology. Most patients (65%) underwent staging surgery, and 27% had fertility-sparing surgery. No significant association was found between age and tumor type. The authors report a higher NEOC prevalence than in previous reports from other settings.

pmid-41686118.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍で、肺と脳に転移のあった42歳男性の症例。経胸壁心エコーで左心房の腫瘤が血栓と誤認された。画像検査と手術により、左上肺静脈から進展した腫瘍と判明した。心臓への転移は非血行性に肺静脈を介して起こりうることを示し、多角的画像診断の重要性を強調している。
pmid-41686118.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old man with testicular germ cell tumor, refractory to chemotherapy and metastatic to lungs and brain, who presented with dyspnea and angina. Echocardiography initially suggested a left atrial thrombus. Multimodality imaging and surgery revealed the mass was tumor extending from a left superior pulmonary vein. The authors note that the lungs are the most common metastatic site in testicular cancer and that cardiac spread is typically via direct extension or the pulmonary veins. The report stresses multimodality imaging to distinguish tumor from thrombus.

pmid-41687980.summary_ja: 本総説は、若年欧州男性に最も多いがんである精巣胚細胞腫瘍（TGCT）の最近の進歩をまとめたものです。異数性の高さ、低い遺伝子変異負荷、多遺伝子性の感受性、miR-371-3やctDNAなどの新規バイオマーカー、シスプラチンを含む治療と生存者の長期的影響を論じています。
pmid-41687980.summary_en: This review summarizes recent progress on testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs), the most common cancer among young European men. It covers rising incidence, genomic features such as high aneuploidy, low mutational burden and global hypomethylation, and polygenic susceptibility with 78 loci identified in GWAS. The authors discuss cisplatin-based multimodal therapy, long-term health and psychosocial effects in survivors, and emerging biomarkers such as the miR-371-3 cluster and ctDNA. They also address treatment de-escalation to limit survivorship burden.

pmid-41689870.summary_ja: インディアナ大学の精巣がんデータベースを後方視的に解析し、胎児性癌優位の臨床病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍126例の治療戦略を比較した研究です。初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清の群では85%が完全寛解を達成し、3年無再発生存率は85.1%でした。化学療法群の3年無再発生存率は89.8%でした。郭清後の再発も化学療法で救済可能で、初回郭清が治療負担を減らす可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-41689870.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of the Indiana University Testicular Cancer Database included 126 patients with clinical stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors and embryonal carcinoma predominance over 50%. Of 67 patients who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, 85% achieved complete remission as a single modality, with 3-year recurrence-free survival of 85.1%. Among 59 receiving upfront chemotherapy, 3-year recurrence-free survival was 89.8%, and recurrences were effectively salvaged. The authors conclude that primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection may reduce overall treatment burden in early-stage II embryonal carcinoma-predominant NSGCT.

pmid-41690477.summary_ja: 体細胞由来の卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST)成分を伴う子宮内膜癌23例の臨床病理学的、免疫組織化学的、分子生物学的検討。74%がp53異常型で、73%にTP53変異を認めた。7p21.2や9p21.3の増幅など胚細胞腫瘍に類似した所見があった。全生存期間は他の分子分類より有意に不良で、高悪性度(グレード3)とみなすべきと結論された。
pmid-41690477.summary_en: Twenty-three endometrial carcinomas with a somatically derived yolk sac tumor component were analyzed clinicopathologically, immunohistochemically, and molecularly. Most were p53-abnormal (74%), and TP53 variants occurred in 73%. Germ-cell-tumor-like features included 7p21.2 and 9p21.3 amplifications and 12p polysomy. Overall survival was significantly poorer than in other endometrial carcinoma molecular subtypes, and 75% of patients had died of disease or were alive with disease. The authors conclude these tumors are aggressive and should be graded as high-grade.

pmid-41692474.summary_ja: 意識障害と尿閉を呈した18歳女性で、卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎が疑われ、入院当日に卵巣摘出術を施行した。ステロイドパルスと大量免疫グロブリン療法で改善した。自己抗体は全て陰性で、早期腫瘍切除の意義が論じられた。
pmid-41692474.summary_en: An 18-year-old woman presented with altered consciousness and urinary retention. Brain MRI showed FLAIR hyperintensity along the brainstem surface. Because of an ovarian teratoma, paraneoplastic encephalitis was suspected, and ovariectomy was performed on admission. Steroid pulse therapy and high-dose intravenous immunoglobulin were started, improving symptoms and MRI findings. All tested autoantibodies were negative. The authors note that no guidance exists on ovariectomy timing in autoimmune encephalitis with ovarian teratoma outside anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, and suggest early tumour resection may be desirable to remove the antigen.

pmid-41694384.summary_ja: 右卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を伴う15歳女児の自己免疫性脳炎症例です。統合失調症様症状や幻覚を呈し、抗NMDAR抗体は陰性でしたが、血清と脳脊髄液から抗NCAM1抗体が検出されました。免疫療法で症状が消失し、治療後に抗体は消失しました。卵巣組織でもNCAM1の発現が確認され、新たな傍腫瘍性脳炎の可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-41694384.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old girl with autoimmune encephalitis presenting with schizophrenia-like symptoms, delusions, hallucinations, and catalepsy, associated with a right mature cystic ovarian teratoma. Anti-NMDA receptor antibodies were negative, but anti-NCAM1 antibodies were detected in serum and cerebrospinal fluid. Treatment with methylprednisolone, intravenous immunoglobulin, and additional immunotherapy led to resolution, and the antibodies disappeared afterward. Immunohistochemistry confirmed NCAM1 expression in the ovarian tissue. The authors suggest anti-NCAM1 antibodies may define a novel paraneoplastic autoimmune encephalitis with psychotic features.

pmid-41694818.summary_ja: 月経前の若年女性で、成熟奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)の付属器捻転が急性虫垂炎様に発症した症例。捻転では腹痛や急性腹症が典型的で、早期診断と適切な手術により卵巣温存と低侵襲手術が可能となる。隣接臓器の炎症も鑑別に入れる必要がある。初経前の女児には類皮嚢腫の定期的なスクリーニングはない。
pmid-41694818.summary_en: The authors present a young premenstrual patient whose mature ovarian teratoma (dermoid cyst) with adnexal torsion mimicked acute appendicitis. Abdominal pain or an acute abdomen is the usual presentation of torsion. Early diagnosis and timely surgery can preserve the ovary and allow minimal surgery. The authors stress that inflammation of neighbouring organs such as the appendix should be considered, and note that routine screening for dermoid cysts does not exist in premenarchal girls.

pmid-41702443.summary_ja: オランダの多職種ワーキンググループが、セミノーマ患者の続発がんリスク低減を目的として陽子線療法の国家適応プロトコルを策定した。腎臓、膵臓、胃、膀胱のリスクを推定し、過去の13例で陽子線と光子線の計画を比較した。第1版の基準は50歳以下、傍大動脈・傍腸骨への照射、生命を脅かす併存症なしとした。
pmid-41702443.summary_en: This study describes a multidisciplinary Dutch workgroup's development of a National Indication Protocol for proton therapy in seminoma testis patients, aimed at reducing subsequent primary cancer risk. Organ-specific excess risks from radiation were estimated for kidney, pancreas, stomach, and bladder. Proton-photon planning comparisons in 13 historical patients showed feasibility for absolute excess risk reduction of at least 2% in most cases. Version 1 criteria included age 50 years or younger, paraortic or para-iliac radiotherapy, and no life-threatening comorbidity. In the first 76 patients, 71% qualified for version 2, and average AER reduction was 3.0%. About 75% of seminoma patients were estimated to qualify.

pmid-41709043.summary_ja: 小児悪性卵巣腫瘍49例の後方視的解析で、胚細胞腫瘍が75.5%を占めた(未熟奇形腫59.5%)。胚細胞腫瘍は石灰化を伴う大きな単側性病変で、AFP上昇を認めた。超音波所見、O-RADS、腫瘍マーカーの統合により術前の病理診断が可能になると述べている。
pmid-41709043.summary_en: This retrospective analysis included 49 children with pathologically confirmed malignant ovarian tumors. Germ cell tumors accounted for 75.5%, including immature teratoma (59.5%), with endodermal sinus tumor and mixed germ cell tumor each 16.2%. Sex cord-stromal tumors were 16.3% and lymphoma 8.2%. Germ cell tumors were typically unilateral, large, calcified and associated with elevated AFP, whereas lymphoma was bilateral, small and associated with elevated LDH. The authors propose that integrating ultrasound features, O-RADS and tumor markers enables preoperative pathological typing in children.

pmid-41709281.summary_ja: インド中部の三次医療施設で精巣腫瘍患者108例を後方視的に解析し、進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の転帰を評価した研究です。約半数が低体重で、81%が毒性により治療遅延や用量変更を経験しました。中央値の無増悪生存期間は8.6か月、全生存期間は11.9か月と、高所得国より不良でした。正常BMIは良好な予後と関連しました。
pmid-41709281.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 108 patients with testicular cancer at a tertiary center in central India evaluated outcomes in advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. About half of the patients were underweight, and 81% experienced treatment delays or dose modifications, mainly due to toxicity. Median PFS was 8.6 months and median overall survival 11.9 months, markedly inferior to figures from high-income countries. Normal BMI was significantly associated with better PFS and OS. The authors attribute poor outcomes to delayed presentation, advanced disease, poor chemotherapy tolerance, and frequent treatment modifications.

pmid-41711113.summary_ja: デンマークの臨床病期I精巣がん患者1377例を対象に、組織型を問わない再発予測の機械学習モデルを開発・検証した研究です。CatBoostがLightGBMより高性能で、AUCは0.74、陰性的中率は0.86でした。脈管浸潤、胎児性癌、腫瘍壊死などが主要な予測因子で、腫瘍壊死と脈管浸潤の解剖学的位置は新たな予測因子でした。再発の除外に特に有用とされています。
pmid-41711113.summary_en: This Danish population-based cohort study of 1377 patients with clinical stage I testicular cancer developed a unified machine learning model to predict relapse regardless of histology. CatBoost outperformed LightGBM with an AUC of 0.74 and a negative predictive value of 0.86, while a random survival forest achieved a concordance index of 0.71. Prediction was better in non-seminoma. Top features included lymphovascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma, tumor necrosis, rete testis invasion, tumor size, and elevated LDH and beta-hCG. Tumor necrosis and the anatomical location of lymphovascular invasion were novel predictors. The model is particularly useful for ruling out relapse.

pmid-41712877.summary_ja: 再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍の患者69例(大量化学療法)と26例(通常量化学療法)の血漿cfDNAを浅層全ゲノム解析で評価した。腫瘍割合の高値は全生存期間の短縮と関連し、マイクロRNA(miRNA)のmiR-371a-3pは予後因子ではなかった。卵黄嚢腫瘍や絨毛癌の組織像を多く含む高リスクのコピー数異常クラスターは予後不良であった。腫瘍割合が高い症例では大量化学療法が有効に見えた。
pmid-41712877.summary_en: This study analyzed plasma cell-free DNA by shallow whole-genome sequencing in 69 relapsed/refractory GCT patients treated with high-dose chemotherapy and 26 treated with conventional-dose chemotherapy. High baseline tumor fraction was associated with worse overall survival, while miR-371a-3p levels were not prognostic. A high-risk copy-number cluster enriched for yolk sac and choriocarcinoma histology predicted worse PFS and OS. High-dose chemotherapy appeared more effective than conventional dosing in patients with high tumor fraction. The authors propose these biomarkers could refine risk stratification.

pmid-41716564.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に対する腹腔鏡単孔式手術(LESS)のため、手術用グローブと吸引チューブのリングで作製した自作ポートの手技報告。改変した回収袋で閉鎖系を作り、臍部から摘出。低コストで資源の限られた環境に適する。
pmid-41716564.summary_en: This technical report describes a low-cost, self-assembled glove-port platform for laparoscopic single-site surgery (LESS) resection of ovarian teratoma. The port was built from a surgical glove and suction-tube rings, and a modified retrieval bag with a drawstring was used to contain and extract the specimen through the umbilicus. The procedure was completed without spillage or extra incisions. The authors present this as a safe, feasible alternative in resource-limited settings.

pmid-41717809.summary_ja: 精巣生検を受けた男性1870例の後方視的解析で、OCT3/4反射免疫染色によるGCNISの検出率を検討した。GCNISは生検の1.4%に認められ、精子形成が保たれた精細管の近傍からも見つかった。胚細胞腫瘍の既往や疑いがある男性では6倍高頻度であった。精子形成の程度とは関連が認められなかった。
pmid-41717809.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution series of 1870 men who underwent testicular biopsy for infertility assessed the diagnostic yield of reflex OCT3/4 immunohistochemistry for detecting germ cell neoplasia in situ. GCNIS was found in 1.4% of biopsies and occasionally adjacent to or within tubules with normal spermatogenesis. Men with suspected or known germ cell tumor were six times more likely to have GCNIS. Detection did not differ by unilateral or bilateral sampling, or by degree of spermatogenesis. Subtle interstitial seminoma was identified in three patients. The authors conclude that OCT3/4 reflex testing improves detection, and that clinical history rather than spermatogenic status predicts GCNIS.

pmid-41720484.summary_ja: SEERデータベースの精巣がん患者30,689例を用いたコックス回帰による予後ノモグラムの開発研究。1、3、5、10年の全生存期間と原疾患特異的生存期間を予測する。年齢が最も強い予後因子で、絨毛癌はセミノーマと比べ予後が最も不良であった。内部・外部検証で良好な識別能と較正を示し、TNM分類より正確なスコアリングシステムも提案された。
pmid-41720484.summary_en: Using 30,689 SEER patients diagnosed with testicular cancer from 2004 to 2021, the authors built Cox-based nomograms for 1-, 3-, 5-, and 10-year overall survival and cancer-specific survival. Age was the strongest predictor, and choriocarcinoma had the worst survival compared with seminoma. Internal and external validation showed C-index values of 0.78 to 0.87 with good calibration. A prognostic scoring system was also developed and outperformed the TNM system in this cohort.

pmid-41723047.summary_ja: 1994年から2023年に治療された臨床病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生存者128例を対象とした後方視的単施設コホート研究。経過観察群と補助療法群で併存症の頻度は概ね同様であった。全般的なQOLは両群とも高く、差は臨床的に意味のある水準に達しなかった。補助療法を選択する場合は白金製剤の累積曝露を最小限にすべきと提言している。
pmid-41723047.summary_en: This single-center retrospective cohort study assessed patient-reported outcomes and late comorbidities in 128 long-term survivors of clinical stage I testicular germ cell tumors, treated between 1994 and 2023. Surveillance and adjuvant chemotherapy groups had broadly similar comorbidity profiles, including dyslipidemia, hypertension, and hypogonadism. Global quality of life was high across strategies, and differences in scores generally did not reach clinical relevance. A clinically relevant subset reported sexual difficulties. The authors suggest minimizing cumulative platinum exposure when adjuvant therapy is chosen and emphasize structured survivorship care addressing cardiometabolic and psychological needs.

pmid-41724498.summary_ja: 精巣原発腫瘍の切除から20年以上を経て転移性奇形腫を発症した45歳男性の症例です。転移巣には乳頭状構造を示すミュラー管型明細胞癌が含まれ、奇形腫との合併として初めての報告です。PAX8やケラチンなどが陽性で、AFP、β-hCG、SALL4などは陰性でした。FISHで12p等染色体が確認され、奇形腫成分も残存していました。
pmid-41724498.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old man who developed a metastatic teratoma more than 20 years after resection of a primary testicular tumor. The metastasis contained a Mullerian-type clear cell carcinoma with papillary architecture and hobnail-like nuclei, a combination not previously reported with teratoma. Immunohistochemistry was positive for PAX8, keratin AE1/AE3, EMA, and MOC31, and negative for AFP, beta-hCG, SALL4, and OCT3/4. Fluorescence in situ hybridization revealed isochromosome 12p. A teratoma component was also present, and the authors describe this as the first report of such an association.

pmid-41724745.summary_ja: 2024年ISUPコンセンサス会議の事前調査として、精巣の胚細胞腫瘍前駆病変の診断実務をISUP会員に尋ねた。GCNISが適切な用語であるという強い合意が得られた。OCT3/4が主要マーカーとして好まれたが、免疫組織化学の必要性では合意に至らなかった。
pmid-41724745.summary_en: This report presents results of a premeeting anonymous survey of International Society of Urological Pathology members for the 2024 ISUP Consensus Conference, focusing on testicular germ cell tumour precursor lesions. There was strong agreement that GCNIS is the preferred term and should be reported in invasive GCT. Most pathologists prefer OCT3/4 as the primary marker, and a panel is generally considered unnecessary. No consensus was reached on whether immunohistochemistry is required. Three open questions remain: subtyping intratubular lesions, the approach to gonadoblastoma, and distinguishing Sertoli cell nodules from tumours.

pmid-41725111.summary_ja: 原発性無月経で受診した46,XYの成人完全型アンドロゲン不応症候群の女性2例を報告。いずれも胚細胞腫瘍を合併し、セミノーマと精細管内胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。全エクソーム解析で複数のAR変異が同定された。腹腔鏡下腫瘍摘除術後、12-24か月の観察で再発は認められなかった。
pmid-41725111.summary_en: This case series describes two adult women with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (46,XY) who developed germ cell tumors, both presenting with primary amenorrhea and raised testosterone and LH. The first had a left seminoma and right testicular tissue dysplasia, and the second had recurrent seminoma with intratubular germ cell neoplasia. Whole exome sequencing identified multiple AR mutations in each patient, which may contribute to severe CAIS phenotype and germ cell tumor development. Both underwent laparoscopic lumpectomy. At 12 to 24 months of follow-up, no recurrence was seen, and hormone replacement maintained secondary sex characteristics.

pmid-41727822.summary_ja: 2020年にRadiology Case Reportsに掲載された、脂肪を含まない成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の症例報告の訂正記事。訂正内容と原論文のDOIのみが記載され、臨床データは含まれない。対象は卵巣奇形腫であるため関連ありとして扱う。
pmid-41727822.summary_en: This erratum corrects a 2020 case report in Radiology Case Reports on a mature cystic ovarian teratoma without intracystic fat that showed the fat-within-the-wall sign. The notice contains only the correction statement and the DOI of the original article, with no clinical data. Because the corrected article concerns a mature ovarian teratoma, the item is kept as relevant, although it has no substantive content of its own.

pmid-41728581.summary_ja: 69歳女性の小腸閉塞の症例報告。回腸ループと右付属器腫瘤の癒着が原因で、腎腫瘤も偶発的に見つかった。人工肛門造設後、癒着剥離、右卵巣摘出、右腎摘出を施行。炎症を伴う潰瘍性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が症状の原因で、腎細胞癌も確認された。良性卵巣類皮嚢腫との同時性腎細胞癌の初めての報告とされる。
pmid-41728581.summary_en: This case report describes a 69-year-old woman with small bowel obstruction caused by adhesions between ileal loops and an incidentally found right adnexal mass. Imaging also showed a right renal mass. After a temporary loop ileostomy, she underwent adhesiolysis, right oophorectomy and right nephrectomy. Histology showed an inflamed, ulcerated ovarian mature cystic teratoma that caused the symptoms, along with a renal cell carcinoma. The authors note this is the first documented case of renal cell carcinoma synchronous with a benign ovarian dermoid cyst, and stress the value of recognizing unusual incidentalomas.

pmid-41728606.summary_ja: 閉経後57歳女性で、右卵巣の高異型度漿液性癌と左卵巣の良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が同時に認められた症例。左付属器病変は類皮嚢腫に相当する脂液面を示した。病理組織学的に漿液性癌(FIGO IIIC)と確認され、白金製剤による化学療法後、9か月再発なし。広範な組織採取により、良性病変への過剰治療を避けることの重要性を強調している。
pmid-41728606.summary_en: This case report describes a 57-year-old postmenopausal woman with synchronous high-grade serous carcinoma of the right ovary and a benign mature cystic teratoma in the left ovary. Imaging showed fat-fluid levels in the left adnexal lesion, consistent with a dermoid cyst. Histopathology confirmed HGSC with tubal and cervical stromal invasion, and immunohistochemistry supported Müllerian origin. The tumor was staged as FIGO IIIC. After hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and omentectomy, platinum-based chemotherapy was given, with no recurrence at 9 months. The authors emphasize careful sampling to avoid overtreating benign lesions.

pmid-41731693.summary_ja: 男性の絨毛癌を扱う最新の総説。精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に合併することが多く、転移とβ-hCG高値を伴って発症する。絨毛癌は化学療法感受性が高いが、腫瘍崩壊症候群や絨毛癌症候群を起こしうる。臨床像、病態、治療(開発中の治療を含む)と重篤な合併症の管理について解説している。
pmid-41731693.summary_en: This update review covers choriocarcinoma in males, a rare malignancy usually arising with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. It typically presents with metastases and elevated β-hCG levels. Choriocarcinoma is chemosensitive, but chemotherapy can cause tumor lysis syndrome and choriocarcinoma syndrome. The review addresses clinical presentation, pathogenesis, standard and investigational treatments, and management of the severe complications of choriocarcinoma syndrome.

pmid-41736172.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の34歳男性で、肉眼的血尿を契機に前立腺混合型胚細胞腫瘍が見つかった症例。主体は卵黄嚢腫瘍で、一部がセミノーマ様を示した。腫瘍は精管上皮にパジェット様に進展していた。精巣には病変はなく、前立腺原発と結論づけている。
pmid-41736172.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with Klinefelter syndrome who presented with gross hematuria and a prostatic mixed germ cell tumor. The tumor was predominantly yolk sac tumor with focal seminoma and extended into the left vas deferens with pagetoid spread mimicking germ cell neoplasia in situ. Fluorescence in situ hybridization detected isochromosome 12p in tumor cells, yet no tumor was found in either testis. Immunohistochemistry showed the in situ-like component was SALL4 and c-kit positive but AFP negative. The authors conclude the tumor originated in the prostate. The case highlights an unusual anatomical distribution of mixed GCT in Klinefelter syndrome.

pmid-41737155.summary_ja: パキスタン・カラチの三次医療施設で2019〜2024年の生検記録385例を後方視的に解析した研究です。胞状奇胎は28.3%を占め、全胞状奇胎が最も多くみられました。患者の多くは16〜30歳でした。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌は稀でした。診断精度の向上と地域の疫学的サーベイランスの必要性を述べています。
pmid-41737155.summary_en: This observational retrospective study reviewed 385 biopsy records from a tertiary hospital in Karachi, Pakistan, from 2019 to 2024 to establish the frequency of molar pregnancies and their histopathological features. Molar pregnancies accounted for 28.3% of cases, with complete moles the most common. Most patients were aged 16 to 30 years. Invasive moles and choriocarcinoma were rare. Vesicular villi and trophoblastic proliferation were the main diagnostic findings. The authors call for higher diagnostic accuracy and local epidemiological surveillance, and suggest multicenter molecular studies.

pmid-41739995.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のマーカーであるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、CA125を同時に検出する白金ナノザイムを用いた側方流動免疫測定法を開発した。実験計画法で条件を最適化し、患者血清で検証した。AFPとhCGは感度87.5%と100%、特異度98.3%と100%で、検査室の基準値と良く一致した。
pmid-41739995.summary_en: The authors developed a multiplexed lateral flow immunoassay using platinum nanozyme conjugates to detect three ovarian germ cell tumor markers: AFP, hCG, and CA125. Design of experiments optimized antibody-nanozyme conjugation, and a new limit-of-detection model addressed heteroscedastic variance. Validation in patient serum showed sensitivities of 87.5% for AFP and 100% for hCG, with specificities of 98.3% and 100%, compared with laboratory gold standard values. The work provides a semiquantitative point-of-care tool for monitoring nonepithelial ovarian tumors.

pmid-41740198.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫関連抗NMDAR脳炎の小児97例の単施設後方視的コホート研究です。重症度と12か月後の機能転帰に関連する因子を検討しました。重症例は症状負荷、多発性MRI病変、extreme delta-brushと関連していました。多変量解析では、中枢性低換気、多発病変、delta-brush、21日を超える腫瘍摘出遅延が不良転帰の独立因子でした。
pmid-41740198.summary_en: This single-center retrospective cohort of 97 pediatric patients with ovarian teratoma-associated anti-NMDAR encephalitis examines factors predicting severity and 12-month functional outcome. Severe disease was linked to symptom burden, multifocal MRI lesions, and extreme delta-brush. Multivariable analysis identified central hypoventilation, multifocal lesions, extreme delta-brush, and resection delayed beyond 21 days as independent predictors of poor outcome. The combined clinical and imaging-EEG model showed AUC 0.86.

pmid-41741123.summary_ja: 30代女性の絨毛癌が、びまん性嚢胞性肺疾患に似た多発嚢胞性肺転移として発見された症例。転移性腫瘍が多発性肺嚢胞の原因となることは稀だが、リンパ脈管筋腫症や肺ランゲルハンス細胞組織球症との鑑別が必要である。若年女性の嚢胞性肺病変では転移性疾患も考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-41741123.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in her 30s with choriocarcinoma presenting with multiple cystic lung lesions that mimicked diffuse cystic lung disease. Metastatic malignancy is an uncommon cause of multiple pulmonary cysts and can mimic lymphangioleiomyomatosis or pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis. The authors note that choriocarcinoma secretes beta-hCG and has a poor prognosis. They highlight the importance of considering metastatic disease in the differential diagnosis of diffuse cystic lung changes, especially in young women with a gynecologic history.

pmid-41743225.summary_ja: 15歳女児が腹部膨満と胸部圧迫感で受診し、大量の胸水と腹水を認めた。卵巣腫瘍の外科的切除後に胸腹水は速やかに消失し、偽Meigs症候群と考えられた。病理で卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と診断され、補助化学療法を受けた。9か月の経過観察で再発は認めなかった。小児の骨盤内腫瘤に伴う大量の胸腹水は誤診されやすく、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に入れる必要がある。
pmid-41743225.summary_en: A 15-year-old girl presented with abdominal distension, chest tightness, and large pleural and ascitic effusions. Surgical resection of the pelvic tumor led to rapid resolution of the effusions, consistent with pseudo-Meigs syndrome. Pathology confirmed ovarian dysgerminoma. She received adjuvant chemotherapy, recovered well, and had no recurrence during 9 months of follow-up. The report highlights that massive effusions with a pelvic mass in children can be misdiagnosed and that ovarian germ cell tumor should be considered in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-41743388.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の卵巣腫瘤を右付属器摘出術で切除したところ、成熟卵巣奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌と診断された。追加手術の予定時にびまん性腹膜癌腫症が判明し、術前化学療法となった。悪性転化例の診断と治療の難しさを示す。
pmid-41743388.summary_en: The authors describe a postmenopausal woman whose pelvic mass, resected with right adnexectomy, was histologically diagnosed as squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature ovarian teratoma. A multidisciplinary tumour board recommended completion surgery, but intraoperative findings revealed diffuse peritoneal carcinomatosis. She was therefore referred for neoadjuvant chemotherapy. The case highlights the diagnostic and therapeutic challenges of squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma and its aggressive clinical course.

pmid-41749126.summary_ja: 奇形腫を伴う抗NMDAR脳炎の小児84例の後方視的コホート研究。中枢性低換気、多発MRI病変、極端なデルタブラシが重症度と関連した。12か月時点で23.8%が予後不良であった。独立予測因子には、発症から21日を超えた腫瘍切除も含まれた。
pmid-41749126.summary_en: This single-center retrospective cohort of 84 pediatric patients with teratoma-associated anti-NMDAR encephalitis identified markers of diffuse neuroinvolvement associated with severe disease and poor 12-month outcomes. Central hypoventilation, multifocal MRI lesions, and extreme delta-brush on EEG were linked to ICU-level severity. At 12 months, 23.8% had poor functional outcomes. Independent predictors were central hypoventilation, four or more symptom categories, multifocal MRI involvement, extreme delta-brush, and tumor resection more than 21 days after onset. The multivariable model had an AUC of 0.89. Early tumor resection and early recognition of diffuse involvement may improve prognosis.

pmid-41749828.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の胎児性癌細胞株3種と、そのシスプラチン耐性株を用い、シスプラチン投与後の全遺伝子発現応答を比較した研究。親株は応答が強く、p53標的遺伝子の上昇とMYC標的遺伝子の低下を示した。p53、MYC、TFRC1の標的遺伝子の応答低下が耐性の機序と考えられた。一部の遺伝子は患者コホートの無病生存とも関連した。
pmid-41749828.summary_en: Researchers compared the transcriptional response to acute cisplatin in three parental embryonal carcinoma TGCT cell lines and their isogenic cisplatin-resistant clones. Parental cells showed a stronger response, including upregulation of p53 targets and downregulation of MYC targets. Genes altered exclusively in parental cells, including TFRC, were associated with disease-free survival in a TGCT patient cohort. The authors conclude that diminished responsiveness of p53, MYC, and TFRC1 target genes may underlie cisplatin resistance in TGCT.

pmid-41755649.summary_ja: 2000〜2023年にシェフィールド絨毛性疾患センターで診断された非典型胎盤部結節22例の後方視的症例集積。45%が外科的管理を受け、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍への進展は認めなかった。既報の悪性化リスクとの差異を指摘し、国際的なコンセンサスの必要性を述べている。
pmid-41755649.summary_en: This retrospective case series from the Sheffield Trophoblastic Disease Centre (2000-2023) included 22 atypical placental site nodules. Ten patients (45%) underwent surgical management, mostly total abdominal hysterectomy. Twelve patients opted primarily for conservative management, and some later chose hysterectomy after counselling. None developed histological gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. The authors note this contrasts with reported malignancy risks of 11-14% and call for an international consensus on management and follow-up of atypical placental site nodules.

pmid-41756063.summary_ja: 子宮内胎児死亡を契機に発見された胎盤内絨毛癌の症例報告。病理組織学的診断、臨床管理、残存病変のフォローアップを記載している。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍は希少で指針が限られ、血清β-hCGに依存しているのが現状である。日常的な胎盤検査が未予想の絨毛癌の発見につながり、今後のガイドライン作成に組み込むべきと述べている。
pmid-41756063.summary_en: This case report describes intraplacental choriocarcinoma discovered in the setting of intrauterine fetal demise. The authors present the histopathologic diagnosis, clinical management, and surveillance for residual disease. Because gestational trophoblastic neoplasia is rare, treatment and surveillance guidance is limited, and clinicians rely mainly on serum β-hCG levels. The report emphasizes that routine placental examination can reveal unsuspected choriocarcinoma. The authors argue that such examination should be included in future clinical practice guidelines for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-41758761.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘤の男性183例を後方視的に解析し、血清腫瘍マーカーと腹部CTで胸部CTを省略できるかを検討しました。胚細胞腫瘍174例のうち胸部転移は10例でした。事前規定のルールでは転移見逃しはなく(感度100%、陰性的中率100%)、胸部CTの45.4%を回避できました。外部検証を前提に、被ばく低減に有用と結論しています。
pmid-41758761.summary_en: This retrospective cohort of 183 men with a testicular mass evaluated whether chest CT could be selectively omitted using serum tumor markers and abdominal CT. Of 174 germ-cell tumors, chest metastases occurred in 10 patients. The prespecified rule would have missed no metastases (sensitivity 100%, NPV 100%) and avoided 45.4% of chest CTs. The authors conclude this strategy may reduce radiation exposure, pending external validation.

pmid-41762714.summary_ja: 13歳女児で、仙尾部奇形腫内の神経内分泌腫瘍からの異所性ACTH産生によるクッシング症候群。FDG-PETは軽度の集積だったが、68Ga-DOTA-NOC PET/CTで強いソマトスタチン受容体発現を認めた。腹腔鏡下切除後にコルチゾールとACTHは正常化し、9か月で再発はない。相補的なPET検査と完全切除の重要性を強調している。
pmid-41762714.summary_en: This report describes a 13-year-old girl with ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome caused by ectopic ACTH secretion from a neuroendocrine tumor within a sacrococcygeal teratoma. FDG-PET showed mild uptake, whereas 68Ga-DOTA-NOC PET/CT showed intense somatostatin receptor expression. Laparoscopic resection found a mature teratoma with a well-differentiated G1 neuroendocrine tumor positive for ACTH and SSTR2. Cortisol and ACTH normalized after surgery, with no recurrence at 9 months. The authors highlight complementary PET imaging and complete resection as key to managing this rare pediatric syndrome.

pmid-41765467.summary_ja: 縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の27歳男性の剖検例。骨髄異形成症候群と骨髄肉腫を同時に発症していた。腫瘍は奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、セミノーマ、絨毛癌成分からなっていた。骨髄以外のリンパ節や臓器に骨髄芽球が浸潤し、TP53とKRASの変異が認められた。
pmid-41765467.summary_en: This autopsy report describes a 27-year-old man with primary mediastinal germ cell tumor who developed simultaneous myelodysplastic neoplasm with low blasts and myeloid sarcoma. Presenting features included an 11 cm anterior mediastinal mass, elevated AFP and hCG, and thrombocytopenia. The autopsy showed a mixed tumor with teratoma, yolk sac tumor, seminoma, and choriocarcinoma components. Myeloid blasts infiltrated lymph nodes, liver, spleen, and intestine without transformation to acute myeloid leukemia in the marrow. Sequencing identified TP53 and KRAS variants, and p53 loss was seen in extramedullary blasts. The authors stress considering hematologic malignancy when extramediastinal lesions or thrombocytopenia appear.

pmid-41768349.summary_ja: 原発性前立腺卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。文献上わずか9例しか報告されていないまれな疾患である。臨床像、病理学的特徴、治療、予後について文献レビューを行い、診断と管理の一助としている。
pmid-41768349.summary_en: This case report describes primary prostatic yolk sac tumor, an extremely rare entity with only nine prior cases documented in the literature. The authors present a patient with this tumor and review the literature regarding clinical presentation, pathological features, therapeutic approaches and prognosis. The unusual anatomic site and diverse histological patterns make diagnosis challenging. The authors aim to provide additional experience to aid diagnosis and management of this entity.

pmid-41768783.summary_ja: 低所得国の妊娠中の23歳女性が性器出血とショックで受診した症例。hCGの著明な上昇から妊娠性絨毛性疾患が疑われ、侵入奇胎に続発した子宮破裂と判明した。病理組織学的所見はないものの絨毛癌と臨床的に診断され、メトトレキサート療法が開始された。1コース後に受診が途絶えた。
pmid-41768783.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old pregnant woman in a low-income country who presented with genital bleeding and hypovolemic shock. Markedly elevated hCG suggested gestational trophoblastic disease, and uterine rupture following an invasive mole was diagnosed. Subtotal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and bladder repair was performed. Without histopathology, choriocarcinoma was inferred clinically and biochemically. Methotrexate-folinic acid chemotherapy was started, but she was lost to follow-up after the first course. The authors stress that early diagnosis and emphasizing the curability of the disease are key to treatment adherence.

pmid-41769489.summary_ja: バングラデシュの胞状奇胎57例を対象とした横断研究。完全奇胎の88.9%がp57陰性、部分奇胎の69.2%が陽性。p57免疫染色は病理診断を補完し、完全・部分の再分類に寄与した。
pmid-41769489.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated p57 immunostaining in 57 histologically diagnosed hydatidiform moles from Bangladesh. Among 36 complete moles, 88.9% were p57-negative, while 69.2% of 13 partial moles were p57-positive. Immunostaining showed a statistically significant association with final diagnosis and led to reclassification of cases into 42 complete and 15 partial moles. The authors conclude that p57 immunostaining, used together with histopathology, improves diagnostic accuracy and reduces ambiguity in mole subclassification.

pmid-41770291.summary_ja: 絨毛癌に対するスタチン再利用の可能性を、メバロン酸経路とRho GTPaseを介した機械的シグナル伝達の観点から論じた総説です。前臨床研究でシンバスタチンとアトルバスタチンが増殖抑制、アポトーシス誘導、β-hCG低下、化学療法抵抗性株を含む増殖・転移抑制を示しています。高リスクや難治性の絨毛癌に対する早期臨床試験を提案しています。
pmid-41770291.summary_en: This review proposes repurposing statins to treat choriocarcinoma by inhibiting the mevalonate pathway and disrupting Rho GTPase-driven mechanosignaling. Preclinical data show simvastatin and atorvastatin reduce proliferation, induce apoptosis, lower β-hCG secretion, and inhibit growth and metastasis, including in chemoresistant lines. Geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate reverses these effects, supporting a prenylation-dependent mechanism. The authors advocate early-phase clinical trials of statins in high-risk or refractory choriocarcinoma.

pmid-41771671.summary_ja: デンマーク全国コホートで、精巣胚細胞がん患者の子の小児・若年成人がんリスクを対照群と比較した。小児がんのリスクは両群で同程度であった。息子のAYAがんリスクは上昇し(HR 1.9)、その大部分は精巣胚細胞がんによるものだった(HR 3.6)。娘にはリスク上昇は認められなかった。
pmid-41771671.summary_en: This Danish nationwide cohort study assessed childhood and adolescent/young adult cancer risk in offspring of men with testicular germ cell cancer, compared with matched controls. Childhood cancer risk was comparable between offspring of cases and controls. Sons of testicular cancer probands had an increased AYA cancer risk (HR 1.9), driven almost entirely by testicular germ cell cancer (HR 3.6). Other cancer types showed no significant difference. Daughters showed no elevated risk. The authors conclude that the increased AYA risk in sons reflects a higher rate of testicular cancer rather than other malignancies.

pmid-41772063.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株で過剰発現するLSD1を標的に、天然アピゲニン類縁体の阻害活性を評価した。8,3'-ジプレニルアピゲニンが最も強い可逆的・選択的阻害を示し、NCCITとNTERA-2の増殖を抑制した。活性酸素種の産生やATP低下などの機序も示され、新規候補化合物として期待される。
pmid-41772063.summary_en: This study evaluated a series of natural apigenin analogues for inhibition of lysine-specific demethylase 1 (LSD1), a target overexpressed in testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. 8,3'-diprenylapigenin was the most potent inhibitor (IC50 3.60 µM) and reversibly, selectively inhibited LSD1. It suppressed proliferation of NCCIT and NTERA-2 cells, induced reactive oxygen species, reduced catalase activity and ATP, and increased LDH release in NTERA-2 cells. The authors propose it as a novel candidate for treating testicular germ cell tumors, warranting further exploration.

pmid-41773116.summary_ja: 80歳女性献体の解剖で、両側付属器の異常組織を偶発的に認めた症例報告。左卵巣では萎縮した卵巣間質と、呼吸上皮と甲状腺組織を含む成熟奇形腫(卵巣甲状腺腫)が確認された。奇形腫の骨盤内線維化や、甲状腺組織による高血圧関連死の可能性について考察している。
pmid-41773116.summary_en: This case report describes incidental bilateral adnexal masses found during dissection of an 80-year-old hysterectomized female cadaveric donor. Histology showed atrophied ovarian stroma and a mature teratoma with respiratory epithelium and thyroid tissue, consistent with struma ovarii in the left mass. Other findings included an elongated rectum, sigmoid megacolon, a sigmoid adhesion and bilateral inguinal fat herniations. The authors discuss post-hysterectomy complications, pelvic fibrosis in teratomas and the potential for active thyroid tissue within teratomas to cause hypertension-related death.

pmid-41773153.summary_ja: 40歳ネパール出身男性の10年にわたる頸部リンパ節腫脹と胸痛。2023年のCTで前縦隔腫瘤を認め、生検で成熟奇形腫。2024年に胸腔鏡下手術で完全切除し症状は消失。稀な縦隔奇形腫の診断遅延を示す症例。
pmid-41773153.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old Nepalese man with recurrent cervical and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, chest pain, and throat pressure over ten years with intermittent follow-up. CT in 2023 revealed an anterior mediastinal mass, and biopsy showed a mature teratoma. Video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery in 2024 found adhesion to the pericardium and proximity to the phrenic nerve and brachiocephalic vein. The patient achieved complete symptom remission. The case highlights diagnostic delay in a rare mediastinal teratoma.

pmid-41773555.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の免疫微小環境を、腫瘍浸潤T細胞を中心に総説した論文。免疫特権を持つ精巣が腫瘍によって破綻し、マクロファージや樹状細胞などの免疫細胞が変化することを概説。免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の効果は限定的であり、単一細胞解析に基づく新規免疫療法の開発が必要と論じている。
pmid-41773555.summary_en: This review examines the immune landscape of testicular germ cell tumors, focusing on tumor-infiltrating T lymphocytes. The authors describe how the immune-privileged testis is disrupted in TGCT, altering macrophages, mast cells, dendritic cells, and T cell subsets. They critically evaluate CD4+ and CD8+ T cell subtypes in anti-tumor responses and immune evasion. Although immune checkpoint inhibitors and CAR-T approaches have succeeded in other cancers, their efficacy in TGCT is limited. The review calls for high-resolution single-cell characterization of T cell populations to guide novel immunotherapy strategies.

pmid-41775250.summary_ja: 韓国の全国データベースを用いた成人卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍332例の後方視的コホート研究です。組織型別の治療パターンと生存を比較しました。ディスジャーミノーマでは手術単独が多く、非ディスジャーミノーマ性や奇形腫性では補助化学療法が多用されていました。補助化学療法は次治療までの期間を延長しましたが、全生存期間の改善は認めませんでした。
pmid-41775250.summary_en: This nationwide Korean retrospective cohort of 332 adults with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors compares treatment patterns and survival by histologic subtype. Surgery alone was common in dysgerminoma, while adjuvant chemotherapy was frequent in non-dysgerminomatous and teratomatous GCTs. Adjuvant chemotherapy prolonged time to first subsequent therapy or death overall but did not improve overall survival. Subgroup analyses showed the TFST benefit in non-dysgerminomatous and malignant teratomatous tumors.

pmid-41775352.summary_ja: 化学療法後RPLNDを受けた転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍48例を後方視的に解析し、CTで測定した腰筋椎体指数（PLVI）の予測能を評価した。低いPLVIは術後合併症の増加および無転移生存期間の短縮と関連した。PLVIは手術と腫瘍学的転帰の予測マーカーとして有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-41775352.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 48 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell cancer who underwent post-chemotherapy RPLND evaluated whether central sarcopenia, measured as the psoas lumbar vertebral index (PLVI) on CT, predicts outcomes. Median follow-up was 81.5 months. Low PLVI was significantly associated with higher postoperative complication rates and, together with large tumour size, independently associated with shorter metastasis-free survival. The authors conclude that PLVI may be a useful predictive marker for surgical and oncological outcomes after RPLND.

pmid-41777659.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍16例の全エクソーム解析を行った。43.75%に予測される発がん性変異を認め、KITやKRASが含まれた。KITとKRASの変異は治療標的として有望であり、MTOR、PIK3CA、AKT2も標的治療の候補とされた。
pmid-41777659.summary_en: This study performed whole-exome sequencing on 16 pediatric germ cell tumors and matched normal samples, comprising ten ovarian, five testicular and one mediastinal tumor. Seven samples (43.75%) harbored predicted oncogenic variants in genes including KIT, KRAS, MTOR, PIK3CA and AKT2. Copy number alterations involved chromosomes 4, 7, 8, 10, 12, 21 and 22, with amplification of KRAS and CCND2 and deletion of KIT and PTEN. Clinically significant KIT and KRAS mutations suggested potential therapeutic targets, while MTOR, PIK3CA and AKT2 were proposed as candidates for targeted therapy in pediatric GCTs.

pmid-41782041.summary_ja: 病期IIaの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の54歳日本人男性の症例報告です。エトポシド・シスプラチン療法の初回標準量1コースの後、肝障害、難聴、透析を要する急性腎障害、汎血球減少、視力障害など多臓器毒性を生じました。シスプラチン継続が不可能となり、エトポシド・カルボプラチン3コースに変更し完全寛解を得て、12か月間無再発です。シスプラチン開始前の個別リスク評価を強調しています。
pmid-41782041.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old Japanese man with stage IIa nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who developed severe multiorgan toxicity after a single standard cycle of etoposide and cisplatin. Complications included hepatic dysfunction, ototoxicity, dialysis-requiring acute kidney injury, pancytopenia, and visual impairment. Cisplatin could not be continued, so he received three cycles of etoposide-carboplatin, achieving complete remission and remaining disease-free at 12 months. The authors highlight individualized risk assessment before cisplatin therapy.

pmid-41782058.summary_ja: 17歳男性の前縦隔に、心膜嚢胞との鑑別が問題となった13.6cm大の嚢胞性腫瘤を認めた。経食道心エコーで心膜外病変と判断され、正中胸骨切開で切除した。病理組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。
pmid-41782058.summary_en: A 17-year-old male presented with mild chest tightness and a syncopal episode two months earlier. Non-contrast CT showed a 13.6 cm cystic anterior mediastinal mass with fluid-like attenuation and no enhancement, closely attached to the pericardium. Transesophageal echocardiography showed extrapericardial compression, and the lesion was initially diagnosed as a pericardial cyst. Median sternotomy resection was performed. Histology showed mature cystic teratoma, and recovery was uneventful. The authors recommend TEE or MRI to avoid misdiagnosis of cyst-dominant teratomas.

pmid-41788713.summary_ja: 68歳女性の巨大卵巣腫瘍（35 cm、11 kg）。病理は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化による高異型度アポクリン癌。AR・EGFR陽性、ER・PR陰性。CA-125は559 U/mLから6か月後に正常化し再発なし。報告例は稀。
pmid-41788713.summary_en: This case report describes a 68-year-old woman with a giant ovarian tumor growing over 40 years, measuring 35 cm and weighing 11 kg. Histology showed a mature cystic teratoma with malignant transformation to high-grade apocrine carcinoma. Immunohistochemistry was AR and EGFR positive, ER and PR negative, and HER2 2+ (FISH negative). Serum CA-125 was 559 U/mL. The patient declined staging surgery, and at 6 months CA-125 was normal with no recurrence. The authors note that only four such cases have been reported.

pmid-41789661.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の診療における最近の進歩と課題をまとめた総説です。低容積の後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴う精巣セミノーマに対し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清が選択肢となることを示しています。循環腫瘍DNAやマイクロRNA-371が新規バイオマーカーとして注目されています。クローディン6標的療法は難治例に期待されており、多職種連携と高ボリュームセンターへの紹介を強調しています。
pmid-41789661.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in germ cell tumor management, including retroperitoneal lymph node dissection as an option for low-volume retroperitoneal disease in seminoma. It highlights circulating tumor DNA and microRNA-371 as emerging biomarkers. Claudin 6-targeted therapies in ongoing trials show promise for refractory disease. The authors emphasize multidisciplinary care and referral of advanced or refractory patients to high-volume centers.

pmid-41789794.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の精子を化学療法前後で解析した。BEP療法により無精子症や壊死精子症が生じ、非セミノーマ群で顕著であった。ヒストン修飾H4K12acは精子の運動能や数と相関し、妊孕性温存の指標となりうると示唆された。
pmid-41789794.summary_en: This study prospectively analyzed semen samples from seminoma and non-seminoma patients with testicular germ cell tumors after orchiectomy, before chemotherapy and at 3 and 6 months afterward. Standard semen analysis, flow cytometry, motility clustering and western blot for histone modifications were performed. Non-seminoma patients had higher baseline sperm count and volume. BEP chemotherapy caused azoospermia and necrozoospermia, especially in non-seminoma patients, while seminoma showed milder effects. Histone H4K12ac correlated with motility, count, morphology and DNA integrity, suggesting it as a marker for individualized post-chemotherapy monitoring and fertility preservation.

pmid-41797204.summary_ja: ドイツAGO CORSETTデータベースの悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍77例の記述的解析。妊孕性温存手術は約8割で実施され、全生存率は各群で95～100%。再発率は混合型45%と最も高く、妊孕性温存は生存に悪影響を及ぼさなかった。
pmid-41797204.summary_en: This descriptive analysis of the German AGO CORSETT database included 77 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (36 dysgerminoma, 21 malignant teratoma, 20 mixed). Fertility-sparing surgery was offered to 75-83% across groups. Recurrence after median 78 months was 5%, 14%, and 45%, respectively, with 100%, 100%, and 95% overall survival. Mixed tumors had the highest recurrence. The authors conclude fertility-sparing surgery did not adversely affect survival, although mixed MOGCT behaved heterogeneously.

pmid-41797746.summary_ja: 右精巣腫瘤を主訴とした25歳男性の症例報告です。混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の奇形腫成分に神経芽腫様の体細胞型悪性腫瘍を認めた初めての報告です。β-hCGは上昇、AFPとLDHは正常、画像上転移はありませんでした。根治的精巣摘除術と免疫組織化学で診断し、pT1と病期分類しました。化学療法4コース後、完全寛解を維持しています。
pmid-41797746.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with a right testicular mass whose mixed non-seminomatous germ cell tumor contained a teratomatous component with neuroblastoma-like somatic malignancy, the first such documented case. Beta-hCG was elevated while AFP and LDH were normal, and imaging showed no metastases. Radical orchiectomy and immunohistochemistry established the diagnosis, staged pT1. He completed four cycles of chemotherapy and remains in complete remission.

pmid-41797852.summary_ja: AFP高値の原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の32歳男性に対し、救援化学療法後の残存腫瘍をデスペレーション手術で完全切除した。病理組織学的に生存腫瘍と奇形腫は認められず、AFPは正常化して再発はない。選択された患者では長期生存につながる可能性が示された。
pmid-41797852.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumour presented with a 100 mm anterior mediastinal mass and AFP of 17,000 ng/mL. After induction and salvage chemotherapy, AFP fell to 20 ng/mL but did not normalize, and a 55 mm cystic tumour persisted. Desperation surgery was performed despite a rise in AFP to 40 ng/mL. Complete resection showed no viable tumour or teratoma. AFP normalized postoperatively, and the patient remained recurrence-free. The authors suggest desperation surgery may achieve long-term survival in selected patients.

pmid-41800277.summary_ja: 33歳男性の原発性縦隔セミノーマの症例報告(CARE準拠)。嗄声、呼吸困難、嚥下困難、咳で受診し、前縦隔と中縦隔に巨大腫瘤を認めた。生検と免疫組織化学でセミノーマと確定した。シスプラチン併用のBEP療法により腫瘍は著明に縮小した。早期診断と適切な治療が予後改善に不可欠と結論づけている。
pmid-41800277.summary_en: This CARE-compliant case report describes a 33-year-old man with hoarseness, dyspnea, dysphagia and cough. Imaging showed a large mass in the anterior and middle mediastinum, which biopsy and immunohistochemistry confirmed as seminoma. Cisplatin-based BEP chemotherapy produced a favorable response with significant tumor reduction. The authors conclude that early diagnosis and appropriate treatment are essential for a favorable prognosis in primary mediastinal seminoma, a rare germ cell tumor that predominantly affects young men.

pmid-41804315.summary_ja: リヤドの単施設で、再発・難治性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性46例に対する救済療法を後方視的に比較しました。大量化学療法と自家造血幹細胞移植群は高リスク・初回治療抵抗性が多い集団でした。それでも完全寛解率は高く(59%対41%)、3年全生存率は60%対53%でした。後方視的研究であり直接比較には限界があります。
pmid-41804315.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study in Riyadh compared conventional-dose chemotherapy and high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplantation in 46 men with relapsed or refractory testicular germ cell tumors. The HDCT-ASCT group had higher-risk, more primary refractory disease, yet achieved a higher complete remission rate (59% vs 41%). Three-year OS was 60% with CDCT and 53% with HDCT-ASCT; 3-year EFS was 54% and 43%. The authors note that retrospective design limits direct comparison.

pmid-41806167.summary_ja: 2012〜2024年にSCT切除を受けた新生児17例の単施設後方視的研究である。59%が術中輸血を受け、39%が術後30日以内に有意な事象を経験し、1例が死亡した。輸血例は腫瘍体積が大きく、未熟奇形腫や在胎37週未満が輸血の予測因子であった。大量出血リスクの高さが示された。
pmid-41806167.summary_en: This retrospective single-centre study reviewed 17 neonates who underwent sacrococcygeal teratoma resection at Boston Children's Hospital between 2012 and 2024. Transfusion was needed in 59%, and 39% had a clinically significant postoperative event within 30 days; one patient died. Transfused neonates had larger tumour volumes and higher tumour volume-to-weight ratios. Predictors of transfusion included immature histology, gestational age under 37 weeks, larger tumour volume, higher estimated blood loss and longer anaesthesia. Altman type 2 tumours, prematurity and longer anaesthesia predicted postoperative events. The authors highlight the high risk of massive haemorrhage in this population.

pmid-41806988.summary_ja: 20代女性の卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ症例。急性腹症で受診し、画像で腫瘤内の気腫様所見から消化管腫瘍が疑われた。緊急手術で360度捻転を伴う左卵巣腫瘍と判明し、免疫組織化学でディスジャーミノーマと確定した。
pmid-41806988.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in her 20s with acute abdomen, palpable mass, left lower quadrant pain and vomiting. Imaging revealed a large pelvic mass containing linear air pockets, initially suggesting a gastrointestinal stromal tumour or abscess. Emergency surgery found a left ovarian tumour with 360-degree torsion and congestion. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry (SALL4, PLAP, OCT-4 positive) confirmed dysgerminoma. The authors hypothesize that the intratumoural gas was intravascular gas related to torsion, trapped in fibrovascular septa, highlighting torsion as a cause of unusual gas patterns.

pmid-41808696.summary_ja: 細胞毒性治療前に自然発生的腫瘍崩壊症候群を呈した精巣胚細胞腫瘍6例を後方視的に検討した。多くはセミノーマ型で腫瘍量が多かった。腎不全と感染により死亡率は高かった。腫瘍量が主要な危険因子と考えられた。
pmid-41808696.summary_en: This case series describes six patients with testicular germ cell tumours who developed spontaneous tumour lysis syndrome before any cytotoxic therapy. Most had seminomatous histology and extensive imaging tumour burden. Management included hydration, rasburicase or allopurinol, renal replacement therapy, and individualized chemotherapy. Mortality was substantial, mainly due to renal failure and infections. The authors conclude that tumour burden is a key risk factor regardless of histology, and early recognition and tailored supportive care are critical.

pmid-41809961.summary_ja: 27歳女性で、両側付属器腫瘤が偶発的に発見された。MRIで両側卵巣病変を認め、手術で一側に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、対側に子宮内膜症性嚢胞が確認された。術前画像の限界と、術中評価および病理学的評価の重要性を強調している。
pmid-41809961.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with incidentally discovered bilateral adnexal masses. MRI showed bilateral ovarian lesions, and surgery found a mature cystic teratoma in one ovary and an endometrioma in the other. The authors highlight the limits of preoperative imaging in detecting synchronous ovarian pathologies and the importance of intraoperative assessment and histopathology. Recognition of such bilateral collision tumors affects surgical planning, fertility preservation, and follow-up.

pmid-41810059.summary_ja: 43歳女性が反復性性器出血とβ-hCG高値（1165 mU/mL）で受診し、子宮頸部妊娠を疑って掻爬。組織学的に妊娠性絨毛癌が疑われたが、外部診断は体細胞型癌を示唆。分子検査で非母性DNAが検出され、妊娠性絨毛癌と確定。術後28か月で再発なし。
pmid-41810059.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old woman with recurrent vaginal bleeding and elevated beta-hCG (1165 mU/mL) after dilation and curettage for suspected cervical ectopic pregnancy. Histology suggested gestational choriocarcinoma, but an outside review favored somatic carcinoma with germ cell differentiation. Hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and lymphadenectomy followed. Molecular testing detected nonmaternal DNA and no TP53 mutation, confirming gestational choriocarcinoma. Chemotherapy was given, and there was no recurrence at 28 months.

pmid-41810207.summary_ja: 小児の放射線治療後の臓器障害を、cfDNAメチル化解析で評価したパイロット症例集積です。胚細胞腫瘍と混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例を含みます。光子線と陽子線の治療群で、cfDNAメチル化変化を線量分布と臨床転帰と比較しました。cfDNAメチル化が臓器障害のバイオマーカーとなりうること、陽子線が臓器保護に優れる可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-41810207.summary_en: This pilot case series assesses organ damage after pediatric radiotherapy using cell-free DNA methylation. Six patients included one with a germ cell tumor and one with a mixed germ cell tumor, alongside medulloblastoma and neuroepithelial tumor cases. Patients received photon or proton therapy, and cfDNA methylation changes were compared with dose distributions and clinical outcomes. Trends suggested cfDNA methylation may serve as a biomarker of organ injury and that proton therapy may better protect critical organs.

pmid-41812828.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍33例で8種類のADC標的の免疫組織化学的発現を評価した。Nectin4とFOLR1は高頻度に発現し、CLDN18.2は全例で陰性であった。難治例に対するADC治療の分子的根拠を示唆している。
pmid-41812828.summary_en: This immunohistochemistry study examined eight antibody-drug conjugate targets (FOLR1, Nectin4, TROP2, CEACAM5, HER3, CLDN6, CLDN18.2, tissue factor) in 33 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia cases, including choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, plus normal placentas and hydatidiform moles. Nectin4 was detected in all cases, and FOLR1 in 90.9%, with high expression in 36.4% by PS2+ criteria. CLDN18.2 was absent. TROP2 varied by subtype and was highest in epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. No associations with stage, prognosis or recurrence were found, supporting biomarker-driven ADC trials in refractory GTN.

pmid-41814647.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍とGCNISの33例の組織で、miR-371a-3pとmiR-373-3pをin situ解析し、一部は術前血清と比較した研究。非奇形腫性腫瘍とGCNISでは両マイクロRNAが検出され、奇形腫では陰性であった。血清で陰性でも組織では陽性の症例があり、血清での未検出は技術的感度の問題と考えられた。miR-373-3pは独立した診断的価値を持つ可能性がある。
pmid-41814647.summary_en: This study used single-molecule in situ hybridization to examine miR-371a-3p and miR-373-3p expression in tumor tissue from 33 patients with testicular germ cell tumors or germ cell neoplasia in situ, comparing findings with paired pre-orchiectomy serum in 20 patients. Both miRNAs were detected in all non-teratomatous tumors and GCNIS, while teratoma lacked expression. Several patients negative in serum were positive in tissue, suggesting that serum non-detection reflects technical sensitivity. miR-373-3p may have diagnostic value independent of miR-371a-3p.

pmid-41815375.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対するロボット支援化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清42例の後方視的解析。側臥位28例、仰臥位14例。手術時間中央値167.5分、合併症14%（Clavien-Dindo I-II）、再発17%。両術式で良好な成績。
pmid-41815375.summary_en: This retrospective single-center study reviewed 42 patients who underwent robot-assisted post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (R-PC-RPLND) for metastatic NSGCT, using lateral (n=28) or supine (n=14) approaches. Median operative time was 167.5 minutes and blood loss 100 mL. Vascular injury occurred in 4.8%, and no conversions to open surgery were needed. Postoperative complications were 14%, all Clavien-Dindo I-II. Relapse occurred in 17% over a median follow-up of 22 months. Both approaches showed favorable outcomes.

pmid-41815461.summary_ja: 妊娠11週で左下腹部痛を呈した21歳初妊婦の症例報告です。19cmの成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が捻転していました。緊急開腹で捻転解除と左卵管卵巣摘出を行い、生存中の子宮内妊娠は温存されました。病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定しました。妊娠23週時点で妊娠は良好に継続しています。妊娠初期の急性腹症では付属器捻転の鑑別が重要と強調しています。
pmid-41815461.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old primigravida at 11 weeks' gestation with acute left lower abdominal pain due to torsion of a 19 cm mature cystic teratoma. Emergency laparotomy achieved detorsion and left salpingo-oophorectomy while preserving the viable intrauterine pregnancy. Histopathology confirmed mature cystic teratoma.
