The pregnancy continued favorably at 23 weeks. The authors emphasize adnexal torsion as a key differential in early pregnancy.

pmid-41815478.summary_ja: 妊娠19週の29歳初産婦が強い下腹部痛で受診し、15cm大の左卵巣腫瘤に対して卵管卵巣摘出術を施行した。病理組織学的検査で卵巣ディスジャーミノーマと確認された。正期に経腟分娩した。妊娠中の捻転や治療判断の課題を論じる。
pmid-41815478.summary_en: A 29-year-old primigravida presented with severe lower abdominal pain at 19 weeks of gestation. Ultrasonography revealed a 15.3 cm left ovarian mass, and left salpingo-oophorectomy was performed. Histology confirmed ovarian dysgerminoma. She delivered a healthy infant vaginally at term. The authors discuss difficulties in diagnosing torsion in early pregnancy, the surgical risk of preterm labour, and the role of fertility-sparing surgery and chemotherapy by FIGO stage.

pmid-41816726.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍178例の後方視的研究。術前の汎免疫炎症値(PIV)は転移・後腹膜リンパ節浸潤例で有意に高く、T・N・M病期およびIGCCCGリスク群の上昇に伴い増加。安価な術前マーカーとして有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-41816726.summary_en: This retrospective study of 178 patients who underwent radical orchiectomy for testicular germ cell tumors evaluated the preoperative pan-immune inflammation value (PIV) as a prognostic marker. PIV was significantly higher in patients with metastasis and retroperitoneal lymph node invasion, increased progressively with higher T, N, and M stages, and rose across higher IGCCCG risk groups. The authors propose PIV as a cost-effective preoperative marker for predicting advanced disease in testicular tumors.

pmid-41820140.summary_ja: 化学療法後RPLNDを受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍677例のうち、精巣摘除標本にセミノーマを含む109例を後方視的に解析した。セミノーマの割合が高いほど追加の術中処置と失血量が増加した。壊死は割合とともに増えたが、RPLNDを除外するほどの予測力はなかった。
pmid-41820140.summary_en: This retrospective study from Indiana University included 677 patients undergoing post-chemotherapy RPLND for nonseminomatous germ cell tumours, of whom 109 had seminoma components in the orchiectomy specimen. Higher percentage of seminoma increased the need for additional intraoperative procedures and blood loss. Patients with more than 75% seminoma had about 12 times higher odds of requiring additional procedures than those with 25% or less. Necrosis became more frequent with increasing seminoma quartiles, but this did not sufficiently predict necrosis to exclude RPLND.

pmid-41821902.summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器がん全般における三次リンパ組織構造(TLS)を論じた総説である。精巣セミノーマではTLSが良好な予後と関連する一方、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍ではSERPINB9によるケモカイン低下を介してTLSが抑制される。成熟したTLSが抗腫瘍免疫に重要とされる。
pmid-41821902.summary_en: This comprehensive review examines tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) across genitourinary cancers, including prostate, bladder, testicular, renal and penile tumours, as prognostic and therapeutic markers. In testicular seminoma, TLSs are associated with a more favourable prognosis, whereas non-seminomatous germ cell tumours show TLS suppression linked to SERPINB9-mediated downregulation of chemokines. The authors also discuss TLS roles in responses to BCG and immune checkpoint therapy in bladder and renal cancer, and in penile squamous cell carcinoma. They emphasise that mature TLSs with germinal centres are key to effective antitumour immunity.

pmid-41823372.summary_ja: 精巣の小腫瘤60例を対象に、血液中マイクロRNA-371a-3p(miR371a)アッセイの診断性能を評価した。感度77.5%、特異度80%、陽性的中率88.6%であった。血清腫瘍マーカーの感度は低く、術前診断での有用性が示唆されたが、標準化と多施設前向き検証が必要である。
pmid-41823372.summary_en: This real-world cohort of 60 men undergoing inguinal exploration for small testicular masses evaluated a CE-marked blood microRNA-371a-3p assay. The test showed 77.5% sensitivity, 80% specificity, 88.6% positive predictive value and 64% negative predictive value. Sensitivity was 77.5% overall, 12% for serum tumor markers in seminoma, and 66% for serum markers in non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. The single false negative in the non-seminoma group had predominant teratoma. The authors conclude the assay is promising for preoperative diagnosis, but pre-analytical standardization and multicenter prospective validation are needed.

pmid-41831125.summary_ja: 次世代シーケンスで悪性胚細胞腫瘍14例のゲノム異常と相同組換え修復欠損(HRD)を解析した研究です。HRD陽性は57.1%で、女性(87.5%)が男性(16.7%)より高率でした。男性例では卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫でTP53変異が見られました。HRD陽性の女性へのPARP阻害薬、性別に応じた標的治療の可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-41831125.summary_en: This study examines genomic landscape and homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) in 14 patients with malignant germ cell tumors using next-generation sequencing. HRD was positive in 57.1%, markedly more often in females (87.5%) than males (16.7%). Male cases showed TP53 mutations in yolk sac tumors and teratomas, along with KRAS, PRKDC, and CDKN1B alterations. A mediastinal teratoma with rhabdomyosarcomatous transformation harbored complex ROS1 and MET alterations. Findings suggest PARP inhibitors for HRD-positive female patients and sex-specific targeted strategies.

pmid-41834300.summary_ja: 頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の小児・思春期患者917例を対象とした国際コンソーシアムの解析。二次性悪性腫瘍が13例同定された。中央値5.9年の追跡期間は短く、原因として治療関連、共通の始原生殖細胞由来の二次原発、原腫瘍の悪性転化が考えられる。リスクと原因の解明には長期追跡が必要とされる。
pmid-41834300.summary_en: This international consortium study assessed second malignant neoplasms (SMNs) in 917 children and adolescents treated for extracranial germ cell tumors. Thirteen SMNs were identified, with a median follow-up of only 5.9 years. The authors note that SMNs may be treatment-related, second primary malignancies from a shared primordial germ cell progenitor, or somatic malignant transformation of the original GCT. The study concludes that longer follow-up is needed to define the risk and causation.

pmid-41835342.summary_ja: iTestis登録の精巣胚細胞腫瘍22例の化学療法前後組織を用いた観察コホート研究。CLDN6はGCNISや非奇形成分で高発現したが、奇形腫では低発現。i12pは病期を通じて持続し、生存GCTの指標となりうる。
pmid-41835342.summary_en: This observational cohort study used matched pre- and post-chemotherapy tissue from 22 patients with testicular germ cell tumors in the iTestis registry. CLDN6 was uniformly expressed in germ cell neoplasia in situ and nonteratoma components, but was low in primary and metastatic teratoma, with 23% positivity in metastatic teratomas. The 12p isochromosome was found in 82% of primary tumors and persisted across stages. CLDN6-targeted therapy may be less effective against teratoma, whereas i12p may serve as a biomarker of viable GCT.

pmid-41836988.summary_ja: 2013〜2024年に腹腔鏡で治療された成熟嚢胞性奇形腫139例の後方視的単施設症例集積。平均腫瘍径は9 cm、術中内容物漏出は2.2%で、合併症は認めなかった。厳格な無破裂摘出を行えば、広範な大きさの奇形腫に腹腔鏡手術が実施可能と結論づけている。
pmid-41836988.summary_en: This retrospective single-center series included 139 consecutive patients with pathologically confirmed ovarian mature cystic teratomas managed laparoscopically between 2013 and 2024. Mean cyst size was 9 cm, and adnexal torsion occurred in 6%. Cystectomy was performed in 40% and adnexectomy in 60%. Intraoperative spillage occurred in 2.2%, with no intra- or postoperative complications. The authors describe a giant 8.5-kg teratoma as an illustrative case and conclude that laparoscopy with strict no-rupture retrieval is feasible for MCTs across a broad size range.

pmid-41837073.summary_ja: 以前に右卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた27歳女性で、抗NMDAR脳炎が残存する対側卵巣奇形腫により難治化した症例報告である。免疫療法では改善が限られ、反復画像で対側卵巣嚢胞が発見された。嚢胞摘出術で成熟奇形腫が確認され、切除後に神経症状は徐々に回復した。難治例では反復画像と完全切除が重要とされる。
pmid-41837073.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old nulligravida who had previously undergone right salpingo-oophorectomy for mature teratoma and later presented with psychiatric symptoms, seizures and respiratory failure. Cerebrospinal fluid analysis confirmed anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Despite high-dose corticosteroids, intravenous immunoglobulin and rituximab, neurological improvement was limited until repeat imaging identified a residual contralateral ovarian cyst. Laparotomy with cystectomy confirmed a mature teratoma, and gradual but prolonged neurological recovery followed resection. The authors argue that residual or contralateral ovarian teratomas can sustain refractory autoimmune encephalitis, that repeat pelvic imaging should be considered in refractory cases, and that complete resection is essential.

pmid-41841788.summary_ja: 哺乳と呼吸困難を呈した生後6か月女児の舌腹側の腫瘤の症例です。術前MRIでは舌下腺嚢胞や類皮嚢腫が疑われましたが、切除後の病理組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定しました。舌腹側に生じる奇形腫は極めて稀です。乳児の口腔内腫瘤では病理学的確認の重要性が示されています。
pmid-41841788.summary_en: This case report describes a 6-month-old female infant with a ventral tongue mass causing feeding and breathing difficulties. Preoperative MRI suggested a sublingual gland cyst or dermoid cyst, but histopathology after excision confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Such extragonadal tumors are exceedingly rare on the ventral tongue. The report highlights the importance of histopathological confirmation for oral masses in infants.

pmid-41842689.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群の思春期患者に縦隔胚細胞腫瘍を認めた症例である。性腺外に発生する胚細胞腫瘍のリスク上昇が指摘されている。異常な性腺刺激ホルモン値が診断の契機となった。
pmid-41842689.summary_en: This report describes an adolescent with Klinefelter syndrome who was found to have a mediastinal germ cell tumour. The authors emphasise that patients with Klinefelter syndrome have increased risk of germ cell tumours, particularly extragonadal ones. The diagnosis was reached based on unusual gonadotropin values, suggesting that suppressed gonadotropins may serve as a warning sign of an extragonadal tumour in such patients.

pmid-41842929.summary_ja: インドの単施設で卵精巣性性分化疾患15例の長期転帰を後方視的に検討しています。大多数が男性として養育され、性同一性違和は認めませんでした。卵精巣からディスジャーミノーマを生じた1例(6.6%)を含みます。性腺悪性腫瘍のリスクは低いものの、46,XXでも否定できないと結論しています。
pmid-41842929.summary_en: This retrospective single-centre Indian cohort of 15 patients with ovotesticular DSD reports long-term outcomes including gender identity, gonadal malignancy, and endocrine function. Most were raised male, and none reported gender incongruence. Gonadal malignancy occurred in one patient (6.6%), a 46,XX individual raised female who developed a dysgerminoma arising from ovotestes at age 20.7. The authors conclude the malignancy risk is low but not negligible even with a 46,XX karyotype.

pmid-41846383.summary_ja: 1984～2017年に仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた26例を後方視的に解析。中央値180か月の経過観察で46%に排尿・排便機能障害を認めた。骨盤内腫瘍高(ITH)は機能障害例で有意に大きく、腫瘍径やAltman分類より客観的な予測因子とされた。QOLは概ね良好であった。
pmid-41846383.summary_en: This retrospective study of 26 patients treated surgically for sacrococcygeal teratoma between 1984 and 2017 evaluated long-term urinary and anorectal function and quality of life, with a median follow-up of 180 months. Nearly half had functional impairments, mostly isolated anorectal dysfunction. Intrapelvic tumor height was significantly greater in patients with adverse outcomes and emerged as a more objective predictor than tumor size or Altman classification. Most patients reported good quality of life.

pmid-41853469.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を有し好中球減少症にある小児例。高周波超音波検査で、好中球回復前に脾臓の低エコー性偽結節を検出した。脾摘出でCandida tropicalisによる肝脾カンジダ症と確定し、超音波による早期診断の有用性を示した。
pmid-41853469.summary_en: This pediatric case report describes a neutropenic child with an ovarian teratoma who developed hepatosplenic candidiasis. High-frequency ultrasonography detected subtle hypoechoic pseudonodules in the spleen during profound neutropenia (ANC 30/μL), before neutrophil recovery. These lesions evolved into classic bull's-eye lesions. Candida tropicalis was confirmed by splenectomy. The authors argue that high-frequency ultrasound can enable early diagnosis of hepatosplenic candidiasis before immune recovery, challenging the belief that lesions appear only after neutrophil recovery.

pmid-41858337.summary_ja: 公共データベースを用いたin silico解析で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるFKBP4の役割を検討しています。FKBP4は正常精巣より高発現で、病期とともに増加しました。幹細胞マーカーと正の相関を示し、全生存期間のハザード比上昇と関連しました。TGCTの亜型を区別する因子となりうると提案していますが、実験的検証は今後の課題です。
pmid-41858337.summary_en: This in silico study examines FKBP4 expression in testicular germ cell tumor using public datasets. FKBP4 was higher in TGCT than normal testis and increased with stage, correlated with stemness markers, and was associated with overall survival hazard. Gene ontology and STRING interaction analyses suggest FKBP4 may be a key regulator distinguishing TGCT subtypes. The authors propose FKBP4 as a candidate biomarker pending experimental validation.

pmid-41858486.summary_ja: 尿失禁で受診した30歳女性の骨盤内嚢胞性腫瘤を、MRIで仙骨前部の典型的な仙尾部奇形腫と評価した。手術切除により良性成熟奇形腫と確定した。成人の骨盤腫瘤の鑑別にMRIが重要であることを示す。
pmid-41858486.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman presented with urinary incontinence, and ultrasound revealed a nonspecific cystic pelvic mass. Pelvic MRI showed a well-circumscribed presacral mass with cystic and fat-containing components typical of sacrococcygeal teratoma, without signs of invasion or malignancy. Surgical excision was performed, and histopathology confirmed a benign mature teratoma. The authors highlight that sacrococcygeal teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of adult pelvic masses, and that MRI is essential for characterization and surgical planning.

pmid-41859712.summary_ja: 43歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に、角化型扁平上皮癌が発生していた症例。子宮頸部スクリーニングでHPV16型と59型が検出された。FIGO IC期と判定され、手術後にBEP補助化学療法が計画された。奇形腫の悪性転化はまれで、HPV関連の発生はさらにまれである。
pmid-41859712.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old woman with an ovarian mature cystic teratoma that was histologically confirmed as a keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma arising within it. HPV types 16 and 59 were detected on cervical screening. The tumor was staged as FIGO IC, and surgery was followed by planned adjuvant BEP chemotherapy. The authors note that malignant transformation of teratoma is uncommon and that HPV-related squamous carcinoma arising from ovarian teratoma is scarcely documented. They emphasize considering malignant transformation based on age, tumor size, and tumor markers.

pmid-41861371.summary_ja: 息子を縦隔胚細胞腫瘍で亡くした親による個人的な振り返りの記事です。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍が精巣がんとどのように異なるかを、自身の経験を通して述べています。希少腫瘍と診断された他の患者への思いや、息子の記憶を次世代へ繋ぐことにも触れています。系統的方法を伴わない物語的な内容です。
pmid-41861371.summary_en: This personal reflection by a parent describes their son's experience with a mediastinal germ cell tumor and considers how these tumors differ from testicular cancer. The author reflects on others diagnosed with rare tumors and on honoring their son's memory by paying it forward. The piece is narrative and non-systematic.

pmid-41863841.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫22例の上皮領域を対象に全エクソーム解析を実施した。CN-LOHパターンから減数分裂エラーの経路を推定し、扁平上皮癌に伴う上皮内癌領域ではTP53変異とAPOBEC関連シグネチャを認めた。OMTの発生機序と悪性転化の早期事象に関する知見を提示している。
pmid-41863841.summary_en: This study used laser microdissection and whole-exome sequencing on 29 epithelial regions from 22 ovarian mature teratomas and one carcinoma in situ region arising in a squamous cell carcinoma. Copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity patterns allowed classification into established types, with type II tumors showing evidence of meiosis I followed by meiosis II errors. Somatic mutation burden was extremely low, with one PIK3CA mutation. The carcinoma in situ showed additional copy number alterations, TP53 mutations, and a tumor mutation burden of 6.2 mutations per megabase, with APOBEC-associated signatures. The authors propose insights into OMT development and early malignant transformation.

pmid-41864234.summary_ja: 9か月以上植物状態が続いた抗NMDAR脳炎45例の国際後方視的コホート研究である。47%に卵巣奇形腫を認めた。中央値5年で約3分の1が完全回復し、約3分の2が回復または改善に至った。奇形腫はmRSスコア2到達の低下と関連した。早期の難治性評価は遅延回復を過小評価しうるため、中止判断は個別化すべきとされる。
pmid-41864234.summary_en: This international retrospective cohort study of 45 patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis who remained in a vegetative state for at least nine months examined treatment response and long-term outcomes. Forty-seven percent had ovarian teratomas, which were removed in 20 patients. At a median of five years, 33% had completely recovered and 29% had substantially improved, and the estimated cumulative incidence of reaching mRS 2 was 66% at five years. Teratomas were associated with a lower probability of reaching mRS 2, while older age and higher NEOS2 scores were associated with mortality. The authors conclude that early assessment of refractoriness may underestimate delayed recovery.

pmid-41868674.summary_ja: 22歳の未経妊女性の巨大卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に扁平上皮癌を合併した症例報告。CTでは22.5 cmの脂肪と石灰化を含む囊胞充実性腫瘤が見られた。妊孕性温存術で病期IAと確認された。術後SCC抗原は低下し、補助化学療法(パクリタキセルリポソーム+カルボプラチン)を6コース施行。無病経過を維持している。
pmid-41868674.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old nulligravid woman with a giant ovarian mature cystic teratoma containing squamous cell carcinoma, identified after abdominal pain and distension. CT showed a 22.5 cm mixed cystic-solid mass with fat and calcifications. Fertility-sparing staging surgery confirmed well-to-moderately differentiated SCC, FIGO stage IA. Immunohistochemistry showed mutant-type p53, diffuse EGFR expression and high PD-L1. After surgery, SCC antigen fell to 2.396 ng/mL, and six cycles of adjuvant paclitaxel liposome plus carboplatin were given. The patient remained disease-free.

pmid-41869646.summary_ja: 11か月女児の間欠的な膣出血で発症した原発性膣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。初め血腫と誤診された。子宮鏡下切除の後、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン(PEB)療法を6コース施行し、12か月の経過観察で再発はない。説明不能な膣腫瘤の鑑別に本腫瘍を含めるべきと述べている。
pmid-41869646.summary_en: This case report describes an 11-month-old girl with intermittent vaginal bleeding, initially misdiagnosed as a hematoma, in whom pathology confirmed a primary vaginal yolk sac tumor. Hysteroscopic resection was followed by six cycles of PEB chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. No recurrence occurred during 12 months of follow-up. The authors highlight this extragonadal tumor as a differential for unexplained vaginal masses and note that surgery combined with PEB chemotherapy was effective.

pmid-41883945.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の2例の症例集積です。発症後18日で未熟奇形腫を摘出しリツキシマブを併用した症例は完全回復(mRS 0)しました。一方、成熟奇形腫の残存病変に対して再手術を要した16歳例では、四肢不全麻痺と運動失調が残りました(mRS 2)。早期の腫瘍切除が予後改善に寄与しうることを示しています。
pmid-41883945.summary_en: This dual-case series describes two patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratomas, in whom timing of surgical resection influenced neurological outcome. The first patient, with an immature teratoma resected 18 days after onset and treated with rituximab, achieved full recovery (mRS 0). The second, a 16-year-old whose residual mature teratoma required reoperation on day 95, had residual quadriparesis and ataxia (mRS 2). Both remained recurrence-free at 14 and 17 months, supporting early resection to halt antibody production.

pmid-41884319.summary_ja: 18歳男性の髄膜腫様の頭蓋骨円蓋部腫瘤を報告した。開頭術で胚細胞腫瘍と判明し、縦隔原発セミノーマの頭蓋内転移と診断された。化学療法で完全奏効が得られた。若年男性では胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に含め、腫瘍マーカーの評価が重要である。
pmid-41884319.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old man with a convexity mass initially diagnosed as meningioma, with dural invasion and skull destruction. Craniotomy revealed a germ cell tumour with a high Ki-67 index and placental alkaline phosphatase immunoreactivity. Subsequent evaluation identified an anterior mediastinal mass, leading to the diagnosis of intracranial metastasis from a primary mediastinal seminoma. Systemic chemotherapy produced a complete response. The authors emphasise that germ cell tumours should be considered in young men with meningioma-like lesions and that tumour markers and nuclear medicine studies should be used proactively.

pmid-41887253.summary_ja: 胎児性癌成分を含む卵巣腫瘍55例の形態学的検討。全例が悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍の一成分であった。併存成分は卵黄嚢腫瘍(89%)、未熟奇形腫(62%)、ディスジャーミノーマ(36%)が多い。純粋な卵巣胎児性癌は認められなかった。多くの純粋例は混合型腫瘍のサンプリング不足と考えられている。
pmid-41887253.summary_en: This morphologic study reviewed 55 ovarian tumors with an embryonal carcinoma component, all arising within malignant mixed germ cell tumors. Yolk sac tumor was the most frequent admixed component (89%), followed by immature teratoma (62%) and dysgerminoma (36%). Glandular, solid, and papillary patterns predominated. Pure ovarian embryonal carcinoma was not identified. The authors suggest many purported pure examples are undersampled mixed tumors or other entities, and that morphology, supported by immunohistochemistry when needed, is key to diagnosis.

pmid-41889248.summary_ja: 再発・難治性の小児胚細胞腫瘍4例に対し、GemDMCを用いた大量化学療法と自家造血幹細胞救援を行った報告です。シスプラチン耐性が4例、完全寛解が3例で得られました。毒性は管理可能で、生着遅延は認められませんでした。
pmid-41889248.summary_en: This report describes the first pediatric use of gemcitabine, docetaxel, melphalan and carboplatin (GemDMC) within sequential cycles of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell rescue in four children with multiply relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors. Three patients had extensive metastases and four were cisplatin-resistant. Three achieved complete remission. Toxicities were manageable and reversible, with no significant engraftment delays. The authors propose GemDMC-based sequential aHSCR as a promising salvage strategy for relapsed or refractory metastatic pediatric germ cell tumors.

pmid-41900999.summary_ja: ハンガリーで初めて、病期IVの超高リスク絨毛癌に対しPD-1阻害薬による治療に成功した症例を報告する。標準治療は手術と全身化学療法だが、化学療法抵抗性の一部では免疫療法が有効な選択肢となりうる。本症例ではペムブロリズマブが奏効した。
pmid-41900999.summary_en: This case report describes the first successful programmed death-1 inhibitor-based treatment in Hungary of a patient with stage IV, ultra-high-risk choriocarcinoma, a aggressive form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Standard management combines surgical removal and systemic chemotherapy, but immunotherapy can be valid in some chemoresistant cases. The authors describe pembrolizumab, a humanized anti-PD-1 antibody, as the treatment that achieved a successful response in this patient.

pmid-41903117.summary_ja: 小児抗NMDAR脳炎103例を後方視的に解析し、奇形腫合併例は他群より重症で入院期間が長かった。CSF抗体価は入院期間やmRSと相関した。奇形腫関連の神経合併症を理解するうえで重要な研究である。
pmid-41903117.summary_en: This single-centre retrospective study of 103 children with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis compared patients with teratomas with those with herpes simplex encephalitis and idiopathic disease. Patients with teratomas had more severe early symptoms, earlier lumbar punctures, higher CSF white cell counts, earlier treatment, and longer hospital stays. CSF antibody titres correlated with length of stay and modified Rankin scores through 12-month follow-up. Normal routine CSF studies and brain MRI delayed first-line immunotherapy. The authors also describe a perisylvian focal phenotype in about half of idiopathic cases.

pmid-41906083.summary_ja: 28歳女性の前縦隔に生じた17cm大の成熟奇形腫の症例です。胸骨挙上器を用いた単孔式剣状突起下VATSで完全切除し、胸骨正中切開を回避しました。18か月後も再発や手技関連合併症はありませんでした。
pmid-41906083.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with a 17 cm anterior mediastinal mass, confirmed by CT and PET/CT. The tumor was completely resected through a uniportal subxiphoid VATS approach. A percutaneous Tian-Ping sternal lifter expanded the retrosternal working space, avoiding median sternotomy. Histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. The patient was discharged on day nine and remained free of recurrence and procedure-related complications at 18 months. The authors propose this suspension technique as a sternum-sparing option for selected giant anterior mediastinal masses.

pmid-41907641.summary_ja: 46歳女性の原発性子宮頸部卵黄嚢腫瘍。術前化学療法、根治手術、補助BEP療法を受けたが、再発しBEP抵抗性が確認された。アルブミン結合型パクリタキセルとカルボプラチンにビバシズマブを併用した救援療法で持続的な完全奏効が得られた。子宮頸部卵黄嚢腫瘍の臨床像と治療成績をレビューしている。
pmid-41907641.summary_en: This report describes a 46-year-old woman with primary cervical yolk sac tumor, an extremely rare site. She received neoadjuvant chemotherapy, radical surgery, and adjuvant BEP. After initial complete remission she relapsed with confirmed BEP resistance. Salvage therapy with nab-paclitaxel and carboplatin plus bevacizumab produced a durable complete response, followed by bevacizumab maintenance. The authors review clinical features, treatment, and survival of advanced cervical yolk sac tumor and suggest that the TC regimen combined with VEGF inhibitors may be a salvage option for recurrent or metastatic disease.

pmid-41909080.summary_ja: 奇形腫由来の卵巣扁平上皮癌が再発・転移した患者において、ペムブロリズマブ投与後に血球貪食性リンパ組織球症(HLH)を発症した症例報告です。持続する発熱と血球減少が特徴でした。HLH-2024基準とHScoreで診断し、ステロイド単剤で改善しました。免疫チェックポイント阻害薬による致死的となりうる有害事象として、早期認識の重要性を強調しています。
pmid-41909080.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with recurrent metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the ovary arising in a teratoma who developed hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) after pembrolizumab, presenting with persistent fevers and cytopenias. The diagnosis was supported by HLH-2024 criteria and HScore, and differentiation from infection and other inflammation was challenging. Steroid monotherapy led to clinical and laboratory improvement. The authors review prior HLH cases in gynecologic malignancies and emphasize early recognition of this rare but potentially fatal immune checkpoint inhibitor-related adverse event.

pmid-41909363.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫内に甲状腺癌が発生した女性2例を報告する。1例目は乳頭状甲状腺癌とBRAF変異を伴い、甲状腺全摘術と放射性ヨウ素治療を施行された。2例目は、術後の付属器集積を契機に卵巣腫瘤を摘除し、奇形腫内の低分化甲状腺癌と確定した。両者とも無病経過である。
pmid-41909363.summary_en: This case series describes two women with thyroid carcinoma arising in ovarian teratomas. The first had ovarian teratoma with papillary thyroid carcinoma and a BRAF mutation, treated with completion thyroidectomy and radioactive iodine. The second had high-risk papillary thyroid carcinoma, and later adnexal uptake on postoperative scanning led to removal of an ovarian mass showing poorly differentiated thyroid cancer in teratoma. Both remained disease-free with endocrinology follow-up. The authors stress thorough histological evaluation and attention to relevant mutations.

pmid-41913809.summary_ja: 2014〜2020年に卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で嚢胞摘出術を受けた285例の後方視的研究です。20%で子宮内膜症が併存し、疼痛や血清CA125が高値で、術後1か月のAMH低下も大きい結果でした。再発率に差はありませんでした。
pmid-41913809.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 285 women who underwent ovarian cystectomy for mature cystic teratoma between 2014 and 2020. Endometriosis coexisted in 57 patients (20%). The coexisting group had more dysmenorrhea, higher CA125, more unclear cleavage planes and a greater postoperative AMH decline at one month. Recurrence rates did not differ between groups. The authors conclude that coexisting MCT and endometriosis is not uncommon and may warrant management beyond that of either disease alone.

pmid-41917252.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者7,908例を含む14の比較コホート研究を統合解析した。ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清は、出血量、輸血率、在院日数で有意に優れていた。手術時間、リンパ節採取数、合併症、射精障害、再発には有意差がなかった。安全で有効な選択肢として支持されるが、前向き多施設研究が必要と結論している。
pmid-41917252.summary_en: This updated systematic review and meta-analysis pooled 14 comparative cohort studies including 7,908 patients undergoing robotic-assisted versus non-robotic (open or laparoscopic) retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer. Robotic surgery was associated with significantly lower estimated blood loss, lower transfusion rates, and shorter hospital stay. Operative time, lymph node yield, overall complications, ejaculatory dysfunction, and recurrence did not differ significantly. Heterogeneity was considerable for several outcomes, and the authors call for prospective multicentre studies.

pmid-41917767.summary_ja: 15歳女児の9年にわたる難治性精神症状が、巨大卵巣奇形腫の切除で劇的に改善した。CA19-9が上昇していた。文献レビューでは奇形腫関連精神病32例を集計し、脳炎症状のない例は極めて少なかった。
pmid-41917767.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old girl with nine years of refractory psychiatric symptoms, initially diagnosed as schizophrenia, who had a giant ovarian teratoma with elevated CA19-9. Histology confirmed neural tissue. After tumour resection, psychiatric symptoms resolved dramatically. A systematic literature review identified 32 cases of teratoma-associated psychosis, of which only two lacked encephalitic features, one seronegative for NMDA antibodies. The authors suggest CA19-9 elevation may serve as a nonspecific clue, and that comprehensive imaging is essential in atypical, treatment-resistant psychosis.

pmid-41917860.summary_ja: 小児精巣良性腫瘍51例(うち奇形腫24例)の後方視的研究。2018年以降の多職種評価により精巣温存手術の施行率が7/26から19/25へ有意に増加した。腫瘍径と時期が温存手術と関連していた。中央値44か月の経過観察で合併症はなかった。過剰治療は少なくなく、可能な場合には精巣温存手術を考慮すべきとされる。
pmid-41917860.summary_en: This retrospective study of 51 children with benign testicular tumors, 24 of them teratomas, compared testis-sparing surgery (TSS) rates between periods before and after multidisciplinary evaluation began in 2018. TSS increased significantly from 7 of 26 to 19 of 25 cases. Tumor size and period were significantly associated with TSS in multivariable analysis. Frozen sections matched final pathology in all 18 cases examined. With a median follow-up of 44 months and no complications, the authors conclude that overtreatment is common and that TSS should be considered when feasible.

pmid-41917881.summary_ja: 小児精巣Leydig細胞腫瘍14例を、卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫の各14例と比較した多施設後方視的コホート研究です。Leydig細胞腫瘍は早熟や超音波所見の特徴があり、精巣温存手術後も再発は認められませんでした。
pmid-41917881.summary_en: This multicentre retrospective cohort compared 14 children with testicular Leydig cell tumor with 14 with endodermal sinus tumor and 14 with testicular teratoma. Leydig cell tumor patients were older and more often had precocious puberty and elevated testosterone. Ultrasound showed hypoechoic masses with peripheral rim hypervascularization only in Leydig cell tumors. All Leydig cell tumor patients underwent testis-sparing surgery with negative margins and no recurrence over a median of 42 months. Affected testes reached volumes similar to the contralateral testis within 3 to 4 years.

pmid-41918635.summary_ja: インド北部の三次医療機関で6年間に診断された妊娠中の類皮嚢腫87例の後方視的観察研究。60.9%は保存的に管理され、24.1%が妊娠中に手術を受けた(主に妊娠中期の腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術)。捻転は10.3%に認め、悪性転化はなかった。周産期転帰は両群で同等であった。
pmid-41918635.summary_en: This retrospective observational study from a North Indian tertiary care center included 87 pregnant women with dermoid cysts (mature cystic teratomas) diagnosed over six years. Most were diagnosed in the second trimester. Of these, 60.9% were managed conservatively and 24.1% underwent antenatal surgery, mainly laparoscopic cystectomy. Torsion occurred in 10.3%, and no malignant transformation was found. Perinatal outcomes were comparable between conservatively and surgically managed groups. The authors conclude that most cysts can be managed expectantly and that second-trimester laparoscopy is safe when surgery is needed.

pmid-41922334.summary_ja: 血清427検体を用いたPhIP-Seqで、GCT診断用の24ペプチドのイムノシグネチャーを開発した。感度93%、特異度99%、AUC 0.98で、従来の腫瘍マーカー陰性例の大半を検出した。セミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別モデルも示された。従来の腫瘍マーカーを補う、拡張性のある血清バイオマーカーとして有望である。
pmid-41922334.summary_en: This study used phage immunoprecipitation sequencing (PhIP-Seq) on 427 serum samples (150 GCT, 277 controls) to build a 24-peptide immunosignature panel, GCT-iSIGN. It achieved 93% sensitivity, 99% specificity, and an AUC of 0.98, detecting 23 of 24 biomarker-negative GCT cases. A second 17-peptide model, Sem-iSIGN, distinguished seminoma from nonseminoma with 96% specificity but only 65% sensitivity. Antigen overexpression was supported by TCGA data, ELISA, and immunohistochemistry, suggesting a scalable serum biomarker approach beyond conventional tumor markers.

pmid-41923292.summary_ja: CRISPR/Cas9でCLDN6を欠損させた胚細胞腫瘍細胞株を作製し、機能を解析した基礎研究である。CLDN6欠損により増殖、遊走、接着、凝集能が低下した。遺伝子発現やタンパク質への影響は小さく、腫瘍進展への関与と治療標的としての可能性を示唆している。
pmid-41923292.summary_en: This basic research study used CRISPR/Cas9 to generate CLDN6-deficient germ cell tumor cell lines (TCam-2, 2102EP, NCCIT, and JAR). Loss of CLDN6 reduced proliferation, migration, adhesion, and aggregation in 2D and 3D cultures, consistent with disrupted cell-cell contacts. Transcriptome and proteome analyses showed only minor changes, suggesting CLDN6 has a limited role in gene expression regulation. The authors conclude that CLDN6 contributes to adhesion, migration, and proliferation during germ cell tumor progression, supporting its potential as a therapeutic target.

pmid-41924289.summary_ja: 13歳男児の左精巣に生じた卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。陰嚢内腫瘤に加え、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とhCGの著明な上昇を認めた。根治的精巣摘除術で確定診断され、29か月の経過観察で再発・転移はなかった。早期の根治的精巣摘除術で治癒が得られ、長期フォローアップが重要と結論づけている。
pmid-41924289.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old boy with a left testicular mixed yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma, presenting with a scrotal mass and markedly elevated AFP and hCG. Radical orchiectomy provided pathological confirmation, and there was no recurrence or metastasis during 29 months of follow-up. The authors review the literature on similar testicular tumors in young patients and conclude that immediate radical orchiectomy can achieve clinical cure in early adolescence, with long-term follow-up being crucial.

pmid-41925035.summary_ja: 絨毛浸潤の制御された生理過程から病的状態までを整理した総説である。絨毛癌ではPI3K/AKT、Wnt/β-catenin、Notch経路の活性化と、PD-L1による免疫逃避が転移能に関与すると論じられている。
pmid-41925035.summary_en: This review examines trophoblast invasion as a controlled process, from normal implantation and spiral artery remodelling to pathological states. In placenta accreta spectrum, dysregulated MMP-2, MMP-9, integrins, VEGF, and HIF-1α drive myometrial invasion. In choriocarcinoma, activation of PI3K/AKT, Wnt/β-catenin, and Notch signalling promotes hyperproliferation, PD-L1-mediated immune evasion, and metastatic potential. The authors discuss shared molecular mediators between obstetric pathology and cancer biology, and emerging models such as trophoblast organoids, placental explants, and placenta-on-a-chip systems.

pmid-41934019.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍82例の化学療法後精巣摘除術の病理所見を後方視的に解析した研究である。残存する生存腫瘍の予測因子として、若年、poor-risk、超音波所見などが挙げられた。精巣温存療法は慎重に検討すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-41934019.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 82 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors who underwent postchemotherapy orchiectomy at a single cancer centre between 1992 and 2025. Teratoma was found in 44%, germ cell neoplasia in situ in 4.9%, and seminoma in 2.4%. Five-year relapse-free and cancer-specific survival were 92.2% and 94.5% for benign pathology, versus 64.9% and 81.6% for viable disease. Younger age, palpable mass, poor-risk IGCCCG status, second-line chemotherapy, and adverse ultrasound features predicted residual viable disease. The authors suggest testis-preserving strategies should be considered cautiously in selected patients.

pmid-41934934.summary_ja: 胎児内胎児7例のCT所見を手術・病理所見と対応させ、1.3〜10.4年の長期経過を検討した後方視的画像研究です。病変は主に後腹膜に発生し、脂肪や骨化した骨格構造を含む被包性腫瘤として描出されました。全例で完全切除され、再発や悪性転化は認められませんでした。CTは奇形腫との鑑別と安全な手術計画に有用と結論づけています。
pmid-41934934.summary_en: This retrospective imaging study describes CT features of seven patients with fetus in fetu, correlating imaging with surgical and histopathological findings and long-term follow-up of 1.3 to 10.4 years. Lesions were mostly retroperitoneal, and CT consistently showed encapsulated masses containing fat and ossified skeletal elements, with vertebral axis or limb-like structures. All underwent complete excision without recurrence or malignant transformation. The authors emphasize that CT helps differentiate fetus in fetu from teratoma and supports safe surgical planning.

pmid-41936489.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清92例で、循環腫瘍DNAの後腹膜組織型の診断精度を後方視的に検討しています。陽性例の陽性的中率は96%と高い一方、奇形腫単独の検出は不良でした。全ゲノム解析による改善が示唆されています。
pmid-41936489.summary_en: This retrospective study assessed the diagnostic accuracy of circulating tumor DNA for retroperitoneal histology in 92 patients who underwent primary or post-chemotherapy RPLND for testicular germ cell tumor. ctDNA was measured preoperatively and at 3, 6 and 12 months after surgery. For active GCT or teratoma overall, sensitivity was 60%, specificity 87%, PPV 96% and NPV 30%. For GCT alone, sensitivity was 85% and NPV 86%. For teratoma alone, performance was poor. A positive ctDNA indicated active disease with high confidence, and whole-genome assays may improve teratoma detection.

pmid-41937160.summary_ja: 34歳女性の縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。7か月で約1.5cmから6.5cmへ急速に増大し、18F-FDG PET/CTではSUVmax 6.9の不均一な集積を認めた。胸腔鏡補助下に完全切除し、成熟グリア成分を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。急速増大や高いFDG集積が必ずしも悪性転化を意味しないと結論している。
pmid-41937160.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with a right anterior superior mediastinal mature cystic teratoma that grew from about 1.5 cm to 6.5 cm over seven months, an average rate of 7.14 mm per month, far above the usual indolent growth. 18F-FDG PET/CT showed heterogeneous uptake with an SUVmax of 6.9. Thoracoscopic-assisted complete resection confirmed mature cystic teratoma with mature glial components. The authors conclude that rapid growth and high FDG uptake do not necessarily indicate malignant transformation, and recommend multidisciplinary decisions based on dynamic quantitative imaging.

pmid-41938468.summary_ja: 22歳女性の縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を報告した。4年前のCTでは正常であり、急速な増大が示唆された。ロボット支援胸腔鏡手術で安全に完全切除され、病理学的に悪性所見はなかった。
pmid-41938468.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with a rapidly enlarging 8 cm anterior mediastinal mass, previously normal on CT four years earlier. Imaging showed fat and calcification consistent with mature cystic teratoma. Robotic-assisted thoracoscopic surgery achieved complete resection despite adhesion to the pericardium and proximity to the right phrenic nerve. Histopathology confirmed mature teratoma without malignant features. The authors note that mediastinal teratomas can grow rapidly and that robotic-assisted thoracoscopic surgery is a safe minimally invasive option for complex mediastinal masses.

pmid-41938636.summary_ja: 新生児の仙尾部腫瘤は、脂肪腫と誤認されても胚細胞腫瘍が隠れている可能性がある。慎重な臨床評価、肛門直腸機能評価、MRIにより良性病変と仙尾部奇形腫を鑑別する必要がある。これに基づき、適切な外科的管理とフォローアップを行うべきである。
pmid-41938636.summary_en: This clinical case report notes that sacrococcygeal masses in neonates that appear benign, such as presumed lipomas, may conceal germ cell tumors. The authors recommend careful clinical evaluation, functional anorectal assessment, and MRI to distinguish benign lesions from sacrococcygeal teratomas. Appropriate surgical management and follow-up are then guided by these findings in the neonatal period.

pmid-41939179.summary_ja: 両側の大型成熟嚢胞性奇形腫とCA-125高値を呈した52歳閉経後女性の症例報告です。成熟奇形腫内に生じた中分化扁平上皮癌が右卵巣に限局(pT1a)していました。子宮全摘、両側付属器切除などを施行しています。閉経後、腫瘍径の大きさ、腫瘍マーカー上昇は悪性転化を疑う危険信号であり、詳細な病理組織学的評価の重要性を強調しています。
pmid-41939179.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old postmenopausal woman with bilateral large mature cystic teratomas, hydroureteronephrosis and elevated CA-125, in whom a moderately differentiated squamous cell carcinoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma was confined to the right ovary (pT1a). Treatment consisted of total hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, appendectomy and peritoneal washings. The authors highlight postmenopausal status, large tumor size and elevated tumor markers as red flags for malignant transformation, underscoring the importance of thorough histopathological evaluation.

pmid-41939787.summary_ja: 小児の前縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍が化学療法で病理学的完全奏効に至った症例です。原発巣を完全切除したにもかかわらず早期に再発し、肺転移巣の切除を要しました。再発腫瘍はセミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍の混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、原発巣と組織型が異なっていました。縦隔の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、完全奏効や完全切除後でも早期再発と組織型変化を念頭に置くべきと報告しています。
pmid-41939787.summary_en: This case report describes a pediatric anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor that achieved a pathological complete response to chemotherapy. Despite complete resection, early recurrence occurred, and the patient required pulmonary metastasectomy. The recurrent lesion was a mixed germ cell tumor of seminoma and yolk sac tumor, showing histological discordance from the primary tumor. The authors note that early recurrence and histological change at relapse should be considered in mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, even after apparent complete pathological response and complete resection.

pmid-41941753.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の胚細胞腫瘍1927例と対照10601例を用いた多人種ゲノムワイド関連解析。精巣、卵巣、頭蓋内、性腺外の各腫瘍を対象とした。BAK1、SPRY4、DMRT1、DEPTOR近傍など4座位が全ゲノム有意水準に達した。既報の精巣腫瘍関連座位18個が関連し、年齢や発生部位を超えた遺伝的基盤の共有が示唆された。
pmid-41941753.summary_en: This multi-ancestry genome-wide association study analyzed 1927 children and adolescents with germ cell tumors from the Germ Cell Tumor Epidemiology Study against 10601 controls, including testicular, ovarian, intracranial, and extragonadal tumors. Four loci reached genome-wide significance, including variants near BAK1, SPRY4, DMRT1, and DEPTOR, with additional subgroup-specific loci. Eighteen of 78 previously reported testicular loci were associated with pediatric germ cell tumors, suggesting shared genetic architecture across age and tumor location.

pmid-41946536.summary_ja: 40代女性の卵巣成熟奇形腫によるACTH異所性産生性クッシング症候群を報告した。IPSSで異所性と確認され、腹腔鏡下卵管卵巣摘出術で完全寛解に至った。標準画像で陰性の場合は卵巣奇形腫を考慮すべきである。
pmid-41946536.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in her early 40s with ACTH-dependent Cushing syndrome caused by ectopic ACTH secretion from a mature ovarian teratoma. Biochemical testing and inferior petrosal sinus sampling confirmed an ectopic source. Pituitary and thoracoabdominal imaging were negative, and pelvic imaging revealed a right ovarian mass. Laparoscopic salpingo-oophorectomy showed a mature cystic teratoma with ACTH-positive neuroendocrine cells. Complete biochemical remission and hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis recovery were achieved at one year. The authors stress considering ovarian teratomas when standard imaging is unrevealing.

pmid-41947084.summary_ja: 8か月男児の原発性胃混合型胚細胞腫瘍。初回切除で未熟奇形腫と診断されたが、AFPが1週間で465.8から1000 ng/mL超へ上昇した。再手術で未熟奇形腫95%と卵黄嚢腫瘍5%の混合型と確認された。VCP/IEV化学療法4サイクルでAFPは正常化し、48か月以上無病生存している。動的なAFP監視の重要性を示す。
pmid-41947084.summary_en: This report describes an 8-month-old boy with a primary gastric mixed germ cell tumor. Initial resection showed an immature teratoma, but serial AFP monitoring revealed a rise from 465.8 to over 1000 ng/mL within a week. Reoperation confirmed a mixed germ cell tumor with 95% immature teratoma and 5% yolk sac tumor. Four cycles of VCP/IEV chemotherapy normalized AFP. The patient has remained disease-free for over 48 months. The authors emphasize dynamic AFP surveillance in unmasking occult malignancy.

pmid-41949134.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に化学療法を受けた159例の後方視的多施設研究。腰筋指数(PMI)が10%以上減少した患者では、疾患進行(26.1%対10.6%)と死亡(8.7%対1.8%)が多かった。PMIの減少は、疾患進行と死亡の独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-41949134.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter study of 159 patients receiving chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors examined whether a change in psoas muscle index (PMI) predicts outcomes. A decrease of 10% or more was associated with higher progression (26.1% vs. 10.6%) and mortality (8.7% vs. 1.8%). In multivariable analysis, PMI decrease, rete testis invasion, and non-seminomatous or mixed histology independently predicted progression, while only PMI decrease predicted mortality. The authors conclude that PMI reduction is an independent prognostic factor.

pmid-41951101.summary_ja: 妊娠と無関係に肝臓に発生した原発性肝絨毛癌の34歳女性の症例報告です。術前のβ-hCGは22,936 mlU/mLと著明に高値でした。化学療法後に多発する肝内動脈門脈シャントによる難治性門脈圧亢進症が生じ、内科治療、コイル塞栓、TIPSはいずれも奏功しませんでした。肝移植を行い、9か月時点で再発なく生存しています。
pmid-41951101.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with primary hepatic choriocarcinoma, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor without gestational origin, who presented with multiple liver lesions and markedly elevated hCG. After four cycles of curative-intent chemotherapy, she developed multiple intrahepatic arterioportal shunts causing refractory portal hypertension that did not respond to medical therapy, coiling, or TIPS. Liver transplantation was performed for both the shunts and potential residual tumor, and she was alive without early recurrence at 9-month follow-up.

pmid-41953206.summary_ja: パキスタンの単施設で1999〜2022年に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の少女116例の後方視的研究です。5年無イベント生存率は87.1%、5年全生存率は90.5%でした。腫瘍マーカーの速やかな正常化は良好な予後と関連していました。
pmid-41953206.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study from Pakistan included 116 girls with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 1999 and 2022. Dysgerminoma was the most common histology. Most patients had upfront surgery followed by adjuvant chemotherapy, mainly JEB or BEP. Five-year event-free and overall survival were 87.1% and 90.5%. Histology, regimen and risk group influenced survival, and rapid tumor marker normalization was associated with better event-free survival. Relapse occurred in 2.6%. The authors conclude that multimodal therapy yields good outcomes in a low-resource setting.

pmid-41953803.summary_ja: 進行性の行動変化から妄想と緊張病を呈した24歳女性の症例報告である。脳MRIで可逆性脾梁病変を認め、髄液で抗NMDAR抗体が陽性であった。両側卵巣奇形腫の摘除と免疫療法で症状は改善し、自己免疫性脳炎の診断の重要性を示している。
pmid-41953803.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman whose progressive behavioral changes evolved into paranoid delusions and catatonia, with reversible splenial lesion syndrome on brain MRI. Anti-NMDA receptor antibodies were detected in cerebrospinal fluid, and abdominal CT revealed bilateral ovarian teratomas. Treatment with corticosteroids, intravenous immunoglobulin, and surgical removal of the teratomas was followed by rituximab, leading to significant clinical improvement and complete MRI resolution. The authors highlight that RESLES can be the initial imaging manifestation of anti-NMDAR encephalitis and that autoimmune causes should be considered in acute psychiatric presentations.

pmid-41957136.summary_ja: 腫瘍マーカー陽性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍107例に対する救済的化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清の検討。病理では生存胚細胞腫瘍47.7%、奇形腫32.7%、体細胞型悪性腫瘍8.4%などが確認された。5年全生存率は68%で、奇形腫では96%と良好であった。体細胞型悪性腫瘍や線維壊死組織は再発リスクの上昇と関連し、奇形腫が疑われる場合は手術が支持されると結論づけられた。
pmid-41957136.summary_en: In 107 men with marker-positive non-seminomatous germ cell tumors undergoing salvage post-chemotherapy RPLND, final histology showed viable germ cell tumor (47.7%), teratoma (32.7%), fibro-necrotic tissue (11.4%), or somatic malignancy (8.4%). After median follow-up of 45 months, 5-year RFS was 54% and OS 68%. Teratoma histology had superior outcomes, with 5-year OS of 96%, while somatic malignancy and fibro-necrotic tissue predicted worse recurrence-free survival. Larger residual masses and advanced stage were also associated with poorer outcomes.

pmid-41958774.summary_ja: 7か月男児が左前縦隔の巨大腫瘤により重度の呼吸窮迫と肺虚脱を呈した症例です。縦隔奇形腫と判断され、適時の外科的治療が行われました。乳児期の大型奇形腫は圧迫により急速に生命を脅かすため、小児の呼吸窮迫の鑑別に縦隔奇形腫を含め、早期の手術介入が重要であると報告しています。
pmid-41958774.summary_en: This case report describes a 7-month-old boy with a large left anterior mediastinal mass presenting with severe respiratory distress and a collapsed lung. Imaging suggested a mediastinal teratoma, and the mass was managed with timely surgical intervention. The authors stress that mediastinal teratoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of pediatric respiratory distress caused by a mediastinal mass. Because large infant teratomas can rapidly become life-threatening through compression, early recognition and surgery are essential for good outcomes.

pmid-41958792.summary_ja: 4歳男児の胃原発混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍のうち消化管発生はきわめてまれである。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は原発より転移として見られることが多い。組織形態、免疫組織化学、腫瘍マーカーが正確な診断に有用であり、小児の低分化上皮様腫瘍では発生部位にかかわらず胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に挙げるべきと述べている。
pmid-41958792.summary_en: This report describes a primary mixed germ cell tumor of the stomach in a four-year-old boy, an extremely rare extragonadal presentation of a tumor more commonly seen in the gonads. The authors note that such tumors are often metastatic rather than primary and stress that histomorphology, immunohistochemistry, and tumor markers help establish the correct diagnosis. They argue that germ cell tumor should be considered in the differential of poorly differentiated epithelioid neoplasms in children regardless of site.

pmid-41958928.summary_ja: 広範な肺・脳・腎・骨転移を伴う小児の原発性縦隔悪性胚細胞腫瘍の男児症例です。腫瘍切除の前後に多剤併用化学療法を行い、完全寛解に至りました。12か月生存し寛解を維持しています。
pmid-41958928.summary_en: This case report describes a male child with a primary mediastinal malignant germ cell tumor and extensive metastases to lung, brain, kidney and multiple bones. He received multi-drug combination chemotherapy before and after tumor resection. He achieved complete remission and has survived 12 months, remaining in remission. The authors highlight that multi-agent combination chemotherapy within a multimodal strategy may be effective for advanced pediatric mediastinal germ cell tumors, which generally have poor prognosis.

pmid-41959930.summary_ja: 血清AFPとhCGが正常範囲のまま、後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴う精巣胎児性癌を呈した24歳男性の症例報告。画像診断、病理組織学的検査、免疫組織化学で確定診断し、根治的精巣摘除術とBEP化学療法後、12か月の経過観察で再発は認めなかった。
pmid-41959930.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with testicular embryonal carcinoma and retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis whose serum AFP and hCG remained normal. Diagnosis was confirmed by imaging, histopathology, and immunohistochemistry. He underwent radical orchiectomy followed by BEP chemotherapy and had no recurrence at 12-month follow-up. The authors emphasize a multidisciplinary diagnostic approach, including immunohistochemistry, for marker-negative presentations and the importance of long-term follow-up.

pmid-41960975.summary_ja: ギラン・バレー症候群で入院中の32歳男性に、停留精巣と子宮様組織を伴う巨大な腹骨盤腔腫瘤を認めた症例報告です。FDG PET/CTで腫瘤に強い集積を示し、子宮様組織には集積を認めませんでした。生検でセミノーマと退化した子宮組織が確認され、持続性ミュラー管症候群と診断されました。停留精巣の画像評価は早期診断と悪性転化の予防に有用です。
pmid-41960975.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with Guillain-Barré syndrome who had abdominal distension, bilateral cryptorchidism and a large abdominopelvic mass with uterine-like tissue. 18F-FDG PET/CT showed high uptake in the mass but not in the uterine-like tissue. Biopsy revealed seminoma with rudimentary uterine tissue, confirming persistent Müllerian duct syndrome. The authors note that this rare autosomal recessive disorder can be suspected on cryptorchidism imaging, allowing timely surgery to prevent malignant transformation.

pmid-41969137.summary_ja: 2018〜2022年にスウェーデンで行われた後腹膜リンパ節郭清217例の前向き多施設コホートの後方視的解析です。重篤な合併症は少なく、両側郭清は射精障害を増やしました。化学療法後の標本では奇形腫が以前の報告より多く認められました。
pmid-41969137.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of a prospective Swedish multicentre cohort included 217 patients who underwent primary or post-chemotherapy RPLND between 2018 and 2022. Intraoperative complications occurred in 0-8% and serious Clavien-Dindo grade IIIb or higher events in 2-3%. Bilateral templates increased postoperative complications after post-chemotherapy RPLND and loss of ejaculation after both settings. Robotic surgery and laparoscopy after chemotherapy were safe. Viable cancer was found in 95% of primary seminomas and 52% of primary nonseminomas. Post-chemotherapy specimens showed more teratoma than previously reported.

pmid-41969539.summary_ja: 2009～2018年に診断されたインド・ラトナギリ県の精巣がん43例の地域ベースがん登録に基づく生存解析である。10年相対生存率は63.3%で、限局例は100%であった。40歳未満、セミノーマ、手術、治療完了が良好な予後と関連していた。農村病院と三次施設の連携が重要と結論づけた。
pmid-41969539.summary_en: This population-based registry study reports 10-year survival for testicular cancer in Ratnagiri district, India, for diagnoses from 2009 to 2018. Among 43 registered cases, the 10-year relative survival was 63.3%, and survival was 100% for localized disease. Younger age (under 40), seminoma histology, surgery, and completed treatment predicted better outcomes. The authors conclude that linkage between rural hospitals and a tertiary cancer center contributes to better outcomes and recommend continued education of primary-care clinicians.

pmid-41971913.summary_ja: 絨毛癌、類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が混在した65歳女性の混合型妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の症例報告です。当初は卵巣癌や子宮内膜癌の合併も疑われました。多剤化学療法で重篤な毒性が生じ、減量手術の後も敗血症と進行を来し、死亡に至りました。既報の混合型45例のレビューも併せて示し、鑑別と治療の不確実性を指摘しています。
pmid-41971913.summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old woman with mixed gestational trophoblastic neoplasia comprising choriocarcinoma, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor and placental site trophoblastic tumor, initially diagnosed as undefined GTN with possible ovarian or endometrial cancer. She received multi-agent chemotherapy complicated by severe toxicity, followed by cytoreductive surgery and sequential chemotherapy, but developed sepsis and progressive disease, and died after supportive care was withdrawn. The authors also reviewed 45 previously reported mixed GTN cases to highlight diagnostic difficulty and treatment uncertainty.

pmid-41976328.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の網状・充実性・腺管状・乳頭状・肝様などの形態学的パターンを概説しています。免疫組織化学の所見、小生検標本での鑑別診断、化学療法後の形態変化を取り上げ、臨床・画像・検査所見と統合した診断の重要性を論じています。
pmid-41976328.summary_en: This review summarizes the morphologic spectrum of mediastinal yolk sac tumor, including reticular, solid, glandular, papillary and hepatoid patterns. It discusses immunohistochemical correlations used to resolve diagnostic dilemmas and key differential diagnoses in small mediastinal biopsies. Limitations of limited sampling and post-chemotherapy morphologic changes are emphasized. The authors integrate morphology with clinical, radiologic and laboratory findings to improve recognition of this aggressive malignant germ cell neoplasm across its presentations.

pmid-41976385.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ51例で、核内のPTTG1免疫組織化学的発現をリンパ節転移の指標として評価した後方視的研究です。PTTG1スコアはリンパ節転移と関連し、腫瘍径や壊死で補正後も独立した関連を示しました。カットオフ4.0で感度90.5%、特異度57.1%、AUC 0.939でした。リンパ行性転移の生物学的特徴を反映する可能性があり、前向き研究での検証が必要と述べています。
pmid-41976385.summary_en: This hypothesis-generating retrospective study of 51 patients with testicular seminoma evaluated intranuclear PTTG1 immunohistochemical expression as a marker of lymph node involvement. PTTG1 scores correlated with nodal metastasis and adipose tissue invasion, and the score was independently associated with nodal involvement after adjustment for tumor size and necrosis. At a cut-off of 4.0, sensitivity was 90.5% and specificity 57.1%, with an AUC of 0.939. The authors suggest PTTG1 may reflect biological features of lymphatic dissemination. Larger prospective studies are needed to validate these findings.

pmid-41976887.summary_ja: 無症状の27歳女性で、子宮下部から頸部に及ぶ成熟子宮奇形腫を認めた症例報告。IBS(®)を用いて摘出し、この機器による子宮奇形腫摘出の初報告である。術後に正期産を達成し、術前MRIと文献的考察を加えた。
pmid-41976887.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old asymptomatic woman with a mature uterine teratoma arising from the lower uterine segment and extending to the cervix. The lesion was removed using the IBS Integrated Bigatti Shaver, the first reported use of this device for uterine teratoma. She later achieved a successful term pregnancy. The authors recommend preoperative MRI for uterine teratomas, note that ultrasound often misreads them as polyps or myomas, and review the literature.

pmid-41978681.summary_ja: 精巣捻転に対する整復・両側精巣固定術の4年後に左精巣セミノーマと診断された44歳男性の症例報告。精巣摘除術の18か月後に右鼠径リンパ節転移を生じ、対側への転移は極めて稀である。切除後にBEP化学療法3サイクルを施行した。術後のリンパ流の変化が一因と考察し、両側鼠径部の診察を推奨している。
pmid-41978681.summary_en: This case report describes a 44-year-old man diagnosed with seminoma of the left testis four years after detorsion and bilateral orchiopexy for testicular torsion. Eighteen months after inguinal orchiectomy, he developed a right inguinal lymph node metastasis, an exceptionally rare contralateral spread. Initial imaging showed no other lesions, and resection confirmed metastasis. Subsequent abdominal wall nodules were biopsy-negative. He received three cycles of BEP chemotherapy. The authors suggest bilateral inguinal examination in such patients, given possibly altered lymphatic drainage after prior scrotal surgery.

pmid-41980879.summary_ja: 体細胞型悪性腫瘍を伴う胚細胞腫瘍11例の、通常成分と体細胞型成分のペアでコピー数変化を比較しています。8例では両成分のプロファイルが類似し共通の起源を示しました。3例では体細胞型成分で変化が多く、分岐的な進化と腫瘍進行への関与が示唆されています。
pmid-41980879.summary_en: This study compared genome-wide copy number alterations in paired somatic-type malignancy and conventional germ cell tumor components from 11 tumors, including 22 samples. Most tumors (8/11) showed similar copy number profiles between paired components, supporting a common clonal origin. In three tumors, mostly metastases or a mediastinal primary, the somatic-type component carried more alterations, suggesting divergent subclonal evolution. No highly recurrent copy number alterations were found in somatic-type components. The findings link copy number changes to tumor progression in germ cell tumors with somatic-type malignancy.

pmid-41982533.summary_ja: 健診で偶然見つかった膵尾部の3cm嚢胞性病変を、腹腔鏡下に被膜を保った切除と経皮ドレナージで治療した54歳男性の症例報告です。術前画像では良性・悪性の鑑別が困難でした。病理学的に嚢胞性成熟奇形腫と確定し、10か月以上の経過観察で再発はありません。膵嚢胞性病変の画像診断の限界と、不必要な拡大手術を避ける意義を述べています。
pmid-41982533.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old man with an incidentally detected 3 cm cystic lesion in the pancreatic tail, which was preoperatively indeterminate and managed with laparoscopic resection of the encapsulated mass combined with percutaneous drainage rather than distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy. Pathology confirmed a cystic mature teratoma. With over 10 months of follow-up and no recurrence, the authors note that pancreatic dermoid cysts are extremely rare and mostly diagnosed postoperatively. The article also summarizes current knowledge on these uncommon tumors to help avoid unnecessary extensive resections.

pmid-41982864.summary_ja: 31歳女性のFIGO病期IVBの卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ症例。鎖骨上窩リンパ節転移と腹膜播種を伴い、減量手術とBEP化学療法により良好な経過が得られた。化学感受性は高いが、進行例は稀であることを報告している。
pmid-41982864.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with FIGO stage IVB ovarian dysgerminoma, with supraclavicular lymph node metastasis and peritoneal carcinomatosis. Diagnosis was established by classical histopathology. She underwent cytoreductive surgery followed by BEP chemotherapy and achieved a favorable clinical outcome. The authors note that dysgerminoma is highly chemosensitive and usually presents at an early stage, so advanced cases such as this are rare.

pmid-41988438.summary_ja: 46歳女性の卵巣奇形腫内に発生した濾胞性リンパ腫の症例報告。過多月経で受診し、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)で病期IIIと判明した。併用化学療法により、治療終了時のPETで代謝的完全寛解を得た。奇形腫内にリンパ系悪性腫瘍が生じる稀な併存例である。
pmid-41988438.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old woman with follicular lymphoma arising within an ovarian teratoma. She presented with menorrhagia but was otherwise well. PET imaging showed stage III disease, and she received combination chemotherapy, achieving complete metabolic remission on the end-of-treatment PET. The report highlights the unusual coexistence of a lymphoid malignancy within a teratoma, which should be considered when evaluating ovarian teratomas.

pmid-41988850.summary_ja: 純粋非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍67例(胎児性癌63例、卵黄嚢腫瘍4例)を対象に、精巣内胚細胞腫瘍(GCNIS)と隣接する浸潤・精細管内成分の転写因子を免疫組織化学で比較しました。GCNISは全例でOCT4、SOX17、NANOGが陽性でした。非セミノーマへの分化転換は精原細胞ニッチの外で起こると示唆されています。
pmid-41988850.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study of 67 pure non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors (63 embryonal carcinoma, 4 yolk sac tumor) examines germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS) and adjacent invasive and intratubular components for OCT4, SOX17, NANOG, SOX2, CD30 and FOXA2. GCNIS expressed OCT4, SOX17 and NANOG in all cases and was negative for CD30 and SOX2 in embryonal carcinoma-associated lesions, and for FOXA2 in yolk sac tumor-associated lesions, while invasive components showed their classic phenotypes. The authors conclude that reprogramming to non-seminoma likely occurs outside the spermatogonial niche.

pmid-41991229.summary_ja: 40歳代前半の女性で、難治性の抗NMDA受容体脳炎(頭痛、幻覚、進行性脳症)の症例報告。画像検査では腫瘍を認めなかったが、臨床的な疑いから行った左卵管卵巣摘出術で成熟奇形腫が判明した。手術と免疫療法により身体機能は徐々に回復し、意識レベルも改善した。画像陰性の難治例では集学的治療と外科的探索を検討すべきと強調している。
pmid-41991229.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in her early 40s with refractory anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis presenting with headache, hallucinations, and progressive encephalopathy. Imaging failed to detect a neoplasm, but a left salpingo-oophorectomy performed on clinical suspicion revealed a mature teratoma. Surgery combined with immunotherapy led to gradual recovery in physical function and improved consciousness. The authors emphasize aggressive multimodal therapy and surgical exploration in imaging-negative refractory cases.

pmid-41991382.summary_ja: SEERデータを用いた精巣がん患者46,395例の解析で、自殺の標準化死亡比は1.31でした。病期が進むほど上昇し、遠隔転移では2.29でした。診断後1年以内のリスクが最も高く、早期の心理社会的スクリーニングの必要性を示しています。
pmid-41991382.summary_en: This SEER population-based cohort included 46,395 patients with testicular cancer diagnosed between 2000 and 2021. Suicide accounted for 125 deaths. Standardized mortality ratio for suicide was 1.31 compared with the age-adjusted US population. Risk increased with stage: SMR 1.07 for localized, 1.48 for regional and 2.29 for distant disease. Suicide risk was highest in the first year after diagnosis (SMR 2.21) and remained elevated at 1 to 5 and 5 to 10 years. Separated, divorced or widowed status and race were associated with higher risk. The authors recommend early psychosocial screening and mental health support.

pmid-41991407.summary_ja: 胆道閉鎖症で1歳時に生体肝移植を受けた20歳男性が、監視中のαフェトプロテイン（AFP）が493 ng/mLに上昇した。肝病変はなく、精巣腫大から超音波検査で不均一な腫瘤を認め、精巣摘除術で精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と確定した。術後にAFPは正常化した。AFP監視の有用性と限界を論じる。
pmid-41991407.summary_en: A 20-year-old man who had received a living donor liver transplant at age 1 for biliary atresia was found to have AFP of 493 ng/mL during surveillance. Imaging showed no liver lesions, but testicular swelling was identified, and scrotal ultrasound revealed a heterogeneous mass. Orchiectomy confirmed a mixed germ cell tumor composed of seminoma, yolk sac tumor, and embryonal carcinoma. AFP normalized after surgery. The authors note that AFP surveillance enabled early detection of a curable extrahepatic tumor but may miss AFP-negative testicular cancers, and they call for standardized pediatric transplant surveillance guidelines.

pmid-41992487.summary_ja: メキシコの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者2,755例を対象とし、代謝や体組成指標がIGCCCG分類を超えて生存を予測するかを検討したコホート研究です。除脂肪量指数、血清アルブミン、HDLコレステロールが多変量解析で独立した予後因子でした。非セミノーマとセミノーマの両方で代謝栄養プロファイルにより5年生存率が明確に層別化されました。栄養評価がIGCCCG分類を補完しうると述べています。
pmid-41992487.summary_en: This cohort study of 2,755 Mexican patients with testicular germ cell tumors examined whether metabolic and body composition measures predict survival beyond the IGCCCG risk classification. Lean mass index, serum albumin, and HDL cholesterol were independently associated with survival in multivariate Cox regression. Metabolic-nutritional profiles stratified 5-year survival substantially in both non-seminoma and seminoma patients, and a reduced model of BMI, lean mass, and albumin achieved an optimism-corrected AUC of 0.866. The authors suggest nutritional assessment could complement IGCCCG classification and guide supportive care.

pmid-41993117.summary_ja: 急性骨盤痛と13cmの左付属器腫瘤、CA-125高値で受診した40歳女性の症例報告です。開腹による左付属器切除で、11cmの卵巣甲状腺腫内に生じた1cmの乳頭状甲状腺癌が確認されました。術後の甲状腺検査は正常でした。多職種は甲状腺全摘と対側付属器切除を勧めましたが、患者は拒否し経過観察を選択しました。甲状腺癌の診療指針に沿った管理と患者の意向の尊重を強調しています。
pmid-41993117.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman presenting with acute pelvic pain and a 13 cm left adnexal mass with elevated CA-125. Laparotomy with left salpingo-oophorectomy revealed a 1 cm papillary thyroid carcinoma arising within an 11 cm struma ovarii, without capsular or vascular invasion. Postoperative thyroid workup was normal. Although multidisciplinary teams recommended completion thyroidectomy and contralateral adnexectomy, the patient declined further surgery and opted for surveillance alone. The authors stress managing malignant struma ovarii according to thyroid carcinoma protocols.

pmid-41994753.summary_ja: 左精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の既往を持つ24歳男性の皮膚転移の症例報告である。ダーモスコピーで悪性を疑う所見を認め、生検で低分化癌のリンパ管内浸潤が確認された。精巣腫瘍からの皮膚転移は極めて稀で、進行病変を示す。
pmid-41994753.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with a history of non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the left testis who presented with disseminated raised, dome-like skin lesions. Dermoscopy showed milky-red areas, blue-white veil-like zones, blood crusts, and structureless white areas, raising suspicion of malignancy. Skin biopsy confirmed cutaneous intralymphatic infiltration by a poorly differentiated carcinoma. The authors note that cutaneous metastasis from a testicular tumor is exceptionally rare and indicates advanced disease with significant prognostic implications. They suggest that dermoscopic features may help prompt further oncologic evaluation when clinical presentation is misleading.

pmid-41995947.summary_ja: 新生児仙尾部奇形腫に対する術前塞栓術のため、臍静脈から動脈管を経由して動脈循環にアクセスした1例。新生児では動脈穿刺に伴うスパズム・血栓・出血のリスクがあるため、臍静脈経由は有用な代替手段となりうる。動脈管開存の有無が実施可否を左右する。
pmid-41995947.summary_en: This case report describes preoperative embolization of a neonatal sacrococcygeal teratoma performed on the first day of life. Because arterial access in neonates carries risks of spasm, thrombosis, and puncture complications, the team accessed the arterial circulation through the umbilical vein and the ductus arteriosus, avoiding arterial puncture. Embolization was performed safely and effectively, and perioperative bleeding was controlled. The authors note that feasibility depends on ductus arteriosus patency. They suggest that this umbilical venous approach may be valuable in selected neonates in whom femoral access is technically difficult, since the umbilical vein is already a common pediatric access route.

pmid-41998312.summary_ja: 719例の胚細胞腫瘍のメチル化データを統合し、組織型ごとに特徴的なメチル化プロファイルを示しました。卵黄嚢腫瘍のAPCとDPP7、胎児性癌のGATA4とFBRSを腫瘍DNAで検証し、DPP7は血清の遊離DNAでも検出可能でした。組織型分類に役立つリキッドバイオプシー型バイオマーカーの候補となる知見です。
pmid-41998312.summary_en: This study integrates 16 DNA methylation datasets comprising 719 germ cell tumors, along with healthy testis and blood controls, to characterize histology-specific methylation profiles independent of tumor location, age, or sex. Differentially methylated regions were identified for each histology, and methylation-sensitive restriction enzyme-based qPCR validated two yolk sac tumor markers (APC, DPP7) and two embryonal carcinoma markers (GATA4, FBRS) in tumor DNA. DPP7 was also detectable in serum cell-free DNA, suggesting potential as a liquid biopsy biomarker for subtyping.

pmid-41998592.summary_ja: 腫瘍マーカー陰性の精巣腫瘍39例を対象に、せん断波エラストグラフィーの色調所見を後方視的に解析した研究である。セミノーマの76%に特徴的な「map sign」が認められ、非セミノーマには認められなかった。従来の超音波検査より診断精度が高く、非侵襲的な鑑別法として有用と示唆された。
pmid-41998592.summary_en: This retrospective observational study evaluated shear wave elastography (SWE) color features in 39 pathologically confirmed testicular tumors that were negative for tumor markers. A 'map sign' (predominantly blue with red streaks) was seen in 76% of seminomas and in none of the non-seminomas. Using this sign as the criterion for seminoma gave 100% specificity and 100% positive predictive value, with 76.2% sensitivity and 87.2% accuracy, outperforming conventional ultrasound. The authors suggest SWE may be a noninvasive, repeatable diagnostic tool, although the sample is small and retrospective.

pmid-42000607.summary_ja: ラテンアメリカの三次紹介施設で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する開腹とロボット支援のRPLNDを後方視的に比較したコホート研究です。傾向スコアマッチング後の20組で、ロボット支援では出血量と在院日数が有意に少なくなりました。手術時間、合併症、再入院に差はなく、無再発生存と全生存期間(全生存率)も両群で同等でした。経験豊富な施設では周術期の安全性と早期腫瘍学的アウトカムを損なわずに利点が得られると結論しています。
pmid-42000607.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study from a tertiary referral center in Latin America compared open and robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for testicular germ cell tumors. After propensity score matching, 20 pairs were analyzed. Robotic surgery was associated with lower estimated blood loss and shorter length of stay, with similar operative time, transfusion, complications, and readmission. Recurrence-free and overall survival did not differ significantly between groups. The authors conclude that robotic RPLND offers reduced blood loss and hospitalization without compromising perioperative safety or early oncologic outcomes in experienced centers.

pmid-42004047.summary_ja: 2015〜2025年に治療された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍34例の後方視的解析です。縦隔セミノーマの3年成績は良好で、縦隔非セミノーマは再発率が高い結果でした。後腹膜非セミノーマの全生存率が最も低く、部位と組織型に応じたリスク評価の重要性を示しています。
pmid-42004047.summary_en: This retrospective single-centre study analysed 34 patients with primary mediastinal or retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumours treated between 2015 and 2025. Most received chemotherapy stratified by IGCCCG prognostic group, and 44% underwent surgery. Relapse occurred in 44.9% of patients who completed chemotherapy, with a median time of 0.79 years. Three-year relapse-free and overall survival were 100% in primary mediastinal seminoma, while primary mediastinal non-seminoma had a 3-year relapse-free survival of 46%. Retroperitoneal non-seminoma had the lowest overall survival, supporting site- and histology-specific risk assessment.

pmid-42008430.summary_ja: 2013〜2023年に北京の一施設で診断された周閉経期の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍5例(絨毛癌3例、侵入奇胎2例)の症例集積です。β-hCG、超音波所見、病理所見、治療内容を解析しました。全例が治療を完了し、最長2年の経過観察で再発はありませんでした。閉経前後の不正性器出血では血清β-hCGと骨盤画像の併用が早期診断に重要と述べています。
pmid-42008430.summary_en: This retrospective case series analyzes five perimenopausal women diagnosed with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia between 2013 and 2023 at a single Beijing hospital, including three choriocarcinomas and two invasive moles. Clinical features, serum β-hCG levels, ultrasound findings, pathology, surgical procedures and chemotherapy regimens were reviewed. All completed treatment and follow-up of up to 2 years without recurrence. The authors suggest combining serum β-hCG with pelvic imaging for early diagnosis, and that hysterectomy with adnexectomy plus chemotherapy may improve efficacy.

pmid-42012929.summary_ja: 精索への不連続浸潤のみを認め、その他の転移がない精巣胚細胞腫瘍19例を多施設で検討した研究である。この所見を病期M1とすると過剰治療につながるため、pT3(disc)として扱うべきと提案している。再発の危険因子として位置づけられる。
pmid-42012929.summary_en: This international multi-institutional study examined 19 testicular germ cell tumor patients whose only metastatic-type finding was discontinuous spermatic cord involvement, meaning they would otherwise be clinical stage I. Adjuvant chemotherapy was given to 15 patients, and 10 developed recurrence, most often in the retroperitoneum. Four patients under active surveillance showed no recurrence. The authors argue that discontinuous cord invasion should not be classified as pM1, since this could lead to overtreatment. They propose staging such tumors as pT3(disc), recognizing this finding as a risk factor for recurrence.

pmid-42015095.summary_ja: 41歳女性の帝王切開瘢痕部（子宮峡部前壁）に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例です。MRIで脂肪成分を認め、子宮鏡下切除で完全切除されました。非典型的な峡部腫瘤の鑑別に子宮奇形腫を含める必要性を述べています。
pmid-42015095.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old woman with postmenstrual brown vaginal discharge and a mass in the anterior uterine isthmus at a prior cesarean scar. Transvaginal ultrasound and MRI showed a heterogeneous lesion with intralesional fat. Hysteroscopy revealed hair-like structures and caseous material. Histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma with keratinized squamous epithelium, hair shafts and calcification. The lesion was completely excised by hysteroscopic resection under laparoscopic monitoring. The authors emphasize that uterine teratoma should be considered in atypical isthmic masses, especially at cesarean scar sites.

pmid-42015720.summary_ja: 小児の卵巣病変の外科的管理の現状をまとめた総説。多くは良性で、成熟奇形腫が最も多い腫瘍性病変である。良性病変には卵巣温存、ロボット支援を含む低侵襲手術を推奨し、悪性が疑われる場合は開腹による完全切除と病期分類を行う。
pmid-42015720.summary_en: This review outlines current surgical management of ovarian lesions in pediatric patients, most of which are benign, with mature teratoma the most common neoplastic subtype. It recommends ovary-sparing, minimally invasive techniques, including robot-assisted approaches, for benign lesions. When malignancy is suspected, laparotomy with complete tumor excision, oophorectomy, and staging is performed. The authors stress accurate evaluation and early diagnosis to prevent complications and preserve future fertility.

pmid-42016696.summary_ja: 3か月の男児が進行性の腹部膨満と便秘、上腹部の硬い腫瘤を呈しました。画像で胃大彎由来の充実性・嚢胞性混在病変が認められ、奇形腫が疑われました。開腹で完全摘出され、三胚葉すべての組織を含む成熟胃奇形腫で悪性所見はありませんでした。乳児の原因不明の腹部膨満では胃奇形腫を考慮し、完全切除が有効と報告しています。
pmid-42016696.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-month-old male infant with progressive abdominal distension, constipation, and a firm upper-abdominal mass. Imaging showed a large mixed solid and cystic lesion arising from the greater curvature of the stomach, suggesting a teratoma. Complete surgical removal via laparotomy confirmed a mature gastric teratoma containing tissues from all three germ layers, without malignant features. Recovery was smooth with rapid symptom improvement. The authors emphasize considering gastric teratoma in infants with unexplained abdominal distension and support complete resection as an effective approach.

pmid-42017013.summary_ja: メキシコ系ヒスパニックの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者40例のエクソーム解析で、感受性に関わる生殖細胞系列変異を探索しています。ARFGAP1、SLCO4A1、MC4Rの3変異が独立コホートでも再現されました。全エクソームレベルの有意性には達せず、死亡率との関連も予備的な所見です。
pmid-42017013.summary_en: This exome sequencing study investigated germline variants that contribute to testicular germ cell tumor susceptibility in a Mexican Hispanic population. Forty patients were compared with ancestry-matched controls using gene-based and single-variant analyses. Three novel variants (in ARFGAP1, SLCO4A1 and MC4R) were significant and directionally consistent in an independent cohort of 211 patients, with PAGE controls. None reached exome-wide significance. All three showed preliminary associations with mortality. The findings are exploratory signals that highlight the need for more inclusive genomic research in underrepresented populations.

pmid-42022700.summary_ja: 上大静脈症候群と多房性の心腔内腫瘍進展を伴う縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の21歳男性の症例報告である。経食道心エコーで心房と心室の可動性腫瘤を認め、脳梗塞を合併した。VIP化学療法により心腔内腫瘤は完全に消失した。切除不能な心腔内腫瘍に対する化学療法先行の有効性を示している。
pmid-42022700.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man with a primary mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor causing superior vena cava obstruction and massive multi-chamber intracardiac extension. He presented with chest pain and ST elevation, and transesophageal echocardiography showed mobile masses in the right atrium, right ventricle, and left atrium. He developed embolic cerebral infarcts and pericardial effusion progressing toward tamponade. Emergent pericardiocentesis, anticoagulation, and VIP chemotherapy led to complete resolution of the intracardiac masses. The authors highlight echocardiography's role in intracardiac tumor diagnosis and the efficacy of a chemotherapy-first approach for inoperable intracardiac tumor burden.

pmid-42022726.summary_ja: 異所性妊娠に対するメトトレキサート治療後1年で発症した33歳女性の症例である。β-hCGは36,477IU/Lと高値で、子宮腫瘤と肺結節を認めた。FIGO病期III、WHOスコア9の高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と分類された。子宮全摘術で転移性上皮型栄養膜腫瘍と確定し、EMA-EP療法でβ-hCGは著明に低下した。診断の難しさと化学療法抵抗性に注意を促している。
pmid-42022726.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with prior methotrexate treatment for suspected ectopic pregnancy who presented a year later with abnormal uterine bleeding and β-hCG of 36,477 IU/L. Imaging showed a uterine mass and pulmonary nodules. She was classified as FIGO stage III with WHO score 9. Hysterectomy confirmed metastatic epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, and EMA-EP chemotherapy led to a marked decline in β-hCG. The case highlights diagnostic challenges, chemoresistance, and the importance of early histopathologic confirmation.

pmid-42027729.summary_ja: 出生前に右腎腫瘤を指摘された生後3か月男児の原発性腎奇形腫の症例です。造影CTで脂肪成分を含む境界明瞭な病変を認め、腎温存手術で完全摘出されました。病理は成熟奇形腫で、1年後も再発はありません。
pmid-42027729.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-month-old boy with a right renal mass detected prenatally. Postnatal contrast-enhanced CT showed a well-circumscribed fat-containing lesion at the upper pole of the kidney. Open nephron-sparing surgery achieved complete enucleation with negative margins. Histopathology confirmed a mature teratoma. At one-year follow-up the child showed normal renal development and no recurrence. The authors note that primary renal teratomas are extremely rare germ cell tumors that can be difficult to distinguish from other fat-containing renal masses in infants by imaging alone.

pmid-42027732.summary_ja: 無痛性の陰嚢腫脹で受診した51歳男性の、精巣腫瘍の自然破裂例の症例報告です。緊急手術で穿孔が確認され、卵黄嚢腫瘍優勢の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断されました。初回の病期分類は陰性でしたが、補助療法前の再病期分類で肺転移が見つかりました。BEP化学療法3コースで完全寛解し、2年時点で無再発です。
pmid-42027732.summary_en: This report describes a 51-year-old man with spontaneous rupture of a left testicular tumor presenting as painless scrotal swelling. Emergency exploration confirmed perforation, and histology showed a yolk sac-predominant non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Although initial staging was negative, early restaging before adjuvant therapy identified a new pulmonary metastasis. He received three cycles of BEP chemotherapy, achieved complete remission and remained disease-free at two-year follow-up. The authors emphasize prompt evaluation and early restaging in atypical acute scrotal presentations.

pmid-42029172.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫内に微小な腎芽腫成分を伴う新生児症例の報告と、同様に腎組織を有する新生児19例の文献レビュー。腎組織の79%は未熟または異所性の後腎性組織、21%はWilms腫瘍様であった。全例が外科的切除を受け、癌関連死亡は認めなかった。
pmid-42029172.summary_en: This report presents a neonatal sacrococcygeal teratoma containing a minor nephroblastomatous component and reviews newborns with renal tissue in such teratomas. A systematic search identified 16 studies, and with the present case, 19 newborns were analyzed. Renal tissue was immature or ectopic nephrogenic in 79% and overtly Wilms tumor-like in 21%. All underwent surgical resection, with chemotherapy in 26.3% and radiotherapy in 10.5%. Median follow-up was 29.5 months, with no cancer-related deaths, supporting a cautious multidisciplinary approach.

pmid-42029599.summary_ja: 抗Ma2抗体陽性の傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎を伴う精巣腫瘍の21歳男性の症例です。4年後に中枢性尿崩症が判明しました。系統的レビューでは38例中16例（42%）に視床下部・間脳病変が認められ、長期の内分泌フォローアップの必要性が示されています。
pmid-42029599.summary_en: This report presents a 21-year-old man with anti-Ma2 paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis and right testicular intratubular germ cell neoplasia, treated with orchifunicolectomy and immunosuppression. Four years later he developed seizures, decreased libido and polyuria-polydipsia, with water deprivation testing and copeptin supporting partial central diabetes insipidus. A PRISMA-based systematic review identified 11 studies with 38 anti-Ma2-positive patients with testicular cancer. Hypothalamic or diencephalic involvement occurred in 42%, and endocrine manifestations were rarely detailed. Long-term endocrine surveillance is recommended.

pmid-42032650.summary_ja: 慢性乾性咳嗽と黄色の毛髪様物の喀出(トリコプチシス)を呈した45歳女性の前縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例報告。造影CTでは膿瘍との鑑別が難しく、左後側方開胸で左上葉の一部を含めて一括切除した。病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と確定した。気道交通を示唆する重要な所見と述べている。
pmid-42032650.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old woman with chronic dry cough who expectorated yellowish hair-like strands, a rare presentation termed trichoptysis. Contrast-enhanced CT showed a left superior mediastinal mass with peripheral enhancement and inflammatory stranding that initially suggested abscess. Left posterolateral thoracotomy achieved en bloc excision with wedge resection of the adherent left upper lobe. Histopathology confirmed a mature mediastinal teratoma. The authors emphasize that trichoptysis strongly suggests teratoma with airway communication, that imaging can mimic infection, and that complete resection gives excellent outcomes.

pmid-42033925.summary_ja: 若年女性3例の卵巣奇形腫が原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍（PNET）へ悪性転化した症例です。免疫染色とFISH所見から中枢型PNETと診断され、1例でLDB1変異が認められました。文献54例の検討では卵黄嚢腫瘍成分の併存が再発リスクと関連する可能性が示唆されました。
pmid-42033925.summary_en: This report describes three young women with ovarian teratomas that malignantly transformed into primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET). Small round blue cells formed nests and trabeculae adjacent to mature or immature teratoma components. Immunohistochemistry showed neuroendocrine marker positivity, and FISH showed no EWSR1 rearrangement, supporting central-type PNET. LDB1 alteration was found in one case. Literature review of 54 cases from 21 publications suggested that yolk sac tumor components may be associated with a higher risk of recurrence. The authors emphasize comprehensive pathologic and molecular evaluation.

pmid-42034155.summary_ja: 巨大な卵巣成熟奇形腫の捻転に伴い、270〜360°の子宮捻転と高度の虚血を生じた21か月女児の症例報告です。右付属器切除後、子宮は捻転解除後に直ちに肉眼的な回復が見られなかったものの、保存的に管理されました。5.5年の経過観察で子宮の形態と血流は正常で、無症状でした。可能な限り子宮の保存的管理を検討すべきと提言しています。
pmid-42034155.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-month-old girl presenting with acute abdominal pain due to torsion of a large ovarian mature teratoma, complicated by a 270° to 360° uterine torsion with severe ischemia. After right salpingo-oophorectomy, the uterus was managed conservatively despite lacking immediate macroscopic recovery after detorsion. Mid-term follow-up of 5.5 years showed normal uterine morphology and vascularization with no symptoms. The authors suggest that conservative uterine management should be considered whenever possible, with long-term follow-up essential.

pmid-42034485.summary_ja: SEERデータベースの3万4,738例を解析し、年齢群別に精巣胚細胞腫瘍の特徴と予後を比較した。高齢者ではセミノーマと病期Iが多かった。病期Iでは治療選択に年齢差はなかった。病期IIIでは高齢者の癌特異的生存率が有意に低く、年齢に応じた治療戦略の検討が必要と結論している。
pmid-42034485.summary_en: This SEER-based analysis compared testicular germ cell tumors in 34,738 men aged 15-70 treated with orchiectomy between 2004 and 2021, stratified into younger (15-44) and older (45-70) groups. Older men more often had seminoma and stage I disease. Among stage I patients, histology-specific management did not differ by age. Five-year cancer-specific survival exceeded 96% for stage I and II regardless of age. For stage III, older age was associated with significantly worse survival for both seminoma and non-seminoma. The authors suggest age-specific management strategies.

pmid-42036502.summary_ja: 出生時から進行性の右眼球突出を呈した14か月男児の症例報告。視神経を圧迫する大型の充実・嚢胞性の眼窩後部病変を認め、前頭眼窩開頭術で全摘出した。病理組織学的に成熟眼窩奇形腫と確定し、文献的考察を加えた。
pmid-42036502.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-month-old boy with progressive right proptosis since birth, caused by a large mixed solid-cystic retro-orbital lesion compressing the optic nerve.
