Gross total excision was achieved through a fronto-orbital craniotomy, and histopathology confirmed a mature orbital teratoma. Recovery was uneventful. The authors review the presentation, imaging, histopathology, and management of congenital orbital teratomas, which are rare germ cell tumors presenting with rapid unilateral proptosis.

pmid-42037835.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の掻爬術後1か月に持続性出血と呼吸困難を呈した24歳女性の絨毛癌症例報告である。β-hCGは250,000 mIU/mLを超え、肝、消化管、肺に転移を認めた。多剤化学療法によりβ-hCGは正常化した。奇胎後のフォローアップの重要性を示している。
pmid-42037835.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman who developed persistent vaginal bleeding, pelvic pain, and dyspnea one month after a molar pregnancy treated by dilation and curettage. She had pallor, serum beta-hCG above 250,000 mIU/mL, and hemoglobin of 2 g/dL. CT showed hepatic and gastrointestinal metastases and multiple pulmonary nodules. Multi-agent chemotherapy was started and normalized beta-hCG after several cycles. The authors highlight the importance of vigilant follow-up after molar pregnancy when beta-hCG remains elevated, because timely diagnosis and treatment can achieve cure despite widespread metastasis.

pmid-42038208.summary_ja: 出生前に腹腔内腫瘤を指摘された新生児の、腹腔内停留精巣由来の成熟奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビュー。360度の捻転と結腸圧迫を伴い、完全切除で良好に回復した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は日齢とともに生理的に低下した。新生児の腹腔内腫瘤では精巣位置の評価を行うべきと提言している。
pmid-42038208.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes a full-term neonate with a prenatally detected intra-abdominal mass arising from a cryptorchid testis, complicated by 360-degree torsion and colonic compression. Complete resection led to an uneventful recovery, with serum AFP declining physiologically with age and no recurrence at one month. A systematic review identified ten cases of prenatally detected tumors with progressive growth, mostly mature teratomas, with torsion in 20% and no recurrences reported. The authors recommend evaluating testicular position in neonates with intra-abdominal masses.

pmid-42038264.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫の散発例26例の末梢血を対象に全エクソーム解析を行い、生殖系列の一塩基多型とコピー数変異を探索した研究である。24の共通変異遺伝子が同定され、MUC関連遺伝子群が相互作用ネットワークの中心であった。MUC2が薬剤標的の候補として予測された。結果は探索的であり、病因解明やバイオマーカー・薬剤標的としての検証が必要である。
pmid-42038264.summary_en: This study performed whole exome sequencing on peripheral blood from 26 sporadic patients with immature teratoma to identify germline single nucleotide polymorphisms and copy number variations. Twenty-four commonly mutated genes were found, including frameshift variants in MYPOP and FRG2C and nonsynonymous variants in CNTNAP3, GPRIN2, and MUC3A. Protein-protein interaction and pharmacogenomic analyses highlighted MUC family genes and predicted MUC2 as a potential drug target. Mutation and amplification patterns were also examined in ovarian cancer databases. The authors propose these variants may contribute to immature teratoma pathogenesis, although the results are exploratory.

pmid-42038583.summary_ja: 2006〜2019年に頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍と診断された0〜15歳の543例を解析。根治的治療を完遂した症例の5年全生存期間(全生存率)は83%で、性腺原発は性腺外より予後が良好であった。頭頸部、縦隔、絨毛癌組織型は予後不良であった。
pmid-42038583.summary_en: This study analyzed 543 children aged 0-15 years diagnosed with extracranial germ cell tumors at a single institution between 2006 and 2019. Incidence peaked at age 1 year in both sexes, with a second peak at age 14 years in girls and overall female predominance. The 5-year overall survival among patients completing curative treatment was 83%. Gonadal tumors had better survival than extragonadal tumors (87.6% vs. 75.6%), while head and neck, mediastinal, and choriocarcinoma histologies had poorer survival.

pmid-42040380.summary_ja: 10歳女児の巨大縦隔奇形腫の症例である。約15×14cmの嚢胞性縦隔腫瘤により縦隔偏位と肺虚脱を生じていた。2年間の労作時呼吸困難と胸痛が主訴で、検査値は正常範囲であった。外科的切除により成熟縦隔奇形腫と確定し、術後は肺の完全な再膨張と残存病変のないことが確認された。小児での報告が少ないため、臨床・画像所見の特徴を提示している。
pmid-42040380.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old girl with a giant, predominantly cystic mediastinal mass measuring about 15 × 14 cm, causing mediastinal shift and lung collapse. She presented with two years of progressive exertional dyspnea and chest pain, while routine laboratory tests were normal. Surgical resection confirmed a mature mediastinal teratoma. Postoperative recovery was uneventful, and follow-up CT showed full pulmonary re-expansion without residual lesion. The authors highlight clinical and imaging features that should prompt suspicion of giant mediastinal teratoma in children, given the limited pediatric literature.

pmid-42043194.summary_ja: 18歳女性の抗NMDAR脳炎症例で、卵巣成熟奇形腫の切除と免疫療法により改善した。切除奇形腫の神経グリア組織からパルボウイルスB19 DNAが検出されたが、全身性ウイルス血症や活動性感染は認められなかった。PCR陽性は活動性感染を意味せず、所見は仮説創出的であると著者らは述べている。
pmid-42043194.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with an ovarian mature teratoma. Tumor resection was performed alongside immunotherapy, leading to clinical improvement. Molecular analysis detected parvovirus B19 DNA within the teratomatous neuroglial tissue, without systemic viremia or active central nervous system infection. The authors emphasize that PCR positivity does not indicate active infection, and the finding is hypothesis-generating. Immunotherapy and tumor resection remain the established management priorities.

pmid-42047768.summary_ja: 抗糖尿病薬メトホルミンが絨毛癌の増殖と転移を抑制しうることを示す知見をまとめた総説です。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍は早期に全身転移しやすく、化学療法抵抗性の症例もあるため、新たな治療法が求められていると述べています。AMPK/mTOR経路を中心に、妊娠性絨毛癌におけるメトホルミンの分子機序の最近の知見を概説しています。
pmid-42047768.summary_en: This narrative review summarizes evidence that metformin, an antidiabetic drug with antiproliferative activity, can reduce proliferation and metastasis of choriocarcinoma. It describes the biology of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, including its early systemic spread and chemoresistant disease in some patients, and the need for new regimens with fewer toxicities. The authors briefly summarize recent advances in the molecular mechanisms of metformin in gestational choriocarcinoma, focusing on the AMPK/mTOR pathway, while noting that these mechanisms are not yet fully elucidated.

pmid-42048012.summary_ja: 化学療法後に3cmを超える後腹膜残存腫瘤を有する病期IIC セミノーマ5例(初発3例、再発2例)の後方視的症例集積。IMRTによる放射線療法を施行し、中央値30か月の経過観察で再発や二次性悪性腫瘍は認めなかった。RPLNDの合併症が懸念される症例では、非侵襲的な選択肢となりうる。
pmid-42048012.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective case series describes five patients with stage IIC seminoma (three de novo, two relapsed) who received radiotherapy for retroperitoneal residual masses after BEP chemotherapy. Median residual size was 6.5 cm, and all had PET-CT SUVmax above 3. Patients received paraaortic or combined paraaortic and ipsilateral pelvic irradiation using IMRT, with a total dose of 25.5 Gy and a 10 Gy boost to residual masses. At a median follow-up of 30 months, no recurrence or secondary malignancy occurred. The authors suggest radiotherapy may be a non-invasive option when RPLND morbidity is anticipated.

pmid-42048675.summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、AYA精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者1,870例の死因を対照と比較。死亡の52％は原発腫瘍によるもので、病期IIIでは二次がん死亡が顕著であった。長期生存者では非がん死が多くなる。生存者ケアには行動医学的支援と二次がんの監視が必要である。
pmid-42048675.summary_en: This population-based SEER analysis evaluated cause-specific mortality among adolescent and young adult (AYA) testicular GCT survivors compared with matched controls. Of 1,870 deaths, 52% were from primary GCT, 15% from nontestis cancers, and 32% from noncancer causes. Secondary cancer mortality was markedly elevated in stage III, while stage I patients more often died from accidents, suicide, or homicide. Noncancer mortality predominated after 10 years. The authors recommend behavioral health support, comprehensive health monitoring, and secondary cancer surveillance in survivorship care.

pmid-42049597.summary_ja: 欧州泌尿器科学会(EAU)が2026年に改訂した精巣がんガイドラインの要約です。泌尿器科医、腫瘍内科医、放射線腫瘍医、病理医からなる多職種チームが2023年以降の文献を評価しました。病期、組織型、予後分類ごとに診断、初期治療、再発の検出と治療、生存者ケアの推奨を示しています。前版からの主な変更点と、合意が弱い領域も明示されています。
pmid-42049597.summary_en: This article summarizes the 2026 European Association of Urology guidelines on testicular cancer, prepared by a multidisciplinary panel of urologists, medical and radiation oncologists, and pathologists after a literature review since 2023. Recommendations are presented across stages, histologies and prognostic categories for diagnosis, primary management, relapse detection and treatment, and survivorship care. Areas lacking strong consensus are highlighted, and the main changes from the previous version are described.

pmid-42052480.summary_ja: 頸管から発生した、稀な孤発性の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍である原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告である。症状が非特異的なため、見逃されたり誤診されやすい。1例の臨床経過と治療過程を解析し、診断と治療の改善、予後向上を目指している。本疾患に対する臨床医の認識向上の必要性も示している。
pmid-42052480.summary_en: This case report describes primary cervical choriocarcinoma, a rare sporadic gestational trophoblastic tumour arising from the cervical canal rather than the uterine body. Its nonspecific clinical manifestations often lead to missed or incorrect diagnosis. By analyzing the clinical features and treatment course of one patient, the authors aim to improve diagnosis, management, and prognosis of this disease, while highlighting the need for greater awareness among clinicians.

pmid-42058518.summary_ja: サウジアラビアの転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の症例報告で、通常の不正性器出血ではなく肺動静脈奇形を初発症状として呈した。局所的なヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生が血管変化を来す可能性を論じている。肺転移に典型的な症状とは異なる、GTNの稀な初発徴候を示した点が特徴である。
pmid-42058518.summary_en: This case report from Saudi Arabia describes metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia that first presented with pulmonary arteriovenous malformations rather than the usual abnormal vaginal bleeding. The authors review GTN subtypes, including invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor, and explain that localized hCG production may cause vascular changes such as AVM formation. They note that pulmonary AVMs are not typically considered a direct consequence of metastatic spread. The case highlights an unusual initial manifestation of GTN.

pmid-42061117.summary_ja: 2019〜2025年に単一施設で診断された、卵黄嚢腫瘍分化を伴う女性生殖管の体細胞型癌4例の解析と文献的考察。全例で体細胞型癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分の二相性分化を認め、SALL4とGPC3が陽性、p53は異常発現を示した。進行期の2例は術後7か月以内に死亡した。
pmid-42061117.summary_en: This study analyzed four female genital tract carcinomas with yolk sac tumor (YST) differentiation diagnosed at a single center from 2019 to 2025, with a literature comparison to three larger series. Primary sites were the cervix, endometrium, and ovary. All tumors showed biphasic differentiation with somatic carcinoma and YST components, with SALL4 and glypican-3 positivity and aberrant p53 expression. NGS identified TP53 mutations and RICTOR amplification in one case. Two patients with stage III-IV disease died within 7 months.

pmid-42061606.summary_ja: PRISMA 2020に従い、21の観察研究(新生児・乳児1,399例)を統合した仙尾部奇形腫の外科的切除後の成績に関するシステマティックレビュー・メタ解析です。死亡率は5%、再発は9%でした。創部合併症、排尿障害、排便障害も評価されています。生存成績は良好である一方、合併症と再発のリスクが少なくないため、慎重な手術手技と長期フォローアップの必要性が示されました。
pmid-42061606.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 21 studies (1,399 neonates and infants) evaluates outcomes of surgical resection for sacrococcygeal teratoma, following PRISMA 2020. The pooled overall mortality was 5% and tumor recurrence 9%, with low heterogeneity for mortality. Wound complications (23%), urinary dysfunction (15%) and bowel dysfunction (21%) showed substantial heterogeneity. The authors conclude that survival is favorable but morbidity and recurrence risk are considerable, underscoring meticulous technique, routine coccygectomy, and prolonged multidisciplinary follow-up.

pmid-42063474.summary_ja: 中絶後に長期の不正性器出血を呈した38歳女性の症例である。超音波とMRIで子宮内膜腔の境界明瞭な病変を認め、脂肪や石灰化を欠いていた。このため粘膜下筋腫と誤診され子宮鏡下切除が行われた。病理組織学的検査で子宮成熟奇形腫と確定した。典型的な脂肪・石灰化の欠如が診断の落とし穴となり得ることを指摘している。
pmid-42063474.summary_en: This radiology case report describes a 38-year-old woman with prolonged abnormal vaginal bleeding after an abortion. Ultrasound and MRI showed a well-defined endometrial cavity lesion with enhancement similar to myometrium, lacking macroscopic fat, fat suppression, or calcification, which are typically expected in uterine teratoma. Preoperatively it was misdiagnosed as submucosal myoma, and hysteroscopic resection was performed. Histopathology confirmed mature uterine teratoma. The authors caution that absent fat or calcification can lead to diagnostic pitfalls.

pmid-42064772.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化(TM)と精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)のリスクの関連について、PRISMA-ScRに従った文献のスコーピングレビュー。孤立性TMのリスクは小さいが、停留精巣や家族歴を伴うとリスクが上昇する。共同意思決定の中で定期的な超音波検査を行うリスク層別化の枠組みを提案している。
pmid-42064772.summary_en: This PRISMA-ScR scoping review synthesizes evidence on testicular microlithiasis (TM) and its link to testicular germ cell tumor risk in infertile men. TM and TGCT share molecular pathways within testicular dysgenesis syndrome. Isolated TM carries minimal risk, whereas coexisting cryptorchidism, infertility, or family history raises it significantly. The authors propose an intermediate-risk framework for periodic ultrasound within shared decision-making. Routine biomarker testing is not supported, and routine imaging surveillance for isolated TM is not recommended.

pmid-42067483.summary_ja: 米国退役軍人保健制度の1,774例の精巣がん生存者と対照群を比較した後方視的コホート研究である。10年時点のアルコール使用障害の累積発生率は、生存者で21.6%、対照群で1.5%であった。化学療法は独立した危険因子ではなく、社会人口学的要因が関連した。
pmid-42067483.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study used the US Veterans Affairs national database to compare 1,774 testicular cancer survivors with 3,224 matched cancer-free controls from 1990 to 2021. At 10 years, cumulative alcohol use disorder (AUD) incidence was 21.6% in survivors versus 1.5% in controls (HR 13.8). Chemotherapy was not independently associated with AUD. Unemployment, Black race, and not smoking (protective) were associated with risk. The authors conclude that AUD risk in survivors is driven mainly by sociodemographic factors rather than treatment exposure, and recommend targeted screening and survivorship interventions.

pmid-42067849.summary_ja: 右卵巣の大きな未熟奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の33歳女性の症例報告です。頭部MRIと脳脊髄液所見は初期には正常でしたが、後に髄液中で抗NMDAR抗体が検出されました。ステロイド、血漿交換、リツキシマブ、右付属器切除により神経症状は完全回復し、6か月で発作はありませんでした。画像や髄液が正常でも本症を疑い、早期の腫瘍切除を行うことの重要性を指摘しています。
pmid-42067849.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with a large right ovarian immature teratoma, who presented with headache, fever, mood disturbance, seizures and cognitive impairment. Initial brain MRI, CSF and EEG findings were nonspecific, and anti-NMDAR antibodies were later detected in CSF. Treatment with corticosteroids, plasmapheresis, rituximab and salpingo-oophorectomy led to complete neurological recovery and seizure freedom at six months. The authors highlight the diagnostic challenge when imaging and CSF are normal and the importance of early tumor removal.

pmid-42067996.summary_ja: 13歳女児の後腹膜胎児性癌の症例報告。穿刺吸引細胞診で印環細胞様細胞がみられ、診断を誤らせる可能性があった。細胞質内の粘液空胞は他の悪性腫瘍とも紛らわしく、印環細胞分化を伴う胎児性癌の細胞像と組織像の対応を示した。
pmid-42067996.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with retroperitoneal embryonal carcinoma whose fine-needle aspiration cytology showed misleading signet-ring-like cells. The authors discuss how mucin-filled cytoplasmic vacuoles, scant cellularity, and scattered cells can mimic other benign or malignant signet-ring cell neoplasms. They present this rare embryonal carcinoma with signet-ring differentiation and its cytohistological correlation, highlighting a diagnostic pitfall in cytology.

pmid-42073127.summary_ja: 2010〜2020年に手術された6〜18歳の卵巣・付属器腫瘤77例の後方視的研究。84.4%は非悪性で、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が最多(39.0%)だった。境界悪性・悪性の12例中11例で卵巣温存手術が可能で、AFP高値は悪性胚細胞腫瘍と相関した。
pmid-42073127.summary_en: This retrospective study of 77 children and adolescents aged 6-18 years describes surgically managed ovarian and adnexal masses treated between 2010 and 2020. Most (84.4%) were non-malignant, with mature cystic teratoma the most common (39.0%). Twelve patients had borderline or malignant tumors, and ovary-sparing surgery was achieved in 11 of them. Elevated AFP correlated with malignant germ cell tumors, and O-RADS combined with tumor markers aided risk stratification. After a median 4.2-year follow-up, 11 were alive without disease.

pmid-42078164.summary_ja: 疼痛を伴う右陰嚢腫大を呈した32歳男性の巨大精巣セミノーマ症例報告である。病理学的に15.8cmの純粋セミノーマで、精索浸潤を認めた（pT3）。術後に腫瘍マーカーは低下し、BEP療法が開始された。疼痛は悪性を否定しないことを強調している。
pmid-42078164.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a one-month history of painful, progressively enlarging right scrotal swelling, initially misread on ultrasound abroad. Examination showed marked scrotal enlargement and erythema. CT revealed a large right testicular mass with retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy but no distant metastases. Serum beta-hCG and LDH were elevated, while AFP was normal. Urgent radical inguinal orchidectomy showed a pure seminoma measuring 15.8 cm with lymphovascular invasion and spermatic cord involvement (pT3). Markers declined after surgery, and BEP chemotherapy was started. The authors stress that painful scrotal swelling does not exclude malignancy and emphasize early recognition.

pmid-42078602.summary_ja: 精神疾患と誤診された21歳女性の抗NMDAR脳炎症例。髄液で抗NMDAR抗体が陽性、骨盤部MRIで左卵巣奇形腫が見つかり切除された。免疫療法と腫瘍切除、ステロイド療法で完全回復した。原因不明の精神病や痙攣を呈する若年女性では、婦人科的評価が重要とされる。
pmid-42078602.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman in Pakistan with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis initially misdiagnosed as a primary psychiatric illness. CSF analysis confirmed anti-NMDAR antibodies, and brain MRI showed left temporal hyperintensities. Partial improvement followed initial immunotherapy. Pelvic MRI then detected a left ovarian teratoma, which was surgically excised. Combined with continued corticosteroids, this led to full neurological and psychiatric recovery. The authors emphasize gynecologic evaluation in young women with unexplained psychosis or seizures, even without pelvic symptoms.

pmid-42078612.summary_ja: 甲状腺全摘後のI-131シンチグラフィで予期せぬ骨盤部集積を認め、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された26歳女性の症例報告。腹腔鏡下嚢胞摘出術を施行した。甲状腺外の骨盤部放射性ヨード集積の鑑別に卵巣甲状腺腫を含める重要性を強調した。
pmid-42078612.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with papillary thyroid carcinoma, normocalcemic primary hyperparathyroidism due to a parathyroid adenoma, and incidental struma ovarii within a mature cystic teratoma. Unexpected pelvic radioiodine uptake on post-thyroidectomy I-131 scintigraphy led to identification of the ovarian lesion, which was resected laparoscopically. The authors stress that struma ovarii should be included in the differential diagnosis of extrathyroidal pelvic radioiodine uptake to avoid inappropriate treatment escalation.

pmid-42088104.summary_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫の切除後5年に両側精巣腫瘍を発症した30歳男性の症例報告である。左精巣はセミノーマ、右精巣は奇形腫成分を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍後の両側精巣腫瘍の初報告であり、長期フォローアップの重要性を述べている。
pmid-42088104.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man who underwent resection of a retroperitoneal teratoma. A cystic right testicular lesion without malignant features was placed under surveillance. Five years later, he presented with left testicular discomfort, and imaging showed bilateral testicular tumors with elevated serum hCG (11.9 mIU/mL). Bilateral radical orchiectomy revealed pure seminoma in the left testis and mixed germ cell tumor with seminoma and teratoma components in the right. The authors report this as the first case of bilateral testicular tumors after extragonadal germ cell tumor treatment and recommend long-term follow-up with consideration of testicular germ cell neoplasia in situ.

pmid-42090637.summary_ja: 1971年から2018年に英国とイタリアの施設で手術と化学療法を受けた悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍254例の国際多施設研究です。10年無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は82.8%でした。35歳以上、病期III/IV、非ディスジャーミノーマ組織型が不良な予後因子でした。大量化学療法は初回再発で生存を改善しましたが、後の再発では改善しませんでした。
pmid-42090637.summary_en: This international multicenter study analyzed 254 patients with stage IC to IV malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with surgery and chemotherapy from 1971 to 2018 at UK and Italian centers. Ten-year progression-free survival was 82.8% and cancer-specific survival 83.2%. On multivariable analysis, age 35 years or older, stage III/IV disease, and nondysgerminoma histology were associated with worse cancer-specific survival, while grade 2/3 immature teratoma behaved like dysgerminoma. High-dose chemotherapy improved survival at first relapse but not at later relapses. Stage IV disease achieved about 80% long-term survival.

pmid-42090882.summary_ja: National Cancer Databaseを用い、2018〜2022年に診断された病期T1の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍740例を解析。47.3%でリンパ節郭清が行われたが近年は減少していた。傾向スコアで補正すると、リンパ節郭清は生存の改善とは関連せず、補助化学療法の施行率は高かった。
pmid-42090882.summary_en: Using the National Cancer Database, this study analyzed 740 women with stage T1 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors diagnosed in 2018-2022. Lymphadenectomy was performed in 47.3%, with use declining over time, and was more likely with dysgerminoma histology and larger tumors. Nodal metastases occurred in 6.6%. After propensity-weighted analysis, lymphadenectomy was not associated with improved survival but was linked to higher adjuvant chemotherapy use. The authors suggest that selective lymphadenectomy may be appropriate.

pmid-42093929.summary_ja: 小児卵巣奇形腫82例の後方視的研究で、成熟45例と未熟37例のKi-67、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)を比較した。未熟例ではいずれも有意に高値だった。3因子の併用モデルはAUC 0.96を示し、Ki-67 30%超は無再発生存の短縮とも独立して関連した。
pmid-42093929.summary_en: This retrospective study of 82 children with ovarian teratomas compared Ki-67, AFP, and LDH between 45 mature and 37 immature cases. All three markers were significantly higher in immature tumors. In multivariate analysis, Ki-67 above 30%, AFP above 500 ng/mL, and LDH above 300 U/L independently predicted immaturity, and the combined model achieved an AUC of 0.96. High Ki-67 was independently associated with shorter recurrence-free survival, and all eight recurrences occurred in immature teratomas.

pmid-42094196.summary_ja: 19歳女性の右大腿後部皮下腫瘤を未熟奇形腫と診断した症例報告である。全エクソーム解析でBLMおよびMSH6の病的生殖細胞系列変異が同定された。性腺外に生じた稀な悪性奇形腫の経過、治療方針および予後を記載している。
pmid-42094196.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with a subcutaneous mass in the right posterior thigh, diagnosed as immature teratoma with undifferentiated embryonic components and high Ki-67 expression. Whole exome sequencing identified two pathogenic germline variants, BLM and MSH6. The report details the clinical course, treatment strategy, and prognosis of this exceptionally rare extragonadal malignant teratoma. Because such a location is extremely unusual and the literature is limited, the authors aim to provide reference information for clinicians managing similar cases.

pmid-42099065.summary_ja: 70歳男性の腎門部（後腹膜）成熟奇形腫の症例です。分化型神経内分泌腫瘍を伴い、遠位尿管に高異型度の上部尿路尿路上皮癌が併存していました。病理学的検査で奇形腫、神経内分泌成分、尿路上皮癌はそれぞれ区別されました。腎門部に奇形腫と神経内分泌腫瘍、尿路上皮癌が併存した初の報告とされ、成人の腎門部腫瘤の鑑別に奇形腫を含めるべきと述べています。
pmid-42099065.summary_en: This case report describes a 70-year-old man with a renal hilar mature teratoma containing a well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor, coexisting with high-grade upper urinary tract urothelial carcinoma in the distal ureter. Imaging showed distinct lesions in the renal hilum and distal ureter. Histopathology confirmed the teratoma with a separate neuroendocrine component and urothelial carcinoma. The authors describe this as the first documented renal hilar mature teratoma harboring a well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor alongside urothelial carcinoma, and recommend including teratoma in the differential diagnosis of incidental renal hilar masses in adults.

pmid-42099371.summary_ja: 28歳女性の右卵巣に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と良性粘液性嚢胞腺腫が併存した衝突腫瘍の症例報告である。腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。病理学的に両成分が混在せずに存在することを確認し、正確な診断と個別化された治療の重要性を述べている。
pmid-42099371.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old premenopausal woman with an ovarian collision tumor consisting of a mature cystic teratoma and a benign mucinous cystadenoma in the right ovary. Pelvic ultrasound showed a 7 by 6 by 5 cm cyst, and the tumor marker was normal. Macroscopic examination revealed a dermoid cyst with hemorrhagic areas, and histopathology confirmed both components without intermixing. The authors define collision tumors as two histologically and pathogenetically distinct neoplasms coexisting in the same organ. They emphasize that recognizing such tumors is important for accurate diagnosis and for tailoring treatment to each component's biological behavior.

pmid-42099840.summary_ja: 前向き第II相研究4編(216例)のシステマティックレビューとメタ解析。2年無再発生存は85%で、射精機能は92.8%で温存されていた。重篤合併症は9.6%であった。安全で有望だが、無作為化比較試験による検証が必要と結論。
pmid-42099840.summary_en: This living systematic review and meta-analysis pooled four prospective phase II studies including 216 patients with stage IIA/IIB seminoma treated with primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, registered in PROSPERO. The pooled 2-year relapse-free survival was 85%. In-field recurrence occurred in 5.5% and out-of-field recurrence in 10.1%. Antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 92.8%, and major complications (Clavien-Dindo IIIA or higher) occurred in 9.6%. Risk of bias was low to moderate by the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. The authors conclude that primary RPLND is feasible and safe in carefully selected patients, but randomized comparisons with conventional therapy and longer follow-up are required.

pmid-42103533.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(MOGCT)48例の手術標本で、腹水・腹膜液細胞診をTIS基準に従って評価した。19%(9例)に転移を疑う、または転移と確定する所見があり、3例は癌腫と誤診されていた。SALL4免疫染色は診断の確認に有用で、陽性の細胞所見は進行期や大網浸潤と相関した。
pmid-42103533.summary_en: This study of 48 surgically resected malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (MOGCTs) evaluated peritoneal fluid cytology using TIS reporting criteria. Nine cases (19%) showed features suspicious or definitive for intraperitoneal metastasis, and three had been misdiagnosed as carcinomas. SALL4 immunohistochemistry on cell blocks upgraded one case and helped confirm germ cell origin. Positive cytology correlated with intra-abdominal spread, omental involvement, and advanced pathological stage.

pmid-42110050.summary_ja: 原発性無月経の41歳表現型女性（CAIS）。骨盤内腫瘤と後腹膜リンパ節腫大を認め、生検でディスジャーミノーマと診断された。術前BEP化学療法と減量手術後、腹腔内精巣は完全病理学的奏効を示した。核型は46,XYで、CAISと一致した。
pmid-42110050.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old phenotypic female with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (CAIS) and primary amenorrhea who presented with a pelvic mass and retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. Biopsy showed dysgerminoma with elevated β-hCG and LDH. After neoadjuvant BEP chemotherapy and cytoreductive surgery, the intra-abdominal testes showed a complete pathological response. Karyotyping confirmed a 46,XY pattern consistent with CAIS. The authors highlight the rare malignant transformation of intra-abdominal testicular tissue in a phenotypic female.

pmid-42111890.summary_ja: 3歳児で右Wilms腫瘍に対側の後腹膜腫瘤を伴った症例です。転移か別原発かの鑑別が問題となりました。術前化学療法で腎腫瘍は縮小しましたが後腹膜腫瘤は不変でした。手術で右側は高リスクWilms腫瘍、対側は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定しました。同時発生は極めて稀であり、早期診断と多職種による治療計画の重要性を報告しています。
pmid-42111890.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-year-old child with right-sided Wilms tumor and a contralateral retroperitoneal mass, initially raising concern for metastasis versus a second primary tumor. Preoperative chemotherapy shrank the renal tumor but not the retroperitoneal mass. Surgery confirmed high-risk Wilms tumor on the right and a mature cystic teratoma on the contralateral side. The authors highlight diagnostic challenges in concurrent tumors and the importance of early recognition, multidisciplinary planning, and tailored therapy. Simultaneous Wilms tumor and retroperitoneal teratoma is exceptionally rare.

pmid-42116351.summary_ja: 急性虫垂炎として受診した14歳女児の盲腸類皮嚢腫の症例と、既報の盲腸類皮嚢腫を網羅したシステマティックレビューです。術中に悪性を除外できず腫瘍学的右半結腸切除を行い、病理組織学的検査で良性類皮嚢腫でした。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫である盲腸類皮嚢腫は極めてまれで、虫垂炎や卵巣腫瘤を模倣することがあります。
pmid-42116351.summary_en: This report combines a case of a 14-year-old girl with cecal dermoid cyst presenting as acute appendicitis with a systematic review of published cecal dermoid cases. Because malignancy could not be excluded intraoperatively, the patient underwent diagnostic laparoscopy followed by oncologic right hemicolectomy. Histopathology showed a benign dermoid cyst with acute suppurative appendicitis, and 20 reactive lymph nodes were negative. The authors note that cecal dermoid cysts, which are mature cystic teratomas, are exceedingly rare and can mimic appendicitis or ovarian masses. Laparoscopy is useful, but oncologic resection may be required when malignancy cannot be excluded.

pmid-42117072.summary_ja: 先天性左精巣欠損の39歳男性で、右精巣腫瘍（β-hCG高値）と無精子症を認めた。精巣摘除術後に顕微鏡下onco-TESEを施行し、残存精細管から運動精子を回収した。病理はピュアセミノーマであった。単独精巣の精巣がん患者でも精子回収が可能であると報告している。
pmid-42117072.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with congenital absence of the left testis and a right testicular mass with elevated β-hCG and FSH. Azoospermia with AZFc partial deletion was noted. After orchiectomy, microsurgical oncological testicular sperm extraction (onco-TESE) retrieved motile sperm from preserved seminiferous tubules. Pathology showed pure seminoma. The authors conclude that microsurgical onco-TESE can retrieve sperm in patients with a solitary testis and testicular cancer, even with impaired spermatogenesis.

pmid-42117759.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療を受けた男性57,365例を含む6研究のメタ解析で、二次性白血病の発症を一般人口と比較しました。化学療法は有意なリスク上昇（SIR 5.77）を示し、放射線療法は有意差がありませんでした（SIR 2.55）。エビデンスの確実性はGRADEで中等度と評価され、絶対リスクは小さいとされています。治療選択の慎重な検討の必要性を述べています。
pmid-42117759.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis of six studies including 57,365 men treated for testicular germ cell tumors assessed the risk of secondary leukemia compared with the general population. Chemotherapy was associated with a significantly increased risk (SIR 5.77, 95% CI 1.35-24.62), while radiation showed no statistically significant association (SIR 2.55). Evidence certainty was moderate by GRADE, and absolute risk remained small. The authors conclude that chemotherapy increases the relative risk of secondary leukemia after treatment for testicular germ cell tumors, supporting careful consideration of therapeutic decisions given long survival.

pmid-42118332.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の化学耐性に、GSK-3β/mTOR経路の異常活性化が関与する機序を総説している。上皮間葉転換、代謝変化、免疫逃避、オートファジーの異常などを検討した。GSK-3β活性化薬やmTOR阻害薬などの併用療法も提示している。
pmid-42118332.summary_en: This review examines how aberrant activation of the GSK-3β/mTOR signaling axis contributes to chemoresistance in gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors discuss mechanisms including epithelial-mesenchymal transition, metabolic reprogramming, immune evasion, autophagy dysregulation, and suppressed apoptosis, along with resistance to methotrexate, actinomycin D, and etoposide. They outline therapeutic approaches such as GSK-3β activators, mTOR inhibitors, and combination regimens. The review proposes a translational framework for molecularly targeted therapy in chemoresistant disease.

pmid-42131333.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)でTNFSF10発現が予後と関連し、その抑制により細胞増殖・遊走・浸潤が低下した。腫瘍微小環境との相関も示された。TNFSF10は予後バイオマーカーおよび免疫療法の標的候補となりうる。
pmid-42131333.summary_en: This study evaluates TNFSF10 as a prognostic biomarker and potential immunotherapy target in testicular germ cell tumors. Integrated analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing and TCGA data showed that aberrant TNFSF10 expression was significantly associated with patient survival. Silencing TNFSF10 in TGCT cells inhibited proliferation, migration, and invasion, supporting a role in tumor progression. TNFSF10 expression also correlated with several components of the tumor microenvironment, suggesting involvement in both biological behavior and treatment response. The authors conclude that TNFSF10 is a promising diagnostic and prognostic biomarker for stratification and targeted therapy, supporting personalized treatment approaches.

pmid-42133855.summary_ja: 臨床病期IIAの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の21歳男性に対し、完全に腹膜外で単孔式の両側ロボット支援RPLNDを行った手技報告です。手術時間は175分、出血量は35mLで、術後2日目に退院しました。摘出した32個のリンパ節のうち3個に奇形腫が認められました。36か月の時点で無病生存を維持しています。腹膜を開かないことで低侵襲かつ十分な郭清が可能と述べています。
pmid-42133855.summary_en: This report describes the first extraperitoneal single-port bilateral robot-assisted RPLND, performed in a 21-year-old man with clinical stage IIA nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after right radical orchiectomy. Using a da Vinci Xi system with a 4-cm pararectal incision, the team performed a split-and-roll bilateral template dissection with vascular preservation. The operation took 175 minutes with 35 mL blood loss, and the patient was discharged on day 2. Three of 32 retrieved nodes contained teratoma, and at 36 months the patient remained disease-free. The authors suggest this approach achieves thorough dissection with reduced morbidity.

pmid-42137572.summary_ja: 妊娠37週6日に出生前超音波で発見された、胃前壁由来の未熟奇形腫の新生児例の報告。腫瘤は51.9×47×39 mmで、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は60,500 ng/mL超と著明に上昇していた。出生後4日目に切除断端陰性の完全切除を行い、病理でグレード3の未熟奇形腫と確認された。術後経過は良好だった。新生児腹部腫瘤の鑑別診断に胃奇形腫を含める重要性を述べている。
pmid-42137572.summary_en: This case report describes a term male neonate with an immature gastric teratoma arising from the anterior gastric wall, detected prenatally at 37 weeks and 6 days. The mass measured 51.9 × 47 × 39 mm, and AFP exceeded 60,500 ng/mL. Complete surgical resection with negative margins was performed on postnatal day four. Histology confirmed grade III immature teratoma, and recovery was uneventful, with declining inflammatory markers at one-week follow-up. The authors stress including gastric teratoma in the differential diagnosis of neonatal abdominal masses.

pmid-42138484.summary_ja: 43歳患者の原発性肺絨毛癌で、腎臓への転移を伴う稀な症例。肺葉切除と腎摘除の標本から診断され、補助化学療法と抗PD-1抗体療法を実施した。非妊娠性絨毛癌の診断の難しさを示す。β-hCGの監視を継続している。
pmid-42138484.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old patient with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma that metastasized to the kidney, a rare presentation. The diagnostic process began with suspected implantation of unknown location, and the final diagnosis was established from lobectomy and nephrectomy specimens, with molecular genetic confirmation of the pulmonary tumour. Treatment included adjuvant chemotherapy and anti-PD-1 immunotherapy. Follow-up involves regular imaging and beta-hCG monitoring. The report emphasizes diagnostic challenges in non-gestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-42138750.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対するロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清を段階的に示した手技ガイド。化学療法後の残存腫瘤や低容量セミノーマへの一次的郭清を対象とする。腹膜フラップの作成と懸垂、神経の早期同定、大動脈・下大静脈間の後方優先的な剥離などを解説している。
pmid-42138750.summary_en: This technical report offers a stepwise guide to robotic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer, including post-chemotherapy residual masses and primary RPLND in low-volume seminoma. The workflow covers patient positioning in Trendelenburg, creation and suspension of a broad peritoneal flap, early nerve identification, split-and-roll dissection, and posterior-first interaortocaval development. Mechanical clip control is favored for lymphatic and higher-risk vascular branches. The authors propose standardization to improve technical clarity in this demanding operation.

pmid-42147576.summary_ja: 骨盤内の充満感を訴えた30歳未経妊女性で、左卵巣の多房性嚢胞を良性と判断しました。腫瘍マーカーは正常で、妊孕性温存のため卵巣嚢胞摘出術を行い、病理組織学的検査で卵巣甲状腺腫と確定しました。複雑な卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断に本疾患を含める必要性が示されています。
pmid-42147576.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old nulliparous woman with pelvic fullness and a large multiloculated left ovarian cyst initially interpreted as benign. Tumor markers were normal and she was clinically euthyroid. She underwent fertility-sparing left ovarian cystectomy with ovarian reconstruction. Histopathology established struma ovarii. The postoperative course was uneventful. The authors stress that struma ovarii should be included in the differential diagnosis of complex ovarian masses even when imaging and tumor markers suggest a benign process, and that histopathological confirmation is essential. Fertility-sparing surgery is an effective option in benign cases.

pmid-42148859.summary_ja: 右卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の既往がある33歳女性で、コンピュータ断層撮影（CT）で疑われた左卵巣転移の評価にFDG PET/CTを施行した。周辺集積と中心低集積を示す腫瘤を転移と疑ったが、手術で付属器捻転と壊死が判明し悪性所見はなかった。卵黄嚢腫瘍のフォローアップにおけるPET/CTの偽陽性の落とし穴を示す症例である。
pmid-42148859.summary_en: A 33-year-old woman previously treated for a right ovarian yolk sac tumor with salpingo-oophorectomy and hysterectomy underwent FDG PET/CT to evaluate a suspected left ovarian metastasis seen on CT. PET showed a solid pelvic mass with peripheral uptake and a central photopenic area, suggesting metastasis with central necrosis. Surgery revealed adnexal torsion with necrosis and hemorrhage, without malignancy. The case illustrates a pitfall of FDG PET/CT in surveillance of yolk sac tumor.

pmid-42149926.summary_ja: 27歳女性の卵巣未熟奇形腫の術前病期分類で、PET/CTにより骨盤内の2か所に強いFDG集積を認めた。MRIで子宮重複症と診断され、生理的な月経時の集積であった。重複子宮における生理的集積が悪性腫瘍を模倣しうることを示し、解剖学的変異の認識の重要性を述べている。
pmid-42149926.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with ovarian immature teratoma who underwent preoperative 18F-FDG PET/CT for staging. Intense FDG uptake in two pelvic structures mimicked endometrial cancer or metastasis. MRI showed no lesions in either uterus and confirmed uterine didelphys. The authors conclude that physiological menstrual uptake in a duplicated uterus can simulate malignancy, and that clinicians should recognize anatomic variants to avoid misinterpretation during pelvic staging.

pmid-42151003.summary_ja: 原発性精巣腫瘍の遺伝的素因に関する近年の進歩を概説。精巣腫瘍の約95%を占める胚細胞腫瘍は、GWASで同定された多数の低浸透率の感受性アレルによる多遺伝子モデルで説明される。CHEK2変異は中等度浸透率を示す最初の胚細胞腫瘍素因遺伝子として挙げられている。
pmid-42151003.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in the genetic predisposition to primary testicular tumors. Most germ cell tumors, which account for about 95% of primary testicular neoplasms, follow a polygenic model in which many common low-penetrance alleles identified by genome-wide association studies contribute to risk. The authors highlight CHEK2 variants as the first moderate-penetrance germ cell tumor predisposition gene. They also discuss monogenic syndromes linked to sex cord-stromal tumors, including Carney complex, Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, and HLRCC, and emerging associations with APC and DICER1.

pmid-42152549.summary_ja: フランスの精巣胚細胞腫瘍男性472例と対照683例を比較した病院ベースの症例対照研究である。出生時の居住地周辺500m以内の農業用地を歴史的航空写真とGISで評価した。耕作地やブドウ園との全体的な関連は認められなかった。果樹園の存在は軽度のリスク上昇と関連し、セミノーマでは統計的に有意な上昇がみられた。
pmid-42152549.summary_en: This French hospital-based case-control study included 472 men with testicular germ cell tumors and 683 matched controls aged 18 to 45. Researchers used historical aerial images and GIS methods to measure agricultural land within 500 meters of each participant's residence at birth, as a proxy for pesticide exposure. No overall association was found for arable land or vineyards. Orchards were associated with a modest increase in risk, which was stronger for seminoma and for conception in spring-summer. The authors conclude there was no overall association beyond the orchard finding.

pmid-42152653.summary_ja: 絨毛癌におけるβ-hCGを超えた新規バイオマーカーを整理した総説です。β-hCGには偽陽性や再発の検出遅延などの限界があります。ctDNA、循環腫瘍細胞、エクソソーム、マイクロRNAなどを方法論と臨床的有用性で分類し、統合上の課題を論じています。多重マーカーによる精密診断への展望を示しています。
pmid-42152653.summary_en: This review surveys emerging biomarkers for choriocarcinoma, a rare, highly aggressive gestational trophoblastic neoplasia that responds well to chemotherapy. It notes limitations of serum β-hCG, including false positives and slow detection of relapse. The authors categorize novel markers such as ctDNA, circulating tumor cells, exosomes, and microRNAs by method and clinical utility, and discuss integration challenges. They outline future directions toward multi-marker precision diagnostics for diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic monitoring. The review is a narrative overview rather than a systematic review.

pmid-42164110.summary_ja: NCDB解析(4661例)で臨床病期IIセミノーマに対する一次RPLNDの全生存は化学療法・放射線療法と差がなかった。救援化学療法を要する割合は臨床的な病変進展度とともに増加した。後方視的データのため、バイアスには留意が必要。
pmid-42164110.summary_en: This retrospective National Cancer Data Base analysis included 4661 patients with clinical stage II seminoma treated between 2004 and 2022. Overall survival did not differ between primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and chemotherapy or radiation therapy, and sensitivity analysis after energy-balancing weighting gave similar results. Among patients who underwent primary RPLND, estimated 2-year salvage chemotherapy-free survival was 70%, 45%, and 36% for cN1, cN2, and cN3 disease. The authors conclude that survival after primary RPLND appears comparable to alternatives, and that the risk of needing salvage chemotherapy rises with clinical disease extent. The retrospective design introduces unmeasured bias.

pmid-42164182.summary_ja: 当初は仙骨前部の横紋筋肉腫と診断された2歳児が、後に仙尾部奇形腫の内部に発生した腫瘍であったと判明した症例です。奇形腫内の胚細胞成分から体細胞型悪性腫瘍が生じることはまれです。英文文献に類似例は見当たらなかったと報告しています。極めてまれな病態の治療標準化のため、症例の公表が重要と述べています。
pmid-42164182.summary_en: This case report describes a two-year-old child initially diagnosed with presacral rhabdomyosarcoma who was later found to have arisen within a sacrococcygeal teratoma. Somatic malignancy arising from a germline component within a teratoma is rare, in contrast to the more common immature teratoma. The authors could not identify a similar case in the English literature. They emphasize the need for publication to support standardization of management protocols for these extremely rare conditions.

pmid-42164365.summary_ja: 2歳5か月の男児で、右停留精巣の720度捻転に対して捻転解除と精巣固定術を施行し、精巣を温存した。術後約6か月で陰嚢の進行性腫大が生じ、AFPは1,258.7 ng/mLと著明な高値を示した。根治的精巣摘除術で卵黄嚢腫瘍と確定し、AFPは術後に正常範囲まで低下した。進行性の腫大や充実性病変を認める場合は腫瘍マーカー評価を行うべきと提言している。
pmid-42164365.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-5-month-old boy who underwent detorsion and orchiopexy for a 720-degree torsion of a right undescended testis. The testis was preserved, and early postoperative ultrasound showed heterogeneous changes interpreted as benign. About six months later, progressive scrotal enlargement developed, with serum alpha-fetoprotein at 1,258.7 ng/mL. Radical orchiectomy confirmed a yolk sac tumor, and alpha-fetoprotein normalized postoperatively without short-term recurrence. The authors recommend tumor marker evaluation when a torsed undescended testis shows progressive enlargement or a solid lesion.

pmid-42168362.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍でLINC00152が高発現し、進行、リンパ節転移、予後不良と関連することを示した基礎研究。YBX1/AKT経路の活性化とHAVCR2を介したT細胞疲弊を明らかにし、免疫療法との併用標的として提案している。
pmid-42168362.summary_en: This translational study integrates single-nucleus RNA-seq, spatial transcriptomics, and bulk RNA-seq of TGCT samples. LINC00152 was upregulated, especially in non-seminomas, and associated with advanced stage, nodal metastasis, and poor prognosis. LINC00152 bound YBX1 to block its proteasomal degradation and activate AKT signalling, promoting proliferation and invasion. High-LINC00152 tumour cells also induced HAVCR2 and T cell exhaustion, which recombinant HAVCR2 rescued. The authors propose LINC00152 as a prognostic biomarker and a target for combination immunotherapy.

pmid-42169898.summary_ja: 妊娠29週の22歳女性に生じた、卵黄嚢腫瘍分化を伴う胃食道腺癌の症例である。当初は肝生検で神経内分泌癌と診断されたが、病理再検で確定された。緊急帝王切開後に化学療法を行ったが効果は短期間で、18か月後に死亡した。妊娠中に報告された初の症例とされる。
pmid-42169898.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old pregnant woman at 29 weeks gestation with gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma showing yolk sac tumor differentiation. Liver biopsy initially suggested neuroendocrine carcinoma, but pathology review confirmed adenocarcinoma with yolk sac tumor features. She underwent emergent Cesarean section followed by sequential cytotoxic chemotherapy with short-lived responses. She died 18 months after presentation. The authors note this is the first documented case in pregnancy and stress the value of expert pathology review.

pmid-42171366.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍は精巣がんの侵襲性の高い亜型で、特に成人では治療抵抗性と予後不良に関わる。成人例は混合腫瘍の成分として現れることが多く、小児の純粋型は治癒しやすい。病態、診断バイオマーカー、エピジェネティックな分子機構、新規治療戦略を概説している。
pmid-42171366.summary_en: This review examines yolk sac tumors, an aggressive subtype of testicular cancer that contributes to progression and therapy resistance, particularly in adults. Adult forms, often mixed with other components, respond poorly to cisplatin-based therapy, whereas pediatric pure forms are usually curable. The article summarizes pathophysiology, diagnostic biomarkers, and molecular and epigenetic drivers of aggressive behavior. It also highlights emerging therapeutic strategies aimed at improving early detection and overcoming resistance in this high-risk subtype.

pmid-42172465.summary_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍の2002-2021年の単施設後方視的研究。卵巣温存手術は20%から61%へ増加し、腹腔鏡手技も普及した。前思春期では悪性率が高かった。平均4年の観察で再発率は両群で同等であった。
pmid-42172465.summary_en: This 20-year single-center retrospective study reviewed 87 children with histologically confirmed ovarian tumors, the most common being mature cystic teratoma (54%), and 18 were malignant. Ovary-sparing surgery rose from 20% to 61.4% between the two decades, and laparoscopy increased from 6.7% to 35.1%. Ovary-sparing patients had smaller tumors and lower malignancy rates. Prepubertal children had higher malignancy rates than pubertal children (29.5% vs 11.6%). Over a mean 4-year follow-up, recurrence rates were similar between ovary-sparing surgery and oophorectomy groups. The authors conclude that fertility-preserving surgery is safe in selected patients and that age-specific evaluation is essential.

pmid-42178587.summary_ja: 10歳と12歳の女児2例の卵巣腫瘍の報告。化学療法中に腫瘍マーカーは低下しつつ腫瘍が増大し、切除標本で成熟奇形腫と判明した。growing teratoma syndromeは病勢進行と誤認されやすく、マーカー低下下での増大には注意が必要と指摘している。
pmid-42178587.summary_en: This case series describes two Black African girls, aged 10 and 12 years, with ovarian tumors initially diagnosed as malignant with elevated AFP and β-hCG. Tumors progressed during chemotherapy even as tumor markers continued to decline. Surgical removal revealed mature teratoma without malignant components, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. The authors stress that this phenomenon is often mistaken for disease progression, and that clinicians should maintain a high index of suspicion when an abdominal germ cell tumor enlarges on therapy despite falling markers.

pmid-42180088.summary_ja: 胎児口腔内に生じた未熟奇形腫の症例と文献レビューである。CTやMRIでは、石灰化を伴う充実嚢胞性腫瘤と充実部の拡散制限が認められた。病理はGrade IIIの未熟奇形腫で、右側頭部のくも膜嚢胞と髄膜瘤を併存していた。出生前診断と鑑別のための画像所見の体系的評価を提唱している。
pmid-42180088.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes imaging features of an immature teratoma arising in the fetal oral cavity, with concurrent right temporal arachnoid cyst and meningocele. Ultrasonography, CT, and MRI showed a solid-cystic oropharyngeal mass with punctate calcification and restricted diffusion in solid components. Pathology confirmed a Grade III immature teratoma. A comparative table of prior cases was compiled. The authors emphasize systematic multimodal imaging to enable accurate prenatal diagnosis and differentiation from other oral masses.

pmid-42180643.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の若年男性に、右心系の腫瘍性・血栓性非細菌性血栓性心内膜炎(NBTE)が合併した症例。化学療法前の経胸壁心エコーが病変の検出と評価に有用で、内科的治療で改善した。多職種による管理の重要性を示す。
pmid-42180643.summary_en: This case report describes a young man with metastatic testicular germ cell tumor complicated by right-sided tumorous-thrombotic nonbacterial thrombotic endocarditis (NBTE). The vegetations can be tumorous, thrombotic, inflammatory, or mixed, and they showed dynamic changes and improvement with medical therapy. Transthoracic echocardiography performed before chemotherapy was valuable for detecting and characterizing the lesions. The authors recommend a multidisciplinary team approach for managing NBTE in patients with metastatic TGCT. The report highlights that cardiac complications of metastatic germ cell tumors can be rare but clinically important.

pmid-42181386.summary_ja: 両側卵巣奇形腫の46歳女性の症例報告。術前造影MRIで見過ごされた左卵巣類皮嚢腫内の悪性転化が、術後の病理組織学的検査で確定した。後方視的な再評価で、悪性転化部位に一致する限局性の不整な増強壁肥厚と拡散制限が確認された。明らかな浸潤所見がなくても、このような微細な所見が初期の悪性転化を示す可能性があり、慎重な評価が必要と述べている。
pmid-42181386.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old woman with bilateral ovarian teratomas in whom malignant transformation within the left dermoid cyst was missed on preoperative imaging and confirmed only on histopathology. Retrospective review of contrast-enhanced MRI showed focal irregular enhancing mural thickening with corresponding diffusion restriction, matching the malignant site. The authors suggest such subtle findings may indicate early malignant transformation even without overt invasive features, and emphasize careful evaluation of the cyst wall.

pmid-42183407.summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎の後に持続出血を来した27歳女性。低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と判定され、組織学的にはp63陰性、Ki-67高値、β-hCG陽性から絨毛癌と診断された。子宮全摘術が行われた。上皮様栄養膜腫瘍との鑑別には免疫染色が重要である。
pmid-42183407.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with a history of partial hydatidiform mole and persistent post-curettage bleeding, later classified as low-risk GTN. Initial histology suggested epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, but immunohistochemistry showed p63 negativity, high Ki-67, and β-hCG positivity, favoring choriocarcinoma. She underwent total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingectomy. The authors emphasize that accurate classification requires integrating clinical data, β-hCG trends, and an appropriate immunohistochemical panel, especially p63, because ETT responds poorly to chemotherapy.

pmid-42183905.summary_ja: 新規の生殖細胞系列TP53変異を有するLiFraumeni症候群の5.5歳女児の症例である。母親は同一のTP53変異による妊娠性絨毛癌で死亡していた。非保因者である両親から母子で同一の変異が生じた初の報告とされ、両者の関連機序を考察している。
pmid-42183905.summary_en: This family case report describes a 5.5-year-old girl with Li-Fraumeni syndrome caused by a novel germline TP53 variant, who developed multiple malignancies. Her mother had died after gestational choriocarcinoma caused by the same TP53 mutation, and neither parent carried a family history of LFS. The authors describe this as the first reported TP53 mutation from non-carrier parents affecting both mother and child. They discuss possible mechanisms linking the mother's gestational choriocarcinoma and the child's LFS.

pmid-42184400.summary_ja: 2021〜2023年に三次施設で精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた83例の前向き観察研究である。開腹移行率は6%、平均手術時間は250分、平均出血量は60 mLであった。重大な血管・臓器損傷は認めず、再発率は9.6%だった。腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清は安全で有効であり、高ボリューム施設での実施が望ましいと結論している。
pmid-42184400.summary_en: This prospective observational study reports 83 patients who underwent laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for testicular germ cell tumors at a tertiary center from 2021 to 2023. Cases included primary, standard, salvage, desperation, and redo procedures. The conversion rate to open surgery was 6%, with mean operative time of 250 minutes and mean blood loss of 60 mL. No major vascular or organ injuries occurred. Recurrence occurred in 9.6%, with recurrence-free survival of 36.7 months. The authors conclude that laparoscopic RPLND is safe and effective and advise performing it at high-volume centers.

pmid-42186191.summary_ja: 10歳時に左停留精巣固定術、35歳時に右精巣腫瘍に対する高位精巣摘除術を受けた53歳男性。左精巣セミノーマが診断され、術後4コースの化学療法でリンパ節転移は完全奏効した。停留精巣後の異時性両側発生例である。
pmid-42186191.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 53-year-old man who had undergone fixation for a left undescended testis at age 10 and right high orchiectomy for a testicular tumor at age 35. He presented with left scrotal swelling, and imaging showed a left testicular tumor with scrotal skin infiltration and enlarged inguinal and para-aortic lymph nodes. Pathology confirmed seminoma. Four courses of postoperative chemotherapy achieved complete response of the nodal metastases, and he has remained free of recurrence. The case illustrates a metachronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumor after cryptorchidism.

pmid-42186518.summary_ja: 43歳男性の左陰嚢腫脹は水瘤と疑われたが、超音波検査とCTで充実成分を伴う大きな精巣腫瘤が判明した。β-hCGの上昇を認め、高位精巣摘除術で古典型セミノーマ（pT1b）と確定した。非定型的な水瘤が精巣悪性腫瘍を覆い隠しうるため、早期の超音波検査と腫瘍マーカー評価が重要であると示している。
pmid-42186518.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with a long-standing left scrotal swelling initially suspected to be a hydrocele. Ultrasonography and contrast-enhanced CT revealed a bulky solid left testis, and serum beta-hCG was elevated while AFP and LDH were normal. High inguinal orchidectomy and histopathology confirmed classical seminoma, staged pT1b. The authors emphasize that atypical hydrocele can conceal testicular malignancy, and that early ultrasonography and tumor marker assessment are essential for timely diagnosis.

pmid-42187568.summary_ja: 絨毛癌様分化を伴う閉経後子宮内膜癌2例の報告と文献レビュー。hCG値が低い類内膜癌優位例は子宮内膜癌型化学療法、絨毛癌優位で術後hCGが高い例は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍型化学療法で治療し、いずれも無病。主たる腫瘍生物学に基づく治療選択を提案。
pmid-42187568.summary_en: This case-based review describes two postmenopausal women with endometrioid carcinoma containing a choriocarcinomatous component. The patient with an endometrial carcinoma-dominant tumor and rapidly normalized hCG received paclitaxel plus carboplatin. The patient with a choriocarcinoma-dominant tumor and markedly elevated postoperative hCG received GTN-oriented EMA/CO chemotherapy. Both remained disease-free. A review of published cases showed inconsistent use of two treatment paradigms without unified selection criteria. The authors propose that adjuvant therapy should be guided primarily by dominant tumor biology and postoperative hCG dynamics rather than FIGO stage alone.

pmid-42188358.summary_ja: 治療前に精液を凍結保存した精巣がん男性284例の後方視的研究。精液パラメータの多くはWHO基準値の第5〜25パーセンタイルに分布し、精子濃度・運動率・正常形態率は有意に低値であった。腫瘍の組織型と異常精液所見との有意な関連はなかった。セミノーマ患者は非セミノーマ患者より高齢であった。若年男性への系統的な精液評価と妊孕性温存の重要性が強調された。
pmid-42188358.summary_en: This retrospective study of 284 men with testicular cancer who cryopreserved semen before treatment found that semen parameters were mostly between the 5th and 25th percentiles of WHO reference values, and that sperm concentration, total motility, and normal morphology were significantly lower in cancer patients. Tumor histology was not significantly associated with abnormal semen parameters. Seminoma patients were significantly older than non-seminoma patients, and age was inversely associated with cancer risk. The authors emphasize systematic semen evaluation and fertility preservation for young men with testicular cancer.

pmid-42197105.summary_ja: Bossioらによるオレウロペインの研究(Nutrients 2022)の訂正。性腺内・性腺外セミノーマ細胞の増殖と遊走の抑制効果を扱った原論文の記載を修正する。訂正内容の詳細は抄録からは分からず、原論文の修正版を参照する必要がある。
pmid-42197105.summary_en: This erratum corrects a published study by Bossio and colleagues on oleuropein, a compound from olive plants. The original article examined how oleuropein counteracts both proliferation and migration of intragonadal and extragonadal seminoma cells. The correction notice itself contains only a brief statement that the original publication has been amended, and the specific changes are not described in the abstract text. Readers are directed to the corrected article for the revised content. The erratum is relevant because the corrected work concerns seminoma cell biology, a germ cell tumor model.

pmid-42199017.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の退縮後瘢痕に、血管腫様に見えるほど高度な血管増生を示す34例を検討した病理学的研究です。4例では血管腫との誤認が生じうることが示されました。血管密度は非腫瘍実質の平均2.6倍で、血管腫様の例では6倍を超えていました。誤診は不適切な管理につながるため、認識が重要と結論づけています。
pmid-42199017.summary_en: This pathology study identified 34 cases of regressed testicular germ cell tumors with highly vascularized scars, most often seminoma-related. In four cases, the vessels were so prominent and closely packed that the scars mimicked hemangiomas, a misinterpretation that could lead to inappropriate management because regressed germ cell tumors require metastatic evaluation and surveillance. Quantification showed vessel density increased 2.6-fold on average over non-neoplastic parenchyma, and more than sixfold in the hemangiomatoid cases. Seminoma was the most common germ cell tumor type inducing this florid vascular reaction. The authors conclude that recognizing this phenomenon is important for correct clinical management.

pmid-42199430.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者170例で、血漿sCD14高値はシスプラチン誘発末梢神経障害の重症度と関連した。感覚障害に加え、治療群によっては運動・自律神経障害のリスク上昇も認められた。化学療法群のsCD14は積極的監視群より高値であった。累積シスプラチン量との有意な関連は認められず、腸管バリア破綻と免疫活性化が持続する神経毒性に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-42199430.summary_en: In 170 long-term survivors of testicular germ cell tumors (median follow-up 10 years), higher plasma soluble CD14 was associated with more severe cisplatin-induced peripheral neuropathy, including worse sensory symptoms and, depending on treatment group, increased risk of motor and autonomic neuropathy. sCD14 levels were higher in chemotherapy-treated patients than in those under active surveillance. No association was found between cumulative cisplatin dose and gut microbial translocation markers. The authors suggest treatment-related intestinal barrier disruption and immune activation may contribute to persistent neurotoxicity.

pmid-42199575.summary_ja: 腎上極に接する10cmの後腹膜腫瘤を有する35歳男性で、経皮的針生検により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断。画像では脂肪肉腫などとの鑑別が難しかった。術前診断と手術計画に経皮生検が有用であった。
pmid-42199575.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a 10 cm retroperitoneal mass adjacent to the upper pole of the right kidney, found incidentally on a health checkup. CT suggested a renal angiomyolipoma, while MRI showed heterogeneous septated components with calcifications, raising concern for liposarcoma. Ultrasound-guided percutaneous core needle biopsy revealed keratinizing squamous epithelium, skin appendages, adipose tissue, and smooth muscle, consistent with a mature cystic teratoma. The tumor was resected en bloc with the right kidney due to strong adhesion. Final histopathology confirmed no malignant component. The authors emphasize that percutaneous biopsy helped establish a preoperative diagnosis and surgical plan for this complex retroperitoneal mass.

pmid-42200089.summary_ja: 右卵巣に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫2個を含む6.13×5.20 cmの腫瘤が捻転した36歳女性の症例報告。経腟超音波検査でグレースケールとカラードプラにより渦巻き徴候が認められた。腹腔鏡で付属器の四重捻転を確認し、右卵管卵巣摘出術を行った。病理で出血性壊死を伴う捻転が確認された。渦巻き徴候は、特に複数の成熟奇形腫例で付属器捻転の特異性の高い術前マーカーであり、急性骨盤痛の日常的超音波検査に組み込むべきと主張している。
pmid-42200089.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with right lower abdominal pain caused by torsion of a 6.1 × 5.2 cm right ovarian mass containing two mature cystic teratomas. Transvaginal ultrasonography showed the whirlpool sign on grayscale and color Doppler. Laparoscopy found quadruple torsion of the adnexa, and salpingo-oophorectomy was performed. Pathology confirmed torsion with hemorrhagic necrosis. The authors argue the whirlpool sign is a highly specific preoperative marker for adnexal torsion, especially with multiple mature teratomas, and advocate its routine use in acute pelvic pain.

pmid-42202429.summary_ja: 化学療法未施行の精巣胚細胞腫瘍57例で、リンパ節郭清前の血清M371を測定した後方視的研究である。非セミノーマでは陽性的中率100%で、奇形腫では上昇しなかった。M371は腫瘍マーカー陰性のリンパ節腫大の診断に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-42202429.summary_en: This retrospective study measured serum microRNA-371a-3p (M371) before lymph node dissection in 57 chemotherapy-naive patients with testicular germ cell tumors. M371 was elevated in most nonseminoma and seminoma cases with metastases but not in teratoma. For identifying lymph node metastases, the test showed 67.3% sensitivity and 87.5% specificity overall, with 100% positive predictive value in nonseminoma. Postoperative levels fell significantly. The authors conclude M371 can aid diagnosis of marker-negative lymphadenopathy.

pmid-42210622.summary_ja: 2013〜2018年に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍170例の後方視的解析です。ディスジャーミノーマが最多でした。大半が妊孕性温存手術を受け、18例が妊娠に至りました。術前化学療法は腫瘍学的転帰を損なわない可能性を示しています。
pmid-42210622.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study analyzed 170 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 2013 and 2018. Dysgerminoma was most common, followed by yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma. Most patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery, and 87 percent of those receiving chemotherapy resumed menstruation, with 18 pregnancies. Five-year progression-free and overall survival were high for stage I/II and lower for stage III/IV. Relapsed yolk sac tumors could not be salvaged. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy did not appear to compromise oncological outcomes.

pmid-42212286.summary_ja: 18歳以下の女児の卵巣成熟奇形腫169例で、LESSと開腹囊腫摘出術を比較した後方視的コホート研究である。LESS群では手術時間、出血量、合併症、在院日数が有意に優れた。腫瘍径15cm未満がLESSに適すると考察している。
pmid-42212286.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study compared laparoendoscopic single-site surgery (LESS) with open cystectomy for ovarian mature teratomas in 169 girls aged 18 years or younger. The LESS group (n=151) had smaller tumors than the open group (n=18), and showed shorter surgery, less blood loss, fewer complications, faster bowel recovery, and shorter hospital stays. Follow-up at one month and one year found no recurrence reported. The authors conclude LESS is safe and effective, with tumor diameter under 15 cm favoring its use.

pmid-42212783.summary_ja: 2002〜2025年に縦隔または転移性胚細胞腫瘍105例にシスプラチン併用化学療法を行った国内単施設の後方視的研究。5年がん特異的生存率はセミノーマで97%、非セミノーマで73%だった。腫瘍マーカーの正常化は予後良好と関連し、肺以外の内臓転移が最大の死亡リスク因子だった。
pmid-42212783.summary_en: This Japanese single-institution retrospective study reviewed 105 patients with mediastinal or metastatic germ cell tumors (33 seminoma, 72 non-seminoma) treated with cisplatin-based induction chemotherapy from 2002 to 2025. The 5-year cancer-specific survival was 97% for seminoma and 73% for non-seminoma. Residual tumor resection was performed in 56 non-seminoma patients, and normalized tumor markers at surgery were associated with much better survival. Non-pulmonary visceral metastasis was the strongest risk factor for cancer death.

pmid-42214057.summary_ja: 1,361例のスクリーニングで同定された17例の抗KLHL11脳炎。小脳失調や脳幹脳炎が主体で、腫瘍は59％に認められ、セミノーマが最も多かった。早期診断による腫瘍治療と免疫療法の重要性を指摘している。
pmid-42214057.summary_en: This study describes 17 patients with anti-KLHL11 encephalitis identified from screening of 1,361 individuals. Cerebellar ataxia, brainstem encephalitis, and opsoclonus-myoclonus were common. Tumors were found in 59% of cases, most often seminoma (n=5), and one ovarian teratoma. Most patients received first-line immunotherapy, and 67% of those with outcomes improved or stabilized, although six patients died within 12 months, mainly from encephalitis or cancer. The authors recommend early diagnosis to enable prompt oncologic and immunologic treatment.

pmid-42215910.summary_ja: 妊娠27週の初産婦で、卵管絨毛癌の破裂と子宮内妊娠の併存例。当初は子宮筋腫の変性と誤診され、開腹術で診断された。腹痛と腹腔内出血を伴う妊娠中の急性腹症では絨毛癌を疑うべきと結論している。
pmid-42215910.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-week-pregnant primigravida who presented with three days of worsening abdominal pain. Ultrasound identified a uterine mass that was initially misdiagnosed as a degenerated myoma. Laparotomy, prompted by severe intra-abdominal hemorrhage and fetal death, revealed a ruptured and bleeding fallopian tube choriocarcinoma, which was only then correctly diagnosed. Choriocarcinoma coexisting with an intrauterine pregnancy is extremely rare and requires early diagnosis. The authors conclude that acute abdomen and intra-abdominal hemorrhage during pregnancy should raise suspicion of choriocarcinoma, so that the diagnosis is not delayed by misinterpretation of imaging findings.

pmid-42219219.summary_ja: 最も頻度の高い先天性胚細胞腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫の疫学、病態、出生前・出生後管理、転帰、術後サーベイランスを概説する総説である。出生前は腫瘍形態・増殖・胎児心血管状態で層別化し、尾骨切除を伴う完全切除が要となる。切除可能例の予後は概ね良好である。再発の主因は不完全切除や未熟成分等で、AFPと画像による経過観察が有効とされる。
pmid-42219219.summary_en: This review synthesizes the epidemiology, pathogenesis, antenatal and postnatal management, outcomes, and postoperative surveillance of sacrococcygeal teratoma, the most common congenital germ cell tumor. Antenatal risk stratification integrates tumor morphology, growth, and fetal cardiovascular status. Complete resection with coccygectomy is central to surgery. Incomplete resection, spillage, coccyx retention, and immature or malignant elements drive recurrence. Survival is generally favorable for resectable tumors, and serial examination, AFP monitoring, and imaging are effective for surveillance.

pmid-42220799.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対するロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に乳糜腹水を発症した35歳男性の症例である。保存的治療で60日間改善せず、在宅TPNを導入して80日後に治癒した。1年後も腫瘍の再発はなかった。保存的治療が長期間を要することがあると示している。
pmid-42220799.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with testicular seminoma who developed chylous ascites after robotic-assisted RPLND. Ascitic fluid triglyceride was 420 mg/dL. Conservative management with paracentesis, drainage, total parenteral nutrition, and octreotide failed to stop leakage after 60 days, so home TPN via a central venous port was started. Chylous leakage resolved after 80 days, and the patient remained free of recurrence one year later. The case shows that conservative treatment may sometimes require a prolonged course.

pmid-42221246.summary_ja: 12年間の後方視的解析(77例)で、成熟奇形腫が最多で、悪性腫瘍は24.7%を占めた。胚細胞腫瘍は4歳未満で多かった。画像で充実性病変の多くが悪性であり、腫瘍マーカーと免疫組織化学が診断に有用。
pmid-42221246.summary_en: This retrospective review of 77 pediatric ovarian neoplasms diagnosed over 12 years at a tertiary center found that most were benign, with mature teratomas the most common benign type at 22.1%. Malignant tumors made up 24.7% and included germ cell tumors, sex cord-stromal tumors, and a mixed tumor. Malignant germ cell tumors predominated in children under 4 years. Most solid lesions on imaging were malignant, while all cystic lesions were benign. Tumor markers including AFP, CA-125, beta-hCG, and LDH correlated well with histology, and immunohistochemistry supported the diagnosis in malignant cases. The authors stress that histopathology supported by immunohistochemistry and tumor markers is key to accurate management.

pmid-42221265.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）に対する子宮摘出術の治療成績を評価したシステマティックレビューとメタ解析である（PROSPERO登録）。後方視的コホート7研究・407例を統合した完全寛解率は86.6%で、非転移例は99.5%、転移例は46.3%であった。合併症と死亡率は低かった。非転移例や化学療法抵抗性例で有用だが、転移例では効果が限定的である。
pmid-42221265.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis, registered in PROSPERO, evaluated remission outcomes after hysterectomy in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Searching databases from 2000 to 2024 and including seven retrospective cohort studies with 407 patients, the pooled complete remission rate was 86.6%. Remission was 99.5% in nonmetastatic cases but only 46.3% in metastatic disease. Complication and mortality rates were low, with deaths mainly in metastatic or high-risk patients. Hysterectomy is valuable for nonmetastatic or chemoresistant GTN when fertility is not desired, but its effectiveness is limited in metastatic disease, and serum hCG monitoring remains essential postoperatively.

pmid-42222377.summary_ja: 8歳女児の男性化徴候と高度のテストステロン上昇を示した卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の症例である。当初は性索間質性腫瘍が疑われた。免疫組織化学で胚細胞マーカーとβ-hCG陽性の合胞体栄養膜細胞が確認された。KRASとCDK4の増幅を伴い、手術と化学療法後に5年以上寛解を維持している。
pmid-42222377.summary_en: This case report describes an 8-year-old girl with virilization and markedly elevated testosterone, initially suspected to be a steroid-producing sex cord-stromal tumor. Histopathology revealed an ovarian dysgerminoma with unusual architectural patterns. Immunohistochemistry showed germ cell markers and beta-hCG-positive syncytiotrophoblasts, explaining the androgen excess. Molecular profiling identified concurrent KRAS and CDK4 amplifications. After surgery and chemotherapy, sustained remission was observed over more than five years.

pmid-42222402.summary_ja: 後腹膜腫瘤でセミノーマと診断された37歳男性で、超音波検査・MRIでは明らかな精巣病変は指摘されなかったが、燃え尽き腫瘍と解釈された。精巣摘除術で精細管間に限局する生存セミノーマが判明し、巨視的腫瘤はなかった。化学療法3コースで完全代謝応答を得た。転移性セミノーマでは、微細な精巣異常があれば原発部位の病理診断のため精巣摘除術を考慮すべきと結論づけられた。
pmid-42222402.summary_en: A 37-year-old man presented with a retroperitoneal mass diagnosed as metastatic seminoma, with no discrete testicular lesion on ultrasound or MRI. MRI findings were interpreted as a burned-out primary. Orchiectomy revealed diffuse intertubular seminoma with fibro-sclerotic remodeling and no macroscopic mass. After three cycles of chemotherapy he achieved complete metabolic response. The authors conclude that subtle testicular abnormalities in metastatic seminoma should prompt orchiectomy to establish primary-site pathology.

pmid-42224890.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化から生じる原発性卵巣悪性黒色腫の症例を、76研究・92例で系統的にレビューし、プール解析しました。死亡は62%で、病期の進行とともに全生存期間は短縮しました。免疫療法は未調整解析で生存と関連しましたが、病期Iに限ると有意ではありませんでした。全病期で予後不良であり、国際共同研究と希少がん登録の必要性を指摘しています。
pmid-42224890.summary_en: This systematic review and pooled analysis identified 76 studies reporting 92 patients with primary ovarian malignant melanoma, which typically arises from malignant transformation of a mature cystic teratoma. Mean age at diagnosis was 50.6 years. Almost half were International Federation of Gynaecology and Obstetrics stage I, and 62% of patients died. Median overall survival declined with advancing stage. Chemotherapy, immunotherapy, radiotherapy, and targeted therapy were used as adjuvant treatments. Immunotherapy appeared associated with better survival in an unadjusted analysis, but this was not significant in stage I disease.

pmid-42228290.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のマーカーmiR-371a-3p測定(M371-Test)について、血漿と血清を比較した前向き多施設研究の中間解析です。感度は血漿92.5%、血清94.0%、特異度は血漿100%、血清92.9%で、血漿での診断性能は同等でした。採血後の取り扱いを簡便化できる可能性が示されています。
pmid-42228290.summary_en: This interim analysis of a prospective multicenter study compared the M371-Test for miR-371a-3p in paired plasma and serum from 109 patients, 67 with germ cell tumors and 42 controls. Sensitivity was 92.5 percent in plasma and 94.0 percent in serum, while specificity was 100 percent in plasma and 92.9 percent in serum. The specificity difference was concentrated in patients in post-treatment remission. Plasma collected in S-Monovette cfDNA Exact tubes may simplify preanalytical handling and ambient storage, which requires formal stability evaluation.

pmid-42228851.summary_ja: 1990〜2022年に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた進行性胚細胞腫瘍206例の後方視的解析である。27.2%で血管修復などの追加手技を要した。初診時の腫瘍径と病理標本の生存腫瘍が独立した危険因子であった。手術計画では初期腫瘍量を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-42228851.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 206 patients with advanced germ cell tumors who underwent post-chemotherapy RPLND between 1990 and 2022. Additional intraoperative procedures, mostly vascular repairs, were needed in 27.2% of patients. Multivariate analysis identified tumor size at initial diagnosis and viable tumor in the pathology specimen as independent risk factors. The authors recommend that surgical planning account for initial tumor burden and the likelihood of residual viable disease to optimize perioperative outcomes.

pmid-42230008.summary_ja: 感染した仙尾部奇形腫に続発する再発性右殿部膿瘍と肛門狭窄を呈した乳児の症例です。精査の結果Currarino症候群と診断され、感染奇形腫の切除を含む複数回の手術を受けました。再発に対して多職種による経過観察が続けられています。仙尾部奇形腫が殿部膿瘍として発症するのはまれで、一般的な急性外科疾患と誤認されやすいと述べています。
pmid-42230008.summary_en: This case report describes an infant with recurrent right gluteal abscess secondary to an infected sacrococcygeal teratoma and associated anal stenosis. Extensive workup led to a diagnosis of Currarino syndrome, and the patient underwent multiple surgical procedures including excision of the infected teratoma. The child remains under multidisciplinary surveillance for recurrence. The authors emphasize that sacrococcygeal teratomas rarely present as gluteal abscesses and can mimic common acute surgical conditions, creating diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.

pmid-42231028.summary_ja: 一次化学療法終了後3か月以内に死亡した転移性胚細胞腫瘍102例の多施設後方視的コホートでは、死亡までの期間中央値は28日であった。主な死因は急性呼吸不全（34.1%）、疾患進行、敗血症性ショック、出血であった。肝転移、広範な肺病変、β-hCG高値などが早期死亡と関連し、早期の同定と支持療法の最適化が求められると結論づけられた。
pmid-42231028.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter cohort of 102 adults with metastatic germ cell tumors who died within 3 months of completing first-line chemotherapy found a median time to death of 28 days. Leading causes were acute respiratory failure (34.1%), disease progression, septic shock, and hemorrhage. Early death was associated with liver metastases, massive lung involvement, β-hCG above 50,000 mIU/mL, poor performance status, elevated neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio, and need for intensive care. The authors call for early identification, adapted induction regimens, and optimized supportive care.

pmid-42232113.summary_ja: 20歳女性の神経精神症状悪化と焦点発作。抗NMDAR抗体陽性と卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が確認され、72時間以内の早期腫瘍切除と免疫療法で5週間後に神経症状が改善した。自己免疫性脳炎の多職種管理と超早期切除の安全性を示す。
pmid-42232113.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old woman with subacute neuropsychiatric decline and focal seizures, found to have anti-NMDA receptor antibodies and a large ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Surgical resection was performed within 72 hours, before antibody confirmation, followed by plasma exchange, IV immunoglobulin, and rituximab. She showed gradual, sustained neurological recovery after five weeks of inpatient treatment. The authors support multidisciplinary care and the safety of ultra-early tumor resection in paraneoplastic autoimmune encephalitis.

pmid-42233170.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の凍結精子によるICSIの結果を、非TGCTがん患者と比較した観察研究である。TGCT群で自然流産率が有意に高く（43.8%対9.1%）、妊娠率に差はなかった。精子の染色体異常やDNA断片化が関与すると考察し、治療後の精子の利用や着床前遺伝学的検査を提案している。
pmid-42233170.summary_en: This observational study compared ICSI outcomes using cryopreserved sperm from 12 patients with testicular germ cell tumor and 25 patients with non-TGCT cancer. The spontaneous miscarriage rate was significantly higher in the TGCT group (43.8% vs 9.1%), while pregnancy rates did not differ. The authors attribute this to chromosomal abnormalities or DNA fragmentation in TGCT sperm. They suggest that natural conception or post-treatment sperm may be preferable, and that preimplantation genetic testing may be considered in selected cases.

pmid-42238946.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫の治療後に腹膜結節を生じた12歳女児の症例。画像では再発が疑われたが腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。シングルポート・ロボット支援下に切除し、病理で腹膜神経膠腫症と確定した。12か月間の経過観察で再発はなかった。病理学的確認の重要性と、思春期での低侵襲手術の有用性を述べている。
pmid-42238946.summary_en: This case report describes a 12-year-old girl with immature ovarian teratoma who developed multiple peritoneal nodules after initial surgery and chemotherapy. Imaging raised concern for recurrence, while serum tumor markers stayed normal. Single-port robotic-assisted exploration and resection of all visible peritoneal lesions were performed. Histopathology showed mature astrocytic glial tissue with low proliferative activity, confirming gliomatosis peritonei. Recovery was rapid and wound healing satisfactory, with no recurrence during 12 months of follow-up. The authors conclude that histopathological confirmation is essential to distinguish gliomatosis peritonei from malignant recurrence, and that single-port robotic surgery is a feasible minimally invasive option in adolescents.

pmid-42239814.summary_ja: オマーンの生後2週間の女児で、腹部膨満と哺乳不良を呈し、画像で純粋な嚢胞性仙骨前部病変が見つかりました。腹腔鏡補助下の嚢胞切除と尾骨切除を行い、成熟嚢胞性仙尾部奇形腫(Altman IV型)と確定しました。軽微な創離開を除き経過は順調で、再発はありませんでした。新生児での腹腔鏡補助下切除は実行可能であると述べています。
pmid-42239814.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-week-old girl in Oman with abdominal distension and feeding intolerance, whose imaging revealed a purely cystic presacral lesion. Laparoscopic-assisted cyst excision with coccygectomy was performed, and histopathology confirmed a mature cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma, classified as purely cystic Altman type IV. Postoperative recovery was uneventful apart from minor wound dehiscence, which resolved conservatively, and there was no recurrence at follow-up. The authors note that purely cystic type IV sacrococcygeal teratomas are rare and difficult to diagnose, and that complete excision with coccygectomy is the cornerstone of treatment.

pmid-42240645.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍188例を対象に、多パラメータMRIのラジオミクスと機械学習でセミノーマと非セミノーマを鑑別する多施設研究である。臨床情報を組み合わせたSVMモデルの外部テストAUCは0.846であった。AFPと嚢胞性壊死が有意な予測因子であった。
pmid-42240645.summary_en: This multicenter diagnostic study developed machine learning models using multiparametric MRI radiomics to distinguish testicular seminoma from non-seminoma in 188 patients. The best model combined DWI, ADC, T2WI, and contrast-enhanced T1WI features with clinical data, using an SVM classifier, achieving AUCs of 0.934, 0.922, and 0.846 in training, validation, and external test sets. AFP and cystic necrosis were significant clinical predictors. The authors conclude the combined model is precise, robust, and adaptable for preoperative differentiation.

pmid-42243417.summary_ja: 1990〜2023年に治療した高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）患者47例を後方視的に検討した研究である。エトポシドを含む多剤化学療法の累積投与量が6,000 mg/m2以上の4例（8.5%）で治療関連骨髄性腫瘍が発生し、全例が死亡した。KMT2A再構成とIDH1/2変異を認めた。エトポシドの高用量累積曝露が白血病化のリスクとなり、長期的な血液学的監視の必要性を示している。
pmid-42243417.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 47 patients with high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated at one institution between 1990 and 2023. Four patients (8.5%) developed therapy-related myeloid neoplasms after prolonged etoposide-containing multi-agent chemotherapy, with cumulative etoposide doses of at least 6,000 mg/m2. Onset ranged from 3 to 5 years after GTN treatment initiation. KMT2A rearrangements and IDH1/2 mutations were identified. Despite allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, all four patients died. The authors conclude that high cumulative etoposide exposure carries leukemogenic risk and recommend long-term hematologic surveillance.

pmid-42250912.summary_ja: 62か国132施設のデータを用い、仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)とCurrarino症候群の仙骨前奇形腫における悪性転化を比較した国際的後方視的コホート研究。対象3,388例のうちSCTは3,183例、CSは205例。初回切除時の悪性転化率は、SCTで1年10.3%、2年31.9%、CSでは2年4.2%と有意に高かった。再発奇形腫の悪性組織は、SCTで35.4%、CSで5.9%であった。生存率は両群で同等だった(94.9%対96.9%)。CSでは悪性は稀と結論づけている。
pmid-42250912.summary_en: This global retrospective cohort study compared malignant transformation of sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) with presacral teratoma in Currarino syndrome (CS), using data from 132 institutions in 62 countries. Among 3,388 patients, 3,183 had SCT and 205 had CS. Malignant transformation at initial resection was markedly higher in SCT (10.3% and 31.9% at one and two years) than in CS (4.2% at two years). Recurrent teratomas were malignant more often in SCT (35.4% vs 5.9%). Survival was equivalent between groups (94.9% vs 96.9%).

pmid-42252251.summary_ja: 19研究70例のシステマティックレビューと、多施設後方視的解析による4例の症例集積を合わせた検討です。74例中40例が総合的治療を受け、3年全生存期間(全生存率)は50.8%でした。多変量解析では、単一モダリティ治療または無治療のみが予後不良と関連しました。総合的治療が転帰改善に重要と結論しています。
pmid-42252251.summary_en: This study combines a systematic literature review of 19 studies with 70 patients and a multicenter retrospective series of four pediatric patients with non-gestational choriocarcinoma. Among 74 pooled patients, 40 received comprehensive treatment, and the 3-year overall survival was 50.8%. Univariate analysis associated age, primary tumor site, and treatment modality with survival, but multivariate analysis showed that only single-modality treatment or no treatment predicted poor prognosis. The authors conclude that the disease is aggressive and that comprehensive multimodal treatment is crucial for improving outcomes.

pmid-42254200.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対し根治的鼠径精巣摘除術を受けた16年後に、無痛性の肉眼的血尿を呈した52歳男性。膀胱の浸潤性腫瘤が前立腺と尿管遠位部へ進展し、高度の水腎症を伴っていた。腫瘍マーカーは正常で、古典的セミノーマと確定した。白金製剤による化学療法と尿路減圧を行った。
pmid-42254200.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old man who presented with painless hematuria 16 years after radical inguinal orchidectomy for stage I testicular seminoma. A large infiltrative bladder mass extended into the prostate and distal ureter, causing severe hydronephrosis. Tumor markers were normal, and transurethral resection with immunohistochemistry confirmed classical seminoma. Regional lymph node involvement without distant metastasis was found, and he was treated with platinum-based chemotherapy and urinary decompression. The authors stress that tumor markers may be normal in late recurrence and that histopathological confirmation is essential.

pmid-42255871.summary_ja: 26歳男性の原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。化学療法、自家造血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法、手術、放射線療法を行ったが進行した。ペムブロリズマブを開始したが、2か月でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が44,053から90,123 ng/mLに上昇し、画像上も進行した。その後脊髄転移による硬膜外進展と対麻痺が生じ、緩和放射線療法後も進行により死亡した。白金製剤抵抗性腫瘍の攻撃的な生物学的特性と、PD-1阻害に対する一次抵抗性を指摘している。
pmid-42255871.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old man with primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor that progressed despite chemotherapy, high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation, surgery, and radiation. Pembrolizumab was started, but alpha-fetoprotein rose from 44,053 to 90,123 ng/mL within two months, with radiographic progression. He then developed spinal metastases with epidural extension and paraplegia, and died of progressive metastatic disease despite palliative radiation. The authors highlight the aggressive biology of platinum-resistant tumors and primary resistance to PD-1 inhibition.

pmid-42256088.summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣腫瘤177例を超音波検査で追跡した多施設後方視的研究です。腫瘤は妊娠後期に縮小し、若年と高い妊娠前BMIが増大因子でした。妊娠中の手術は経過観察群と比べて転帰に差がなく安全でした。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が40%で最多、悪性率は2.5%でした。
pmid-42256088.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective study analyzed 177 pregnant women with ovarian masses, assessing size changes by ultrasound and their impact on pregnancy outcomes. Masses decreased in size from the first trimester to the third trimester and further after delivery. Younger age and higher prepregnancy BMI were associated with mass enlargement during pregnancy. Surgery during pregnancy was safe and did not differ in outcomes from follow-up. Mature cystic teratoma was the most common pathology at 40%, and the overall malignancy rate was 2.5%.

pmid-42256664.summary_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群の29歳男性が、30 cmの腹骨盤部腫瘤で受診した。生検で精巣セミノーマと診断され、術前化学療法後の手術で子宮と右付属器が確認された。著者らは、本疾患の治療上の難しさと、妊孕性の温存および精巣変性の防止のための早期診断の重要性を強調している。
