pmid-42256664.summary_en: A 29-year-old man with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome presented with a 30 cm abdominopelvic mass. Biopsy diagnosed testicular seminoma. After neoadjuvant chemotherapy, surgery revealed a uterus and right adnexa. The authors highlight the therapeutic challenges of this rare condition in the case, and the importance of early diagnosis to optimize fertility and reduce the risk of testicular degeneration.

pmid-42259504.summary_ja: 18歳女性の右耳後部に10年以上認められた無症候性の腫瘤。MRIでT1・T2強調像とも高信号を示した。右浅葉耳下腺切除術を合併症なく施行し、病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。性腺外の奇形腫は耳下腺では極めて稀であり、鑑別診断に含める必要性を強調している。
pmid-42259504.summary_en: This report describes an 18-year-old woman with a painless, slow-growing mass in the right postauricular region present for over a decade. MRI showed a lobulated lesion with high signal on T1- and T2-weighted images. She underwent successful right superficial parotidectomy without complications, and histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. The authors emphasize that extragonadal teratoma, though exceedingly rare in the parotid gland, should be included in the differential diagnosis of long-standing asymptomatic parotid masses. A literature review is included.

pmid-42259548.summary_ja: 上大静脈症候群と肺・リンパ節転移を伴う原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の24歳男性の症例です。化学療法と部分切除後に脳転移が生じ、化学療法と頭蓋放射線療法で完全寛解しました。6年後の骨転移の再切除では化学療法関連の悪性転化による腺癌が判明しました。全生存期間(全生存率)は82か月で、腫瘍マーカーと画像による経時的な経過観察の重要性を示しています。
pmid-42259548.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with primary mediastinal yolk sac tumor who presented with superior vena cava syndrome and pulmonary and lymph node metastases. After chemotherapy and partial resection, brain metastasis developed and achieved complete remission with chemotherapy plus cranial radiotherapy. Bone metastases appeared six years later, and re-resection revealed adenocarcinoma consistent with chemotherapy-related malignant transformation. Despite multiple lines of chemotherapy and radiotherapy, the disease progressed, with overall survival of 82 months. The case highlights the value of dynamic tumor marker and imaging surveillance.

pmid-42260927.summary_ja: 三次医療機関で2015〜2024年に抗NMDAR脳炎と診断された106例の後方視的コホート研究である。卵巣奇形腫関連例（23例）は急性期重症度が高く、ICU入室率と人工呼吸管理率が高かった。急性期の38%でHPO軸抑制を認めたが、回復期には黄体形成ホルモンとエストラジオールが有意に改善した。妊娠率は両群で同程度であり、卵巣機能障害は多くが可逆的と考えられた。
pmid-42260927.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 106 women with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis at a tertiary hospital (2015-2024) examined ovarian endocrine recovery and fertility. Teratoma-associated cases (n = 23) had more severe acute disease, with higher ICU admission and mechanical ventilation rates. Although 38% of patients showed HPO axis suppression during the acute phase, luteinizing hormone and estradiol levels improved significantly during convalescence. Pregnancy rates were similar between teratoma (80%) and non-teratoma (83.3%) groups. Ovarian dysfunction appears largely reversible, supporting fertility counseling and reproductive health monitoring in young women.

pmid-42261685.summary_ja: 36歳男性の嚢胞性頸部奇形腫の症例報告である。病理所見で扁平上皮や皮脂腺などの三胚葉成分を認め、FISHで核の24%に12p染色体の増加が検出された。精巣超音波検査で性腺原発は否定された。形態学と分子検査の統合が成人の頸部腫瘤の評価に有用であると述べている。
pmid-42261685.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a cystic neck teratoma, a very rare head and neck germ cell neoplasm. Histology showed squamous epithelium, sebaceous glands, hair, and smooth muscle, and fluorescence in situ hybridization detected chromosome 12p gain in 24% of nuclei. Testicular ultrasound excluded a gonadal primary, confirming a primary cervical teratoma. The authors argue that combining morphology with molecular testing aids evaluation of adult neck masses and may clarify the biological potential of these tumors.

pmid-42265043.summary_ja: 精巣がんの治療による晩期毒性を、腫瘍制御を損なわずに減らす戦略を総説した。白金製剤化学療法や放射線療法による心血管障害、聴力障害、二次性悪性腫瘍を整理し、病期II精巣セミノーマに対する初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清の役割を論じている。miR-371のバイオマーカーとしての可能性や、MRIと遠隔診療を用いた低負担の経過観察にも言及している。
pmid-42265043.summary_en: This narrative review examines strategies to reduce long-term toxicity in testicular cancer while preserving oncologic efficacy. It discusses toxicities of platinum chemotherapy and radiotherapy, including cardiovascular disease, ototoxicity, and secondary malignancies, and the role of primary RPLND in stage II seminoma as an alternative to chemotherapy. Surgical refinements such as the midline extraperitoneal approach and robotic techniques are described. The authors also highlight microRNA-371 as a potential biomarker and the shift toward less intensive surveillance with MRI and telehealth.

pmid-42267015.summary_ja: 前立腺癌と新規診断された51歳男性の病期分類検査で、前縦隔腫瘤が奇形腫として偶発的に見つかった症例です。ロボット支援胸腺摘出術で成熟奇形腫が大腸型腺癌に悪性転化していることが判明しました。循環腫瘍DNAは測定可能な残存病変陰性で、画像検査と腫瘍マーカーによる経過観察が行われています。縦隔の成熟奇形腫の悪性転化はきわめてまれです。
pmid-42267015.summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old man with prostate cancer in whom an incidental anterior mediastinal mass suggested a teratoma on staging workup. Robotic thymectomy revealed a mature teratoma with malignant transformation to colorectal-type adenocarcinoma. Circulating tumor DNA was negative for measurable residual disease, and the patient was managed with surveillance including serial imaging and tumor marker monitoring. Mature teratomas account for 5% to 10% of mediastinal tumors, but malignant transformation is exceedingly rare, making this case clinically notable for surveillance planning.

pmid-42269538.summary_ja: 奇形腫を背景に生じた原発性卵巣カルチノイド13例の後方視的解析。閉経後女性が多く、卵巣甲状腺腫由来が過半数を占めた。約半数でエストロゲン過剰の所見があった。全例がシナプトフィジン陽性でKi-67は低値だった。5例の遺伝子解析で1例にARID1A変異を認めた。
pmid-42269538.summary_en: This retrospective study describes 13 primary ovarian carcinoid tumors, all arising within a teratomatous background. Most were strumal carcinoids in postmenopausal women with a median age of 55. Nearly half showed estrogen excess, including two with concurrent endometrial carcinoma. All tumors were diffusely synaptophysin positive with low Ki-67 indices. Next-generation sequencing of five tumors showed heterogeneous mutations, and an ARID1A p.Q1494* variant was found in one mixed-architecture tumor, which the authors describe as exploratory.

pmid-42271123.summary_ja: 2000〜2022年に外科的切除を受けた原発性後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の小児24例を解析した、フランスの多施設後方視的研究。8例が術前化学療法を受け、そのうち5例で腫瘍進行を認めた。R0切除は75%で達成された。病理では成熟奇形腫11例、未熟奇形腫9例、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う悪性胚細胞腫瘍4例が含まれた。中央値7.1年の観察で91.6%が再発なく生存している。術前化学療法は効果が限られ、growing teratoma syndromeのリスクがあるため慎重に検討すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-42271123.summary_en: This French national multicenter retrospective study analyzed 24 children with primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumors who underwent surgery between 2000 and 2022. Eight received neoadjuvant chemotherapy, and five of them progressed. R0 resection was achieved in 75%. Histology showed 11 mature and 9 immature teratomas, plus 4 malignant GCTs with yolk sac tumor components. Major complications occurred in 21%, and two children died. At a median follow-up of 7.1 years, 91.6% were alive without recurrence. The authors advise caution with neoadjuvant chemotherapy, which may limit tumor volume reduction and risk growing teratoma syndrome.

pmid-42271363.summary_ja: 2004年から2024年に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍81例を対象とした後方視的単施設研究です。3日間修正BEP療法の5年無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は97.5%でした。ブレオマイシン誘発性肺炎は4.9%に生じ、妊娠を試みた30例中90%が妊娠しました。毒性が少なく妊孕性を保てる治療として提案されています。
pmid-42271363.summary_en: This retrospective single-center study evaluated a 3-day modified BEP regimen (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) in 81 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 2004 and 2024. Most patients had early-stage disease and underwent primary surgery, with fertility-sparing surgery in 73 cases. After a median follow-up of over nine years, the 5-year progression-free survival rate was 97.5%, and bleomycin-induced pneumonitis occurred in 4.9%. Among 30 women attempting conception, 90% became pregnant. The authors propose the regimen as a safer, more convenient alternative that preserves fertility.

pmid-42272775.summary_ja: 周期性の左下腹部痛と増大する腫瘤を呈した34歳未経妊女性の症例である。術前は類皮嚢腫と両側子宮内膜症性嚢胞が疑われたが、手術で左卵管から生じる大きな嚢胞が見つかり、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。極めて稀な発生部位であり術前診断が困難なため、複雑な付属器腫瘤の鑑別に本疾患を含めることが推奨された。
pmid-42272775.summary_en: A 34-year-old nulliparous woman presented with cyclical left lower abdominal pain and an enlarging mass, initially suspected to be a dermoid cyst with bilateral endometriomas. Intraoperatively a large cyst arising from the left fallopian tube was found, and histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma coexisting with bilateral ovarian endometriomas. The authors highlight the diagnostic difficulty of this exceedingly rare site and recommend considering fallopian tube mature cystic teratoma in the differential of complex adnexal masses.

pmid-42277552.summary_ja: 米国の保険請求データベースを用い、再発・難治性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の成人男性に対する緩和的化学療法を後方視的に解析した研究です。緩和的化学療法までの中央値は12.5か月で、ゲムシタビン・オキサリプラチンが最多でした。リアルワールド全生存期間の中央値は7.7か月と予後は不良でした。新規治療の必要性を示しています。
pmid-42277552.summary_en: This real-world claims-based study of the Komodo database assessed palliative chemotherapy in adult men with relapsed or refractory testicular germ cell tumors. Among 51 patients for treatment patterns, median time from diagnosis to palliative chemotherapy was 12.5 months, with gemcitabine-oxaliplatin the most common regimen. In 80 patients with prior salvage therapy, median real-world overall survival was 7.7 months and time to real-world progression 3.8 months. Outcomes were poor across high-dose and conventional-dose subgroups, underscoring the need for novel therapies.

pmid-42278990.summary_ja: 妊娠29週2日に胎児の仙尾部腫瘤様病変が偶然見つかった症例。緊急帝王切開で娩出され、生後数日以内に切除された。病理学的に未熟奇形腫と診断され、児は良好に発育した。出生前画像診断と三次施設での多職種管理の重要性を強調している。
pmid-42278990.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with a sacrococcygeal lesion detected incidentally at 29 weeks and 2 days of gestation. Delivery was performed by emergency cesarean section, and the tumor was resected within the first days of life. Final pathology showed an immature teratoma, and the child developed normally. The authors stress the importance of detailed prenatal imaging, fetal echocardiography, and multidisciplinary care at a tertiary center. A literature review on prenatal diagnosis and treatment of sacrococcygeal teratoma is included.

pmid-42281742.summary_ja: 原発性無月経と高ゴナドトロピン性性腺機能低下を呈した46,XY完全型性腺異形成の16歳表現型女性の症例です。開腹手術で両側卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）にリンパ節転移を伴うIIIC期と確定しました。原発性無月経では核型分析が必須で、診断の遅れは進行癌につながると強調しています。
pmid-42281742.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old phenotypic female with 46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis (Swyer syndrome) who presented with primary amenorrhea and hypergonadotropic hypogonadism. Imaging revealed pelvic masses, and laparotomy confirmed bilateral ovarian dysgerminoma with para-aortic and pelvic lymph node metastases, staged as FIGO IIIC. The patient was referred for adjuvant chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that karyotype analysis is essential in primary amenorrhea with hypergonadotropic hypogonadism to detect 46,XY disorders of sex development and their high risk of gonadal malignancy, and that diagnostic delay can lead to advanced cancer.

pmid-42286960.summary_ja: 停留精巣の成人患者194例（210精巣）の後方視的コホート研究です。精巣固定術後の解剖学的成功率は80%で、約43%の精巣に高度の精子形成障害が認められました。術後48か月で同側にセミノーマを発症した1例があり、悪性腫瘍リスクが残るため長期フォローアップの必要性が示されています。
pmid-42286960.summary_en: This single-center retrospective cohort study of 194 postpubertal cryptorchid patients (210 testes) evaluated outcomes after orchiopexy between 2018 and 2024. Anatomical success at three months was 80%, with recurrence and atrophy in about 10% each. Histologically, 43% of testes had severe spermatogenic impairment, which was independently associated with high testicular position and smaller testicular volume. One patient developed ipsilateral seminoma 48 months after orchiopexy. The authors conclude that spermatogenic impairment is often established before surgery, so the main value of orchiopexy lies in anatomical repositioning, pathological assessment, and facilitating long-term surveillance because malignancy risk is not eliminated.

pmid-42288209.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、選択的PI3Kγ阻害薬エガネリシブを胎児性癌細胞株NCCITとマウスモデルで検討した前臨床研究。in vitroでは、AKT1依存的にAKT1-OCT4/SOX2軸を阻害し、増殖・遊走・浸潤・幹細胞性を抑制した。in vivoではシスプラチンと同等の抗腫瘍効果を示し、卵巣予備能、ホルモンバランス、妊孕性を維持した。卵巣ではPTENの発現上昇とGSK3β活性の増強が認められた。妊孕性を温存する治療戦略として有望と述べている。
pmid-42288209.summary_en: This preclinical study tested the selective PI3Kγ inhibitor eganelisib in malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, using the human embryonal carcinoma cell line NCCIT and mouse models. In vitro, eganelisib suppressed proliferation, migration, invasion, and stemness through AKT1-dependent disruption of the AKT1-OCT4/SOX2 axis. In vivo, it matched cisplatin's antitumor effect while preserving ovarian reserve, hormone balance, and fertility. Mechanistically, it upregulated PTEN and enhanced GSK3β activity in the ovary. The authors propose it as a fertility-sparing strategy.

pmid-42289107.summary_ja: 妊娠終結後、超音波所見がわずかで非典型的に低いβ-hCG値のため診断が遅れた絨毛癌の症例です。病変は肺、脳、肝臓に転移しました。外科的介入と多剤化学療法、放射線療法の併用で、進行期でも持続的寛解が得られました。妊娠終結後の定期的なβ-hCG測定と早期の形態学的確認の必要性を強調しています。
pmid-42289107.summary_en: This case report describes choriocarcinoma with multiple metastases in a patient whose early diagnosis after pregnancy termination was delayed because ultrasound changes were minimal and β-hCG levels were atypically low. The disease spread from the reproductive tract to the lungs, brain, and liver. Treatment combined surgical intervention with polychemotherapy and radiation therapy, achieving sustained remission despite advanced stage. The authors stress regular β-hCG monitoring and early morphological confirmation after any pregnancy termination, and note the high chemosensitivity of choriocarcinoma. The report also discusses diagnostic pitfalls in suspected gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-42289382.summary_ja: 2005〜2015年にルーマニアの三次施設で治療した精巣がん246例の後方視的コホート研究。非セミノーマ性混合型胚細胞腫瘍が最も多く、約3分の1が進行期だった。最終追跡時の生存者は85.4%だった。病期とIGCCCGリスク分類が生存と関連した。
pmid-42289382.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study analyzed 246 patients with testicular cancer treated at a Romanian tertiary center between 2005 and 2015. Non-seminomatous mixed germ cell tumors were the most common histology, and about one-third presented with advanced disease. At last follow-up, 85.4% of patients were alive. Overall survival was estimated by Kaplan-Meier analysis, and Cox regression provided adjusted hazard ratios. Survival was better in early-stage disease and worse with advanced stage and poor IGCCCG risk, supporting the prognostic value of these factors.

pmid-42289757.summary_ja: 流産後5か月の40歳女性が頭痛や痙攣で発症し、脳実質内血腫と硬膜下血腫を認めた症例です。β-hCGは1500 IU/Lでした。開頭術で血腫除去と転移病変の切除を行い、病理組織学的に絨毛癌と診断されました。肺と子宮への転移を伴うFIGO病期IVで、多剤併用化学療法により神経症状は改善し、β-hCGも正常化しました。原因不明の頭蓋内出血では、生殖年齢女性のβ-hCG測定が重要と指摘しています。
pmid-42289757.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman who presented with severe headache, seizures, and right-sided weakness five months after a spontaneous abortion. Imaging showed an intraparenchymal hemorrhagic mass and a concurrent subdural hematoma. Serum β-hCG was 1500 IU/L. Urgent craniotomy evacuated the hematoma and resected the metastatic lesion, which histopathology confirmed as choriocarcinoma. Staging revealed pulmonary and uterine involvement, consistent with FIGO stage IV disease. Multi-agent chemotherapy led to neurological recovery and normalization of β-hCG. The authors emphasize measuring β-hCG in women of reproductive age with unexplained intracranial hemorrhage.

pmid-42291633.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍でBEP化学療法を受けた85例を対象とした非ランダム化単施設コホート研究。治療中と治療後の胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と肺機能検査の変化を評価した。2サイクル後には21%に放射線学的なブレオマイシン肺毒性、20%に肺機能低下が認められた。CTと肺機能変化の関連は有意だった(OR 10.65)。多くは時間経過で肺機能が回復し、症状のない患者にはBEP中の定期的CTを行うべきでないと結論づけている。
pmid-42291633.summary_en: This nonrandomized monocentric cohort study examined 85 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors receiving BEP chemotherapy, assessing chest CT changes and pulmonary function tests during and after treatment. After two cycles, 21% had radiographic bleomycin-induced pulmonary toxicity and 20% had PFT deterioration. CT and PFT changes were significantly associated (OR 10.65). Most PFTs recovered over time, and radiographic changes did not correlate with later PFT. The authors advise against routine CT during BEP unless patients have symptoms.

pmid-42291940.summary_ja: 胃癌の病期分類のためのPET/CT検査で、偶発的に骨盤内腫瘤が見つかった53歳女性の症例です。腫瘤はFDG集積を示さず、CTで歯牙様石灰化と脂肪成分があり、超音波検査で卵巣奇形腫と確認されました。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫はPET/CTで代謝的に不活性ですが、CT形態で同定可能です。他の悪性腫瘍の検査で見つかる卵巣病変への注意を促しています。
pmid-42291940.summary_en: This case report describes a 53-year-old woman with gastric carcinoma in whom FDG PET/CT performed for staging incidentally detected a pelvic mass. The lesion showed no FDG uptake but had tooth-like calcifications and fatty components on CT, suggesting ovarian teratoma, which targeted ultrasonography confirmed. Mature cystic teratomas typically appear metabolically inactive on PET/CT, but their characteristic CT morphology allows reliable identification. The authors emphasize that clinicians should recognize incidental ovarian pathologies found during PET/CT performed for unrelated malignancies, as these can be clinically important.

pmid-42292165.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の患者が、出血を伴う脈絡膜病変による視覚症状で受診し、基礎疾患の診断に至った症例を報告している。既報の絨毛癌による脈絡膜転移をメタ解析的にまとめ、視力障害と予後不良の関連を示した。脈絡膜黒色腫との鑑別にはマルチモーダルイメージングが有用である。
pmid-42292165.summary_en: This report describes a patient with testicular choriocarcinoma whose initial presentation was visual symptoms from a hemorrhagic choroidal lesion, which led to diagnosis of the underlying malignancy. The authors summarize prior reports of choroidal metastasis from choriocarcinoma, which are associated with substantial vision loss and poor survival. Choroidal metastases often cause intraocular hemorrhage and can mimic choroidal melanoma, so multimodal imaging aids differentiation. In patients presenting with choroidal lesions and hemorrhage, metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma should be considered.

pmid-42292176.summary_ja: 2年かけて進行した左陰嚢の腫瘤(2.51kg)を呈した30代後半男性の症例報告です。血清AFP、hCG、LDHは正常範囲でした。根治的精巣摘除術と免疫染色により純粋セミノーマと確定しました。調理油の煙への曝露や慢性的な睡眠不足などの環境要因が、今後検討すべき修正可能な因子として論じられています。
pmid-42292176.summary_en: This case report describes a man in his late 30s with a giant left testicular mass weighing 2.51 kg (22 × 14 × 12 cm), developed over two years. He had occupational exposure to high-temperature cooking oil fumes, long working hours, sleep deprivation, smoking, and alcohol use. Serum AFP, hCG, and LDH were normal. Radical orchiectomy and immunohistochemistry (PLAP+, CD117+, SALL4+, CKpan-, CD30-) confirmed pure seminoma. The authors suggest that environmental carcinogens and chronic sleep deprivation may be modifiable factors deserving investigation, while acknowledging that causality is not established. Delayed diagnosis allowed unusual tumor growth.

pmid-42294116.summary_ja: hCGが著明に高値（455,501 mIU/mL）で子宮内妊娠を認めず、破裂子宮外妊娠として緊急手術を受けた36歳女性の症例報告である。腹腔鏡で盲腸周囲の腫瘤を認め、腹腔内腫瘤から絨毛癌が確認された。FIGO病期IV期、WHOスコア10に分類され、EMA-CO療法5コースで寛解を得た。子宮内妊娠がないにもかかわらずhCGが著明に高い場合は、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を考慮すべきと強調している。
pmid-42294116.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with markedly elevated beta-hCG (455,501 mIU/mL), no intrauterine pregnancy, and hemoperitoneum initially presumed to be a ruptured ectopic pregnancy. Laparoscopy revealed a peri-cecal mass, and pathology showed choriocarcinoma in the peritoneal mass with atypical trophoblastic proliferation in curettage specimens. Classified as FIGO stage IV with a WHO score of 10, she achieved sustained remission after five cycles of EMA-CO chemotherapy. The authors stress that markedly elevated hCG without an intrauterine pregnancy should prompt consideration of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-42294314.summary_ja: 34歳男性の左横隔膜に生じた5.1 cmの成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。血清CA19-9の単独上昇（401.00 U/mL）を認めた。腹腔鏡下に完全切除し、横隔膜脚の修復とNissen噴門形成術を同時に施行した。3か月の経過観察で無症状、CA19-9は正常化し、再発を示唆する所見はなかった。単独のCA19-9上昇が原発性横隔膜奇形腫に関連しうると考察している。
pmid-42294314.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with a 5.1 cm mixed cystic-solid mass in the left hemidiaphragm, an exceptionally rare site for teratoma. He presented with mild discomfort and isolated elevation of serum CA19-9 (401 U/mL). Laparoscopic complete excision was performed with primary crural repair and Nissen fundoplication to prevent hernia and reflux. Histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. At three-month follow-up, he was asymptomatic, CA19-9 had normalized, and there was no evidence of recurrence. The authors suggest isolated CA19-9 elevation may be associated with primary diaphragmatic teratomas.

pmid-42296720.summary_ja: セミノーマにおけるHAVCR2(TIM-3)の予後的意義を、TCGAコホートの転写産物解析、4遺伝子のエラスティックネット回帰によるスクリーニング、独立した組織マイクロアレイでの免疫組織化学により検討した研究。TCGAでは高発現で無増悪期間が良好な傾向があった。TMAでは高TIM-3発現が良好な無再発生存と関連し、統合解析でも無イベント生存期間の改善が見られた。探索的な結果であり、前向きな検証が必要と結論している。
pmid-42296720.summary_en: This study examined the prognostic role of HAVCR2 (TIM-3) in seminoma by combining transcriptomic data from the TCGA cohort, elastic-net Cox screening of four immune checkpoint genes, and immunohistochemistry in an independent tissue microarray cohort. Higher HAVCR2 expression showed a trend toward better progression-free interval in TCGA. In the TMA cohort, high TIM-3 was associated with favorable relapse-free survival, and in the pooled cohort with improved event-free survival. The findings are exploratory, and the authors call for prospective validation.

pmid-42299463.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群における腫瘍リスクを整理した総説。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のリスク上昇が示され、非ホジキンリンパ腫や白血病など血液悪性腫瘍も増加傾向にある。精巣がんのリスク増加は明確ではないと整理している。
pmid-42299463.summary_en: This narrative review summarizes clinical evidence on neoplastic risk in Klinefelter syndrome, based on a PubMed search. The syndrome is associated with an increased risk of breast cancer, mediastinal germ cell tumors, and hematologic malignancies such as non-Hodgkin lymphoma and leukemia. Evidence on testicular cancer is limited, with no clear increase in risk, while prostate cancer risk and mortality are lower. The authors recommend regular clinical follow-up with targeted investigations when indicated to facilitate early diagnosis.

pmid-42304701.summary_ja: 大動脈大静脈間セミノーマ再発に対し、ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った35歳男性の症例報告です。造影CTから作成した患者固有の高精度3DモデルとAR技術を術前計画と術中ナビゲーションに用いました。腎動脈分枝を安全に同定でき、76分で出血30mLと合併症なく完遂しました。9か月後も再発はありません。
pmid-42304701.summary_en: This proof-of-concept case report describes a 35-year-old man with a 4 cm interaortocaval seminoma recurrence who underwent unilateral template robot-assisted RPLND. A patient-specific hyperaccuracy three-dimensional model was generated from contrast-enhanced CT and integrated into preoperative planning and intraoperative augmented reality navigation. The model identified a critical renal arterial branch adjacent to the tumor, allowing safe dissection. The procedure took 76 minutes with 30 mL blood loss and no complications. Pathology confirmed a 4.5 cm viable seminoma metastasis, and there was no recurrence at nine months. The authors suggest that multicenter prospective studies are needed.

pmid-42309708.summary_ja: 30歳以下の卵巣成熟奇形腫(41例)と未熟奇形腫(23例)のCT・MRI所見およびラジオミクス特徴を比較した研究です。両者は視覚評価とラジオミクス解析で有意に区別されました。低悪性度と高悪性度の未熟奇形腫は視覚評価では困難でしたが、脂肪抑制T1強調画像由来のMRIラジオミクス特徴により区別できる可能性が示されました。非侵襲的な悪性度評価法として、さらなる検証が必要とされています。
pmid-42309708.summary_en: This imaging study compared CT and MRI radiomic features of ovarian mature teratomas (41 patients with MRI, 31 with CT) and immature teratomas (23 patients, 20 with CT) in patients aged 30 years or younger. Visual findings and radiomic features differed significantly between mature and immature teratomas. Among immature teratomas, low-grade and high-grade tumors were difficult to separate visually, except that nodular fat was larger in low-grade lesions. Several MRI features from fat-suppressed T1-weighted images and some CT radiomic features distinguished low- from high-grade immature teratomas, suggesting a potential noninvasive grading approach that requires further validation.

pmid-42310162.summary_ja: 2005〜2023年に放射線療法を受けた、胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移再発の男性60例の後方視的研究である。治療は放射線療法単独、化学療法併用などで分類し、定位放射線治療（SRS）と全脳照射（WBRT）を比較した。4年全生存期間は39%、頭蓋内進行率は44%で群間差はなかった。単発病変では両者の頭蓋内制御は同等で、単発SRSは多発病変より良好な成績を示した。
pmid-42310162.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 60 men with germ cell tumor brain metastasis relapse treated with radiotherapy between 2005 and 2023. Patients were grouped by multimodal approach (radiotherapy alone, radiotherapy with conventional- or high-dose chemotherapy, or radiotherapy after chemotherapy alone) and by technique (stereotactic radiosurgery or whole brain radiotherapy). Four-year overall survival and intracranial progression were 39% and 44%, with no significant difference across groups or techniques. For solitary brain metastases, SRS and WBRT achieved similar intracranial control, while SRS for solitary lesions was associated with superior overall survival and intracranial progression outcomes compared with multiple lesions.

pmid-42311008.summary_ja: 後腹膜に12cmの腫瘤と血清AFP高値(56.8IU/mL)を有する生後5か月男児の症例報告です。切除標本には指状の突起があり、消化管、呼吸上皮、膵実質、副腎皮質など複雑な器官様分化を認めました。椎体がないため、胎児内胎児ではなく胎児型奇形腫と診断されました。体軸骨格の構造とAFPが分類と監視の補助になると考察されています。
pmid-42311008.summary_en: This case report describes a 5-month-old boy with a 12 cm retroperitoneal mass and elevated serum AFP (56.8 IU/mL). The resected tumor had a digitiform projection with a nail bed, and histopathology showed extensive organoid differentiation including gut loops, respiratory epithelium, pancreatic parenchyma, and adrenal cortex. The absence of a vertebral column or ossified long bones led to a diagnosis of mature cystic teratoma with fetiform features rather than fetus-in-fetu. The authors discuss the diagnostic ambiguity of this gray-zone entity, which has an estimated malignancy potential of about 10%. They emphasize that axial skeletal organization and serum AFP serve as complementary tools for classification and surveillance.

pmid-42312274.summary_ja: 三次施設で2013〜2020年に治療された新生児の口咽頭腫瘍20例の後方視的検討である。成熟奇形腫が9例（45%）と最多であった。完全切除と気道確保、経過観察により、横紋筋肉腫例を除き良好な経過だった。
pmid-42312274.summary_en: This single-center retrospective series reviewed 20 newborns with oropharyngeal tumors treated between 2013 and 2020, with follow-up of 5 to 12 years. Mature teratoma was the most common diagnosis, accounting for nine cases (45%), followed by congenital epulis, multiple hamartoma, epignathus, rhabdomyosarcoma, and dermoid. All patients except one with rhabdomyosarcoma did well. The authors conclude that prognosis is good with early diagnosis, airway securing, complete excision, and timely follow-up. They note that the oropharynx is one of the rarest sites of congenital teratoma, at about 2% of cases.

pmid-42315173.summary_ja: 2020〜2024年にブラジルの小児がん専門施設で、両側成熟奇形腫の若年患者4例にエクスコープ支援下の卵巣温存手術を行った後方視的症例集積。全例で成熟奇形腫が確認され、術中の被膜破綻はなかった。平均観察期間は31か月。2例で自然月経が維持され、1例は性腺機能低下症でホルモン補充療法を要し、1例は評価不能であった。再発は認められなかった。技術的に実施可能と結論し、卵巣予備能マーカーを用いた比較試験の必要性を述べている。
pmid-42315173.summary_en: This retrospective case series describes four adolescents who underwent exoscope-assisted ovarian-sparing surgery for bilateral mature teratomas between 2020 and 2024 at a Brazilian pediatric cancer center. All tumors were benign mature teratomas, and there were no intraoperative capsular ruptures. Mean follow-up was 31 months. Two patients maintained spontaneous menses, one required hormone replacement for hypogonadism, and one was not assessable. No recurrence occurred. The authors conclude the technique is feasible but call for controlled studies with ovarian reserve markers.

pmid-42317400.summary_ja: 出生前から右副腎部に急速に増大する嚢胞充実性腫瘤を認め、当初は神経芽腫と考えられた新生児の症例です。出生後のMIBG集積は正常で、カテコラミン代謝物も正常でした。その後の画像検査で新たな石灰化と脂肪成分が出現し、未熟後腹膜奇形腫と確定しました。周産期の腫瘤では、画像所見の経時的変化と胎児期から新生児期への連続的な画像追跡が診断の鍵になると強調しています。
pmid-42317400.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a rapidly enlarging right suprarenal mass, initially interpreted prenatally and postnatally as neuroblastoma based on cystic-solid appearance and nonspecific biochemistry. Serial imaging later showed new calcification, emerging fatty components, and progressive enlargement, prompting reconsideration. Complete resection confirmed an immature retroperitoneal teratoma without adrenal involvement. The authors emphasize that time-dependent radiologic evolution and continuous fetal-to-neonatal imaging follow-up are key clues for distinguishing these perinatal masses.

pmid-42317785.summary_ja: 男性の原発性肺絨毛癌2例の報告と、68例の文献レビューである。14歳男性は多発肺転移を伴い、治療中断後に死亡した。71歳男性は肺癌と疑われたが、EMA/CO療法後にβ-hCGが正常化し15か月無再発であった。既報の中央生存期間は15か月。血清β-hCG検査と病理学的検査の併用が診断に重要であり、早期手術と多剤化学療法が予後を改善しうると結論している。
pmid-42317785.summary_en: This report describes two males with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma. A 14-year-old with hemoptysis and multiple bilateral lung metastases died after discontinuing treatment. A 71-year-old initially suspected of lung cancer achieved normalized β-hCG after EMA/CO chemotherapy and remained recurrence-free for 15 months. A literature review identified 68 prior cases with a median survival of 15 months. Histopathology showed syncytiotrophoblasts and cytotrophoblasts, with hCG and CK7 immunopositivity. The authors stress that serum hCG testing combined with pathology is critical, and that early surgery plus multi-agent chemotherapy may improve prognosis.

pmid-42317923.summary_ja: 58歳の閉経後女性の病期I混合型胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）の症例。AFPは5 ng/mLと正常範囲で、混合型では必ずしも上昇しないことを示す。化学療法を行わず手術のみで治療し、24か月間無腫瘍で経過している。低病期と早期治療が予後良好に寄与したと考察している。
pmid-42317923.summary_en: This case report describes a 58-year-old postmenopausal woman with a stage I mixed germ cell tumor composed of yolk sac tumor and mature cystic teratoma. Serum AFP was only 5 ng/mL, illustrating that AFP may be normal in some mixed GCTs. Because of her postmenopausal status and stage I disease, she underwent extensive surgery without fertility preservation or chemotherapy. She has remained tumor-free for 24 months. The authors attribute the favorable outcome to low stage, early intervention, and the yolk sac tumor component.

pmid-42317924.summary_ja: 急速に進行する左片麻痺と頭痛を呈した26歳男性の症例報告。右前頭頭頂部の出血性腫瘤に対し緊急開頭術を行い、ほぼ全摘出した。全身検索で肺と腹部大動脈傍リンパ節の転移、右精巣の腫大が認められ、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が著明に上昇していた。病理で卵黄嚢腫瘍と確定した。補助化学療法の後、根治的精巣摘除とリンパ節郭清を行い、AFPは正常化し、1年後に機能は完全回復した。若年男性の出血性脳病変では胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に挙げるべきと述べている。
pmid-42317924.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old man who presented with rapidly progressive left weakness and headache. Imaging showed a right frontoparietal hemorrhagic mass, treated by urgent craniotomy and near-total excision. Systemic evaluation revealed pulmonary and para-aortic metastases and an enlarged right testis, with markedly elevated serum AFP. Histology confirmed a yolk sac tumor. After adjuvant chemotherapy, radical orchidectomy with lymph node dissection normalized AFP, and he had full recovery at one year. The authors stress considering germ cell tumors in hemorrhagic brain lesions in young males.

pmid-42318479.summary_ja: 精巣内胎児性横紋筋肉腫15例と精巣セミノーマ30例の造影CT所見を後方視的に比較した。同側鼠径部との平行関係と血管球徴が鑑別に有用で、ロジスティック回帰モデルのAUCは0.961であった。術後の進行は胎児性横紋筋肉腫で66.7%、セミノーマで3.3%と明らかに高かった。両者の鑑別にCT所見が役立つ。
pmid-42318479.summary_en: This retrospective study compared enhanced CT features of 15 intratesticular embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma cases with 30 testicular seminomas. The parallel relation of the lesion to the ipsilateral inguinal region and a vascular ball sign differed significantly, and a logistic regression model achieved an AUC of 0.961 with sensitivity 86.7% and specificity 96.7%. Postoperative progression was far more frequent in rhabdomyosarcoma (66.7%) than in seminoma (3.3%). The authors conclude that these CT signs help distinguish testicular ERMS from seminoma.

pmid-42318542.summary_ja: 腹痛を訴えた65歳女性の症例報告です。CTで骨盤内の石灰化を伴う腫瘤が認められ、右卵管由来が疑われましたが、手術で大網由来と判明し、病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫と確定しました。性腺外奇形腫の稀少性と、術前診断の難しさについて考察されています。
pmid-42318542.summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old woman with mild abdominal pain and a calcified pelvic mass on CT, initially suspected to arise from the right fallopian tube. Surgery revealed that the mass was located in the greater omentum without adnexal involvement. Histopathological examination confirmed a mature teratoma. The mass was successfully excised and the postoperative recovery was smooth. The authors review that extragonadal teratomas are extremely rare, that omental teratomas are their most common type, and that preoperative diagnosis is challenging because many patients are asymptomatic. They emphasize that histopathological examination is required for definitive diagnosis.

pmid-42318900.summary_ja: 76歳閉経後女性の36 cmの左卵巣腫瘍。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の中に浸潤性高異型度乳頭状尿路上皮癌を認めた。遺伝子解析でKRAS、ARID1A、RB1、TP53の変異とPD-L1陽性が示された。FIGO病期1Aで、補助療法なしに7か月間無病生存している。
pmid-42318900.summary_en: This case report describes a 76-year-old postmenopausal woman with a 36 cm left ovarian tumor containing a mature cystic teratoma, in which an invasive high-grade papillary urothelial carcinoma had arisen. Immunohistochemistry supported urothelial origin. Next-generation sequencing showed a microsatellite-stable tumor with low mutational burden, with KRAS, ARID1A, RB1, and TP53 alterations and PD-L1 positivity. The tumor was FIGO stage 1A, and the patient remained alive without disease after 7 months without adjuvant therapy. The authors review the 13 previously reported cases.

pmid-42318909.summary_ja: 妊孕年齢の若年女性2例に発生した高悪性度卵巣未熟奇形腫の報告。未熟な神経上皮成分を伴う転移が認められた。細胞学的所見、免疫表現型、組織学的グレード、臨床経過を重点的に記述している。他の高悪性度悪性腫瘍と形態が重なり、免疫組織化学の有用性が限られるため、細胞診断は困難であると指摘している。
pmid-42318909.summary_en: This cytopathology report describes two young women of childbearing age with high-grade ovarian immature teratomas that metastasized with immature neuroepithelial components. The authors emphasize cytologic findings, immunophenotype, histologic grading, and clinical course. Cytologic diagnosis is difficult because the features overlap with other high-grade malignant neoplasms, and immunohistochemistry offers limited help. The report highlights these diagnostic challenges and the value of recognizing the tumor in cytologic material.

pmid-42325811.summary_ja: 肺と脳に転移を伴う病期IVの超高リスク絨毛癌（FIGOスコア14）の37歳女性の症例報告です。標準化学療法後に中枢神経系の再発が進行し、集中的多剤併用EP療法、髄腔内メトトレキサート、サイクル3からのペムブロリズマブ、残存脳病変への定位放射線治療を行いました。1年以上持続する完全奏効が得られ、難治性の超高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-42325811.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old woman with stage IV ultra-high-risk choriocarcinoma (FIGO score 14) with lung and brain metastases. After early relapse with progressive CNS disease, she received salvage intensive multi-agent EP chemotherapy, intrathecal methotrexate, pembrolizumab from cycle three, and stereotactic radiosurgery for residual CNS disease. She achieved complete radiological and biochemical response sustained for more than one year. The authors argue that adding immune checkpoint inhibition to dose-intensified chemotherapy may help refractory ultra-high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-42327343.summary_ja: BMP15の生殖系列変異を有する遺伝性卵巣未熟奇形腫の家系2つを解析した研究である。発症した2名の全例にCDHR2の切断型変異（c.2233C>T）が認められ、非発症の姉妹には認めなかった。細胞実験で変異アレルはmRNAとタンパク質の発現低下、局在異常、HIPPO経路の異常活性化を示した。CDHR2がBMP15と相乗的に働くか、修飾遺伝子として作用する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-42327343.summary_en: This study investigated two three-generation pedigrees with hereditary ovarian immature teratoma carrying a BMP15 germline mutation (c.262C>T). Whole-exome sequencing showed that both affected second-generation individuals also carried a truncating CDHR2 variant (c.2233C>T, p.R745X), which was absent in unaffected sisters. The variant was classified as pathogenic under ACMG criteria. In vitro, the mutant allele showed reduced mRNA and protein expression, altered subcellular localization, abnormal metabolite accumulation, and aberrant HIPPO pathway activation. The authors propose CDHR2 may act synergistically with BMP15 or as a modifier gene in ovarian immature teratoma development.

pmid-42327945.summary_ja: 異常子宮出血と子宮内膜腔内腫瘤を呈した66歳女性の症例報告と文献レビューです。術前AFPは9652ng/mLと著明に高値でした。免疫組織化学を含めて子宮内膜原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、FIGO病期IVbでした。完全な外科的病期診断と化学療法の併用が生存に有益である可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-42327945.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes a 66-year-old woman with abnormal uterine bleeding and an endometrial cavity mass. Preoperative serum AFP was markedly elevated at 9652 ng/mL. Total hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and partial omentectomy were performed. Morphology and immunohistochemistry (including SALL4 and AFP) were consistent with a primary endometrial yolk sac tumor, with FIGO stage IVb disease. Postoperative AFP fell only to 5193 ng/mL. The authors note that fewer than 40 cases have been reported in English literature and suggest that complete surgical staging combined with chemotherapy may improve survival.

pmid-42328348.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘤に対し根治的精巣摘除術を受け、セミノーマと診断された56歳男性の症例です。肺転移に対しVIP療法を4サイクル施行後、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けました。その後大腸腺癌が判明し、免疫染色でMSH6の消失が認められたことからリンチ症候群が疑われています。胚細胞腫瘍と遺伝性癌症候群の稀な合併を報告しています。
pmid-42328348.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old man with a testicular mass who was diagnosed with classic seminoma after right radical orchiectomy. He received four cycles of VIP chemotherapy for pulmonary spread, followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, which found no residual cancer. Colorectal adenocarcinoma was later identified, and immunohistochemistry showed loss of MSH6 expression with preserved MLH1, MSH2, and PMS2, raising suspicion for Lynch syndrome. The authors highlight the rare co-occurrence of germ cell tumor and hereditary cancer syndrome.

pmid-42331594.summary_ja: フランスの全国規模の症例対照研究で、出生時の両親の職業性農薬曝露と成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクを検討しました。父親の高度な除草剤および殺菌剤への曝露が、セミノーマと非セミノーマの両方で有意な関連を示しました。母親の曝露では有意な関連はありませんでした。結論として、父親の高度な農薬曝露がリスクと関連すると報告されています。
pmid-42331594.summary_en: This French nationwide case-control study (454 cases, 670 matched controls aged 18-45) examined parental occupational pesticide exposure at birth and adult testicular germ cell tumor risk, stratified by histology. Two job-exposure matrices, ALOHA+ and FRIJEM, showed moderate to substantial agreement. Only high paternal occupational exposure, particularly to herbicides and fungicides as assessed by ALOHA+, was significantly associated with TGCT, including seminoma and non-seminoma subtypes. Maternal exposure showed no significant association. The authors conclude that high paternal exposure to pesticides at birth is positively associated with TGCT, though effect sizes are imprecise.

pmid-42332454.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を合併した抗NMDAR脳炎の35歳女性の長期経過症例。約20か月の昏睡後にICUで集中リハビリテーションを開始し、3か月でModified Barthel Indexは0から72に改善した。独立歩行と身の回りの動作を回復し、有害事象は認めなかった。免疫療法と併用した積極的リハビリテーションの有用性を示唆している。
pmid-42332454.summary_en: This long-term case report describes a 35-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, a history of thyroid carcinoma, and an ovarian teratoma, who remained comatose for months despite high-dose corticosteroids, immunoglobulin, plasma exchange, and several second-line immunosuppressants. After about 20 months, she began intensive rehabilitation in the ICU, five sessions weekly under cardiorespiratory monitoring. Over three months, the Modified Barthel Index rose from 0 to 72 and the Mini-Mental State Examination reached 9, and she regained independent ambulation and self-care without adverse events. The authors conclude that early structured rehabilitation is feasible and beneficial alongside immunotherapy in severe autoimmune encephalitis.

pmid-42333331.summary_ja: 20代前半の女性の未熟奇形腫内に発生した膠芽腫の症例報告である。胚細胞腫瘍における稀な体細胞型悪性腫瘍の一例を示している。未熟奇形腫は神経上皮を主成分とし、グレード2・3では外科的切除と多剤化学療法が必要とされる。膠芽腫の発生機序や、中枢神経系腫瘍との遺伝学的共通性は未解明である。
pmid-42333331.summary_en: This case report describes a glioblastoma arising within an immature teratoma in a woman in her early 20s, representing a rare somatic malignancy within a germ cell tumor. The authors review that immature teratomas contain neuroepithelium and require surgery with multidrug chemotherapy for grade 2 and 3 tumors. They note that squamous cell carcinoma is the most common malignant transformation of mature teratomas, while glioblastoma is extremely rare. Whether these glioblastomas share genetic alterations with central nervous system tumors remains unresolved. The report adds to the limited literature on such somatic malignancies.

pmid-42334782.summary_ja: 1991~2023年に名古屋大学病院で初回治療を受けた妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍268例を後方視的に検討しました。FIGOスコア7~8の侵入奇胎群の全例が減量化学療法で完全寛解しました。40歳以上、先行する胞状奇胎、妊娠からの短い期間、腫瘍径の大きさは侵入奇胎群で多くみられました。選択された症例では減量化学療法が可能であり、過剰治療を避けるためリスク層別化の精緻化が必要と結論付けています。
pmid-42334782.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review analyzed 268 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated at Nagoya University Hospital from 1991 to 2023. Forty-nine were high-risk by FIGO scoring, and 17 with FIGO scores of 7-8 were divided into invasive mole and choriocarcinoma groups using the Japanese scoring system. All seven patients in the invasive mole group received de-escalated chemotherapy and achieved complete remission. Age of 40 years or older, antecedent hydatidiform mole, shorter interval from index pregnancy, and larger tumor size were more frequent in the invasive mole group. The authors conclude that de-escalated chemotherapy may be feasible for selected patients, though risk stratification needs refinement.

pmid-42338270.summary_ja: 免疫グロブリンを産生する胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)4例を解析した研究です。ペムブロリズマブ後に再発した1例では、経時的なゲノム解析で母体由来の遺伝子(Igλ、HLA-DQA2領域など)の取り込みが確認されました。腫瘍細胞と宿主免疫細胞の細胞融合が関与し、免疫関連機能を獲得した可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-42338270.summary_en: This study of four placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) cases, all producing immunoglobulin, examined one daughter-derived PSTT that relapsed after pembrolizumab therapy. Temporal genomic analysis showed incorporation of daughter-non-inherited maternal alleles, including the Ig lambda and HLA-DQA2 loci, with TLR10 and SIGLEC10 expression rising as incorporation increased. The authors suggest that cell fusion between tumor cells and host maternal immune cells may mediate this gene transfer and acquisition of B-cell-related functions.

pmid-42339144.summary_ja: 大量の性器出血を伴う有茎性の子宮腫瘤を呈した2症例の報告である。1例目は40代女性で、出血後に脱出した腫瘤の緊急切除を受け、病理組織学的検査で平滑筋成分を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と判明した。2例目は子宮筋腫と考えられた頸部腫瘤が子宮内膜症性嚢胞であった。典型的に見える腫瘤でも稀な病変が隠れうるため、包括的な病理組織学的評価が重要である。
pmid-42339144.summary_en: This report presents two unusual pedunculated uterine masses with heavy vaginal bleeding. In the first, a woman in her 40s underwent urgent resection of a prolapsing mass after hemorrhage; histopathology revealed a mature cystic teratoma containing a leiomyomatous component, an exceptionally rare finding. In the second, a woman in her late 40s had a pedunculated cervical mass initially thought to be a leiomyoma, but histology showed an endometriotic cyst. The authors emphasize that typical-appearing prolapsing uterine masses may conceal rare entities and underscore the value of comprehensive histopathological assessment.

pmid-42344439.summary_ja: 重度の鉄欠乏性貧血を呈した幼児の胃原発純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告です。亜全胃切除と補助化学療法を受け、術後3年間腫瘍のない状態が維持されています。文献レビューでは胃原発例は既報12例で、小児例は1例のみでした。小児女児における初の報告です。
pmid-42344439.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old girl with severe iron deficiency anemia caused by a primary gastric pure yolk sac tumor. She underwent subtotal gastrectomy and adjuvant systemic chemotherapy and remained tumor-free at three years. The authors reviewed the literature and identified only 12 prior gastric pure yolk sac tumor cases, one in a child. This is the first reported pediatric female case, presenting with significant gastrointestinal blood loss.

pmid-42344622.summary_ja: 25歳女性に生じた卵巣奇形腫関連抗NMDAR脳炎と、A群レンサ球菌（Group A Streptococcus）感染の併存例の症例報告である。当初は統合失調感情障害として治療されたが、急激な悪化により精査された。脳脊髄液中の抗NMDAR抗体と両側卵巣奇形腫が確認された。IVIG、高用量ステロイド、両側卵巣嚢腫摘出術、血漿交換により改善した。症状出現前の感染が誘因となった可能性が示唆されるが、因果関係は不明である。
pmid-42344622.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old African American woman with ovarian teratoma-associated anti-NMDAR encephalitis and concurrent Group A Streptococcus infection. She initially presented with acute psychiatric symptoms and was treated for suspected schizoaffective disorder before deterioration prompted further evaluation. Cerebrospinal fluid testing confirmed anti-NMDAR antibodies, and imaging revealed bilateral ovarian teratomas. Treatment included IVIG, high-dose corticosteroids, bilateral ovarian cystectomy, and plasma exchange, with eventual clinical improvement. The authors note a possible infectious trigger preceding symptom onset, although causality remains uncertain.

pmid-42344689.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫に対し2回の妊孕性温存手術とBEP療法を受けた23歳女性の症例報告です。追跡MRIで左付属器に5.7cmの多房性病変が見つかりましたが、腫瘍マーカーは正常でした。GnRH作動薬療法で腫瘤は1.4cmに縮小し、子宮内膜症性嚢胞と判断されました。1年後も再発はなく、AMHも保たれていました。
pmid-42344689.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old woman with ovarian immature teratoma treated by two fertility-sparing surgeries and BEP chemotherapy. During follow-up, MRI revealed a 5.7 cm multicystic left adnexal lesion without restricted diffusion, and tumor markers were normal. Because a third surgery risked ovarian damage and she declined needle biopsy, GnRH agonist therapy was started. The mass shrank to 1.4 cm after three cycles, followed by maintenance dienogest. At one year there was no progression, regular cycles were maintained, and AMH remained above 2 ng/mL, supporting a diagnosis of endometriotic cyst. The authors suggest that a hormonal trial may be an alternative to immediate surgery in carefully selected patients under close oncologic surveillance.

pmid-42346253.summary_ja: 1985年から2025年にブラジルの基幹施設で治療した妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍550例の後方視的コホートです。非胞状奇胎後のGTNは病期が進行し、転移が多く認められました。5年疾患特異的生存率は97.4%、無増悪生存率は92.4%でした。多変量調整後は、GTNの型が生存と独立して関連しませんでした。生存は主に初期の疾患重症度で規定されると結論付けています。
pmid-42346253.summary_en: This retrospective cohort of 550 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia at a Brazilian reference center from 1985 to 2025 compared molar and non-molar disease. Non-molar GTN presented with more advanced FIGO stages and metastases. Five-year disease-specific survival was 97.4%, and progression-free survival 92.4%. Unadjusted analyses showed worse outcomes for non-molar disease, but after multivariable adjustment, GTN type was not independently associated with survival. The authors conclude survival is driven mainly by baseline disease severity.

pmid-42351457.summary_ja: 月経過多と無月経を繰り返し、β-hCGが軽度上昇したままの32歳女性の症例報告です。超音波検査で子宮後壁の低エコー病変がみられ、稽留流産として内容物除去術が行われました。病理組織学的検査では筋層と血管に浸潤する異型中間型栄養膜細胞がみられ、免疫組織化学でβ-hCGとGATA3が陽性、p63が陰性でした。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断され、早期認識の重要性が示されています。
pmid-42351457.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with intermittent menorrhagia, amenorrhea, and persistently mildly elevated beta-hCG. Ultrasound showed a hypoechoic posterior uterine lesion, initially diagnosed as missed miscarriage and treated with evacuation. Histopathology showed atypical intermediate trophoblast cells infiltrating myometrium and vessels. Immunohistochemistry was positive for beta-hCG and GATA3 and negative for p63, confirming placental site trophoblastic tumor. The authors stress early recognition because the presentation can mimic benign pregnancy-related conditions.

pmid-42352980.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症した一卵性双生児と両親の生殖系列エクソーム解析を行った家系研究である。双生児は両親からそれぞれ受け継いだPDE11Aの複合ヘテロ接合変異を有し、アンチセンスlncRNAのPDE11A-AS1と重なっていた。TGCTの素因へのPDE11A遺伝子座の寄与を示唆している。
pmid-42352980.summary_en: This family-based genomic study performed germline exome sequencing on monozygotic twins with testicular germ cell tumor and their parents. Both twins carried compound heterozygous PDE11A variants inherited from each parent, including a splice-acceptor variant predicted to cause a frameshift and a catalytic-domain missense variant. Both variants overlap the antisense lncRNA PDE11A-AS1. In silico analysis predicted favorable RNA-RNA interactions between PDE11A and PDE11A-AS1 transcripts. Additional variants in MSH6 and CTU2 may modify susceptibility. The authors propose a contributory role for the PDE11A locus in TGCT predisposition.

pmid-42358535.summary_ja: 30歳の初産婦で、帝王切開時に偶発的に左卵巣嚢腫が見つかった。病理学的に、索状型カルチノイドを伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。産後6週で腹腔鏡下付属器摘出術を行い、最終病期はFIGO IAであった。母体と新生児の予後は良好で、18か月の経過観察で再発は認めなかった。妊娠中の卵巣カルチノイドの診断と管理について文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-42358535.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old primigravida whose left ovarian cyst was incidentally found at cesarean section. Pathology showed a mature cystic teratoma with trabecular carcinoid. She underwent laparoscopic adnexectomy six weeks after delivery and was staged FIGO IA. Maternal and neonatal outcomes were favorable, with no recurrence over 18 months of follow-up. The report reviews the diagnostic challenges, management, and prognosis of ovarian carcinoid during pregnancy, aiming to raise clinical awareness of this exceptionally rare presentation.

pmid-42361457.summary_ja: 1998年から2023年の文献の系統的検索と、卵巣奇形腫に伴う抗NMDAR脳炎99例のテーマ別解析を組み合わせたレビューです。完全回復は62%、部分回復は34%でした。補助化学療法や免疫調節療法の追加は転帰を改善せず、卵巣温存手術は卵巣摘除術と同等の結果でした。卵巣温存手術と追加治療の慎重な使用を推奨し、診断アルゴリズムを提案しています。
pmid-42361457.summary_en: This PRISMA-compliant review combined a systematic literature search (1998 to 2023) with thematic analysis of 99 patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma. Most patients had surgery, and 87% received adjuvant treatment. Full recovery occurred in 62% and partial recovery in 34%. Neither adjuvant chemotherapy nor immunomodulatory therapy was associated with better outcomes, and ovarian-sparing surgery produced results comparable to oophorectomy. The authors recommend ovarian-sparing surgery and judicious use of additional therapy, and propose a diagnostic algorithm.

pmid-42362259.summary_ja: 1997年から2017年に台湾の1施設で治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍87例の後方視的研究です。婦人科腫瘍医と小児腫瘍医の治療方針の違いを比較しました。妊孕性温存手術と完全病期分類の間で10年無増悪生存率に差はありませんでした。BEP療法はJEB療法より良好な成績を示し、高リスク群ではシスプラチンの有用性が示唆されました。
pmid-42362259.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 87 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated at one Taiwanese hospital between 1997 and 2017, comparing care by gynecologic and pediatric oncologists. Ten-year progression-free survival was similar between conservative fertility-sparing surgery and complete staging. BEP regimen was associated with better progression-free survival than JEB, at 97.8 versus 77.8 percent. The authors conclude that cisplatin appears more effective than carboplatin in high-risk patients.

pmid-42362340.summary_ja: 30代後半の女性で、後腹膜成熟奇形腫が大腸型腺癌へ悪性転化し、傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴った症例を報告した。左腎摘除を含む切除とCAPEOX療法を施行し、6か月後に卵巣転移が出現して追加手術を受けた。1年後も無病であった。卵巣転移の初めての報告例として、長期監視の重要性を強調している。
pmid-42362340.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in her late 30s with a mature retroperitoneal teratoma that underwent malignant transformation into colonic-type adenocarcinoma with para-aortic lymph node metastases. She underwent resection including left nephrectomy and lymph node dissection, followed by adjuvant CAPEOX chemotherapy. Six months later, she developed an ovarian metastasis requiring further surgery. The patient remained disease-free at one-year follow-up. The authors note this is the first documented ovarian metastasis from such a transformed teratoma and emphasize long-term surveillance.

pmid-42365841.summary_ja: 2001年から2020年に小型精巣腫瘤に精巣温存手術を施行した36例を後方視的に解析した研究です。胚細胞腫瘍を含む5例(13.5%)で腫瘍学的イベントが生じ、いずれも胚細胞腫瘍でした。テストステロン値の有意な変化はありませんでした。適切に選択された症例では根治的精巣摘除術の代替となりうるものの、再発リスクのため慎重な経過観察が必要と結論付けています。
pmid-42365841.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 37 testis-sparing surgeries in 36 patients with small testicular masses treated between 2001 and 2020. Oncological events occurred in 13.5% of cases, all involving germ cell tumors, with a median time to event of six months. No patient required testosterone replacement, and testosterone levels did not change significantly. The authors conclude testis-sparing surgery may be a feasible alternative to radical orchiectomy in carefully selected patients, but close follow-up is essential given recurrence risk in germ cell tumors.

pmid-42367805.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の免疫微小環境をマイクロRNAがどのように制御し、免疫療法感受性を規定しうるかを検討した総説である。非選択例では免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の成績が乏しく、PD-L1単独では予測性が低いと指摘している。マイクロRNAを標的とする治療や、放射線療法などとの併用による免疫応答の増強を今後の方向性として提案している。
pmid-42367805.summary_en: This review examines how microRNAs regulate the immune microenvironment in testicular germ cell tumors and whether they could determine sensitivity to immunotherapy. It notes that immune checkpoint inhibitors have shown disappointing results in unselected TGCT patients and that PD-L1 expression alone is an unreliable predictor. The authors discuss unresolved questions, including the contributions of low tumor mutational burden and testicular immune privilege. They propose a mechanism-based translational agenda that combines miRNA-directed agents, extracellular vesicles, and immune-priming approaches such as radiotherapy, vaccines, or CAR-T therapy.

pmid-42372937.summary_ja: 未経妊の25歳女性に生じた多発性両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に対し、妊孕性を温存するロボット支援両側卵巣嚢腫摘出術を示した手術動画です。血管収縮薬の浸潤、水剥離、標的を絞った単極エネルギー、選択的縫合などの要点を解説しています。病理は両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、術後経過は順調でした。両側多発病変でも組織温存の低侵襲手術が可能と結論づけています。
pmid-42372937.summary_en: This surgical video demonstrates fertility-sparing robot-assisted bilateral ovarian cystectomy for multiple large mature cystic teratomas in a 25-year-old nulligravid woman. Key steps included vasoconstrictive infiltration, hydrodissection, blunt dissection with targeted monopolar energy, traction-countertraction enucleation, and selective suturing of the ovarian cortex. Pathology confirmed bilateral mature cystic teratomas, and the postoperative course was uncomplicated. The authors argue that extensive bilateral disease does not preclude tissue-preserving minimally invasive surgery.

pmid-42373199.summary_ja: 大きな縦隔奇形腫の切除後に左下葉の完全虚脱と気管支軟化症を生じた少年の症例です。90日間の包括的リハビリテーションに、肺拡張を促す仮想現実(VR)運動を組み込みました。画像所見と臨床症状が著明に改善し、再度の侵襲的気管支鏡検査は回避されました。術後の肺虚脱に対するVRの有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-42373199.summary_en: This case report describes a teenage boy who developed complete left lower lobe collapse with bronchomalacia and recurrent chest infections after excision of a large mediastinal teratoma. A 90-day comprehensive pulmonary rehabilitation program was designed, incorporating virtual reality exercises to promote lung expansion, improve fitness, and enhance quality of life. Marked radiological and clinical improvement was achieved, avoiding a repeat invasive bronchoscopy. The report suggests virtual reality may be a useful modality in rehabilitation after post-surgical lung collapse.

pmid-42374600.summary_ja: 左精巣セミノーマ病期IIBの治療から4年後に、頭痛、嘔吐、右手の脱力で発症した34歳男性を報告した。MRIで神経膠腫を疑う脳内腫瘍が見つかり、切除標本の病理と免疫染色でセミノーマの異時性脳転移と確定した。治療後数年が経過しても、神経症状では本疾患を鑑別に挙げるべきと強調している。
pmid-42374600.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man who presented with headache, vomiting, and right-hand weakness four years after successful treatment for left testicular stage IIB seminoma. MRI showed an intra-axial brain mass initially suspected to be a glioma. After surgical resection, histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed a metachronous seminoma metastasis to the brain. The authors emphasize considering this diagnosis in the differential when neurological symptoms suggest an intracranial lesion, even years after treatment. They note that current stage II surveillance guidelines do not include routine brain imaging.

pmid-42375916.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍、大量腹水、hCG高値を呈した37歳未経妊女性の症例報告です。卵黄嚢腫瘍様および絨毛癌様の分化を部分的に示し、分類不能な悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(FIGO病期IC1)と診断されました。病期評価が不完全で組織像も曖昧だったため、BEP療法4サイクルを選択し、現在無病生存しています。
pmid-42375916.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old nulligravid woman with a right ovarian tumor, massive ascites, and elevated serum hCG. Histology showed focal yolk sac tumor-like morphology and focal choriocarcinoma-like differentiation. Immunohistochemistry showed AFP, SALL4, OCT4, and CD30 negative, with scattered hCG-positive cells. The tumor was classified as an unclassifiable malignant ovarian germ cell tumor, FIGO stage IC1. Because staging was incomplete and the histology was ambiguous, four cycles of BEP chemotherapy were given rather than de-escalation. The patient remains disease-free on follow-up. The authors emphasize that adjuvant decisions in stage I disease depend on staging adequacy and biologic uncertainty.

pmid-42378441.summary_ja: 2016〜2025年に三次施設で診療された、胚細胞腫瘍の体細胞型悪性腫瘍(SM)72例の解析。原発部位は精巣が56%、縦隔が33%だった。縦隔例の大半は肉腫様変化を示し、再発時の進展例では腺癌が多かった。胎児性神経外胚葉腫瘍(ENET)組織型は非ENET型より予後が不良で、中央値の全生存期間は1.8年対8年だった。PTEN-AKT-mTOR経路とTP53の変異が頻繁に認められた。
pmid-42378441.summary_en: This tertiary center review analyzed 72 patients with somatic-type malignancy arising in germ cell tumors, treated between 2016 and 2025. Primary sites were testicular (56%), mediastinal (33%), and other (11%). Mediastinal tumors mostly showed sarcomatous transformation, while evolved adenocarcinoma was common at relapse. Embryonal-type neuroectodermal tumor histology carried a worse median overall survival (1.8 vs 8 years). PTEN-AKT-mTOR and TP53 mutations were frequent in available genomic data. Outcomes to frontline therapy were poor, underscoring the need for predictors of transformation and targetable alterations in relapsed disease.

pmid-42378456.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発巣切除標本30例を後方視的に解析し、21種類の細胞表面抗原を免疫組織化学で評価した。CLDN6は大多数の症例で高発現し、EGFRとTROP2は奇形腫成分で高い発現を示した。これら3つを抗原標的治療の候補として提案しており、転移例や再発例での検証が必要とされている。
pmid-42378456.summary_en: This retrospective study performed immunohistochemistry for 21 cell surface antigens in orchiectomy specimens from 30 patients with testicular germ cell tumors (11 pure seminoma, 19 mixed GCT). Claudin-6 (CLDN6) was highly expressed in nearly all samples, including 100% of pure seminomas and 89.5% of mixed tumors. EGFR and TROP2 were also frequently highly expressed, particularly in teratoma components, while most other antigens, such as CD19, DLL3, FOLR1, and BCMA, showed little expression. The authors propose CLDN6, EGFR, and TROP2 as candidate targets for antigen-directed therapy, requiring validation in metastatic and relapsed disease.

pmid-42378617.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の転移に対し、白金製剤による化学療法を受けた41歳男性の症例です。化学療法後に咳、体重減少、神経症状が出現しました。肺腫瘤と脳転移が認められ、気管支肺胞洗浄のGeneXpertで肺結核が確認されました。抗結核療法を開始し、脳神経外科手術は全身状態の安定後に行いました。化学療法後の免疫抑制による潜在性結核の再活性化が示唆されています。
pmid-42378617.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old man with metastatic mixed testicular germ cell tumor who developed chronic cough, weight loss, and neurological symptoms after platinum-based chemotherapy. Imaging showed a pulmonary mass and cerebral metastasis, and bronchoalveolar lavage GeneXpert confirmed pulmonary tuberculosis. He received anti-TB therapy, and neurosurgery was delayed until stabilization. The authors suggest reactivation of latent tuberculosis infection after chemotherapy-induced immunosuppression and recommend heightened suspicion for TB in immunocompromised cancer patients in endemic settings.

pmid-42385096.summary_ja: チリの2施設で治療された胚細胞腫瘍628例の後方視的コホート。病期I精上皮腫の5年全生存率は98.8%であった。病期Iセミノーマでは脈管侵襲と術前β-hCG値が再発と関連し、C-indexは0.76であった。進行病期は国際基準より成績が劣り、集約的な診療体制の整備が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-42385096.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study from two Chilean institutions included 628 patients with germ cell tumors. Five-year overall survival was 98.8% for stage I seminoma and 98.0% for stage I nonseminomatous disease. Advanced-stage patients fared worse than International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group reference cohorts. In stage I seminoma, lymphovascular invasion and preorchiectomy beta-hCG levels were associated with relapse, with a Harrell C-index of 0.76. Established risk factors were not associated with relapse in stage I nonseminomatous disease. The authors call for centralized care, referral pathways, and national registries to improve outcomes.

pmid-42385389.summary_ja: セミノーマ4例の凍結組織を用い、空間トランスクリプトーム解析と空間メタボローム解析を統合した。腫瘍領域では解糖系や酸化的リン酸化、フェロトーシス関連経路が濃縮され、グルタチオン代謝の異常が認められた。TCam-2細胞および異種移植モデルで、グルタチオン合成阻害やxCTのノックダウンはフェロトーシスを誘導し増殖を抑制した。
pmid-42385389.summary_en: This study performed spatial transcriptomics and spatial metabolomics on fresh-frozen seminoma tissue from four patients to map tumor heterogeneity. Tumor regions were enriched for glycolysis, oxidative phosphorylation, and ferroptosis pathways, and metabolomics showed dysregulated glutathione metabolism. In TCam-2 seminoma cells and xenograft mice, inhibiting glutathione synthesis with buthionine sulfoximine or knocking down xCT induced ferroptosis and suppressed growth. The authors propose glutathione metabolic reprogramming as an adaptive redox mechanism in seminoma and a potential therapeutic target through promotion of ferroptosis.

pmid-42387674.summary_ja: 小児の両側同時性精巣腫瘍の症例報告です。左精巣に卵黄嚢腫瘍、右精巣に奇形腫が認められ、超音波所見と鑑別診断に焦点が当てられています。病理型の異なる両側精巣腫瘍は極めて稀であり、術前の超音波検査が治療方針の選択に重要であることを示しています。
pmid-42387674.summary_en: This case report describes a pediatric patient with synchronous bilateral testicular tumors of different pathological types: a yolk sac tumor in the left testis and a teratoma in the right testis. The paper focuses on the sonographic findings and differential diagnosis of these two tumor types. Preoperative ultrasonography was crucial for planning the treatment strategy in this rare condition. The authors aim to improve recognition of synchronous bilateral testicular tumors of distinct histologies in children, a condition that is extremely rare and may present diagnostic challenges on imaging.

pmid-42389208.summary_ja: hCGの上昇とともに臨床症状を示した若年女性の卵巣ディスジャーミノーマを、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と誤診した症例。単剤化学療法後もhCGが陰性化せず、化学療法を強化された。肺病変の開胸切除により転移性ディスジャーミノーマと確定診断された。ガイドラインに基づく治療後、寛解を維持している。低値持続のhCGでは鑑別を広く持つことが重要である。
pmid-42389208.summary_en: A young woman with a hormonally active ovarian dysgerminoma was initially misdiagnosed with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia because of elevated and rising hCG and clinical symptoms. Monochemotherapy failed to normalize hCG, and chemotherapy was escalated for suspected GTN. The correct diagnosis was made only after thoracotomy resection of a pulmonary lesion, which proved to be dysgerminoma metastasis. The patient then received guideline-based treatment and is in remission. The authors stress maintaining a broad differential diagnosis for persistent low-level hCG elevation.

pmid-42390562.summary_ja: 2025年12月までのPubMedとScopusを検索し、転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後残存腫瘤に対する新規PETトレーサーを評価した17研究を解析しました。αvβ3インテグリン標的薬は成熟奇形腫と壊死の鑑別で有望な前臨床結果を示しました。グレリン受容体やクローディン6を標的とするトレーサーも有望です。臨床的検証が必要ですが、過剰治療の低減に寄与する可能性が示されています。
pmid-42390562.summary_en: This systematic review of PubMed and Scopus through December 2025 included 17 studies evaluating novel PET tracers for residual masses after chemotherapy in metastatic testicular germ cell tumors. Tracers examined included [18F]-FLT, FAPI, αvβ3-integrin agents, [18F]-fluciclovine, PSMA-targeted agents, and ghrelin- and claudin-6-based tracers. αvβ3-integrin imaging showed promising preclinical results in differentiating mature teratoma from necrosis. Ghrelin receptor tracers appear promising but remain preclinical. Claudin-6 is highly expressed in most histologies and has early clinical support. The authors conclude these tracers could reduce overtreatment, though clinical validation is still needed.

pmid-42391959.summary_ja: 45歳男性で、左精巣の多発結節と右精巣の小病変が超音波検査で見つかり、腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲でした。両側根治的精巣摘除術が行われ、左側は多巣性の古典的セミノーマ、右側はライディッヒ細胞腫と診断されました。異なる系統の腫瘍が同時に発生した稀な症例であり、詳細な病理組織学的評価の重要性を示しています。
pmid-42391959.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old man with bilateral synchronous testicular neoplasms of different lineages. Ultrasonography showed multiple nodules in the left testis and a small lesion in the right testis, while tumor markers were normal. Bilateral radical orchiectomy was performed. Histopathology showed a multifocal classic seminoma in the left testis and a Leydig cell tumor in the right testis, and immunohistochemistry confirmed the distinct lineages. The authors highlight that thorough histopathological evaluation is essential to guide management, since the germ cell tumor requires metastatic evaluation and surveillance while the sex cord-stromal tumor is benign. The case illustrates the rarity of such synchronous combinations.

pmid-42393880.summary_ja: CTで包虫症と誤診された巨大卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の40歳女性の症例報告です。寄生虫検査が陰性であったため再評価を行いました。標的超音波検査で可動性の嚢胞内球体を、脂肪抑制MRIで脂肪成分を確認し、浮遊球徴候を同定しました。開腹手術と病理で確定診断に至りました。画像と臨床の不一致時には超音波検査とMRIによる再検討が重要と述べています。
pmid-42393880.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with a giant ovarian mature cystic teratoma initially misdiagnosed as hydatid disease on CT because of daughter-cyst-like structures. Negative parasite tests prompted reevaluation. Targeted ultrasound showed mobile intracystic spherules, and fat-saturated MRI demonstrated fat content, confirming the floating ball sign. Laparotomy and histopathology confirmed the diagnosis. The authors emphasize that when imaging and clinical data conflict, targeted ultrasound and MRI should guide diagnostic reconsideration.

pmid-42396393.summary_ja: 絨毛癌成分が優位で、低異型度の類内膜癌成分を少量伴う子宮内膜癌の61歳女性の症例報告です。浅い筋層浸潤にもかかわらず、血清hCGが著明に上昇し、多発肺結節がみられました。絨毛成分が病勢を主導していると判断し、術前にEMA/CO化学療法を選択しました。6サイクル後にhCGは正常化し肺病変は消失し、子宮全摘術後に絨毛癌の残存はなく、2年以上無病生存しています。
pmid-42396393.summary_en: This case report describes a 61-year-old postmenopausal woman with endometrial carcinoma containing a predominant choriocarcinomatous component and a minor grade 1 endometrioid component. Serum hCG was markedly elevated, and multiple pulmonary nodules were present despite superficial myometrial invasion. Recognizing that the trophoblastic component was driving disease, neoadjuvant EMA/CO chemotherapy was given, normalizing hCG and resolving lung lesions. Hysterectomy and salpingo-oophorectomy showed no residual choriocarcinoma, and she remained disease-free beyond two years.

pmid-42400955.summary_ja: 1994年から2025年に治療された縦隔原発純粋セミノーマ24例の後方視的コホート研究です。5年PFSは86.2%、5年OSは95.2%でした。前方治療としてのシスプラチン併用化学療法で良好な成績が得られ、ブレオマイシンも安全に使用できました。定期的な放射線療法、手術、化学療法後PETは必須ではないと結論づけられています。
pmid-42400955.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study from a tertiary center included 24 patients with primary mediastinal pure seminoma treated from 1994 to 2025. Most presented with good-risk features, and 54% had metastases at diagnosis. Three patients (12.5%) had progression within the mediastinum after completing chemotherapy, all detected by CT. Five-year PFS was 86.2% and 5-year OS was 95.2%. No patient developed bleomycin-related pulmonary toxicity. The authors conclude that excellent outcomes can be achieved with front-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy without routine consolidative radiotherapy, surgery, or postchemotherapy PET, and that bleomycin can be safely used in this population.

pmid-42403385.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の14歳女性が化学療法3サイクル目に長時間作用型G-CSFの投与後、全身性過敏反応を起こした症例です。低血圧、低酸素血症、白血球増加(24時間で55から104×10⁹/L)を認め、アドレナリンとデキサメタゾンで改善しました。その後の短時間作用型G-CSF製剤でも約30分以内に同様の反応が生じました。製剤を変えても反応が再発しうる点、小児での安全性は今後の検証が必要と述べています。
pmid-42403385.summary_en: This pediatric case report describes a 14-year-old female with a germ cell tumor who developed a systemic hypersensitivity reaction after prophylactic long-acting G-CSF (efbemalenograstim alfa-vuxw) during her third chemotherapy cycle. Hypotension, hypoxemia, and leukocytosis rose from 55 to 104 × 10⁹/L within 24 hours, with eosinophilia present. Epinephrine and dexamethasone resolved symptoms. A subsequent short-acting filgrastim biosimilar caused a nearly identical reaction within 30 minutes. The authors conclude that recurrent hypersensitivity may occur with sequential G-CSF products, and that the long-acting agent's pediatric safety needs validation in controlled trials.

pmid-42403642.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌に対しBEP療法を開始して約2週半後に両側肺結節を生じた38歳男性の症例報告。転移、ブレオマイシン肺毒性、感染が鑑別となった。結節の形態や腫瘍マーカーの正常化からは転移は否定的で、フランシセラ・ツラレンシス血清反応陽性により肺野野兎病と診断された。シプロフロキサシンの内服で改善した。腫瘍学領域での誤診や不適切な病期診断を避けるための重要性を指摘している。
pmid-42403642.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old man with testicular embryonal carcinoma who developed bilateral pulmonary nodules about two and a half weeks after starting BEP chemotherapy. Differential diagnoses included metastasis, bleomycin-induced pulmonary toxicity, and infection. Atypical nodule morphology, peribronchovascular distribution, and normal tumor markers argued against metastasis. Positive Francisella tularensis serology and exposure to outdoor hunting dogs established pulmonary tularemia. Oral ciprofloxacin for 10 days led to marked improvement on follow-up CT. The authors stress avoiding misdiagnosis, inappropriate staging, and unnecessary treatment escalation in oncology patients.

pmid-42415580.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後残存腫瘤に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた23例で、Heidenreich基準を後方視的に検証しました。6例が片側修正郭清の適応で、17例は両側郭清でした。中央値85.4か月の観察で、後腹膜再発は4例、遠隔再発は2例でした。片側郭清の適応例では対側再発はありませんでした。この基準は適切な症例選択に有用で、腫瘍学的転帰を損なわず手術を縮小できる可能性があると結論付けています。
pmid-42415580.summary_en: This retrospective cohort externally validated the Heidenreich criteria in 23 patients who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for residual masses of non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Six patients qualified for unilateral-modified dissection and 17 for fully bilateral dissection. With median follow-up of 85.4 months, retroperitoneal and distant recurrences occurred in 4 and 2 patients, respectively. Among those eligible for unilateral dissection, one had an in-field retroperitoneal recurrence and none had contralateral recurrence. The authors conclude the criteria correctly classified patients, allowing tailored surgery that may spare procedures without compromising oncologic outcomes.

pmid-42419002.summary_ja: 29施設の小児外科腫瘍研究コラボレーションによる127例の多施設後方視的研究。卵巣未熟奇形腫の2年無再発生存率は82%、死亡は2例で全生存は良好だった。血清AFP高値と術前腫瘍破裂が再発と関連し、再発時の外科的切除が推奨される。
pmid-42419002.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective study of 127 females aged 0–18 years with pure ovarian immature teratoma diagnosed in 2010–2022, across 29 institutions of the Pediatric Surgical Oncology Research Collaborative, describes management and outcomes. Only half underwent complete surgical staging, and mature teratoma and gliomatosis were common findings. Two-year recurrence-free survival was 82%, with two deaths overall. Elevated serum AFP and preoperative tumor rupture were independently associated with recurrence. Surgical resection at recurrence is recommended.

pmid-42419003.summary_ja: 29施設が参加した多施設後方視的研究で、18歳未満の卵巣未熟奇形腫143例を対象としました。微小卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う16例は、高異型度・高病期の腫瘍が多く、診断時のAFP値が高く、化学療法を受ける割合も高くなっていました。無再発生存期間は両群で差がなく、悪性再発は6.25％対7.1％でした。治療の違いが結果に影響した可能性があり、さらなる研究が必要とされています。
pmid-42419003.summary_en: This multi-institutional retrospective review from 29 centers included 143 females under 18 with ovarian immature teratoma, of whom 16 had microscopic yolk sac tumor foci. The YST group had higher-grade, higher-stage tumors and higher AFP at diagnosis, and more often received chemotherapy. Recurrence-free survival did not differ between groups, with malignant recurrence in 6.25 versus 7.1 percent. The authors note that treatment differences may have influenced results and call for further studies.

pmid-42421177.summary_ja: 軽微な外傷後に右精巣痛を訴えた39歳男性の症例報告です。陰嚢超音波検査で内部にドプラ血流を伴う精巣内病変を認め、血腫や梗塞としては非典型的でした。AFPとβ-hCGの上昇を踏まえ、根治的精巣摘除術で思春期後混合型胚細胞腫瘍と確定しました。救急画像診断における診断の固執バイアスへの注意を促しています。
pmid-42421177.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with acute right testicular pain after minor trauma. Scrotal ultrasound showed an intratesticular lesion with internal Doppler vascularity, atypical for hematoma or infarction. Elevated AFP and β-hCG supported malignancy, and radical orchiectomy confirmed a mixed postpubertal germ cell tumor. The authors highlight the value of Doppler evaluation in acute scrotal ultrasound and warn of anchoring bias in emergency imaging.

pmid-42424570.summary_ja: インドの単施設で2015〜2021年に治療された中間・不良リスクの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍400例の後方視的解析。5年全生存期間(OS)は中間リスク84.6%、不良リスク52.6%だった。35歳以上、縦隔原発、肝・肺・脳転移が独立した予後因子であった。リスク因子モデルとノモグラムは既存の分類より予後層別化能が高く、治療強化を検討すべき最不良リスク群を提案している。
pmid-42424570.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study from western India analyzed 400 patients with intermediate- or poor-risk nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated from 2015 to 2021. Five-year overall survival was 84.6% for intermediate-risk and 52.6% for poor-risk patients. Age of at least 35 years, mediastinal primary, and liver, lung, or brain metastases predicted worse outcomes. A risk factor model with a validated nomogram stratified patients more accurately than the International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group classification. The authors propose a poorest-risk subset that may benefit from treatment intensification.

pmid-42424681.summary_ja: 中国の4施設で妊孕性温存手術を受けた悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍264例を対象とした多施設後方視的研究です。腫瘍径、左右側、FIGO病期が無病生存と関連し、Cox法に基づく予測モデルが最も良好な性能を示しました。ノモグラムで提示され、3年および5年の予測能は良好でした。個々の再発リスク評価に役立つ可能性があります。
pmid-42424681.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective study included 264 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors who underwent fertility-sparing surgery at four Chinese hospitals. Tumor size, laterality, and FIGO stage were associated with disease-free survival. Among four machine learning models, a Cox-based model performed best and was presented as a nomogram. Internal bootstrap validation showed AUCs of 0.838 at 3 years and 0.851 at 5 years, with good calibration and decision curve benefit. The model may help individualize recurrence risk assessment.

pmid-42425185.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の免疫病態をまとめた総説。卵巣奇形腫(約20%)と単純ヘルペス脳炎が主要な誘因とされる。NR1サブユニットを標的とする抗体の病原性が受動・能動免疫実験で示された。奇形腫や頸部リンパ節などに自己反応性B細胞が認められ、早期免疫療法の重要性を論じている。
pmid-42425185.summary_en: This review summarizes the immunopathogenesis of N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis, a mainly monophasic autoantibody-mediated disorder. Ovarian teratomas, present in about 20% of cases, and herpes simplex encephalitis are highlighted as key initiating factors. Passive and active immunization studies have shown the pathogenicity of antibodies targeting the NR1 subunit. Autoreactive B cells have been detected in peripheral blood, cerebrospinal fluid, teratomas, and cervical lymph nodes, with memory and antibody-secreting phenotypes. The authors discuss current and future targeted immunotherapies and stress the importance of early treatment to interrupt pathogenic antibody production.

pmid-42428031.summary_ja: NF1を有する40歳男性で、左精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と肺転移を認めた症例報告である。VIP、TGP療法と転移巣切除後に進行し、包括的ゲノムプロファイリングでNF1の病原性フレームシフト変異を同定した。患者提案型の臨床試験でMEK阻害薬トラメチニブを投与し、6か月間AFPが正常化したが、その後進行した。NF1変異を有する転移性胚細胞腫瘍へのトラメチニブ使用の初の報告で、限定的な効果の可能性が示された。
pmid-42428031.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old man with NF1 and a left testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor with lung metastases, who progressed after VIP and TGP chemotherapy and metastasectomy. Comprehensive genomic profiling identified a pathogenic NF1 frameshift mutation. Under a patient-proposed trial protocol, he received the MEK inhibitor trametinib, and AFP normalized for six months before progression. He died 39 months after diagnosis. The authors describe this as the first report of trametinib for NF1-mutant metastatic germ cell tumor, with a possible but limited effect.

pmid-42428049.summary_ja: PSAは軽度上昇にとどまる一方でLDHが著明に上昇し、大きな前立腺腫瘤を呈した34歳男性の原発性前立腺セミノーマの症例報告です。免疫組織化学によりセミノーマと確定され、良好リスクに分類されました。シスプラチン併用化学療法により持続的な完全寛解を得ています。PRISMAに準じた文献レビューでは12例が抽出され、腫瘍マーカーの乖離がみられ、胚細胞マーカーの感度と特異度は不十分でした。
pmid-42428049.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with a bulky primary prostatic seminoma and only mildly elevated PSA, while LDH was markedly elevated. PET/CT showed a metabolically active prostatic mass, and immunohistochemistry confirmed seminoma. Treated as good risk, he achieved sustained complete remission after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. A PRISMA-based review identified 12 modern cases, showing marker discordance and that germ cell markers lacked sufficient sensitivity and specificity. Early biopsy with germ cell immunohistochemistry is essential in atypical young patients.

pmid-42433816.summary_ja: 24歳女性の仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。殿部の高度変形と骨盤痛、座位・歩行困難を呈した。仙骨後方への進展のため、経仙骨到達による完全切除と尾骨切除を施行し、手術と整容の両面で良好な結果が得られた。
pmid-42433816.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old Afghan woman with severe gluteal deformity, pelvic pain, and difficulty sitting and walking due to a sacrococcygeal teratoma, a very rare presentation in adults. MRI and CT characterized the presacral mass. Because the lesion grew posteriorly to the coccyx, complete removal with coccygectomy via a trans-sacral approach was performed. Surgical and cosmetic outcomes were favorable. The authors emphasize that sacrococcygeal teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of a presacral mass.

pmid-42434637.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化として生じた卵巣扁平上皮癌の39歳女性の症例です。臨床症状と画像所見が非特異的なため術前診断は困難で、病理組織学的検査で確定しました。治療は手術と補助療法を含む多角的戦略が必要とされます。若年患者における奇形腫の悪性転化の診断・治療上の課題を指摘しています。
pmid-42434637.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman with ovarian squamous cell carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma. The preoperative diagnosis was difficult because clinical and imaging features were nonspecific, and the diagnosis was established histopathologically. The authors note that most primary ovarian squamous cell carcinomas arise from malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma, while others are linked with endometriosis or Brenner tumor. The paper outlines her presentation and subsequent multimodal management. The report highlights the diagnostic and therapeutic challenges of malignant transformation of teratomas, particularly in younger patients.

pmid-42436886.summary_ja: 急性骨盤痛で受診し、当初は卵巣捻転が疑われた29歳女性の症例。緊急開腹で破裂した130mm腫瘤が見つかり、病理組織学的に未熟神経外胚葉成分(グレード3)25%と成熟成分75%の混合型奇形腫、FIGO病期IC2と診断された。術後のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は90.5 ng/mlであり、完全手術とBEP補助化学療法が行われた。病理学的な悉皆的評価の重要性を強調している。
pmid-42436886.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman who presented with acute pelvic pain initially suspected to be ovarian torsion. Emergency laparotomy revealed a ruptured 130 mm mass, and histopathology showed a mixed teratoma with 25% grade 3 immature neuroectodermal elements and 75% mature elements, classified as FIGO stage IC2. Postoperative alpha-fetoprotein was 90.5 ng/ml. After multidisciplinary review, she underwent completion surgery and adjuvant BEP chemotherapy. The authors emphasize meticulous pathological grading and maintaining a high index of oncologic suspicion in acute adnexal events.

pmid-42437150.summary_ja: 既知の卵巣甲状腺腫（単一胚葉性奇形腫）を有する38歳女性が、腹膜に多発病変を呈した症例報告です。MRIで腹腔内と骨盤内に拡散制限を示す造影される播種性病変が確認され、核医学検査ではI-123の集積はみられませんでした。生検で高分化甲状腺組織が確認され、腹膜ストルモーシスと診断されました。卵巣甲状腺腫の既往がある症例の腹膜結節では本疾患を鑑別に含めるべきです。
pmid-42437150.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old woman with known struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma, who developed multiple peritoneal lesions. MRI showed diffusion-restricting enhancing implants throughout the abdomen and pelvis, while nuclear medicine imaging showed no I-123 uptake. Biopsy confirmed well-differentiated thyroid tissue, establishing peritoneal strumosis, also termed highly differentiated follicular carcinoma of ovarian origin. The authors emphasize including this entity in the differential diagnosis of peritoneal nodules in patients with prior struma ovarii.

pmid-42438040.summary_ja: 1994~2024年に精巣摘除術後に積極的監視を受けた臨床病期Iセミノーマ1025例の後方視的多施設コホートです。中央値45か月の経過観察で11.3%が再発しました。Boormansモデルは従来分類より識別能が高かったものの(C-index 0.66対0.61)、臨床的有用性の改善は限定的でした。より正確なリスク適応型治療には新規バイオマーカーの統合が必要と述べています。
pmid-42438040.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter cohort analyzed 1,025 patients with clinical stage I seminoma under active surveillance after orchidectomy, from 1994 to 2024. Relapse occurred in 11.3% over a median follow-up of 45 months. The authors compared the Boormans model, which incorporates tumor size, rete testis invasion and lymphovascular invasion, with the conventional classification. Both tumor size and rete testis invasion independently predicted relapse. The Boormans model showed better discrimination (C-index 0.66 vs. 0.61), but its gain in clinical utility across risk-adapted treatment scenarios was limited. The authors suggest novel biomarkers may be needed for more accurate risk-adapted management.

pmid-42438667.summary_ja: 閉経後の52歳アフガン人女性で、腹水と複雑な血流豊富な右付属器腫瘤を認め、CA-125高値から進行卵巣癌が疑われました。カルボプラチン/パクリタキセル療法7コースを受けても改善せず、手術の結果、良性の卵巣甲状腺腫と判明しました。術後14か月間再発はありません。
pmid-42438667.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old postmenopausal Afghan woman with ascites, pelvic pain, and a complex vascular right adnexal mass with markedly elevated CA-125, initially suspected to be advanced ovarian carcinoma. She received seven cycles of carboplatin/paclitaxel without response. Laparotomy and left salpingo-oophorectomy revealed benign struma ovarii without peritoneal carcinomatosis.
