Ascites resolved and CA-125 normalized after surgery, and she remained free of recurrence at 14 months. The authors emphasize considering struma ovarii in the differential diagnosis of complex ovarian masses even when tumor markers suggest malignancy.

pmid-42440869.summary_ja: 新規に高血圧を発症した27歳女性の症例報告である。高レニン性高アルドステロン症を認め、画像検査で腎動脈狭窄や原発性アルドステロン症は否定された。3cmの左卵巣腫瘍を認め、腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢腫摘出術を行った。病理組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を確認し、免疫組織化学でレニン陽性細胞を認めた。術後に血圧は速やかに正常化した。レニン産生卵巣腫瘍は二次性高血圧の鑑別に加えるべきと述べている。
pmid-42440869.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with newly diagnosed hypertension and hyperreninemic hyperaldosteronism. Imaging excluded renal artery stenosis and primary aldosteronism, and a 3 cm left ovarian tumor was identified. Laparoscopic cystectomy showed a mature cystic teratoma with renin-positive cells on immunohistochemistry. Blood pressure normalized rapidly after surgery. The authors suggest renin-producing ovarian tumors should be considered in the differential diagnosis of secondary hypertension, and that surgery may be warranted when biochemical suspicion is strong.

pmid-42441051.summary_ja: 呼吸器症状で受診した若年男性の前縦隔腫瘤と肺結節の症例です。AFPが著明に上昇し、LDHとβ-hCGも上昇していました。精巣超音波検査で異常がなく、縦隔原発の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断されました。病理で多形性卵黄嚢腫瘍と確認され、CBOP-BEP療法によりAFPは低下しました。画像と腫瘍マーカーの統合的評価が前縦隔腫瘤の診断に有用と述べています。
pmid-42441051.summary_en: This case report describes a young man with respiratory symptoms and a large anterior mediastinal mass with pulmonary nodules. Serum markers showed markedly elevated AFP and moderate elevations of LDH and β-hCG. A normal testicular ultrasound supported a primary mediastinal origin. Imaging and markers allowed a diagnosis of non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, and cisplatin-etoposide chemotherapy was started before histology. Ultrasound-guided biopsy confirmed a pleomorphic yolk sac tumor. He was then treated with CBOP-BEP at a specialist centre, with falling AFP levels. The authors highlight integrating multimodal imaging with tumor markers when assessing complex anterior mediastinal masses.

pmid-42444801.summary_ja: 尿路生殖器症状を伴わない片側頸部腫瘤で受診した38歳男性の非妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告です。病理組織学的検査と免疫組織化学により診断され、画像では原発巣が特定できない広範なリンパ節病変がみられました。白金製剤併用化学療法に一時的に反応しましたが、その後病勢が進行しました。原因不明の頸部リンパ節腫脹やβ-hCG高値の男性では、本疾患を鑑別に含めることが診断遅延の防止に重要です。
pmid-42444801.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old man with non-gestational choriocarcinoma presenting as a unilateral cervical tumor without genitourinary symptoms. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed the diagnosis, and imaging showed extensive lymph node involvement without a definite primary. He had a transient response to platinum-based chemotherapy, followed by progression. The authors highlight the importance of considering this entity in men with unexplained cervical lymphadenopathy, poorly differentiated tumors, and elevated beta-hCG, to reduce diagnostic delay.

pmid-42445452.summary_ja: 原発性無月経と高ゴナドトロピン性性腺機能低下を呈した46,XY完全型性腺異形成(Swyer症候群)の患者で、病期IIIC両側性ディスジャーミノーマが見つかった症例報告。早期の染色体検査により予防的性腺摘除術を適時に行えば、性腺悪性腫瘍を防ぎうると強調している。抄録は要旨のみで、詳細な経過の記載はない。
pmid-42445452.summary_en: This clinical case report describes a patient with 46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis (Swyer syndrome) and bilateral dysgerminoma staged IIIC, identified after evaluation of primary amenorrhea with hypergonadotropic hypogonadism. The authors argue that prompt karyotype analysis is essential in adolescents with this presentation, enabling timely prophylactic gonadectomy to prevent gonadal malignancy and improve endocrine, reproductive and long-term outcomes. The provided abstract is a brief conclusion-style summary, and detailed clinical course is not described.

pmid-42445629.summary_ja: 2010~2024年に陽子線治療を受けた精巣胚細胞腫瘍19例の多施設前向き登録データです。全例が計画どおり放射線療法を完遂しました。非転移例では2年の全生存期間(全生存率)と無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)がいずれも100%でした。グレード3以上の治療関連有害事象や二次がんはみられませんでした。陽子線治療は実行可能で忍容性が高いと結論付けられていますが、長期の経過観察が必要です。
pmid-42445629.summary_en: This registry analysis from the Proton Collaborative Group reviewed 19 consecutive patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated with proton beam therapy between 2010 and 2024. All 19 completed the planned radiation course. In evaluable patients with median follow-up of 23.9 months, two-year overall and progression-free survival were 100% in non-metastatic patients, with 100% local control. There were no grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events and no secondary malignancies during 28.8 person-years of follow-up. Acute toxicities were mostly grade 1-2. The authors conclude that proton beam therapy is feasible and well tolerated for seminoma, while longer follow-up is needed.

pmid-42446622.summary_ja: 長節型バレット食道を背景に食欲不振で受診した87歳男性の剖検例である。食道胃接合部に輪状に広がる隆起性病変を認め、生検で絨毛癌成分の小さな巣を伴う腸芽様分化型腺癌と診断された。CTで多発肝転移を認めた。入院11日後、腫瘍出血による吐血と循環血液量減少性ショックで死亡し、剖検で腫瘍からの出血が確認された。腫瘍は食道内静脈と奇静脈に沿って進展し、肝・肺へ転移した。
pmid-42446622.summary_en: An 87-year-old man with long-segment Barrett esophagus presented with anorexia. Endoscopy showed an elevated, nearly circumferential lesion at the lower esophagus and esophagogastric junction. Biopsy revealed adenocarcinoma with enteroblastic differentiation containing small foci of choriocarcinoma components. CT showed multiple liver metastases. He died 11 days after admission from hematemesis and hypovolemic shock due to tumor hemorrhage, confirmed at autopsy. The tumor spread along intraesophageal and azygos veins and metastasized to the liver and lung, suggesting an aggressive carcinoma arising from long-segment Barrett esophagus.

pmid-42447055.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫の治療後に再発を模倣した2症例の報告と文献的考察。1例はシスプラチン系化学療法後のgrowing teratoma syndromeで、後に見つかったPET集積病変は異物肉芽腫反応であった。もう1例では腹膜神経膠腫症と子宮内膜症が併存した。画像や腫瘍マーカーの異常が必ずしも再発を意味しないと結論づけている。
pmid-42447055.summary_en: The authors report two patients with ovarian immature teratoma and review the literature on post-treatment findings that mimic recurrence. In the first case, a patient developed classic growing teratoma syndrome after platinum-based chemotherapy and underwent surgical resection; a later PET-avid lesion with mildly elevated tumor markers turned out to be a foreign-body granulomatous reaction. In the second case, a patient treated surgically without adjuvant chemotherapy developed peritoneal gliomatosis coexisting with deep infiltrating endometriosis. The authors conclude that enlarging masses, peritoneal implants, metabolically active lesions, and elevated tumor markers do not necessarily indicate malignant recurrence, and that histopathological correlation is essential.

pmid-42447513.summary_ja: フランスの全国的な病院ベース症例対照研究（症例454例、対照670例）で、思春期および若年成人期の大麻使用と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討した。若年成人期の毎日の使用はリスク増加と関連し、特にセミノーマで顕著だった。非セミノーマや思春期の使用では関連は認められなかった。
pmid-42447513.summary_en: This nationwide French hospital-based case-control study (454 cases, 670 controls) examined cannabis use in adolescence and early adulthood in relation to testicular germ cell tumor risk. Overall associations were inconsistent. Daily use in early adulthood was associated with increased TGCT risk (OR 1.50) and with seminoma (adjusted OR 1.93), with significant exposure-response trends for seminoma. Weekly use across ages 12 to 25 also increased risk. No associations were seen in adolescence or for non-seminoma. The authors caution that subtype findings require independent confirmation.

pmid-42449283.summary_ja: 2020年から2024年にかけて胸腔鏡手術を受けた小児縦隔腫瘍12例を対象とした単施設の後方視的症例集積であり、臨床的特徴と中期成績を評価した。症状は多様で、組織学的には神経芽腫、神経節神経腫、リンパ腫、奇形腫、胸腺腫が含まれた。9例で完全切除が行われ、開胸移行はなかった。24か月のフォローアップ期間中に局所再発は認められなかった。著者らは、胸腔鏡下治療は安全かつ実行可能で有効であり、小児縦隔腫瘍に対する低侵襲な選択肢になると結論づけている。
pmid-42449283.summary_en: This single-center retrospective case series of 12 children with mediastinal tumors treated by thoracoscopic surgery between 2020 and 2024 evaluated clinical features and mid-term outcomes. Presentations were varied, and histology included neuroblastoma, ganglioneuroma, lymphoma, teratoma, and thymoma. Complete resection was achieved in 9 patients with no conversion to open surgery, and no local recurrence occurred over 24 months of follow-up. The authors conclude that thoracoscopic management is safe, feasible, and effective, offering a minimally invasive option for pediatric mediastinal tumors.

pmid-42449632.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍細胞株において、PRDM14とその共役因子CBFA2T2が複合体を形成し、多能性遺伝子の発現と増殖を維持することを示した基礎研究。いずれかをノックダウンすると多能性関連遺伝子の発現が低下し、細胞増殖が障害された。トランスクリプトーム解析でも両者の標的は大きく重なった。胚細胞腫瘍の悪性化における新たな機構を提案している。
pmid-42449632.summary_en: This laboratory study examined whether PRDM14 acts in germ cell tumors through its corepressor partner CBFA2T2. PRDM14 and CBFA2T2 were expressed across GCT cell lines, colocalized in the nucleus, and formed a functional complex. Knockdown of either gene reduced pluripotency gene expression and impaired proliferation. Transcriptomic profiling after depletion showed extensive overlap in differentially expressed genes and convergent changes in developmental and metabolic pathways. The authors propose that PRDM14 and CBFA2T2 together sustain pluripotency and proliferation in GCT cells, a novel component of GCT biology.

pmid-42450953.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性腫瘍(奇形腫を含む)に伴う傍腫瘍性神経症候群の3症例を報告し、2020~2025年の文献を総説しています。多くで神経症状が卵巣がんの診断に先行しました。抗NMDAR抗体は脳炎と、抗Yo抗体は小脳変性と関連していました。腫瘍治療と免疫調整療法により多くで部分改善または安定化が得られ、多職種での対応が必要と結論付けています。
pmid-42450953.summary_en: This report describes three patients with paraneoplastic neurological syndromes associated with ovarian malignancies, together with a narrative review of studies from 2020 to 2025. In most cases, neurological symptoms preceded the ovarian cancer diagnosis. Cerebellar degeneration was most often linked to anti-Yo antibodies, while encephalitis was more commonly associated with anti-NMDAR antibodies. Outcomes were variable, with partial improvement or stabilization in most patients after oncologic and immunomodulatory treatment. The authors conclude that these syndromes may serve as an early clinical clue to ovarian malignancy, including teratomas, and that multidisciplinary management is needed.

pmid-42453859.summary_ja: 47歳の男性(エホバの証人)で、10.8cmの原発性縦隔セミノーマを認めた。宗教的理由から輸血を拒否したため、手術は困難であった。エトポシド、イホスファミド、シスプラチンによる3サイクルの化学療法で腫瘍は44%縮小し、部分奏効が得られた。残存腫瘍に対する強度変調放射線療法(36Gy/20分割)により完全奏効が得られ、11か月間、再発や晩期毒性なく維持された。外科的切除が困難な場合、化学療法に続く地固め放射線療法は有効な選択肢となりうる。
pmid-42453859.summary_en: A 47-year-old Jehovah's Witness man with a 10.8-cm primary mediastinal seminoma declined blood transfusion for religious reasons, which precluded surgery. He received three cycles of etoposide, ifosfamide, and cisplatin, achieving a 44% tumor reduction and partial response. Intensity-modulated radiotherapy (36 Gy in 20 fractions) to the residual tumor produced a complete response that was maintained for 11 months without recurrence or late toxicity. The authors suggest that chemotherapy followed by consolidative radiotherapy may be a safe and effective short-term option for mediastinal germ cell tumors when surgical resection is not feasible.

pmid-42453887.summary_ja: 原発性肺絨毛癌と脳転移を有する61歳男性の症例です。放射線療法と化学療法の後、進行に対して免疫療法を含む二次治療が行われました。TP53などの変異が同定されました。二次治療で頭蓋外病変は長期間制御されましたが、脳病変が進行し腹腔内出血で死亡しました。既報45例のレビューから、妊娠性絨毛癌とは臨床的・分子的に異なる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-42453887.summary_en: This report describes a 61-year-old man with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma and brain metastases, treated with radiotherapy, albumin-bound paclitaxel plus cisplatin, and then after progression with etoposide, capecitabine, and camrelizumab. Sequencing identified alterations in TP53, STK11, KEAP1, and SMARCA4. The second-line regimen was associated with prolonged extracranial control, but the disease progressed intracranially and the patient died of intra-abdominal hemorrhage. A PubMed review identified 45 previously reported patients. The authors suggest primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma may differ clinically and molecularly from gestational choriocarcinoma, while noting these observations come from a single patient.

pmid-42460113.summary_ja: Argüelles Balasらの症例報告に対する論評である。新生児仙尾部腫瘤のAFPは、成人の基準範囲ではなく新生児の文脈で解釈すべきであり、成人の基準値は誤解を招くと論じている。切除後はMRI、病理、臨床経過とあわせてAFPの推移を連続測定すべきとする。原報告では、AFPの解釈と術後の推移をより明確に示すと良いとしている。
pmid-42460113.summary_en: This commentary on a case by Argüelles Balas et al. argues that AFP in neonatal sacrococcygeal masses must be interpreted against neonatal reference ranges rather than adult values, since adult cutoffs may mislead. It recommends serial AFP measurement after resection to assess kinetics alongside MRI, pathology, and clinical follow-up. The commentary suggests the original report would be strengthened by explicitly clarifying AFP interpretation and postoperative AFP trends. It is a brief letter-type comment rather than an original study.

pmid-42460230.summary_ja: 25歳女性の卵巣腫瘍で、奇形腫を背景に血管肉腫が診断された症例です。手術所見、肉眼所見、病理組織学的所見および免疫組織化学による診断過程を詳述しています。血管肉腫の組織学的多様性と、多角的治療や精密医療への移行の動向をレビューしています。正確な診断には、組織学的特徴の理解と適切な免疫組織化学の実施が重要と述べています。
pmid-42460230.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman with primary ovarian angiosarcoma arising in the background of a teratoma. The authors detail the surgical findings, gross appearance, histopathological features and immunohistochemical workup that enabled diagnosis. A literature review summarizes the variable histological presentation of angiosarcoma, which depends on tumor site and degree of differentiation. The paper notes emerging evidence from clinical trials supporting multimodal therapy and precision medicine for angiosarcoma. The authors emphasize that accurate diagnosis relies on recognizing histological variability and performing an appropriate immunohistochemical panel.

pmid-42470065.summary_ja: 腹痛で受診した38歳女性の両側性卵巣原発高分化濾胞癌(悪性卵巣甲状腺腫)の症例。子宮全摘、両側付属器切除、甲状腺全摘、放射性ヨウ素治療を実施した。3年間のフォローアップでサイログロブリンは正常範囲を維持し、再発は認めなかった。根治術後の甲状腺全摘と放射性ヨウ素療法を推奨している。
pmid-42470065.summary_en: The authors describe a 38-year-old woman with highly differentiated follicular carcinoma of ovarian origin, a rare subtype of malignant struma ovarii, presenting with abdominal pain and extensive peritoneal and adnexal masses. She underwent hysterectomy, bilateral adnexectomy, omentectomy, pelvic lymph node dissection, total thyroidectomy, and radioactive iodine therapy. Histopathology confirmed the diagnosis. Over 3 years of follow-up, serum thyroglobulin remained normal and imaging showed no recurrence. The authors recommend total thyroidectomy with radioactive iodine after radical surgery to reduce recurrence risk and emphasize multidisciplinary management for such rare tumors.

pmid-42471935.summary_ja: 30代女性の不正性器出血と左付属器の脂肪含有腫瘤の症例報告である。当初は卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と解釈されたが、腹腔鏡下に卵管由来と判明し卵管摘出術が行われた。同一卵管に漿液性腺線維腫の併存もみられた。脂肪含有が必ずしも卵巣由来を示さないことを強調している。
pmid-42471935.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in her 30s with abnormal genital bleeding and a fat-containing left adnexal mass that was initially interpreted as an ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Imaging showed the ipsilateral ovary as a separate, normal-appearing structure. Laparoscopy revealed that the tumor originated from the fallopian tube, and salpingectomy was performed. Histopathology showed mature cystic teratoma coexisting with a serous adenofibroma within the same tube. The authors highlight that intralesional fat does not necessarily indicate ovarian origin, and that assessing the spatial relationship with the ovary is essential for accurate preoperative diagnosis.

pmid-42473063.summary_ja: 本論文は、FIGO婦人科がん委員会による2026年版の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）病期分類を解説するものである。絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍、hCG上昇を伴う胞状奇胎後持続症などを対象とし、改訂点と解釈のための注釈を示している。標準化された病期分類は治療方針の決定と治療成績の比較に不可欠である。
pmid-42473063.summary_en: This FIGO committee article presents the 2026 revised staging system for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN), which includes choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, and post-molar persistent disease with rising hCG. It explains the changes introduced in the updated system and provides explanatory notes to aid interpretation. The authors emphasize that standardized, evidence-based staging and scoring are essential for guiding management and enabling comparison of treatment outcomes across centers and studies.

pmid-42476068.summary_ja: メトトレキサート耐性の絨毛癌細胞株(JAR・JEG-3)を樹立し、1000種類以上の化合物ライブラリーから薬剤をスクリーニングした基礎研究です。DHFRの発現上昇は確認されたものの、その阻害では感受性は回復しませんでした。コルヒチンとシコニンが細胞毒性を示し、シコニンは in vivo で腫瘍体積の縮小傾向を示しました。耐性絨毛癌に対する治療候補として今後の検討が期待されます。
pmid-42476068.summary_en: This laboratory study established methotrexate-resistant choriocarcinoma cell lines (JAR and JEG-3) and screened a library of more than 1,000 compounds. RNA sequencing showed DHFR overexpression in resistant JAR cells, but DHFR silencing did not restore methotrexate sensitivity. Colchicine and shikonin emerged as the most cytotoxic candidates across both resistant lines. In vivo experiments suggested shikonin reduced tumor volume, while colchicine showed more limited antitumor activity. The authors conclude these agents warrant further investigation as potential treatments for methotrexate-resistant choriocarcinoma.

pmid-42477775.summary_ja: 胸痛で受診した21歳男性が、16時間以内に発熱、低血圧、敗血症性ショックを呈した。9×7 cmの前縦隔奇形腫が心膜内へ破裂し、膿性心嚢液貯留と心タンポナーデを来していた。心膜穿刺を反復し、手術で腫瘍と心膜の瘻孔が確認された。病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫優位の混合型胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ5%)と確定し、14か月後も転移はない。
pmid-42477775.summary_en: A 21-year-old man developed fever, hypotension and septic shock within 16 hours of presenting with chest pain. A 9 × 7 cm anterior mediastinal teratoma had ruptured into the pericardium, causing purulent effusion and tamponade. Pericardiocentesis was repeated, and surgery revealed a fistula from the mass to the pericardium. Pathology showed a mixed germ cell tumor, mostly mature teratoma with 5% seminoma. No adjuvant therapy was needed, and he remained free of metastasis at 14 months.

pmid-42479372.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍52例で、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節の3D CT体積縮小率と残存病変の関連を検討した後方視的研究。縮小率10%ごとに生存腫瘍のオッズは約51%低下した。カットオフ49.5%でAUCは0.904であった。外部検証を前提に術前の層別化に有用と述べている。
pmid-42479372.summary_en: This retrospective study of 52 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors evaluated whether 3D CT-based volumetric shrinkage of retroperitoneal lymph nodes predicts viable residual disease after post-chemotherapy RPLND. Final pathology showed necrosis/fibrosis in 36.5%, teratoma in 44.2%, and viable GCT in 19.2%. Median shrinkage was greatest in the necrosis group (68.0%) and lowest in the viable GCT group (28.0%). In multivariable analysis, each 10% increase in volumetric shrinkage reduced the odds of viable disease by about 51%. At a cut-off of 49.5%, the AUC was 0.904, and bootstrap-corrected AUC was 0.866. The authors suggest this imaging biomarker may aid preoperative risk stratification, pending external validation.

pmid-42479617.summary_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマの化学療法後に残存する後腹膜腫瘤に対する救済療法のシステマティックレビューです。対象は239例の純粋セミノーマでした。高リスク群では放射線療法と経過観察の間で全生存期間に有意差はありませんでした。エビデンスの確実性は低く、個別化した治療判断と前向き研究が必要とされています。
pmid-42479617.summary_en: This systematic review examined salvage therapy for residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy in advanced testicular seminoma, including radiotherapy, surgery, further chemotherapy and high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation. The included studies comprised 239 patients, all with pure seminoma. The evidence was of low certainty and heterogeneous. Overall survival did not differ significantly between radiotherapy and observation in high-risk groups. Complications were mainly related to surgery and chemotherapy toxicity. The authors conclude that individualized decisions are needed and that prospective studies are required.

pmid-42486665.summary_ja: 思春期男性の上腹部腫瘤。精巣は正常であったが、大網の多嚢胞性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。超音波検査とCTが術前診断に有用で、開腹術で3胚葉由来の成熟組織を認めた。完全切除により5年間再発はない。精巣正常の男性における大網奇形腫は報告が少なく、腹部腫瘤の鑑別で考慮すべき稀な疾患である。
pmid-42486665.summary_en: A male in early adolescence with a six-month history of an enlarging upper abdominal mass was found to have a multicystic mature cystic teratoma of the greater omentum, with normal testes. Ultrasonography and CT suggested the diagnosis, and laparotomy confirmed a benign teratoma with mature tissues from all three germ layers. Complete surgical excision was curative, with no recurrence at 5-year follow-up. The authors note this is one of only three reported omental teratomas in males with normal testes and emphasize considering this rare entity in abdominal masses and the role of imaging in preoperative assessment.

pmid-42487423.summary_ja: 1995年から2020年に三次小児病院で治療された仙尾部奇形腫18例を対象とした、後方視的・前方視的併用コホート研究である。PedsQLで評価した12例では、年齢・性別を一致させた対照群より生活の質（QOL）スコアが有意に低かった。合併症は72.2%、再発は27.7%に認めた。泌尿器系機能障害がQOL低下の主因であり、長期的な多職種によるフォローアップの必要性が示された。
pmid-42487423.summary_en: This ambispective cohort study of 18 patients treated for sacrococcygeal teratoma at a tertiary pediatric center from 1995 to 2020 evaluated long-term health-related quality of life in survivors. Among 12 patients assessed with PedsQL, scores were significantly lower than age- and sex-matched controls (73.1 vs 86.7). Complications occurred in 72.2 percent and recurrence in 27.7 percent. Urinary dysfunction was the main determinant of impaired quality of life. The authors recommend long-term multidisciplinary follow-up and systematic HRQoL assessment.

pmid-42487426.summary_ja: 複雑性腹壁破裂に腸管穿孔を合併し、仙尾部奇形腫を伴った新生児の1例。治療は4段階に分けて約6か月を要した。この併存例で良好な転帰を得た初の報告である。段階的手術により各病変の合併症リスクを抑えつつ、患児は良好な成長と発達を示した。
pmid-42487426.summary_en: A newborn with complex gastroschisis complicated by intestinal perforation also had a sacrococcygeal teratoma. Treatment was staged over 6 months and 18 days: gastroschisis closure with enterostomy, teratoma resection, Santulli-technique atresia repair, and stoma closure. The authors note that only one similar case has been reported worldwide, and this is the first with a good outcome. The infant showed good growth and development afterward. The staged approach was considered to address each pathology safely while limiting complications.

pmid-42487859.summary_ja: 病期IVの右側ディスジャーミノーマに対するBEP療法の第2コース後に手足症候群を発症した32歳女性の症例。ブレオマイシンなどを中止し、外用ステロイドで治療した。足の症状は1か月で完治し、手も改善を続けた。BEP療法のまれな皮膚毒性として、予防と治療の検討が必要と述べている。
pmid-42487859.summary_en: The authors report a 32-year-old woman with stage IV right-sided dysgerminoma who developed hyperpigmentation, swelling, and desquamation of the hands and feet after the second cycle of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy. Dermatology diagnosed chemotherapy-induced hand-foot syndrome. Bleomycin and other cytotoxic agents were discontinued, and topical betamethasone was started. Her feet healed completely within a month, while her hands continued to improve. The authors highlight this rare dermatologic complication of BEP therapy and call for further study of its prevention and treatment.

pmid-42488403.summary_ja: 腹腔鏡下に右卵管の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を認め、腫瘍のみ切除して卵管を温存した症例。術後3か月の子宮卵管造影で卵管開通は保たれたが、遅延相での骨盤内造影剤貯留から卵管周囲癒着が示唆された。タイミング性交は無効で体外受精を行った。胚移植前の腹腔鏡で水卵管症が判明し右卵管摘除を行い、凍結融解胚盤胞移植で妊娠し正期産で出産した。
pmid-42488403.summary_en: This case report describes a mature cystic teratoma found in the right fallopian tube during laparoscopy, treated by resecting only the tumor while preserving the tube. Three-month hysterosalpingography showed patent tubes but delayed pelvic contrast retention suggesting peritubal adhesions. After failed timed intercourse, IVF was performed; laparoscopy before embryo transfer revealed hydrosalpinx requiring right salpingectomy. Clinical pregnancy followed frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer and resulted in term delivery. The authors conclude that early postoperative hysterosalpingography and prompt laparoscopic evaluation can improve later infertility treatment.

pmid-42488731.summary_ja: 80歳男性の原発性性腺外絨毛癌の症例。気胸と多発肺結節、縦隔リンパ節腫大、肝病変を認め、血清hCGは17,000 mIU/mLであった。胸腔鏡手術後も急速に進行し、入院24日目に死亡した。多発肺結節を伴う気胸では、高齢男性でも絨毛癌を鑑別に入れるべきと述べている。
pmid-42488731.summary_en: The authors report an 80-year-old man with primary extragonadal choriocarcinoma presenting with right pneumothorax, more than 30 pulmonary nodules, mediastinal lymphadenopathy, and hepatic lesions. Serum hCG was 17,000 mIU/mL. Thoracoscopic surgery was required for persistent air leak. Histopathology showed biphasic trophoblastic morphology, with positivity for GATA3, hCG, and CK7, and PET/CT showed no testicular abnormality. Despite temporary improvement after surgery, the disease progressed rapidly and the patient died on hospital day 24. The authors suggest that pneumothorax with multiple pulmonary nodules should prompt consideration of choriocarcinoma even in elderly men.

pmid-42489415.summary_ja: 68歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌の症例である。細胞減量術後、下行結腸への浸潤と4個のリンパ節転移が判明し、補助化学療法を8サイクル受けた。18年以上無病で経過しており、長期生存の要因について考察している。
pmid-42489415.summary_en: This updated case report describes a 68-year-old woman with a 20 cm ovarian tumour, diagnosed after cytoreductive surgery as squamous cell carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma. The descending colon was invaded and four lymph nodes were metastatic. She received eight cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy and has remained disease-free for more than 18 years. The authors describe her clinical characteristics and speculate on the reasons for her long-term survival, highlighting the rare prognosis of malignant transformation of mature teratoma.

pmid-42491121.summary_ja: 34cmの巨大精巣腫瘤により出血性ショックを呈した45歳男性。AFP 689 ng/mL、LDH 6,566 IU/Lと著明高値。緊急で根治的精巣摘除術と両側鼠径リンパ節郭清を施行し、皮膚壊死に対しては陰圧閉鎖療法後に遅延植皮術を行った。病期IIIAの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、補助化学療法後2年無再発。
pmid-42491121.summary_en: A 45-year-old man presented with hemorrhagic shock from a 34-cm testicular mass with bilateral inguinal lymphadenopathy, AFP 689 ng/mL, and LDH 6,566 IU/L. Emergency radical orchiectomy and bilateral inguinal lymph node dissection were performed. Extensive skin necrosis required vacuum-assisted closure and delayed skin valvuloplasty. Histology confirmed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, stage IIIA. Adjuvant VIP chemotherapy was given, and the patient remained recurrence-free at 2 years. The report stresses prompt diagnosis and public awareness.

pmid-42491137.summary_ja: シスプラチンを使用困難な88歳男性の急速増大する原発性縦隔セミノーマ症例。カルボプラチン3コース後に進行したが、救済放射線療法で著明に縮小し、LDHも正常化した。治療開始19か月後も安定病勢で生存している。高齢者では化学療法の後に放射線療法を行う戦略が現実的な選択肢となりうると示唆している。
pmid-42491137.summary_en: The authors report an 88-year-old man with a rapidly enlarging primary mediastinal seminoma, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor, who was unsuitable for cisplatin because of age and organ dysfunction. He received three cycles of carboplatin, with initial regression followed by progression after the third cycle. Salvage radiotherapy produced marked tumor shrinkage and normalization of lactate dehydrogenase, and the patient remained alive with stable disease at 19 months after treatment initiation. The case suggests that carboplatin followed by radiotherapy may be a pragmatic option for elderly patients with mediastinal seminoma who cannot receive cisplatin-based therapy.

pmid-42494888.summary_ja: 子宮角妊娠の手術から1か月後に発症した34歳女性の妊娠性絨毛癌。β-hCGは304,000 IU/Lで、子宮底部の血流豊富な腫瘤と大量血腹を認めた。緊急開腹で腸管や大網に浸潤する絨毛組織が確認された。資源が限られた環境では術後のβ-hCG監視が不十分で診断が遅れると指摘し、定期的な測定と超音波検査を推奨している。
pmid-42494888.summary_en: The authors report a 34-year-old woman with gestational choriocarcinoma one month after surgery for a cornual ectopic pregnancy. She presented with hemodynamic instability, a beta-hCG of 304,000 IU/L, and a 14.8 cm hypervascular uterine fundal mass with massive hemoperitoneum. Emergency laparotomy revealed 4 liters of hemoperitoneum and placental tissue infiltrating the bowel, omentum, and uterus, confirmed histologically as gestational choriocarcinoma. The case highlights delayed recognition of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia after ectopic pregnancy surgery in low-resource settings, where postoperative beta-hCG surveillance is often inadequate. The authors recommend routine beta-hCG monitoring and prompt ultrasound evaluation.

pmid-42498104.summary_ja: 1985年から1994年にデンマークで出生した男児を対象とした入れ子式症例対照研究である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例103例と対照446例の母体血清中4-OH-CHTを測定した。全体では濃度倍増あたりのハザード比は0.89で有意差はなかった。1990年代の妊娠に限ると、非セミノーマで高いリスク推定値を示したが、信頼区間は1を含んだ。明確な関連は示されなかった。
pmid-42498104.summary_en: This nested case-control study measured maternal serum 4-hydroxychlorothalonil in 549 samples from 103 testicular germ cell cancer cases and 446 matched controls, born in Denmark between 1985 and 1994. Hazard ratios were estimated with Cox regression. The overall hazard ratio per doubling of concentration was 0.89, not significant, with higher estimates for nonseminomas. Restricted to 1990s pregnancies, when concentrations were higher, risk estimates were elevated but confidence intervals crossed unity. The authors conclude no overall association was found, although a possible nonseminoma signal warrants further study.

pmid-42500174.summary_ja: ブラジルの多施設後方視的コホート研究で、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍142例を対象に標準的なEMA/CO療法とアクチノマイシンDを省いたEM/CO療法を比較した。寛解率に有意差はなかったが、EM/CO群で化学抵抗性が多く、リスクスコア7以上で再発が高率だった。治療前hCG値は化学抵抗性の予測因子であった。
pmid-42500174.summary_en: This Brazilian multicenter retrospective cohort compared conventional EMA/CO chemotherapy with a modified EM/CO regimen lacking actinomycin-D in 142 women with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Remission rates were 85.3% with EMA/CO and 72.7% with EM/CO, a non-significant difference. EM/CO patients more often had invasive mole, while EMA/CO patients more often had choriocarcinoma and metastases. A risk score of 7 or more predicted recurrence and chemoresistance with EM/CO. Pretreatment serum hCG predicted chemoresistance, and the number of EM/CO cycles predicted toxicity.

pmid-42500365.summary_ja: 左卵巣に三胚葉成分を含む大型の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有する閉経後女性の症例報告。高齢と悪性化リスクを考慮し、開腹下に子宮全摘と両側付属器切除を行った。閉経後は悪性化リスクが高まるため、年齢・リスク・合併症に応じた個別化管理と早期診断の重要性を強調している。
pmid-42500365.summary_en: The authors report a postmenopausal woman with a large mature cystic teratoma of the left ovary containing elements from all three germ layers. She underwent laparotomy, hysterectomy, and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, chosen in view of her age and the risk of malignancy. The report reviews that mature cystic teratomas, although usually seen in young women, carry a higher malignancy risk in postmenopausal patients, and that symptoms may be nonspecific but complications can threaten life. The authors emphasize early detection, accurate diagnosis, and individualized management based on age, malignancy risk, and complications to improve outcomes.

pmid-42500623.summary_ja: 2006年から2021年に治療された、卵巣成熟奇形腫と推定された385例を後方視的に検討した単施設研究である。体細胞型腫瘍は3.1%、悪性転化は2.07%に認められた。腫瘍径の大きさと充実・嚢胞混合構造が腫瘍化の予測因子であり、術前の腫瘍マーカーは判別能を示さなかった。
pmid-42500623.summary_en: This retrospective single-center study reviewed 385 patients with presumed ovarian mature teratomas treated from 2006 to 2021, with systematic pathological re-evaluation. Somatic neoplasms were found in 3.1% and malignant transformation in 2.07%, with squamous cell carcinoma among the malignant types. Tumor diameter was larger in the neoplasm group, and mixed solid-cystic architecture strongly predicted neoplasia. Preoperative tumor markers had no discriminatory value, and frozen sections produced false-negative results.

pmid-42516376.summary_ja: 可塑剤ATBCと精巣セミノーマの予後に関連する遺伝子をネットワーク毒性学と複数の解析で検討。PDK1とOARD1が予後因子として同定され、TCGAコホートでのリスクモデルは1〜3年AUCが0.6超であった。免疫組織化学では腫瘍組織で両タンパクが低下していた。計算解析が中心で、さらなる検証が必要である。
pmid-42516376.summary_en: This study integrated network toxicology, bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing, and clinical data to examine how acetyl tributyl citrate (ATBC), a plasticizer, relates to prognosis in testicular seminoma. PDK1 and OARD1 were identified as ATBC-associated prognostic genes, and a risk model built in the TCGA-TGCT cohort achieved 1-, 2-, and 3-year AUCs above 0.6. Five cell subtypes were identified by single-cell analysis, with B cells considered the key population. Immunohistochemistry showed lower PDK1 and OARD1 protein levels in seminoma tissue than in normal testis. The authors propose these genes as prognostic biomarkers, though the findings are largely computational and require further validation.

pmid-42518873.summary_ja: 以前に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の嚢胞切除術を受けた39歳女性の症例。両側付属器腫瘤と腫瘍マーカー高値を認め、手術の結果、奇形腫内に発生した杯細胞腺癌と対側卵巣への浸潤が確認された。免疫組織化学では腸型分化を示した。術後に後腹膜リンパ節腫大が出現し、組織型に基づき消化管系の化学療法が選択された。現在は進行のため3次治療中である。
pmid-42518873.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman with a prior cystectomy for mature cystic teratoma who presented with bilateral adnexal masses and elevated CA-125, CEA and CA 19-9. Surgical staging found goblet cell adenocarcinoma arising in the teratoma, with contralateral ovarian involvement. Immunohistochemistry showed intestinal-type features. Retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy appeared after surgery, and a gastrointestinal-based chemotherapy regimen was chosen according to histology. The patient is on third-line treatment for progression. The authors note the absence of standard guidelines and call for collaborative reporting.

pmid-42519907.summary_ja: 左側頭部・頬・眼瞼に生じた成熟奇形腫の乳児例。PIK3CA関連過成長症候群を示唆する所見を伴い、プロプラノロールとシロリムスは奏効しなかった。外科的減量術により病理学的に完全切除された。骨浸食に対する再建が必要となったが外反は生じなかった。多職種管理と長期フォローアップの重要性を示す。
pmid-42519907.summary_en: An infant with a mature teratoma of the left temporal region, mid-cheek, lateral canthus, and upper eyelid, with components consistent with PIK3CA-related overgrowth syndrome. Oral propranolol and sirolimus failed to reduce the lesion, so surgical debulking was performed for diagnosis and treatment. Histopathology confirmed complete excision. Postoperatively, scars healed without ectropion, though bony erosion required later reconstruction. The authors emphasize multidisciplinary management and long-term follow-up for recurrence.

pmid-42521184.summary_ja: 2002年から2024年に小児後腹膜奇形腫24例を治療した単施設後方視的研究。開腹13例と腹腔鏡11例を比較した。腹腔鏡群は手術時間が長い一方、術後在院日数は短かった。出血量、合併症、再発に差はなく、中止例もなかった。選択された症例では腹腔鏡手術が実施可能と結論づけている。
pmid-42521184.summary_en: This single-center retrospective study compared open and laparoscopic resection of pediatric retroperitoneal teratomas in 24 children treated between 2002 and 2024. Thirteen underwent open surgery and 11 laparoscopic surgery. Baseline characteristics, tumor volume, and vessel encasement were similar. Laparoscopic surgery had a longer operative time (median 304 vs. 146 min) but shorter postoperative hospital stay (7 vs. 10 days). Blood loss, tumor rupture, complications, and recurrence did not differ, and no laparoscopic case required conversion. The authors conclude that laparoscopic resection is feasible for selected children with retroperitoneal teratoma.

pmid-42523533.summary_ja: 35歳時にpT1期セミノーマで左精巣摘除術を受け、補助化学療法を受けなかった46歳男性が、右精巣に異時性腫瘍を発症した。妊孕性温存のため精巣温存手術が施行された。術後22か月で性機能は保たれたが、精液検査で無精子症を認めた。若年発症の異時性腫瘍では精巣温存手術を考慮しうると考察された。
pmid-42523533.summary_en: A 46-year-old man developed a right testicular tumor 11 years after left orchiectomy for stage pT1 seminoma, for which he had not received adjuvant carboplatin. Because fertility and quality of life mattered, testis-sparing surgery was performed with a warm ischemia time of 32 minutes. Biopsy showed seminoma without germ cell neoplasia in situ. At 22 months, sexual function was preserved, but semen analysis showed azoospermia. The authors suggest testis-sparing surgery may be considered for young patients with metachronous tumors.

pmid-42526970.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の稀な亜型である卵巣甲状腺腫から生じた甲状腺癌を扱う総説。最も多いのは乳頭状甲状腺癌である。病理組織学的所見、分子病理、臨床的意義、予後を検討し、病変が卵巣に限局する場合は妊孕性温存手術、高リスク因子や卵巣外進展では甲状腺全摘と放射性ヨウ素アブレーションの検討が挙げられている。
pmid-42526970.summary_en: This review addresses thyroid carcinomas arising from struma ovarii, a rare subtype of ovarian teratoma. Papillary thyroid carcinoma is the most common carcinoma in this setting. The article discusses histopathologic findings, molecular pathology, clinical implications, and prognosis. Management includes surgery, with fertility-sparing approaches when disease is confined to the ovary, and consideration of total thyroidectomy and radioactive iodine ablation for high-risk pathologic features or disease spread beyond the ovary. The authors note that literature to guide evaluation and management is limited.

pmid-42529775.summary_ja: 27歳男性が右下腹部痛と腹膜炎で虫垂炎を疑われ開腹されました。虫垂は正常でしたが、540度捻転した精索を伴う11x13x12cmの腹腔内腫瘤を認めました。右根治的精巣摘除術を施行し、病理はセミノーマ(pT2N0M0S0、病期IB)でした。急性腹症では陰部の診察が重要と指摘されています。
pmid-42529775.summary_en: A 27-year-old man with right lower quadrant pain, vomiting and peritonitis underwent laparotomy for presumed appendicitis. The appendix was normal, but an 11 x 13 x 12 cm intra-abdominal mass with a 540-degree torsed spermatic cord was found, and the right testis was absent. Right radical orchiectomy was performed. Histopathology confirmed classical seminoma, staged pT2N0M0S0 stage IB. The authors emphasize that genital examination is essential in acute abdominal pain, to avoid missing a torsed undescended testicular malignancy.

pmid-42530234.summary_ja: 上大静脈症候群を呈した43歳男性である。胸部CTで血管内腫瘤が認められ、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)で強い集積を示した。腫瘍マーカーはNSEのみ軽度上昇していた。上大静脈腫瘍切除と上大静脈置換が行われ、病理組織学的にセミノーマと確定した。
pmid-42530234.summary_en: A 43-year-old man presented with superior vena cava syndrome. Chest CT showed an intravascular mass, and 18F-FDG PET/CT showed significant uptake, so malignancy was suspected before pathological confirmation. Among tumor markers, only NSE was mildly elevated. Resection of the SVC mass with SVC replacement was performed, and pathology confirmed classic seminoma. The report documents a rare primary seminoma arising within the superior vena cava.

pmid-42536610.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の組織学的成分間の空間的距離を定量するデジタル病理ワークフローの有効性を検討した概念実証研究。成熟奇形腫4例と神経成分を含む未熟奇形腫3例を解析した。気管支上皮と気管支腺など解剖学的に関連する組織対では距離が短く、技術的な実現性が示された。未熟成分と成熟成分の間には一貫した近接性は認められなかった。
pmid-42536610.summary_en: This proof-of-concept study developed a digital pathology workflow to quantify spatial distances among histological components in ovarian teratomas. Four mature teratomas and three immature teratomas with neural elements were analyzed by manual annotation of whole-slide images, centroid-based distance calculation, and exploratory statistics. Anatomically related pairs, such as bronchial epithelium and bronchial gland, showed short distances, supporting technical feasibility. No consistent proximity was observed between immature and mature components. The authors caution that spatial association does not imply biological interaction or lineage relationship.

pmid-42539462.summary_ja: モンゴルの妊娠性絨毛癌66例を2011〜2025年で後方視的に解析した。EMA/CO導入後は完全寛解率が69.7%から97.0%に上昇し、疾患関連死亡率は30.3%から3.0%に低下した。転移の有無が依然として予後を規定した。
pmid-42539462.summary_en: This 15-year retrospective cohort from Mongolia included 66 patients with gestational choriocarcinoma, of whom 57.6% had metastatic disease. After EMA/CO was introduced in 2018, complete remission rose from 69.7% to 97.0%, and disease-related mortality fell from 30.3% to 3.0%. Chemoresistance and relapse also declined, though not significantly. Metastatic disease remained the main prognostic factor. Because of the retrospective design and baseline differences between cohorts, the authors interpret the findings cautiously and emphasize serum β-hCG surveillance and standardized management.

pmid-42541120.summary_ja: 新生児の頸部成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で気道圧迫を来した1例。生後4日目に完全切除を行い、術前AFPは14,432.78 ng/mLと著明高値だった。術後に甲状腺機能低下症を認めたが、5か月時点で再発なくAFPは44.64 ng/mLに低下した。早期の気道確保と多職種による術後管理の重要性を示す。
pmid-42541120.summary_en: A male neonate with a large cervical mature cystic teratoma causing critical airway compression was managed with urgent intubation and complete surgical excision on day 4 of life. Preoperative serum AFP was markedly elevated at 14,432.78 ng/mL. Histopathology confirmed mature teratoma without immature elements. Postoperatively, subclinical hypothyroidism required levothyroxine. At 5 months there was no recurrence, and AFP had decreased to 44.64 ng/mL. The report emphasizes early airway stabilization, detailed imaging, complete excision, and multidisciplinary surveillance.

pmid-42541142.summary_ja: 原発性不妊症と横方向精巣異所症を有する34歳男性の症例報告である。右の異所性精巣腫瘍はセミノーマと診断され、両側精巣摘除術が行われた。遺伝子検査で新規のAMHR2複合ヘテロ接合変異が同定された。MRI、遺伝学的評価、早期の治療介入が不妊症や悪性転化のリスク低減に重要であると述べている。文献レビューも含む。
pmid-42541142.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with primary infertility and transverse testicular ectopia, in which a right ectopic testicular tumor proved to be seminoma. Bilateral orchiectomy was performed. Genetic testing identified novel compound heterozygous AMHR2 variants. The authors highlight the value of MRI, genetic evaluation, and early management to reduce infertility and the risk of malignant transformation in these patients. The paper includes a literature review of this rare anomaly, which is typically associated with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome.

pmid-42544240.summary_ja: シリアのラタキア大学病院で2007〜2025年に治療された精巣がん318例の後方視的解析。診断時中央値は32歳で、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（51.6%）がセミノーマ（45.9%）をやや上回った。混合型胚細胞腫瘍が最多の亜型であった。病期I・IIAの危険因子も評価し、世界的な分布と一致する結果であった。
pmid-42544240.summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 318 testicular cancer patients treated at Latakia University Hospital in Syria from 2007 to 2025. The median age at diagnosis was 32 years. Germ cell tumors predominated, with NSGCT (51.6%) slightly more frequent than seminoma (45.9%). Mixed germ cell tumor was the most common NSGCT subtype (29.9%). Most patients were stage I. Risk factors including vascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma, tumor size over 4 cm, and rete testis invasion were characterized. Findings align with global proportions.

pmid-42545162.summary_ja: 原発不明の非妊娠性絨毛癌と多発転移を有する56歳男性の陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)所見の症例報告です。18F-FDGの強い集積に対し、68Ga-FAPI-04の集積は限定的でした。単一症例であり一般化には限界がありますが、本例ではFDG PETがFAPI PETより病変描出に優れていました。
pmid-42545162.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old man with nongestational choriocarcinoma of unknown primary and multiple metastases who underwent both 18F-FDG and 68Ga-FAPI-04 PET/CT. The lesions showed intense 18F-FDG uptake but limited 68Ga-FAPI-04 accumulation. In this single patient, FDG imaging was more informative than FAPI imaging for lesion depiction. The report is brief and describes one patient, so generalizability is limited. Choriocarcinoma is a highly malignant trophoblastic tumor, and nongestational forms are extremely rare in men.

pmid-42549471.summary_ja: 意識障害と異常行動を呈した16歳女児で、抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が疑われ腹腔鏡手術による右卵管卵巣摘出術が施行されたところ、未熟卵巣奇形腫と判明した。免疫グロブリン療法、ステロイドパルス療法、血漿交換を行い、その後ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を施行した。早期の腫瘍摘出と薬物療法により症状は改善した。
pmid-42549471.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl with impaired consciousness and abnormal behavior was diagnosed with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. Laparoscopic right salpingo-oophorectomy for a presumed mature cystic teratoma revealed an immature ovarian teratoma. She then received immunoglobulin therapy, steroid pulse therapy and plasma exchange, followed by bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy. Early tumor removal and pharmacotherapy improved her symptoms. The authors urge clinicians to consider underlying malignant tumors in young patients with encephalitis.

pmid-42549863.summary_ja: 2000〜2024年に転移性精巣純粋セミノーマに対して化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた52例の単施設後方視的コホート研究。残存する生存セミノーマは、再発疑いで手術した例では100%、1次治療後では23%、2次以上の治療後では6%に認められた。大量化学療法を受けた15例では生存腫瘍は認めなかった。
pmid-42549863.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study from a single institution included 52 patients who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic testicular pure seminoma between 2000 and 2024. Residual viable seminoma was found in 100% of patients treated for suspected relapse, 23% after first-line chemotherapy, and 6% after two or more lines. None of 15 patients receiving high-dose chemotherapy had viable disease. Five patients relapsed, all with viable residual seminoma at surgery. The authors conclude that surgical benefit may be limited after first-line therapy, underscoring careful patient selection.

pmid-42549986.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍1850例(頭蓋外1316例、頭蓋内534例)を対象とした、COGレジストリに基づく観察研究である。社会経済的因子と診断時の進行病期との関連をロジスティック回帰で解析した。女性は遠隔転移期の診断オッズが低く、男性では無保険が進行病期のオッズ上昇と関連した。
pmid-42549986.summary_en: This registry-based cohort study used Children's Oncology Group data from 1850 pediatric germ cell tumor patients enrolled in 2003 to 2021, including 1316 extracranial and 534 intracranial cases. Logistic regression examined associations between socioeconomic factors, such as redlining scores, Child Opportunity Index, and insurance status, and late-stage diagnosis. Females had lower odds of distant-stage disease. Among males, uninsured status was associated with higher odds of late-stage disease. Individual socioeconomic factors appeared to explain more stage disparities than area-level factors.

pmid-42552511.summary_ja: 悪性成分を含む卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫26例の超音波所見を後方視的に解析した国際研究。原報告の46.2%は良性奇形腫と誤分類されていた。充実成分、血流豊富、大きな腫瘍径、閉経後が悪性疑いの因子であった。血清CA125の有用性は限られていた。
pmid-42552511.summary_en: This international retrospective study identified 26 patients with histologically confirmed malignancy within ovarian mature cystic teratomas, most commonly squamous cell carcinoma (50%). Original ultrasound reports misclassified 46.2% as benign teratoma. On expert retrospective review of images, 40% appeared typical of mature cystic teratoma, while 28% appeared malignant. Solid vascularized components, large size, older age, and postmenopausal status raised suspicion. Serum CA125 was of limited value, while squamous cell carcinoma antigen may be more useful.

pmid-42558765.summary_ja: 妊娠10〜11週の30歳女性が、精神症状、痙攣、重度の脳症で入院しました。脳脊髄液の抗NMDAR抗体は1:160で、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では右海馬の辺縁系脳炎所見がありました。両側の成熟卵巣奇形腫を腹腔鏡下に摘出し、免疫療法を併用した結果、症状は改善しました。妊娠中の早期の脳脊髄液検査と奇形腫の速やかな切除が重要です。
pmid-42558765.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman at 10 to 11 weeks of gestation developed psychiatric symptoms, seizures and severe encephalopathy. CSF anti-NMDAR IgG titer was 1:160, and MRI showed right hippocampal limbic encephalitis. Pelvic ultrasound identified adnexal masses suspicious for teratoma. She received steroids, IVIG, plasma exchange, rituximab and laparoscopic removal of bilateral mature ovarian teratomas, with pregnancy-conscious management. Motor events ceased by the end of the first postoperative week, and function gradually improved. The report emphasizes early CSF testing and prompt teratoma removal in pregnancy.

pmid-42559124.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍と傍大動脈リンパ節転移を有する70歳男性。根治的精巣摘除術後に病期IIC、純粋型セミノーマと診断された。CKDのためシスプラチンを使えず、カルボプラチン単剤療法（AUC 7）を4コース施行した。PET-CTで残存集積を認めず、治療後1.5年無病生存中である。
pmid-42559124.summary_en: A 70-year-old man with a left testicular tumor, para-aortic lymphadenopathy, and left hydronephrosis was diagnosed with stage IIC pure seminoma (pT1N3M0) after radical orchiectomy. Because chronic kidney disease and poor performance status precluded cisplatin, he received four cycles of carboplatin monotherapy (AUC 7). Grade 2-3 pancytopenia was managed with pegfilgrastim and dose interval adjustment. PET-CT after treatment showed no residual uptake, and consolidation para-aortic radiotherapy was given. He remained disease-free 1.5 years later.

pmid-42559448.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の再発性脳転移を有する22歳男性が、転移巣からの右前頭葉脳内出血で来院した症例報告である。新規のカメラ吸引装置を用いて緊急開頭腫瘍切除と血腫除去を行った。術後は化学療法と術腔への放射線療法を行ったが、急速に病勢が進行した。出血性脳転移の腫瘍切除を補助する低侵襲カメラ吸引システムの有用性が示された。
pmid-42559448.summary_en: This surgical case report describes a 22-year-old man with recurrent metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma who presented with acute right frontal intraparenchymal hemorrhage from a brain metastasis. Emergent craniotomy was performed using a novel camera-suction device to resect the tumor and evacuate the hematoma. Pathology confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma. Postoperatively he received chemotherapy and adjuvant radiation to the resection cavity, but the disease progressed rapidly. The authors describe the minimally invasive camera-suction system as an adjunct for resecting hemorrhagic brain metastases.

pmid-42562958.summary_ja: 精巣がん126例を後方視的に解析し、健常ドナー候補100例と比較した単施設コホート研究である。精液性状は全般に低下しており、凍結融解後にはさらに低下した。病期II例では非セミノーマで精液性状が良好であった。凍結精子を使用したのは8%で、生児出生率は67%であった。
pmid-42562958.summary_en: This retrospective single-center cohort study of 126 men with testicular cancer (83 seminoma, 35 non-seminoma, 8 sex-cord stromal tumors) compared baseline and post-thaw semen parameters with 100 healthy donor candidates. Testicular cancer patients had significantly impaired semen quality in nearly all parameters, and sex-cord stromal tumors had the poorest values. Pathology-specific differences within stage were seen only in stage II, favoring non-seminoma. Of 91 men who cryopreserved sperm, only 8% used it for assisted reproduction over a median 5.3-year follow-up, with a 67% live-birth rate. The authors recommend counseling that reflects pathology-related variation and banking multiple vials.

pmid-42565062.summary_ja: 3歳男児で、後縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍が脊柱管内へ進展し脊髄を圧迫して対麻痺を来した。術前化学療法後に手術を行い、神経症状は回復した。長期的に寛解を維持している。原発は縦隔であり、極めて稀な小児例として診断・治療上の課題を示す。
pmid-42565062.summary_en: A 3-year-old boy presented with paraplegia caused by a posterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor with intraspinal extension and spinal cord compression. Neoadjuvant chemotherapy was followed by surgery, which led to neurological recovery. The patient achieved long-term remission. The report highlights diagnostic and therapeutic challenges in this exceedingly rare pediatric presentation, where the primary tumor arose in the mediastinum rather than the central nervous system.

pmid-42570634.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の再発・難治例を対象に、葉酸受容体α(FRα)標的の新規抗体-ポリマー-薬物複合体を評価した基礎研究と症例報告である。細胞株とマウスモデルで既存薬より強い抗腫瘍効果を示した。
pmid-42570634.summary_en: This exploratory study compared the antibody-drug conjugate mirvetuximab soravtansine (MIRV) with a novel antibody-polymer-drug conjugate (MIRV-P-MMAE) targeting folate receptor α in testicular germ cell tumor models. MIRV-P-MMAE showed much greater cytotoxicity in FRα-positive choriocarcinoma cells, and in mice it significantly prolonged survival and cured 3 of 8 animals. Only 5.1% of TGCT samples showed membrane FRα, but all five post-chemotherapy samples showed cytoplasmic positivity. One patient with refractory disease achieved stabilization with MIRV. The authors support further exploration of this APDC in FRα-expressing refractory TGCT.

pmid-42571160.summary_ja: ドイツ・スイスの専門家59名への構造化アンケートで、臨床病期I・IIAの精巣がんの管理を評価した。I期セミノーマでリスク因子を有する症例に補助療法を行う施設は52.9%であった。I期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で積極的監視を常に選択する施設は11.5%にとどまり、ガイドラインとの乖離が認められた。
pmid-42571160.summary_en: A structured questionnaire was sent to 59 experts from German and Swiss centers to assess management of clinical stage I and IIA testicular cancer. Of 53 evaluable responses, 52.9% gave adjuvant therapy for seminoma stage I with risk factors, and only 11.5% always applied active surveillance for NSGCT stage I. Repeat imaging in stage IIA NSGCT was consistent in only 31.4%. Substantial discrepancies from guidelines were found, with risk of overtreatment.

pmid-42576447.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症（CAIS）の思春期後16例の性腺32個を対象に、術前骨盤MRIと病理所見を後方視的に比較した。セミノーマを含む肉眼的腫瘍は3例に認めた。均一な信号と拡散制限の欠如は腫瘍の不在と関連し、陰性的中率は100%であった。
pmid-42576447.summary_en: This retrospective review evaluated 32 gonads from 16 postpubertal individuals with molecularly confirmed complete androgen insensitivity syndrome who underwent preoperative pelvic MRI and bilateral gonadectomy. Macroscopic neoplasia occurred in three patients, including seminoma with germ cell neoplasia in situ. Homogeneous signal and absence of diffusion restriction were associated with absence of neoplasia, with a negative predictive value of 100%. Gonadal volume was ≤21.9 cm3 in non-neoplastic gonads and ≥116.4 cm3 in neoplastic lesions.

pmid-42577089.summary_ja: 61歳男性が黒色便、動悸、胸部圧迫感を呈し、小腸の性腺外非妊娠性絨毛癌と脳・肺・肝・リンパ節転移と診断された。エトポシドとシスプラチンによる化学療法を受け、β-hCGの著明な低下と血色素の上昇を認め、肺および肝転移の縮小を確認した。非特異的な症状のため診断が遅れやすく、高い臨床的疑いと早期治療の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-42577089.summary_en: A 61-year-old man presented with black stools, palpitations, and chest tightness, and was diagnosed with extragonadal non-gestational choriocarcinoma of the small intestine with metastases to the brain, lung, liver, and lymph nodes. He received etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy and showed a robust clinical and biochemical response, with marked reduction in β-hCG and increased hemoglobin. Follow-up imaging demonstrated shrinkage of pulmonary and liver metastases. The authors emphasize that the nonspecific presentation of this exceptionally rare entity often delays diagnosis, and highlight the need for high clinical suspicion and early treatment.

pmid-42578132.summary_ja: 生後2か月の男児で、肝芽腫を疑われた上腹部の10x8cm腫瘤を呈しました。手術で後腹膜に進展した腫瘍が確認され、卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫成分を含む悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断されました。肝左外側区域切除後、ブレオマイシン、カルボプラチン、エトポシドによる化学療法を実施しました。3年後も無再発で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常化しています。
pmid-42578132.summary_en: A 2-month-old Indian boy presented with abdominal distension and a 10 x 8 cm upper abdominal mass initially suspected to be hepatoblastoma. Surgery revealed a 12 x 10 cm tumor adherent to the liver with retroperitoneal extension. Histopathology showed a malignant mixed germ cell tumor with yolk sac and teratomatous elements. He underwent left lateral segmentectomy followed by adjuvant bleomycin, carboplatin and etoposide chemotherapy. At three years he remains disease free, with normalized AFP and no recurrence on MRI. The report stresses tumor marker evaluation and multidisciplinary care in neonatal GCTs.

pmid-42583670.summary_ja: 結核性胸膜炎の疑いで抗結核薬治療を開始した30歳女性の症例報告である。2週間後に肝炎と著明なAFP上昇（481 IU/mL）を認め、縦隔病変から胚細胞腫瘍が疑われた。RUCAMで薬剤性肝障害と判定され、病理組織学的検査で肺腺癌（SALL4陰性）と確定した。肝炎の回復とともにAFPは正常化した。AFPの上昇は程度と経時変化を臨床経過の中で解釈すべきと強調している。
pmid-42583670.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with pleural effusion, empirically treated for tuberculosis, who developed hepatitis and markedly elevated AFP (481 IU/mL) with a mediastinal mass suspected to be a germ cell tumor. Drug-induced liver injury was judged probable by RUCAM, and histology showed pulmonary adenocarcinoma negative for SALL4. AFP normalized as the hepatitis resolved. The authors emphasize that the magnitude and temporal pattern of AFP should be interpreted in clinical context, and that histopathological confirmation prevents misdiagnosis.

pmid-42586591.summary_ja: 妊娠30週に血圧上昇と呼吸困難を呈した20歳代前半の女性の症例です。当初は子癇前症関連の心肺疾患や周産期心筋症が疑われましたが、巨大な多嚢胞性縦隔腫瘤による心肺圧迫が判明しました。産後3か月で完全切除を受け、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定し、症状は消失しました。
pmid-42586591.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in her early 20s at 30 weeks of gestation with hypertension and dyspnoea, initially suspected of preeclampsia-associated cardiopulmonary disease or peripartum cardiomyopathy. Echocardiography showed preserved left ventricular function and right ventricular dilatation, while imaging revealed a large multicystic anterior mediastinal mass compressing cardiopulmonary structures. Labour was induced at 34 weeks. Three months postpartum, she underwent complete surgical resection, and pathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma with resolution of cardiopulmonary symptoms.

pmid-42588606.summary_ja: 反復性胞状奇胎の原因遺伝子NLRP7について、絨毛癌を含む妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍との関係を統合した総説。NLRP7の機能喪失はメチル化や免疫寛容に影響し、絨毛癌では発現上昇が報告されている。変異の型により自己卵子での妊娠可能性が異なるとし、がん監視と生殖判断を結ぶ仮説的枠組みを提案する。
pmid-42588606.summary_en: This review synthesizes NLRP7 biology in recurrent hydatidiform mole and gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, including choriocarcinoma. NLRP7 loss disrupts subcortical maternal complex assembly, maternal DMR methylation, and HLA-C-dependent immune privilege, while it is reported to be up-regulated in choriocarcinoma. Genetic permissiveness for autologous-oocyte pregnancy depends on variant type. The authors propose a framework linking cancer surveillance with reproductive decision-making, which is hypothesis-generating rather than validated.

pmid-42588652.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の寛解後にhCGが持続的に低値を示した46例を後方視的に解析しました。35例が再発し再治療を要しました。初回の低値hCGが20U/L超の11例は全例再発しました。ランドマーク解析では、ピーク値20U/L以下が無治療確率の高さと関連しました。
pmid-42588652.summary_en: This single-center retrospective study of 46 patients with gestational choriocarcinoma or invasive mole examined persistent low-level hCG (above 5 and up to 1000 U/L) after GTN remission. Thirty-five required retreatment, and all 11 patients whose first low-level hCG exceeded 20 U/L recurred. One-year treatment-free probability was 30.4%. Landmark analyses at 60, 90 and 180 days showed that a pre-landmark peak hCG of 20 U/L or lower was associated with higher treatment-free probability, supporting continued surveillance in selected patients.

pmid-42590165.summary_ja: 2015年から2024年に精巣胚細胞腫瘍で根治的精巣摘除術を受けた114例を後方視的に解析し、積極的監視と化学療法の無再発生存を比較した。傾向スコア重み付けによる補正後も、治療方針と無再発生存との間に有意な関連は認められなかった（HR 0.96）。事象数が少なく探索的な解析であり、同等性の根拠とはみなされない。
pmid-42590165.summary_en: This retrospective cohort of 114 patients who underwent radical orchiectomy for testicular germ cell tumour between 2015 and 2024 compared active surveillance with chemotherapy using inverse probability of treatment weighting to address confounding by indication. Recurrence occurred in 25.4%. Neither crude nor weighted Cox analyses showed a significant association between strategy and recurrence-free survival (weighted HR 0.96). The authors caution that limited events and residual imbalance make the findings exploratory and not evidence of equivalence.

pmid-42591338.summary_ja: 人工呼吸・CRRT・昇圧薬を要したICU入室の35歳男性。精巣腫大、肺・後腹膜転移、β-hCG 570 mIU/mL、LDH 2000 U/L超を認めた。病理確認前にPEI療法（シスプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミド）を開始し、1コースで著明に改善した。後の精巣摘除術でセミノーマの残存を認めた。
pmid-42591338.summary_en: A 35-year-old man in the ICU, requiring mechanical ventilation, CRRT, and vasopressors, had massive testicular swelling, extensive pulmonary and retroperitoneal metastases, beta-hCG of 570 mIU/mL, and LDH over 2000 U/L. Chemotherapy with PEI (cisplatin, etoposide, ifosfamide) was started before histological confirmation, with marked improvement after one cycle. Orchiectomy later showed necrosis with residual seminoma. Later cycles were modified due to renal failure, infection, cardiomyopathy, and ifosfamide toxicity. PET-CT after four cycles showed regression with residual lesions.

pmid-42591435.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫は悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍で最も多い組織型であり、妊娠中の発症はきわめてまれである。妊娠12週の21歳初産婦が骨盤内腫瘤で紹介され、専門家による超音波検査で本症が示唆された。妊娠15週に腹腔鏡手術で左付属器切除術が行われ、病理組織学的検査でIIB期と確定した。化学療法は見送られ、正期産で出産し、産後に病勢進行は認められなかった。
pmid-42591435.summary_en: Dysgerminoma is the most common subtype of malignant ovarian germ cell tumor, and it is exceptionally rare during pregnancy. A 21-year-old primigravida at 12 weeks was referred after a pelvic mass was detected. Expert ultrasound suggested dysgerminoma, and serum LDH was markedly elevated at 847 U/L. Laparoscopic left adnexectomy at 15 weeks confirmed stage IIB disease. Chemotherapy was deferred after multidisciplinary evaluation, and she delivered at term without evidence of progression.

pmid-42592012.summary_ja: 18歳未満の精巣・卵巣胚細胞腫瘍72例を対象とした後方視的分子臨床病理研究。89遺伝子パネルの標的シーケンスで、12p獲得やKRAS・TP53・KIT・NRASの変異などを同定した。遺伝子シグネチャー陽性例の3年無イベント生存率は65.0%で、陰性例の88.5%より低かった（p=0.019）。全生存期間には有意差がなく、仮説生成的な知見であり独立した検証が必要とされる。
pmid-42592012.summary_en: A retrospective molecular clinicopathological study of 72 patients under 18 with testicular or ovarian germ cell tumors, using targeted sequencing of an 89-gene panel. Recurrent alterations included 12p gain, KRAS, TP53, KIT, and NRAS mutations, and KRAS amplification. Twenty tumors were classified as signature-positive by a combined count of TP53 mutation, 12p gain, KRAS amplification, and other oncogenic alterations. Three-year event-free survival was 65.0% in signature-positive versus 88.5% in negative tumors (p=0.019), with a stage-adjusted hazard ratio of 2.74 for EFS. Overall survival did not differ significantly. The authors describe this as hypothesis-generating and requiring independent validation.

pmid-42592517.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫に対する術前化学療法後に腹痛と腹部膨満を呈した若年女性の症例である。両側成熟奇形腫に播種病変と腹水浸潤を認めた。播種は通常、未熟奇形腫に多く、成熟奇形腫では極めて稀である。
pmid-42592517.summary_en: The authors report a young woman who had received neoadjuvant chemotherapy for an immature ovarian teratoma and then presented with abdominal pain and distension. Hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy revealed bilateral mature teratoma with disseminated deposits and ascitic fluid involvement. The deposits contained elements from all three germ layers, with glial tissue the most widely implanted. Mature teratoma with deposits is very rare, as deposits are usually seen in immature teratomas. The report aims to clarify the literature on disseminated deposits and ascites in mature ovarian teratoma.

pmid-42592585.summary_ja: 30歳未経妊女性。腹痛と腹部膨満、CEA高値（CA125は正常）で受診し、約22Lの粘液性腹水を認めた。卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した低悪性度粘液性腫瘍で、消化管型の免疫表現型を示した。虫垂は正常で、卵巣由来の腹膜偽粘液腫の一例である。
pmid-42592585.summary_en: A 30-year-old nulliparous woman presented with abdominal pain, distension, and markedly elevated CEA with normal CA125. Surgery revealed a large ovarian mass and about 22 L of mucinous ascites. Oophorectomy, appendectomy, omentectomy, and peritoneal biopsies were performed. Pathology showed a low-grade mucinous neoplasm arising in a mature cystic teratoma, with a gastrointestinal-type immunophenotype. The appendix was grossly normal. The patient had an uncomplicated course and is under surveillance. The report highlights an ovarian source mimicking appendiceal pseudomyxoma peritonei.

pmid-42595378.summary_ja: 胎児母体間出血を伴うことのあるまれな妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍、胎盤内絨毛癌の症例報告である。38週で緊急帝王切開を受けた28歳女性で、産後13日目の大量出血に対し子宮動脈塞栓術が施行された。β-hCGの上昇と肺結節から診断され、化学療法で完全寛解が得られた。
pmid-42595378.summary_en: Intraplacental choriocarcinoma is a rare gestational trophoblastic tumor that can cause fetomaternal hemorrhage. A 28-year-old woman underwent emergency cesarean section at 38 weeks. Severe neonatal anemia and elevated maternal alpha-fetoprotein suggested fetomaternal hemorrhage. Thirteen days postpartum, massive bleeding required uterine artery embolization. Elevated β-hCG and pulmonary nodules led to the diagnosis. Chemotherapy with methotrexate, etoposide and actinomycin D achieved complete remission, and embolization did not appear to impair its efficacy.

pmid-42595387.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された口蓋の胎児内胎児の症例です。妊娠23週の4cm口腔内腫瘤に対し、妊娠34週で子宮外分娩時治療(EXIT)を行い気道を確保しました。その後、気管切開と段階的切除を実施しました。病理組織学的に神経、消化管、副腎、皮膚、骨、歯などが確認され、Spencer基準を満たしました。児は生後96日に退院しています。
pmid-42595387.summary_en: A prenatally diagnosed palatal fetus-in-fetu, a rare anomaly closely related to epignathus (a teratoma), was managed with ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT). A 4 cm oral mass at 23 weeks caused polyhydramnios and gastric shrinkage. Cesarean delivery with EXIT at 34+5 weeks secured the airway, followed by tracheostomy and staged resection. Histopathology showed nerve, gastrointestinal, adrenal, skin, bone and tooth tissues, meeting Spencer's criteria. The infant was discharged on postnatal day 96. The authors emphasize individualized prenatal planning and team collaboration.

pmid-42596731.summary_ja: 管内進展を示す精子細胞性腫瘍20例を多施設で収集し、免疫組織化学的に再検討した。管内成分は胚細胞上皮内腫瘍（GCNIS）と異なり基底膜肥厚を欠き、精子形成を伴うことが多かった。SSX陽性・OCT4陰性で、セミノーマとの鑑別に有用である。
pmid-42596731.summary_en: This multi-institutional study collected 20 spermatocytic tumors (ST) with intratubular spread and re-examined them with OCT4, CD117, SSX, and DMRT1 staining. Intratubular ST involved 3 to more than 50 tubules, typically along the invasive tumor periphery, and usually filled the tubule. Unlike GCNIS, intratubular ST lacked thickened basement membranes and often showed concomitant spermatogenesis. All cases were SSX-positive and OCT4-negative. CD117 was variably positive. The authors caution that intratubular ST can mimic seminoma or GCNIS and should be distinguished using morphology and immunohistochemistry.

pmid-42598711.summary_ja: 複視、めまい、胸部圧迫感と体重増加を呈した20歳男性の症例である。前縦隔と脳に同時に病変を認め、生検と脳脊髄液検査から性腺外セミノーマと診断された。精巣微小石灰化を長年認めていた。全脳照射とBEP療法(シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン)で良好な臨床的・画像的反応が得られた。
pmid-42598711.summary_en: A 20-year-old man presented with diplopia, dizziness, chest tightness and weight gain. Imaging, biopsy and cerebrospinal fluid analysis revealed an extragonadal seminoma involving the anterior mediastinum and brain simultaneously. He had longstanding testicular microlithiasis. Treatment with whole-brain radiation and BEP chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin) produced a favorable clinical and radiological response. The case offers insights into atypical metastatic patterns, diagnostic challenges and prognosis of extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-42606737.summary_ja: 18歳未満の8cm以上の嚢胞性卵巣腫瘤30例を後方視的に検討し、卵巣温存手術と卵巣摘出術を比較しています。腫瘍はすべて良性で、奇形腫が17例と最多でした。腫瘍マーカーはほとんどが陰性でした。巨大であっても適応を選べば卵巣温存が可能かを検討しています。
pmid-42606737.summary_en: This retrospective study of 30 girls under 18 with cystic ovarian masses of at least 8 cm evaluated ovarian-sparing surgery (OSS) and compared it with oophorectomy. The median tumor diameter was 148 mm. All tumors were benign, with 17 teratomas, 12 cystadenomas and 2 functional cysts. Tumor markers were negative in most patients. The study aims to show that large tumor size alone should not preclude ovarian preservation in selected pediatric patients. The provided abstract does not report the comparative outcomes between surgical groups.

pmid-42609705.summary_ja: 汎血球減少を呈した24歳男性で、陰嚢内腫瘤に対し右精巣摘除術が施行され、胎児性癌と傍大動脈リンパ節転移が確認された。汎血球減少は骨髄異形成症候群と診断された。用量調整を伴う化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の後、同種造血幹細胞移植を行い、術後2年間再発を認めなかった。
pmid-42609705.summary_en: A 24-year-old man with pancytopenia underwent right orchiectomy for a scrotal mass, which revealed embryonal carcinoma with para-aortic lymph node metastasis. The pancytopenia was diagnosed as myelodysplastic syndrome. Chemotherapy with dose modifications over a prolonged course was followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, which found viable tumor cells. After adjuvant chemotherapy and allogeneic stem cell transplantation for MDS, he remained free of recurrence for 2 years. Careful management may achieve durable disease control in such cases.

pmid-42610477.summary_ja: 53研究・7,585例を統合したシステマティックレビューとネットワークメタ解析。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の化学療法抵抗性は23.8%で、絨毛癌、高いFIGOスコア、高β-hCG、腫瘍量の多さなどが関連した。エトポシド含有レジメン（特にFAEV）は抵抗性の順位が低い傾向を示したが、前向きの検証が必要とされる。
pmid-42610477.summary_en: This systematic review and network meta-analysis of 53 studies (7,585 patients) estimated chemoresistance in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia at 23.8%. Choriocarcinoma, high FIGO score, pretreatment β-hCG above 10^5 IU/L, greater tumor burden, longer interval from antecedent pregnancy, and first-line single-agent chemotherapy were associated with resistance. Exploratory ranking suggested that methotrexate and fluorouracil rank higher for predicted resistance, whereas etoposide-containing regimens, particularly FAEV, rank lower. The authors conclude these findings require prospective validation before informing treatment selection.

pmid-42611982.summary_ja: 36歳男性の右精巣腫瘍（4.5cm）で精巣摘除術が行われた。混合型胚細胞腫瘍に加え、体細胞型の胎児型神経外胚葉性腫瘍とネフロブラストーマが併存していた。術後1か月で後腹膜リンパ節転移が出現し化学療法を受け、13か月時点で転移を認めず生存している。原発精巣腫瘍内に両成分が同時に存在した初の報告である。
pmid-42611982.summary_en: A 36-year-old man with a 4.5 cm right testicular mass underwent orchiectomy. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor with teratoma, seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, and yolk sac tumor components, plus an embryonic-type neuroectodermal tumor and a nephroblastoma as somatic-type malignancies. Immunohistochemistry showed SOX11 positivity in the neuroectodermal component and PAX8 and WT1 positivity in the nephroblastoma. One month later he developed a retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis, treated with chemotherapy. He remained alive without metastatic disease at 13 months. The authors report the first such concurrent combination within a primary testicular tumor.

pmid-42614196.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇した29歳女性で、腹腔鏡検査により絨毛癌と診断された。STR遺伝子型検査に必要な組織が不足したため、経験的に治療され寛解を得た。3年後に骨盤内の単発再発を切除したところ、完全胞状奇胎に由来すると判明し、予後スコアが修正された。現在25か月間無病生存中である。
pmid-42614196.summary_en: A 29-year-old woman with rising hCG was initially diagnosed with ectopic pregnancy, and laparoscopy showed choriocarcinoma. The tissue was insufficient for short tandem repeat genotyping, so she was treated empirically and went into remission. Three years later an isolated pelvic recurrence was resected, and STR genotyping revealed a homozygous androgenetic pattern, consistent with a complete hydatidiform mole. The prognostic score was revised accordingly, and she remained disease-free at 25 months of follow-up.

pmid-42614392.summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者60例の治療前血漿を用いた探索的バイオマーカー研究。HLA-GとオステオポンチンのELISA値が高いことが、PD-1阻害薬+化学療法への一次抵抗性と関連した。2マーカーモデルの見かけ上のAUCは0.908だったが、外部検証は行われていない。低侵襲な治療前リスク層別化の候補となりうるが、独立した検証が必要である。
pmid-42614392.summary_en: This biomarker study used data-independent acquisition mass spectrometry on pretreatment plasma from 30 patients with choriocarcinoma, followed by ELISA in a full cohort of 60 patients. Elevated baseline HLA-G and osteopontin were associated with primary resistance to PD-1 inhibitor plus chemotherapy. An exploratory two-marker model showed an apparent AUC of 0.908 in the same cohort, without external validation. Tissue immunophenotyping and public datasets provided supporting biological context. The authors suggest these markers could serve as candidate minimally invasive tools for pretreatment risk stratification.

pmid-42614904.summary_ja: 原発性後腹膜混合型胚細胞腫瘍の55歳男性で、BEP療法後に体細胞型悪性腫瘍が出現し、その後局所再発した。再発腫瘍でマイクロサテライト不安定性高度陽性（MSI-high）が判明した。適切な組織選択と適時のMSI検査の重要性を示す。
pmid-42614904.summary_en: A 55-year-old man with a primary retroperitoneal mixed germ cell tumor received four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Fourteen months later, retroperitoneal lymph node enlargement led to dissection that revealed a somatic-type malignancy. Six months after that, local recurrence developed. Microsatellite instability testing of the resected recurrent tumor showed MSI-high status, although initial sampling had not identified it. The authors conclude that careful tissue selection and timely MSI testing are essential to identify potentially actionable cases in germ cell tumors, especially when immune checkpoint inhibitors may be considered.

pmid-42617029.summary_ja: 小児にきわめてまれな胃奇形腫の、2か月齢男児の症例報告である。出生時から進行性の腹部膨満を呈した。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、胃の後下面由来の脂肪と石灰化を含む大きな腫瘤が確認された。開腹下に完全切除され、病理組織学的検査で奇形腫と確定した。
pmid-42617029.summary_en: Gastric teratoma is an extremely rare neoplasm in childhood. The authors report a 2-month-old male infant with progressive abdominal distension since birth. Ultrasonography and CT showed a large mass arising from the posteroinferior stomach, containing fat and calcification. Laparotomy achieved complete excision, and histopathological examination confirmed teratoma. The case highlights the rarity of extragonadal teratoma in infancy and the role of imaging in preoperative evaluation of a large abdominal mass.

pmid-42621335.summary_ja: モンゴルにおける妊娠性絨毛癌の治療成績(EMA/CO導入前後)に関する後方視的コホート研究の訂正通知です。本記録には訂正内容の詳細は示されていません。具体的な変更点は原論文と訂正版をご確認ください。
pmid-42621335.summary_en: This is a correction notice for a 15-year retrospective cohort study on treatment outcomes of gestational choriocarcinoma in Mongolia before and after EMA/CO introduction. The notice states only that it corrects the article with DOI 10.3389/fonc.2026.1863040. No details of the corrected content are given in this record. Readers should consult the original article and its correction for the specific changes.

pmid-42624851.summary_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の非造影CT642例からなる公開データセットを提示する。成熟・未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ、胎児性癌の6組織亜型を含む。ラジオミクスを用いた予備的機械学習で有用性が示された。
pmid-42624851.summary_en: The authors present CT-PEGCT-Diag, a publicly available dataset of 642 non-enhanced CT scans of pediatric extracranial germ cell tumors covering six histological subtypes, including mature and immature teratoma, yolk sac tumor, mixed germ cell tumor, dysgerminoma, and embryonal carcinoma. The dataset includes standardized preprocessing, quality control, and expert-annotated tumor masks. Preliminary radiomics-based machine learning models show its utility for diagnostic tool development. The dataset is intended to support validation of AI models and research into imaging biomarkers for subtype classification.

pmid-42626665.summary_ja: 38歳女性が腹部膨満感と早期満腹感で受診した。腫瘍マーカー(AFP、CEA)は正常範囲だった。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で左肝葉に隣接する17.7cmの複雑な嚢胞性病変を認め、脂肪成分と壁在結節を伴っていた。小網由来の被膜に包まれた腫瘤を開腹下に切除し、病理組織学的検査で三胚葉成分を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。術後経過は良好だった。肝周囲奇形腫は画像上、肝嚢胞性病変と類似しうる。
pmid-42626665.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman presented with abdominal bloating and early satiety. Tumor markers AFP and CEA were normal. MRI showed a 17.7 cm complex cystic lesion adjacent to the left hepatic lobe with fatty components and a mural nodule. Laparotomy excised an encapsulated mass arising from the lesser omentum. Histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma containing all three germ layers, and the postoperative course was uneventful. The report highlights that perihepatic teratomas can mimic hepatic cystic lesions on imaging.

pmid-42628849.summary_ja: 精巣摘除標本16例（純粋セミノーマと精巣網のパジェット様浸潤）で12番染色体短腕の等染色体（i(12p)）をFISHで評価した後方視的研究。精巣網の浸潤病変14例中13例はi(12p)陰性で、浸潤性セミノーマは14例中5例（36%）で陽性だった。胚細胞上皮内腫瘍の拡がりとする解釈を支持する結果であった。
pmid-42628849.summary_en: This retrospective study assessed isochromosome 12p [i(12p)] by FISH in 16 orchiectomy specimens with pure seminoma and pagetoid rete testis involvement. Pagetoid rete testis lesions were i(12p)-negative in 13 of 14 evaluable cases, whereas invasive seminoma showed i(12p) in 5 of 14 (36%). Components negative for i(12p) showed polysomy 12, suggesting mutually exclusive alterations. The findings support interpretation of pagetoid rete testis involvement as spread of germ cell neoplasia in situ rather than invasion, with rare exceptions possibly representing retrograde invasion.

pmid-42628947.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫61例でSOX2とSALL4を評価した多施設後方視的研究である。SOX2は成熟成分と未熟成分の両方に陽性で、成熟度の鑑別能は低かった。形態学的再評価で当初の未熟奇形腫9例中5例が成熟奇形腫に再分類された。
pmid-42628947.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective study analyzed 61 ovarian teratomas, including 52 mature and 9 immature, to test SOX2 and SALL4 as markers of immature neuroectodermal tissue. SOX2 stained both immature and mature neuroectodermal elements, including glia and ependymal rosettes, so it does not discriminate maturity. SALL4 was positive only in immature components. Morphological reassessment reclassified 5 of 9 immature teratomas as mature. The authors recommend interpreting SOX2 together with morphology and SALL4 to avoid overdiagnosis.

pmid-42630273.summary_ja: クラスII肥満の13歳男児で、気管と左主気管支を圧迫する10.4×9.7 cmの前縦隔腫瘤を認めた。覚醒下に左二腔チューブで挿管したが、左気管支への挿入が困難であった。チューブを主気管内に戻し、両側ルーメンを用いた両側換気で対応した。一過性の高二酸化炭素血症は開胸後に改善した。腫瘍は完全切除され、成熟奇形腫と確定した。
pmid-42630273.summary_en: A 13-year-old boy with class II obesity had a 10.4 × 9.7 cm anterior mediastinal mass compressing the trachea and left main bronchus, with a pericardial effusion. Awake intubation with a left double-lumen tube was performed, but the left bronchus could not be entered. The tube was withdrawn into the main airway, and both lumens provided bilateral ventilation. Transient hypercapnia resolved after thoracotomy. Complete resection confirmed a mature teratoma, and the airway strategy was judged feasible for high-risk patients.

pmid-42633222.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんの患者に生じた、化学療法後の巨大後腹膜奇形腫を報告する。大動脈を巻き込んだ病変に対し一塊切除と大動脈再建を行い、R0切除を達成した。術後の合併症を経て、3年間無病経過が得られた。
pmid-42633222.summary_en: A 29-year-old man with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer developed a persistent 16 cm postchemotherapy retroperitoneal teratoma encasing the supraceliac and infrarenal aorta. He underwent en bloc resection with aortic replacement, extended left nephrectomy, and juxtarenal reconstruction with a rifampin-soaked graft, achieving an R0 resection. Postoperative complications included transient renal dysfunction and a chyle leak requiring intervention. At 3 years of follow-up, he remained disease-free. The report illustrates the surgical challenges of residual retroperitoneal teratoma after chemotherapy.

pmid-42633459.summary_ja: 30歳男性の前縦隔胚細胞腫瘍で、上大静脈閉塞と悪性心膜液貯留により心タンポナーデ直前の状態であった。化学療法後に心肺バイパス下で上大静脈のPTFE人工血管による再建を伴う外科的切除を施行した。大血管浸潤例での多診療科連携の重要性を強調している。
pmid-42633459.summary_en: A 30-year-old man had a large anterior mediastinal germ cell tumor causing superior vena cava obstruction and malignant pericardial effusion with impending cardiac tamponade. He received chemotherapy, then underwent surgical resection with SVC reconstruction using a PTFE graft under cardiopulmonary bypass. The authors emphasize the diagnostic complexity of mediastinal germ cell tumors and the importance of multidisciplinary care when tumors invade great vessels and adjacent cardiac structures.

pmid-42637219.summary_ja: MRKH症候群の18歳女性で、左遺残子宮角の切除標本の病理組織学的検査により、子宮筋層内の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が偶然見つかった症例報告。後方視的なMRI再読で、見逃されていたT2低信号病変が確認された。遺残子宮角における成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の初報告とされる。
pmid-42637219.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old with Mayer-Rokitansky-Küster-Hauser syndrome and primary amenorrhea who underwent laparoscopic vaginoplasty and excision of a left rudimentary uterine horn. Histopathology unexpectedly revealed an intramyometrial mature cystic teratoma in the horn wall. Retrospective MRI review identified a subtle T2-hypointense lesion that had been overlooked. The authors note this is the first reported mature cystic teratoma within a rudimentary uterine horn in MRKH syndrome, and highlight the rarity of extragonadal dermoids.

pmid-42643034.summary_ja: 後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に高分化神経内分泌腫瘍が生じた19歳男性の症例である。ロボット支援下切除のみで6か月間無病であった。文献上、同様の報告は少なく、完全切除後の多くは低悪性度で経過している。
pmid-42643034.summary_en: The authors present a 19-year-old man with a retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma containing a well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor, with Ki-67 of 2%. No metastases were found on staging, and robotic resection was performed without adjuvant therapy. He remained disease-free at 6 months. A focused literature review identified only a few reported cases of neuroendocrine tumors arising in mature cystic teratomas, most of which behaved indolently after complete excision. The authors support surgical resection as definitive treatment and call for standardized reporting and long-term follow-up.

pmid-42644162.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往がある31歳男性が、根治的精巣摘除術の数か月後に心不全と呼吸困難を発症した。三尖弁と肺動脈分枝に腫瘤を認め、病理学的に未熟成分と成熟成分を含む奇形腫と確定した。感染性心内膜炎や肺塞栓症に類似し診断遅延を招くため、心臓腫瘤では転移の可能性を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-42644162.summary_en: A 31-year-old man with a history of testicular germ cell tumor developed heart failure and respiratory distress months after radical orchiectomy. Imaging showed masses in the tricuspid valve and pulmonary branches. Histopathology confirmed a teratoma with immature and mature elements. Tricuspid valve replacement and pulmonary mass removal were planned. The authors note that GCT metastases can mimic infective endocarditis or pulmonary embolism, potentially causing diagnostic delay.

pmid-42645894.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における循環マイクロRNA（特にmiR-371a-3p）の総説。非奇形性の生存腫瘍の診断精度が高く、初診時には従来の腫瘍マーカーを上回る。化学療法モニタリングや再発検出への応用が期待される一方、奇形腫は検出できず、測定法の標準化と前向き検証が課題である。
pmid-42645894.summary_en: This narrative review summarizes evidence on circulating microRNAs, particularly miR-371a-3p, as liquid biopsy biomarkers across the testicular germ cell tumor disease continuum. miR-371a-3p shows high diagnostic accuracy for viable non-teratomatous TGCTs, outperforms conventional markers AFP, β-hCG and LDH at primary diagnosis, and declines rapidly after effective treatment, supporting roles in chemotherapy monitoring and relapse detection. Its inability to detect teratoma is a major limitation. Assay heterogeneity, lack of standardized cutoffs and the need for prospective validation remain barriers to clinical implementation.

pmid-42650941.summary_ja: 40歳女性の多発転移性絨毛癌の症例。脳内出血の再発、肺腫瘤、肝被膜下血腫で発症した。妊娠は否定されたが、β-hCGは高値であった。肝組織の病理組織学的検査で絨毛癌の転移が確認され、化学療法によりβ-hCGは低下した。出血性の脳・肝転移が血管奇形などと誤認されうることを示す。
pmid-42650941.summary_en: This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with multimetastatic choriocarcinoma who presented with recurrent intracerebral hemorrhage, a lung mass and subcapsular liver hematomas. Pregnancy was excluded despite elevated beta-hCG. Histopathology of liver tissue confirmed choriocarcinoma metastases. She received chemotherapy, and beta-hCG levels decreased. The case highlights that choriocarcinoma can present with hemorrhagic brain and liver metastases, which may be mistaken for vascular malformations.

pmid-42650952.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍に伴う傍腫瘍性神経症候群の症例とPRISMAに準拠した33研究のレビューである。卵巣奇形腫に伴う抗NMDAR脳炎は概ね良好な回復を示した。一方、上皮性卵巣悪性腫瘍に関連する抗Yo関連小脳変性症は予後が不良であった。
pmid-42650952.summary_en: The authors report a 58-year-old woman with anti-Yo-associated cerebellar dysfunction and FIGO IIIC high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma, who had progressive neurological disability despite tumor control. They also performed a PRISMA-guided review of PubMed and Scopus, identifying 33 studies of paraneoplastic neurological syndromes associated with ovarian tumors from 2016 to 2026. Anti-NMDAR encephalitis, mainly linked to ovarian teratomas, generally showed favorable recovery.
