Anti-Yo-associated cerebellar degeneration, mainly linked to epithelial ovarian malignancies, had poorer outcomes. The authors emphasize prompt antibody testing and multidisciplinary care.

pmid-42656285.summary_ja: 無月経、性器出血、β-hCG高値の40歳女性が、当初子宮外妊娠を疑われた。腹腔鏡で回腸腫瘍を切除し絨毛癌と診断され、原発性小腸絨毛癌と確定された。FAV療法で生化学的完全寛解となったが、13か月後に肺と右付属器の転移で再発した。付属器病変は化学療法抵抗性で、付属器切除と地固め療法により長期寛解を得た。
pmid-42656285.summary_en: A 40-year-old woman with amenorrhea, vaginal bleeding and elevated beta-hCG was initially suspected of ectopic pregnancy. Laparoscopy revealed an ileal tumour, which was resected and proved to be choriocarcinoma; normal pelvic viscera and imaging excluded other primaries. After FAV chemotherapy she achieved complete biochemical remission, but relapsed 13 months later with pulmonary and right adnexal metastases. The adnexal lesion was chemoresistant, and adnexectomy followed by consolidation FAEV produced durable remission. The authors emphasise this diagnostic pitfall and the value of multimodal therapy for refractory disease.

pmid-42661924.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍41例の保存FFPE標本50検体を対象に、NanoStringで30遺伝子を解析した後方視的探索研究。化学療法後奇形腫は、POU5F1の発現低下とアポトーシス・細胞周期関連遺伝子の上昇という特徴的な発現パターンを示した。一方、プラチナ耐性と感受性の原発腫瘍では有意差を示す遺伝子は同定されず、本遺伝子セットでは耐性を捉えられなかった。
pmid-42661924.summary_en: A retrospective exploratory molecular profiling study of 50 archival FFPE testicular germ cell tumor samples from 41 patients, examining 30 genes related to apoptosis, DNA repair, and cell cycle using NanoString nCounter. Samples included platinum-sensitive, platinum-resistant, and post-chemotherapy teratomas. Post-chemotherapy teratomas showed distinct expression, with lower POU5F1 (OCT4) and higher apoptosis and cell-cycle genes. However, platinum-resistant and sensitive primary tumors overlapped substantially, and no gene reached differential expression thresholds. The authors conclude that this gene set did not capture platinum resistance and call for broader genomic, immune, and epigenomic profiling.

pmid-42662666.summary_ja: 精巣病変のない転移性性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する27歳男性の症例である。貧血に対する輸血後に輸血関連循環過負荷が疑われる呼吸不全を来した。集中治療と化学療法を行ったが、心停止により死亡した。
pmid-42662666.summary_en: The authors describe a 27-year-old man with metastatic extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor presenting with a large retroperitoneal mass, pulmonary and hepatic metastases, and markedly elevated β-hCG without a testicular lesion. Severe anemia required multiple transfusions, after which he developed hypoxic respiratory failure with pulmonary edema, suspected to be transfusion-associated circulatory overload. Despite intensive care, hepatic embolization, and chemotherapy, he died of cardiac arrest. The case illustrates the aggressive course of metastatic extragonadal NSGCT and the need for careful transfusion practice and vigilance for transfusion reactions.

pmid-42663715.summary_ja: 1990～2023年に11施設で行われた化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清（PC-RPLND）を、傾向スコアマッチングでロボット手術と開腹手術に分けて比較した後方視的研究です。3年無再発生存率は同等でしたが、ロボット手術では出血量、在院日数、合併症（16.4%対32.1%）が少ない結果でした。
pmid-42663715.summary_en: This multicenter retrospective study compared robotic and open post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) for testicular cancer across eleven academic centers from 1990 to 2023. Propensity score matching produced 134 matched pairs. Three-year relapse-free survival was similar (92.8% robotic vs. 88.5% open), but robotic surgery was associated with less blood loss, shorter hospital stay, and fewer complications (16.4% vs. 32.1%), including no ileus. Lymph node yield and viable tumor rates were comparable. The retrospective design is a key limitation.

pmid-42663935.summary_ja: スペイン・タラゴナ県の人口ベース腫瘍登録に基づき、1980~2018年の精巣胚細胞がん458例を解析した観察研究である。罹患率は年4.3%で有意に上昇し、特に40~49歳で増加した。病期I が大半を占め、近年の10年ネット生存率は90%を超えた。
pmid-42663935.summary_en: This population-based registry study describes trends in testicular germ cell cancer incidence, mortality, and survival in Tarragona, Spain, from 1980 to 2018 among 458 cases. Seminomas accounted for 55%. Incidence rose significantly (APC 4.3%), most markedly in men aged 40 to 49. Most cases were stage I. Mortality was stable. Ten-year net survival exceeded 90% in recent years, although the improvement was not statistically significant. Associations with LDH, β-hCG, and AFP were analyzed.

pmid-42665409.summary_ja: 急性血腹で発症した33歳女性で、病期IVBの卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(ディスジャーミノーマ60%、絨毛癌40%、限局性の卵黄嚢腫瘍)と診断された。最適な減量手術後、小児腫瘍学の考え方を取り入れた隔週投与の用量強化型Cy-BEP-MTXを選択した。7コースを完遂して完全寛解に至り、3年間無増悪生存期間を維持している。
pmid-42665409.summary_en: A 33-year-old woman presented with acute hemoperitoneum and was diagnosed with stage IVB mixed ovarian germ cell tumor comprising 60% dysgerminoma, 40% choriocarcinoma and focal yolk sac tumor. After optimal cytoreductive surgery, a multidisciplinary tumor board chose a dose-dense modified Cy-BEP-MTX regimen given every two weeks, incorporating pediatric oncology principles. She completed seven cycles, achieved complete remission and has remained progression-free for three years. The authors suggest that for ultra-high-risk non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma, optimal surgery followed by a pediatric-inspired dose-dense regimen may offer better cure rates than standard adult protocols.

pmid-42668959.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う抗NMDAR脳炎の26歳女性の症例である。腫瘍摘出と一次免疫療法の後も症状が持続し、シクロホスファミドを追加した。その後、両側大脳基底核と黒質の異常を伴う嗜眠と振戦が出現し、追加治療で改善した。
pmid-42668959.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma underwent tumor resection and received first-line immunotherapy. Persistent symptoms led to cyclophosphamide, which improved her condition. Later she developed lethargy and upper-limb tremor, with bilateral basal ganglia and substantia nigra abnormalities on MRI. An additional course of cyclophosphamide led to improvement in both clinical symptoms and imaging findings. The authors suggest that further immunotherapy may be effective for delayed neurological worsening in refractory cases.

pmid-42670651.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に出現する多様な組織像を総説したものです。growing teratoma syndrome、体細胞型悪性腫瘍、肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍、血管形成性間葉系病変、絨毛性腫瘍などを取り上げています。古典的な組織型と化学療法抵抗性の発生機序を概説し、化学療法後切除標本の病理診断の要点を解説しています。治療後数年経過して出現することもあるため、病理医の注意を喚起しています。
pmid-42670651.summary_en: This review examines postchemotherapy germ cell tumor phenotypes in testicular tumors, including growing teratoma syndrome, somatic-type malignancies, sarcomatoid yolk sac tumors, vasculogenic mesenchymal lesions and trophoblastic tumors. It summarizes classic GCT morphologic subtypes and mechanisms of chemotherapy resistance. The authors guide pathologists in diagnostic handling of postchemotherapy resection specimens, noting that these changes can appear years after initial therapy.

pmid-42678028.summary_ja: 出生時に外性器異常があり、16年間先天性副腎過形成として治療された20歳女性の症例である。全ゲノム解析でアロマターゼ欠損症が確定し、手術で両側性性腺芽腫と右卵巣のディスジャーミノーマが判明した。両者の併存が因果関係かどうかは不明である。
pmid-42678028.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with ambiguous genitalia at birth had been treated for 21-hydroxylase deficiency for 16 years. Evaluation for amenorrhea revealed hypergonadotropic hypogonadism with a 46,XX karyotype, and whole-genome sequencing identified a homozygous CYP19A1 splice-site variant consistent with aromatase deficiency. Surgery showed bilateral gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma in the right ovary. This is the first genetically confirmed aromatase deficiency case with coexisting gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma, and whether the association is causal remains uncertain.

pmid-42686232.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の基本事項と、外科的管理を含む現在のベストプラクティスを概説した総説。原発部位により外科的管理は異なるが、いずれの部位でも適切な治療と病期分類に手術が中心的役割を担う。小児では、治癒を最大化しつつ将来の妊孕性を含む臓器機能を温存することが目標とされる。
pmid-42686232.summary_en: This review summarizes the fundamentals of pediatric and adolescent extracranial germ cell tumors and current best practices for their surgical and overall management. The authors note that surgical strategy varies by primary site, including gonadal and extragonadal locations, but that surgery is central to achieving adequate treatment and staging across all sites. In children, surgical goals include maximizing cure while preserving organ function, including future fertility. The article provides an overview of principles relevant to clinicians managing these rare tumors.

pmid-42687164.summary_ja: 出生3日目の男児で、右腹部腫瘤と右停留精巣を認めた。画像検査では奇形腫との鑑別に苦慮したが、切除標本の病理組織学的検査で胎内胎児(FIF)と診断された。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は日齢に応じて正常範囲であった。完全切除と超音波検査・腫瘍マーカーによる長期フォローアップが推奨されている。
pmid-42687164.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-day-old male neonate with a right abdominal mass and an undescended right testis. Prenatal ultrasound and postnatal MRI and contrast-enhanced CT showed a cystic-solid mass with fat-like signal and calcifications, creating uncertainty between fetus-in-fetu (FIF) and teratoma. Serum AFP and hCG were not elevated for age. Laparotomy revealed a 5.0 cm encapsulated mass arising from the undescended testis, which was excised with the atrophic testicular tissue. Histopathology showed an organized axial skeleton and multiple differentiated tissues, fulfilling Willis criteria for FIF. The authors stress recognizing calcified skeletal elements and fat components to avoid misdiagnosis as teratoma, and recommend complete excision with long-term ultrasonography and tumor marker follow-up.

pmid-42688378.summary_ja: 閉経後の54歳タンザニア女性で、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の高分化扁平上皮癌が、臍の破裂性病変（シスター・メアリー・ジョセフ結節）として発見された症例報告。完全減量は困難で、術後にカルボプラチン・パクリタキセル療法を施行した。資源制約下での悪性転化と皮膚転移の稀な経過が示された。
pmid-42688378.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old postmenopausal Tanzanian woman with well-differentiated invasive squamous cell carcinoma arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, presenting with a ruptured Sister Mary Joseph nodule. Imaging showed a complex adnexal mass, peritoneal disease and lymphadenopathy. Due to resource constraints, immunohistochemistry was not performed, but residual teratomatous elements supported the diagnosis. Complete cytoreduction was not feasible. She received adjuvant carboplatin-paclitaxel. The case illustrates malignant transformation with cutaneous metastasis in a resource-limited setting.

pmid-42688689.summary_ja: 33歳女性が急性の行動異常と精神症状を呈し、当初は原発性精神疾患として扱われた。意識の変動と異常不随意運動が出現し、脳脊髄液で抗NMDAR抗体が検出され、画像で左卵巣奇形腫が見つかった。ステロイドパルス、IVIG、奇形腫の外科的切除により著明に改善し、再発はなかった。精神症状に見える患者における神経学的な危険徴候の早期認識が強調されている。
pmid-42688689.summary_en: A 33-year-old woman presented with acute behavioral and psychiatric symptoms initially attributed to a primary psychiatric disorder. Her course evolved with fluctuating consciousness and abnormal involuntary movements, prompting neurological evaluation. Anti-NMDAR antibodies were detected in cerebrospinal fluid, and imaging revealed a left ovarian teratoma. She received intravenous methylprednisolone, IVIG, and surgical excision of the teratoma, with significant improvement and no relapse during follow-up. The case was managed by an interdisciplinary team, and the authors stress recognizing early neurological red flags in apparent psychiatric presentations.

pmid-42689909.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術と化学療法を受けた混合性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の20代男性が、経過観察を中断した後に呼吸困難で再来した症例。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は著明高値であった。肺門部腫瘤、左心房への腫瘍栓、転移を認め、生検で肺腺癌と診断された。奇形腫成分由来の体細胞型悪性転化と判断され、気道管理を行いながら経過観察された。
pmid-42689909.summary_en: This case report describes a man in his 20s with mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor (yolk sac tumor, teratoma, embryonal carcinoma) treated by orchiectomy and chemotherapy in 2023, who was lost to follow-up and later presented with dyspnea. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated. Computed tomography showed a left hilar mass compressing the bronchus, pulmonary vein tumor thrombus extending into the left atrium, and a subcarinal metastasis. Biopsy revealed pulmonary adenocarcinoma, which the multidisciplinary team judged to be somatic-type malignant transformation of the teratomatous component of recurrent disease. The patient remained stable with airway surveillance.

pmid-42691057.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のバイオマーカーとしてのmiR-371~373クラスターのマイクロRNAを総説しています。循環miR-371a-3pは非奇形腫性の生存腫瘍で90%超の感度・特異度を示し、従来の腫瘍マーカーを上回りました。奇形腫では発現が認められない点が限界とされ、診断から経過観察までの臨床応用が論じられています。
pmid-42691057.summary_en: This review examines microRNAs of the miR-371~373 cluster as biomarkers for testicular germ cell tumors. Circulating miR-371a-3p showed sensitivity and specificity above 90% for viable nonteratomatous tumors and outperformed conventional markers, reflecting tumor burden through orchiectomy, chemotherapy, and relapse. Its differentiation-dependent expression, absent in teratoma, is both a strength and a limitation. Clinical use across diagnosis, staging, surveillance, and postchemotherapy assessment is reviewed, along with analytical and health-economic issues and emerging data in ovarian and extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-42691507.summary_ja: NSGマウスに移植したセミノーマ細胞株を用いたin vivoおよびFACSベースのCRISPR/Cas9スクリーニングで、VENTXが幹細胞性を維持する因子と同定された。ノックアウトによりクローン形成能、スフェア形成、腫瘍形成が低下した。VENTXはID1/2/3の発現低下などを介して多能性経路と関連し、再発・抵抗性への治療標的として期待される。
pmid-42691507.summary_en: This study used in vivo and FACS-based CRISPR/Cas9 knockout screening in Tcam-2 seminoma cells implanted into NSG mice, identifying VENTX as a key regulator of seminoma stemness. VENTX knockout reduced clonogenicity, sphere formation, CD117+/CD133+ populations and tumor initiation in vivo. RNA sequencing linked VENTX to pluripotency pathways, with downregulation of ID1/2/3 and altered Wnt/β-catenin and TGF-β signaling. DNA methylation-based stemness scores also correlated with VENTX expression in testicular germ cell tumors, suggesting VENTX as a potential therapeutic target against recurrence and resistance.

pmid-42694708.summary_ja: 57歳の元喫煙者が胸痛と乾性咳嗽で受診し、CTで中心性のポップコーン状石灰化を伴う左下葉腫瘤を認め、当初は肺過誤腫が疑われた。腫瘍マーカーは陰性であった。左下葉切除術を行い、未熟成分や悪性成分のない成熟奇形腫と確定された。石灰化を伴う肺腫瘤の鑑別に肺内奇形腫を含めるべきと論じられている。
pmid-42694708.summary_en: A 57-year-old former smoker presented with chest pain and dry cough. Chest X-ray and CT showed a large, well-circumscribed left lower lobe mass with central popcorn calcification, initially suggesting a pulmonary hamartoma. Tumor markers were negative. Left lower lobectomy was performed via posterolateral thoracotomy. Histopathology showed mature cartilaginous, adipose, bony, neural, and glial tissues without immature or malignant components, confirming a mature intrapulmonary teratoma. The authors note that isolated intrapulmonary teratomas are exceptionally rare and should be included in the differential diagnosis of calcified lung masses resembling hamartoma. Complete resection was diagnostic and curative.

pmid-42695620.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の若年女性44例を対象に、妊孕性温存手術と白金製剤化学療法後の月経と妊娠を後方視的に検討した。97.7%が月経を再開し、妊娠例では先天異常なく出産が得られた。10年全生存率は97.9%であり、適切な症例での妊孕性温存治療を支持する結果である。
pmid-42695620.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 44 women aged 15 to 40 years with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, treated with fertility-sparing surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy, compared menstrual and reproductive outcomes with 44 age-matched controls. Most patients (97.7%) resumed menstruation, with some changes in cycle characteristics. Among 17 women attempting conception, 9 achieved pregnancy with live births and no congenital anomalies. Ten-year progression-free and overall survival were 95.3% and 97.9%, supporting fertility-preserving treatment in selected patients.

pmid-42697817.summary_ja: フランス小児がん学会の胚細胞腫瘍グループが作成した、小児・青年の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する最新の診療推奨である。手術による腫瘍制御と臓器機能温存を重視し、リスク群に応じて白金製剤を用いた化学療法を組み合わせる。病期、原発部位、初診時腫瘍マーカー値、年齢でリスク分類を行う。TGM13-NSプロトコル完了後に改訂され、小児科と成人腫瘍科の連携や臨床試験への参加も推奨している。
pmid-42697817.summary_en: This French national guideline provides updated treatment recommendations for malignant non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) in children and adolescents. Management emphasizes surgery aimed at oncologic control while preserving organ function, combined with platinum-based chemotherapy tailored to risk group. Risk stratification uses tumor stage and site, initial tumor marker levels and age. The guideline reflects the TGM95 and TGM13-NS protocols and recommends coordinated care between pediatric and adult teams and enrollment in clinical trials. It was developed by the Germ Cell Tumor Group of the French Society of Childhood Cancer.

pmid-42699067.summary_ja: 妊娠26週の定期超音波検査で発見された巨大な胎児仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。妊娠33週に切迫早産で緊急帝王切開となり、生後4日目に切除された。病理組織学的検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。出生前診断、適切な手術、多職種連携の重要性が強調された。
pmid-42699067.summary_en: This case report describes a giant fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma detected at 26 weeks by routine ultrasound and serially monitored. Spontaneous preterm labor at 33 weeks led to emergency cesarean delivery. The neonate, with Altman type I SCT, underwent surgical excision on day 4 of life, and histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. Postoperative wound infection was managed conservatively. Favorable outcomes were observed at 4- and 10-month follow-up. The authors highlight early antenatal detection, timely surgery and multidisciplinary care, even in resource-limited settings.

pmid-42702554.summary_ja: 45,X/46,XYモザイクを有する17歳男性で、右精巣の異常を超音波検査で指摘され精巣摘除術を受けました。性腺芽腫、上皮内胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマが確認されました。腫瘍の分子解析で病的KIT変異と12pを含む広範な染色体のコピー数増加が判明し、性分化疾患のない男性例と類似していました。
pmid-42702554.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old male with 45,X/46,XY mosaicism and undervirilized external genitalia whose ultrasound showed a right testicular abnormality. Orchiectomy revealed gonadoblastoma, germ cell neoplasia in situ, and seminoma. Molecular analysis of the tumor identified a heterozygous pathogenic KIT mutation and copy number gains across nearly all chromosomes, including 12p, resembling findings in males without differences of sex development. The authors also review five prior seminomas in 45,X/46,XY mosaicism and recommend careful long-term surveillance.

pmid-42704075.summary_ja: 6歳女児が抗NMDAR抗体と抗MOG抗体の両方陽性の脳炎を発症した症例報告である。ステロイドパルスと免疫グロブリン療法では症状が持続し、血漿交換とリツキシマブ投与後に改善した。発症6か月後のフォローアップ(経過観察)で右卵巣奇形腫が発見され、神経組織にNR1とMOGの発現が認められた。抗体が併存する小児でも腫瘍の継続的な監視が重要であると著者らは強調している。
pmid-42704075.summary_en: This case report describes a 6-year-old girl with concurrent anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and MOG antibody-associated disease. Symptoms persisted despite methylprednisolone and intravenous immunoglobulin but improved after plasma exchange and rituximab. Six months after onset, follow-up screening identified a right ovarian teratoma. Histopathology showed neural tissue expressing NR1 and MOG. The authors emphasize continued tumor surveillance in patients with coexisting antibodies, even in children.

pmid-42704838.summary_ja: 8歳女児が腹部膨満感、疝痛、便秘で受診した。CTで右卵巣腫瘤、肝病変、腹腔内液体貯留を認めた。減量手術で神経膠組織を伴う未熟奇形腫が確認され、病期IVの混合型胚細胞腫瘍として化学療法を開始した。腫瘍マーカーは正常化したが残存腫瘤が持続し、開腹術で混合型胚細胞腫瘍と確認された。完全切除は不可能で経過観察とし、11か月時点で安定していた。腫瘍増大と腫瘍マーカー正常化の際はgrowing teratoma syndromeを考慮すべきと結論された。
pmid-42704838.summary_en: An 8-year-old girl presented with abdominal distension, colicky pain and constipation. CT showed a right ovarian mass, a liver lesion and intra-abdominal fluid. Cytoreductive surgery revealed an immature teratoma with neuroglial implants, and she was staged IV mixed germ cell tumor. After chemotherapy, a residual mass persisted despite normal tumor markers, and laparotomy confirmed mixed germ cell tumor. Complete resection was not feasible, so close monitoring was chosen, and she remained stable at 11 months. The authors suggest considering growing teratoma syndrome in pediatric germ cell tumors with tumor growth and normal markers.

pmid-42705957.summary_ja: SEERデータベース（2007〜2022年）を用いた後方視的研究で、マーカー陰性の病期I・IIa・IIbの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を解析。初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清の施行率は年々低下し、病期Iでは16%から2.4%に減少した。10年のがん特異的死亡率は両群で有意差がなく、郭清手技の集約化の持続性が懸念された。
pmid-42705957.summary_en: This SEER population-based retrospective study (2007–2022) analyzed adults with marker-negative stage I, IIa and IIb testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (6,222, 766 and 649 patients). Primary RPLND use declined substantially over time, most sharply in stage I (from 16% to 2.4%), and later diagnosis year independently predicted lower use across stages. Ten-year cancer-specific mortality did not differ significantly between primary RPLND and chemotherapy in stage I or II disease. The authors raise concern about sustaining adequate RPLND volume at centers.

pmid-42706224.summary_ja: 胎盤性絨毛組織から生じるまれな悪性疾患である高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の化学療法を概説した叙述的総説。化学感受性は高いが、診断の遅れや不適切な層別化・レジメンが予後不良の主因であると指摘する。初回および救援化学療法、耐性機序、再発例の管理を扱う。多剤併用化学療法が依然中心だが、分子診断や標的療法、免疫療法の進歩が治療の個別化に寄与しうるとする。
pmid-42706224.summary_en: A narrative review of chemotherapy in high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN), a group of rare malignancies arising from placental trophoblastic tissue. The authors emphasize that delayed diagnosis, inadequate risk stratification, or inappropriate regimens are primary determinants of adverse outcomes despite high chemosensitivity. The review covers risk stratification, first-line and salvage chemotherapy, treatment outcomes, chemoresistance mechanisms, emerging therapies, and management of relapsed disease. The expert opinion concludes that multiagent chemotherapy remains the cornerstone, while molecular diagnostics, biomarkers, targeted therapies, and immunotherapy may further personalize treatment.

pmid-42707640.summary_ja: 多嚢胞性卵巣症候群の既往がある22歳未経妊女性が、急性の強い下腹部痛と嘔吐で受診した。両側卵巣に大きな腫瘤を認め、類皮嚢腫が疑われ、右卵巣捻転も示唆された。以前のCTで両側嚢胞が指摘されていたが、患者はPCOSによる変化と考えて受診が遅れた。開腹術で各卵巣に5個を超える奇形腫を認め、両側嚢腫切除術で卵巣間質を温存した。病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。
pmid-42707640.summary_en: A 22-year-old nulligravid woman with polycystic ovarian syndrome presented with acute severe lower abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting. Imaging showed large bilateral ovarian masses consistent with dermoid cysts and suspected right ovarian torsion. An earlier CT had shown bilateral cysts, but she attributed her symptoms to PCOS, which delayed evaluation. Laparotomy revealed more than five dermoid teratomas on each ovary. Bilateral cystectomy preserved ovarian stroma, and pathology confirmed mature cystic teratomas. The authors stress distinguishing PCOS-related cysts from ovarian dermoid cysts to prevent torsion and protect fertility, and the importance of clear physician-patient communication.

pmid-42708994.summary_ja: 慢性便秘を有する思春期女性が下腹部痛と腫瘤を呈した。当初は便塞栓として評価されたが、CTで右付属器腫瘤と捻転の疑いが判明し、腹腔鏡下に捻転解除と嚢胞切除を行い卵巣を温存した。若年者の卵巣捻転の診断の難しさを示し、妊孕性温存の観点から腹腔鏡下の捻転解除が推奨されている。
pmid-42708994.summary_en: A teenage girl with chronic constipation presented with lower abdominal pain and a palpable mass. Initial ultrasound interpreted the mass as extragenital, and her symptoms were initially attributed to faecal impaction. CT later revealed a right adnexal mass with suspected torsion, and laparoscopic detorsion with cyst excision was performed, preserving the ovary. The case illustrates the diagnostic challenges of ovarian torsion in early adolescence. The authors advise laparoscopic, fertility-sparing detorsion to preserve the adnexa, and the lesion was identified as a teratoma.

pmid-42716803.summary_ja: 画像上良性が強く疑われた前縦隔の巨大嚢胞性奇形腫の26歳女性の症例報告。術前にCT下経縦隔ドレナージで腫瘍を縮小させ、視野確保と破裂リスクの低減を図った。その後ロボット支援胸腔鏡手術で、炎症性癒着を伴ったものの破裂なく完全切除された。段階的治療の有用性が示唆された。
pmid-42716803.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with a giant anterior mediastinal cystic teratoma that was strongly suggested to be benign on imaging. CT-guided transmediastinal drainage was performed preoperatively to reduce tumor volume and rupture risk, improving surgical exposure. Robot-assisted thoracoscopic surgery then achieved complete resection despite dense inflammatory adhesions, without cyst rupture. The authors suggest that this staged strategy of preoperative drainage followed by robotic surgery may be a safe and effective minimally invasive approach for selected patients with giant benign mediastinal cystic tumors.

pmid-42719641.summary_ja: 37歳男性が時折の胸痛で受診し、縦隔腫瘤が見つかった。病理学的に大動脈外膜から生じた心膜内成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。胚細胞腫瘍の縦隔発生はきわめてまれで、成熟奇形腫は心膜外に生じることが多いと指摘されている。縦隔腫瘤は鑑別が多様であり、画像所見・症状・血清学的所見が診断と治療の指針となることが強調される。
pmid-42719641.summary_en: A 37-year-old man with occasional chest pain was found to have a mediastinal mass. Pathology showed an intrapericardial mature cystic teratoma arising from the aortic adventitia. The authors note that germ cell tumors are exceedingly rare in the mediastinum and that mature teratomas are most commonly found outside the pericardium. The report describes this exceedingly rare diagnosis and highlights that mediastinal masses have a broad differential, with radiographic features, symptoms, and serologies guiding diagnosis and management.

pmid-42720745.summary_ja: 2005〜2025年に後腹膜奇形腫を切除された小児20例を後方視的に検討し、CTによる腫瘍と血管の近接指標を評価した。血管接触数3以上、接触長60mm以上で合併症リスクが高く、血管変形スコアが高いほど亜全摘となりやすかった。術前評価が手術の難易度推定に役立つことを示した。
pmid-42720745.summary_en: This retrospective study of 20 children who underwent resection of retroperitoneal teratoma between 2005 and 2025 evaluated CT-based vascular proximity metrics, including tumor-vessel contact length, number of contacted vessels, and a deformation score. Intraoperative complications occurred in 35%. A contacted vessel count of at least 3 and a contact length of at least 60 mm were associated with higher complication risk, and higher deformation scores with subtotal resection. The authors suggest these preoperative measures can help estimate surgical difficulty.

pmid-42724812.summary_ja: JEG-3細胞を複合ハイドロゲル内で3Dバイオプリントし、絨毛癌の体外モデルを構築して2D培養と比較した基礎研究である。3Dモデルでは生存率と代謝活性が高く、増殖、転移、薬剤耐性、EMTに関わる遺伝子発現が増加し、hCG分泌量も多かった。3種の化学療法薬のIC50値も有意に高かった。絨毛癌の生物学と治療抵抗性を研究する、より実際に近い前臨床プラットフォームと位置づけられている。
pmid-42724812.summary_en: The authors built a three-dimensional bioprinted in vitro model of choriocarcinoma using JEG-3 cells in a composite hydrogel and compared it with conventional two-dimensional culture. The 3D model showed stronger viability and metabolic activity, more robust proliferation, higher expression of genes linked to proliferation, metastasis, drug resistance, immune suppression and EMT, and greater hCG release. IC50 values for three chemotherapeutic agents were significantly higher in the 3D model. The platform is presented as a more realistic preclinical tool for studying choriocarcinoma biology and therapy resistance.

pmid-42725460.summary_ja: 60歳女性の原発性子宮ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告です。超音波検査とMRIでは子宮平滑筋肉腫が疑われ、[18F]FDG PET/CTではびまん性のFDG集積が認められました。子宮全摘術および両側卵管卵巣摘出術後の病理組織学的・免疫組織化学的検査で診断が確定しました。画像上は肉腫との鑑別が重要であることを示しています。
pmid-42725460.summary_en: This case report describes a 60-year-old woman with primary uterine dysgerminoma who presented with lower abdominal pain. Pelvic ultrasonography and MRI suggested uterine leiomyosarcoma, and [18F]FDG PET/CT showed diffuse FDG uptake consistent with uterine malignancy. Total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy was performed, and histopathology and immunohistochemistry established the diagnosis of dysgerminoma. The report highlights that primary uterine dysgerminoma can mimic uterine sarcoma on imaging and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of uterine malignancy in older women.

pmid-42729022.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫を切除された新生児46例を3～7年追跡した後方視的コホート研究です。下部尿路機能障害は19.6%に発生し、主に頻尿と切迫性失禁でした。影響を受けた患者の8/9で尿流動態検査に異常を認めました。Altman II型では腫瘍径が大きいほど障害と関連し、腫瘤効果の関与が示唆されました。
pmid-42729022.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study followed 46 neonates after sacrococcygeal teratoma resection for 3 to 7 years. Lower urinary tract dysfunction developed in 19.6%, mainly urinary frequency and urge incontinence. Urodynamic studies were abnormal in 8 of 9 affected patients. Tumor size was significantly larger in Altman type II LUTD patients, suggesting mechanical mass effect may contribute. The authors recommend lower urinary tract evaluation for symptomatic patients or those with large tumors, and advise prospective validation before routine urodynamic screening.

pmid-42729604.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の切除歴があり、血清陰性自己免疫性脳炎が疑われた20歳代前半の女性の症例です。複数回の入院で精神症状と緊張病様症状を繰り返し、奇形腫再発や炎症性再燃を示す所見は認められませんでした。ロラゼパム投与で症状が改善し、縦断的な再評価の重要性が論じられています。
pmid-42729604.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in her early 20s with a prior resected mature cystic ovarian teratoma and a clinical diagnosis of possible seronegative autoimmune encephalitis. Across several hospitalizations she had recurrent mania, psychosis, poor oral intake, and catatonic features alongside a seizure disorder. Evaluations for recurrent teratoma and inflammatory relapse were negative, while symptoms repeatedly improved with lorazepam. The authors argue that benzodiazepine responsiveness supported but did not alone establish catatonia, and that longitudinal reassessment is valuable when etiologic certainty is limited.

pmid-42733935.summary_ja: 精巣混合性胚細胞腫瘍に由来する転移性絨毛癌と髄膜癌腫症を有する30代男性が、くも膜下出血を疑われた。腫瘍性動脈瘤を椎骨脳底動脈移行部に認め、ステント併用コイル塞栓術を施行した。術後6日目に致死的な再出血を起こし脳死となった。脳転移を伴う絨毛癌では頭蓋内血管の積極的なスクリーニングが推奨される。
pmid-42733935.summary_en: A man in his 30s with metastatic choriocarcinoma from mixed testicular germ cell tumor and leptomeningeal carcinomatosis presented with ambiguous subarachnoid hemorrhage. CT angiography identified an oncogenic aneurysm at the vertebrobasilar junction, which was treated with stent-assisted coil embolization. On postoperative day six, catastrophic rebleeding occurred, and angiography showed no intracranial flow, consistent with brain death. The authors recommend that patients with metastatic choriocarcinoma involving the brain undergo proactive intracranial vascular screening.

pmid-42739800.summary_ja: 56歳男性が停留精巣に相当する左鼠径部の無痛性腫瘤で受診し、腫瘍マーカーは正常だった。MRIで嚢胞様成分を伴う不均一な病変を認め、鼠径部からの根治的精巣摘除術が行われた。病理組織学的に精母細胞性腫瘍の三相性の特徴を示し、GCNISやリンパ管侵襲、肉腫様変化は認めなかった。免疫組織化学でSALL4とCD117が陽性、OCT3/4陰性であり、古典的セミノーマとの鑑別が示された。12か月の追跡で再発は認めなかった。
pmid-42739800.summary_en: A 56-year-old man presented with a painless left inguinal mass corresponding to a cryptorchid testis. Serum tumor markers were normal. MRI showed a heterogeneous lesion with pseudocystic areas, and radical inguinal orchiectomy was performed. Histopathology revealed the triphasic pattern of spermatocytic tumor without GCNIS, lymphovascular invasion, or sarcomatous transformation. Immunohistochemistry showed SALL4 and CD117 positivity with OCT3/4 and D2-40 negativity, distinguishing it from classical seminoma. No recurrence or metastasis was seen during 12 months of follow-up. The authors also conducted a narrative literature review on this rare entity.

pmid-42741818.summary_ja: 縦隔を占拠する巨大な前縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例報告です。腫瘍は右心房や大血管を圧迫し、右胸腔へ穿孔していました。高度の癒着のため胸骨正中切開を選択し、心膜内癒着剥離や肺剥皮術とともに、腫瘍を右心膜・横隔神経と一塊として切除しました。切除標本には毛髪、脂肪、石灰化が認められました。
pmid-42741818.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with an 11 × 10 × 10 cm heterogeneous anterior mediastinal mature teratoma that compressed the right atrium, right ventricle, superior vena cava, and aorta and perforated into the right pleural cavity. Dense adhesions required median sternotomy, with extensive intrapericardial adhesiolysis, right lung decortication, and en bloc resection of the tumor together with the involved right pericardium and phrenic nerve. The resected specimen contained hair, fat, and calcifications, consistent with mature teratoma. The report illustrates surgical strategy for large benign mediastinal germ cell tumors with major intrathoracic involvement.

pmid-42745205.summary_ja: 2週間の行動異常と幻覚で発症し、その後緊張病症状が進行した38歳男性である。自己免疫性脳炎が疑われ、がん検索で混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍が見つかり、右精巣摘除術が行われた。腫瘍切除と免疫療法を行ったが、ベンゾジアゼピンや抗精神病薬に反応せず重度の緊張病へ進行した。両側性の電気けいれん療法12回で緊張病と精神病症状が持続的に改善した。難治性の緊張病には電気けいれん療法が有効な選択肢となりうると提案している。
pmid-42745205.summary_en: A 38-year-old man developed subacute psychiatric symptoms, followed by catatonia, and autoimmune encephalitis was suspected. Cancer screening revealed a mixed testicular germ cell tumor, and right orchiectomy was performed. Despite tumor removal and immunotherapy, he progressed to severe catatonia unresponsive to benzodiazepines and antipsychotics. Electroconvulsive therapy was given, and 12 bitemporal sessions produced marked, sustained improvement in catatonic, psychotic and behavioral symptoms. The authors propose that severe catatonia may be the dominant presentation of seronegative paraneoplastic encephalitis and that electroconvulsive therapy may be effective for refractory cases.

pmid-42745867.summary_ja: 原発性無月経を有する16歳の女性（社会的性別は女性）が骨盤内腫瘤で受診し、核型は46,XYであった。β-hCGとCA125が上昇していた。開腹で右付属器の大きな腫瘤と骨盤内病変を認め、術中迅速診断で悪性胚細胞腫瘍（ディスジャーミノーマ疑い）から減量手術が行われた。病期IIBの卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と確定し、化学療法を4サイクル受けた。CA125は正常化し、再発は認められていない。Y染色体物質を有する患者では性腺腫瘍のリスクがあり、早期の核型解析と性腺評価の重要性が示された。
pmid-42745867.summary_en: A 16-year-old with female social gender and primary amenorrhea presented with a pelvic mass. Karyotype was 46,XY, and β-hCG and CA-125 were elevated. Exploratory laparotomy revealed a large right adnexal mass and multiple pelvic lesions; frozen section suggested a malignant germ cell tumor favoring dysgerminoma, and cytoreductive surgery was performed. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed ovarian dysgerminoma, stage IIB, with malignant cells in peritoneal lavage. She received four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy. CA-125 normalized, with no recurrence through April 2025. The authors advise early karyotype and gonadal assessment in patients with primary amenorrhea or gonadal dysgenesis.

pmid-42746138.summary_ja: 経膣分娩と硬膜外麻酔後2週間で腰痛と右下肢のしびれが出現した28歳女性の症例である。緊急MRIで脊椎と全身の転移性病変を認め、hCGの著明な上昇から産後の絨毛癌と確定した。レッドフラッグ症状に対する標準化された経路が迅速な診断に寄与したと報告している。
pmid-42746138.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman developed lower back pain and right leg paraesthesia two weeks after an uncomplicated term vaginal birth with epidural analgesia. Initial assessment suggested postpartum nerve injury, but urgent MRI showed widespread spinal and systemic lesions consistent with metastatic disease. Markedly elevated human chorionic gonadotropin confirmed postpartum choriocarcinoma. The authors highlight how a structured pathway for red-flag neurological symptoms enabled rapid diagnosis and timely oncological management.

pmid-42746894.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)と性索間質腫瘍(SCST)について、予後推定に有用で確かな臨床病理学的特徴をまとめた病理学的総説である。TGCTは上皮内胚細胞腫瘍(GCNIS)から生じ、セミノーマと非セミノーマに分類される。SCSTは化学療法や放射線療法に反応しにくい点で異なる。肉眼・顕微鏡的な報告の実践的指針と、診断上の落とし穴の回避について述べている。
pmid-42746894.summary_en: This pathology review summarizes the clinicopathological features most relevant and robust for prognostication in testicular tumors, covering testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) and sex cord-stromal tumors (SCSTs). It describes classification of TGCTs into seminomas and nonseminomas arising from germ cell neoplasia in situ, the importance of accurate staging and risk stratification, and the contrasting chemosensitivity of SCSTs. The authors give practical guidance on macroscopic and microscopic reporting and on avoiding diagnostic pitfalls. Recent molecular insights that refine classification and predict outcomes are also discussed.

pmid-42750298.summary_ja: 日本産科婦人科学会の腫瘍登録データを用いた1,538例の後方視的解析です。組織型は未熟奇形腫が過半数を占め、5年全生存率は94.8%でした。進行期、不完全切除、年齢50歳以上が予後不良因子でした。化学療法レジメンの影響は本登録研究からは評価できないとされています。
pmid-42750298.summary_en: This retrospective registry analysis from the Japan Society of Obstetrics and Gynecology tumor registry evaluated 1,538 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors diagnosed from 2004 to 2019. Histology was immature teratoma (56.6%), yolk sac tumor (28.7%), dysgerminoma (10.0%), and mixed germ cell tumor (9.6%). The 5-year overall survival rate was 94.8%, highest for dysgerminoma and lowest for mixed tumors. Advanced FIGO stage and incomplete resection predicted poorer survival across subtypes, and age 50 or older was associated with worse survival in several histologies. The authors note that chemotherapy regimens could not be assessed.

pmid-42750303.summary_ja: 中国の3つの三次医療機関で治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍213例の多施設後方視的コホート研究。リンパ節郭清は手術時間・出血量・入院期間の増加と関連したが、5年無増悪生存期間の改善とは関連しなかった。術後化学療法の遅延と卵黄嚢腫瘍・混合型悪性胚細胞腫瘍が予後不良因子であった。リンパ節郭清に生存上の利点はなく、適時の化学療法の重要性が強調された。
pmid-42750303.summary_en: A multicenter retrospective cohort of 213 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated at three Chinese tertiary hospitals, of whom 57 underwent lymphadenectomy. Lymph-node metastasis occurred in 17.5% overall. Lymphadenectomy was associated with longer operative time, hospital stay, and blood loss, but not with improved 5-year PFS after inverse propensity of treatment weighting. Delayed postoperative chemotherapy and unfavorable histology (yolk sac tumor, mixed malignant germ cell tumor) were independent predictors of worse survival. The authors conclude that lymphadenectomy provided no survival benefit but increased morbidity, underscoring the importance of timely chemotherapy.

pmid-42750671.summary_ja: 妊娠18週の35歳未経産婦に生じた150mm大の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の捻転症例。左側腹部痛と嘔吐で受診し、超音波検査で渦巻き徴候を認め付属器捻転と診断された。妊娠中期に腹腔鏡下左付属器切除術を行い、術後経過は良好で、妊娠は満期まで継続し健康な新生児が出生した。
pmid-42750671.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old nulliparous woman at 18 weeks of pregnancy who presented with acute left flank pain and vomiting. Ultrasonography revealed a 150 mm left adnexal mass with features of mature cystic teratoma and a whirlpool sign suggesting adnexal torsion. Laparoscopic left adnexectomy was performed in the second trimester because irreversible necrosis had already occurred. Histopathological examination confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Postoperative recovery was uneventful, and the pregnancy progressed to term with delivery of a healthy newborn. The authors emphasize that the whirlpool sign is a key sonographic marker in pregnancy with large teratomas.

pmid-42751104.summary_ja: 62歳男性で、直腸腺癌に対する3系統の治療後に絨毛癌への形質転換を来し、β-hCGが15,000 mIU/mlを超えた症例報告です。EMP/CO療法を2サイクル行い、放線菌素Dの代わりにシスプラチンを用いました。β-hCGは各サイクル後に低下しました。副作用と急速な進行により治療を継続できず、患者は死亡しました。
pmid-42751104.summary_en: This case report describes a 62-year-old man whose rectal adenocarcinoma transformed into choriocarcinoma after three lines of colorectal cancer treatment, with serum β-hCG above 15,000 mIU/ml. He received two cycles of EMP/CO, with cisplatin substituted for actinomycin D. β-hCG fell after each cycle, though it rose again during a delayed second cycle. Poor tolerance and rapid progression ended treatment, and the patient died. The authors review mechanisms, diagnosis and treatment, and suggest antiangiogenic and immunotherapy agents warrant exploration.

pmid-42751146.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた39例を比較した研究です。高リスク腫瘍解剖の症例で、術前に大動脈・下大静脈ステントを留置した群は非留置群より推定出血量が有意に少ないと報告されています。症例数が少ないため、結論の一般化には慎重さが必要です。
pmid-42751146.summary_en: This comparative study reviewed 39 patients who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) for germ cell tumor, including eight who received prophylactic aortocaval stenting before surgery. In high-risk tumor anatomy, stented patients had significantly lower estimated blood loss than non-stented patients (1069 vs 2529 mL, P = .043). The authors suggest that prophylactic aortocaval stenting may reduce intraoperative bleeding in selected high-risk patients. The small sample size and limited comparison restrict the generalizability of these findings.

pmid-42751422.summary_ja: 非言語性のレット症候群の35歳女性が腹痛・便秘などを呈し、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で左付属器腫瘤を認めた。開腹術で付属器捻転を伴う大きな嚢胞性腫瘤が見つかり、左卵管卵巣摘出術が行われた。病理組織学的に成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。レット症候群の病態が、奇形腫の提示や術前準備、経過に影響しうる点が論じられている。
pmid-42751422.summary_en: A 35-year-old nonverbal woman with Rett syndrome presented with abdominal pain, constipation, distension, nausea, and vomiting. Computed tomography revealed a left adnexal mass. Exploratory laparotomy found a large cystic mass with adnexal torsion, and she underwent left salpingo-oophorectomy. Microscopic examination confirmed a mature ovarian cystic teratoma. The authors discuss how the pathophysiology of Rett syndrome may influence the presentation, surgical preparation, and clinical course of teratoma, and note that the report adds to the limited literature on gynecologic pathology in this condition.

pmid-42751673.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の17歳女性で、両側卵巣に時期を変えて奇形腫が見つかり、2回の手術で切除された。ステロイド療法と30回の血漿交換で約2か月後に改善して退院した。回復が不完全な場合には残存病変や反対側病変の再評価を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-42751673.summary_en: A 17-year-old woman developed fever followed by neuropsychiatric symptoms and was found to have anti-NMDAR IgG in serum and CSF. Teratomas were discovered on both ovaries at different times, and two surgeries removed them. She received corticosteroids and 30 sessions of plasmapheresis, improving over about two months. Follow-up showed good recovery with mild residual cognitive impairment. The authors argue that early thorough evaluation for ovarian teratoma is essential, and that repeat assessment for residual or contralateral lesions should be considered when recovery is incomplete.

pmid-42755746.summary_ja: 33歳男性の精巣結節(術前検査で偶発的に発見)が腸型腺癌と診断された症例報告。腫瘍マーカーは正常で、超音波検査・MRIで周囲増強を伴う精巣内結節を認めた。消化管等の原発巣は否定され、部分精巣摘除術後6か月間再発は認めなかった。文献的考察として画像所見の総括と、セミノーマや混合型胚細胞腫瘍、転移性腺癌との鑑別が示されている。
pmid-42755746.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with an incidentally detected testicular nodule diagnosed as intestinal-type adenocarcinoma, a very rare testicular malignancy. Serum tumor markers were normal, and ultrasonography and MRI showed an intratesticular nodule with peripheral enhancement. Gastrointestinal and CT evaluation found no extratesticular primary, and the patient underwent partial orchiectomy with no recurrence during 6 months of follow-up. A literature review summarizes multimodal imaging features and differential diagnosis from seminoma, mixed germ cell tumor, and metastatic adenocarcinoma.

pmid-42756637.summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍で精巣摘除術後に補助療法を拒否した37歳男性の症例である。肺転移、脳転移へと進行し、化学療法、放射線療法、外科的切除を組み合わせた治療を受けた。右心房内転移を切除し、維持療法により約6か月間病勢が安定している。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の予測困難な転移様式を示す。
pmid-42756637.summary_en: A 37-year-old man with a testicular yolk sac tumor declined adjuvant therapy after orchiectomy. He later developed pulmonary metastases treated with BEP chemotherapy, then progressive brain involvement requiring decompressive craniectomy and whole-brain radiotherapy, followed by salvage TIP chemotherapy. Thoracotomy revealed and resected a right atrial metastasis. Maintenance oxaliplatin and bevacizumab kept the disease stable for about six months. The case illustrates the unpredictable behavior of non-seminomatous germ cell tumors and the value of multidisciplinary management.

pmid-42758859.summary_ja: マーカー陰性の病期IIA非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍について、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と化学療法を費用と質調整生存年で比較したシミュレーション研究である。後腹膜リンパ節郭清は費用が低く、質調整生存年も高かった。化学療法が費用対効果を持つのは、再発リスクや毒性が極端な場合に限られた。
pmid-42758859.summary_en: This cost-utility microsimulation compares open nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) with three cycles of BEP chemotherapy for marker-negative stage IIA nonseminomatous germ cell tumour, using a lifetime horizon and a simulated cohort of 300,000 patients. RPLND cost less ($50,735 versus $91,830) and yielded 1.57 more QALYs, making it the dominant strategy. Chemotherapy became cost-effective only under extreme assumptions, such as a 3-year progression risk after RPLND above 27.8% or no chemotherapy toxicity. The authors conclude that RPLND should be preferred for most patients.

pmid-42763737.summary_ja: 34歳女性が左傍卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤に対し腹腔鏡下左卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた。術中迅速病理は陰性であったが、最終病理で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した濾胞型乳頭状甲状腺微小癌が判明した。甲状腺精査で同時性の乳頭状甲状腺癌(2.3cm)が見つかり、二期的な両側甲状腺手術と放射性ヨウ素アブレーションが計画された。奇形腫由来の甲状腺癌はまれであり、迅速病理の限界と多職種連携の重要性を指摘している。
pmid-42763737.summary_en: A 34-year-old woman with a left para-ovarian cystic mass underwent laparoscopic left salpingo-oophorectomy. Frozen section was negative, but final histology showed a papillary thyroid microcarcinoma, follicular variant, arising within a mature cystic teratoma. Subsequent thyroid evaluation revealed a synchronous 2.3 cm encapsulated follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma, leading to staged bilateral thyroid surgery and planned radioactive iodine ablation. The authors note the rarity of teratoma-derived thyroid carcinoma, the limits of frozen-section analysis, and the need for multidisciplinary care. They advise thyroid ultrasonography and caution against relying on serum thyroglobulin alone.

pmid-42764877.summary_ja: 表現型正常の46,XX女性で、進行する男性化兆候と血清テストステロン高値、hCG陽性を認めた。卵巣腫瘤に対し妊孕性温存手術を施行し、性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ、絨毛性腫瘍、ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍の混合と診断された。補助化学療法は患者の拒否により行われず、長期監視が選択された。
pmid-42764877.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old phenotypically normal 46,XX woman with progressive virilization, long-standing menstrual irregularity, markedly elevated testosterone, and positive hCG. Rapid growth of an ovarian mass prompted laparoscopic left adnexectomy with fertility-sparing surgery. Histopathology showed dissecting gonadoblastoma mixed with dysgerminoma, trophoblastic tumor, and Leydig cell tumor. Hormone levels and menses normalized after resection. Although adjuvant chemotherapy was recommended, the patient declined it and chose strict long-term surveillance. The authors review comparable rare cases and stress early surgery, standardized subtyping, karyotyping, fertility-sparing surgery, and prolonged follow-up.

pmid-42781003.summary_ja: 55歳男性が左陰嚢の腫脹で受診し、精巣捻転を疑われた。画像で左陰嚢内に転位した精巣と腹腔内のミュラー管由来構造が認められ、精巣摘除術を施行した。病理組織学的検査でセミノーマと診断された。腫瘍マーカーや画像所見では悪性を示唆されていなかった。持続性ミュラー管症候群(PMDS)に伴う精巣悪性腫瘍への注意が必要である。
pmid-42781003.summary_en: A 55-year-old man presented with left scrotal swelling and tenderness, and imaging revealed a displaced right testis in the left scrotum with Müllerian duct derivatives in the abdomen. The preoperative diagnosis was transverse testicular ectopia with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome and testicular torsion. Orchiectomy revealed seminoma, with most tissue necrotic, despite normal tumor markers and no clear malignancy on imaging. The authors report this as the second PMDS case with TTE found through torsion and the first with incidental testicular malignancy, and advise considering malignancy in such patients.

pmid-42786998.summary_ja: 2017年から2025年に北京協和医院で治療した純粋卵巣未熟奇形腫30例を後方視的に検討した。超音波画像を2名の婦人科超音波専門医が再評価し、4つの超音波パターンに分類した。全例で充実成分内に「pebbled mosaic sign」が認められた。充実性形態は病理学的グレードの高さと関連し、パターン1は高グレードと関連する可能性がある。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇は56.7%に見られた。術前診断に役立つ所見と結論づけている。
pmid-42786998.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 30 patients with pure ovarian immature teratomas treated at Peking Union Medical College Hospital from 2017 to 2025. Two gynecologic sonologists re-evaluated ultrasound images and classified tumors into four sonographic patterns. All tumors showed a pebbled mosaic sign within solid components, and solid morphology was associated with higher pathological grade. Serum AFP was elevated in 56.7% of patients. Pattern 1 tumors may be associated with a higher pathological grade. The authors propose the pebbled mosaic sign as a characteristic feature that supports preoperative recognition of immature teratomas.

pmid-42787366.summary_ja: 精巣・縦隔原発を伴わず頸部リンパ節に限局した、極めてまれな性腺外セミノーマの1例である。非典型的な部位のため診断は困難で、複数回の生検を要した。FISHによる12p増加の検出が胚細胞由来の確定に決定的であった。非典型的なリンパ節腫大では幅広い鑑別診断を維持すべきだと強調している。
pmid-42787366.summary_en: The authors describe an exceptionally rare extragonadal seminoma confined to cervical lymph nodes, without testicular or mediastinal primary. The atypical location made diagnosis difficult, requiring multiple biopsies for correlation with histologic, immunophenotypic, and cytogenetic findings. FISH detection of 12p gain was pivotal in confirming germ cell origin. The report emphasizes maintaining a broad differential for atypical lymphadenopathy and reviews the diagnostic challenges of this presentation.

pmid-42787497.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の既往で嚢腫摘出術を受けた患者に、両側の再発性病変による慢性肉芽腫性腹膜炎が生じた症例です。画像では腹膜癌腫症と類似し、誤診や過剰治療の危険がありました。破裂した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫による稀な合併症であり、臨床画像と病理組織学的な照合が重要と述べられています。既往歴の確認が腹膜病変の評価に役立つことを示しています。
pmid-42787497.summary_en: This case report describes chronic granulomatous peritonitis caused by recurrent bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratomas in a patient with prior cystectomy. The condition mimicked peritoneal carcinomatosis on imaging, creating a risk of misdiagnosis and unnecessary aggressive treatment. The authors emphasize careful clinicoradiologic and histopathologic correlation to identify this rare complication of ruptured mature cystic teratoma and avoid inappropriate therapy. The report highlights the importance of considering prior cystectomy history when evaluating peritoneal lesions.

pmid-42789301.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎の既往がある51歳女性で、β-hCG値が横ばいとなった症例報告である。子宮摘出標本では、残存する単一の胞状絨毛に隣接して早期の妊娠性絨毛癌が認められた。免疫組織化学でβ-hCGの強発現、Ki-67指数約80%、p63陰性が示され、絨毛癌と確定した。絨毛が残存していても絨毛癌は否定できず、慎重な臨床病理学的照合が必要であると著者らは指摘している。
pmid-42789301.summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old woman with a prior complete hydatidiform mole whose beta-hCG levels plateaued. Hysterectomy revealed early gestational choriocarcinoma adjacent to a single residual molar villus, showing that retained chorionic villi do not exclude this diagnosis. Immunohistochemistry confirmed choriocarcinoma, with strong beta-hCG expression, a Ki-67 index of about 80%, and absence of p63, excluding other trophoblastic tumors. The authors highlight this diagnostic pitfall and the need for careful clinicopathologic correlation.

pmid-42789804.summary_ja: 30代女性の19cm右卵巣腫瘤である。卵管卵巣摘出術、大網切除、腹膜生検、リンパ節郭清を行い、術中に腫瘍が破裂した。術中迅速病理で未熟奇形腫が疑われたが、最終病理では成熟奇形腫内に発生した粘液性腺癌と判明した。免疫組織化学で転移性消化管腫瘍との鑑別を行い、リンパ節と生検は陰性、病期はFIGO IC1であった。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化の診断には、十分な検体採取と免疫組織化学が重要と強調している。
pmid-42789804.summary_en: A woman in her 30s presented with a 19 cm right ovarian mass. Surgery included salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, peritoneal biopsies and bilateral lymphadenectomy, with intraoperative rupture. Frozen section suggested immature teratoma, but final pathology showed mucinous adenocarcinoma arising within a mature teratoma. Immunostaining showed CK20, CDX2 and SATB2 positivity, patchy CK7 and loss of PAX8, which helped distinguish primary ovarian disease from metastatic gastrointestinal tumor. All lymph nodes and staging biopsies were negative, and the final stage was FIGO IC1. The authors highlight thorough sampling and immunohistochemistry in diagnosing malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-42792781.summary_ja: 若年女性に多い重篤な自己免疫性脳炎で、卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の病態、臨床経過、診断、治療、長期転帰を総括した。奇形腫が神経組織や免疫浸潤を介して抗体産生を促すことを論じ、早期の腫瘍摘出と免疫療法の併用の重要性を強調している。新たな治療標的にも言及する。
pmid-42792781.summary_en: This comprehensive review summarizes current knowledge on anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma, a severe autoimmune condition that mostly affects young women. It discusses how teratomas may trigger disease through neuroglial tissue expressing the GluN1 subunit, dense immune infiltrates, and tertiary lymphoid-like structures that support antibody production. The authors also describe the multistage clinical course, cerebrospinal fluid, imaging and electrophysiological findings, and the importance of early tumor removal combined with immunotherapy, along with long-term outcomes and emerging experimental approaches.

pmid-42794874.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘤387例を後方視的に解析。病変サイズは悪性胚細胞腫瘍の予測因子として良好な識別能(AUC 0.829)を示し、最適カットオフは12.5mmであった。年齢や腫瘍マーカーを加えると識別能が向上した。対側GCNISは2.8%で、臨床因子では予測困難であり、個別化した生検戦略が支持される。
pmid-42794874.summary_en: This single-center retrospective analysis of 387 patients with testicular lesions (2013–2024) evaluated whether lesion size predicts malignancy. Malignant GCTs were significantly larger than benign lesions, with an AUC of 0.829 and an optimal cutoff of 12.5 mm, though bootstrap validation showed wide uncertainty in the threshold (7.45–19.5 mm). Adding age, AFP, β-hCG, and LDH improved discrimination (AUC 0.863). Contralateral GCNIS was found in 2.8% of biopsied patients and was not reliably predicted by clinical variables, supporting individualized biopsy strategies.

pmid-42798410.summary_ja: コントロール不良の高血圧を有する72歳女性の右副腎部に8.6cmの脂肪含有腫瘤があり、画像上は副腎骨髄脂肪腫と診断された。腹腔鏡下副腎摘除術で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定し、副腎周囲の後腹膜由来と考えられた。脂肪優位の成熟奇形腫は、脂肪含有副腎腫瘤の鑑別診断に加えるべきである。
pmid-42798410.summary_en: A 72-year-old woman with uncontrolled hypertension had an 8.6-cm fat-containing right adrenal mass, initially diagnosed as myelolipoma on imaging. Laparoscopic adrenalectomy revealed a mature cystic teratoma containing adipose tissue, epithelial-lined cysts, neural tissue, cartilage, thyroid tissue, and bone marrow, with only compressed adrenal tissue at the periphery. The authors conclude that a periadrenal retroperitoneal origin is likely and that fat-dominant mature teratomas should be included in the differential diagnosis of fat-containing adrenal masses.

pmid-42799312.summary_ja: 15歳女児が無痛性の左腹部腫瘤で受診し、画像で大きな卵巣病変を認めた。下腹部正中切開で切除した。卵巣甲状腺腫は単胚葉性の卵巣奇形腫で、症状が非特異的で誤診されやすい。思春期の他の卵巣腫瘍との鑑別の難しさを強調している。
pmid-42799312.summary_en: A 15-year-old girl presented with a painless left abdominal mass. Imaging revealed a sizable ovarian lesion, which was resected through a lower midline laparotomy. Struma ovarii is an uncommon monodermal ovarian teratoma that often presents nonspecifically and can be misdiagnosed. The authors highlight the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing struma ovarii from other adolescent ovarian neoplasms and describe their surgical approach and management considerations.

pmid-42800980.summary_ja: 生後6か月の乳児の前縦隔成熟奇形腫が縦隔腫瘤症候群として発症した症例である。気道と血管の圧迫により重篤な呼吸障害を来した。画像検査が診断の中心となり、麻酔下の気道虚脱リスクを考慮した周術期管理が必要であった。早期認識と多職種連携が重要とされる。
pmid-42800980.summary_en: This case report describes a six-month-old infant with an anterior mediastinal mature teratoma presenting as mediastinal mass syndrome. The mass caused significant respiratory compromise through airway and vascular compression. Imaging played a central role in diagnosis, and the diagnostic challenges were highlighted. Perioperative management required special consideration because of the risk of airway collapse under anesthesia. The authors emphasize early recognition, heightened clinical suspicion, and multidisciplinary coordination when managing mediastinal masses in infants. The report focuses on diagnostic and anesthetic issues rather than detailed histopathology or follow-up.

pmid-42802890.summary_ja: 不正子宮出血と軽度のβ-hCG上昇を呈した28歳女性の症例報告。子宮腫瘤、リンパ節腫大、肺転移を認め、コア生検で上皮様トロホブラスト腫瘍が疑われた。化学療法後に子宮全摘術などを施行し、術後10か月の時点で無病でβ-hCGも正常化した。上皮様トロホブラスト腫瘍、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、絨毛癌の鑑別の難しさが示された。
pmid-42802890.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with abnormal uterine bleeding, mildly elevated β-hCG, a heterogeneous uterine mass, lymphadenopathy, and pulmonary metastases. Core biopsy suggested epithelioid trophoblastic tumour, but subclassification was limited by a small sample and an ambiguous immunohistochemical profile. She received neoadjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy followed by total hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and lymphadenectomy. At 10 months postoperatively she remained disease-free with normal β-hCG. The authors highlight diagnostic overlap among epithelioid trophoblastic tumour, placental site trophoblastic tumour, and choriocarcinoma.

pmid-42803619.summary_ja: 16歳女性の卵巣未熟奇形腫の症例で、内部に未分化な神経芽腫成分を伴い、腹膜と領域リンパ節に転移していた。17q獲得を認め高リスク神経芽腫とされた。ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、エトポシドによる治療後、中間リスク神経芽腫の治療に移行した。治療後の画像で明らかな再発はなく、経過観察中である。
pmid-42803619.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with an ovarian immature teratoma containing a poorly differentiated neuroblastoma component, with peritoneal and regional lymph node involvement. Genetic analysis showed 17q gain, indicating higher-risk disease. She first received bleomycin, cisplatin and etoposide under AGCT1531, then intermediate-risk neuroblastoma therapy under ANBL0531. Post-treatment imaging showed no definite recurrence, and she remains under surveillance. The case illustrates a rare pediatric neuroblastoma arising within a teratoma.

pmid-42806929.summary_ja: 呼吸窮迫を呈した満期産の新生児に、心肺を圧迫する巨大な嚢胞性心膜内腫瘤が認められた症例報告である。心エコー検査と胸部断層撮影で解剖学的構造が明らかになり、外科的切除により未熟性心膜奇形腫と診断された。新生児の巨大心拡大の原因として、心膜奇形腫が外科的に矯正可能なまれな原因であることを示している。
pmid-42806929.summary_en: This case report describes a term neonate with respiratory distress and a giant cystic intrapericardial mass compressing the heart and lungs, with effusion. Echocardiography and chest tomography defined the anatomy. Surgical resection confirmed an immature pericardial teratoma, an unusual extragonadal germ cell tumor, and a favorable outcome was noted. The case highlights pericardial teratoma as an unusual but surgically correctable cause of massive cardiomegaly in neonates.

pmid-42809511.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍102成分、GCNIS 41例、隣接正常精巣26例でHLA-Iの発現を比較した研究である。HLA-I消失はセミノーマと胎児性癌で多くみられた。GCNISでは全例で発現が保たれていた。HLA-I消失は腫瘍の再プログラミングと幹細胞様形質の維持に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-42809511.summary_en: This translational study examined HLA class I (HLA-I) expression in 102 testicular germ cell tumor components, 41 germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCNIS) lesions, and 26 adjacent normal testis samples. HLA-I loss was more frequent in seminoma and embryonal carcinoma than in other non-seminomatous components. All GCNIS retained HLA-I expression, differing significantly from both tumors and normal testis, where HLA-I loss occurred in all samples with a patterned distribution. The authors propose that HLA-I loss varies during germ cell tumor reprogramming and contributes to tumor-microenvironment crosstalk that maintains stem-cell features in seminoma and embryonal carcinoma. Future studies should clarify its role in GCNIS and adjacent testis.

pmid-42811676.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者組織、細胞株、活性化した免疫細胞でアンドロゲン受容体の発現を確認した。ジヒドロテストステロン(DHT)はセミノーマ由来のTCam-2細胞への影響は小さかったが、T細胞と単球の活性化を用量依存的に抑制した。セミノーマ微小環境を模した共培養系でも免疫細胞の活性を修飾した。腫瘍性精巣内のアンドロゲンが腫瘍免疫と臨床転帰に影響しうると考察している。
pmid-42811676.summary_en: This laboratory study examined whether androgens influence tumour-immune interactions in testicular germ cell tumours. Androgen receptor and related genes were expressed in patient tumour tissue, TGCT cell lines and activated primary immune cells. Dihydrotestosterone had only minor effects on the seminoma-derived TCam-2 cells, but markedly attenuated activation of T cells and monocytes in a dose-dependent manner. In TCam-2 co-culture models of the seminoma microenvironment, DHT modulated immune cell activity and selected tumour features. The authors suggest that androgens in the tumorous testis may shape the immune environment and affect clinical outcome.

pmid-42815687.summary_ja: 3次施設で出生前に診断された胎児仙尾部奇形腫36例を後方視的に検討しました。中大脳動脈(MCA)ドップラー速度が1.5MoM以上の異常例は39%でした。異常例では出生時のヘモグロビンと血小板が低値で、新生児死亡や周産期死亡が多く認められました。異常例では未熟奇形腫が多く見られました。小規模研究のため多施設での検証が必要とされています。
pmid-42815687.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 36 prenatally diagnosed fetal sacrococcygeal teratomas at a tertiary center compared outcomes by middle cerebral artery Doppler status. Abnormal Doppler velocities, defined as at least 1.5 MoM, occurred in 39 percent of fetuses and were associated with markedly lower neonatal hemoglobin, platelet counts, higher neonatal mortality, and perinatal death. Abnormal Dopplers also correlated with more severe prenatal disease and immature teratoma histopathology. The authors suggest MCA Doppler may identify higher-risk cases but note the small sample size requires validation in multicenter cohorts.

pmid-42818672.summary_ja: Lynch症候群(MSH2変異)を有する33歳男性の転移性胎児性癌型精巣腫瘍の症例です。精巣摘除術後にBEP化学療法とペムブロリズマブを併用し、腫瘍マーカーと転移巣は改善しました。次世代シーケンシングではMSSかつ低TMBで、生殖細胞系変異と腫瘍レベルのバイオマーカーの乖離が示されました。ペムブロリズマブの寄与は不明と結論づけています。
pmid-42818672.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with germline MSH2-associated Lynch syndrome and metastatic pure embryonal testicular carcinoma. After orchiectomy he received BEP chemotherapy with pembrolizumab added from cycle 2. Tumor markers fell and hepatic and nodal metastases responded well. Next-generation sequencing then showed microsatellite stable disease with low tumor mutational burden. The authors conclude that germline Lynch status does not reliably predict tumor-level biomarkers, and that the contribution of pembrolizumab to the response remains unclear given the expected cisplatin sensitivity.

pmid-42820230.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の既往がある27歳女性が、意識混濁や記憶障害の悪化で三次医療機関へ搬送された。造影コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で右付属器に40mmの卵巣奇形腫を認め、免疫療法と多診療科管理ののち、ロボット支援下右卵管卵巣摘出術で切除した。若年女性における手術的管理と多診療科アプローチの重要性を示す。
pmid-42820230.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman with known anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis had progressive confusion, memory loss, and agitation and was transferred to a tertiary center. Contrast CT showed a 40 mm complex right adnexal mass consistent with ovarian teratoma. After 37 days of hospitalization with immunotherapy and multidisciplinary management, the tumor was removed by robotic-assisted right salpingo-oophorectomy. The authors stress surgical management of ovarian teratoma in reproductive-aged women with this encephalitis and note the lack of optimal treatment strategies.

pmid-42823697.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から扁平上皮癌が生じた58歳女性の症例報告。大きな複合性骨盤内腫瘤と血清SCC抗原高値を認め、術中迅速病理診断で扁平上皮癌と判明した。FIGO IA期と診断され、外科的管理後にカルボプラチン/パクリタキセルによる補助化学療法を行い、24か月時点で再発はない。子宮頸部の高リスクHPV感染も併存していたが、卵巣腫瘍はHPV陰性であった。
pmid-42823697.summary_en: This case report describes a 58-year-old postmenopausal woman with a large complex ovarian mass in whom squamous cell carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma was identified by frozen section. Serum SCC antigen was elevated. Staging surgery confirmed FIGO stage IA disease, and four cycles of adjuvant carboplatin/paclitaxel chemotherapy were given. Concurrent cervical high-risk HPV infection with low-grade squamous intraepithelial lesion was found, but the ovarian tumor was HPV negative, p16 negative, and p53 positive. The authors note that the mechanism remains unclear without genomic evidence.

pmid-42823842.summary_ja: 突然の初回精神病エピソードで受診した35歳女性が、48時間以内に失語を呈した症例です。脳脊髄液で細胞増多と抗NMDA受容体IgG陽性が確認され、骨盤画像で卵巣奇形腫が見つかり切除されました。初回の免疫療法と血漿交換で寛解が持続しました。18か月の神経心理評価で、言語性ワーキングメモリの障害が残存しました。失語は自己免疫性脳炎を示す手掛かりになると述べられています。
pmid-42823842.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with abrupt first-episode psychosis who rapidly developed aphasia within 48 hours. CSF showed pleocytosis and strongly positive anti-NMDA receptor IgG, and pelvic imaging revealed an ovarian teratoma that was resected. First-line immunotherapy followed by plasma exchange achieved sustained remission. Serial neuropsychological testing over 18 months documented heterogeneous recovery, with verbal working memory as the most persistent deficit. The authors highlight aphasia as a clue to autoimmune encephalitis beyond primary psychiatric diagnoses.

pmid-42825045.summary_ja: 11歳女児の症例報告。成熟卵巣奇形腫を伴う血清陰性の抗NMDA受容体脳炎で、奇形腫摘出とステロイド・免疫グロブリン静注で治療された。6年間のフォローアップでは言語理解は保たれたが、実行機能・注意・処理速度・言語性記憶に障害が残り、自閉スペクトラム症の基準を満たした。血清陰性例は見逃されやすく、残存障害の把握には画像よりも神経心理学的評価が有用とされている。
pmid-42825045.summary_en: This case report describes an 11-year-old girl with seronegative anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with a mature ovarian teratoma, which was removed and followed by corticosteroids and IVIG. Antibodies in serum and CSF were negative, though sampled late after treatment began. Six-year follow-up neuropsychological testing revealed intact verbal comprehension but deficits in executive function, attention, processing speed, and verbal memory, with criteria for autism spectrum disorder. The authors emphasize that seronegative disease is easily missed and that neuropsychological assessment reveals residual burden better than imaging.

pmid-42825364.summary_ja: 出生直後から鼡径部腫瘤を示した新生仔ウシの片側性先天性精巣セミノーマの症例報告である。肉眼所見と組織学的所見から当初セミノーマが考えられ、卵黄嚢腫瘍との鑑別が検討された。免疫組織化学でCD117陽性、汎サイトケラチン陰性であり、セミノーマと確定した。
pmid-42825364.summary_en: This case report describes a unilateral congenital testicular seminoma in a neonatal Holstein calf, presenting as an enlarged inguinal mass at birth. Grossly, the right testis showed a gray-to-pink neoplasm with hemorrhage and cystic degeneration. Histology revealed lobulated neoplastic cells with prominent nucleoli, pleomorphism, and 18 mitoses in 10 high-power fields. A microcystic pattern raised yolk sac tumor as a differential diagnosis. Immunohistochemistry showed cytoplasmic CD117 positivity and negative pancytokeratin, confirming seminoma. The authors report this as the first case of unilateral congenital seminoma in a neonatal Holstein calf.

pmid-42827350.summary_ja: 52歳女性が悪心・嘔吐を主訴に受診し、血清β-hCGの上昇と、子宮傍組織から下大静脈へ進展する骨盤内腫瘤を認めた。生検で絨毛癌と確定した。EMA-CO療法により完全寛解となり、1年間の経過観察で再発はなかった。非典型的転移の診断の難しさと、妊娠歴のある女性の原因不明の全身症状では絨毛癌を鑑別に挙げる必要性を示した症例である。
pmid-42827350.summary_en: A 52-year-old woman presented with recurrent nausea and vomiting, elevated serum beta-hCG, and a pelvic mass extending from the parametrium into the inferior vena cava. Biopsy confirmed choriocarcinoma. Workup revealed pulmonary hypertension and pulmonary emboli. She received EMA-CO chemotherapy, achieved complete remission, and showed no recurrence during one year of follow-up. The authors highlight the diagnostic challenge of non-classical metastases and the need to consider choriocarcinoma in women with a prior pregnancy and unexplained systemic symptoms.

pmid-42829713.summary_ja: 帝王切開創部の腹壁に生じた絨毛癌の40歳女性例です。異所性妊娠として治療されましたが、β-hCGが高値のまま持続し、切除で高リスク絨毛癌と確定しました。その後2回再発し、化学療法と救援療法でも効果は限定的でした。免疫組織化学でPD-L1陽性(TPS 40%)が認められ、免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の使用を支持する根拠が示されています。
pmid-42829713.summary_en: This case report describes choriocarcinoma arising at an abdominal wall cesarean scar in a 40-year-old woman, initially treated for suspected ectopic pregnancy. Persistently elevated β-hCG led to surgical excision confirming high-risk disease, followed by two recurrences despite multiple chemotherapy and salvage regimens. Immunohistochemistry showed CD8+ T cell infiltration, PD-L1 expression at 40%, and VEGF/EGFR positivity with intact mismatch repair. The authors argue these findings support immune checkpoint inhibitors for chemorefractory gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and emphasize early pathological confirmation, standardized chemotherapy, and timely surgery.

pmid-42830689.summary_ja: 胚細胞由来の栄養膜腫瘍36例をmiR-371~373とDNAメチル化で解析し、妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍や奇形腫と比較した。絨毛癌以外の型は奇形腫に近いメチル化プロファイルを示し、化学療法後の分化した表現型と考えられた。絨毛癌は妊娠性腫瘍に近いパターンを示した。
pmid-42830689.summary_en: This molecular study compared 36 trophoblastic tumors of germ cell origin, including biphasic and monophasic choriocarcinoma, cystic and unclassified trophoblastic tumors, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, with gestational trophoblastic tumors and teratomas. Non-choriocarcinoma tumors had lower miR-371a-3p levels than choriocarcinomas, and their methylation profiles clustered with teratomas, while choriocarcinomas clustered with gestational tumors. The authors propose that these postchemotherapy lesions represent differentiated phenotypes rather than a separate tumor class.

pmid-42831053.summary_ja: 37歳女性が17年間の間欠的な側腹部不快感を主訴に受診した。造影CTで右副腎上部に脂肪と石灰化を含む著明に増大した腫瘍を認め、17年前の画像から性状は変わらず増大のみであった。開腹下の副腎全摘術が施行され、病理組織学的に悪性成分を伴わない成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。慢性の副腎部腫瘤の鑑別診断に本疾患を含める必要性が示された。
pmid-42831053.summary_en: A 37-year-old woman presented with a 17-year history of intermittent flank discomfort that had recently worsened. Contrast-enhanced CT showed a markedly enlarged right suprarenal mass containing fat and calcification, unchanged in character since imaging 17 years earlier. Open total adrenalectomy was performed without complications, and histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma without malignant elements. The case illustrates the unusually indolent natural history of primary adrenal mature cystic teratoma and supports its inclusion in the differential diagnosis of chronic suprarenal masses.

pmid-42837146.summary_ja: 腹部CT所見で未熟奇形腫31例と成熟奇形腫61例を後方視的に比較した。放射線組学、深層学習、放射線科医の主観的評価は同程度の精度(AUC約0.81〜0.82)を示し、3者を併用すると0.865に向上した。術前の誤分類低減に寄与する可能性がある。
pmid-42837146.summary_en: This retrospective diagnostic study included 31 immature and 61 mature ovarian teratomas on abdominal CT. It compared radiomics machine learning, deep learning, and two radiologists' subjective assessments in distinguishing immature from mature teratomas. Individual approaches achieved AUCs of about 0.81 to 0.82, and combining them improved discrimination to 0.865, with similar gains among tumors with calcification or fat. The authors conclude that quantitative image analysis complements rather than replaces expert interpretation and may reduce preoperative misclassification.

pmid-42837771.summary_ja: 再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍の患者22例を対象とした後方視的単施設研究。プレリキサホルを用いた救援的動員で86%の症例でCD34+細胞の採取に成功した。15例が大量化学療法に進み、中央値66.8か月の追跡で47%が無病生存を継続していた。前治療歴の多い患者に対しても有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-42837771.summary_en: This retrospective single-center study evaluated plerixafor-based rescue mobilization in 22 patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors who had received a median of 2.5 prior treatment lines. Successful CD34+ cell collection was achieved in 86% of patients, with a median yield of 4.9 × 10^6 cells/kg. Fifteen patients (68%) proceeded to high-dose chemotherapy, and after a median follow-up of 66.8 months, 47% remained continuously disease-free. Median engraftment times were 12.5 days for neutrophils and 14.8 days for platelets. The authors conclude that plerixafor-based mobilization is feasible and effective in heavily pretreated patients.

pmid-42842390.summary_ja: 転移性純粋セミノーマで一次化学療法後に残存腫瘤や後腹膜進行を認めた108例を解析した多施設後方視的研究である。生存セミノーマは38%で認められた。再発は27%、Clavien-Dindo分類3a以上の術後合併症は10%であった。完全切除可能な選択例で有用とされ、それ以外の症例では大量化学療法が最善とされている。
pmid-42842390.summary_en: This retrospective international multi-institutional study reviews 108 patients with pure metastatic seminoma who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) after first-line PEB, TIP or PEI for residual masses or retroperitoneal progression. Viable seminoma was found in 38% and necrosis or fibrosis in 60%. Relapse occurred in 27%. Five-year PFS after surgery alone for viable seminoma was 44%, and 5-year OS was 84%. Severe complications occurred in 10%. The authors conclude that PC-RPLND is valuable for selected completely resectable masses.

pmid-42843903.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の36歳女性が、けいれんと重度の高血圧で発症し、後頭葉の血管性浮腫を示すPRESを認めた。卵巣の成熟奇形腫を腹腔鏡下に切除し、副腎皮質ステロイド療法と併用して神経症状は完全に回復した。PRESの鑑別に自己免疫性脳炎を含めるべきと論じている。
pmid-42843903.summary_en: A 36-year-old woman with anti-NMDAR encephalitis presented with recurrent seizures and severe hypertension, and MRI showed occipital vasogenic edema consistent with posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome. Anti-NMDAR antibodies were found in serum and CSF, and a small mature ovarian teratoma was identified. After corticosteroids and laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy, she achieved complete neurological recovery. The authors discuss the roles of hypertension, autonomic instability, and immune-mediated endothelial dysfunction, and emphasize considering autoimmune encephalitis in PRES.

pmid-42848679.summary_ja: 25歳女性の左坐骨直腸窩に生じた巨大類皮嚢腫（良性嚢胞性奇形腫）。類皮嚢腫は通常、体幹正中や仙尾部に生じるため、坐骨直腸窩の発生は極めて稀である。坐骨直腸窩腫瘤の鑑別疾患を概説し、稀な提示例として報告している。
pmid-42848679.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman with a giant dermoid cyst in the left ischiorectal fossa, a rare location for a benign cystic teratoma. The authors note that dermoid cysts typically present as midline masses of the trunk, sacrococcygeal region or head and neck. They review the differential diagnosis of ischiorectal fossa masses, including developmental cysts, epidermoid cysts, lipomas, neurofibromas and tailgut cysts. The report documents an uncommon presentation in a young woman and highlights the rarity of such cases in the literature.

pmid-42854831.summary_ja: 北京の4施設で行われた多施設RCT。卵巣奇形腫嚢腫摘出術における完全被覆型保護デバイスと従来法を比較した。巨視的漏出は、デバイス群0%、対照群25%であった。手術時間と破綻率は同程度である。34.5か月の経過観察で慢性骨盤痛は対照群のみに生じた。
pmid-42854831.summary_en: This multicentre randomised controlled trial in four Beijing centres compared a Totally Enclosed Protective Device with conventional decortication and retrieval bag extraction during laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy for masses of 3 to 10 cm, reported as ovarian teratoma cystectomy. Of 105 analysed participants, macroscopic intraoperative leakage occurred in 0 percent of the device group versus 25 percent of controls, a significant difference. Intraoperative rupture rates were similar, and operative times were comparable. Over 34.5 months, new chronic pelvic pain occurred only in control patients. The authors conclude that contained extraction is effective and may prevent long-term complications in this sample.

pmid-42855723.summary_ja: cT4N0M0のIII期原発性縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の23歳男性。術前BEP化学療法5サイクル、根治手術、術後放射線療法、補助化学療法4サイクルを施行した。腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、診断後26か月で画像上・生化学的に完全寛解を維持している。集学的治療の有用性を示すとともに、2年以上の監視の必要性を論じている。
pmid-42855723.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old man with stage III (cT4N0M0) primary mediastinal yolk sac tumour managed by a multidisciplinary team. Treatment comprised five cycles of neoadjuvant BEP chemotherapy, radical surgery, postoperative radiotherapy and four cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy. Tumour markers normalised, and imaging showed partial radiological response with sustained biochemical remission. At 26 months after diagnosis, the patient remained in complete radiological and biochemical remission. The authors argue that intensive multimodal therapy can achieve encouraging outcomes in this aggressive tumour, while noting that the case reflects individualised treatment and that surveillance beyond two years is warranted.

pmid-42857374.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の扁平上皮癌転化で切除された59歳女性が、術中破綻と骨盤内散布の後に播種性再発を来した。腹壁腫瘤と多発性骨盤・腹膜病変を認め、完全な開腹減量術を施行した。病理は類皮嚢腫内の低分化扁平上皮癌で、カルボプラチン・パクリタキセルの補助療法後4年間無再発である。
pmid-42857374.summary_en: This case report describes a 59-year-old woman who developed disseminated relapse after excision of an ovarian dermoid cyst with squamous cell carcinoma transformation. Intraoperative rupture and pelvic spillage had occurred at the initial surgery. She presented with an abdominal wall mass and multifocal pelvic and peritoneal disease. Complete open cytoreduction was performed, including abdominal wall resection and multivisceral resections. Histology confirmed poorly differentiated SCC within a dermoid cyst, with negative margins. Adjuvant carboplatin-paclitaxel was given without significant toxicity, and she has remained disease-free for four years.

pmid-42857818.summary_ja: 4歳男児の後腹膜腫瘤（150×100×136 mm）で、石灰化と軸性構造を認め胎児内胎児（FIF）が疑われた。臍下切開でen bloc完全切除し、病理は椎体などを含み未熟・悪性成分はなかった。AFPは正常で再発はない。椎体軸の同定が成熟奇形腫との鑑別に重要と結論づけている。
pmid-42857818.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-year-old boy with progressive abdominal distension and a 150 by 100 by 136 mm retroperitoneal mass containing calcifications and axial structures, suggesting fetus in fetu. En bloc complete excision through an infraumbilical laparotomy was achieved without capsular breach. Histopathology identified vertebral bodies, limb-bud-like structures and tissues from all three germ layers, with no immature or malignant elements. Follow-up showed normal AFP and no recurrence. The authors stress that identifying a vertebral axis distinguishes fetus in fetu from mature teratoma, and that AFP surveillance may be considered when immature elements are present.

pmid-42857881.summary_ja: 急性腹痛の18歳女性で、画像上は腸間膜由来と解釈された大きな腹腔内腫瘤を認めた。症状持続と診断不確実のため開腹し、卵巣由来と判明して完全切除された。病理は悪性所見のない成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。若年女性の腹部腫瘤では卵巣奇形腫を鑑別に含めるべきと論じている。
pmid-42857881.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman who presented with acute abdominal pain and a large intra-abdominal mass initially interpreted on imaging as arising from the mesentery. Exploratory surgery because of persistent symptoms and diagnostic uncertainty revealed that the mass was ovarian in origin, and complete resection was achieved. Histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma without malignant features. The postoperative course was uneventful. The authors highlight that ovarian teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of abdominal masses in young women, even when imaging suggests an extragonadal origin.

pmid-42859772.summary_ja: 分娩後に反復する大量子宮出血を呈した24歳女性で、病理は絨毛癌、肺転移を伴い、hCGは317,589 mIU/mLであった。子宮頸管内のフォーリーカテーテル圧迫で出血を制御し、翌日からMEA化学療法を開始した。子宮温存のまま完全寛解に至った。
pmid-42859772.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with recurrent massive uterine bleeding after term vaginal delivery. Histology from repeat evacuation was consistent with choriocarcinoma, with pulmonary metastases and serum hCG of 317,589 mIU/mL at the time of emergency admission. A 16-French Foley catheter placed in the cervical canal reduced bleeding to a manageable level, allowing combination chemotherapy with MEA to begin the next day. Uterine artery embolisation and hysterectomy were avoided. She completed 16 cycles of chemotherapy, achieved complete remission and retained her uterus. The authors propose cervical Foley tamponade as a temporising measure.

pmid-42861026.summary_ja: 慢性骨盤痛の23歳と29歳の女性。超音波で血流を欠く骨盤内腫瘤を認め、同側付属器は確認されなかった。腹腔鏡で、腹壁と骨盤側壁に癒着した遊離性腫瘤を摘出し、病理は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。3か月後まで再発なく、早期の診断的腹腔鏡検査の重要性を示した。
pmid-42861026.summary_en: This report describes two young women aged 23 and 29 years with chronic pelvic pain who had ultrasound showing a solid-cystic pelvic mass with absent Doppler flow and no identifiable ipsilateral adnexa. Diagnostic laparoscopy revealed a free-floating mass densely adherent to the abdominal wall and pelvic sidewalls, consistent with auto-amputated adnexa. Histology showed mature cystic teratoma. Both patients recovered uneventfully and had no recurrence at three months. The authors emphasise early diagnostic laparoscopy in young women with persistent abdominal pain.

pmid-42864021.summary_ja: 停留精巣の既往がある32歳男性。12 cmの右鼠径部腫瘤を認め、生検でセミノーマと診断された。精巣は萎縮し石灰化を伴っていた。切除病理は退縮性精巣セミノーマの鼠径リンパ節転移で、pT1N3M0（IIC期）であった。補助化学療法なしで経過観察し、5年間再発はない。
pmid-42864021.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 32-year-old man with a history of orchiopexy for cryptorchidism who presented with a 12 cm tender right inguinal mass. Needle biopsy confirmed seminoma. The right testis was atrophic with diffuse microcalcifications, and PET/CT showed uptake limited to the inguinal region. En-bloc resection of the testis and inguinal mass revealed metastatic lymph node involvement from a regressed (burned-out) testicular seminoma, staged pT1N3M0 (IIC). Tumour markers normalised postoperatively. Surveillance without adjuvant chemotherapy showed no recurrence over five years.

pmid-42864507.summary_ja: Currarino症候群の3症例で、仙骨前部に非典型的な腫瘤を認めた。最終病理は粘液乳頭状上衣腫、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、奇形腫内神経内分泌腫瘍であった。1例は直腸後部奇形腫との併存を、1例は出生前超音波で診断された奇形腫を伴う髄膜瘤を報告している。
pmid-42864507.summary_en: This case series describes three children with Currarino syndrome who presented with atypical presacral masses. Final diagnoses were myxopapillary ependymoma, mature cystic teratoma and neuroendocrine tumour arising within a teratoma. Case 1 documented an unreported association of myxopapillary ependymoma with a retrorectal teratoma. Case 2 showed substantial enlargement of a presacral meningocele with associated teratoma, diagnosed prenatally by ultrasound. Case 3 documented a neuroendocrine tumour within a teratoma. The authors highlight the heterogeneity of presacral lesions and the need for individualised, multidisciplinary surgical management.

pmid-42866361.summary_ja: 27歳女性の46,XX純粋性性腺異形成に生じた巨大卵黄嚢腫瘍。AFPは2000 ng/mL超で、子宮全摘と両側卵管卵巣摘出後にBEP化学療法を施行した。AFPは正常化し、6か月後に再発はなかった。発生異常性腺の腹部腫瘤ではマーカー上昇時に卵黄嚢腫瘍を想起すべきと論じている。
pmid-42866361.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with primary amenorrhoea, hypergonadotropic hypogonadism and a 46,XX karyotype consistent with pure gonadal dysgenesis. She presented with acute abdominal pain and a 20 cm adnexal mass, with alpha-fetoprotein above 2000 ng/mL. Total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy was followed by BEP chemotherapy. AFP normalised, and six-month imaging showed no residual disease. The authors emphasise that yolk sac tumour should be considered in dysgenetic gonads with abdominal masses and elevated tumour markers.

pmid-42872027.summary_ja: 8歳で捻転に対し右卵巣摘出を受け成熟奇形腫と診断された女児。16か月後の対側奇形腫切除後、10歳でAFP高値の骨盤内腫瘍が出現し、卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍（FIGO IA期）と診断された。化学療法後も現在ホルモン補充療法中である。過度の卵巣摘出の不利益を示す。
pmid-42872027.summary_en: This case report describes an 8-year-old girl who underwent right oophorectomy for torsion, revealing a mature teratoma. Sixteen months later, a contralateral mature teratoma was excised with ovarian preservation. At age 10, she presented with an 8 cm pelvic tumour and elevated alpha-fetoprotein. MRI suggested a malignant germ cell tumour. Laparotomy achieved intact removal, and pathology confirmed FIGO stage IA ovarian yolk sac tumour. She received combination chemotherapy and remains on hormone replacement therapy. The authors argue that overzealous oophorectomy may compromise ovarian function.

pmid-42872049.summary_ja: インドの三次施設で妊娠性絨毛性疾患69例を後方視的に解析した研究。胞状奇胎が94%を占め、絨毛癌と侵入奇胎は少数だった。完全寛解は89.9%であり、早期診断、治療、β-hCGによる定期的監視の重要性を強調している。
