pmid-42872049.summary_en: This retrospective observational study reviewed 69 patients diagnosed with gestational trophoblastic disease at a tertiary centre in India over a two-month period. Hydatidiform mole accounted for 94.2 percent of cases, with choriocarcinoma in 4.3 percent and invasive mole in 1.4 percent. Most patients had pre-evacuation beta-hCG above 100,000 mIU/mL. Complete resolution was achieved in 89.9 percent, while 10.1 percent developed persistent or invasive disease. The authors emphasise early diagnosis, prompt treatment and regular beta-hCG surveillance.

pmid-42877364.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の33歳女性。免疫療法は奇効なく、画像上は卵巣奇形腫が不明瞭であった。家族の同意待ちで両側卵管卵巣摘出術が遅れ、病理で成熟奇形腫が確認された。切除後も神経障害は残存し、早期の原因巣制御の重要性を示した。
pmid-42877364.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis complicated by refractory seizures, movement disorder and ventilator dependence. Despite corticosteroids, plasma exchange, IVIG and rituximab, she did not improve. Pelvic imaging did not clearly identify an ovarian teratoma, but gynaecological consultation recommended bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Surgery was delayed until family consent was obtained. Pathology confirmed a mature ovarian teratoma. Neurological impairment persisted after resection and cyclophosphamide. The authors highlight the importance of suspecting occult teratoma and considering timely tumour removal.

pmid-42879318.summary_ja: 50歳男性が、進行性の脳神経障害と脊髄症で発症した。2年前からの右陰嚢腫脹を後に申告した。精巣生検で精巣セミノーマ（IIA期）と診定され、治療後も神経症状は進行した。研究用抗体検査でLGI4抗体陽性が判明し、傍腫瘍症候群と診断された。
pmid-42879318.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old man whose initial presentation was progressive cranial polyneuropathy and myelopathy, including third and sixth nerve palsies, sensory changes and myelitis. He had a two-year history of painful right hemiscrotal swelling. Imaging and testicular biopsy revealed stage IIA testicular seminoma, treated with orchiectomy, steroids, intravenous immunoglobulin and chemotherapy. Despite treatment, neurological deterioration continued. Research-based antibody testing identified leucine zipper 4 autoantibody positivity, indicating a paraneoplastic syndrome associated with metastatic seminoma.

pmid-42882377.summary_ja: 46,XX、18歳女性の卵巣腫瘍で、高度の男性化とβ-hCG上昇を呈した。最終病理は剥離性性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）への転化およびライディッヒ細胞腫であった。妊孕性温存手術後にホルモンとβ-hCGは正常化した。
pmid-42882377.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with a 46,XX karyotype who presented with virilization, testosterone above 16,000 pg/mL and beta-hCG of 192 IU/L. Imaging and frozen section favoured a sex cord-stromal tumour, but final pathology showed dissecting gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma transformation, trophoblastic differentiation and a Leydig cell tumour. Fertility-sparing surgery normalised androgen and beta-hCG levels, and the patient remained well at 6.5 months. The authors suggest that discordant endocrine, marker and imaging findings should prompt consideration of mixed histology.

pmid-42886468.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後残存後腹膜腫瘤に対し、ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した10例の後方視的検討。病理では壊死、奇形腫、生存腫瘍が認められ、中央値20か月の観察で再発はなかった。適切に選択された症例では安全で実施可能な代替法と結論づけている。
pmid-42886468.summary_en: This retrospective single-centre series describes ten patients with testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumours who underwent robotic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for post-chemotherapy residual masses. Histopathology showed necrosis, teratoma and viable tumour, and no recurrence was seen at a median follow-up of 20 months. Three patients required open conversion. The authors conclude that robotic RPLND is a safe and feasible alternative to open surgery in carefully selected patients, with outcomes depending on pre-operative planning and surgical expertise.

pmid-42890171.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は、甲状腺組織が優勢な卵巣成熟奇形腫の単胚葉性変異である。超音波検査、CT、MRIでは、固形成分と嚢胞成分が混在する複雑な付属器腫瘤として描出され、内部構造は不均一である。MRIはT1・T2強調像で不均一な信号を示し最も特徴的である。画像のみで確定診断に至ることは稀で、病理組織学的検査が依然としてゴールドスタンダードである。
pmid-42890171.summary_en: This review summarizes the multimodality imaging features of struma ovarii, a monodermal variant of ovarian mature teratoma dominated by thyroid tissue. Ultrasound, CT, and MRI typically show a complex adnexal mass with mixed solid and cystic components, heterogeneous internal architecture, and variable enhancement. MRI is the most distinctive, showing heterogeneous T1 and T2 signal from thyroid tissue, proteinaceous fluid, and hemorrhagic or colloid content. Because imaging rarely allows definitive diagnosis, histopathology remains the gold standard. Awareness of this spectrum improves radiologic accuracy and management.

pmid-42890642.summary_ja: 肉眼的血尿で受診した67歳男性の6 cm膀胱腫瘤。経尿道的切除の病理で、AFP、グリピカン-3、SALL4陽性の純粋型卵黄嚢腫瘍と確認され、尿路上皮癌成分は認めなかった。他部位に原発はなく、原発性膀胱卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。切除後にエトポシドとシスプラチンによる化学療法を施行し、2年間再発なく経過している。外科的切除と化学療法の併用の有用性を示した。
pmid-42890642.summary_en: A 67-year-old man with gross hematuria had a 6 cm bladder mass. Transurethral resection showed a pure yolk sac tumor with AFP, glypican-3, and SALL4 positivity and no urothelial carcinoma component. No primary lesion was found elsewhere, so it was diagnosed as a primary bladder yolk sac tumor. After resection he received four cycles of etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy and has remained recurrence-free for two years. The authors conclude that combined surgical resection and chemotherapy can achieve favorable outcomes in this very rare entity.

pmid-42898484.summary_ja: 臨床病期I期の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者53例で、血清マイクロRNA-371a-3p（M371）を術前と術後5回測定した。半減期の中央値は3.8時間で、従来の腫瘍マーカーより著明に速かった。半減期は臨床因子と関連しなかったが、正常化までの時間は術前値と関連した。M371は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の新規バイオマーカーとして有用な動態特性を持つと結論づけている。
pmid-42898484.summary_en: Serum microRNA-371a-3p (M371) was measured before orchiectomy and at five postoperative time points in 53 patients with clinical stage I germ cell tumors. The median half-life was 3.8 hours (IQR 2.9 to 6.2), much faster than conventional markers. No clinical factor was associated with the half-life, but the absolute median time to normalization of 33.8 hours was linked to the baseline level. Interindividual variability was notable. The authors conclude that rapid postoperative M371 kinetics is a valuable feature of this biomarker for testicular GCT, though baseline sampling several days before surgery is a limitation.

pmid-42898986.summary_ja: 包虫嚢胞が疑われた左上葉の複雑な嚢胞性病変を有する26歳女性。胸腔鏡下切除で毛髪と不均一な内容物が確認され、病理組織学的検査で多胚葉由来の成熟組織を認め、肺内成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。過去の肺内奇形腫8例のレビューでは、術前診断の不確実性が繰り返し見られた。
pmid-42898986.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman presented with dyspnea and chest pain. A large complex cystic lesion in the left upper lobe was initially suspected to be a hydatid cyst. Video-assisted thoracoscopic excision revealed hair and heterogeneous contents. Histopathology showed mature tissues from multiple germ layers with xanthogranulomatous inflammation, confirming intrapulmonary mature cystic teratoma. She was well at three-month follow-up. A focused review of eight previously reported intrapulmonary teratomas showed variable presentations and frequent preoperative diagnostic uncertainty, including confusion with hydatid cysts or lung abscess.

pmid-42904127.summary_ja: 原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍（セミノーマ80%、胎児性癌20%）から約5年後に再発した35歳男性。後腹膜の14.1 cm腫瘤が下大静脈を圧排していた。コア生検ではセミノーマのみで非セミノーマ成分は認めなかった。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の中間リスクとして化学療法を開始した。初期の症状は改善したが、治療成績は未確定である。病理・血清マーカー・画像を統合した評価の重要性を強調している。
pmid-42904127.summary_en: A 35-year-old man with a prior 6.5 cm mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma 80 percent, embryonal carcinoma 20 percent) presented about five years after orchiectomy with a bulky 14.1 cm retroperitoneal mass compressing the IVC. Core biopsy showed seminoma with focal necrosis and no nonseminomatous component. Because embryonal carcinoma in the primary and inadequate sampling could not exclude unsampled nonseminoma, the team treated him as intermediate-risk NSGCT with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Early follow-up showed symptomatic improvement, but outcome data were incomplete. The authors stress integrating primary pathology, markers, and imaging.

pmid-42904289.summary_ja: 治療歴のない23歳男性。右精巣に12 cmの腫瘤と転移が疑われる肺病変を認めた。根治的精巣摘除術の標本で、70〜80%を占める分化型横紋筋腫性腫瘍を伴う思春期後奇形腫が確認され、まれに絨毛癌の病巣も認められた。後の生検で転移性絨毛癌と確定した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍における横紋筋腫様分化は、真の横紋筋肉腫とは挙動が異なりうるため、認識が重要と指摘している。
pmid-42904289.summary_en: A therapy-naive 23-year-old man presented with a 12 cm right testicular mass and pulmonary lesions suspicious for metastasis. Radical orchiectomy showed a post-pubertal teratoma with 70 to 80 percent differentiated rhabdomyomatous tumor, without mitoses, necrosis, or primitive sarcomatous elements, plus rare choriocarcinoma foci. Later jejunal and lung biopsies confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma. The authors stress recognizing cytodifferentiated rhabdomyomatous tissue in testicular GCT, since it may behave differently from true rhabdomyosarcoma, and note that this expands the spectrum of testicular GCT differentiation.

pmid-42905501.summary_ja: 純粋型セミノーマ76例を後方視的に検討し、単核セミノーマ細胞におけるβ-hCGとCD117の免疫組織化学を評価した。β-hCG発現は臨床病期と独立して関連した（OR 2.238）。病期I例では斑状・びまん性発現が精巣網浸潤と相関した。包括的な腫瘍サンプリングとβ-hCG染色が、高リスク病理の同定に有用な可能性が示唆された。
pmid-42905501.summary_en: This retrospective study of 76 patients with pure seminoma examined β-hCG and CD117 immunohistochemistry in mononuclear seminoma cells. β-hCG expression was independently associated with clinical stage (OR 2.238). In stage I tumors, patchy or diffuse β-hCG expression correlated with rete testis invasion. β-hCG and CD117 expression were inversely related. The authors suggest that β-hCG immunostaining with comprehensive tumor sampling may help identify tumors with anaplastic features and higher-risk pathology in seminoma.

pmid-42908263.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された巨大な頸部腫瘤を有する新生児。緊急帝王切開後、脊髄麻酔下にEXIT手技を施行した。挿管不能のため外科的気管切開を行い、生後6日目に439gの頸部奇形腫を切除、生後48日目に退院した。選択された緊急例では、子宮胎盤循環を保ちつつ迅速な気道確保が可能な麻酔法として脊髄麻酔が有用である可能性を示唆している。
pmid-42908263.summary_en: A neonate with a prenatally detected large cervical mass underwent an ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure under spinal anesthesia after emergency cesarean section. Because intubation failed, surgical tracheostomy was performed. The 439 g cervical teratoma was excised on postnatal day 6, and the infant was discharged on day 48. The authors suggest spinal anesthesia may be a viable option for EXIT procedures in selected emergency cases, preserving uteroplacental circulation while enabling rapid airway control.

pmid-42908320.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍53例の74成分で、非セミノーマ成分はセミノーマより LSD1 陽性率が高く、Ki-67 と相関した。選択的 LSD1 阻害薬 NCL1 は胎児性癌細胞でアポトーシスを誘導し、生存率を低下させた（シスプラチン適応細胞を含む）。異種移植では腫瘍形成前の投与で増殖を抑えたが、確立した腫瘍には有意な効果がなかった。治療標的として検討に値すると結論づけている。
pmid-42908320.summary_en: LSD1 positivity was higher in non-seminomatous than seminomatous tumor components across 74 components from 53 testicular GCT patients, and correlated with Ki-67. The selective LSD1 inhibitor NCL1 in embryonal carcinoma cells increased H3K9me2 at SOX2 and OCT4 promoters, reduced pluripotency proteins, induced apoptosis, and reduced viability, including in cisplatin-adapted cells. In xenografts, treatment started before tumors became measurable suppressed outgrowth, while established tumors were not significantly inhibited. The authors suggest LSD1 warrants further study as a target.

pmid-42914936.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜転移リンパ節50例（転移46例、対照4例）を後方視的に解析した。CNNによる検出の感度・特異度はDWIで0.85と0.79、T2強調画像で0.73と0.97であった。大病変ほど検出精度が高く、セミノーマと非セミノーマで差はなかった。臨床応用には、より大規模な検証が必要とされている。
pmid-42914936.summary_en: Fifty patients, 46 with retroperitoneal lymph node metastases from testicular germ cell tumors and 4 controls, were retrospectively analyzed using DWI and T2-weighted MRI. Lesions were manually segmented and analyzed with convolutional neural networks. The CNN detected metastases with sensitivity 0.85 and specificity 0.79 on DWI, versus 0.73 and 0.97 on T2-weighted images. Larger lesions were detected better, and performance did not differ between seminoma and nonseminoma. The authors conclude that automated detection is feasible but requires larger cohort validation before clinical use.

pmid-42919092.summary_ja: 眼球突出で受診し、眼窩外および頭蓋内へ進展した原発性眼窩卵黄嚢腫瘍（性腺外胚細胞腫瘍）の稀な症例。病理組織学的検査による早期診断と多職種による介入が良好な転帰につながったと報告している。眼窩卵黄嚢腫瘍に関する限られた文献のレビューも含む。
pmid-42919092.summary_en: A rare primary orbital yolk sac tumor, an extragonadal germ cell tumor, was reported in a patient who presented with proptosis. The tumor had spread beyond the orbit with intracranial extension. The authors describe the presentation and diagnostic workup, emphasizing histopathology for timely detection and early management. Multidisciplinary intervention contributed to a successful outcome. The report includes a review of the limited literature on orbital yolk sac tumors, which rarely show extra-orbital or intracranial spread.

pmid-42923311.summary_ja: Lynch症候群を有する12歳女児が、悪性転化した卵巣奇形腫内に発生した黒色腫を発症した症例。生殖細胞系列MSH6変異が判明した。イピリムマブとニボルマブによる補助療法を3サイクル施行し、グレード3の肝酵素上昇を認めた。初診から約18か月、検出可能な病変なく経過している。外科的管理が中心で、ctDNAの役割は研究段階と述べている。
pmid-42923311.summary_en: A 12-year-old premenarchal girl with Lynch syndrome developed melanoma arising within an ovarian teratoma of malignant transformation. A germline MSH6 mutation was identified postoperatively. She received adjuvant ipilimumab and nivolumab for three cycles, complicated by grade 3 transaminitis. A contralateral cystectomy for suspected recurrence was negative. Nearly 18 months after diagnosis she remains on nivolumab monotherapy without detectable disease. The authors emphasize surgery as the mainstay with systemic immunotherapy and describe ctDNA as investigational for surveillance.

pmid-42923972.summary_ja: カルボプラチンとエトポシドに不応の脳転移を伴う難治性絨毛癌の症例。既に放射線療法を受け追加照射や手術もできない患者に、血液脳関門を通過するブスルファン・チオテパによる大量化学療法と自家幹細胞移植を施行した。病勢は安定しQOLも回復した。脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の新たな選択肢として提案している。
pmid-42923972.summary_en: A patient with refractory choriocarcinoma and brain metastases, unresponsive to carboplatin and etoposide and previously irradiated, received high-dose busulfan and thiotepa followed by autologous stem cell transplantation. These agents cross the blood-brain barrier and are used in CNS lymphoma. The regimen achieved stable disease and restored good quality of life. The authors propose this repurposed approach as a practical option for choriocarcinoma with brain metastases when radiotherapy and surgery are not feasible.

pmid-42927371.summary_ja: 分娩後約6か月の20歳女性で、進行する腹部膨満と体重減少を呈した。CTで巨大な骨盤内腫瘤を認め、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は60,500 µg/Lを超える著明高値だった。右卵巣摘出標本（3,697g）で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、卵黄嚢腫瘍が約70%を占めた。肝病変は未解決で病期は確定できず、画像・腫瘍マーカー・病理の併用の重要性を示す。
pmid-42927371.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old woman presenting about six months after vaginal delivery with progressive abdominal distension, pain, weight loss and amenorrhea. CT showed a giant complex abdominopelvic mass, and serum AFP exceeded 60,500 µg/L while β-hCG was only 2 IU/L. The 3,697 g right ovarian specimen showed a mixed germ cell tumor of mature cystic teratoma and yolk sac tumor, with yolk sac tumor comprising about 70% and no immature component. The primary tumor was pT1a, but overall stage could not be established because hepatic findings were unresolved. Follow-up data were unavailable. The authors stress combining imaging, tumor markers and histopathology.

pmid-42930552.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の予後・予測分子マーカーを系統的にレビューした。miR-371a-3pは非奇形腫性の活動性病変で感度約0.90、特異度約0.86と高精度だが、純粋奇形腫では陰性であった。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCG、乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)は病期分類とIGCCCGリスク分類に依然必要で、単一の新規マーカーで包括的評価を代替できる段階にはない。
pmid-42930552.summary_en: This PRISMA 2020-aligned systematic review searched major databases through July 2026 to evaluate prognostic and predictive molecular markers in testicular germ cell tumors. Markers were classified as established, validated research or emerging candidates, spanning classical serum markers, pluripotency factors, circulating microRNAs, methylated cell-free DNA, immune features and risk models. miR-371a-3p showed pooled sensitivity of about 0.90 and specificity of about 0.86 for active non-teratomatous disease but was negative in pure teratoma. AFP, β-hCG and LDH remain necessary for staging and IGCCCG risk assignment, and no single new marker yet replaces comprehensive evaluation.

pmid-42932114.summary_ja: SEERデータベースの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者10,353例（停留精巣250例）を解析した。停留精巣群ではセミノーマが多かったが、がん特異的生存に差はなく、多変量解析でも停留精巣は独立した予後因子ではなかった（HR 1.14）。予後不良因子は遠隔転移、非セミノーマ、年齢などで、予後判断は腫瘍関連因子に基づくべきとされた。
pmid-42932114.summary_en: This SEER-based cohort study of 10,353 men who underwent orchiectomy for testicular germ cell tumors between 2000 and 2022 compared 250 undescended and 10,103 descended testis cases. Seminoma was more common in the undescended group (65.2% vs 51.4%). Kaplan-Meier analysis showed no significant cancer-specific survival difference, and multivariable Cox regression found cryptorchidism was not an independent predictor (HR 1.14). Propensity score matching confirmed these findings. Independent predictors of worse survival were distant stage, nonseminoma histology, regional stage, older age and certain ethnic groups. The authors conclude prognosis should be guided by tumor-related factors.

pmid-42934552.summary_ja: 36歳未経妊女性の子宮未熟奇形腫である。MRIで9.5cmの嚢胞充実性腫瘤を認めた。初回の不完全切除で未熟奇形腫（grade 2）、再切除で成熟奇形腫を確認し、BEP療法を4コース施行した。妊孕性を温存したまま1年半後に出産し、5年間再発はない。妊孕性温存の適応条件について考察している。
pmid-42934552.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old nulliparous woman with uterine immature teratoma who presented with abnormal vaginal bleeding and a 9.5 cm mixed cystic-solid uterine mass on MRI. Initial incomplete resection showed grade 2 immature teratoma, and a second complete resection revealed mature teratoma. She received four cycles of BEP chemotherapy, later delivered a healthy baby, and remained recurrence-free over five years of follow-up. The authors state that fertility-sparing management may be considered when disease is confined to the endometrium with grade 1-2 histology and a favorable chemotherapy response. They note that successful pregnancy after such management had not previously been reported.

pmid-42937425.summary_ja: 2015〜2023年に16か国20施設で、薬剤抵抗性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍76例にペムブロリズマブを投与した後方視的研究である。測定可能病変のある60例で71.7%が完全奏効し、2年全生存率は85.6%であった。予後不良の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などでは補助療法として用いられた。HLA-Gが奏効予測因子として示唆された。
pmid-42937425.summary_en: This international retrospective study of 76 patients with drug-resistant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated with pembrolizumab across 20 centres in 16 countries between 2015 and 2023 found complete response in 71.7% of 60 patients with measurable disease. Two-year overall survival was 85.6%. Sixteen patients received adjuvant pembrolizumab instead of high-dose chemotherapy, mostly for poor-prognosis PSTT/ETT, and no deaths occurred after first remission. No grade 4 or worse immune toxicities were recorded. Exploratory analysis suggested low HLA-G expression may relate to nonresponse. Without a control group, the authors conclude pembrolizumab shows durable responses and adjuvant potential.

pmid-42937749.summary_ja: 29歳女性で極めて高いβ-hCGから異所性妊娠が疑われたが、腹腔鏡で右卵管と骨盤側壁の出血性腫瘤を認め、卵管原発絨毛癌（FIGO III期）と確定した。5-フルオロウラシルとアクチノマイシンDによる化学療法で、β-hCGは2か月以内に正常化し、持続寛解を維持した。病理組織学的検査が異所性妊娠との鑑別に不可欠である。
pmid-42937749.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with irregular menses and extremely high β-hCG, initially suspected to be an ectopic pregnancy. Laparoscopy revealed a hemorrhagic mass involving the right fallopian tube and pelvic sidewall. Histopathology confirmed primary tubal choriocarcinoma with pelvic peritoneal implantation, classified as FIGO stage III. She received multiple cycles of 5-fluorouracil and actinomycin D combination chemotherapy, and β-hCG normalized within two months. She remained in sustained remission during follow-up. The authors emphasize that histopathological examination is essential to distinguish gestational choriocarcinoma from ectopic pregnancy, and the paper includes a literature review.

pmid-42946222.summary_ja: 性分化疾患の小児81例を後方視的に解析し、腫瘍リスクで層別化した。性腺摘出率は高リスク96%、中等度リスク63%、低リスク38%であった。腫瘍は9例（性腺芽腫7例、ディスジャーミノーマ2例）に認められた。リスクに応じた性腺管理を支持し、CAISでは思春期後まで摘出を延期すべきとしている。
pmid-42946222.summary_en: This retrospective review of 81 children with differences of sex development evaluated in a multidisciplinary clinic from 2013 to 2024 stratified them by gonadal tumor risk. Gonadectomy rates were 96% in high-risk, 63% in intermediate-risk and 38% in low-risk groups, with younger ages in higher-risk patients. Tumors were found in nine patients, seven gonadoblastoma and two dysgerminoma, all high or intermediate risk. Two-thirds of tumors occurred in complete gonadal dysgenesis. The authors support risk-stratified gonadal management, including deferring gonadectomy until after puberty in CAIS.

pmid-42947026.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARとJEG-3をエトポシドに段階的に曝露して耐性株を作製した。耐性株は増殖、遊走、浸潤能が低下していた。RNAシーケンスでMAPK関連分子が示唆され、siRNAによるMAPK7のノックダウンで感受性が回復した。MAPK7がエトポシド耐性に寄与すると考えられ、治療標的の候補となりうる。
pmid-42947026.summary_en: This laboratory study established etoposide-resistant derivatives of the JAR and JEG-3 gestational choriocarcinoma cell lines by stepwise exposure to increasing etoposide concentrations. Resistant cells showed reduced proliferation, migration and invasion compared with parental cells. RNA sequencing and upstream regulator analyses implicated MAPK-related kinases, including MAPK7, MAPK9 and MAP2K5. siRNA knockdown of MAPK7 restored etoposide sensitivity in resistant cells. The authors conclude that the MAPK signaling pathway, particularly MAPK7, contributes to etoposide resistance in choriocarcinoma, which may suggest a therapeutic target for patients whose disease fails etoposide-containing regimens.

pmid-42948797.summary_ja: 生後6週の男児で、出生時からの黒色便、嘔吐、重度貧血を呈した。造影CTで大弯に接する石灰化を伴う固形嚢胞性病変を認め、開腹で胃内に突出する腫瘤を切除した。病理で成熟奇形腫と確定した。術後5日で黒色便は消失し、1か月時点で良好であった。胃奇形腫では消化管出血は稀な表現であり、完全切除で治癒が得られる。
pmid-42948797.summary_en: This case report describes a six-week-old male infant who presented with melena since birth, non-bilious vomiting and severe anaemia requiring four red cell transfusions. A large supraumbilical mass was present, and contrast-enhanced CT suggested a gastric teratoma with calcification abutting the greater curvature. At laparotomy, an exophytic intragastric mass was excised with primary gastric repair. Histopathology confirmed a mature teratoma. Melena resolved by postoperative day five, and the infant was well at one-month follow-up. The authors note that gastrointestinal bleeding is an unusual presentation and that complete excision is curative.

pmid-42951463.summary_ja: 2008〜2025年に治療された卵巣甲状腺腫35例の後方視的研究である。超音波では多房性嚢胞性腫瘤が多く、一部で「struma pearl sign」を認めた。18例が純粋良性、15例が不純良性、2例が卵巣内乳頭状甲状腺癌を伴う悪性であった。中央値18か月の経過観察で再発・転移はなかった。
pmid-42951463.summary_en: This single-centre retrospective study reviewed 35 women with histologically confirmed struma ovarii treated between 2008 and 2025. Mean age at diagnosis was 43.3 years, and one-third were asymptomatic. Ultrasonography often showed multiloculated cystic masses, and the struma pearl sign appeared in some cases. Laparoscopic surgery was used in 60% and frozen section in 57%. Pathology showed 18 pure benign, 15 impure benign and 2 malignant cases with papillary thyroid carcinoma. With a median follow-up of 18 months, there was no recurrence or metastasis. The authors conclude the pearl sign is supportive but its absence does not exclude diagnosis.

pmid-42954286.summary_ja: 23歳女性で、子宮内の深部浸潤性・過血管性病変と子宮動静脈瘻を認め、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と確定した。妊孕性温存を希望し、術前に超音波ガイド下高密度焦点式超音波療法(HIFU)で血流を低下させた後、低用量化学療法で完全な生化学的寛解を得た。HIFUは安全で、全身療法への橋渡し戦略として有用と考えられる。
pmid-42954286.summary_en: A 23-year-old woman had persistently plateaued β-hCG after hysteroscopic management for suspected incomplete abortion. Imaging showed a deeply invasive hypervascular uterine lesion with uterine arteriovenous fistula. Given her wish for fertility preservation and high surgical risk, ultrasound-guided high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) was performed first, reducing perfusion and vascular flow. Complete ablation was not achieved, but low-dose chemotherapy produced complete biochemical remission and radiological regression. Expert review confirmed placental site trophoblastic tumor. No major HIFU complications occurred, and menstruation resumed. HIFU was judged feasible and safe as a bridging therapy.

pmid-42955976.summary_ja: 2019〜2025年に北インドの三次施設で治療された生後12か月以下の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍16例の後方視的研究である。仙尾部が87.5%を占め、全例が成熟奇形腫で、完全切除が得られた。出生前診断は12.5%にとどまり国際的水準を下回った。平均8か月の観察で再発・死亡はなかったが、より長期の経過観察が必要とされる。
pmid-42955976.summary_en: This retrospective study of 16 infants aged 12 months or younger with histopathologically confirmed extragonadal germ cell tumors, managed at a rural North Indian tertiary centre from 2019 to 2025, found sacrococcygeal location in 87.5% and mature teratoma in all cases. Complete excision with tumor-free margins was achieved universally, and superficial surgical site infections occurred in three infants. Antenatal diagnosis was made in only 12.5%, well below international benchmarks. No recurrence or death occurred during a median follow-up of 8 months. The authors stress that longer surveillance of at least 3 to 5 years is essential.

pmid-42958320.summary_ja: 22歳女性の右卵巣腫瘤と肝・肺転移で、組織学的に絨毛癌が疑われた。PCR法でY染色体DNAが認められないことから、妊娠性ではない非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌と診断された。外科的切除後にBEP化学療法を行い、完全代謝奏効が得られ、経過観察中である。分子診断が鑑別の鍵となった症例である。
pmid-42958320.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman presented with irregular menses, abdominal pain, a right ovarian mass and liver and lung metastases. Histopathology suggested choriocarcinoma. A PCR-based assay showed no Y chromosome DNA, which established a diagnosis of non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma rather than gestational origin. She underwent surgical resection and received BEP chemotherapy, achieving a complete metabolic response, and remains under follow-up. The authors emphasize that molecular diagnostics are essential to distinguish non-gestational from gestational choriocarcinoma, because treatment and prognosis differ. Early diagnosis and timely chemotherapy may achieve favorable outcomes.

pmid-42961570.summary_ja: DSD98例のうち性腺腫瘍は19例(19.4%)で、性腺芽腫が63.2%と最多であった。その他にジャーミノーマなどが認められた。臨床、ホルモン、染色体、病理像を解析した。DSDにおける性腺生検は、前がん病変や上皮内・浸潤性の悪性変化の有無を精査し、適切なリスク層別化を行うべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-42961570.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 98 patients with differences of sex development seen over five years at a tertiary centre and identified 19 with gonadal tumors, a prevalence of 19.4%. Gonadoblastoma was the most common at 63.2%, followed by germinoma, testicular adrenal rest tumor, Leydig cell tumor and Sertoli cell nodule. The authors analysed clinical, hormonal, cytogenetic and histological profiles. They conclude that every gonadal biopsy in DSD should be carefully examined for premalignant, in situ or invasive change to allow appropriate risk stratification and treatment.

pmid-42968948.summary_ja: 75歳男性が強い腹痛で受診し、穿孔を伴う7.5cmの虫垂腫瘤と多発肝結節を認めた。組織学的には低悪性度虫垂粘液性腫瘍(LAMN)に隣接する絨毛癌で、β-hCGは289,308 mIU/mLと著明な高値であった。肝生検で転移が確認され、術後1か月で死亡した。男性原発虫垂絨毛癌の初めての報告例である。
pmid-42968948.summary_en: A 75-year-old man presented with severe abdominal pain, and imaging showed a 7.5 cm appendiceal mass with perforation and multiple liver nodules. Histology revealed a poorly differentiated carcinoma with syncytiotrophoblastic, cytotrophoblastic and intermediate trophoblastic components adjacent to a low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm. Immunohistochemistry was positive for CK7, β-hCG, GATA3 and SALL4, and liver biopsy showed metastatic choriocarcinoma. Serum β-hCG was exceptionally high at 289,308 mIU/mL. The patient received hospice care and died one month after surgery. The authors describe this as the first documented case of male primary appendiceal choriocarcinoma with LAMN and highlight its diagnostic challenges and poor prognosis.

pmid-42972323.summary_ja: 30歳の未経妊女性の卵巣腫瘤(O-RADS 5)に対し、腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出で神経内分泌腫瘍と判明した後、受精卵凍結保存を行い、病期分類のための開腹手術を実施した。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した高分化型の原発性卵巣島状カルチノイドで、FIGO IA期相当。6か月時点で無病生存であり、妊孕性温存治療の適応を検討した症例。
pmid-42972323.summary_en: A 30-year-old nulligravid woman with primary infertility presented with a persistently enlarging right ovarian mass rated O-RADS 5. After laparoscopic excision identified a neuroendocrine neoplasm, embryo cryopreservation was performed, followed by staging laparotomy with right oophorectomy. Histopathology showed a well-differentiated primary ovarian insular carcinoid arising within a mature cystic teratoma, consistent with FIGO stage IA. No extragonadal primary or metastasis was found, and she remained disease-free at six months. The authors suggest fertility-preserving management may be considered in carefully selected young patients after multidisciplinary evaluation and exclusion of metastatic disease, with longer follow-up needed.

pmid-42975996.summary_ja: 臨床病期II-IIIの進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍18例で、化学療法前、RPLND前、RPLND後に5種の血清マイクロRNAを測定した。切除標本は壊死55%、奇形腫38%、生存腫瘍5%であった。AFP、hCG、LDHは期待どおり低下した。奇形腫または生存腫瘍を予測するROC解析のAUCは大部分が0.45〜0.70で、統計的有意性に達したものはなかった。現時点では残存腫瘤切除の判断にマイクロRNAは不十分と結論している。
pmid-42975996.summary_en: Eighteen patients with stage II-III NSGCT had five serum microRNAs measured before chemotherapy, before RPLND, and afterward. Resectates showed necrosis in 55%, teratoma in 38%, and viable tumor in 5%. Tumor markers AFP, hCG, and LDH decreased as expected. ROC analysis showed AUCs mostly between 0.45 and 0.70 for predicting teratoma or viable tumor, and none reached statistical significance. The authors conclude serum microRNAs are not yet sufficient to guide decisions on residual mass resection.

pmid-42978663.summary_ja: 咳嗽を主訴とした41歳男性で、右上葉に大きな肺腫瘤と多発性脳転移があり、β-hCGは10,000 mIU/mL以上に上昇していた。生殖腺病変は認められなかった。放射線療法、EMA/CO療法、EMA/EP療法とシンチリマブの併用、そして三次治療としてのナブパクリタキセル、ベバシズマブ、ペニプリマブを行ったが病勢は進行した。男性例の文献検討では免疫チェックポイント阻害薬の使用例で全生存期間が長い傾向があった。
pmid-42978663.summary_en: A 41-year-old man with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma and multiple brain metastases had β-hCG above 10,000 mIU/mL and no gonadal lesion. Treatment included radiotherapy, EMA/CO, EMA/EP with sintilimab, and third-line nab-paclitaxel, bevacizumab, and penpulimab, but disease progressed. A literature review of metastatic male cases suggested longer overall survival with immune checkpoint inhibitor-based therapy, though this was exploratory. Serial β-hCG tracked disease closely and guided decisions.

pmid-42980035.summary_ja: MTX耐性のJEG-3絨毛癌モデルから得られたタンパク質変化を出発点に、4種の相互作用ネットワークで治療仮説を優先順位付けした。DepMap/PRISM、転写産物、DrugCombや正常胎盤のデータを統合し、堅牢性検定を行った。PLK1は全MCDA条件で首位となったが、ネットワークの帰無モデルではFDR有意に達しなかった。MTXとPLK1阻害薬の併用が最優先の実験的仮説だが、治療としての検証はされていないと結論づけている。
pmid-42980035.summary_en: Using an MTX-resistant JEG-3 choriocarcinoma model, the authors prioritized therapeutic hypotheses through network propagation across four interaction networks, with robustness tests and integration of DepMap/PRISM, transcriptomic, DrugComb, and normal placenta data. PLK1 ranked first across all MCDA perturbations and was the only candidate ranked first in all four evaluated analyses. Network null-model p values did not reach FDR significance. The authors conclude MTX plus PLK1 inhibition is the highest-priority hypothesis for experimental evaluation, not validated therapy.

pmid-42982248.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のシスプラチン耐性は、単一の耐性遺伝子ではなく、発生・組織学的状態の制約された進化によって生じるという立場をとる総説である。12p染色体増加が共通の悪性背景となり、組織学的分化と系統状態が白金感受性の基準を左右する。エピジェネティック変化、多能性関連プログラムの低下、p53-MDM2系の異常、DNA損傷応答の適応が関与する。残存・再発病変は当初の診断ではなく現在の病理に基づき再評価すべきとしている。
pmid-42982248.summary_en: This review argues that cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumors arises from constrained evolution of developmental and histologic states rather than a single gene. Chromosome 12p gain provides a shared malignant background, while histology and lineage state influence baseline platinum sensitivity. Epigenetic remodeling, reduced pluripotency programs, p53-MDM2 dysregulation, and DNA damage response adaptation shape whether injury leads to apoptosis or tolerance. The authors propose reassessing residual or relapsed lesions by their current pathology rather than the original diagnosis.

pmid-42984645.summary_ja: 強直性脊椎炎でTNF-α阻害薬を6年間投与されていた31歳女性に、再発性の殿部腫瘤が生じた。連続生検で仙尾部奇形腫が腺癌と扁平上皮癌の混合癌へ変化したことが判明し、TP53とKRAS G12D変異を併せ持っていた。切除、化学療法、放射線療法を行ったが多臓器転移が進行した。再発奇形腫の悪性転化への注意と、悪性腫瘍診断後のTNF阻害薬の見直しを強調している。
pmid-42984645.summary_en: A 31-year-old woman with six years of TNF-alpha inhibitor therapy for ankylosing spondylitis developed a recurrent gluteal mass. Serial biopsies showed transformation of a sacrococcygeal teratoma into mixed adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma, with concurrent TP53 and KRAS G12D mutations. Widespread metastases developed despite resection, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy. The authors emphasize vigilance for malignant transformation in recurrent teratoma and reassessment of TNF inhibitor use after a solid malignancy diagnosis.

pmid-42985436.summary_ja: 局在性純粋精巣セミノーマと診断され右精巣摘除術を受けた32歳男性例である。アジュバント・カルボプラチン投与前の病期分類CTで、偶発的に両側甲状腺病変が見つかった。精査の結果、両側多発性乳頭状甲状腺癌と頸部リンパ節転移が判明し、放射性ヨウ素治療を施行した。生殖細胞系列検査では病的変異を認めなかった。全身治療前に甲状腺異常があったため、治療関連の発生は考えにくいとしている。
pmid-42985436.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with localized pure testicular seminoma underwent right orchiectomy. Staging CT before adjuvant carboplatin incidentally showed bilateral thyroid lesions, and subsequent evaluation revealed bilateral multifocal papillary thyroid carcinoma with cervical lymph node metastases. Radioiodine therapy was given. Germline testing found no pathogenic variants. The authors conclude a treatment-related origin is unlikely since thyroid abnormalities preceded systemic therapy, and they highlight the unresolved relationship between germ cell tumors and thyroid malignancy.

pmid-42986281.summary_ja: 進行性の呼吸困難、発熱、胸痛を呈した若年産後女性が、重症肺高血圧と右室機能障害を経て心停止に至った。超音波で子宮病変を認め、β-hCGが著明に高値であったことから妊娠性絨毛癌と診断された。心臓MRIで右室機能と肺高血圧に伴う心臓病変を精密に評価した。化学療法によりβ-hCGは正常化し、肺高血圧と右室機能障害も改善した。
pmid-42986281.summary_en: A young postpartum woman developed progressive dyspnea and chest pain, leading to severe pulmonary hypertension, right ventricular dysfunction, and cardiac arrest. Ultrasound showing uterine lesions and markedly elevated β-hCG established gestational choriocarcinoma. Cardiac MRI precisely assessed RV function and pulmonary hypertension-related cardiac involvement. Chemotherapy normalized β-hCG and resolved pulmonary hypertension and RV dysfunction. The report highlights the value of CMR and dyspnea evaluation including β-hCG for early diagnosis.

pmid-42987917.summary_ja: 胸痛を主訴とした32歳女性で、CTで前縦隔の嚢胞性病変と胸水を伴う腫瘍を認めた。抗菌薬投与後も胸痛と発熱が続き、成熟奇形腫を疑って胸骨正中切開で切除した。胸水と腫瘍嚢胞液の双方からアクネ菌(Cutibacterium acnes)が検出された。最終的に縦隔成熟奇形腫の穿孔と細菌性胸膜炎と診断された。
pmid-42987917.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman presented with chest pain, and CT showed an anterior mediastinal tumor with cystic lesions and pleural effusion. Persistent pain and fever despite antibiotics led to suspicion of mature teratoma, and median sternotomy resection was performed. Cutibacterium acnes was identified in both pleural effusion and cyst fluid. The final diagnosis was perforation of the mediastinal mature teratoma with bacterial pleurisy.

pmid-42989299.summary_ja: 停留精巣由来の巨大後腹膜セミノーマで、β-hCGとLDHが高値の41歳男性例である。エトポシドとシスプラチンによる4サイクルの化学療法後も、PETで集積(SUVmax 3.6)を示す5.8×8.5 cmの残存腫瘤が残った。完全外科的切除を行い、病理学的に生存腫瘍細胞のない完全病理学的奏効が確認された。約2年経過後も無病で腫瘍マーカーは正常である。PET陽性残存腫瘤に対する外科的切除の診断的意義を示す。
pmid-42989299.summary_en: A 41-year-old man with a giant retroperitoneal seminoma from an undescended left testis had elevated β-hCG and LDH. After four cycles of etoposide and cisplatin, a residual 5.8 × 8.5 cm mass with PET uptake (SUVmax 3.6) remained, and complete surgical resection was performed. Histopathology showed complete pathological response without viable malignant cells. At nearly two years, he remains disease free with normal tumor markers. The case highlights surgical resection's role in pathologic clarification of PET-positive residual masses after seminoma chemotherapy.

pmid-42994136.summary_ja: B細胞性急性リンパ性白血病の既往がある45歳女性が、脳転移による頭蓋内出血で発症した超高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌(FIGO IV期、WHOスコア13)と診断された。一次治療のEMA-CO療法に抵抗性を示したため、二次細胞傷害性療法ではなく早期救済療法としてペムブロリズマブを投与した。β-hCGは速やかに正常化し、完全寛解が持続している。有害な免疫関連事象はなく、治療は良好に耐容されている。
pmid-42994136.summary_en: A 45-year-old woman with B-ALL and ultra-high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma (FIGO stage IV, WHO score 13) presented with intracranial hemorrhage from metastases. After resistance to first-line EMA-CO chemotherapy, she received early salvage pembrolizumab instead of second-line cytotoxic regimens. β-hCG normalized rapidly, and complete remission has been sustained. Treatment has been well tolerated without immune-related adverse events. The authors suggest early immunotherapy may be an option for high-risk, chemo-refractory patients.

pmid-41026202.summary_ja: 卵巣付属器病変869例を対象に、O-RADS MRIスコアと画像・臨床所見を組み合わせて組織型を予測した後方視的研究です。脂肪成分は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と強く関連しました（OR 126.5）。子宮内膜症性嚢胞、粘液性・漿液性嚢胞腺腫、境界悪性・浸潤性腫瘍の予測因子も示されました。診断精度の向上と不要な手術の回避が期待されています。
pmid-41026202.summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 869 adnexal lesions from 651 patients in the EURAD database, combining O-RADS MRI scores with clinical and imaging features to predict histopathological subtypes. Fatty content and multiple T1/T2 signals in cystic components were strongly associated with mature cystic teratomas (OR 126.5 for fatty content). Other associations included endometriomas, mucinous and serous cystadenomas, and features predicting borderline or invasive tumors. Integrating MRI features with O-RADS improved diagnostic precision and could help avoid unnecessary surgery.

pmid-41418783.summary_ja: ヒト原始胚細胞様細胞を、フィーダーフリー培養下でマウス由来のシグナルを用いてヒト胚性胚細胞様細胞へ変換した基礎研究です。得られた細胞は人工多能性幹細胞に類似し、多能性状態の相互変換が示されました。胚細胞腫瘍発生の機構を含む多能性転換の研究基盤として提案されています。
pmid-41418783.summary_en: A laboratory study showing that human primordial germ cell-like cells (hPGCLCs) can be converted into human embryonic germ cell-like cells (hEGCLCs) using signals identified in mice, in a feeder-free culture system. The hEGCLCs were transcriptionally similar to human iPSCs and could give rise back to hPGCLCs, demonstrating interconvertible pluripotent states. DNA demethylation seen in hPGCLCs was reversed at the chromatin level in hEGCLCs. The authors propose the model as a tractable system for studying pluripotency transitions, including those driving germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-41436705.summary_ja: セレン・テルル複合ナノロッドを、マウス精巣奇形腫F-9細胞と正常線維芽細胞L-929で比較したin vitro研究です。Se-TeNRは腫瘍細胞に選択的にアポトーシスを誘導し、酸化還元調節の違いが示されました。胚細胞腫瘍の概念を主題とするものではありません。
pmid-41436705.summary_en: This study compared selenium nanoparticles (SeNPs), tellurium nanoparticles (TeNPs), and Se-Te hybrid nanorods (Se-TeNRs) in mouse testicular teratoma F-9 cells and L-929 fibroblasts. Se-TeNRs eliminated 99% of F-9 cells at 5 µg/mL via apoptosis while sparing fibroblasts. Redox effects differed: nanoparticles induced NOX-driven oxidative stress in F-9 cells and antioxidant responses in L-929 cells. Se-TeNRs caused sustained calcium store depletion in tumor cells and suppressed F-9 migration. The authors propose these hybrid nanorods as precision agents for cancer therapy with reduced side effects.

pmid-41474685.summary_ja: 小児の肺・縦隔腫瘍の細胞診所見を概説した総説。胚細胞腫瘍を含む複数の疾患を扱い、免疫細胞化学や分子検査との統合、診断アルゴリズムを提案している。胚細胞腫瘍は主要な対象の一つにとどまり、単独の主題ではない。
pmid-41474685.summary_en: This review synthesizes the cytomorphologic spectrum of pediatric lung and mediastinal tumors, including germ cell tumors, pleuropulmonary blastoma, lymphomas, and small round cell tumors. It emphasizes distinguishing features, diagnostic pitfalls, and the integration of immunocytochemistry and molecular testing. The authors propose a structured diagnostic algorithm combining clinical, radiologic, and cytologic data, and discuss emerging roles for next-generation sequencing, AI-assisted cytology, and liquid-based methods. Germ cell tumors form one of several entities discussed rather than the sole subject.

pmid-41534550.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と完全胞状奇胎に由来する単為発生および雄核発生のiPS細胞を用い、インプリンティングを受けるDMRを網羅的メチル化解析で探索した。26か所の新規候補を同定し、DOCK4とLYNX1を検証した。これらは線維芽細胞や成人組織にはみられない多能性状態特異的な刷り込みパターンを示した。奇形腫や胞状奇胎由来細胞は、初期ヒト発生における刷り込み研究の道具として用いられている。
pmid-41534550.summary_en: Using parthenogenetic and androgenetic iPS cells derived from mature cystic teratomas and complete hydatidiform moles, the authors performed genome-wide methylation profiling to identify imprinted differentially methylated regions. They identified 26 candidates, validated DOCK4 and LYNX1, and showed pluripotent-state-specific imprinting absent in fibroblasts and adult tissues. The work uses teratoma- and mole-derived cells as tools for understanding imprinting in early human development.

pmid-41622743.summary_ja: 新規の18F標識FAP阻害薬プローブを前臨床と臨床で評価した。10例の臨床研究では、セミノーマを含む複数のがん種で18F-FDG PETより優れた病変コントラストが示された。セミノーマは多数のがん種の一つであり、主題ではない。
pmid-41622743.summary_en: The authors developed an 18F-labeled FAP inhibitor probe, 18F-NOTA-R49, and evaluated it preclinically in cell lines and tumor-bearing mice, showing high early tumor uptake that was blocked by unlabeled compound. In a clinical study of 10 patients with various cancers, 18F-NOTA-R49 PET showed superior lesion contrast to 18F-FDG PET in several cancer types, including seminoma, particularly for peritoneal and lymph node metastases. Seminoma is one of several tumour types included, so germ cell tumour is not the main focus.

pmid-41658479.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍に対する化学療法後に胸腺過形成を生じた女性2例の症例報告である。1例はステージIC1の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫、もう1例はステージIIIBの高異型度漿液性癌であった。化学療法後12〜24か月でCTにより前縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、悪性所見のない胸腺過形成と診断された。両者に甲状腺機能亢進症が認められた。
pmid-41658479.summary_en: This case report describes two women with ovarian malignancy who developed thymic hyperplasia after chemotherapy: one with stage IC1 ovarian dysgerminoma and one with stage IIIB high-grade serous carcinoma. Both had an anterior mediastinal mass on CT 12 and 24 months after chemotherapy, without malignant features, and were diagnosed with thymic hyperplasia. Both were also found to have hyperthyroidism and received medical therapy. The authors suggest thyroid function testing when thymic hyperplasia is found in young female patients with malignancy.

pmid-41687039.summary_ja: フランス全国の抗NMDA受容体脳炎(抗NMDAR脳炎)のICU入院216例を後方視的に解析し、難治性・ICU依存型の26例を定義した。卵巣奇形腫の合併率が高く、予後不良と死亡率の上昇が認められた。早期認識と個別化治療の必要性が示唆された。
pmid-41687039.summary_en: This retrospective French national cohort of 216 ICU-admitted patients with nonherpetic anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis defines refractory, intensive care-dependent disease, present in 26 patients. Compared with others, these patients more often had ovarian teratoma, the triad of seizures, movement disorders and dysautonomia, higher CSF cell counts and antibody titers, and elevated serum neurofilament. Despite earlier immunotherapy, they had worse functional outcomes and higher mortality, supporting early recognition of this high-risk subgroup.

pmid-41724719.summary_ja: 自己免疫性脳炎の再発を検討したシステマティックレビューとメタ解析(39研究)。全体の再発率は16.2%で、抗NMDAR脳炎では奇形腫切除後に再発率が有意に低下した。二次治療は再発を減らし、抗LGI1脳炎、年齢、治療開始の遅れが危険因子であった。1年以降は再発が増えないため、長期の維持免疫療法は不要な可能性がある。
pmid-41724719.summary_en: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 39 observational studies estimated the overall recurrence rate of autoimmune encephalitis at 16.2%. Anti-NMDAR encephalitis recurrence was 14.8% and fell significantly after teratoma removal. Second-line immunotherapy reduced recurrence, and anti-LGI1 encephalitis, age, and shorter delayed treatment were risk factors. Recurrence did not increase after one year of follow-up, suggesting that maintenance immunotherapy beyond one year may not be necessary.

pmid-41838633.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関する先行論文の訂正通知。血漿DNase低値の予後不良性と、DNase Iのシスプラチン効果増強を報告した論文が対象。本通知は訂正対象のDOIのみを示し、訂正内容は記載されていない。
pmid-41838633.summary_en: This correction notice amends an earlier PLoS One article on testicular germ cell tumors, which reported low plasma DNase associated with worse outcomes and that exogenous DNase I improved cisplatin efficacy. The abstract text here only identifies the article being corrected by DOI. No details of the correction are given in this notice. Readers should consult the original article's corrected version for the specific changes.

pmid-41844526.summary_ja: 陰嚢超音波検査の解剖と実践的ポイントを、炎症、血管奇形、外傷後遺症、嚢胞性病変、一般的な精巣腫瘍などに分けて画像例とともに解説した絵画的総説である。胚細胞腫瘍は精巣腫瘍の一部として扱われる。
pmid-41844526.summary_en: This pictorial review outlines anatomy and practical tips for scrotal ultrasound, then discusses a systematic approach to scrotal pathologies. Categories covered include infectious and inflammatory conditions, vascular anomalies, trauma sequelae, cystic lesions, and common testicular neoplasms. Numerous ultrasound examples illustrate clinical presentation, imaging features, and recommended management. Germ cell tumours are only one part of the broader testicular neoplasm discussion, so they are not the central focus.

pmid-41907618.summary_ja: ガーナの三次施設で2013〜2024年に病理確定したを卵巣腫瘍を後方視的に解析した横断研究。74.4%が卵巣癌で、年齢、閉経後、貧血、充実成分、血流、腹水、CA-125上昇が予測因子であった。良性腫瘍では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が最も多かった。超音波検査や遺伝子検査の充実を提言している。
pmid-41907618.summary_en: This cross-sectional study analyzed 496 women with histology-confirmed ovarian tumors discussed at a tertiary tumor board in Ghana from 2013 to 2024. Of these, 74.4% had ovarian cancer. Logistic regression identified older age, postmenopausal status, anemia, comorbidities, solid components, vascular flow on imaging, ascites and elevated CA-125 as predictors. Among 127 benign tumors, mature cystic teratomas were the most frequent histologic type, along with mucinous tumors and serous tumors. The authors call for better gynecologic ultrasound, intraoperative pathology consultation and molecular testing to guide ovarian cancer care in Ghana.

pmid-41938736.summary_ja: 繊維産業の就労女性で、職業性化学物質暴露を背景に重篤な胎児奇形を認め妊娠中絶に至った症例です。FFPE組織から重金属を検出する手法を用いています。仙尾部奇形腫の併存は仮説生成的な所見として考察されています。
pmid-41938736.summary_en: This case report describes a textile worker with occupational chemical exposure whose pregnancy was complicated by severe fetal malformations and termination. Retrospective toxicology, pathology and forensic review identified an occupational contribution. Toxicants were detected in FFPE fetal and placental tissue using an innovative technique. A sacrococcygeal teratoma was observed and discussed as a hypothesis-generating finding in the context of exposure. The authors highlight the need for occupational surveillance during pregnancy and integration of environmental assessment into prenatal care.

pmid-41985045.summary_ja: 既知のSDHx生殖細胞系列変異を有する57腫瘍(傍神経節腫、褐色細胞腫、腎細胞癌、消化管間質腫瘍、セミノーマを含む)でSDHB免疫組織化学を検討。49%に異常な保持パターンがみられ、4型に分類された。SDHB染色の異常な消失があれば遺伝子検査を推奨している。セミノーマは対象腫瘍の一つである。
pmid-41985045.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined SDHB staining in 57 tumors with known germline SDHx variants, including paragangliomas, pheochromocytomas, renal cell carcinomas, gastrointestinal stromal tumors, and seminomas. Forty-nine percent showed aberrant retained staining, classified into four patterns such as focal retention and fine granular staining. The authors recommend genetic testing for any abnormal loss of SDHB staining and note that interpretation of this screening tool is challenging.

pmid-41993992.summary_ja: ASCO/ESMO 2025と2025年発表のGU腫瘍学の第II/III相RCT 40件を系統的にレビューしています。精巣がんは1件のみで、セミノーマにおける治療の縮小（SAKK 01/10）が含まれます。胚細胞腫瘍は多領域のうちの一部として扱われています。
pmid-41993992.summary_en: This PRISMA-based systematic review synthesizes 40 phase II and III randomized trials in genitourinary oncology presented at ASCO/ESMO 2025 or published in 2025. Trials cover bladder, kidney, prostate, penile and testicular cancers. The only testicular study was a de-escalation trial for seminoma (SAKK 01/10). Risk of bias was assessed with RoB 2. The authors highlight biomarker-driven strategies, immunotherapy integration and treatment optimization. They conclude that the evidence supports updated guidelines and personalized management across GU cancers.

pmid-41997945.summary_ja: FoxO依存性オートファジー制御因子mythoのゼブラフィッシュ欠損モデルを解析しています。変異体では組織変性、自然発生の運動障害、生殖能力低下が認められ、雄でセミノーマの発生率が高いことが報告されました。精子のDNA断片化が関連づけられています。
pmid-41997945.summary_en: This study generated mytho knockout zebrafish, a FoxO-dependent autophagy regulator, to examine its role in vertebrate tissue function. Mutants showed higher early mortality, lower oxidative stress resistance, impaired locomotion and muscle structure, and autophagy defects in brain, muscle and testis. Tissue degeneration occurred in pancreas, retina and muscle, with gonadal morphological changes and reduced male reproductive capacity. Males had a higher incidence of seminomas, which was associated with DNA fragmentation in sperm. The authors conclude that Mytho maintains tissue function and DNA integrity.

pmid-42004755.summary_ja: 不妊評価のため生理食塩水注入超音波子宮造影を受けた29歳未経妊女性の症例報告。直後から左下腹部痛を生じ、7cmの複雑性卵巣嚢腫に伴う左卵巣捻転が疑われた。腹腔鏡で3回転捻転した壊死卵巣を認め、左卵管卵巣摘除術を施行した。最終病理は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。検査後の捻転リスクを説明すべきと述べている。
pmid-42004755.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old nulligravid woman who developed acute left lower quadrant pain 1 to 2 hours after saline infusion sonohysterography for fertility evaluation. Imaging suggested left ovarian torsion with a 7 cm complex ovarian cyst, and laparoscopy showed a necrotic ovary torsed three times. Left salpingo-oophorectomy was performed, and final pathology showed a mature cystic teratoma. The authors advise counseling patients with large adnexal cysts about the torsion risk, which the procedure may precipitate, and providing clear post-procedure precautions.

pmid-42054811.summary_ja: カリフォルニア州の登録データに基づく症例対照研究。妊娠中に石油・ガス井戸から3km以内に居住していた母親の子どもを対象に、小児がんリスクを検討した。奇形腫のaORは1.42(95%CI 0.99〜2.05)で有意差はなく、奇形腫は複数の評価対象の一つである。
pmid-42054811.summary_en: This California registry-based case-control study compared childhood cancer risk among children whose mothers lived within 1 or 3 km of oil and gas development wells during pregnancy. Associations were reported for medulloblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, and teratoma, with teratoma aOR 1.42 (95% CI 0.99-2.05) within 3 km, which did not reach statistical significance. The authors suggest oil and gas development may increase the risk of several rare childhood cancers. Teratoma is one of several outcomes rather than the primary focus.

pmid-42147076.summary_ja: 細胞診でBethesda VIに分類された甲状腺結節の3症例で、原発巣は胃腺癌、絨毛癌、平滑筋肉腫であった。細胞ブロックと免疫組織化学が原発巣の同定に重要だった。非甲状腺起源が疑われる異型甲状腺結節では、甲状腺転移を鑑別に挙げるべきだと強調している。
pmid-42147076.summary_en: This case series describes three patients with thyroid metastases that mimicked primary thyroid carcinoma on cytology, classified as Bethesda VI. The primaries were gastric adenocarcinoma, choriocarcinoma, and leiomyosarcoma. Cell block preparation and immunohistochemistry were key to establishing the primary source, alongside whole-body imaging and targeted biopsy. The authors emphasize that thyroid metastasis should be considered in the differential diagnosis of atypical thyroid nodules, particularly when cytologic features point to a nonthyroid origin.

pmid-42200835.summary_ja: 大型良性卵巣嚢腫に対し、腹腔鏡と体外操作を組み合わせた手術法を6例で報告。18cmの多房性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を含む。合併症はなく、妊孕性温存と播種リスク低減の可能性を示した。ただし長期成績は未検証である。
pmid-42200835.summary_en: This report describes a hybrid laparoscopic-extracorporeal technique for large benign ovarian cysts, in which cyst decompression is performed via a suprapubic balloon trocar and the ovary is exteriorized for extracorporeal cystectomy. Six patients were treated, including one with an 18 cm multilocular mature cystic teratoma. No intraoperative or postoperative complications or conversions to laparotomy occurred, and short-term follow-up showed preserved ovarian architecture and normal menstruation. The approach aims to preserve fertility while reducing spillage risk.

pmid-42235513.summary_ja: 種を超えた単一細胞RNAシーケンスデータの統合手法TACMANを提案する計算研究である。腫瘍・炎症・感染症にわたる臨床データに適用されたが、精巣胚細胞腫瘍への応用は一例にとどまる。線虫の生殖細胞腫瘍モデルで同定した腫瘍関連細胞集団が、ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍試料にも保存されていることを示した。主題は手法開発であり、胚細胞腫瘍は応用例の一つである。
pmid-42235513.summary_en: TACMAN is a computational framework for integrating single-cell RNA-seq data across species, combining a metapath-based heterogeneous graph neural network with an encoder-only transformer. The authors apply it to clinical human and mammalian model datasets across tumor, inflammatory, and infectious diseases. A key demonstration uses a C. elegans germline tumor atlas to identify tumor-related cell populations conserved in human testicular germ cell tumor samples. The study is primarily a method paper, with germ cell tumor as one application.

pmid-42251999.summary_ja: AYA世代の放射線療法に関するPRISMA準拠の系統的レビューで、35の研究を統合しています。精巣セミノーマでは陽子線治療が急性消化管毒性を有意に減らし、二次悪性腫瘍リスクも低い可能性が示されました。胚細胞腫瘍は対象部位の一つにとどまります。
pmid-42251999.summary_en: This PRISMA 2020 systematic review synthesized 35 primary studies on radiotherapy in adolescents and young adults using a SWiM approach. Topics included CNS and skull base tumors, breast cancer, late toxicity, and secondary malignant neoplasms. For testicular seminoma, proton beam therapy significantly reduced acute gastrointestinal toxicity compared with conventional treatment and was associated with a 50 to 60 percent lower model-estimated secondary malignancy risk. Testicular seminoma is one of several sites, so the review is not focused on germ cell tumors.

pmid-42297669.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫10例を含む先天性奇形292例を後方視的に解析し、術後合併症の発生時期と家族の意識を検討した。中央値3.5年の経過観察で、1年以降の再手術は腸閉塞や腹壁ヘルニアが主であった。仙尾部奇形腫では晩期再発がみられた。家族は長期フォローアップの利益が負担を上回ると考えていた。
pmid-42297669.summary_en: This single-center retrospective review of 292 children treated for congenital anomalies, including 10 sacrococcygeal teratomas, aimed to determine the time to latest complication after index surgery and to survey family attitudes toward long-term follow-up. Median follow-up was 3.5 years. Late complications requiring surgery beyond one year were mainly bowel obstruction and hernias, with late recurrence observed in CDH and SCT. Survey respondents (n=52) felt the benefits of long-term surveillance outweighed its burdens. The authors conclude surveillance is valuable and its intensity may vary by anomaly.

pmid-42328259.summary_ja: 資源が限られた環境で受診した、外性器の外観が類似する25歳の2名の性分化疾患の症例報告。症例1は女性表現型で陰核肥大と腟口閉塞があり、再建術で良好な転帰を得た。症例2は男性として育ち、月経と腹部腫瘤を認め、開腹で腹腔内ディスジャーミノーマと診断され化学療法を受けている。個別化された患者中心の管理と、診断遅延に伴う課題を強調している。
pmid-42328259.summary_en: This report describes two 25-year-old adults with comparable ambiguous external genitalia but different gender identities and treatment goals, in a resource-limited setting. Case 1 was a phenotypic female with clitoral enlargement and introital obstruction, who underwent introital reconstruction and clitoral reduction with good outcomes. Case 2 was raised male, with menstruation and abdominal masses, and histopathology of exploratory laparotomy confirmed dysgerminoma, for which chemotherapy is ongoing. The authors emphasize individualized, patient-centered management and the ethical and clinical challenges of delayed diagnosis.

pmid-42334499.summary_ja: インフルエンザ様症状の後に両側視神経乳頭浮腫を来した59歳女性の症例報告です。当初は卵巣奇形腫と脳脊髄液の抗GFAP抗体陽性から抗GFAPアストロサイトパチーと考えられましたが、経時的な多モダリティ画像で脈絡膜炎症が判明し、Vogt-小柳-原田病と診断されました。神経炎症性疾患との誤診を避けるための縦断的画像評価の重要性が示されています。
pmid-42334499.summary_en: This case report describes a 59-year-old woman with bilateral optic disc edema, visual field defects, and headache after a flu-like illness. Initial workup showed CSF anti-GFAP positivity, pleocytosis, white matter lesions, and an ovarian teratoma, suggesting GFAP astrocytopathy. Longitudinal multimodal imaging revealed steroid-responsive choroidal inflammation, granulomatous anterior uveitis, and subsequent choroidal depigmentation, which were more consistent with Vogt-Koyanagi-Harada disease. Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss also fit VKH. The authors argue that late-onset VKH can present with optic disc edema and central nervous system involvement, mimicking inflammatory neurologic disease, and that longitudinal imaging helps avoid misdiagnosis.

pmid-42345802.summary_ja: 内分泌撹乱化学物質12種について、尿路性器がん4種(精巣胚細胞腫瘍を含む)の共通標的をネットワーク解析で同定した研究です。精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではKITが浮上しました。実験的検証は腎細胞癌細胞株でのベンゾ[a]ピレンとCASP9に限られます。胚細胞腫瘍は解析対象の一つにすぎません。
pmid-42345802.summary_en: This study used network toxicology and protein-protein interaction analysis to identify shared hub targets of 12 endocrine-disrupting chemicals across four urogenital cancers, including testicular germ cell tumor, where KIT emerged as a target. Docking and molecular dynamics supported binding. Experiments in renal carcinoma cells showed that chronic benzo[a]pyrene exposure stabilized CASP9 protein. Germ cell tumor is one of four cancer types analyzed, with limited direct experimental focus.

pmid-42347968.summary_ja: 左後腹膜病変を有する小児12例に対し、右側臥位での左肋骨下単孔式腹腔鏡手術を行った症例集積である。病理診断には後腹膜成熟奇形腫1例を含む多様な疾患が含まれた。全例が単一創で完遂され、中央値の手術時間は83.5分、出血量は7.5mLであった。術式は安全で実行可能と結論づけている。
pmid-42347968.summary_en: This single-center retrospective case series describes 12 children who underwent left subcostal single-incision laparoscopic surgery in the right lateral position for various left retroperitoneal lesions. Pathology included one retroperitoneal mature teratoma among other diagnoses, such as pulmonary sequestration, neuroblastoma, and pancreatic neoplasms. All procedures were completed through a single incision without conversion. Median operative time was 83.5 minutes, and median blood loss was 7.5 mL. Median postoperative stay was three days. The authors conclude the technique is safe and feasible for pediatric left retroperitoneal lesions.

pmid-42412253.summary_ja: 単一施設の後方視的コホート研究で、全身性腫瘍による脳転移806例を解析した。腫瘍内出血は11.9%に認めた。独立した危険因子は多発病変、原発組織型としての黒色腫およびセミノーマ、抗血小板薬の使用であった。新規の脳転移特異的スコアはAUC 0.75を示し、既存のHAS-BLED（AUC 0.54）を上回った。既存の出血スコアは本集団に適さず、前向き検証が必要とされる。
pmid-42412253.summary_en: This single-centre retrospective cohort of 806 adults with brain metastases from systemic tumors found intratumoral hemorrhage in 11.9 percent. Independent risk factors included multiple metastases, melanoma and seminoma as primary histology, and antiplatelet therapy. Anticoagulation and radiotherapy were not associated with risk. A novel brain-metastasis-specific score achieved an AUC of 0.75, outperforming HAS-BLED (AUC 0.54). The authors conclude that conventional hemorrhage scores are unsuitable for brain metastases and that prospective validation is needed.

pmid-42420933.summary_ja: 腹痛と両側卵巣腫瘤を有する61歳女性に対し、多発性肝・腹腔内包虫嚢胞と卵巣病変の同時手術を施行した症例報告である。右卵巣病変は術前に悪性が疑われたが、病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫と判明した。7年後も再発なく生存している。包虫症と悪性の可能性がある病変を同時に治療することは実行可能と考察された。
pmid-42420933.summary_en: A 61-year-old woman with abdominal pain and bilateral ovarian masses underwent simultaneous surgery for multiple hepatic and abdominal echinococcal cysts and for ovarian lesions. The liver cysts were confirmed as echinococcal, while the right ovarian lesion proved to be a mature teratoma despite a preoperative suspicion of cancer. She remained alive and recurrence-free after seven years. The authors conclude that simultaneous treatment of echinococcosis and potentially malignant lesions is feasible and can achieve survival comparable to malignancy alone.

pmid-42426848.summary_ja: 骨盤内の巨大成熟嚢胞性奇形腫切除後に難治性尿閉を来した19歳女性の症例です。保存療法が無効だったため、左S3神経根に短期間の仙骨神経刺激療法を行いました。刺激装置停止後も排尿は良好で、残尿は0 mLとなり、6か月間再発はありませんでした。短期間の仙骨神経刺激療法が持続的効果をもたらす可能性が示唆されましたが、確立にはさらなる症例の蓄積が必要とされています。
pmid-42426848.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with refractory urinary retention after resection of a large mature cystic teratoma of the pelvis. Urodynamics showed reduced bladder capacity, hypersensitivity, and a post-void residual of 1020 mL, and three months of conservative treatment had failed. She underwent short-term sacral neuromodulation at the left S3 root. Spontaneous voiding returned on the first postoperative day, and after stimulator deactivation, the voiding diary showed a post-void residual of 0 mL. No recurrence was seen over six months. The authors suggest short-term sacral neuromodulation may produce durable benefit, while noting that more cases are needed.

pmid-42450055.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍様分化を伴う胃腺癌3例を、組織病理学と標的遺伝子解析で統合的に検討した。全例で網状・微小嚢胞状・乳頭状の卵黄嚢腫瘍様パターンとAFP、Glypican-3の発現を認めた。523遺伝子パネルの解析では、マイクロサテライト安定型で中等度の腫瘍遺伝子変異量を示し、PI3K-AKTおよびRTK/RAS-MAPKシグナル経路の異常を認めた。卵黄嚢腫瘍様分化は胚細胞由来ではなく上皮性腫瘍の可塑性を反映する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-42450055.summary_en: This integrated histopathologic and targeted genomic study examined three gastric adenocarcinomas with yolk sac tumor differentiation. All showed adenocarcinoma with reticular, microcystic, and papillary yolk sac tumor-like patterns and AFP and Glypican-3 expression. Targeted sequencing with a 523-gene panel found microsatellite-stable tumors with intermediate mutational burden, alterations in PI3K-AKT and RTK/RAS-MAPK pathways, and recurrent CCND3 variants and MDM2 gains. The authors suggest yolk sac tumor differentiation may reflect epithelial tumor plasticity rather than germ cell origin, although larger studies are needed.

pmid-42464956.summary_ja: 手術で確定した付属器腫瘤320例を対象に、O-RADS、CA125、超微小血管造影（UMA）の良悪性鑑別能を後方視的に検討した研究である。複合モデルのAUCは0.906で単独指標より高かった。成熟奇形腫などでCA19-9やHE4が陽性の場合に有用性が高いと述べている。
pmid-42464956.summary_en: This retrospective study of 320 surgically confirmed adnexal masses evaluated O-RADS 2022, CA125, and ultra microangiography for distinguishing benign from malignant lesions. Mature teratoma (22.2%) and serous cystadenoma were the most common benign lesions. Multivariate analysis identified O-RADS classification, SUMA flow pixel ratio, CA125, and age as independent risk factors. The combined model achieved an AUC of 0.906, superior to individual parameters. The authors note that combined application is particularly valuable when CA19-9 and HE4 are positive in mature teratomas or endometriotic cysts.

pmid-42469754.summary_ja: 性交渉のない44歳女性で、感染した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から卵巣膿瘍が生じ、破裂して敗血症性ショックに至った症例です。血液と膿瘍から黄色ブドウ球菌が検出され、血行性感染が疑われました。緊急腹腔鏡手術と抗菌薬治療で回復し、1年後も再発はありませんでした。遷延する発熱と腹痛の鑑別に、非典型的な卵巣膿瘍を含めることの重要性を指摘しています。
pmid-42469754.summary_en: This case report describes a 44-year-old sexually inactive woman with atopic dermatitis who developed septic shock from a ruptured left ovarian abscess. The abscess arose from an infected mature cystic teratoma, and Staphylococcus aureus was isolated from blood and abscess cultures. Extensive evaluation found no gastrointestinal or gynecologic source, suggesting hematogenous spread possibly facilitated by skin barrier disruption. Emergency laparoscopic surgery and antibiotic therapy led to recovery, and no recurrence was seen at one year. The authors emphasize including atypical ovarian abscesses in the differential diagnosis of prolonged fever and abdominal pain.

pmid-42544222.summary_ja: 粘稠な内容物を有する巨大な多房性卵巣腫瘍の72歳女性に対し、経膣的な後腟円蓋切開で排液した後に腹腔鏡下で切除した症例報告。病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた粘液性嚢胞腺腫と診断された。術後3日目に退院し、本法の有用性が示唆された。
pmid-42544222.summary_en: This case report describes a 72-year-old woman with a giant multilocular ovarian tumor containing about 9.8 L of viscous fluid. It was managed by transvaginal posterior colpotomy drainage followed by laparoscopic adnexal resection. Drainage allowed safe trocar placement and adhesiolysis without apparent intraperitoneal spillage. Histopathology showed mucinous cystadenoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. The patient recovered uneventfully and was discharged on postoperative day 3. The authors propose this approach for giant cystic ovarian tumors with viscous contents, especially when they protrude into the pouch of Douglas.

pmid-42576475.summary_ja: PROSPERO登録のシステマティックレビューで、妊娠中の付属器病変の画像所見と診断モデルの性能を検討した（16研究、1,674例）。良性病変では単純嚢胞、子宮内膜症性嚢胞とともに成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が多かった。診断モデルは高い特異度と陰性予測値を示したが、脱落膜化した子宮内膜症性嚢胞を悪性と誤分類した。超音波検査は妊娠中の付属器病変の評価に有用と結論された。
pmid-42576475.summary_en: This PROSPERO-registered systematic review of 16 studies (1,674 patients) examined imaging features and diagnostic model performance for adnexal lesions in pregnancy. Mature cystic teratomas were among the most common benign lesions, alongside simple cysts and endometriomas. Malignant lesions were mostly epithelial ovarian cancer or metastases. Diagnostic models such as the IOTA two-step strategy showed high specificity and negative predictive value, but misclassified decidualized endometriomas as malignant. The authors conclude that ultrasound reliably assesses adnexal lesions in pregnancy.

pmid-42578379.summary_ja: 仙骨上部（S2以下）に浸潤した骨盤悪性腫瘍47例（直腸癌再発、脊索腫、仙骨前悪性奇形腫）に対する後方視的コホート研究。標準化した3段階の後方仙骨切除を施行し、全例でR0切除を達成した。30日・90日死亡率は0%で、排尿障害は一過性であった。
pmid-42578379.summary_en: A retrospective cohort of 47 patients with pelvic malignancies invading the high sacrum (recurrent rectal cancer, chordoma, or presacral malignant teratoma) underwent a standardized three-step posterior sacral resection. All patients achieved R0 resection, with 0% 30-day and 90-day mortality and no major complications. Voiding dysfunction was transient. Median operative time was 245 minutes and median hospital stay 19 days. Five-year recurrence rates were assessed. The lack of a control group was noted as a limitation.

pmid-42630020.summary_ja: 前立腺、腎、精巣、膀胱の各がんにおける全身療法後の手術転帰をまとめたシステマティックレビューです。精巣がんでは化学療法後の検体で生存腫瘍、奇形腫、瘢痕などの割合が示されました。胚細胞腫瘍は泌尿器腫瘍全体の一部であり、主題の中心ではありません。
pmid-42630020.summary_en: This systematic review searched PubMed and Scopus through May 2026 for studies on surgical outcomes after systemic therapy across prostate, kidney, testicular, and bladder cancers. For testicular cancer, post-chemotherapy specimens showed viable tumor in 8.3%-25%, teratoma in 18.2%-50.0%, and scar or in situ neoplasia in 31.1%-60.0%. Across tumor types, systemic therapy often did not eliminate the need for radical surgery. Testicular cancer is one of four cancer types covered, so germ cell tumor is a partial rather than central subject.

pmid-42755844.summary_ja: 不正性器出血で受診した44歳の閉経前女性である。外科的病期分類後に、体細胞由来の卵黄嚢腫瘍分化を伴う高異型度子宮内膜腺癌と診断された。免疫組織化学でSALL4、GPC3陽性、AFPは限局的に陽性で、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は著明に上昇していた。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによるBEP療法を施行し、AFPは治療中に著明に低下した。短期間の経過観察で明らかな進行は認めていない。
pmid-42755844.summary_en: A 44-year-old premenopausal woman with abnormal uterine bleeding was diagnosed after surgical staging with high-grade endometrial adenocarcinoma showing somatically derived yolk sac tumor differentiation. Immunohistochemistry was positive for SALL4, GPC3 and focal AFP, and serum AFP was markedly elevated. She received BEP-based chemotherapy, and AFP fell markedly during treatment, with no definite progression on short-term follow-up. The authors suggest that markedly elevated AFP in an aggressive endometrial tumor should prompt consideration of this differentiation, especially with yolk sac tumor-like morphology and positive staining for AFP, SALL4 and GPC3.

pmid-42835858.summary_ja: 2つの卵巣嚢胞性病変から不死化上皮細胞株を樹立した基礎研究である。子宮内膜症由来株は安定した核型と上皮形質を保持したが、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来株は顕著な染色体不安定性を示した。患者由来疾患モデルの検証には正確な病理診断が不可欠であると強調している。
pmid-42835858.summary_en: This laboratory study establishes immortalized epithelial cell lines from two ovarian cystic lesions using CDK4(R24C), cyclin D1 and hTERT. One lesion was later confirmed as endometrioma (iEn1) and the other as mature cystic teratoma (iEn2). The endometriosis-derived line kept epithelial markers and a stable karyotype and formed glandular structures in xenografts, while the teratoma-derived line showed marked chromosomal instability. The authors conclude that accurate pathological classification is essential to validate patient-derived disease models.

pmid-42856960.summary_ja: 若年成人の胸部・縦隔疾患5種類の診断遅延を扱う焦点総説。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍はその一つである。体系的手法は用いておらず、認知バイアスやシステム上の障壁が遅延の要因と論じている。予後は組織型と腫瘍生物学に依存する。
pmid-42856960.summary_en: This focused narrative review examines delayed diagnosis of five thoracic and mediastinal conditions in young adults: esophageal perforation, traumatic diaphragmatic injury, primary mediastinal germ cell tumours, airway tumours mistaken for asthma, and Hodgkin lymphoma presenting as an anterior mediastinal mass. Searches of PubMed and Scopus were purposive, without a formal systematic protocol or quality appraisal. The authors identify cognitive biases, anchoring and system barriers as contributors to delay. They note that prognosis in mediastinal malignancy depends strongly on histological subtype and tumour biology.

pmid-42991067.summary_ja: 10歳男児で、脂肪、石灰化、胎児骨格を含む大きな腸間膜腫瘤を認め、腹部奇形腫との鑑別が問題となった。手術所見はWillis基準を満たし胎児内胎児と暫定診断されたが、固定不良のため病理組織学的確認はできず、高分化型奇形腫は完全には否定できなかった。腫瘍マーカーは正常で、約10週間後も良好であった。病理組織が得られない場合の画像・術中所見の重要性を示す。
pmid-42991067.summary_en: A 10-year-old boy presented with a large mesenteric mass containing fat, calcifications, and a fetal skeleton, supporting a diagnosis of fetus in fetu over abdominal teratoma. Surgery met the Willis criteria, but histopathology was not interpretable because the specimen was poorly fixed, so a highly differentiated fetiform teratoma could not be excluded. Tumor markers were normal, and the child remained well at about 10 weeks. The case emphasizes radiologic, intraoperative, and clinical correlation when histology is unavailable.

pmid-40409851.summary_ja: 心臓および両側肺動脈に浸潤した血管内胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。人工心肺下での手術により摘出に成功した。
pmid-40409851.summary_en: Case report of an intravascular germ cell tumor with cardiac and bilateral pulmonary artery involvement, successfully resected under cardiopulmonary bypass.

pmid-40408609.summary_ja: 精巣癌のマネジメントに関する総説。手術・経過観察・化学療法・サバイバーシップケアを含む治療戦略を概説する。
pmid-40408609.summary_en: Overview of management strategies for testicular cancer, including surgery, surveillance, chemotherapy, and survivorship care.

pmid-40139237.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のDNA変異に関する症例報告と文献レビュー。
pmid-40139237.summary_en: Case report and literature review on DNA variants in primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-40136047.summary_ja: 染色体パッセンジャー複合体がヒト胎児性癌細胞の多能性維持に果たす役割に関する研究。
pmid-40136047.summary_en: Study on the role of chromosomal passenger complex in maintaining pluripotency in human embryonic carcinoma cells.

pmid-39995254.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者における脂肪肝発症に関する長期経過観察研究。
pmid-39995254.summary_en: Long-term follow-up study of hepatic steatosis development in testicular germ cell tumor survivors.

pmid-39907271.summary_ja: 血清AFP高値を伴う小児肝腫瘤の鑑別診断としての肝原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。
pmid-39907271.summary_en: Case report of yolk sac tumor of the liver as a differential diagnosis for liver mass with elevated AFP in pediatric patients.

pmid-40129838.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の自然破裂による化学性腹膜炎の症例報告。
pmid-40129838.summary_en: Case report of chemical peritonitis caused by spontaneous rupture of mature ovarian teratoma.

pmid-40129452.summary_ja: 急性呼吸不全から死亡に至った転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の症例報告。
pmid-40129452.summary_en: Case report on metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia resulting in acute respiratory failure and death.

pmid-40122440.summary_ja: 子宮自然穿孔で発症した妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。
pmid-40122440.summary_en: Case report of gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with spontaneous uterine perforation.

pmid-40053689.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者における精子のバイオエナジェティクスに関する研究。
pmid-40053689.summary_en: Investigation of bioenergetics in spermatozoa from patients with testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-40146282.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における後腹膜リンパ節郭清後病理予測のための血清マイクロRNAの診断能に関するシステマティックレビューとメタ解析。
pmid-40146282.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis on the diagnostic value of serum microRNAs in retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-40143987.summary_ja: 多発原発悪性腫瘍に対する妊孕性温存手術後に妊娠成功した症例報告。
pmid-40143987.summary_en: A case report on successful pregnancy after fertility-sparing surgery for multiple primary malignancies.

pmid-40156421.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BewoにおけるATRAのMMP-9活性・インテグリン発現への影響に関する研究。
pmid-40156421.summary_en: Investigation of Atra effects on MMP-9 activity and integrin expression in choriocarcinoma cell line Bewo.

pmid-40152072.summary_ja: マイクロRNA-371-373とメチル化解析による、胚細胞腫瘍由来体細胞型悪性腫瘍の卵黄嚢腫瘍起源説に関する研究。
pmid-40152072.summary_en: Study linking microRNA-371-373 cluster and methylation patterns to the origin of somatic-type malignancies in germ cell tumors.

pmid-40196408.summary_ja: 呼吸窮迫を呈した乳児の縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の稀な症例報告。
pmid-40196408.summary_en: A rare case report of mediastinal germ cell tumor presenting as respiratory distress in an infant.

pmid-40196163.summary_ja: 患児サイズに基づく仙尾部奇形腫の予後解析。
pmid-40196163.summary_en: Prognostic analysis of sacrococcygeal teratoma based on patient size at diagnosis.

pmid-40191490.summary_ja: Altman II/III型仙尾部奇形腫切除に対する腹腔鏡・仙骨併用アプローチの症例集積。
pmid-40191490.summary_en: Case series of laparoscopic-assisted abdominal and sacral approach for Altman II/III sacrococcygeal teratoma excision.

pmid-40189027.summary_ja: 女性生殖器領域の原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍(PNET)の臨床病理学的・分子的特徴に関する後方視的検討。
pmid-40189027.summary_en: A retrospective study characterizing PNETs in the female genital tract using clinicopathologic and molecular data.

pmid-40214375.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に生じた乳頭癌tall cell型の稀な症例報告。
pmid-40214375.summary_en: A rare case report of tall cell variant papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in struma ovarii.

pmid-40211726.summary_ja: 没食子酸によるヒト胎児性癌細胞の抗癌効果に関する研究。
pmid-40211726.summary_en: Study demonstrating the anticancer effects of gallic acid in human embryonic carcinoma cells.

pmid-40211607.summary_ja: 全身性肥満細胞症と共通クローン起源の胚細胞腫瘍を有する小児例へのKIT阻害薬治療の症例報告。
pmid-40211607.summary_en: Case report on the use of KIT inhibitors in pediatric systemic mastocytosis and germ cell tumor.

pmid-40203876.summary_ja: NCCN精巣癌ガイドラインVersion 2.2025の改訂点。
pmid-40203876.summary_en: Updated NCCN guidelines for testicular cancer, including new therapeutic approaches and management strategies.

pmid-40221634.summary_ja: 思春期の巨大嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍に対するバルーントロッカー減圧法。
pmid-40221634.summary_en: A novel technique using balloon trocars for decompression of large cystic ovarian tumors in adolescents.

pmid-40217218.summary_ja: 両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫破裂による再発性化学性腹膜炎の薬物・手術併用治療の症例報告。
pmid-40217218.summary_en: A case report of recurrent chemical peritonitis managed with pharmacological and surgical treatments.

pmid-40203524.summary_ja: 精巣癌生存者における骨粗鬆症リスクに関する退役軍人保健局での長期追跡調査。
pmid-40203524.summary_en: Long-term follow-up study assessing osteoporosis risk in testicular cancer survivors.

pmid-40203124.summary_ja: 早期転移性精巣セミノーマにおける18F-FDG PETの診断精度(SEMS試験)。
pmid-40203124.summary_en: Evaluation of 18F-FDG PET for early metastatic seminoma diagnosis based on SEMS trial data.

pmid-40202333.summary_ja: 40歳以上女性における卵黄嚢腫瘍分化を伴う悪性腫瘍の臨床病理学的・分子的解析。
pmid-40202333.summary_en: Clinicopathologic and molecular analysis of yolk sac tumors in older women.

pmid-40200493.summary_ja: 統計学的機械学習による精巣癌手術後の入院期間延長要因の検討。
pmid-40200493.summary_en: Application of statistical learning to identify factors associated with extended hospital stays after testicular cancer surgery.

pmid-40199596.summary_ja: 甲状腺癌を合併した両側悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告。
pmid-40199596.summary_en: A case report of bilateral malignant struma ovarii with concurrent thyroid carcinoma.

pmid-40480741.summary_ja: 本症例は前縦隔奇形腫を有する22歳男性を報告した。右心房血栓と両側肺塞栓が合併し、最初の手術介入を阻止した。経皮的技術により外科的危険が軽減され、腫瘤の安全な切除が可能となった。本症例は良性胚細胞腫瘍の珍しい血管合併症を示し、奇形腫切除に関連する周術期血栓塞栓事象の多分野管理戦略を強調している。
pmid-40480741.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with an anterior mediastinal teratoma complicated by a right atrial thrombus-in-transit and bilateral pulmonary emboli. Percutaneous techniques reduced perioperative surgical risk, enabling safe resection of the mediastinal mass. The case illustrates a rare vascular complication of an otherwise benign germ cell tumor and highlights multidisciplinary management strategies for perioperative thromboembolic events associated with teratoma resection.

pmid-40478614.summary_ja: 本研究はSEERデータベースを用い、妊娠性絨毛癌(719例)と非妊娠性絨毛癌(200例)を比較した。NGCC患者はより高い年齢、より進行した疾患、および悪い生存率を示した。化学療法はNGCCの生存を改善したが、GCCでは限定的効果を示した。著者は個別化治療を支援する5年生存予測ノモグラムとウェブベースツールを開発・検証した。
pmid-40478614.summary_en: This SEER-based retrospective cohort study compared gestational (GCC, n=719) and non-gestational choriocarcinoma (NGCC, n=200), finding NGCC patients were older, had more advanced disease, and worse survival. Chemotherapy improved survival in NGCC but had limited benefit in GCC, while radiotherapy was associated with worse outcomes. The authors developed and validated a nomogram and web-based tool for predicting 5-year survival to guide personalized treatment.

pmid-40464080.summary_ja: 胎盤絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株をモデルとして、バルプロ酸とその誘導体SPDが葉酸輸送体発現と経胎盤葉酸輸送に与える影響を検討した薬理学研究。輸送体発現の変化だけでは葉酸輸送動態を十分に説明できないことが示された。抗てんかん薬の催奇形性リスク評価を目的とし、胚細胞腫瘍そのものを対象とした研究ではない。
pmid-40464080.summary_en: This pharmacology study used the BeWo placental choriocarcinoma cell line as an in vitro model to examine how valproic acid and its amide derivative SPD alter folate transporter expression (FOLR1, SLC19A1, ABCG2) and transplacental folate transfer. Findings suggest transporter expression changes do not fully predict folate transfer kinetics, informing future teratogenicity risk assessment of antiseizure medications. The focus is placental drug transport, not germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-40462788.summary_ja: 31歳女性の全胞状奇胎が急速に肺転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛癌へ進展した症例報告。著しいhCG上昇を認めEMA/CO療法と子宮摘出術により完全奏効を得た。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の急激な進行例を示すが、胚細胞腫瘍ではなく妊娠性絨毛性疾患を扱った内容である。
pmid-40462788.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman whose complete molar pregnancy rapidly progressed to gestational choriocarcinoma with pulmonary metastases and extremely elevated hCG, treated with EMA/CO chemotherapy and hysterectomy achieving complete response. It highlights the aggressive potential of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia after molar pregnancy and the need for further research into high-risk disease trajectories, but addresses gestational trophoblastic disease rather than germ cell tumors.

pmid-40462411.summary_ja: 51例を対象に、子宮内膜症性嚢胞、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)、漿液性/粘液性嚢胞腺腫における腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術後の卵巣予備能(AMH・FSH)を比較検討した研究。奇形腫群・子宮内膜症群ともに術後AMHが有意に低下し、特に子宮内膜症群で低下が顕著だった。奇形腫手術における卵巣予備能温存の重要性を示唆する。
pmid-40462411.summary_en: This study compared ovarian reserve (AMH, FSH) before and after 3D laparoscopic cystectomy across endometriomas, mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts), and serous/mucinous cystadenomas in 51 women. Both endometrioma and dermoid cyst excision significantly reduced postoperative AMH levels, with a more pronounced decline for endometriomas, while cystadenoma removal showed no significant effect. Findings inform counseling on fertility-preserving surgical approaches for ovarian teratoma.

pmid-40457795.summary_ja: 本研究は妊娠性絨毛性疾患に関連する異型胎盤部結節(APSN)の症例集積と37症例の文献レビューを行った。治療には子宮拡張搔爬術または子宮鏡下手術が用いられ、フォローアップ中に2症例がトロホブラスト腫瘍に進行したが、悪性転化の因果性は不明である。
pmid-40457795.summary_en: This case series and literature review examined 5 patients with atypical placental site nodules (APSN), a rare gestational trophoblastic lesion, describing clinical course, treatment (curettage/hysteroscopy), and follow-up. Pooled analysis of 37 reported cases found 2 progressed to trophoblastic tumors, though causal transformation remains unproven. The study concerns gestational trophoblastic disease rather than germ cell tumors.

pmid-40451233.summary_ja: 精巣癌、特にその95%を占める精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関する包括的総説。疫学、臨床像、病期分類、セミノーマ/非セミノーマ別の病期ごとの治療方針、論争点、再発後の救済療法、経過観察までを網羅し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍診療の最新知見と今後の展望を臨床医・研究者向けに提供している。
pmid-40451233.summary_en: This Lancet Seminar provides a comprehensive review of testicular cancer, focusing on testicular germ cell tumors, which comprise about 95% of cases. It covers epidemiology, clinical presentation, staging, distinct management approaches for seminoma versus non-seminoma across clinical stages, controversies, salvage therapy after relapse, and follow-up strategies, offering clinicians an up-to-date synthesis of current evidence and future directions in testicular GCT care.

pmid-40448328.summary_ja: 25歳男性の転移性奇形腫内に体細胞型悪性腫瘍として高悪性度神経内分泌腫瘍が発生した稀な症例報告。思春期後型非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の奇形腫から非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍が生じる現象はまれであり、特に神経内分泌腫瘍としての発生は極めて稀。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の正確な診断・管理における認識の重要性を強調する。
pmid-40448328.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with a high-grade neuroendocrine tumor arising as a somatic-type malignancy within a metastatic teratoma, an extremely rare transformation of a postpubertal-type nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. The authors highlight that non-germ cell malignancies, though rarely neuroendocrine, can arise within teratomas, underscoring the importance of recognizing this phenomenon for accurate diagnosis and management of metastatic germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-40448114.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)由来の細胞外小胞(EV)を細胞株・組織・血漿検体から単離し、miR-371-373クラスターとlet-7eの発現を検討した研究。奇形腫を除くTGCT検体でEV由来miR-371-373が上昇し、分化に伴い発現が変化した。臨床バイオマーカーとして用いられるmiR-371-373の多くがEVを介して分泌され、腫瘍細胞間コミュニケーションに関与することが示唆された。
pmid-40448114.summary_en: This study characterized extracellular vesicles (EVs) from testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) cell lines, tissue, and patient plasma, examining miR-371-373 cluster and let-7e expression. EV-derived miR-371-373 was elevated in TGCT samples except teratoma, and levels changed with differentiation.
