pmid-39990810.summary_ja: 5ヶ月齢女児における腎未熟奇形腫の稀な症例。最初はWilms腫瘍と疑われた無痛性腹部腫瘤を呈示。左腎摘除術施行でGrade III未熟奇形腫が確認され、外胚葉性、中胚葉性、内胚葉性成分と神経上皮構造を含む。
pmid-39990810.summary_en: Rare case of renal immature teratoma in 5-month-old female presenting as painless abdominal mass initially suspected Wilms tumor. CT imaging showed large left abdominal tumor. Left nephrectomy performed with Grade III immature teratoma confirmed, containing ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal components with neuroepithelial structures.

pmid-39979132.summary_ja: 限定的な後腹膜転移を伴う精巣セミノーマに対する一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清の代替アプローチを検討。従来の放射線療法/化学療法からの心血管疾患および二次悪性腫瘍のリスクに対処。施設シリーズと第II相試験からの有効性を評価。
pmid-39979132.summary_en: Reviews alternative primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) approach for testicular seminoma with limited retroperitoneal metastases. Addresses concerns about cardiovascular disease and secondary malignancy risks from conventional radiotherapy/chemotherapy. Evaluates efficacy from institutional series and phase II trials.

pmid-39977396.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者104症例における二側（n=68）対一側（n=36）後腹膜リンパ節郭清テンプレートの比較後方視的研究。2年無再発生存率は二側法で優れている（86.8% vs 80.6%）。転移性セミノーマの好発リンパ節部位をマッピング；対側領域の微小転移を6～11.1%同定。
pmid-39977396.summary_en: Retrospective study of 104 seminoma patients comparing bilateral (n=68) versus unilateral (n=36) retroperitoneal lymph node dissection templates. Two-year recurrence-free survival superior with bilateral approach (86.8% vs 80.6%). Maps common metastatic landing zones; identifies 6-11.1% microscopic contralateral metastases.

pmid-39972715.summary_ja: 女性患者における先天性肺動脈弁上狭窄を模倣する性腺外前縦隔奇形腫の稀な症例。収縮期雑音で発症。外科的切除により症状は完全に消失。心臓評価における鑑別診断の重要性を強調。
pmid-39972715.summary_en: Rare case of anterior mediastinal extragonadal teratoma mimicking congenital supravalvular pulmonary stenosis in female patient presenting with systolic murmur. Complete symptom resolution achieved after surgical resection. Highlights importance of differential diagnosis in cardiac evaluation.

pmid-39968261.summary_ja: 停留精巣における胚細胞上皮内腫瘍(GCN)の組織病理学的研究。43例の患者から精巣摘除術/精巣固定術で得られた組織を通常の組織病理学的検査および免疫組織化学検査(PLAP、CD-117)で検査。1症例(6.7%)がGCN陽性。早期外科的管理の重要性を示唆。
pmid-39968261.summary_en: Histopathological study of germ cell neoplasia in situ (GCN) in cryptorchid testes from 43 patients. Tissue samples from orchidectomy/orchiopexy examined with routine histology and immunohistochemistry (PLAP, CD-117). One case (6.7%) showed GCN positivity. Demonstrates importance of early surgical management.

pmid-39966729.summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者の術前163例vs術後242例の精液検査比較。すべての主要パラメータが術前で有意に優越。射精量・精子数・運動性で顕著差。術後無精子症が3倍増加。術前凍結保存が推奨。
pmid-39966729.summary_en: Retrospective comparison of semen quality in testicular GCT patients preoperatively (n=163) versus post-orchiectomy (n=242). All major parameters significantly better preoperatively: volume (3 vs. 2 ml), total sperm count (56.9 vs. 13 million), motility (40% vs. 25%); azoospermia threefold higher postoperatively.

pmid-39963400.summary_ja: ストルマオバリ（卵巣甲状腺腫）内乳頭状甲状腺癌の症例。50歳女性で正常甲状腺を有する。文献10例の平均診断年齢46.5歳。更年期女性の定期検査の重要性を指摘。
pmid-39963400.summary_en: Case report of papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) within struma ovarii (ovarian mature teratoma with predominant thyroid tissue) in 50-year-old woman with histologically normal thyroid gland. Literature review of 10 similar cases shows median diagnosis age 46.5 years. Emphasizes importance of routine screening in perimenopausal women.

pmid-39960926.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来のカルチノイド腫瘍の稀な症例で、59歳女性が画像検査で良性奇形腫と誤診されていた。骨盤切除術を施行し、病理学的にカルチノイド由来と確認。36か月のフォローアップで再発転移なし。良性と悪性奇形腫成分の鑑別における診断上の課題を強調。
pmid-39960926.summary_en: Rare case of carcinoid tumor arising from mature cystic ovarian teratoma (MCTO) in 59-year-old woman, initially misdiagnosed as benign teratoma on imaging. Pelvic resection performed; pathology confirmed carcinoid origin. 36-month follow-up without recurrence. Highlights diagnostic challenges in distinguishing benign from malignant teratoma components.

pmid-39959558.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性難治性胚細胞腫瘍の治療は臨床的に問題のある状況である。初期治療に反応しなかった転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者は限られた治療選択肢と高い死亡率に直面するが、本症例は難治性精巣セミノーマに対する根治的手術の成功を示した。
pmid-39959558.summary_en: Case report of successful salvage en bloc resection for refractory recurrent testicular seminoma after cisplatin resistance. Addresses clinical challenge of metastatic GCT patients unresponsive to initial chemotherapy. Demonstrates radical surgical intervention as viable alternative for high-mortality patient group with limited therapeutic options.

pmid-39959557.summary_ja: 妊娠中（33歳、妊娠23週）に発見された卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が出血性ショックと腹腔内出血で呈示した稀な症例。左卵巣に24×29cm大の腫瘍と4.5L血性腹水を認める。緊急付属器摘除術を施行し、母体および胎児転帰は良好。早期段階未分化胚細胞腫の管理の重要性を強調。
pmid-39959557.summary_en: Rare case of ovarian dysgerminoma discovered during pregnancy (33 years, 23 weeks gestation) presenting with hemorrhagic shock and hemoperitoneum. Large 24×29 cm left ovarian tumor with 4.5 L hemorrhagic ascites. Emergency adnexectomy performed; maternal and fetal outcomes favorable. Emphasizes early-stage dysgerminoma management.

pmid-39959000.summary_ja: 妊娠中にてんかん重積状態で発症した女性が、抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された。骨盤画像検査で一側性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が同定され、外科的に切除された。免疫療法と集中治療の後、患者は良好に回復し、予定日に健康な新生児を分娩した。このまれな合併症に対する集学的管理の成功を示す。
pmid-39959000.summary_en: A pregnant woman presented with status epilepticus in early pregnancy, diagnosed with anti-NMDAR encephalitis. A unilateral mature cystic teratoma was identified on pelvic imaging and surgically removed. Following immunotherapy and intensive care, she recovered well and delivered a healthy infant at term, demonstrating successful multi-disciplinary management of this rare condition.

pmid-39958673.summary_ja: 32歳女性が卵巣皮様嚢胞の自然破裂による化学腹膜炎で救急車搬送された。患者は外科的に管理された。卵巣皮様嚢胞の自然破裂は稀であり、この症例は良性奇形腫から生じる急性外科的合併症を示している。
pmid-39958673.summary_en: A 32-year-old female presented with abdominal pain and distension caused by spontaneous rupture of an ovarian dermoid cyst, leading to chemical peritonitis. The patient was managed surgically. Spontaneous rupture of ovarian dermoid cysts is uncommon, and this case highlights the acute surgical complications that can arise from these benign teratomas.

pmid-39958508.summary_ja: 一次性卵巣カルチノイドは成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じることが多い稀な分化型神経内分泌腫瘍である。51歳女性患者のMRI画像所見と病理学的相関について報告している。奇形腫からの悪性転化の典型的な病態を示している。
pmid-39958508.summary_en: Primary ovarian carcinoid tumors are rare well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors classified as monodermal teratomas, often arising from mature cystic teratomas. This case report describes a 51-year-old female with primary ovarian carcinoid, detailing MRI features and pathological correlation demonstrating malignant transformation of teratoma.

pmid-39956567.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する脂腺癌は極めてまれで、文献に報告されているのは19例のみである。60代の女性が包括的な手術治療(子宮全摘出術および両側卵管卵巣摘出術を含む)を受けた。レビューでは70%が早期FIGO病期で発症し、外科的管理後の予後が良好であることを示した。
pmid-39956567.summary_en: Sebaceous carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratomas is exceptionally rare, with only 19 cases reported in literature. This case describes a woman in her 60s who underwent comprehensive surgical treatment including hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Review shows 70% present at early FIGO stages with excellent prognosis after surgical management.

pmid-39956429.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)患者1,277例における動脈血栓塞栓症(ATE)の発生率およびリスク因子を検討した後方視的コホート研究。10年および25年での累積ATE発生率はそれぞれ2.6%および12.0%であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法は短期ATEリスクを増加させ、喫煙、年齢≥35歳、乳酸脱水素酵素上昇が長期リスク因子であった。
pmid-39956429.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 1,277 testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) patients examined incidence and risk factors for arterial thromboembolic events (ATE). Cumulative ATE incidence at 10 and 25 years was 2.6% and 12.0% respectively. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy increased short-term ATE risk, while smoking, age ≥35, and elevated LDH were independent long-term risk factors.

pmid-39956109.summary_ja: 精巣病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)457例における精巣摘除術後の積極的監視を評価した後方視的研究。中央値フォローアップ65.3か月で、20%に再発を認め、後腹膜リンパ節が最も一般的な再発部位であった。20年における全生存期間(全生存率)は98.25%で、救済治療後に91.1%が無病であった。
pmid-39956109.summary_en: A retrospective study of 457 patients with stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) treated with active surveillance post-orchiectomy. With median follow-up of 65.3 months, 20% experienced relapse, with retroperitoneal lymph nodes as most common site. Overall survival at 20 years was 98.25%, with 91.1% of relapsed patients achieving disease-free status after salvage treatment.

pmid-39955056.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者における化学療法後の持続性後腹膜腫瘤に対するロボット支援経腸間膜的後腹膜リンパ節郭清を報告した本症例集積。4例が手術を受け、良好な周術期転帰が得られた。病理所見は思春期後奇形腫および壊死を含み、フォローアップ時にすべて無病。
pmid-39955056.summary_en: This case series presents robot-assisted transmesocolic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for persistent retroperitoneal masses in testicular NSGCT patients after chemotherapy. Four patients underwent the procedure with favorable perioperative outcomes. Pathological findings included post-pubertal teratoma and necrosis. All patients remained disease-free at follow-up.

pmid-39949949.summary_ja: 206例妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者のhCG陰性化時期に影響する因子の後方視的分析。BMI増加はhCG陰性化時間短縮と関連。化学療法前hCGレベル高値、子宮全摘術は陰性化時間延長と関連。
pmid-39949949.summary_en: This retrospective study of 206 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) patients identified factors influencing time to hCG negativization. Increased BMI was associated with shorter hCG negativization time, while higher pre-treatment hCG levels, longer time since last pregnancy, and hysterectomy were associated with prolonged conversion times. These findings support tailored treatment strategies for GTN management.

pmid-39948701.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から生じた扁平上皮癌の分子病理学的特徴をシングルニュークレウスRNA配列決定と空間トランスクリプトミクスで分析。KLF5が細胞増殖を促進するアップレギュレートされた遺伝子として同定。miR-145-5pが負の制御因子として機能し、KLF5関連因子が新規治療標的の可能性を示唆している。
pmid-39948701.summary_en: This study applied single-nucleus RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics to analyze squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature teratoma (SCC-MT), a rare malignancy with poorly understood molecular pathology. Analysis identified KLF5 as an upregulated gene promoting cell proliferation, with miR-145-5p as a negative regulator, suggesting novel therapeutic targets.

pmid-39948554.summary_ja: 2011年から2022年の35例後期絨毛癌患者の後方視的分析。異常子宮出血が最も一般的な症状（71.4%）。完全寛解率は88.6%。正常化学療法コース数の増加と補助化学療法コース数が再発リスクの有意な予後因子。
pmid-39948554.summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 35 postterm choriocarcinoma patients treated from 2011 to 2022. Abnormal uterine bleeding was the most common symptom (71.4%). Complete remission rate was 88.6%. Number of chemotherapy courses before achieving normal β-hCG and consolidation chemotherapy courses were significant prognostic factors affecting recurrence risk.

pmid-39944228.summary_ja: 思春期の腹部腫瘍の2症例報告。第1例は抗NMDA受容体脳炎を伴う3 cm卵巣類皮嚢腫で、外科的切除と免疫療法で数日で完全回復。第2例は30 cm子宮平滑筋腫。両症例ともフォローアップで良好。
pmid-39944228.summary_en: Two case reports of unusual abdominal tumors in adolescents: (1) a 12-year-old girl with anti-NMDAR encephalitis and a 3-cm ovarian dermoid cyst successfully managed with surgery and immunotherapy; (2) a 14-year-old girl with massive uterine leiomyoma. The first case demonstrates significant neuropsychiatric manifestations associated with ovarian teratoma.

pmid-39934683.summary_ja: 175例の精巣古典的セミノーマ患者における化学療法中のαフェトプロテイン上昇の後方視的検討。8例（4.6%）がベースラインで上昇AFP有し、6例が治療中に安定した中程度上昇を維持。軽度AFP上昇は診断変更なし。
pmid-39934683.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 175 testicular classical seminoma (TCS) patients examined α-fetoprotein (AFP) elevations during chemotherapy. Eight patients (4.6%) had elevated baseline AFP; six maintained stable moderate elevations without affecting diagnosis or management. Findings highlight that mild AFP elevations in TCS may occur without clinical significance.

pmid-39933864.summary_ja: 早期思春期の少女における卵黄嚢卵巣腫瘍からの腸間膜転移の稀な症例を報告する。腹部膨満で呈示し、画像検査で腫瘍マーカーの上昇を伴う悪性卵巣腫瘍が認められた。病理組織学的検査により卵黄嚢腫瘍が確認。卵巣腫瘍からの腸間膜転移は極めて稀である。
pmid-39933864.summary_en: This case report describes a rare presentation of mesenteric metastases from yolk sac ovarian cancer in an early adolescent girl. Patient presented with abdominal distension; imaging revealed a malignant ovarian tumor with elevated tumor markers. Surgical resection with histopathological confirmation of yolk sac tumor was performed. Mesenteric involvement is exceptionally rare.

pmid-39929118.summary_ja: 14,976検体(135腫瘍型)を用いたブラキウリ発現の組織マイクロアレイ研究。精巣胚細胞腫瘍でのブラキウリ陽性率:卵黄嚢腫瘍21.4%、胎児癌15.2%、セミノーマ4.4%、奇形腫2.4%。胚細胞腫瘍はコルドーマ以外で有意なブラキウリ発現を示す唯一の腫瘍群である。
pmid-39929118.summary_en: This tissue microarray study of 14,976 samples from 135 tumor types analyzed brachyury expression. Among testicular germ cell tumors, brachyury positivity was found in: 21.4% of yolk sac tumors, 15.2% of embryonal carcinomas, 4.4% of seminomas, and 2.4% of teratomas. Germ cell tumors represent the only additional group showing significant brachyury expression beyond chordomas.

pmid-39924670.summary_ja: 性腺胚細胞腫瘍患者1,409名を対象とした8研究のメタアナリシス。カルボプラチン系療法はシスプラチン系より治療失敗率が高いが、全生存率は同等。高用量カルボプラチン(AUC 7.9)はシスプラチンと同等の有効性で毒性がより許容可能。カルボプラチンは実行可能な代替選択肢を示唆している。
pmid-39924670.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 studies (1,409 patients) comparing carboplatin-based versus cisplatin-based chemotherapy in malignant gonadal germ cell tumors (GCTs). Carboplatin showed increased treatment failure rate but similar overall survival. High-dose carboplatin (AUC 7.9) achieved comparable efficacy to cisplatin with more tolerable toxicity, suggesting carboplatin as viable alternative.

pmid-39917302.summary_ja: 67歳男性の原発性肺絨毛膜癌。シスプラチン、エトポシド、パクリタキセルとシンチリマブの併用化学療法で治療。HCG上昇、PD-L1陽性。免疫チェックポイント阻害剤で腫瘍縮小を達成。
pmid-39917302.summary_en: Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in a 67-year-old male treated with combination chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, paclitaxel) and sintilimab. HCG was elevated and PD-L1 expression positive (70%). Treatment with immune checkpoint inhibitors achieved significant tumor reduction, suggesting promising therapeutic options for PPC.

pmid-39915218.summary_ja: セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に関する国際胚細胞腫瘍協力グループ分類の更新を報告。ラクテート脱水素酵素(LDH)の正常上限値の2.5倍以上の上昇を重要な予後因子として強調。高LDH良好リスクセミノーマの臨床管理の世界的な傾向変化を調査したSEMITrendsサーベイ結果。
pmid-39915218.summary_en: Updates to the International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group classification for seminomatous GCTs, highlighting lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) elevation >2.5× upper limit of normal as a key prognostic factor. Results from the SEMITrends survey on global management trends for high-LDH good-risk seminoma.

pmid-39912458.summary_ja: 2291例の転移性胚細胞腫瘍患者を用いた脳転移予測モデルの開発。診断時年齢≥40、絨毛癌優位組織型、化学療法前hCG≥5000、肺転移、骨転移を含む因子を組み込み、脳転移確率を0.6%から90%に層別化。
pmid-39912458.summary_en: Development of a prediction model for brain metastasis in metastatic germ cell tumors using 2291 patients. Model incorporates age ≥40, choriocarcinoma histology, pre-chemotherapy hCG ≥5000, pulmonary and bone metastases. Risk stratification ranges from 0.6% to 90% probability of brain metastasis.

pmid-39912039.summary_ja: 67歳閉経後女性患者の成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した混合型索状および粘液性カルチノイド腫瘍の症例。病理組織学的および免疫組織化学的分析で確認された。6ヶ月フォローアップで再発は認められず。成熟卵巣奇形腫における同時性悪性腫瘍スクリーニングの重要性を強調。
pmid-39912039.summary_en: Case of mixed trabecular and mucinous carcinoid tumors arising from a mature ovarian cystic teratoma in a 67-year-old woman. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed carcinoid features. Six-month follow-up showed no recurrence. Highlights importance of careful examination for synchronous malignancies.

pmid-39911022.summary_ja: 精巣生殖細胞腫瘍における脂肪組織の検討。605例の精巣摘出標本を分析。脂肪組織は1.8%で認識。位置や範囲を検討。病理診断における落とし穴を強調。
pmid-39911022.summary_en: Multi-institutional study of intratesticular adipose tissue in 605 orchiectomy specimens from 3 academic centers, identifying presence in 1.8%. Includes GCTs with and without teratoma components. Location ranged from rete testis to testicular parenchyma. Important for accurate staging and avoiding pathologic staging pitfalls.

pmid-39910147.summary_ja: マウス悪性TGCTモデルを用いてマイクロRNA(miR-291-293、ヒトmiR-371-373のホモログ)を血清バイオマーカーとして同定した研究。マイクロRNAは多能性胎児性癌細胞により発現されるが良性奇形腫では非発現。早期TGCT検出と出生前診断の可能性を示唆。
pmid-39910147.summary_en: Study using mouse malignant TGCT model to identify miRNAs (miR-291-293, homologs of human miR-371-373) as serum biomarkers. MicroRNAs are expressed by pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cells but not benign teratomas. Findings suggest potential for early TGCT detection and possible prenatal diagnosis.

pmid-39901937.summary_ja: 排尿障害と結石様所見を呈した53歳女性の膀胱原発成熟奇形腫症例報告。奇形腫は3つの胚葉由来組織を含む胚細胞由来。外科的切除により症状解決し、長期フォローアップが実施。
pmid-39901937.summary_en: Case report of primary mature teratoma in bladder of 53-year-old woman presenting with urinary obstruction and stone-like findings. Teratoma originates from germ cells containing tissues from all three germ layers. Surgical resection performed with symptom resolution and long-term follow-up.

pmid-39901344.summary_ja: 腎移植22年後の29歳患者における後腹膜転移を伴う精巣セミノーマ症例。BEP化学療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)で治療され、リンパ節の縮小を示した。治療中および治療後のAFP上昇は綿密な監視が必要。
pmid-39901344.summary_en: Case of testicular seminoma with retroperitoneal metastasis in 29-year-old post-kidney transplant patient, 22 years after transplantation. Treated with BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) with lymph node regression. AFP elevation required careful monitoring during and after treatment.

pmid-39899286.summary_ja: 米国における15~40歳男性の最も一般的な固形悪性腫瘍の精巣胚細胞腫瘍のJAMAレビュー(毎年約10,000例)。分類(セミノーマ対非セミノーマ)、リスク要因、腫瘍マーカー(AFP、hCG、LDH)による診断、病期分類、治療をカバー。病期I~III の5年生存率:99%、92%、85%。
pmid-39899286.summary_en: Comprehensive JAMA review of testicular germ cell tumors, most common solid malignancy in males aged 15-40 in the US (~10,000 cases/year). Covers classification (seminomas vs nonseminomatous), risk factors, diagnosis using tumor markers (AFP, hCG, LDH), staging, treatment, and survivorship. Stage I-III 5-year survival: 99%, 92%, 85%.

pmid-39897259.summary_ja: 56歳の閉経後女性の両側付属器纏絡症例。病理組織学的検査により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)として確認。画像上は初期には先の手術に由来する続発性病変と誤解釈。閉経後女性の付属器腫瘤の診断的複雑性を強調。
pmid-39897259.summary_en: Case of 56-year-old postmenopausal woman with bilateral adnexal entanglement confirmed as mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) on histopathology. Initially misinterpreted on imaging as secondary lesions from prior surgeries. Emphasizes diagnostic complexity of adnexal masses in postmenopausal women.

pmid-39890310.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のゲノムおよびエピジェネティック変化の概要。異染色体12p形成と多能性遺伝子のコピー数異常を含む。青年および成人患者のTGCT素因、発症、診断、治療における分子的特徴をカバー。
pmid-39890310.summary_en: Overview of genomic and epigenetic alterations in testicular germ cell tumors, including isochromosome 12p formation and copy number alterations in pluripotency genes. Covers molecular features in predisposition, development, diagnosis, and treatment of TGCTs across adolescent and adult populations.

pmid-39890298.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に由来する体細胞型悪性腫瘍の包括的なレビュー (患者の3~8%に影響)。分子的知見、病理学的特徴、臨床経過、および組織学的亜型をカバー。STMは侵襲的な性質と全身療法への頻繁な耐性を示す。
pmid-39890298.summary_en: Comprehensive review of somatic-type malignancies arising in germ cell tumors, affecting 3-8% of patients. Covers molecular findings, pathologic features, clinical behavior, and histologic subtypes. STMs show aggressive behavior and frequent resistance to systemic therapy.

pmid-39886914.summary_ja: デンマークの積極的監視を受けた臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者924例の全国的コホート。5年累積再発リスク16% (再発146例)、71%は画像検査単独で検出。リスク適応型監視で低リスク患者9% vs 非低リスク28%の再発率を示し、低リスク群での監視削減が可能。
pmid-39886914.summary_en: Nationwide Danish cohort of 924 clinical stage I seminoma patients on active surveillance. 5-year cumulative relapse risk 16% (146 relapses), with 71% detected by imaging alone. Risk-adapted surveillance identified low-risk patients (9% relapse) vs non-low-risk (28%), suggesting safe reduction of monitoring for low-risk groups.

pmid-39877943.summary_ja: 稀な卵巣悪性腫瘍3型のレビュー：中腎様腺癌、成人顆粒膜細胞腫、成熟奇形腫の悪性転化。扁平上皮癌が最も一般的。病理学、免疫組織化学、治療法を概説。
pmid-39877943.summary_en: Review of three rare malignant ovarian tumors: mesonephric-like adenocarcinoma, adult granulosa cell tumors, and malignant transformation of mature teratoma (most commonly squamous cell carcinoma). Covers epidemiology, pathology, immunohistochemistry, and treatment. Malignant teratoma transformation suspected in older patients with large tumors.

pmid-39876093.summary_ja: 妊娠胎盤性疾患の鑑別におけるSALL4免疫染色の研究。絨毛膜癌、水胞状奇胎、胎盤部位栄養膜腫瘍を検討。細胞栄養膜での拡散的SALL4陽性は絨毛膜癌に特異的。
pmid-39876093.summary_en: Study of SALL4 immunostaining to distinguish gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) subtypes: choriocarcinoma from other trophoblastic lesions, and complete hydatidiform mole from partial mole. Diffuse SALL4 positivity in cytotrophoblast/intermediate trophoblast is 74% sensitive and specific for choriocarcinoma diagnosis.

pmid-39876015.summary_ja: 乳幼児の稀な心膜内成熟奇形腫症例。心膜液吸収後に上大静脈閉塞を呈した。心膜液貯留と心臓圧迫が典型的であり、心エコー図と胸部コンピュータ断層撮影血管造影で上大静脈圧迫が確認され、外科的切除により成功裏に治療された。
pmid-39876015.summary_en: Rare case of intrapericardial mature teratoma presenting with superior vena cava obstruction following pericardial effusion absorption in an infant. Typically presents with pericardial effusion and cardiac compression. Echocardiography and thoracic CTA revealed mass compressing superior vena cava; surgical resection performed successfully.

pmid-39873178.summary_ja: 妊娠胎盤性疾患の分子メカニズムのレビュー。遺伝学、エピジェネティクス、マイクロRNAの役割を検討。胎盤栄養膜由来の稀な良性・悪性病変。病因メカニズムの理解を深める。
pmid-39873178.summary_en: Review of molecular mechanisms underlying gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), including genetic, epigenetic, and microRNA roles in pathogenesis and progression. GTD comprises rare benign and malignant lesions originating from placental trophoblast cells. Provides framework for understanding drivers of this rare condition.

pmid-39872676.summary_ja: 67歳男性における多がん検査スクリーニングで診断された早期精巣セミノーマの症例報告。初期の陰性診断検査にもかかわらず、高度な画像検査と内視鏡検査がセミノーマ診断と精巣摘除術へ導いた。陽性多がん検査結果の解釈における課題を強調する症例である。
pmid-39872676.summary_en: Case report of early-stage testicular seminoma in a 67-year-old male diagnosed via multicancer detection screening test. Despite initial negative diagnostic workup, advanced imaging and endoscopy eventually led to seminoma diagnosis, with subsequent orchiectomy. Highlights challenges in interpreting positive multicancer detection results.

pmid-39863292.summary_ja: 毛髪喀出症で発症した前縦隔成熟奇形腫の女性患者の症例報告。気管支肺への浸潤を伴い、右前側方開胸術と右上肺区域切除により治療された。術後は無症状で経過している。
pmid-39863292.summary_en: Case report of a woman presenting with trichoptysis (coughing up hair) diagnosed with benign mature teratoma of the anterior mediastinum with bronchopulmonary involvement. Treated with right anterolateral thoracotomy and right upper bilobectomy with good outcomes.

pmid-39862250.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者のフォローアップにおける腹部骨盤画像診断に関する欧州尿生殖器放射線学会の推奨。後腹膜リンパ節検出のためのコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を比較し、放射線被ばく回避のため臨床病期I疾患でMRIを支持。
pmid-39862250.summary_en: European Society of Urogenital Radiology recommendations for abdominopelvic imaging follow-up in adult testicular germ-cell tumor (TGCT) patients. Compares CT and MRI for retroperitoneal lymph node detection, favoring MRI for stage I disease to avoid radiation exposure.

pmid-39856688.summary_ja: ダウン症候群と停留精巣を有する42歳男性の後腹膜混合型胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍およびセミノーマ）の症例報告。腫瘍マーカーの上昇（αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCG）、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)/コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)検査所見、および手術所見が詳述。化学療法にもかかわらず予後不良。
pmid-39856688.summary_en: Case report of retroperitoneal mixed germ cell tumor (yolk sac tumor and seminoma) in a 42-year-old man with Down syndrome and cryptorchidism. Elevated tumor markers (AFP, β-hCG), PET/CT findings, and surgical findings are detailed. Poor prognosis despite chemotherapy.

pmid-39833047.summary_ja: 86歳男性における後腹膜嚢胞性成熟奇形腫の症例報告。成人、特に男性における稀な性腺外腹部奇形腫の提示。画像特性について討論。病理組織検査ではリンパ球増殖と限局性扁平上皮異型を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を示した。外科的切除が主要治療として推奨された。
pmid-39833047.summary_en: Case report of retroperitoneal cystic mature teratoma in an 86-year-old male. Rare extragonadal presentation in adults, particularly in males. Imaging features discussed; pathology showed mature cystic teratoma with lymphoid hyperplasia and focal squamous atypia.

pmid-39822873.summary_ja: 前縦隔奇形腫に伴う自己免疫溶血性貧血の26歳男性の症例報告。前縦隔奇形腫が基礎疾患であり、腫瘍摘出術により自己免疫溶血性貧血は完全に軽快した。
pmid-39822873.summary_en: Case report of autoimmune hemolytic anemia (AIHA) secondary to mediastinal teratoma in a 26-year-old male. Mediastinal teratoma identified as underlying cause; AIHA resolved completely following surgical excision of the tumor.

pmid-39822812.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する30歳男性患者の心内奇形腫の症例報告。深部静脈血栓症、肺塞栓症、腹腔骨盤転移併存。多診療科的調整による心内腫瘤の外科的切除実施。
pmid-39822812.summary_en: Case report of intracardiac teratoma in a 30-year-old male with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Patient also had abdominopelvic metastases, deep vein thrombosis, and pulmonary embolism. Surgical excision of intracardiac mass with multidisciplinary coordination.

pmid-39814463.summary_ja: 転移性腹腔外絨毛癌の男性患者の症例報告。血清β-hCG上昇と女性化乳房を呈し、生検が不決定的であったが、FDG PET/CTと腫瘍マーカーにより診断確定。
pmid-39814463.summary_en: Case report of metastatic extragonadal choriocarcinoma in a male presenting with elevated serum β-hCG and gynecomastia. Diagnosis confirmed by FDG PET/CT imaging findings and elevated tumor marker despite inconclusive biopsies.

pmid-39813870.summary_ja: 母親の喫煙（プロキシ：母親肺がん）と息子の精巣がんリスク間の関連性を調査したデンマーク全国コホート研究。セミノーマでハザード増加(HR=1.52)だが、非セミノーマでは増加なし。51年間フォローアップに基づく。
pmid-39813870.summary_en: Danish nationwide cohort study investigating association between maternal smoking (proxy: maternal lung cancer) and testicular cancer risk in sons. Found increased hazard for seminomas (HR=1.52) but not non-seminomas. Based on 51-year follow-up.

pmid-39812687.summary_ja: 胎児の先天性胸部腫瘤(縦隔奇形腫を含む)に関する文献レビュー。出生前診断の画像特性、出生後の経過、転帰を論じている。一部の胎児奇形腫は自然退縮を示した。
pmid-39812687.summary_en: Literature review of atypical congenital thoracic masses in fetuses, including mediastinal teratomas and rhabdomyomas. Discusses prenatal imaging features, postnatal manifestations, and outcomes. Some fetal teratomas showed spontaneous regression.

pmid-39809819.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の診断前血清中の循環RNAネットワークを分析した研究。セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの両方のネットワークでハブ遺伝子TEX14、NARS2、G3BP2などが同定された。腫瘍感受性遺伝子と共通の役割が示唆された。
pmid-39809819.summary_en: This study analyzes weighted gene co-expression networks in circulating RNAs from pre-diagnostic serum of testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) patients. Hub genes including TEX14, NARS2, G3BP2, and others associated with testicular dysgenesis were identified in both seminoma and non-seminoma networks. Estrogen-related transcription factors were implicated in TGCT development.

pmid-39809729.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫136例のうち18%に家族性形態が認められた。家族歴のある患者は多焦点腫瘍と転移性病変の発生率が高かった。遺伝的メカニズムは不均一である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-39809729.summary_en: This 22-year retrospective study found familial forms in 18% of 136 pediatric ovarian mature teratoma cases. Patients with family history showed higher rates of multifocal tumors and metachronous lesions. First-degree relatives were affected in half of familial cases, highlighting the importance of genetic predisposition in ovarian teratoma development.

pmid-39794024.summary_ja: 髄外性傍腟奇形腫の稀な症例。術後5年で膿瘍と腟会陰瘻が形成された。適切な治療管理により4年間の再発なし。長期フォローアップの重要性を強調。
pmid-39794024.summary_en: Rare case of paravaginal dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) with fistula formation 5 years post-surgery. The 23-year-old patient developed abscess with vaginoperineal fistula requiring debridement and fistulectomy. Long-term follow-up demonstrated successful management without recurrence, emphasizing importance of postoperative counseling.

pmid-39793154.summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣腫瘍から発症した絨毛性腫瘍の症例。子宮原発病変がないまま、リンパ節転移と高値β-hCGで診断された。妊娠性絨毛性疾患。
pmid-39793154.summary_en: Case of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (placental site trophoblastic tumor) in a 27-year-old woman with an ovarian lesion during pregnancy. Multiple lymphadenopathy was present at presentation, with elevated bHCG. Immunohistochemistry confirmed the diagnosis despite no uterine primary lesion.

pmid-39791511.summary_ja: 卵巣扁平上皮癌42例の検討。54.8%が奇形腫からの悪性転化。中央値OS 42ヶ月、5年生存率48.7%。高TMBと免疫療法の効果が示唆された。
pmid-39791511.summary_en: Study of ovarian squamous cell carcinoma in 42 patients, with 54.8% arising from teratomas. Median overall survival was 42 months, with 5-year OS of 48.7%. High tumor mutation burden was common. Combined immunotherapy with chemotherapy showed benefit in select patients, suggesting potential for future treatment approaches.

pmid-39789779.summary_ja: プラチナ系化学療法を受けた28人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者における6ヶ月間の監督運動介入研究。運動は心肺フィットネス、認知機能を改善し、残留プラズマプラチナ低下。グルコースとリピド代謝改善、内臓脂肪減少、リン酸クレアチン回復動力学の向上。
pmid-39789779.summary_en: Six-month supervised exercise intervention study in 28 testicular germ cell tumor survivors treated with platinum-based chemotherapy. Exercise improved cardiopulmonary fitness, cognitive function, and reduced residual plasma platinum. Enhanced glucose and lipid metabolism, with decreased visceral adiposity and improved phosphocreatine recovery dynamics.

pmid-39788042.summary_ja: 小児卵巣良性腫瘍（奇形腫含む）に対する卵巣温存手術後の機能保護。正常卵巣体積81.5%、正常AMH 89.5%。再発なし。
pmid-39788042.summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of 31 girls (mean age 11.7 years) undergoing ovarian-sparing surgery for benign ovarian neoplasms including teratomas. Normal ovarian volume was preserved in 81.5% of cases, with 89.5% showing normal AMH levels. No ipsilateral recurrences occurred during median 46.6-month follow-up.

pmid-39779499.summary_ja: 2022年版WHO小児腫瘍分類における更新を反映した小児胚細胞腫瘍の包括的レビュー。分子生物学と病理組織学の進歩を反映した臓器非依存的分類について論議。多診療科的ケアへの統合と診断的課題に焦点。
pmid-39779499.summary_en: Comprehensive review of pediatric germ cell tumors reflecting updates in the 2022 WHO Classification of Pediatric Tumors. Discusses organ-independent classification reflecting advances in molecular biology and histopathology. Emphasizes integration of updated classification in multidisciplinary care with focus on diagnostic challenges in pre- and post-pubertal-type tumors.

pmid-39778682.summary_ja: ステージIIA/IIBセミノーマ153例の治療成績比較。放射線療法の5年再発率10%、化学療法3%。放射線療法が急性毒性が少ない。
pmid-39778682.summary_en: Single-institution retrospective analysis of 153 patients with stage IIA/IIB seminoma (67 de novo, 86 relapsed). Radiation therapy (78%) and chemotherapy (22%) yielded excellent outcomes with 5-year relapse rates of 10% and 3% respectively. Radiation therapy preferred due to favorable acute toxicity profile.

pmid-39764538.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化（扁平上皮癌）の進行例。同時化学放射線療法により腫瘍縮小と機能改善が得られた。
pmid-39764538.summary_en: Case report of malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma (squamous cell carcinoma) in a 73-year-old woman. Concurrent chemoradiotherapy resulted in tumor reduction and improved performance status preoperatively. Surgery was performed, but dissemination and metastases developed 5 months postoperatively.

pmid-39761663.summary_ja: 740例の胚細胞腫瘍患者分析で、8例（1.1%）の鼠径部転移を同定。全例が一次セミノーマで75%が既往の鼠径部手術歴。転移性セミノーマでの相対頻度は8.3%。すべての患者で手術および/または化学療法で治癒達成。
pmid-39761663.summary_en: Analysis of 740 germ cell tumor patients identified 8 cases (1.1%) with inguinal metastases, all primary seminomas with 75% having prior groin surgery. Relative frequency in metastatic seminoma was 8.3%. All patients achieved cure with surgery and chemotherapy or chemotherapy alone.

pmid-39760469.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率は1992年の4.71から2021年の6.22に増加。ヒスパニック系男性で最高の発生率と最大の増加を示した。
pmid-39760469.summary_en: SEER database analysis of TGCT incidence trends (1992-2021) showing overall increase from 4.71 to 6.22 per 100,000. Rates increased for both seminoma and nonseminoma across all racial/ethnic groups. Hispanic men now have the highest incidence rates with greatest increases and more advanced stage at diagnosis.

pmid-39756232.summary_ja: ベトナム初の十二指腸成熟奇形腫における悪性転化（扁平上皮癌）の症例報告。腹痛、食欲不振、メレナを訴える35歳男性。外科的切除後に補助化学療法。5ヶ月のフォローアップで再発・転移なし。
pmid-39756232.summary_en: First documented case in Vietnam of malignant transformation (squamous cell carcinoma) in a duodenal mature teratoma. 35-year-old male with flank pain, anorexia, and melena. Surgical resection followed by adjuvant chemotherapy resulted in no recurrence or metastasis at 5-month follow-up.

pmid-39755048.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から卵巣腺癌への悪性転化の症例。BRCA2遺伝子変異が検出された。文献レビュー掲載。
pmid-39755048.summary_en: Case report of malignant transformation of mature ovarian teratoma into early-stage ovarian adenocarcinoma in a 47-year-old woman. Previously unclassified BRCA2 variant (c.8167 G>A) was identified in the adenocarcinoma. Literature review discusses clinicopathological features of teratoma-associated malignant transformation.

pmid-39753205.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断における後方視的研究で、11例の胎児における周生期転帰を評価。腫瘍体積対頭部周囲比と多羊水の組み合わせから新規指標を提案。36%の高い出生後死亡率。100%の感度で死亡率予測。
pmid-39753205.summary_en: Retrospective study of 11 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) proposing a novel perinatal mortality index combining tumor-to-head-circumference ratio and polyhydramnios. High postnatal mortality rate of 36% observed. THC ratio >3.0 with polyhydramnios predicted mortality with 100% sensitivity.

pmid-39749295.summary_ja: 18歳男性で精巣未熟奇形腫および腰椎転移例。化学療法後、growing teratoma syndromeの診断。転移部位で成熟奇形腫を認め、脊椎全摘除術を施行。追加化学療法後、17年間無再発生存。
pmid-39749295.summary_en: Case report of 18-year-old man with testicular immature teratoma and lumbar metastasis. Growing teratoma syndrome was diagnosed after chemotherapy. Total spondylectomy revealed mature teratoma at the metastatic site. Recurrence-free survival achieved for 17 years following additional chemotherapy.

pmid-39735795.summary_ja: 38歳未婚女性における卵巣胎児様奇形腫（homunculus）の稀な症例報告。超音波検査で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を示唆。病理学的検査で胎児様奇形腫を確認。fetus in fetuとの区別の臨床的重要性。
pmid-39735795.summary_en: Rare case report of ovarian fetiform teratoma (homunculus) in a 38-year-old nulliparous woman presenting with abdominal distention. Imaging suggested mature cystic teratoma, but histopathology confirmed fetiform teratoma—a highly differentiated form with fetal-like structures. Clinical importance of distinguishing from fetus in fetu emphasized.

pmid-39730027.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍から発生した胎児型神経外胚葉腫瘍の分子的特徴を分析。全腫瘍にKRAS/CCND2/KMD5A同時増幅を伴う12p染色体獲得を認知。MYCN/MYC増幅とp53抑制、およびPI3K経路活性化とCDK4増幅の2つの遺伝的パターンで層別化。
pmid-39730027.summary_en: This study describes the molecular features of embryonic-type neuroectodermal tumors arising from testicular germ cell tumors. All tumors showed chromosome 12p gain with KRAS/CCND2/KMD5A coamplification. Analysis revealed two distinct genetic stratification patterns: MYCN/MYC amplification with p53 pathway inactivation, and PI3K pathway activation with CDK4 amplification.

pmid-39726664.summary_ja: テストステロン分泌精巣非seminomaGCTの稀な症例報告。過アンドロゲン血症関連症状を呈した。GCT患者におけるホルモンスクリーニングの重要性を強調し、精巣摘除前後の標準化されたホルモン検査実施を提唱。
pmid-39726664.summary_en: A rare case of testosterone-secreting non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. The patient presented with hyperandrogenism-related symptoms. The paper highlights the importance of hormonal screening in GCT patients and advocates for standardized hormonal laboratory analyses in pre- and post-orchidectomy assessments.

pmid-39722226.summary_ja: 胎盤部絨毛膜癌（PSTT）が一過性甲状腺機能亢進症で発症した症例。29歳女性が産後6ヶ月に異常性器出血で発症。血中hCG上昇と甲状腺機能亢進を認めた。子宮全摘および両側卵管切除術後、甲状腺機能は正常化し2年で再発なし。
pmid-39722226.summary_en: Case report of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) presenting with transient hyperthyroidism. A 29-year-old woman developed abnormal genital bleeding 6 months postpartum with elevated hCG and hyperthyroidism. Following hysterectomy and bilateral salpingectomy, thyroid function normalized with no recurrence at 2-year follow-up.

pmid-39720606.summary_ja: 65および40か国の卵巣癌発症率の疫学的分析。組織学的亜型別の地域的変動を記載。多くの国で漿液性癌および胚細胞腫瘍のASRが時間とともに増加していることを示す。
pmid-39720606.summary_en: Population-based epidemiological analysis of ovarian cancer incidence and trends across 65 and 40 countries respectively. The study documents variations by histological subtype, showing increased ASRs for germ cell tumors over time in most countries despite stable overall ovarian cancer trends globally.

pmid-39715308.summary_ja: 下大静脈および右心房血栓を伴う仙骨尾骨胚細胞腫瘍で腫瘍学的緊急事態として呈示した13か月女児。9日目に緊急腫瘍栓除去術施行。化学療法と尾骨を含む腫瘍外科的切除後、12か月フォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-39715308.summary_en: Case report of a 13-month-old girl with sacrococcygeal germ cell tumor complicated by inferior vena cava and right atrial thrombus presenting as an oncologic emergency. Emergency surgical debulking of cardiac thrombus was performed on day 9. Following chemotherapy and tumor resection with coccygectomy, the patient remained recurrence-free at 12-month follow-up.

pmid-39706145.summary_ja: 膣鏡検査アプローチに続く乳幼児膣卵黄嚢腫瘍の長期転帰の症例報告。7ヶ月女児は化学療法に続いて膣鏡検査下での残存病変の同定および切除を受けた(MRIで見落とされた)。60ヶ月フォローアップ間に血清AFPは正常化し、再発なく卵巣/子宮機能が保存された。
pmid-39706145.summary_en: Case report of infantile vaginal yolk sac tumor with long-term outcome following vaginoscopic approach. A 7-month-old girl underwent chemotherapy followed by vaginoscopic identification and resection of a residual lesion missed by MRI. Over 60-month follow-up, serum AFP normalized with no recurrence and ovarian/uterine function preserved.

pmid-39704052.summary_ja: 臨床病期II胚細胞腫瘍の治療オプションとしての一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)のレビュー。論文はRPLNDと化学療法を比較し、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの再発率をレビューし、外科的知見に基づいた補助化学療法決定について述べている。
pmid-39704052.summary_en: Review of primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) as treatment option for clinical stage II germ cell tumors. The paper compares RPLND with chemotherapy, reviews recurrence rates in seminoma and nonseminoma, and discusses adjuvant chemotherapy decisions based on surgical findings.

pmid-39697498.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛膜癌の診断、病期分類、予後危険度スコアリング、および管理における多態的画像検査の役割をレビュー。臨床病理学的所見と画像所見を関連付けて最適な患者管理を提案。
pmid-39697498.summary_en: Review article on the role of multimodality imaging in diagnosis, staging, prognostic risk scoring, and management of gestational choriocarcinoma. The paper correlates imaging findings with clinicopathologic features to optimize patient care for this rare invasive placental malignancy.

pmid-39691761.summary_ja: grade IIIC intermediate risk精巣seminomaが頸部リンパ節腫瘤で発症した31歳男性の症例。放射線学的検査による診断法を示し、臨床像に基づく画像解釈の重要性を強調。
pmid-39691761.summary_en: Case report of a 31-year-old male with grade IIIC intermediate risk testicular seminoma presenting initially with cervical lymph node mass. The paper demonstrates radiological modalities for diagnosis and emphasizes coordinating imaging with clinical presentation in seminoma metastasis.

pmid-39674379.summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術を受けた38人の無精子症精巣がん患者における腫瘍精巣精子抽出の転帰。全体的に24%が成功した精子回収を有した。76%が胚細胞腫瘍を有していた(83%は純粋なセミノーマ、17%は混合型)。胚細胞腫瘍患者の生殖能温存データを提供。
pmid-39674379.summary_en: Outcomes of onco-testicular sperm extraction (TESE) in 38 azoospermic men with testicular cancer undergoing radical orchiectomy. Overall 24% had successful sperm retrieval. 76% had germ cell tumors (83% pure seminoma, 17% mixed). Provides fertility preservation data for GCT patients.

pmid-39674133.summary_ja: 1988-2022年に治療された189例のGTN患者の成績。低危険度疾患は治療センターで100％対地元87％の治癒率。高危険度：89％対47％。治療センターへの集約化で成績が向上。
pmid-39674133.summary_en: Outcomes of 189 GTN patients (molar pregnancy, choriocarcinoma, PSTT, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor) treated 2006-2022. Low-risk disease achieved 100% cure rate at tertiary center versus 87% locally. High-risk disease: 89% versus 47%. Treatment consolidation at referral centers significantly improves outcomes.

pmid-39662898.summary_ja: marker-negativeなCS 2 NSGCTに対する原発性RPLNDの305例の多施設分析。5年無病生存率はCS 2aで79％、CS 2bで76％。viable cancer患者において補助化学療法は成績を改善。RPLNDは選択GCT患者の治療選択肢。
pmid-39662898.summary_en: Multicenter retrospective analysis of primary RPLND in 305 men with marker-negative CS 2 NSGCT. 5-year DFS was 79% for CS 2a and 76% for CS 2b. With viable cancer, adjuvant chemotherapy improved outcomes. RPLND represents viable alternative to initial chemotherapy in selected GCT patients.

pmid-39654586.summary_ja: 妊娠30週に超音波で診断され胎児MRIで確認された巨大 type I 仙骨尾骨teratomaの症例。妊娠34週に急性胎児仁窮により緊急帝王切開施行。生後3日に合併症なく切除、新生児は良好に回復。
pmid-39654586.summary_en: Prenatal case of giant type I sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) diagnosed at 30 weeks gestation and confirmed by fetal MRI. Emergency cesarean section at 34 weeks was performed due to acute fetal distress. Successful postnatal resection on day 3 without complications with good neonatal recovery.

pmid-39654065.summary_ja: 小児癌患者でのsodiumthiosulfate シスプラチン誘発難聴予防効果をACCL0431試験で複数のサブグループで分析。CIHL罹患率はSTS投与で22.4%対非投与54%。5歳未満児およびneuroblastoma等はGCT等より大きなSTS保護効果。
pmid-39654065.summary_en: Secondary analysis of ACCL0431 trial evaluating sodium thiosulfate otoprotection in pediatric cancer patients across subgroups. CIHL incidence was 22.4% with STS versus 54% with observation. Children <5 years and those with neuroblastoma/hepatoblastoma/medulloblastoma showed greatest STS otoprotective effects compared to GCT patients.

pmid-39644709.summary_ja: 本研究は免疫組織化学とqRT-PCRを使用して、精巣セミノーマにおけるCacyBP/SIPタンパク質とERK1/2およびp38キナーゼの発現を分析した。癌性組織で正常組織と比較してCacyBP/SIP発現の著明な減弱が観察され、セミノーマ癌生成経路への関与を示唆している。
pmid-39644709.summary_en: This study analyzed CacyBP/SIP protein and ERK1/2 and p38 kinase expression in testicular seminoma using immunohistochemistry and qRT-PCR. Marked weakening of CacyBP/SIP expression was observed in cancerous tissue compared to normal tissue, suggesting involvement in seminoma carcinogenesis pathways.

pmid-39637520.summary_ja: 25人の妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)患者の膣転移に関する後方視的研究では、76%が化学療法単独で解決した。膣転移は予後上の重要性がわずかで、WHO予後スコアに基づいた標準化学療法レジメンによる保存的管理が推奨された。
pmid-39637520.summary_en: This retrospective study of 25 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) patients with vaginal metastases found that 76% resolved with chemotherapy alone. Vaginal metastases had minimal prognostic significance, and conservative management with standard chemotherapy regimens based on WHO prognostic scoring was recommended.

pmid-39630279.summary_ja: 本研究は、275の癌感受性遺伝子のMIPアレイと標的配列決定を使用して、成熟奇形腫に由来する卵巣扁平上皮癌(SCC)の分子学的特性化を実施した。TP53変異は82%の症例で、CDKN2A変異は54.5%で見られ、奇形腫細胞から由来する胚細胞の起源を支持する証拠があった。
pmid-39630279.summary_en: This study performed molecular characterization of ovarian squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) arising from mature teratomas using MIP array and targeted sequencing of 275 cancer-susceptibility genes. TP53 mutations were found in 82% of cases, CDKN2A mutations in 54.5%, with evidence supporting germ cell origin from teratoma cells.

pmid-39592145.summary_ja: 化学療法後の非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者13例に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清では、最小限の周術期罹病率で、1例で残存がん、7例で成熟奇形腫が認められた。中央18.6ヶ月のフォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-39592145.summary_en: This study evaluated laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for 13 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients after chemotherapy. Minimal morbidity occurred, with residual cancer in one patient and mature teratoma in seven. No recurrence occurred during median 18.6-month follow-up.

pmid-39578989.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫関連の抗NMDA受容体脳炎の臨床レビュー。18歳以上女性の58%に卵巣奇形腫が認められ、早期診断と治療が予後と生殖機能改善につながる。
pmid-39578989.summary_en: This review describes anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma, predominantly affecting young women (81%). Up to 58% of women over 18 have underlying ovarian teratoma. Early recognition and treatment significantly improve recovery chances and reproductive outcomes.

pmid-39578687.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性ストルマ患者376例の系統的レビュー。10年生存率91%、20年生存率87%。補助甲状腺治療による生存率改善なく、過度治療の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-39578687.summary_en: A systematic review of surgically treated malignant struma ovarii (MSO) with or without adjuvant thyroid therapy in 376 patients. Overall survival was 91% at 10 years and 87% at 20 years. Adjuvant thyroid-related therapy showed no survival benefit, suggesting potential overtreatment.

pmid-39577758.summary_ja: Y染色体モザイクを有するターナー症候群患者57例の後方視的研究で、性腺腫瘍の24.6%の有病率(ゴナドブラストーマ14例、ディスジャーミノーマ2例)が判明。47例が中央値8歳で性腺摘除術を受けた。成長ホルモン暴露は腫瘍発症の予測因子ではなかった。
pmid-39577758.summary_en: This retrospective study of 57 Turner syndrome patients with Y-chromosome mosaicism found 24.6% prevalence of gonadal tumors (14 gonadoblastomas, 2 dysgerminomas). Forty-seven underwent gonadectomy at median age 8 years. Growth hormone exposure was not predictive of tumor development.

pmid-39576421.summary_ja: 67の研究のレビューは、精巣胚細胞腫瘍用の次世代バイオマーカーとしてのマイクロRNA-371a-3pを検討しています。この胚性幹細胞関連マイクロRNAは従来のマーカー(AFP、β-hCG、LDH)と比較して優れた感度を示し、診断、監視、フォローアップのための臨床ガイドラインで認識され始めています。
pmid-39576421.summary_en: This review of 67 studies examines miRNA-371a-3p as a next-generation biomarker for testicular germ cell tumors. This embryonic stem cell-associated microRNA demonstrates superior sensitivity compared to conventional markers (AFP, β-hCG, LDH) and is becoming recognized in clinical guidelines for diagnosis, monitoring, and follow-up.

pmid-39571541.summary_ja: 56歳男性が右側非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍治療の27年後に左側精原細胞腫瘍を発症。血清腫瘍マーカーとマイクロRNA-371a-3pは正常。精巣新生物の異なる発生学的起源を強調する例外的症例。
pmid-39571541.summary_en: A unique case of a 56-year-old man who developed a left testicular spermatocytic tumor 27 years after right-sided nonseminomatous germ cell tumor treatment. Serum tumor markers including miRNA-371a-3p were normal. This exceptional case highlights different pathogenetic origins of testicular neoplasms.

pmid-39565383.summary_ja: 20人の男性におけるhCG陽性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の研究では、非セミノーマ性腫瘍の77%が胎児性癌成分を含有し、54%が絨毛癌成分を有していました。2人の患者がhCG誘発性甲状腺機能亢進症から甲状腺クリーゼを発症し、甲状腺摘除術または抗甲状腺療法が必要でした。
pmid-39565383.summary_en: This study of 20 males with hCG-positive testicular germ cell tumors found that 77% of nonseminomatous tumors contained embryonal carcinoma and 54% had choriocarcinoma components. Two patients developed thyroid storm from hCG-induced hyperthyroidism, requiring thyroidectomy or anti-thyroid therapy.

pmid-39557127.summary_ja: 本論文は病期IIA/IIBセミノーマに対する放射線療法戦略を、最近の放射線療法技術の進歩の文脈で検討している。この極めて治癒可能な疾患の95%を超える治癒率を鑑みると、長期治療の有害事象が治療の最適化における重要な考慮事項である。
pmid-39557127.summary_en: This review examines radiation therapy strategies for stage IIA/IIB seminomas in the context of recent radiotherapy advances. Given high cure rates exceeding 95%, long-term treatment morbidity is a crucial consideration in optimizing therapy for this highly curable disease.

pmid-39542769.summary_ja: 53の研究に関するシステマティックレビュー。精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の疫学とリスク因子。遺伝的素因は遺伝率の約44%を占める。出生前内分泌撹乱物質曝露、停留精巣などの早期生活因子がリスク増加に関連。
pmid-39542769.summary_en: A systematic review of 53 studies on testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) epidemiology and risk factors. Genetic predisposition accounts for ~44% of heritability. In utero exposure to endocrine-disrupting chemicals, cryptorchidism, and early-life factors are associated with increased TGCT risk.

pmid-39542173.summary_ja: 妊娠30週の31歳女性における抗NMDA受容体脳炎症例。卵巣奇形腫に関連。精神症状が優位。第一選択免疫療法で症状改善。妊娠継続し経腟分娩実現。
pmid-39542173.summary_en: A case report of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis during pregnancy (30 weeks) in a 31-year-old woman with ovarian teratoma, presenting with predominantly psychiatric symptoms. First-line immunotherapy improved symptoms, allowing term pregnancy and vaginal delivery.

pmid-39540785.summary_ja: 前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの悪性アポクリン腺癌の稀な症例。GCDFP-15陽性、Ki-67陽性10%。手術後6年無再発で予後良好。
pmid-39540785.summary_en: A case report of primary mediastinal apocrine adenocarcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma in a 51-year-old dialysis patient. The tumor showed cribriform/solid patterns with decapitation secretion and GCDFP-15 positivity. Patient remained recurrence-free 6 years after surgery without adjuvant therapy.

pmid-39527247.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における前例のない完全腸管、前立腺組織、尿道および膀胱構造の共存症例。26歳女性。腹腔鏡下囊胞摘出術成功。悪性腫瘍なく術後合併症なし。
pmid-39527247.summary_en: A case report of ovarian mature cystic teratoma containing unprecedented coexistence of complete intestinal tract, prostatic tissue, urethra, and bladder structures. A 26-year-old underwent successful laparoscopic cystectomy with no malignancy or postoperative complications.

pmid-39525900.summary_ja: 卵巣皮様嚢胞の医原性破裂と遠隔播種の稀有な症例。長期間無症状で経過した。画像所見と病理組織学で診断確定。
pmid-39525900.summary_en: A case report of remote rupture of ovarian dermoid cyst with peritoneal and liver surface implants in a postmenopausal woman. Despite iatrogenic rupture history, patient remained asymptomatic for extended period. Classical imaging and histopathology established diagnosis of this rare complication.

pmid-39520703.summary_ja: 121の精巣摘除術における腫瘍変位アーチファクト(TDA)と偽リンパ管脈管侵襲(LVI)の検討。セミノーマはTDA(68%)および偽LVI(53%)が多い。延長したホルマリン固定で組織学的品質改善。
pmid-39520703.summary_en: This study of 121 testicular orchiectomies examined tumor displacement artifact (TDA) and pseudo-lymphovascular invasion (LVI). Seminomas had more TDA (68%) and pseudo-LVI (53%) than mixed GCT. Prolonged formalin fixation (>1 night) reduced TDA and improved histological quality.

pmid-39515739.summary_ja: 早期原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍について、化学療法単独と手術ベースの多剤併用療法を比較した全国登録データ解析。セミノーマは同等の成績。非セミノーマ性腫瘍では手術が5年全生存期間向上に関連。
pmid-39515739.summary_en: A national database analysis of early-stage primary mediastinal germ cell tumors comparing chemotherapy alone versus surgery-based multimodal treatment. For seminomas, outcomes were similar. For nonseminomatous tumors, surgery was associated with improved 5-year survival compared to chemotherapy alone.

pmid-39510679.summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器がんからの肝転移に対する外科的切除のレビュー。胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法が第一選択。肝切除術の適応は腫瘍系統と化学療法反応性に依存。がん種により予後が異なる。
pmid-39510679.summary_en: Surgical review of liver metastases from genitourinary cancers including germ cell tumors. Chemotherapy serves as first-line treatment for metastatic GCTs. Liver resection feasibility depends on tumor lineage and initial chemotherapy response. Discusses different prognostic outcomes across cancer types including GCT.

pmid-39496807.summary_ja: 35歳女性の卵巣奇形腫に関連した抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告と文献レビュー。神経精神症状と発熱を呈する傍腫瘍性自己免疫症候群の臨床的特性を記載。診断上の課題と誤診のリスク、プレドニゾロン、静脈内免疫グロブリン、リツキシマブおよび手術的奇形腫切除を含む多科的管理の重要性を強調。
pmid-39496807.summary_en: Case report and literature review of anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma in a 35-year-old woman. Describes paraneoplastic autoimmune syndrome presenting with neuropsychiatric symptoms. Emphasizes diagnostic challenges and multidisciplinary management including immunotherapy and surgical teratoma removal.

pmid-39491621.summary_ja: 絨毛癌脳転移に対する定位放射線治療の症例集積とシステマティックレビュー。3例の患者(精巣原発2例、妊娠性1例)が画像フォローアップで良好な局所腫瘍制御を示した。文献検索ではCC脳転移に対するSRSの単一症例報告は3編のみで、本報告がこの稀で積極的な胚細胞腫瘍の合併症に対する最大の転帰シリーズである。
pmid-39491621.summary_en: Case series and systematic review of stereotactic radiosurgery for choriocarcinoma brain metastases. Reports 3 patients (2 testicular, 1 gestational) with good local tumor control on imaging follow-up. Literature review identified only 3 prior SRS case reports, establishing this as largest outcome series for rare complication.

pmid-39475366.summary_ja: 高悪性度漿液性癌背景の卵巣双側性体細胞由来GCT（卵黄嚢腫瘍・絨毛がん）症例。予後不良で正確な診断が治療指針に重要。従来報告45例のみ。
pmid-39475366.summary_en: Case report of rare somatically derived germ cell tumors (yolk sac tumor and choriocarcinoma) arising in bilateral ovaries with high-grade serous carcinoma background. Only 45 similar cases reported. Emphasizes diagnostic challenges and poor prognosis of somatically derived GCTs, highlighting importance of accurate pathologic diagnosis for treatment planning.

pmid-39467420.summary_ja: 60人の小児患者における卵巣腫瘍の単一施設研究。画像検査及び腫瘍マーカーの診断信頼性、術前評価及び術式に焦点。腫瘍漏出回避と腫瘍学的原則遵守の重要性、特に未熟奇形腫で重要。
pmid-39467420.summary_en: Single-center study of 60 girls with ovarian tumors including germ cell tumors. Examines diagnostic reliability of imaging and tumor markers, with focus on preoperative evaluation and surgical approaches. Discusses importance of avoiding tumor spillage and following oncologic principles, particularly for immature teratomas.

pmid-39466649.summary_ja: 30歳女性の絨毛癌症例で、肺、膵臓、肝臓および腎臓の多巣性出血性病変を示した稀な症例。18F-FDG PET/CTで膵臓びまん性FDG摂取を含む全身性疾患を有効に検出。化学療法後HCGレベルが低下し、この高度に悪性な胚細胞腫瘍の肯定的な治療反応を示唆した。
pmid-39466649.summary_en: Case report of choriocarcinoma in 30-year-old woman presenting with multifocal hemorrhagic lesions involving lungs, pancreas, liver, and kidneys. 18F-FDG PET/CT effectively detected systemic disease. HCG levels declined after chemotherapy, demonstrating treatment response in this rare and highly malignant germ cell tumor.

pmid-39466085.summary_ja: 23卵巣甲状腺腫症例と164悪性卵巣甲状腺腫症例のシステマティック分析。卵巣嚢胞摘出術は再発リスク因子であり、卵管卵巣摘除術で再発リスク有意に低下。病期I悪性卵巣甲状腺腫管理における外科的アプローチ選択の重要性を強調。
pmid-39466085.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 23 struma ovarii cases and systematic review of 164 malignant struma ovarii (MSO) cases. Identifies ovarian cystectomy as risk factor for recurrence, while salpingo-oophorectomy significantly reduces recurrence risk. Emphasizes importance of surgical approach selection in stage I MSO management and prognosis.

pmid-39448381.summary_ja: 病期II精巣セミノーマにおける一次性後腹膜リンパ節郭清のシステマティックレビュー。385人の患者を含む6つの研究。低合併症率と許容可能な周術期転帰。標準治療より高い再発率だが、長期生存データは92%の5年全生存期間(全生存率)を示唆する。
pmid-39448381.summary_en: Systematic review of primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for stage II testicular seminoma. Analyzes 6 studies involving 385 patients. Reports acceptable perioperative outcomes with low morbidity rates. Recurrence rate higher than standard treatment, though long-term survival data suggests 92% 5-year OS.

pmid-39437183.summary_ja: 348例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の多施設研究で精巣網過形成とヒアリン小体の発生率と診断的落とし穴を検討。本コホートでの発生率は30%で、これらの所見は卵黄嚢腫瘍と顕著に重複する可能性があった。腫瘍塊による精巣閉塞が病因と推定され、形態学的模倣の正確な認識と区別が適切な臨床管理のために重要である。
pmid-39437183.summary_en: Multi-institutional study of 348 testicular germ cell tumor specimens examining diagnostic pitfalls of rete testis hyperplasia and hyaline globules mimicking yolk sac tumor. Finds 30% incidence of these findings. Hypothesizes etiology related to testicular obstruction. Emphasizes importance of distinguishing morphologic mimicry for appropriate clinical management.

pmid-39433090.summary_ja: 思春期女性に偶然発見された卵巣成熟奇形腫の管理。小児患者での確立した治療指針の不足を指摘。文献ギャップの存在。
pmid-39433090.summary_en: Case report and literature review of incidentally discovered mature ovarian teratoma in adolescent patient. Discusses management challenges in pediatric population where definitive treatment guidelines are lacking. Highlights significance gap in literature for evidence-based recommendations in children with mature teratomas.

pmid-39429704.summary_ja: 乳幼児仙尾部悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。診断困難で、手術・化学療法に反応。再発例で再手術が必要。管理の複雑性を強調。
pmid-39429704.summary_en: Case report of malignant sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumor in 8-month-old presenting as pelvic mass compressing bladder. Describes diagnostic challenges, surgical management, and adjuvant chemotherapy. Documents tumor relapse and need for second resection, highlighting complexity of managing rare extragonadal germ cell tumors in infants.

pmid-39425609.summary_ja: 3084人の妊娠性絨毛性疾患患者と414万人の対照を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。妊娠性絨毛癌と侵入奇胎では非絨毛性癌のリスク上昇が認められたが、胞状奇胎では認められなかった。癌リスクは妊娠後の短期間に限定され、長期フォローアップ中に正常化する傾向が見られた。
pmid-39425609.summary_en: Retrospective cohort study of 3084 women with gestational trophoblastic disease examining association with subsequent non-trophoblastic cancer development. Finds increased cancer risk with gestational choriocarcinoma and invasive moles, particularly for gynecologic cancers. Risk elevated in short-term follow-up but normalizes over time.

pmid-39389902.summary_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清中に大血管切除(大動脈、下大静脈、腸骨動脈)を必要とした転移性精巣がん患者41例の後方視的研究。2年全生存率45%、合併症率56%を報告。再手術手技は有意に悪い転帰と関連。
pmid-39389902.summary_en: Retrospective study of 41 metastatic testicular cancer patients requiring major vascular resection (aorta, IVC, iliac artery) during post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Reports 45% 2-year overall survival with 56% complication rate. Re-operative procedures associated with significantly worse outcomes.

pmid-39375166.summary_ja: 低リスク妊娠滋養膜疾患の化学療法耐性と再発危険因子の包括的レビュー。FIGO score、hCG値、転移などが予測因子。
pmid-39375166.summary_en: Comprehensive review of risk factors for treatment resistance and recurrence in low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Examines multiple clinical and laboratory factors including FIGO score, hCG levels, metastasis pattern, and imaging findings. Identifies independent predictors for chemotherapy resistance and disease recurrence.

pmid-39370364.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛膜疾患と絨毛膜癌の遺伝学および後生遺伝学的側面に関するレビュー。水疱状奇胎から絨毛膜癌への進行機序と分子的基盤を解析し、疾患の臨床的管理および治療戦略への示唆を提供する。
pmid-39370364.summary_en: This review outlines current understanding of the genetics and epigenetics of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD), including hydatidiform moles and gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors examine molecular basis of trophoblastic cell abnormality and malignant transformation, and explore the connection between these conditions.

pmid-39362200.summary_ja: KRAS-G12V変異を有する転移性精巣腫瘍で抗PD-1療法とナブパクリタキセルの併用により持続的奏効を得た初の症例。個別化医療に基づくGCT治療戦略の有効性を示す報告。
pmid-39362200.summary_en: First case report of KRAS-G12V mutated metastatic testicular germ cell tumor achieving sustained disease remission with combined anti-PD-1 immunotherapy and nab-paclitaxel chemotherapy. Case demonstrates personalized treatment approach for chemotherapy-resistant TGCTs, highlighting role of molecular profiling and immune checkpoint inhibition in managing recurrent disease.

pmid-39359191.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫251例中101例（40.2%）の中枢神経系組織の神経病理学的検討。皮質構造形成、プルキンエ細胞の異形成変化、血液脳関門形成など、多様な病理学的所見を詳細に記述。
pmid-39359191.summary_en: Systematic neuropathological examination of CNS tissue in 101 ovarian mature teratomas (40.2% of 251 cases), documenting structural variations including plate-like formations, neuron morphology, blood-brain barrier formation, and cortical structures with variable dysmorphic changes. Observations provide insights into teratoma pathogenesis and development of neural tissue abnormalities.

pmid-39359021.summary_ja: 70歳男性の鼻腔における稀な性腺外未熟奇形腫で、SMARCA4機能喪失変異およびCNS GCT様メチル化プロファイルを有する症例。カルボプラチン/エトポシド化学療法および局所放射線照射で治療され、3年以上の無再発生存という好ましい転帰を達成した。非定型GCT部位における正確な診断と個別化管理の必要性を示唆している。
pmid-39359021.summary_en: Rare case of extragonadal immature teratoma in nasal cavity of 70-year-old man with SMARCA4 loss-of-function mutation and CNS GCT-like methylation profile. Treated with carboplatin/etoposide chemotherapy and localized irradiation, achieving favorable outcomes with over three years recurrence-free survival, demonstrating need for precision diagnostics and tailored management in atypical GCT locations.

pmid-39323340.summary_ja: 84人の精巣がん標本(胎児性癌、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、成熟/未熟奇形腫、絨毛癌を含む)における免疫組織化学的HSP90発現の後方視的研究。HSP90bは胎児性癌、セミノーマ、絨毛癌で普遍的に陽性。HSP90aは可変的発現で胎児性癌で最も高い。
pmid-39323340.summary_en: Retrospective immunohistochemical study of HSP90 expression in 84 testicular cancer specimens including embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, yolk sac tumor, mature/immature teratoma, and choriocarcinoma. HSP90b was universally positive in embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, and choriocarcinoma, while HSP90a showed variable expression, with highest levels in embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-39277819.summary_ja: 40歳未満の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者48例(ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍)の後方視的分析。術前MRIと術中凍結切片分析の感度を比較。MRIは95.5%の感度を示し、凍結切片分析の72.9%を上回った。MRIは特に未熟奇形腫の検出に優れていた。
pmid-39277819.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 48 women <40 years with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, endodermal sinus tumor), comparing preoperative MRI and intraoperative frozen-section sensitivity for diagnosis. MRI demonstrated 95.5% sensitivity versus 72.9% for frozen-section analysis, with MRI particularly superior for immature teratoma detection (88.9% vs 50%).

pmid-39269913.summary_ja: 11年間の単一施設経験：237例GCT患者(72%化学療法後)による正中線腹膜外後腹膜リンパ節郭清。中央在院日数2日で89%が術後第2日までに退院。罹病率低く(グレードIII-IV 4%)。腫瘍学的転帰は許容可能で、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性GCT両者の2年再発回避生存期間は85%以上。
pmid-39269913.summary_en: Eleven-year single-institution experience with midline extraperitoneal retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 237 GCT patients (72% post-chemotherapy). Median hospital stay 2 days with 89% discharged by POD2; low morbidity (4% grade III-IV complications); acceptable oncologic outcomes with 2-year RFS >85% in both seminomas and non-seminomatous GCTs and only 7 in-field recurrences.

pmid-39265650.summary_ja: 31歳女性の卵巣奇形腫除去と同時卵子採取の腹腔鏡手術症例。区域麻酔下で10cm成熟奇形腫を完全切除し、7個の卵子を採取、6個の成熟卵子を凍結保存。
pmid-39265650.summary_en: Case report of simultaneous laparoscopic removal of 10cm ovarian mature dermoid cyst and oocyte retrieval under regional anesthesia in 31-year-old woman with prior contralateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Seven follicles were aspirated during procedure with six mature oocytes successfully retrieved and cryopreserved; cyst was completely removed without intracavitary spillage.

pmid-39253799.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)における免疫学的異常の検討：正常な精巣免疫特権から悪性転化まで。精巣免疫特権の破壊、腫瘍発生に寄与する慢性炎症、化学療法耐性TGCT患者における免疫療法について述べた。予後不良患者での有効性は有望だが確実でない。
pmid-39253799.summary_en: Review of immunological alterations in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) from normal testicular immune privilege to malignant transformation. Discusses disruption of testicular immune privilege, chronic inflammation contributing to tumor development, and emerging immunotherapy approaches for chemotherapy-resistant TGCT patients with poor prognosis, highlighting promising but uncertain effectiveness.

pmid-39236056.summary_ja: 中間栄養膜細胞から発生する良性栄養膜性病変である胎盤部位結節(PSN)32症例の後方視的症例集積。最も一般的な症状は異常子宮出血(40.6%)。反復流産(15.6%)および不妊症(15.6%)も一般的。62.5%は子宮器械操作の既往。慢性子宮内膜炎が9.4%に共存。子宮鏡下切除の生殖転帰への利益は限定的。
pmid-39236056.summary_en: Retrospective case series of 32 patients with placental site nodules (PSNs), benign trophoblastic lesions developing from intermediate trophoblastic cells. Most common presentation was abnormal uterine bleeding (40.6%); recurrent pregnancy loss (15.6%) and infertility (15.6%) also common. 62.5% had prior uterine instrumentation; coexisting chronic endometritis noted in 9.4%; hysteroscopic resection showed limited benefit for fertility outcomes.

pmid-39179106.summary_ja: セミノーマによる高カルシウム血症の症例報告と文献レビュー。腫瘍による1,25-ジヒドロキシビタミンD産生亢進が機序。セミノーマの高カルシウム血症11例の報告から、ビタミンD介在性が主要機序と考察。
pmid-39179106.summary_en: Case report and literature review of hypercalcemia in seminoma mediated by elevated 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D production. Elevated 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D (>200 pg/mL) with suppressed PTH and normal PTHrP indicates vitamin D-mediated hypercalcemia of malignancy. Review of 11 reported seminoma cases with hypercalcemia; all four cases with available vitamin D data showed elevated metabolite levels.

pmid-39168413.summary_ja: 非定型的発症とPIK3CD遺伝子多型を有する小児ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）。SRY遺伝子と発育不全性腺が異常発症のリスク因子。進行ステージ病では一次的外科管理に続いて補助化学療法を実施。
pmid-39168413.summary_en: Pediatric case of ovarian dysgerminoma with atypical presentation and PIK3CD genetic mutation. Discusses risk factors including SRY gene presence and dysgenic gonad for abnormal dysgerminoma presentation. Reviews associations between dysgerminoma and other genetic mutations while noting lack of definitive established correlations; outlines primary surgical management followed by adjuvant chemotherapy for advanced-stage disease.

pmid-39167238.summary_ja: 胎盤部位絨毛膜癌4例のマルチパラメトリックMRI画像所見報告。腫瘍による圧迫で見かけ上の子宮筋層菲薄化が生じ、病理的厚さとMRI計測値に大きな乖離を認めた。
pmid-39167238.summary_en: Multiparametric MRI case series of 4 placental site trophoblastic tumors with emphasis on characteristic "pseudo-myometrial thinning." All tumors showed heterogeneous T1/T2/DWI signal with hypointense rim on T2WI and DCE-MRI. Myometrial thickness measured on MRI significantly thinner than pathologic thickness, creating appearance of transmural invasion despite superficial myometrial location, attributed to focal myometrial compression.

pmid-39106349.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫内に発生した前立腺型腺癌とBasal cell carcinoma の2例の稀少症例。免疫組織化学により前立腺由来を確認。手術後14ヶ月および11ヶ月で再発なし。
pmid-39106349.summary_en: Rare case series of two ovarian mature teratomas containing prostatic-type malignancy. First case showed infiltrative atypical glandular proliferation within teratoma; second case exhibited prostate-type low-grade basal cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma (Gleason 3+4), plus goblet cell adenocarcinoma of appendiceal type. Immunostains (NKX3.1, PSA) confirmed prostatic origin; both patients recurrence-free at follow-up.

pmid-39105324.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛膜疾患新生物の腰仙骨転移症例。β-hCG>100万mIU/mL、圧迫症状を伴う13cm の腫瘍。EMACO化学療法と放射線療法により完全奏効を達成。
pmid-39105324.summary_en: Case report of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with lumbosacral metastasis causing conus medullaris syndrome and lumbar radiculopathy in 34-year-old woman. Markedly elevated β-hCG (>1,000,000 mIU/mL); lumbosacral mass 13.3×11.5×6.3 cm with bone and nerve involvement. Successfully managed with 10 cycles EMACO chemotherapy and 30 Gy palliative radiotherapy; achieved remission with resolution of neurologic symptoms and β-hCG normalization.

pmid-39099297.summary_ja: 監視疫学および最終成績データベース(329人の患者)を用いた悪性卵巣甲状腺腫予後の機械学習分析。多変量Cox回帰は高年齢、未婚状態、化学療法、複数腫瘍を不良予後因子と同定。多層パーセプトロンモデルが5年生存率予測で最高精度を示し、MSO管理の臨床的意思決定支援ツール提供。
pmid-39099297.summary_en: Machine learning analysis of malignant struma ovarii prognosis using Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results database (329 patients). Multivariate Cox regression identified older age, unmarried status, chemotherapy, and multiple tumors as poor prognostic factors. Multilayer perceptron model showed highest predictive accuracy for 5-year survival; study provides personalized tool for clinical decision-making in MSO management.

pmid-39078248.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者319例の中央値62ヶ月フォローアップ研究で、両側腫瘍発症に関連する超音波検査所見を特定。微石灰化、不均一なエコーテクスチャ、および残存精巣体積低下が再発リスクを有意に増加。従来の5年を超えた個別化監視プロトコル支持。
pmid-39078248.summary_en: Study of 319 testicular GCT patients identifying ultrasound features predicting bilateral tumor risk over median 62-month follow-up. Microlithiasis, inhomogeneous echotexture, and reduced residual testis volume significantly increase recurrence risk, supporting personalized surveillance protocols beyond conventional 5-year follow-up.

pmid-39068044.summary_ja: ClinicalTrials.govに登録されたGCT治療試験142件の分析。完了試験の75%が結果未公表で、登録情報が不十分。多施設前向き研究と結果公表の強化、試験管理の最適化が必須。
pmid-39068044.summary_en: Analysis of 142 registered clinical trials for ovarian and testicular GCTs reveals significant gaps: 75% of completed trials lack published results, most use single-group designs, and 23% lack reported primary outcomes. Highlights urgent need for improved trial conduct and result dissemination.

pmid-39034154.summary_ja: 縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生する神経内分泌病変の症例報告および文献レビュー。57歳患者が分化良好な低悪性度神経内分泌腫瘍を呈示。13症例の文献レビューは外科的切除のみで優れた予後を示し、高悪性度成分を有する場合でも疾患関連死亡がなかった。
pmid-39034154.summary_en: Case report and literature review of neuroendocrine lesions from mediastinal mature cystic teratoma. 57-year-old presenting with well-differentiated low-grade neuroendocrine tumor. Literature review of 13 similar cases shows excellent prognosis with surgical resection alone, with no disease-related mortality even with high-grade components.

pmid-38959396.summary_ja: 絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮栄養芽細胞腫瘍の混合型妊娠性トロホブラスト腫瘍3例。DNA遺伝子型解析で妊娠性起源を確認。診断の複雑性と多成分認識が治療・予後判定に重要。
pmid-38959396.summary_en: Three cases of rare mixed gestational trophoblastic tumors combining choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. DNA genotyping confirmed gestational origin. Demonstrates diagnostic complexity with variable hCG levels and importance of recognizing all tumor components for prognosis and treatment.

pmid-38953909.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のサブタイプであるディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）のシステマティックレビュー。生殖年齢女性に多く、早期段階で診断、良好な予後、受精能温存治療の安全性と補助化学療法の有益性を強調。多施設前向き研究が必要。
pmid-38953909.summary_en: Systematic review of dysgerminoma, a malignant ovarian germ cell tumor subtype, primarily affecting reproductive-age women. Emphasizes early-stage presentation with favorable prognosis, safety of fertility-sparing treatment, and benefits of adjuvant chemotherapy. Highlights need for multicenter prospective studies.

pmid-38781130.summary_ja: 胎盤未熟奇形腫の稀な症例報告。臨床画像と病理学的知見を呈示。分類に関する議論と治療・フォローアップの管理指針を示す極めて稀な胎盤腫瘍の報告。
pmid-38781130.summary_en: Rare case report of immature teratoma of the placenta presenting with clinical imaging and pathology findings. Discusses classification controversies and therapeutic/follow-up management suggestions for this exceptionally rare placental neoplasm.

pmid-38391380.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内から生じた粘液性腺癌で、広範転移と偽粘液性腹膜炎を呈した稀有例。通常と異なるCK7+免疫表現型。奇形腫における悪性転化の可能性を示唆。
pmid-38391380.summary_en: Rare case of well-differentiated mucinous carcinoma arising within ovarian mature cystic teratoma presenting with disseminated metastasis and pseudomyxoma peritonei. Unusual CK7+/CK20+/CDX2+ immunophenotype suggesting potential for malignant transformation within mature teratomas.

pmid-38391350.summary_ja: 化学療法完了後の卵巣成熟奇形腫のgrowing teratoma syndromeで、長期存在する転移巣に神経内分泌分化を認めた稀症例。転移性疾患における異常な組織分化パターンを示す。
pmid-38391350.summary_en: Rare case of growing teratoma syndrome in ovarian mature teratoma with neuroendocrine differentiation in long-standing metastatic deposit following chemotherapy completion. Demonstrates unusual histopathological differentiation patterns in metastatic disease.

pmid-38380739.summary_ja: 精巣GCT166例（原発155例、転移11例）におけるEZH2とEHMT2/G9aエピマーカー発現の評価。非セミノーマで高発現、特に胚細胞癌。シスプラチン曝露転移で発現上昇。転移と悪性度の関連マーカーを示唆。
pmid-38380739.summary_en: Evaluation of EZH2 and EHMT2/G9a immunoexpression in 155 primary and 11 metastatic testicular GCTs. Non-seminomas show higher expression, particularly embryonal carcinoma. Cisplatin-exposed metastases demonstrate elevated expression, suggesting biomarkers for aggressiveness and metastatic potential.

pmid-38291671.summary_ja: ブレオマイシン含有化学療法を受けた33例の精巣がん患者（G-CSF併用/非併用）の後方視的研究。G-CSF併用患者の36.6%が肺毒性を発症しブレオマイシン中止を要した。毒性リスク要因のさらなる検討の必要性を強調している。
pmid-38291671.summary_en: Retrospective study of 33 testicular cancer patients receiving bleomycin-containing chemotherapy with/without G-CSF. 36.6% receiving concurrent G-CSF developed pulmonary toxicity requiring bleomycin discontinuation. Highlights need for further investigation of toxicity risk factors.

pmid-38284903.summary_ja: 後腹膜腫瘍で機能性パラガングリオーマが疑われたが、組織学的にセミノーマと判明した62歳男性。PLAP、OCT3/4陽性。後腹膜腫瘍の診断における複雑性を示唆。
pmid-38284903.summary_en: Case report of 62-year-old with functional paraganglioma suspected on imaging; histology unexpectedly revealed seminoma positive for PLAP, OCT 3/4, c-kit, and MDM2. Demonstrates diagnostic complexity of retroperitoneal masses and importance of pathological confirmation.

pmid-37962789.summary_ja: メキシコの244例の精巣がん症例（2007～2020年）の人口ベース後方視的研究。致死性の社会人口学的リスク要因を特定：非セミノーマ組織型、進行期、低教育水準。腫瘍組織型と社会経済的状況による健康格差を強調している。
pmid-37962789.summary_en: Population-based retrospective study of 244 Mexican testicular cancer cases (2007-2020) identifies sociodemographic risk factors for mortality: non-seminoma histology, advanced stage, lower education levels. Highlights health disparities by tumor histology and socioeconomic status.

pmid-37314115.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の空腸転移による消化管症状。超高リスク群として化学療法と手術治療を施行。妊娠性絨毛癌の稀有な腸転移例を呈示。
pmid-37314115.summary_en: Case of jejunal metastasis from gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with gastrointestinal symptoms. Patient classified as super high-risk and received combination chemotherapy and surgical intervention. Demonstrates rare presentation of gestational choriocarcinoma with intestinal metastasis.

pmid-33760513.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の包括的なレビューであり、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、絨毛癌、奇形腫を含む。分類、病理組織学、病期分類、および多重治療法について論じている。優れた予後を有し、5年生存率は約96%に達している。
pmid-33760513.summary_en: Comprehensive review of nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors encompassing yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, and teratoma. Discusses classification, pathology, staging, and multimodal treatment with excellent prognosis (96% 5-year survival).

pmid-33620805.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫のWHO分類に基づいた詳細なレビュー。思春期前型（低悪性度）と思春期後型（悪性）の特性、転移能、治療アプローチを記載。進行例は外科切除が重要な役割。
pmid-33620805.summary_en: Detailed review of testicular teratoma including prepubertal (indolent) and postpubertal (malignant) types per WHO classification. Discusses metastatic potential, somatic-type transformation, and multimodal treatment combining chemotherapy and surgery for advanced disease.

pmid-33231995.summary_ja: 嚢胞性奇形腫は3つの胚葉由来の高分化組織を含む良性胚細胞腫瘍である。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の約20%が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）である。最も一般的には卵巣および精巣に見られるが、縸隔、仙骨尾骨部、頸部にも発生する可能性がある。
pmid-33231995.summary_en: Cystic teratoma is a benign germ cell tumor containing well-differentiated tissues from three embryonic layers. Approximately 20% of ovarian germ cell tumors are mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts). Most commonly found in ovaries and testes, they can also occur in mediastinum, sacrococcygeal region, or neck. Although always benign with slow growth rate (1.8 mm/year), malignant transformation rarely occurs.

pmid-33085437.summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマは縦隔腫瘍の1-4%を占める稀な腺外GCTである。成長が緩徐で転移能が限定的である。化学療法と放射線療法に高度に感受性がある。5年生存率は87-100%で、精巣セミノーマと同等である。通常、前縦隔上部、特に無名静脈と上大静脈の交差点付近に発生する。
pmid-33085437.summary_en: Mediastinal seminomas are rare extragonadal germ cell tumors comprising 1-4% of mediastinal neoplasms. These tumors exhibit slow growth patterns and limited metastatic potential. They are highly sensitive to both chemotherapy and radiation therapy. Five-year survival rates have increased to 87-100%, equivalent to testicular seminomas. These tumors typically develop in the anterior-superior mediastinum, particularly near the junction of innominate vein and superior vena cava.

pmid-33085379.summary_ja: 前縦隔は性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の最も一般的な部位で、症例の50～70%を占める。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍は性腺腫瘍に組織学的および生化学的に類似し、両方が12p等腕染色体を示す。3つの主要亜型がある：奇形腫、非セミノーマ性腫瘍、セミノーマで、それぞれ異なる予後と治療意義を有する。
pmid-33085379.summary_en: The anterior mediastinum is the most common site for extragonadal germ cell tumors, accounting for 50-70% of cases. Mediastinal germ cell tumors resemble gonadal tumors histologically and biochemically, both showing isochromosome 12p. Three main subtypes exist: teratomas, non-seminomatous tumors, and seminomas, each with distinct prognosis and treatment implications. Treatment involves surgical resection or cisplatin-based chemotherapy followed by surgery, depending on histological subtype.

pmid-33085310.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍は原始卵黄嚢間葉に組織学的に類似した悪性原始胚細胞腫瘍である。3歳未満の小児における最も一般的な精巣腫瘍で、この年齢群で予後は良好である。成人では、卵黄嚢腫瘍は奇形腫および胎児性癌などの他の胚細胞腫瘍型との組み合わせでしばしば見られる。
pmid-33085310.summary_en: Yolk sac tumors are malignant primitive germ cell tumors histologically similar to primitive yolk sac mesenchyme. The most common testicular tumor in children under three years, with generally good prognosis in this age group. In adults, yolk sac tumors typically occur in combination with other germ cell tumor types such as teratoma and embryonal carcinoma, representing mixed histological patterns.

pmid-32966007.summary_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術は精巣悪性腫瘍の標準的な診断および治療処置である。胚細胞腫瘍は精巣腫瘍の95%を占め、セミノーマが50%以上を占める。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍はほぼ排他的に腫瘍マーカー上昇と関連しており、約10～25%のセミノーマはβ-hCG上昇または乳酸脱水素酵素上昇を示す。
pmid-32966007.summary_en: Radical orchidectomy via inguinal approach is the standard diagnostic and therapeutic procedure for testicular malignancies. Germ cell tumors comprise 95% of testicular tumors, with seminomas accounting for over 50%. Non-seminomatous germ cell tumors are almost exclusively associated with elevated tumor markers, while approximately 10-25% of seminomas show elevated beta-human chorionic gonadotropin or lactate dehydrogenase.

pmid-32965896.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の悪性型である：絨毛癌、侵入奇胎、上皮様栄養膜腫瘍、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍。これらの悪性腫瘍はすべて転移し、適時で効果的な治療がない場合、致命的となる可能性がある。
pmid-32965896.summary_en: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia includes malignant forms of gestational trophoblastic disease: choriocarcinoma, invasive mole, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. All these malignancies can metastasize and prove fatal without timely and effective treatment. Abnormal trophoblastic tissue becomes highly invasive and vascular through dysfunctional regulatory mechanisms, resulting in the development of invasive malignancies.

pmid-32809348.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマは最も治癒可能なGCTで、早期発見時の5年生存率は95%以上である。主に15-34歳の男性に発生し（人口10万対5例）。精巣、縦隔、後腹膜、または腺外部位に発生しうる。組織学的に純粋セミノーマと非セミノーマの区別が治療アルゴリズムを決定する。
pmid-32809348.summary_en: Testicular seminoma is a malignant germ cell tumor with excellent prognosis, achieving over 95% survival rate if diagnosed in early stages. Occurring in approximately 5 per 100,000 men, with peak incidence between 15-34 years. Seminomas can occur in testis, mediastinum, retroperitoneum, or other extragonadal sites. Histological distinction between pure seminoma and non-seminoma determines treatment algorithms.

pmid-32644667.summary_ja: 原始胚細胞から由来し、主に性腺（精巣および卵巣）に生じるが、稀に性腺外部位に生じる胚細胞腫瘍。臨床的にセミノーマと非セミノーマに分類。稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は全GCTの1～3%。ジャーミノーマは頭蓋内GCTのほぼ3分の2を占める。若い思春期に診断され、高い放射線感受性で90%以上の5年全生存期間。
pmid-32644667.summary_en: Germ cell tumors arise from primordial germ cells in gonads or, rarely, at extragonadal sites (1-3% of all GCTs). Clinically classified as seminomas or non-seminomas with significant prognostic implications. Germinoma, the intracranial counterpart of seminoma, comprises approximately two-thirds of intracranial germ cell tumors and generally has over 90% five-year survival rate due to radiosensitivity.

pmid-31536215.summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘤は胸部腫瘍の3%を占め、50%が前方に発生します。最も一般的な前方腫瘤は「4T's」の頭文字：胸腺腫、奇形腫、甲状腺組織、「恐ろしい」リンパ腫。胚細胞腫瘍、特に奇形腫は前縦隔での重要な考慮です。管理は臨床提示、放射線学的所見、組織学、分子技術を統合して最適な治療意思決定を行います。
pmid-31536215.summary_en: Anterior mediastinal masses comprise 3% of thoracic tumors, with 50% occurring anteriorly. The most common anterior masses follow the mnemonic "4T's": thymoma, teratoma, thyroid tissue, and "terrible" lymphoma. Germ cell tumors, specifically teratomas, are important considerations in the anterior mediastinum. Management integrates clinical presentation, radiological findings, histology, and molecular techniques for optimal therapeutic decision-making.

pmid-30571055.summary_ja: 絨毛癌はGTDの稀で攻撃的な亜型で、絨毛性と非絨毛性の2つの型があり、生物学的活動と予後が大きく異なる。主に女性に発生するが、男性では混合型GCTの成分として現れることがある。古くはヒポクラテスが400BC頃に記載したが、より正確に特徴付けられたのはその後である。
pmid-30571055.summary_en: Choriocarcinoma is a rare and aggressive subtype of gestational trophoblastic disease with two significant forms: gestational and non-gestational types showing very different biological behaviors and prognoses. While predominantly occurring in women, choriocarcinoma can also occur in men, typically as a component of mixed germ cell tumors. The disease has been recognized since ancient times but characterized more accurately in recent medical history.

pmid-29261918.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患は異常栄養膜増殖に由来する腫瘍群を包含し、胞状奇胎と栄養膜新生物の両方を含みます。悪性形態（侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、上皮樣栄養膜腫瘍、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍）は転移し、迅速な治療がなければ致命的になる可能性があります。これらの悪性腫瘍は任意の妊娠に続く数週間から数年後に発生する可能性があり、奇胎妊娠後に最も高い危険性があります。
pmid-29261918.summary_en: Gestational trophoblastic disease encompasses a group of tumors arising from abnormal trophoblastic proliferation, including both hydatidiform moles and trophoblastic neoplasms. Malignant forms (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, placental site trophoblastic tumor) can metastasize and become fatal without prompt treatment. These malignancies can develop weeks to years following any pregnancy, with highest risk after molar pregnancy.

pmid-29083593.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎は奇胎妊娠として一般に知られており、妊娠性絨毛性疾患に由来する希な妊娠異常です。異常受精に特徴付けられ、絨毛水腫および栄養膜増生をもたらし、完全または部分である可能性があります。通常良性ですが、胞状奇胎は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、上皮樣または胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍）に進行する可能性がある前悪性病変です。
pmid-29083593.summary_en: Hydatidiform mole, commonly known as molar pregnancy, is a rare pregnancy abnormality arising from gestational trophoblastic disease. Characterized by abnormal fertilization resulting in villous hydrops and trophoblastic hyperplasia, it can be complete or partial. Although typically benign, hydatidiform moles are premalignant lesions that can progress to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, epithelioid or placental site trophoblastic tumors).

pmid-28846234.summary_ja: 精巣がんは細胞由来に基づいて様々な組織型に分類され、セミノーマ性および非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が最も一般的です。セミノーマは全精巣胚細胞腫瘍悪性腫瘍の約3分の1を占め、最も治療可能なヒトがんの一つで、早期疾患では98～99%の生存率があります。全体的な発症率は比較的低いにもかかわらず、15～35歳の男性で最も一般的な悪性腫瘍です。
pmid-28846234.summary_en: Testicular cancers are classified by cell of origin into various histological types, with seminomatous and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors being the most common. Seminoma accounts for approximately one-third of all testicular germ cell malignancies and represents one of the most treatable human cancers, with 98-99% survival in early-stage disease. Despite relatively low overall incidence, it is the most common malignancy in males aged 15-35 years.

pmid-28613751.summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマは精巣または卵巣から由来する胚細胞腫瘍であり、主に若い男性に生じる稀な悪性腫瘍である。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のほぼ70%が非セミノーマで、残り約30%がセミノーマ。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、絨毛癌が非セミノーマに含まれる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の唯一の周知されたリスク因子はクラインフェルター症候群。
pmid-28613751.summary_en: Mediastinal non-seminomas are germ cell tumors arising from testes, ovaries, or the mediastinum primarily in young males. Nearly 70% of mediastinal germ cell tumors are non-seminomas, including embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, teratomas, and choriocarcinomas, while approximately 30% are seminomas. Klinefelter syndrome remains the only well-known risk factor for extragonadal germ cell tumors. Symptoms typically appear only when tumors enlarge.

pmid-40588865.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の臨床像と病理診断をまとめた総説。予防的経過観察と早期化学療法の普及により、近年は子宮外病変や非典型的な形で発見されることが多くなった。組織学的特徴、早期像、免疫組織化学や分子マーカーの使い方を概説し、胚細胞由来や体細胞由来の模倣病変との鑑別の重要性を強調している。
pmid-40588865.summary_en: This review covers the clinical features and pathologic diagnosis of gestational choriocarcinoma, the most common gestational trophoblastic neoplasm.
