With postmolar surveillance and early chemotherapy, the tumor now more often appears at extrauterine sites and in unexpected forms, making diagnosis challenging. The authors summarize histologic features, early manifestations, and the use of immunohistochemical and molecular biomarkers to distinguish it from nongestational mimics of germ cell or somatic origin. The review draws on the literature and the author's diagnostic experience.

pmid-40844663.summary_ja: 本研究は、免疫組織化学によりヒト正常精巣、セミノーマ、非セミノーマ組織におけるHippoシグナル関連タンパク質の局在を調べ、YAP-TEAD阻害薬ベルテポルフィンのセミノーマ細胞株TCam-2への作用を検討した。ベルテポルフィンは増殖・遊走・生存を抑制しアポトーシスを誘導し、セミノーマに対する治療戦略となりうることを示唆した。
pmid-40844663.summary_en: This study examined Hippo pathway protein localization in human normal testis, seminoma, and non-seminoma tissues by immunohistochemistry, then tested the YAP-TEAD inhibitor verteporfin on TCam-2 seminoma cells. Verteporfin reduced Hippo pathway protein levels in a dose- and time-dependent manner without changing mRNA, induced nuclear-to-cytoplasmic translocation, and suppressed proliferation, migration and viability while promoting apoptosis. The authors suggest verteporfin may be a promising therapeutic strategy for seminoma.

pmid-41055771.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性の転移性胚細胞腫瘍31検体でTROP2発現を解析し、絨毛癌と奇形腫で高く、卵黄嚢腫瘍では低いことを示した。TROP2標的の抗体薬物複合体サシツズマブ・ゴビテカンは、耐性サブクローンを含む細胞株に細胞傷害性を示した。臨床的有効性は今後の検証が必要である。
pmid-41055771.summary_en: This study examined TROP2 expression in 31 post-chemotherapy metastatic germ cell tumor specimens from cisplatin-resistant patients, including embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor and teratoma components. TROP2 was most often high in choriocarcinoma and teratoma and largely absent in yolk sac tumor. In germ cell tumor cell lines, the antibody-drug conjugate sacituzumab govitecan showed dose-dependent cytotoxicity, including in cisplatin-resistant subclones. The authors conclude that TROP2 may be a therapeutic target in chemoresistant germ cell tumors, but clinical efficacy still needs confirmation.

pmid-41061279.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後に発症した絨毛癌の腫瘍塞栓による4型肺高血圧症の症例報告。当初は手術適応のある慢性血栓塞栓性肺高血圧症と考えられ肺動脈血栓内膜摘除術が施行されたが、検体の病理組織学的検査でhCG陽性の悪性細胞が確認され、4型への再分類に至った。患者は術中に気道出血と人工心肺離脱困難で死亡した。原因不明の肺動脈閉塞では絨毛癌も鑑別に挙げるべきと示す。
pmid-41061279.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old woman who developed type 4 pulmonary hypertension from tumor emboli of choriocarcinoma after a molar pregnancy. Initially suspected as operable chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension, she underwent pulmonary thromboendarterectomy. Histopathology of the specimens showed hCG-positive malignant cells, leading to reclassification as type 4.2.2 PH. She died intraoperatively from airway bleeding and failure to wean from cardiopulmonary bypass. The case highlights the need to consider choriocarcinoma in unexplained pulmonary arterial obstruction.

pmid-41107829.summary_ja: 帝王切開で出生した女児に13cm大の仙尾部腫瘤があり、生検で未熟仙尾部奇形腫と確認された。制御不能な出血に対し緊急止血処置を行ったが、生後5日目に心不全と呼吸不全で死亡した。文献的解析も行い、死亡因子を検討した。
pmid-41107829.summary_en: This report describes a female fetus delivered by cesarean section with a 13 × 11 × 8 cm sacrococcygeal mass that showed incomplete capsular coverage and hemorrhage. Biopsy confirmed immature sacrococcygeal teratoma. Severe uncontrollable bleeding required emergency hemostatic intervention, and the newborn died on day five from heart failure and respiratory dysfunction. The authors also performed a systematic review and analysis of the literature to identify factors associated with mortality in similar cases. The aim is to raise pediatrician awareness of fatal sacrococcygeal teratoma and to inform strategies for reducing mortality.

pmid-41126232.summary_ja: 28歳男性の前縦隔巨大腫瘍を、画像検査と生検の後に切除し、原発性縦隔胎児性癌と診断した症例。化学療法と放射線療法を併用し、術後8年間再発はない。AFPの推移が病勢や手術効果の評価に有用であると著者らは強調している。
pmid-41126232.summary_en: A 28-year-old man presented with a large anterior mediastinal tumor, which was resected after imaging and biopsy and diagnosed as primary mediastinal embryonal carcinoma. Combined chemotherapy and radiotherapy were given, and he has remained free of recurrence for eight years with regular follow-up. The authors highlight that serum AFP changes closely track disease course and can be used to assess surgical outcome, and they stress that a complete, multimodal treatment plan is important for this aggressive tumor that typically has a poor prognosis in young men.

pmid-41240179.summary_ja: CRISPR/Cas9でPIWIL2全長またはセミノーマに関連する短鎖アイソフォームPL2L60Aを発現するアイソジェニックな細胞株を作製した基礎研究。PL2L60A発現細胞は増殖・遊走能が高く、アポトーシスを起こしにくかった。RNA-seqでは血管新生や細胞外基質リモデリングに関わる遺伝子が誘導され、mTORC1関連遺伝子は抑制されており、セミノーマに典型的なパターンと一致した。PL2L60Aがセミノーマの発生・進展の要因となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-41240179.summary_en: This laboratory study used CRISPR/Cas9 to generate isogenic knock-in cell lines expressing either full-length PIWIL2 or the short isoform PL2L60A, which is linked to testicular seminoma. PL2L60A-expressing cells showed higher proliferation and migration and reduced apoptosis. RNA-seq revealed induction of angiogenesis, extracellular matrix remodeling, and pro-cancer signaling genes, with repression of mTORC1-related genes, a pattern typical of seminoma. The authors propose PL2L60A as a possible driver of seminoma initiation or progression.

pmid-41339905.summary_ja: 抗NMDAR脳炎を伴う卵巣奇形腫と伴わない奇形腫を、RNAシーケンスとプロテオミクスで比較した。2524遺伝子と34タンパク質が有意に発現差を示し、細胞外基質と免疫活性化経路が強調された。鉄死や免疫活性化に関連する因子の変化が示された。
pmid-41339905.summary_en: This retrospective multi-omics study compared ovarian teratoma samples from patients with and without anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis (NMDAR-E). RNA sequencing and iTRAQ-based LC-MS/MS identified 2524 differentially expressed genes and 34 differentially expressed proteins. Functional enrichment highlighted extracellular matrix and immune activation pathways, and genes and proteins related to ferroptosis and immune activation, including SLC40A1, GGH, FKBP11, CCDC80 and ANK3, differed between groups. The authors note these findings are preliminary and generate hypotheses requiring mechanistic and clinical validation.

pmid-41429179.summary_ja: 1946年のSchlumbergerによる前縦隔奇形腫の研究を振り返り、その後の文献と著者の知見を加えて現代的に総括した総説。小児の純粋奇形腫は良性のI型胚細胞腫瘍で卵黄嚢腫瘍へ脱分化しうる一方、思春期以降の男性では12p過剰を伴うII型の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の成分として現れることが多いと論じる。発生起源や関連する血液・血管系悪性腫瘍にも言及する。
pmid-41429179.summary_en: This overview revisits H. G. Schlumberger's 1946 study of anterior mediastinal teratomas and integrates later PubMed literature and the authors' observations. Pure teratomas in children are described as benign type I germ cell tumors that may dedifferentiate to yolk sac tumor, whereas many postpubertal male teratomas are type II tumors within mixed germ cell tumors with 12p overrepresentation. Mature teratomas in postpubertal patients are hybrid type I and IV lesions. The article also considers the origin of these tumors from mismigrated germ cells and their associated hematologic and vascular malignancies.

pmid-41431060.summary_ja: SEERデータベースの732例を解析し、妊娠性絨毛癌における化学療法の生存への効果と機械学習による予後予測を検討。治療法間で生存に有意差はなく、高齢・転移・婚姻状況が予後因子だった。化学療法の開始時期の評価には多施設前向き研究が必要とされる。
pmid-41431060.summary_en: This SEER-based analysis of 732 patients with gestational choriocarcinoma assessed whether chemotherapy improves survival and built machine learning prognostic models. Survival did not differ significantly among chemotherapy, surgery alone, or combined treatment. Older age, metastasis, and marital status were independent prognostic factors, and a Random Forest model performed best for predicting 5-year survival. The authors suggest chemotherapy may not provide a survival benefit and recommend multicenter prospective studies to clarify when chemotherapy should start.

pmid-41431937.summary_ja: 3歳男児で左陰嚢腫脹が水瘤と疑われたが、数か月で硬い無痛性腫瘤となった。超音波とMRIで精巣実質の大部分を置換する多房性嚢胞病変を認め、腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。精巣摘除術で成熟奇形腫と確定し、2年間再発はない。
pmid-41431937.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-year-old boy with left testicular swelling initially suspected to be a hydrocele. Over several months the swelling became a firm, painless mass, and ultrasound and MRI showed a multiloculated cystic lesion with internal vascularity replacing most of the testis. Serum alpha-fetoprotein, beta-hCG and lactate dehydrogenase were normal. Left inguinal orchiectomy showed a mature teratoma without immature or malignant elements. The child had uneventful recovery and no recurrence over two years of follow-up. The authors emphasize early imaging and tumor marker evaluation in children with persistent scrotal swelling.

pmid-41439166.summary_ja: 74歳の閉経後女性で、病期IIIBの体細胞由来卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例である。完全切除後、虚弱のためブレオマイシンを省いてシスプラチン・エトポシドを投与した。AFPの推移に応じて投与間隔を21日から14日に短縮し、3コース後にAFPは正常化した。5年以上無病で経過している。
pmid-41439166.summary_en: A 74-year-old postmenopausal woman with stage IIIB somatically derived ovarian yolk sac tumor underwent complete surgical resection and cisplatin-etoposide chemotherapy, omitting bleomycin due to frailty. Chemotherapy intervals were shortened from 21 to 14 days in response to AFP kinetics. AFP normalized after cycle 3, and treatment was stopped after cycle 4. She has remained disease-free for more than five years under surveillance. The case shows that platinum-based therapy can achieve durable remission when regimens are adjusted for older or frail patients.

pmid-41442441.summary_ja: 32歳女性の胎盤内絨毛癌の症例報告である。出産後の胎盤病理で診断され、EMA-CO療法7コースを完遂して転移は認めなかった。治療終了10か月後に自然妊娠し健康な男児を出産した。5年間の経過観察で母子ともに異常はなく、化学療法後も将来の妊娠は妨げられないことが示唆された。
pmid-41442441.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman whose newborn had severe anemia and elevated alpha-fetoprotein, which led to a postpartum diagnosis of intraplacental choriocarcinoma on placental histopathology. She received seven courses of EMA-CO chemotherapy without metastasis. Ten months later she conceived spontaneously and delivered a healthy boy at term. Five-year follow-up showed normal development in both children and no maternal recurrence or metastasis. The authors suggest that chemotherapy does not preclude future successful pregnancy, and stress accurate diagnosis and long-term follow-up for both mother and child.

pmid-41458741.summary_ja: パキスタンの三次施設における小児の再発・難治性頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍51例の後方視的解析。幹細胞救援を行わない従来型救援化学療法で、5年全生存率72.5%、5年無イベント生存率50%だった。高リスク病変が死亡の独立因子で、自家幹細胞移植が困難な環境では有効な選択肢と結論づけた。
pmid-41458741.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study from a tertiary cancer centre in Pakistan evaluates pediatric relapsed or refractory extracranial germ cell tumors treated with conventional salvage chemotherapy without stem cell rescue. Among 51 analyzed patients, the most common regimen was VeIP/VeIC, and 26 were alive without disease at a median follow-up of 32 months. Five-year overall survival was 72.5% and event-free survival 50%. High-risk disease independently predicted mortality. The authors conclude that conventional salvage chemotherapy is an effective option where high-dose chemotherapy and autologous stem cell transplant are not readily available.

pmid-41459364.summary_ja: 閉経周辺期の51歳女性に生じた完全胞状奇胎の症例報告です。早期浸潤像を伴い、出血性ショックと異常子宮出血で発症しました。緊急子宮摘出術ののち、メトトレキサートを用いた化学療法で血清β-hCGは低下し、転移は認められませんでした。閉経周辺期の異常出血の鑑別として妊娠性絨毛性疾患を考慮すべきと強調されています。
pmid-41459364.summary_en: A case report of a 51-year-old perimenopausal woman with a complete hydatidiform mole showing early invasive features, presenting with hemorrhagic shock and abnormal uterine bleeding. She underwent emergency hysterectomy and, after postoperative methotrexate-based chemotherapy, showed declining serum β-hCG levels with no metastases. The authors emphasize considering gestational trophoblastic disease in the differential diagnosis of abnormal bleeding in perimenopausal women, along with timely surgical and chemotherapeutic management.

pmid-41460459.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清（R-RPLND）について、初回治療と化学療法後の症例を含む後方視的コホート研究をまとめた総説である。初回治療では出血量が少なく、入院期間が短く、順行性射精も保たれることが多い。化学療法後は技術的に難しく、乳糜合併症を含む合併症リスクが高い。開腹手術と比べて出血量と入院期間で優れるが、非ランダム化データのため施設差に注意が必要である。
pmid-41460459.summary_en: This narrative review summarizes retrospective single- and multicentre cohorts of robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (R-RPLND) for testicular germ cell tumours in primary and post-chemotherapy settings. Reported perioperative outcomes in expert centres show low blood loss, short hospital stay, and preserved antegrade ejaculation in primary disease, while post-chemotherapy cases are technically demanding with higher complications, including chylous leakage. Compared with open surgery, R-RPLND shows less blood loss and shorter stay with comparable oncologic outcomes, but the data are non-randomized and centre-dependent.

pmid-41463386.summary_ja: マウス精巣奇形腫F-9細胞と正常線維芽細胞L-929を用いた前臨床研究です。SELENOVは50 µg/mLでF-9細胞に選択的にアポトーシスを誘導し、ミトコンドリア機能障害やROS産生を伴いました。胚細胞腫瘍を標的とする抗がん剤候補となる可能性を示しています。
pmid-41463386.summary_en: This preclinical study examined exogenous selenoprotein V (SELENOV) in mouse testicular teratoma F-9 cells and normal L-929 fibroblasts. At 50 µg/mL, SELENOV markedly reduced F-9 viability, induced late apoptosis, depolarized mitochondria, increased ROS, and sustained intracellular calcium elevation, while L-929 cells required 100 µg/mL for comparable effects. Pro-apoptotic BAX and PUMA were upregulated and BCL-2 and BCL-xL were downregulated in F-9 cells. The authors conclude that SELENOV shows selective cytotoxicity toward germ cell tumor models and may be a targeted anticancer candidate.

pmid-41464707.summary_ja: トルコの7施設で治療された悪性卵巣甲状腺腫17例の後方視的解析である。組織型は古典的乳頭状甲状腺癌が多く、全例が病期I、転移はなかった。中央値43か月の経過観察で死亡例はなく、再発は1例であった。文献的検討では再発率9.2％、5年生存率は良好で、早期診断と適切な管理により予後は良好と結論している。
pmid-41464707.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter study from Türkiye describes 17 patients with malignant struma ovarii treated at seven centers. Most had classical papillary thyroid carcinoma, all were FIGO stage I, and none had metastasis. Four patients received adjuvant radioactive iodine. During a median follow-up of 43 months there were no deaths and one recurrence. A literature review of eight studies with 178 patients found a recurrence rate of 9.2 percent among 76 patients with reported follow-up and favorable five-year survival. The authors conclude that malignant struma ovarii has a favorable prognosis when diagnosed early and managed appropriately.

pmid-41466320.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の既往を持つ32歳男性の症例報告です。精巣摘除と補助化学療法の後、傍大動脈リンパ節の残存を転移と考えて切除しましたが、病理では胚細胞成分のない後腹膜ハイバーノーマ（褐色脂肪腫）でした。胚細胞腫瘍患者の後腹膜腫瘤では鑑別診断の重要性が強調されています。
pmid-41466320.summary_en: A case report of a 32-year-old man with a left testicular mixed germ cell tumor treated with orchiectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy. A residual left para-aortic lymph node at four months was presumed metastatic and resected, but pathology showed a retroperitoneal hibernoma, a benign fat-derived tumor, with no germ cell component. The authors highlight the diagnostic challenge of retroperitoneal masses in patients with known germ cell tumors and the need to include hibernoma in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-41474690.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における血漿DNaseの低値が予後不良と関連し、外因性DNase Iがシスプラチン治療効果を高めるとした原著論文の訂正通知である。通知本文は訂正対象論文のDOIを示すのみで、訂正内容は記載されていない。内容の確認には原著論文を参照する必要がある。
pmid-41474690.summary_en: This is a correction notice for a PLoS One article on testicular germ cell tumors, which reported that low plasma DNase is associated with worse clinical outcome and that exogenous DNase I improves cisplatin treatment efficacy. The notice itself contains only the bibliographic reference to the corrected article, and the corrected article's DOI is given. The abstract contains no clinical data, so the nature of the correction is not specified. Readers should consult the corrected article for the revised content.

pmid-41487830.summary_ja: 24歳男性の成人発症の眼窩成熟奇形腫例です。CTとMRIで脂肪成分を含む境界明瞭な腫瘤を認め、前頭側頭開頭術で完全切除しました。三胚葉由来の成熟組織から成熟奇形腫と確定し、6か月後も再発はありませんでした。類皮嚢腫などとの鑑別の難しさを強調しています。
pmid-41487830.summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with progressive right proptosis and diplopia. CT and MRI showed a well-circumscribed superolateral orbital mass with fat attenuation and no calcification or bony erosion. The tumor was completely resected through a frontotemporal craniotomy. Histopathology showed mature tissues from all three germ layers, including nerve bundles, adipose tissue, and salivary gland-like glandular tissue, confirming a mature teratoma. At six months there was no recurrence, and ocular motility had improved markedly. The authors highlight the difficulty of distinguishing adult orbital teratoma from other fat-containing orbital lesions such as dermoid cysts and lipomas.

pmid-41496571.summary_ja: 生後46日の男児に生じた右鼻咽頭の成熟奇形腫の症例報告です。気道閉塞による呼吸窮迫を呈しました。気管支鏡検査と画像検査で診断し、Loeb口蓋切開の改変法による減量切除で閉塞を解除しました。新生児の鼻咽頭奇形腫では、早期診断、迅速な介入、多職種連携が生命に関わる合併症の予防に重要と述べられています。
pmid-41496571.summary_en: A case report of a 46-day-old boy with a mature teratoma of the right nasopharynx causing acute airway obstruction and respiratory distress. Bronchoscopy and imaging guided the diagnosis, and surgical debulking via a modified Loeb palatal incision relieved the obstruction. Histopathology confirmed a mature teratoma. The authors highlight early diagnosis, prompt intervention, and multidisciplinary management to prevent life-threatening airway complications in neonates with nasopharyngeal teratomas, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-41510478.summary_ja: 閉経周辺期女性の卵巣において、卵黄嚢腫瘍分化を伴う高異型度類内膜腺癌の症例報告です。形態と免疫組織化学的所見が非典型的でした。遺伝子解析でCTNNB1、ARID1A、PIK3CAの病的変異が確認され、類内膜由来と示唆されました。分子プロファイリングの重要性と誤診防止の必要性が強調されています。
pmid-41510478.summary_en: A case report of a perimenopausal woman with high-grade endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the ovary showing yolk sac tumor differentiation, an exceedingly rare combination. Its unusual morphology and immunohistochemical profile raised the possibility of either a common precursor or divergent differentiation. Genomic analysis revealed pathogenic CTNNB1, ARID1A, and PIK3CA mutations, supporting an endometrioid origin. The authors emphasize molecular profiling and awareness of this entity to avoid misdiagnosis and guide appropriate therapy.

pmid-41516325.summary_ja: 非転移性セミノーマの術中生検12例を用い、ex vivo臓器培養(EVOC)系の確立を試みたパイロット研究である。組織構造は7日目まで保たれ、10日間まで組織を維持できた。Ki-67増殖指数と腫瘍細胞数は経時的に低下し、増殖指数のAUCを腫瘍の生存性マーカーとした。治療効果比較のための「EVOCスコア」も提案された。
pmid-41516325.summary_en: This pilot study adapts an ex vivo organ culture (EVOC) platform to non-metastatic seminoma, using intraoperative biopsies from 12 patients undergoing orchifuniculectomy. Histoarchitecture was preserved until day 7, and tissues remained viable for up to ten days. Ki-67 proliferative index and total and tumor cell counts declined over time. The AUC of the proliferative index served as a viability marker, and an EVOC score was proposed to compare treatment effects. The authors suggest the model could support future tumor biology research and pharmacological testing.

pmid-41523417.summary_ja: 65歳女性で、画像上は良性奇形腫が疑われたが、術後の病理組織学的検査で卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した扁平上皮癌と判明した。術前画像は良性病変を示唆して臨床医を誤らせることがあり、悪性成分は病理組織学的評価で初めて同定されることが多い。閉経後女性では特に注意が必要であり、卵巣奇形腫の管理における警戒の重要性を強調している。
pmid-41523417.summary_en: A 65-year-old woman was found to have a presumed benign teratoma on imaging, but histology after surgery revealed squamous cell carcinoma arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma. The authors note that preoperative imaging can mislead clinicians, and the malignant component is often identified only on histopathological evaluation. They report this case to raise awareness of this rare malignant transformation, especially in postmenopausal women, and emphasize vigilance when managing ovarian teratomas.

pmid-41527642.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍85例の後方視的研究で、術前の腫瘍マーカーと炎症指数を比較しました。非セミノーマでAFPとβ-hCGが有意に高値で、NLRとMPV/PLTも高値を示し腫瘍マーカーと正の相関を認めました。簡便な指標がリスク層別化の補助となる可能性を提案しています。
pmid-41527642.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 85 patients with testicular tumors (48 seminomas, 37 nonseminomas), comparing preoperative serum AFP, beta-hCG, and LDH with inflammatory indices (NLR and MPV/PLT). AFP and beta-hCG were markedly higher in nonseminoma patients, and LDH showed a similar trend. NLR and MPV/PLT were also higher in nonseminomas and correlated positively with AFP and beta-hCG. The authors propose that these simple hematological indices may complement classical tumor markers for assessing tumor aggressiveness, systemic inflammation, risk stratification, and follow-up.

pmid-41541134.summary_ja: 21歳のインドネシア人男性で、前縦隔の大きな腫瘤を伴う原発性縦隔セミノーマと診断された症例。超音波ガイド下コア針生検と免疫組織化学で確定し、部分切除の後にBEP療法3コースを受けた。3年時点で無病生存を維持しており、低リソース環境でも低侵襲な診断と実践的な治療が有効であることを示す。
pmid-41541134.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old Indonesian man with a large anterior mediastinal mass diagnosed as primary mediastinal seminoma. Diagnosis was made by ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy and immunohistochemistry (CD117 positive, CD45 negative). Because of extensive invasion and limited surgical resources, only partial resection was possible. He then received three cycles of BEP chemotherapy, achieved full functional recovery, and remained disease-free at three years. The authors emphasize that minimally invasive biopsy, pragmatic surgical decisions, multidisciplinary care, and structured surveillance can achieve durable remission in resource-limited settings.

pmid-41552123.summary_ja: 4歳女児が急性の左側腹部痛と嘔吐で受診し、超音波検査で螺旋状の血流を伴う大きな嚢胞性腫瘤を認めた症例報告。開腹術で成熟卵巣奇形腫と確認された。奇形腫の最も多い合併症は付属器捻転であり、若年女児で頻度が高い。早期診断が適切な管理に不可欠であることを強調している。
pmid-41552123.summary_en: This case report describes a four-year-old girl presenting with acute left flank abdominal pain and vomiting. Ultrasound showed a large cystic abdominal mass with a spiral vascular pattern suggesting adnexal torsion. Laparotomy via a Pfannenstiel incision revealed a mature ovarian teratoma. The authors highlight adnexal torsion as the most frequent complication of mature ovarian teratoma, particularly in young girls, and stress that early diagnosis is essential for optimal management of such pediatric cases.

pmid-41561519.summary_ja: インド北部の三次医療施設で2010〜2019年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍44例を後方視的に解析し、10年全生存率はセミノーマで77%、非セミノーマ性で78%であった。全例で初回精巣摘除術が行われ、転移性疾患の負荷は低かった。過去のインド報告より良好だが、欧米より劣る結果であった。
pmid-41561519.summary_en: This record-based retrospective analysis of 44 patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated at a tertiary center in North India from 2010 to 2019 reports 10-year survival outcomes. Five- and 10-year overall survival were 88% and 77% for seminoma, and 87% and 78% for nonseminoma. No prognostic factor was associated with overall survival. Patients presented with lower metastatic burden and all underwent upfront orchiectomy, giving better results than previous Indian studies but inferior results to Western data.

pmid-41561533.summary_ja: インドの癌センターで病期Iセミノーマの114例を解析した。監視、化学療法、放射線療法を比較し、再発は7.9%であった。5年の無再発生存率は92.4%、全生存率は98.9%である。監視群はフォローアップの遵守率が低かったが、生存率に差はなかった。資源が限られた環境では、積極的監視は良好な選択肢と結論づけている。
pmid-41561533.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data from 114 patients with stage I seminoma at an Indian cancer centre compares active surveillance, chemotherapy, and radiotherapy after high inguinal orchiectomy. Relapse occurred in 7.9% over a median follow-up of 70.6 months. Five-year relapse-free survival was 92.4% and five-year overall survival 98.9%. Only 43.8% of surveillance patients strictly adhered to follow-up guidelines, but survival did not differ by adherence or initial treatment. The authors conclude that surveillance remains a good option in resource-constrained settings.

pmid-41567310.summary_ja: 精巣原発絨毛癌の口腔軟部組織への転移例を報告し、文献を簡潔にレビューしています。精巣癌の口腔転移はまれで予後不良とされます。既往がんのない患者の口腔病変では診断が難しく、多職種による評価が必要と強調しています。
pmid-41567310.summary_en: The authors describe a case of testicular choriocarcinoma metastatic to the oral soft tissues and present a brief literature review. Metastasis of testicular carcinoma to the oral region is very rare and typically carries a poor prognosis. The report stresses that when a patient without a known cancer history presents with an oral lesion, the diagnosis is clinically challenging and requires multidisciplinary evaluation. When a patient has a prior carcinoma, oral and maxillofacial metastasis should be considered in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-41568380.summary_ja: 13歳女児の卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(主にディスジャーミノーマ、一部に絨毛癌成分)と肥満細胞白血病の同時発症例。両者はKIT D816Vなど同一の体細胞変異を共有し、共通の起源が示唆された。白金製剤による化学療法後も骨髄浸潤が持続し、分子標的薬も効果は限定的で、多臓器不全により死亡した。KIT変異を軸とした新たな疾患概念を提唱し、早期の遺伝子解析の重要性を強調している。
pmid-41568380.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with synchronous ovarian mixed germ cell tumor, predominantly dysgerminoma with a minor choriocarcinoma component, and mast cell leukemia. Both tumors shared identical somatic mutations, including KIT D816V, NRAS G12C, and TP53 Y220C, suggesting a common progenitor. Serum tumor markers fell after platinum-based chemotherapy, but cytopenias and marrow infiltration persisted. Targeted therapy with avapritinib and ruxolitinib gave limited response, and the patient died of multiple organ failure. The authors propose recognizing ovarian germ cell tumor/mastocytosis with KIT mutations as a distinct entity and stress early genetic profiling.

pmid-41573424.summary_ja: 20歳女性の肝臓原発の大きな腫瘤例です。AFPは正常で、CTで脂肪と石灰化を含む不均一な腫瘤を認めました。外科的切除により三胚葉由来の成熟組織からなる肝成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定しました。若年者の不均一な肝腫瘤の鑑別に加えるべきと強調しています。
pmid-41573424.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman presented with five months of upper abdominal pain and a palpable right hypochondrial mass. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was normal. Contrast-enhanced CT showed a large heterogeneous liver mass containing fat and calcification. Complete surgical resection was performed, and histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma of the liver with tissues from all three germ layers. The authors emphasize that primary hepatic teratoma, though rare, should be included in the differential diagnosis of heterogeneous liver masses in young patients, and that imaging detection of fat and calcification is valuable.

pmid-41577462.summary_ja: 43歳女性で流産後に子宮鏡で診断された非定型胎盤部結節の症例報告である。核異型を伴う中間型栄養膜細胞の増殖を認め、Ki-67指数は5％超であった。患者は子宮摘出を拒否し保存的管理を選択、12か月間で進行はみられなかった。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍との鑑別の難しさと、多施設レジストリの必要性を指摘している。
pmid-41577462.summary_en: This report describes the first Brazilian case of atypical placental site nodule, a rare gestational trophoblastic disease, diagnosed by hysteroscopy in a 43-year-old woman after miscarriage. Histology showed a circumscribed hyalinized trophoblastic aggregate with nuclear atypia and a Ki-67 index above 5 percent. Because the patient declined hysterectomy, she was managed conservatively with close monitoring, and no progression was seen at 12 months. The authors stress the diagnostic difficulty of distinguishing this lesion from benign placental site nodules and placental site trophoblastic tumor, and call for multicenter registries to guide future management.

pmid-41583471.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣奇形腫51例を対象とした単施設の後方視的研究である。右側例は左側例に比べ無増悪生存期間が有意に良好であった（ハザード比0.01）。片側性、特に右側の腫瘍は両側性より予後が良好であった。原発腫瘍の左右側性を治療や経過観察の計画に考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-41583471.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study of 51 patients with malignant ovarian teratoma examined whether primary tumor laterality affects prognosis. Using Kaplan-Meier and Cox regression analyses, right-sided tumors were associated with significantly better progression-free survival than left-sided tumors (hazard ratio 0.01). Unilateral tumors, particularly right-sided ones, had a better prognosis than bilateral tumors. The authors suggest that gynecologic oncologists consider laterality when counseling patients and tailoring treatment and surveillance for malignant ovarian teratomas.

pmid-41597044.summary_ja: 1施設における小児胚細胞腫瘍93例の後方視的解析である。仙尾部、卵巣、精巣が主な部位で、組織型では卵黄嚢腫瘍と成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が多かった。全生存率は95.8％、悪性例の無イベント生存率は84.2％であった。現行治療プロトコルの有効性と、早期診断・適切な管理の重要性を示している。
pmid-41597044.summary_en: This single-center retrospective study reviews 93 children with germ cell tumors treated at one institution, covering epidemiology, histology, tumor location, staging, treatment, and survival. Sacrococcygeal, ovarian, and testicular sites were most common, and endodermal sinus tumors and mature cystic teratomas predominated histologically. Overall survival was 95.8 percent, with 92.7 percent survival among malignant cases and 84.2 percent event-free survival in those cases. The authors conclude that the high survival rates reflect effective current protocols and emphasize early diagnosis and appropriate management in pediatric germ cell tumors.

pmid-41613673.summary_ja: 急性尿閉を呈した8歳の思春期前女児の両側巨大卵巣腫瘤の症例です。捻転を伴う左側は緊急開腹で、両側卵巣嚢腫摘出術により妊孠温存を図りました。病理学的に右側は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、左側は捻転による出血性壊死で悪性所見はありませんでした。2年の経過観察で安定していますが、卵巣予備能低下からホルモン補充療法を要しています。
pmid-41613673.summary_en: This case report describes an 8-year-old prepubertal girl with bilateral giant ovarian masses, one torsed, presenting with acute urinary retention. Emergency laparotomy and bilateral ovarian cystectomy were performed to preserve fertility. Histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma on the right and hemorrhagic necrosis from torsion on the left, with no malignancy. At two-year follow-up she remained stable but required hormone replacement due to compromised ovarian reserve.

pmid-41625888.summary_ja: 69歳男性の右肺腫瘤で、扁平上皮癌様の組織像を呈した症例です。血清総hCGが24544 IU/Lと著明に高値であったため免疫染色を追加し、SALL4とGATA3陽性から原発性肺絨毛癌と診断されました。非小細胞肺腫瘍が疑われる患者では、初期検査として血清hCG測定が有用であると報告しています。
pmid-41625888.summary_en: This case report describes a 69-year-old man with a large right lung mass whose histology mimicked squamous cell carcinoma. Markedly elevated serum total hCG (24,544 IU/L) prompted immunohistochemical testing, which showed SALL4 and GATA3 positivity and established a diagnosis of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma. The authors emphasize that serum hCG measurement should be considered as an initial investigation in patients with non-small cell lung tumors, followed by immunostaining for choriocarcinoma markers when hCG is elevated, given the diagnostic difficulty and poor prognosis of this rare malignancy.

pmid-41733161.summary_ja: 単施設後方視的研究で、男性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍32例を解析。縦隔が最多部位で、非セミノーマ、縦隔原発、PS不良、IGCCCG不良risk、化学療法後の腫瘍マーカー上昇が予後不良因子。2年全生存率はセミノーマ100%、非セミノーマ65%。
pmid-41733161.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study of 32 men with extragonadal germ cell tumors (2011-2021) found mediastinum as the most common site. Non-seminoma histology, mediastinal primary site, ECOG performance status above 2, poor IGCCCG risk, and elevated post-chemotherapy tumor markers were associated with inferior outcomes. Median follow-up was 65 months. Two-year overall survival was 100% for seminoma and 65% for non-seminoma, highlighting the need for newer salvage therapies in refractory disease.

pmid-41768819.summary_ja: 女児新生児に生じた仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。出生体重3.37kgの児の腫瘍は体重の約3分の1を占め、循環動態への影響が問題となった。多職種チームによるアプローチで外科的切除が成功した。予後は腫瘍の大きさや重量、アプガースコア、術中損傷、悪性の可能性などに左右される。
pmid-41768819.summary_en: This case report describes a female neonate with a sacrococcygeal teratoma, born at 3.37 kg to a 34-year-old primigravida. The tumour made up about one-third of the body weight and created haemodynamic challenges. Prognosis in such cases depends on tumour size and weight, APGAR scores, age at presentation, intraoperative injury and malignant potential. The authors achieved successful surgical resection through a multidisciplinary team approach, which they present as a model for managing large congenital teratomas in neonates.

pmid-41782712.summary_ja: 42歳女性で下垂体微小腺腫と左卵巣類皮嚢腫が併存した症例報告。両疾患の併存はまれで、婦人科的・ホルモン的な不均衡を来した。症状に対する治療が行われた。著者らは包括的な鑑別診断と多職種による対応の重要性を強調し、高プロラクチン血症と卵巣類皮嚢腫の病態との関連について検討の必要性を述べている。
pmid-41782712.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with a pituitary microadenoma who also had a left-sided ovarian dermoid cyst, causing gynecological and hormonal imbalance. The co-occurrence of these two conditions is rare. The patient was managed symptomatically after multidisciplinary evaluation. The authors emphasize the need for comprehensive differential diagnosis and discuss the unclear relationship between elevated prolactin levels and the pathophysiology of ovarian dermoid cysts.

pmid-41842818.summary_ja: 18か月の男児に生じた性腺外の陰茎原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。左鼠径陰嚢部腫瘤で発症し、肺転移を伴う病期IVであった。外科的切除後にブレオマイシン・エトポシド・カルボプラチンによる化学療法を6コース施行し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は段階的に低下した。12か月時点で無病生存を維持しており、AFPは診断とフォローアップに有用と考察されている。
pmid-41842818.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-month-old boy with an extragonadal penile yolk sac tumor presenting as a left inguinoscrotal mass with pulmonary metastasis (stage IV). Initial alpha-fetoprotein was 4,396 ng/mL. A macroscopically complete surgical resection, preserving penile and testicular structures, was followed by six cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and carboplatin chemotherapy. AFP declined progressively, and the patient remained disease-free at 12 months. The authors emphasize AFP as a useful marker for both diagnosis and follow-up.

pmid-42038780.summary_ja: 不妊症精査中に腹腔鏡検査で偶然診断された卵管の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。腹腔鏡は子宮卵管造影で通過性を確認するだけでなく、超音波やHSGでは捉えにくい病変を直接観察でき、同時に治療も可能です。文献検索で得られた4例の腹腔鏡診断例も併せて検討しています。
pmid-42038780.summary_en: This case report describes a rare mature cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube, incidentally diagnosed by laparoscopy during an infertility workup. The authors emphasize that laparoscopy, beyond confirming tubal patency on hysterosalpingography, allows direct visualization of tubal lesions that are difficult to detect with ultrasound or HSG, and permits simultaneous treatment. A PubMed literature search identified four previously reported laparoscopically diagnosed tubal mature cystic teratomas, which were reviewed alongside the present case.

pmid-30422545.summary_ja: hCGは早期胚盤葉と胎盤の栄養膜細胞が産生するホルモンである。高hCG値は正常妊娠と異常妊娠を区別するのに役立つ。絨毛癌を含む特定のがんの診断に有用であることが言及されるが、論文の主な焦点は妊娠と生殖治療におけるhCGの機能である。
pmid-30422545.summary_en: hCG is a hormone produced by trophoblast tissue in early embryos and placental tissue. Elevated hCG levels distinguish normal from abnormal pregnancies. The paper mentions hCG testing aids in diagnosis of certain cancers including choriocarcinoma and extrauterine malignancies, but primary focus is on hCG's physiological role in pregnancy and fertility treatment.

pmid-32310578.summary_ja: hCGは栄養膜細胞、下垂体、非栄養膜性悪性腫瘍から産生されるホルモンで、異なる生物学的機能を持つ複数の同位体から構成される。遊離β-hCG検出は悪性疾患を示唆する。論文はhCG生理に焦点を当てており、GCT診断への応用は付随的である。
pmid-32310578.summary_en: hCG is a hormone produced by multiple cell types (trophoblasts, pituitary, nontrophoblastic tumors) with distinct biological functions. Free-beta hCG detection is suggestive of malignancy and poor prognosis. The paper discusses hCG's role in pregnancy monitoring and cancer diagnosis, though primary focus is on hCG physiology rather than germ cell tumor management.

pmid-39364965.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連した抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。重篤な睡眠障害（agrypnia excitata）が疾患再発のバイオマーカーとなることを示し、免疫療法と手術による奇形腫除去で睡眠パターンが正常化した。
pmid-39364965.summary_en: Case report documenting anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma, where severe sleep disruption characterized by agrypnia excitata served as a clinical biomarker of acute disease relapse. Polysomnographic analysis revealed abnormal sleep architecture with motor hyperactivity, normalized after resumption of immunotherapy and surgical teratoma removal.

pmid-39428610.summary_ja: 小児脳腫瘍生存者の放射線誘発脳血管障害検出研究。生殖細胞腫瘍は13例中3例。研究主体は脳腫瘍全般の晩期障害。
pmid-39428610.summary_en: Study of transcranial Doppler feasibility to detect asymptomatic cerebrovascular disease in childhood brain tumor survivors after cranial radiation. GCT patients comprise 3 of 13 total patients. Focus is on late radiation effects in mixed cohort including medulloblastoma and germ cell tumors.

pmid-39482205.summary_ja: 小児卵巣悪性腫瘍の包括的レビュー。画像診断と腫瘍マーカーの役割。温存手術と化学療法。早期診断と治療で90%を超える生存率。
pmid-39482205.summary_en: Comprehensive overview of ovarian cancer in children and adolescents, a rare but important disease with unique diagnostic and management challenges. Emphasizes multidisciplinary care, imaging and tumor markers in diagnosis, fertility-sparing surgical techniques, and adjuvant chemotherapy. Reports excellent prognosis with early diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-39641441.summary_ja: PSMD12遺伝子バリアント保有者のStankiewicz-Isidor症候群の臨床報告。知的障害や顔面頭蓋奇形が特徴で、複数の臨床所見の一つとして卵巣奇形腫が報告されている。
pmid-39641441.summary_en: This study describes Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome caused by PSMD12 variants, presenting with developmental delay, intellectual disability, and craniofacial anomalies. Among various clinical findings in six patients, one had an ovarian teratoma, expanding the known phenotypic spectrum of this rare genetic disorder.

pmid-39859226.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性抗NMDAR脳炎の症例。腫瘍のニューロン細胞にNR2B受容体の発現が認められた。腫瘍切除と一次免疫療法後も難治性であり、NR2Bの関与を示唆している。
pmid-39859226.summary_en: Case of paraneoplastic anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma. Immunohistochemical analysis revealed NR2B receptor expression in teratoma neural cells. Despite first-line immunotherapy and tumor removal, patient required second-line therapy, suggesting complex pathomechanism.

pmid-39958081.summary_ja: 455例の卵巣腫瘍の病理組織学的分析研究。上皮性腫瘍が72%で主流であり、胚細胞腫瘍は19%を占めた。最も一般的な良性胚細胞腫瘍は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(80例、17.6%)であった。卵巣腫瘍の広範な病理学的スペクトラムを提供している。
pmid-39958081.summary_en: A retrospective clinicopathological study of 455 ovarian neoplasms classified tumors by WHO criteria. Surface epithelial tumors predominated (72%), while germ cell tumors comprised 19%, with mature cystic teratoma being the most common benign GCT (80 cases, 17.6%). The study provides broad histopathological spectrum and distribution of ovarian neoplasms.

pmid-39976505.summary_ja: 小児副腎腫瘍34症例38病変の腹腔鏡手術成績。神経芽細胞腫24例、褐色細胞腫11例、奇形腫1例ほか。奇形腫は副腎腫瘍全体の極一部で詳細な記載は限定的である。
pmid-39976505.summary_en: Minimally invasive adrenalectomy outcomes in 34 pediatric patients (38 adrenal masses) from two European centers. Histology: 24 neuroblastomas, 11 pheochromocytomas, 1 teratoma, 1 cyst, 1 myelolipoma. Mean operative time 108 minutes (unilateral), 270 minutes (bilateral). No major complications reported.

pmid-40022466.summary_ja: 抗GAD抗体関連大脳皮質脳炎2症例。患者1に卵巣奇形腫が発見された。両者とも皮質脳炎を呈し免疫療法で改善。
pmid-40022466.summary_en: Two cases of cerebral cortical encephalitis associated with anti-GAD antibodies. Patient 1 was found to have ovarian teratoma. Both patients presented with diffuse cortical encephalitis features and improved after immunotherapy, suggesting anti-GAD antibodies as a novel etiology for CCE.

pmid-40028323.summary_ja: mGluR5およびNMDAR抗体陽性脳炎の症例。異常行動、痙攣、意識障害で発症。卵巣奇形腫が発見されたが免疫療法後も予後が不良で、既報より悪い転帰。
pmid-40028323.summary_en: Case report of young female with mGluR5 and NMDAR antibody encephalitis presenting with abnormal behavior, seizures, and altered consciousness. Bilateral ovarian teratoma discovered during tumor screening. Despite immunotherapy, prognosis was poor, suggesting mGluR5-positive cases may have worse outcomes than previously reported.

pmid-40295548.summary_ja: 脳腫瘍自動分類システムの開発。Germinomaを含む10種類を分類。EfficientNet-B4で99.76%の精度を達成。
pmid-40295548.summary_en: Deep learning-based system for brain tumor classification using CNN, Inception-v4, and EfficientNet-B4. Classified 10 tumor types including germinoma. EfficientNet-B4 achieved 99.76% accuracy on test dataset of 1000 brain MRI images.

pmid-40361492.summary_ja: 小児脳腫瘍の分子病理（低悪性度・高悪性度グリオーマ、胚胎腫瘍、生殖細胞腫瘍）についてのレビュー。ジェルミノーマはKIT受体変異を含む。小児CNS悪性腫瘍の分子機構と臨床的意義をまとめている。
pmid-40361492.summary_en: This review examines molecular pathology of pediatric brain tumors including gliomas, embryonic tumors, and germ cell tumors. Germinomas are noted to carry KIT receptor mutations. Paper synthesizes molecular mechanisms underlying pediatric CNS malignancies with clinical implications.

pmid-40443866.summary_ja: 子宮頸癌合併の67歳閉経後女性における30cm大の右卵巣嚢腫捻転の症例報告。病理では漿液性嚢胞腺腫に成熟奇形腫と卵巣性甲状腺腫が併存し、左側にも類皮嚢腫を認めた。両側付属器摘出後に子宮頸癌への化学放射線療法を実施。奇形腫は偶発的病理所見であり、主題は閉経後女性における巨大卵巣嚢腫捻転の診断・管理である。
pmid-40443866.summary_en: This case report describes a 67-year-old postmenopausal woman with stage IIIB cervical cancer who developed torsion of a giant (30 cm) right ovarian cyst, with pathology revealing serous cystadenoma coexisting with mature teratoma and struma ovarii, plus a separate left dermoid cyst. She underwent bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and subsequent chemoradiation for cervical cancer. The report emphasizes management of giant ovarian cyst torsion in postmenopausal women with coexisting malignancy, with teratoma noted as an incidental pathological finding.

pmid-41361308.summary_ja: 犬の精巣腫瘍186例(セミノーマを含む)とともに、正常精巣10例でペリオスチンとポドプラニンの発現を免疫組織化学的に解析した。正常精巣では陰性で、腫瘍組織では陽性を示し、セミノーマとセルトリ細胞腫瘍で染色性が強かった。発がんへの関与が示唆された。
pmid-41361308.summary_en: This retrospective veterinary study used immunohistochemistry to assess periostin and podoplanin in 186 canine testicular tumours, including Leydig cell tumours, Sertoli cell tumours and seminomas, along with 10 normal testes. Both proteins were absent in normal testes and expressed in neoplastic tissue, with the strongest staining in seminomas and Sertoli cell tumours. PCR confirmed their presence in frozen samples, and Ki67 correlated with expression in seminomas and Sertoli cell tumours. The authors suggest these proteins may contribute to testicular carcinogenesis in dogs and merit further study.

pmid-41522103.summary_ja: 2013〜2022年に上海の1施設で行われた縦隔病変622例の後方視的解析である。超音波ガイド下経皮的コア針生検の診断成功率は94.05％、合併症率は3.86％であった。胚細胞腫瘍は51例含まれたが、主要な3分類の一つにとどまる。嚢胞壊死と40歳未満の若年が診断不成功の有意な因子であった。
pmid-41522103.summary_en: This retrospective study of 622 patients evaluated factors affecting the diagnostic accuracy of ultrasound-guided percutaneous core needle biopsy for mediastinal lesions at a single Shanghai center between 2013 and 2022. Overall diagnostic success was 94.05 percent, with a complication rate of 3.86 percent. Thymic epithelial tumors, lymphoma, and germ cell tumors (51 cases) were the most common diagnoses. Cystic necrosis and younger age under 40 years were significant predictors of unsuccessful diagnosis. The authors suggest that contrast-enhanced ultrasound and rotational core needles may further improve diagnostic accuracy.

pmid-40406278.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫に伴う胎児下部尿路閉塞の症例報告(ケニア)。連続膀胱穿刺により管理した。
pmid-40406278.summary_en: Case report from Kenya of fetal lower urinary tract obstruction associated with sacrococcygeal teratoma, managed by serial vesicocentesis.

pmid-39701870.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍生存者における認知機能を評価した縦断的研究。
pmid-39701870.summary_en: Longitudinal study assessing cognitive function in survivors of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-39377884.summary_ja: 未分化胚細胞腫に伴う傍腫瘍性全身性エリテマトーデスの症例報告と文献レビュー。
pmid-39377884.summary_en: Case report and literature review on paraneoplastic systemic lupus erythematosus associated with dysgerminoma.

pmid-40144601.summary_ja: アスペルギローマと誤診された肺奇形腫の症例報告。
pmid-40144601.summary_en: Case report of a pulmonary teratoma initially misdiagnosed as aspergilloma.

pmid-40143878.summary_ja: 稀な胚細胞腫瘍4例の症例集積。
pmid-40143878.summary_en: A case series highlighting rare germ cell tumor presentations and their clinical management.

pmid-39370035.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍におけるFcγR3A多型がアベルマブへの反応性に及ぼす影響に関する研究。
pmid-39370035.summary_en: Study on the impact of FcγR3A polymorphism on NK cell activation and response to avelumab in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-39054236.summary_ja: 小児原発性性腺外絨毛癌に関する単施設での検討。
pmid-39054236.summary_en: Institutional study on primary extragonadal choriocarcinoma in male pediatric patients.

pmid-38409507.summary_ja: 稀な卵巣絨毛癌の超音波所見に関する症例報告。
pmid-38409507.summary_en: Case report on the ultrasound evaluation of rare ovarian choriocarcinoma.

pmid-39389038.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された巨大胎児頸部腫瘤における3次元モデリングの有用性の検討。
pmid-39389038.summary_en: Evaluation of 3D modeling for prenatal diagnosis and surgical planning of large fetal neck masses.

pmid-39039777.summary_ja: 頭蓋外悪性胚細胞腫瘍に対する外科的アプローチの総説。
pmid-39039777.summary_en: Review of current surgical approaches in the management of extracranial malignant germ cell tumors.

pmid-39708365.summary_ja: 両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の片側性腺癌転化の症例報告。
pmid-39708365.summary_en: A case report of unilateral malignant transformation to adenocarcinoma in bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-39680568.summary_ja: 精漿マイクロRNAによる精巣癌高リスク不妊男性の識別可能性に関する研究。
pmid-39680568.summary_en: Study on the potential of seminal plasma microRNAs to identify infertile men at risk of testicular cancer.

pmid-39522951.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍におけるmiR-100-5p・miR-125b-5p補充の増殖抑制効果に関する研究。
pmid-39522951.summary_en: Research on the effect of miR-100-5p and miR-125b-5p replenishment in malignant germ cell tumors.

pmid-40349199.summary_ja: 化学療法、手術、放射線療法に耐性を示す妊娠性絨毛癌患者2名がペムブロリズマブ免疫療法により長期寛解を達成した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患腫瘍のPD-L1強発現は免疫チェックポイント阻害薬治療の適応となり、化学療法耐性症例における有用な治療選択肢である。
pmid-40349199.summary_en: This case report describes two gestational choriocarcinoma patients with multidrug resistance to multiple lines of chemotherapy, surgery, and radiation therapy who achieved long-term remission after pembrolizumab immunotherapy. Strong PD-L1 expression in gestational trophoblastic disease tumors makes them suitable targets for immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, offering an alternative treatment strategy for chemorefractory cases.

pmid-40254451.summary_ja: Denys-Drash症候群に伴う胎児生殖母細胞腫の3症例が報告される。胎児生殖母細胞腫は高度に悪性の腺性腫瘍の前駆病変であり、性芽細胞腫を含む悪性腫瘍へ進行する重要な前駆病変である。両側性病変や6歳患者の性芽細胞腫（文献で最年少例の一つ）を含む。DDS患者での除睾タイミング決定は複雑である。
pmid-40254451.summary_en: Three cases of Denys-Drash syndrome with gonadoblastoma are presented, emphasizing the malignant potential of this germ cell tumor precursor. Gonadoblastoma serves as a crucial precursor to highly malignant gonadal tumors including dysgerminoma. Notable findings include bilateral involvement in some cases and a dysgerminoma diagnosis in a 6-year-old patient, among the youngest dysgerminoma cases reported. The timing for gonadectomy in DDS patients remains complex.

pmid-39902085.summary_ja: 32歳患者の稀な縦隔胚細胞腫瘍症例。心膜液ではなく腫瘍塊による直接的な心臓構造圧迫により、タンポナーデ様生理が生じた。血行動態不安定性を呈し、血行動態最適化と外科的介入による腫瘍塊除去を必要とした学際的アプローチが実施。
pmid-39902085.summary_en: Case report of mediastinal germ cell tumor causing tamponade-like physiology through direct tumor compression of cardiac structures rather than pericardial fluid. Unusual presentation in 32-year-old patient with hemodynamic instability requiring multidisciplinary approach for hemodynamic optimization and definitive mass removal through surgical intervention.

pmid-39867042.summary_ja: 69歳女性で初期検出10年後に診断された卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来扁平上皮癌の症例。17cm大嚢胞で画像上悪性所見は最小限。組織診で扁平上皮癌原位置と部分的な間質浸潤を認めた。放射線学的安定性にもかかわらず卵巣奇形腫の遅延悪性転化の可能性を強調。
pmid-39867042.summary_en: Case of squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma 10 years after initial detection in 69-year-old woman. Large 17cm cyst with minimal imaging evidence of malignancy. Histopathology revealed squamous cell carcinoma in situ with partial stromal invasion. Highlights delayed malignant transformation potential of mature ovarian teratomas despite radiographic stability.

pmid-39850963.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)における腸内微生物-腸-精巣軸を探索するレビュー論文。若い男性における最も一般的な悪性腫瘍について議論。菌叢異常が免疫応答、炎症、ホルモンバランスに及ぼす影響を論じる。難治性患者における治療有効性改善と化学療法誘発毒性低減のための微生物バイオマーカーと微生物叢修飾戦略を提案する。
pmid-39850963.summary_en: Review article exploring the microbiome-gut-testis axis in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCT), the most common malignancy in young men. Discusses dysbiosis effects on immune response, inflammation, and hormonal imbalances. Proposes microbial biomarkers and microbiota modulation strategies for improving treatment efficacy in refractory patients while reducing chemotherapy-induced toxicity.

pmid-39850104.summary_ja: 奇形腫に伴う眼球振盪筋クローヌス症候群の症例報告である。傍腫瘍症候群として眼球振盪、筋クローヌス、失調、行動異常と睡眠障害を呈した。当該症候群の診断経路と治療方針を論じ、腫瘍摘出が治療の基本であることを示唆。
pmid-39850104.summary_en: Case report of opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome (OMS) as paraneoplastic manifestation in 20-year-old female with teratoma. OMS is rare inflammatory neurological disease presenting with opsoclonus, myoclonus, ataxia, behavioral and sleep disturbances. Literature review demonstrates that tumor removal is the primary effective treatment for OMS syndrome associated with teratoma.

pmid-39839164.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に随伴した抗CASPR2抗体仲介の自己免疫性脳炎の最初の報告症例。腫瘍随伴性辺縁系脳炎として人格・行動変化、精神病、記憶喪失、けいれんなどの神経精神医学的後遺症を呈した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の稀な自己免疫学的発現と、交叉反応腫瘍抗体の重要性を示唆する症例である。
pmid-39839164.summary_en: First reported case of anti-CASPR2 antibody-mediated autoimmune encephalitis associated with testicular mixed germ cell tumor. Paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis presented with neuropsychiatric sequelae including personality and behavioral changes, psychosis, memory loss, and seizures. Case highlights rare autoimmune manifestation of testicular germ cell tumors and importance of cross-reacting tumor antibodies.

pmid-39828346.summary_ja: 35歳男性のセミノーマの症例で、不妊症評価中に直径10mm精巣腫瘍と陰性の腫瘍マーカーで発見された。右精巣萎縮により迅速術中病理診断が実施されセミノーマが確認。根治的精巣摘除術と生殖能力温存のための術中精子採取を施行し、術後テストステロン補充療法を実施した。
pmid-39828346.summary_en: Case of 35-year-old male with seminoma discovered during infertility evaluation with 10mm testicular mass and negative tumor markers. Right testicular atrophy prompted rapid intraoperative pathology diagnosis confirming seminoma. Patient underwent radical orchiectomy with intraoperative sperm extraction for fertility preservation followed by testosterone replacement therapy post-operatively.

pmid-39822958.summary_ja: 陰嚢および精巣病変の磁気共鳴画像法による図解レビュー。特に超音波検査で不確実な所見を呈する場合において、精巣内・精巣外病変および腫瘍性・非腫瘍性病変の鑑別に優れた能力を有する。術前の腫瘍病期分類と臨床判断決定において重要な役割を果たし、外科的評価が必要な陰嚢病変患者のケアにおける放射線科医の重要な役割を強調する。
pmid-39822958.summary_en: Pictorial review of testicular and scrotal pathologies on magnetic resonance imaging with emphasis on differentiating intratesticular versus extratesticular lesions and neoplastic versus non-neoplastic pathologies. Highlights MRI's critical role in preoperative tumor staging and clinical decision-making for patients presenting with scrotal lesions requiring surgical evaluation.

pmid-39816550.summary_ja: 32歳女性の肺血栓塞栓症として疑われた肺動脈絨毛癌の症例。喀血と胸痛を伴う患者。生検により悪性トロフォブラスト細胞を認めた。化学療法の実施でβ-hCGの正常化とイメージング改善が確認され、1年間のフォローアップで寛解達成。
pmid-39816550.summary_en: Case of primary pulmonary artery choriocarcinoma presenting as suspected pulmonary thromboembolism in 32-year-old female with hemoptysis and chest pain. Diagnosed by biopsy revealing malignant trophoblastic cells. Patient achieved complete remission with chemotherapy, confirmed by normalized β-hCG and imaging improvement at 1-year follow-up.

pmid-39802950.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性対感受性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株におけるミトコンドリアゲノム突然変異を同定した研究。耐性細胞は複数のmtgene突然変異と解糖代謝の選好を示し、感受性細胞は酸化的リン酸化を好んだ。知見は耐性TGCT表現型を区別し、代謝標的治療戦略を示唆。
pmid-39802950.summary_en: Study identifying mitochondrial genome mutations in cisplatin-resistant versus cisplatin-sensitive testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Resistant cells showed mutations in multiple mt genes and preferential glycolysis metabolism, while sensitive cells preferred oxidative phosphorylation. Findings provide novel molecular biomarkers distinguishing resistant TGCT phenotype and suggesting metabolic-targeted therapeutic strategies.

pmid-39792418.summary_ja: SEER登録データを用いた精巣混合奇形腫・セミノーマ3296例の予後研究である。進行T分類、遠隔転移、大きな腫瘍サイズ、リンパ管侵襲が不良予後因子。遠隔転移とリンパ節郭清が独立予後因子として抽出された。
pmid-39792418.summary_en: Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results database study of 3,296 patients with testicular mixed teratoma and seminoma (TMTS). Advanced T stage, lymph node and distant metastasis, large tumor size, and lymphovascular invasion predicted inferior overall and cancer-specific survival. Distant metastasis and regional lymph node resection emerged as independent prognostic factors.

pmid-39791094.summary_ja: 出生前に検出された後腹膜未熟奇形腫の新生児症例報告。左上腎部の大きな病変を画像で示す。血清AFP、β-hCG、MIBG シンチグラフィー結果は正常。出生後6日目の開腹術で悪性成分のない未熟奇形腫を確認。良性病理と一致したAFP軌跡で出生後35日目に退院。
pmid-39791094.summary_en: Case report of newborn with prenatal-detected retroperitoneal immature teratoma showing large left suprarenal mass on imaging. Serum AFP, β-hCG, and MIBG scintigraphy results were normal. Exploratory laparotomy on postnatal day 6 confirmed immature teratoma without malignant components. Patient discharged on day 35 with normal AFP trajectory consistent with benign pathology.

pmid-39790702.summary_ja: 大動脈下大静脈塊として発症した転移性セミノーマの症例である。複数の経皮的生検後に開放生検で診断。根治的精巣摘出とBEP化学療法（3コース）で治療。6ヶ月後のPET/CTで腫瘍ほぼ消失、β-hCGとLDH正常化。
pmid-39790702.summary_en: Unusual case of 56-year-old male with disseminated seminoma presenting as aortocaval mass. Diagnosis required open surgical biopsy after unsuccessful percutaneous attempts. Treated with radical orchiectomy and three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin (BEP) chemotherapy. Six-month follow-up PET/CT showed near-complete mass resolution with normalization of β-hCG and lactate dehydrogenase.

pmid-39790263.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍と転移リンパ節腺癌の症例報告である。化学療法後の腫瘍摘出で原発巣に生存細胞なく、転移リンパ節に腺癌を認めた。体細胞型固形悪性腫瘍への転化を示唆する稀な所見。
pmid-39790263.summary_en: Case of 41-year-old male with mediastinal yolk sac tumor presenting with adenocarcinoma in subcarinal lymph node metastases. Computed tomography revealed enlarged subcarinal lymph nodes and anterior mediastinal mass. After chemotherapy, tumor resection showed no viable cells in primary tumor but adenocarcinoma in metastatic nodes, demonstrating somatic-type solid malignancy transformation.

pmid-39768994.summary_ja: 同時性精巣セミノーマと腎細胞癌の症例報告に関する訂正通知。セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍は若年成人男性における最も一般的な悪性腫瘍であり、胚細胞腫瘍文献と高い関連性がある。稀な同時悪性腫瘍の管理について詳述。
pmid-39768994.summary_en: Correction notice to previously published case report of synchronous seminoma of testis and renal cell carcinoma. Seminomatous testicular tumors represent the most common malignancy in young adult males and are highly relevant to germ cell tumor literature. Original case report details the management of rare concurrent malignancies.

pmid-39768777.summary_ja: 精巣病変の多パラメトリック超音波評価の単施設11年研究である。CEUS感度93.8%、特異度85.2%。エラストグラフィで悪性腫瘍の高い組織硬度（77.8%）を検出。診断支援ツールとしての有用性を示唆。
pmid-39768777.summary_en: Eleven-year retrospective study of 342 patients with testicular lesions using multiparametric ultrasound including contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) and elastography. Of 84 surgically explored cases, malignancy confirmed in 48 (57.1%). CEUS demonstrated sensitivity 93.8% and specificity 85.2%. Elastography showed tissue stiffness in 77.8% of malignant versus 41.0% of benign tumors.

pmid-39768652.summary_ja: ストルマオバリ（卵巣奇形腫内の異所性甲状腺組織）由来の分化型甲状腺癌に関する系統的レビュー。甲状腺全摘出と放射性ヨード治療が多用されたが、大多数の患者では放射性核種療法が必須ではなかった。選別的治療の重要性を指摘。
pmid-39768652.summary_en: Systematic review of radioiodine therapy in differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) arising from struma ovarii, an ovarian teratoma containing ectopic thyroid tissue. Analysis of 11 studies showed most cases treated with total thyroidectomy and radioiodine therapy, particularly with distant metastases. However, majority of patients did not require radiometabolic therapy, suggesting selective rather than universal treatment approach.

pmid-39767846.summary_ja: 小児外科腫瘍学における5症例の生体外蛍光共焦点顕微鏡(FCM)の予備的研究。悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍（胎児性癌90%、卵黄嚢腫瘍10%）を含む症例でFCMが確定病理組織学的検査と高度な一致を示し、迅速な腫瘍特性化のための補助診断ツールとしての有望性を示唆。
pmid-39767846.summary_en: Preliminary study of ex vivo fluorescence confocal microscopy (FCM) for real-time pathological diagnosis in five pediatric surgical oncology cases including malignant mixed germ cell tumor (embryonal carcinoma 90%, yolk sac tumor 10%). FCM demonstrated high agreement with definitive histopathology. Shows promise as adjunctive diagnostic tool for rapid tumor characterization and intraoperative surgical guidance.

pmid-39766916.summary_ja: TCGA-TGCTデータベースの134患者における転写産物解析で、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、奇形腫の間での差別的なマイクロRNA(miRNA)発現パターンを同定。7つの上昇シグネチャーと7つの低下シグネチャーは鑑別診断と予後層別化で高い感度/特異度（0.94/1.0、0.97/0.94）を示し、AJCC病期および遠隔転移に関連。
pmid-39766916.summary_en: Transcriptomic analysis of 134 testicular germ cell tumor patients from TCGA database identifying differential miRNA expression patterns among seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, mixed GCT, and teratoma. Seven upregulated and seven downregulated miRNA signatures showed high sensitivity/specificity (0.94/1.0 and 0.97/0.94) for differential diagnosis and were associated with AJCC stage and distant metastasis.

pmid-39763076.summary_ja: 21歳男性の原発性後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍で肺および脳への多発転移を有した症例。導入化学療法(4サイクルBEP)および救援化学療法(4サイクルTIP)で治療。後腹膜リンパ節郭清および肺転移切除後、残存癌細胞なし。
pmid-39763076.summary_en: Case of 21-year-old male with primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumor with multiple lung and brain metastases. Treated with induction (four cycles BEP) and salvage chemotherapy (four cycles TIP). After gradual tumor marker decline, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and lung metastasis resection performed without residual cancer cells. Case demonstrates value of close monitoring post-chemotherapy to guide additional interventions.

pmid-39763075.summary_ja: 28歳男性の17×16×8cm前縦隔胚細胞腫瘍で卵黄嚢成分を有し、右心圧迫と心原性ショックを引き起こした症例。BEP化学療法後、AFPが24,769 ng/mlで上昇。静脈-動脈体外膜酸素化支持が必要。腫瘍縮小手術後、心血管状態は急速に改善。
pmid-39763075.summary_en: Case of 28-year-old male with 17×16×8cm anterior mediastinal germ cell tumor with yolk sac component causing right heart compression and cardiogenic shock. Elevated AFP at 24,769ng/ml. After BEP chemotherapy, cardiac decompensation required veno-arterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation support. Tumor debulking surgery performed; post-operative cardiovascular status improved rapidly. Demonstrates necessity of multidisciplinary collaboration.

pmid-39758576.summary_ja: 先天性エピグナトゥスの症例報告。稀な奇形腫で硬口蓋に由来し、発生率は生児出生35,000～200,000人に1人。超音波検査で31週間に出生前診断、MRIで35週間に確認。EXIT処置により塊摘除と気道開存を確保。
pmid-39758576.summary_en: Case report of congenital epignathus, a rare teratoma originating from hard palate (incidence 1 in 35,000-200,000 live births). Prenatal diagnosis established at 31 weeks by ultrasound and confirmed by MRI at 35 weeks. Extra-uterine intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure successfully performed to excise mass and ensure airway patency. Demonstrates importance of prenatal diagnosis and multidisciplinary delivery management.

pmid-39735155.summary_ja: 本論文は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から悪性転化した卵巣扁平上皮癌の症例と、その組織発生、診断、治療戦略についての文献レビューを提示しています。
pmid-39735155.summary_en: This case report presents squamous cell carcinoma arising from an ovarian dermoid cyst (mature cystic teratoma) in a 62-year-old woman. The paper discusses histogenesis, diagnostic approaches, and treatment strategies for this rare malignant transformation of mature teratoma.

pmid-39734811.summary_ja: この研究は孤立性下垂体茎肥厚を有する小児における増殖性疾患の予測因子を評価した。結果は35％が増殖性疾患を発症し、8例のジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）が同定され、進行性の茎肥厚が診断と関連していた。
pmid-39734811.summary_en: This study evaluates predictive factors for proliferative disease in children with isolated pituitary stalk thickening. Results show 35% developed proliferative disease, with eight germinomas identified, and progressive stalk thickening associated with germinoma diagnosis.

pmid-39734342.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫化学療法後のgrowing teratoma syndromeと腹膜神経膠腫症の稀な併発例。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン化学療法後に妊孕性温存手術施行。悪性成分と良性成分の区別の診断的課題を強調。
pmid-39734342.summary_en: This case report describes the rare coexistence of growing teratoma syndrome and gliomatosis peritonei following chemotherapy for ovarian immature teratoma. The paper emphasizes the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing benign from malignant components in post-treatment residual masses.

pmid-39727674.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の脊椎転移164症例のシステマティックレビュー。シスプラチン系化学療法および外科的介入を検討。全身および局所疾患管理における多学科ケアの重要性を強調している。
pmid-39727674.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates spinal metastases in non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, analyzing 164 cases. It discusses chemotherapy, surgery, and radiotherapy approaches, highlighting the importance of multidisciplinary care for managing both systemic and localized disease.

pmid-39726691.summary_ja: 75歳閉経後女性の破裂卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に腺癌が転化した症例。手術および組織検査で確認。カルボプラチンとパクリタキセル化学療法後、10か月のフォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-39726691.summary_en: This case report presents adenocarcinoma transformation of a ruptured ovarian mature cystic teratoma in a 75-year-old postmenopausal woman. After partial rupture and surgery, histopathology confirmed adenocarcinoma, followed by chemotherapy with good long-term outcomes.

pmid-39723379.summary_ja: 54歳閉経後女性の成熟良性子宮奇形腫の症例報告および文献レビュー。子宮鏡手術により神経組織、骨、軟骨を含む成熟組織の腫瘤を切除。稀な子宮腫瘍の診断基準と治療戦略を提示している。
pmid-39723379.summary_en: This case report and review describe a mature benign uterine teratoma in a 54-year-old postmenopausal woman. Hysteroscopic surgery successfully removed the mass containing various mature tissues. The paper provides diagnostic criteria and treatment strategies for this rare uterine tumor.

pmid-39723313.summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に発生した粘液性嚢胞腺腫の症例報告。化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘍における診断的課題を強調している。
pmid-39723313.summary_en: This case report describes mucinous cystadenoma arising from residual mass in a patient treated for metastatic non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. The unexpected histological finding highlights diagnostic challenges in post-chemotherapy residual masses.

pmid-39723237.summary_ja: 本論文は胚細胞腫瘍の5%未満である後腹膜セミノーマの稀な症例を報告しており、診断と多学科的治療アプローチについて論述しています。
pmid-39723237.summary_en: This case report presents primary retroperitoneal seminoma in a 40-year-old male, a rare germ cell tumor accounting for <5% of such tumors. Discusses diagnostic challenges, surgical management, and BEP chemotherapy, achieving complete response with multidisciplinary care.

pmid-39719389.summary_ja: 本論文は横紋筋肉腫様分化を示す精巣セミノーマの初報告です。この分化パターンは予後不良を示唆し、病理診断の重要性を強調しています。
pmid-39719389.summary_en: This case report describes the first documented case of a testicular seminoma with rhabdoid differentiation, a feature typically associated with poor prognosis in other malignancies. The report emphasizes the need for careful pathological review of this rare finding in seminoma.

pmid-39712678.summary_ja: 本論文は非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌の稀な症例を報告しており、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の0.6%未満です。脳・肺転移を有し、β-HCG上昇を示していました。
pmid-39712678.summary_en: This case report presents non-gestational ovarian choriocarcinoma with elevated β-HCG, an extremely rare germ cell tumor (<0.6% of ovarian GCTs). The patient presented with neurological symptoms from brain and lung metastases, with histopathology confirming non-gestational origin.

pmid-39711015.summary_ja: 本論文は精巣胚細胞腫瘍における代謝酵素の発現を調査し、胎児性癌が高いグリコリーシス活性を示すことを明らかにしており、MCT1阻害薬の治療可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-39711015.summary_en: This study investigates differential expression of metabolic enzymes (GLUT-1, MCT1, MCT4, LDHA, HIF-1α) across testicular germ cell tumor subtypes. Embryonal carcinomas show significantly higher glycolytic activity, suggesting potential therapeutic targets with MCT1 inhibitors.

pmid-39710843.summary_ja: 本症例報告は喀血および肺転移で呈現した精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(60%絨毛癌を伴う混合型NSGCT)の26歳男性を記述する。消化管出血を引き起こす小腸転移は部分的切除が必要であった。BEPおよびTIP化学療法後完全寛解が達成された。
pmid-39710843.summary_en: This case report documents a 26-year-old male with testicular mixed germ cell tumor (mixed NSGCT with 60% choriocarcinoma) presenting with hemoptysis and lung metastases. Small bowel metastasis causing gastrointestinal bleeding required partial resection; complete remission achieved after BEP and TIP chemotherapy.

pmid-39709518.summary_ja: 本症例報告は進行性増殖、音声障害および嚥下困難で呈現した13歳男児の舌下類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)を記述する。病理組織学的確認を伴う口内切除を通じた外科的切除は小児頭頸部奇形腫における診断的および管理的困難を実証する。
pmid-39709518.summary_en: This case report describes a sublingual dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) in a 13-year-old boy presenting with progressive growth, speech disorders, and swallowing difficulties. Surgical excision via intra-oral approach with histopathological confirmation demonstrates diagnostic and management challenges in pediatric head and neck teratomas.

pmid-39707517.summary_ja: 本症例報告は左半胸郭の広範な浸潤を有する2歳女児における巨大縦隔成熟奇形腫の外科的管理を呈示する。ECMO支援による正中胸骨切開を通じた完全切除は成功し、良性病理が確認され優れた回復が得られた。
pmid-39707517.summary_en: This case report presents surgical management of a huge mediastinal mature teratoma in a 2-year-old girl with extensive left hemithorax involvement. Complete resection via median sternotomy with ECMO support was successful, with benign pathology confirmed and excellent recovery.

pmid-39707031.summary_ja: 本スコーピングレビューは15,295の卵巣類皮嚢腫を25の研究全体で体系的に評価し、大きさに基づいて悪性転化リスクを決定する。悪性転化の>25%は<10cmであり、悪性リスク層別化のための10cmO-RADS閾値に異議を唱えている。
pmid-39707031.summary_en: This scoping review systematically evaluates 15,295 ovarian dermoid cysts across 25 studies to determine malignant transformation risk based on size. Finds that >25% of malignant transformations were <10 cm, questioning the 10 cm O-RADS threshold for malignancy risk stratification.

pmid-39706819.summary_ja: 本論文は精巣胚細胞腫瘍のシスプラチン耐性におけるmiR-371-3pの役割を調査し、miR-371阻害によりシスプラチン感受性が有意に向上することを示しています。
pmid-39706819.summary_en: This study investigates miRNA-371a-3p (miR-371) role in cisplatin resistance of testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Using antagomirs to inhibit miR-371 significantly increased cisplatin sensitivity, suggesting potential therapeutic strategy for cisplatin-resistant TGCTs.

pmid-39698441.summary_ja: 子宮奇形腫は稀な腫瘍で、発生起源は不明である。本症例は成熟嚢胞性子宮奇形腫を呈した44歳女性。STR遺伝子型検査は腫瘍と宿主組織の遺伝的類似性を示し、複数座位のヘテロ接合性喪失を認め、未受精卵や胎児組織ではなく、宿主の多能性幹細胞に由来することが示唆された。
pmid-39698441.summary_en: Uterine teratomas are rare extragonadal germ cell tumors with unclear developmental origins. This case presents a 44-year-old woman with mature cystic uterine teratoma. STR genotyping analysis showed genetic similarity between tumor and host tissues with loss of heterozygosity, suggesting origin from host pluripotent stem cells rather than nonfertilized ova or fetal tissue.

pmid-39697937.summary_ja: 精巣がんは若年男性に一般的であり、胚細胞腫瘍が優勢なタイプである。本症例は精巣捻転に続く攻撃的混合型NSGCT(胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫)の40歳男性を記述する。著しく上昇した腫瘍マーカー(AFP19,420ng/mL、β-hCG4,749mIU/mL)および急速な増殖はNSGCT初期介入の重要性を強調する。
pmid-39697937.summary_en: Testicular cancer is common in young men, with germ cell tumors being the predominant type. This case describes a 40-year-old male with aggressive mixed NSGCT (embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma) following testicular torsion. Markedly elevated tumor markers (AFP 19,420 ng/mL, HCG 4,749 mIU/mL) and rapid growth emphasize the importance of early intervention in NSGCTs.

pmid-39697723.summary_ja: セミノーマは精巣胚細胞腫瘍の50%以上を占める。根治的精巣摘除術後の現代的管理は腫瘍病期とリスク階層化に依存する。臨床病期I疾患では80~85%の再発なし率で監視が好まれる。進行例は放射線療法または化学療法、選択例ではRPLND、残存腫瘤の外科的切除が必要である。
pmid-39697723.summary_en: Seminoma comprises over half of all testicular germ cell neoplasms. Contemporary management after radical orchiectomy depends on tumor stage and risk stratification. Surveillance is preferred for early-stage disease with 80-85% relapse-free rates. Advanced cases require radiation or chemotherapy, with discussion of toxicities, RPLND in selected cases, and surgical resection for residual masses.

pmid-39691920.summary_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘤は良性および悪性病変を含む。30人の小児の研究では83.3%が新生物を有し、33.3%が良性、10%が境界領域、40%が悪性であった。悪性腫瘍は無痛性腹部腫瘤で呈し、腫瘍マーカー(AFP、β-hCG 66.67%)が上昇していた。画像上の固形成分は悪性と相関していた。全患者は平均53.5ヶ月のフォローアップで無病生存を達成した。
pmid-39691920.summary_en: Pediatric ovarian masses include both benign and malignant lesions. This study of 30 children found 83.3% had neoplasms: 33.3% benign, 10% borderline, 40% malignant. Malignant tumors presented with painless abdominal masses and had elevated tumor markers (AFP, hCG in 66.67%). Solid components on imaging correlated with malignancy. All patients achieved disease-free survival at mean 53.5-month follow-up.

pmid-39687655.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍は稀で高度に悪性の胚細胞腫瘍で卵巣癌の約1%を占める。本症例は虫垂炎様症状で初期提示した6歳女性で、術中に大きな右卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を認めた。早期診断、多学科的管理、および向上した認識は、この急速に進行する悪性腫瘍の最適な転帰に不可欠である。
pmid-39687655.summary_en: Ovarian yolk sac tumors (endodermal sinus tumors) are rare, highly malignant germ cell tumors accounting for ~1% of ovarian cancers. This case describes a 6-year-old girl initially presenting with appendicitis-like symptoms who was found to have a large right ovarian yolk sac tumor on surgery. Early diagnosis, multidisciplinary management, and heightened awareness are essential for optimal outcomes in this rapidly progressive malignancy.

pmid-39686951.summary_ja: 胃奇形腫は小児における極めて稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である。本症例集積は全て1歳未満の4患者(75%男性)で、典型的画像特性と正常な腫瘍マーカーが診断に有効。手術が主要治療で成熟および未熟奇形腫の等しい分布。長期フォローアップで再発なく、自然史確立のためのより多くの症例報告の必要性を強調。
pmid-39686951.summary_en: Gastric teratomas are extremely rare extragonadal germ cell tumors in children. This case series of four patients, all under 1 year old (75% male), showed typical imaging features and normal tumor markers aiding diagnosis. Surgery was the primary treatment with equal distribution of mature and immature histology. Long-term follow-up showed no recurrence, emphasizing the need for more case reports to establish natural history.

pmid-39685906.summary_ja: 若年成人精巣がんは優れた予後で、早期病変の生存率は99%に近い。AFP、β-hCG、LDHを含む腫瘍マーカーは診断と危険度分類に不可欠だが、感度は約50%で奇形腫を検出できない。miRNA-371a-3p（感度/特異度約90-92%/84-86%）などの新規バイオマーカーはGCT検出と管理の改善の可能性を示す。
pmid-39685906.summary_en: Testicular cancer in young adults has excellent prognosis with survival rates approaching 99% for early disease. Biomarkers including AFP, β-hCG, and LDH are essential for diagnosis and risk stratification but have limited sensitivity (~50%) and cannot detect teratoma. Novel biomarkers including miRNA-371a-3p (sensitivity/specificity ~90-92%/84-86%) show promise for improved detection and management of GCT.

pmid-39684459.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫は著しい炎症浸潤を有する高度に分化した胚細胞腫瘍である。自発的な奇形腫発症マウスを用いて、本研究はT細胞浸潤の2波を示す免疫細胞浸潤を特性化した。中等度および重度の拡大腫瘍はT細胞、単球/マクロファージおよびB細胞による進行性浸潤を示した。T細胞は免疫チェックポイント発現を伴う不活性状態を採用し、腫瘍成長を可能にした。
pmid-39684459.summary_en: Testicular teratomas are highly differentiated germ cell tumors with prominent inflammatory infiltrates. Using spontaneous teratoma-developing mice, this study characterized immune cell infiltration showing two waves of T-cell involvement. Moderate and severely enlarged tumors displayed progressive infiltration with T cells, monocytes/macrophages, and B cells. T cells adopted an inactive state with immune checkpoint expression, allowing tumor growth.

pmid-39682538.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は50%以上の甲状腺組織からなる卵巣成熟奇形腫の稀な亜型である。本システマティックレビューは14症例のハイブリッド画像法(PET/CT、SPECT/CT、PET/MRI)を診断評価のために検討。F-18 FDG PET/CTとI-131 NaI SPECT/CTは各々50%の症例に寄与。ハイブリッド画像法と他の検査法の組み合わせは初期診断とフォローアップに有用であった。
pmid-39682538.summary_en: Malignant struma ovarii (MSO) is a rare variant of ovarian mature teratoma composed of >50% thyroid tissue with malignant potential. This systematic review of 14 cases evaluated hybrid imaging (PET/CT, SPECT/CT, PET/MRI) for diagnostic assessment. F-18 FDG PET/CT and I-131 NaI SPECT/CT each contributed in 50% of cases. Hybrid imaging combined with other modalities proved valuable for initial diagnosis and follow-up.

pmid-39678394.summary_ja: 奇形腫は3つの胚細胞層の誘導体から生じ、成熟奇形腫が最も一般的である。副腎への発生は稀である。本症例は妊娠30週に検出された18日齢女性の左副腎腫瘤で、コンピュータ断層撮影で9×7×5 cm大の明瞭な腫瘤を認めた。外科的切除と病理組織学的検査で多くの分化した組織を含む嚢胞性成熟奇形腫を確認。良好な経過フォローアップで再発なし。
pmid-39678394.summary_en: Teratomas arise from derivatives of three germ cell layers, with mature teratomas being the most common subtype. Adrenal gland location is exceptionally rare. This case describes an 18-day-old girl with left suprarenal mass prenatally detected at 30 weeks gestation. Computed tomography showed a large, well-defined mass surgically resected measuring 9×7×5 cm. Histopathology confirmed mature cystic teratoma with well-differentiated tissues.

pmid-39677122.summary_ja: 高リスク因子を有する非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は治療の課題である。本症例は胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫を含む混合精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する36歳男性で、精巣摘除術後2年で転移性原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍への転化を示した。患者は積極的な化学療法と直列自家幹細胞移植を受け、有望な反応を示した。
pmid-39677122.summary_en: Nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs) with high-risk features pose treatment challenges. This case reports a 36-year-old male with mixed testicular NSGCT (embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma) showing transformation to metastatic primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) two years post-orchiectomy. The patient received aggressive chemotherapy and tandem autologous stem cell transplantation with promising response.

pmid-39675903.summary_ja: 前縦隔類皮嚢腫は稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である。本症例は低造影と増大傾向を示す31×21×25 mm前縦隔腫瘤を有する36歳女性。磁気共鳴画像法は不均質な信号強度を示した。外科的切除と病理組織学的検査で良性類皮嚢腫を確認、術後経過は良好であった。
pmid-39675903.summary_en: Anterior mediastinal dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) is a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. This case describes a 36-year-old woman with a 31×21×25 mm anterior mediastinal mass showing low contrast and expanding tendency. Magnetic resonance imaging showed heterogeneous signal intensity. Surgical resection with diagnostic histopathology confirmed benign dermoid cyst with uneventful postoperative course.

pmid-39672156.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における残存後腹膜腫瘤の病理組織学を予測することは個別化治療を指導する。本研究はラジオミック特性と血清マイクロRNAを組み合わせた統合機械学習モデルを開発し、前向き試験でAUC 0.91(0.80-0.99)を達成した。ウェブベースノモグラムは病理組織学的確率の迅速な計算を可能にする。
pmid-39672156.summary_en: Predicting histopathology of residual retroperitoneal masses in metastatic NSGCTs guides individualized treatment. This study develops an integrated machine learning model combining radiomic features and serum microRNAs, particularly miRNA-371, achieving AUC 0.91 (0.80-0.99) in prospective testing. The web-based nomogram enables swift calculation of histopathological probabilities for personalized treatment.

pmid-39671418.summary_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパルテート脳炎は卵巣奇形腫に関連する傍腫瘍症候群である。本症例は難治性不眠症、行動障害、精神症状を呈する22歳女性で、脳脊髄液検査で抗NMDAR抗体陽性、超音波検査で小さな卵巣内類皮嚢腫を認め、腹腔鏡下卵巣摘除術で成熟奇形腫を確認した。
pmid-39671418.summary_en: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis is a paraneoplastic syndrome predominantly affecting young women with ovarian teratomas. This case presents a 22-year-old female with refractory insomnia, behavioral disturbance, and psychiatric symptoms. CSF testing revealed anti-NMDAR antibodies. Endovaginal ultrasound identified a small atypical intraovarian dermoid cyst. Laparoscopic oophorectomy confirmed mature ovarian teratoma.

pmid-39659389.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫(SO)は50%以上が甲状腺組織である稀な卵巣奇形腫で、悪性転化が起こり得る。腹膜甲状腺腫は現在、卵巣由来高分化濾胞癌(HDFCO)として分類され、低悪性度悪性可能性を示す。本症例は手術、甲状腺摘除術、ヨウ素-131で治療された再発性多焦点HDFCOを有する38歳女性について述べた。遺伝子検査で病原性DICER1変異が明らかになった。
pmid-39659389.summary_en: Struma ovarii (SO), a rare ovarian teratoma with >50% thyroid tissue, can undergo malignant transformation. Peritoneal strumosis, now classified as highly differentiated follicular carcinoma of ovarian origin (HDFCO), shows low-grade malignant potential. This case describes a 38-year-old woman with recurrent multifocal HDFCO treated with surgery, thyroidectomy, and iodine-131. Genetic testing revealed pathogenic DICER1 variant.

pmid-39650871.summary_ja: 胎児縦隔奇形腫は胎児水腫と子宮内胎児死亡を含む重篤な合併症を招く稀な腫瘍。超音波による早期出生前診断は患者カウンセリングと周産期計画に重要。本例は二絨毛膜二羊膜双胎妊娠の27歳女性で一児に縦隔奇形腫、胎児水腫発症し子宮内死亡。
pmid-39650871.summary_en: Fetal mediastinal teratomas are rare tumors that can cause serious complications including fetal hydrops and intrauterine fetal death. Early prenatal diagnosis via ultrasound is critical for counseling and postnatal planning. This case describes a 27-year-old woman in second trimester of dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancy with mediastinal teratoma that developed hydrops and resulted in intrauterine fetal death.

pmid-39649900.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍は若年男性の一般的な固形腫瘍で、精巣または性腺外から発生し得る。絨毛癌は稀で攻撃的なGCT亜型で、主に女性に影響を及ぼすが男性でも発生する。363例患者の集団ベース研究(精巣CC 74.4%、非精巣CC 25.6%)では、精巣CCは白人患者でより一般的で、5年全生存期間と癌特異的生存率が高かった。
pmid-39649900.summary_en: Germ cell tumors, common solid tumors in young men, can originate in testicles or extragonadal sites. Choriocarcinoma, a rare aggressive GCT subtype, primarily affects females but occurs in males. This population-based study of 363 patients (testicular CC 74.4%, nontesticular CC 25.6%) found testicular CC more common in white patients with higher 5-year overall and cancer-specific survival rates.

pmid-39644277.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫(MSO)は卵巣奇形腫に由来する甲状腺がんで発生率は非常に低い。血清サイログロブリン(Tg)は高分化MSO を他の卵巣悪性腫瘍から鑑別するのに役立つ。正常血清Tgを示す54歳女性の本症例は、両側卵巣由来の高分化濾胞甲状腺癌で広範な腹膜転移を伴っていた。甲状腺摘除術とヨウ化物-131治療後、1年間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。
pmid-39644277.summary_en: Malignant struma ovarii (MSO) is thyroid cancer arising from ovarian teratomas with very low incidence. Serum thyroglobulin (Tg) helps differentiate highly differentiated MSO from other ovarian malignancies. This case of 54-year-old woman with normal serum Tg showed highly differentiated follicular thyroid carcinoma of bilateral ovarian origin with extensive peritoneal metastasis. After thyroidectomy and iodine-131 treatment, one-year follow-up showed no recurrence.

pmid-39640164.summary_ja: 精巣がんは若年男性で最も一般的な癌で予後は良好である。セミノーマは優位な胚細胞腫瘍亜型である。本症例は、大型の後腹膜および腹腔内腫瘤(左陰嚢腫瘤11.3cm)を示す転移性セミノーマを有する30歳ヒスパニック系男性を呈示する。患者は化学療法前に腫瘍崩解症候群基準と電解質異常を満たした。
pmid-39640164.summary_en: Testicular cancer is the most common cancer in young men with favorable outcomes. Seminoma is the predominant germ cell tumor subtype. This case presents a 30-year-old Hispanic male with metastatic seminoma showing large retroperitoneal and intraperitoneal masses (11.3 cm left scrotal mass). The patient met tumor lysis syndrome criteria with electrolyte derangements prior to chemotherapy.

pmid-39640112.summary_ja: 絨毛癌は悪性胚細胞腫瘍でβ-hCGを分泌し予後は不良である。リンパ節転移を伴う原発性肺絨毛癌は極めて稀である。32歳女性が外科治療後、エトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド、ビンクリスチンの3サイクル化学療法を受けた。治療後のPET/CTは無病を示した。
pmid-39640112.summary_en: Choriocarcinoma is a malignant germ cell tumor secreting beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG), often associated with poor prognosis. Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma with lymph node metastasis is extremely rare. This case reports a 32-year-old woman treated surgically followed by three cycles of chemotherapy (etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, vincristine). Post-treatment PET/CT showed no evidence of disease.

pmid-39639286.summary_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍患者80例の分析で、YST患者は若年で腫瘍サイズが大きく、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値が著しく上昇し、MRI上主に充実性病変を示していた。信号強度、輝点サイン、肥厚した精索、上昇したAFP値が主要な診断指標であり、診断精度93.6%を達成した。
pmid-39639286.summary_en: 80 pediatric patients with testicular masses were analyzed to identify diagnostic features of yolk sac tumors. YST patients were younger with elevated AFP levels and larger solid tumors on MRI. Signal intensity, bright dot sign, thickened spermatic cord, and elevated AFP were key diagnostic indicators achieving 93.6% diagnostic accuracy.

pmid-39629066.summary_ja: 妊娠中に診断された悪性卵巣甲状腺腫で、11.2cm成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に乳頭状甲状腺癌成分を有する27歳患者。嚢胞切除術、後続する片側卵管卵巣摘出術、放射性ヨウ素治療により、初期診断から3年後も再発なし。
pmid-39629066.summary_en: A 27-year-old developed malignant struma ovarii with papillary thyroid carcinoma component within an 11.2 cm mature cystic teratoma during pregnancy. Managed with cystectomy, later completion salpingo-oophorectomy, and radioactive iodine therapy. Three years post-diagnosis, remains recurrence-free.

pmid-39628734.summary_ja: 出生前に検出された仙尾部奇形腫（II型）を有する新生児が生後4日に腸圧迫および血管盗流による壊死性腸炎を発症した。外科的切除により壊死性腸炎が解決し、仙尾部奇形腫を背景とした壊死性腸炎の初めての報告症例。
pmid-39628734.summary_en: A neonate with antenatally detected sacrococcygeal teratoma (Type II) developed necrotizing enterocolitis on day 4 of life due to bowel compression and vascular steal. Surgical excision resolved the necrotizing enterocolitis. First reported case of NEC in setting of sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-39628710.summary_ja: 80歳女性の卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な症例。著しく上昇したαフェトプロテイン(AFP)値(246,720 ng/mL)、腹水、全身浮腫を呈した。YSTマーカーの免疫組織化学で確認。術後1年で再発なく良好な臨床状態。
pmid-39628710.summary_en: Rare case of ovarian yolk sac tumor in an 80-year-old woman with markedly elevated AFP (246,720 ng/mL), ascites, and anasarca. Immunohistochemistry confirmed YST markers. Literature review identified 11 postmenopausal YST cases; patient remains recurrence-free one year post-surgery without adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-39624212.summary_ja: 右心室単純奇形腫（甲状腺腫）を呈した50歳男性で、胸部絞扼感および労作時呼吸困難を認めた。心エコー図で58mm高エコー像が認められ、外科的切除により完全切除が達成され、病理は良性で2年予後良好。
pmid-39624212.summary_en: A 50-year-old man with right ventricular monodermal teratoma (goiter) presenting with chest tightness and exertional dyspnea. Echocardiography revealed 58 mm hyperechoic mass. Surgical resection achieved complete excision with benign pathology and favorable 2-year prognosis.

pmid-39618704.summary_ja: 25歳経産未婚女性の卵巣純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。YSTは悪性卵巣生殖細胞腫瘍の第2位（20%）。生殖年齢女性に好発し、化学療法感受性により予後良好。
pmid-39618704.summary_en: Case report of pure yolk sac tumor (YST) in a nulliparous 25-year-old woman with history of endometriotic cysts. YSTs are second most common malignant ovarian GCTs (20%), affecting women of reproductive age with favorable prognosis due to chemosensitivity.

pmid-39618635.summary_ja: 31ヶ月女児の卵巣成熟奇形腫（デルモイド嚢胞）偶発発見例。画像では脂肪と石灰化を含む大型嚢胞性腫瘤。手術切除で成熟奇形腫確認、毛髪・ゼラチン状物質・骨を含有。術後経過良好。
pmid-39618635.summary_en: A 31-month-old female with incidental suprapubic mature cystic teratoma/ovarian dermoid cyst. Imaging showed large cystic mass with fat and calcification. Surgical excision confirmed mature teratoma with hair, gelatinous material, and bone components. Uneventful recovery.

pmid-39610000.summary_ja: 下腹痛および月経困難症を有する27歳女性の左卵巣に2つの異なる嚢胞性病変が認められた。病理組織学的検査により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と子宮内膜症の稀な同時共存が確認された。複数の画像診断法を用いた術前診断の重要性が強調される。
pmid-39610000.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman with lower abdominal pain and dysmenorrhea found to have two distinct cystic lesions in left ovary.
