Discusses three etiologies: maternofetal transmission of maternal cancer, gestational choriocarcinoma transmission to fetus, and transfer between monozygotic twins. Summarizes immunological mechanisms enabling cancer cell survival in child and discusses mechanism-based immunotherapy approaches.

pmid-38369557.summary_ja: 1,672名の転移性非セミノーマ精巣がん患者(2010-2018年)におけるIGCCCG予後グループのSEER人口ベース検証研究。改善された5年全生存期間(全生存率)率を確認:94%(良好予後)、87%(中間予後)、65%(不良予後)。IGCCCG更新コンソーシアムの生存改善が優秀なセンターを超えて広い機関に適用されることを検証。
pmid-38369557.summary_en: Population-based SEER validation study of IGCCCG prognosis groups in 1,672 metastatic non-seminoma testicular cancer patients (2010-2018). Confirmed improved 5-year OS rates: 94% (good prognosis), 87% (intermediate), 65% (poor). Validated that IGCCCG Update Consortium survival improvements apply beyond centers of excellence to broader institutions.

pmid-38362619.summary_ja: 非定型精子細胞腫瘍の分子解析。異なる2つの進展経路が明らかに：RAS/MAPK経路変異またはTP53変異/12p領域増加を伴う倍数性シフト。可塑性概念が全GCT型に適用され、内在的異質性と進展中の重大な形質転換能を示唆。
pmid-38362619.summary_en: Analysis of atypical spermatocytic tumors (type III GCT) revealing molecular heterogeneity with two distinct progression pathways: RAS/MAPK pathway mutations or ploidy shifts with TP53 mutations and/or chromosome 12p gain. Demonstrates plasticity concept applies to all GCT types, illustrating inherent heterogeneity and capability for significant transformation during progression.

pmid-38361551.summary_ja: 胎児心膜奇形腫の症例報告。妊娠28週で非常に大きな奇形腫が診断され、出生前の侵襲的処置と早産分娩のリスク・ベネフィットについて学際的専門家によるコンサルテーションが実施された。計画的な早産帝王切開により乳児を出生させた後、直後に心肺バイパス下での外科的切除を施行し、良好な転帰を得た。
pmid-38361551.summary_en: Case report of very large fetal pericardial teratoma diagnosed at 28 weeks gestation. Multidisciplinary consultation led to planned preterm cesarean delivery for immediate postnatal surgical management. Infant underwent cardiopulmonary bypass and surgical resection with successful outcome.

pmid-38360519.summary_ja: 355名の病期IIセミノーマ患者における一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を実施した8つの研究のシステマティックレビューおよびメタ解析。全体的再発率14%(領内4%)、4%≥病期III合併症。順行性射精が98%のケースで保存。臨床病期IIセミノーマに対する一次RLPNDは安全で有効な治療選択肢、優れた治癒率。
pmid-38360519.summary_en: Systematic review and meta-analysis of 8 studies with 355 stage II seminoma patients undergoing primary RPLND. Overall recurrence rate 14% (infield 4%) with 4% ≥grade III complications. Antegrade ejaculation preserved in 98% of cases. Concluded primary RPLND is safe and effective treatment option for CS II seminomatous GCT with excellent cure rates.

pmid-38359725.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍130患者（成人90例、小児40例）を含む87試験のメタ分析。年齢別全生存率差なし（23vs25ヶ月）。3・5年全生存率は成人34.4%・22.9%、小児41.5%・41.5%。腹側位置、化学療法、手術と良好な転帰の関連。早期診断と治療の重要性を強調。
pmid-38359725.summary_en: Meta-analysis of 87 studies including 130 mediastinal yolk sac tumor patients (90 adults, 40 pediatrics). No significant age-related OS difference (23 vs 25 months). 3- and 5-year OS 34.4% and 22.9% (adults) vs 41.5% and 41.5% (pediatrics). Anterior tumor location, chemotherapy receipt, and surgery associated with better outcomes. Emphasizes importance of early diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-38359698.summary_ja: 化学療法後の胸部転移を有する非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者37名の後方視的研究。化学療法と根治的手術を組み合わせた多面的治療で10年全生存期間(全生存率)94.3%を達成。一次腫瘍型として奇形腫(40.5%)および胎児性癌(40.5%)が優位、転移で奇形腫が主流(70.3%)。
pmid-38359698.summary_en: Retrospective study of 37 non-seminomatous testicular cancer patients with intrathoracic metastasis after chemotherapy. Multimodality treatment combining chemotherapy with radical surgery achieved 10-year OS of 94.3% with no surgical mortality. Teratoma (40.5%) and embryonal carcinoma (40.5%) were prevalent primary histologies; 70.3% teratoma in metastases.

pmid-38358219.summary_ja: 58歳閉経後女性における乳房侵襲的微乳頭癌および偶然発見された良性ブレンナー腫瘍を伴う両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。稀な同時性発症として非ヘレディタリー同時性腫瘍として文書化。正確な診断における免疫組織化学の重要性を強調。
pmid-38358219.summary_en: Case report of 58-year-old postmenopausal woman with invasive micropapillary carcinoma of breast and incidentally discovered bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratomas with benign Brenner tumor. Unusual synchronous presentation documented as non-hereditary synchronous tumors. Emphasizes importance of immunohistochemistry in accurate diagnosis.

pmid-38357086.summary_ja: テッカ・ルテイン嚢胞を伴う完全子宮胎盤奇胎の少女症例。異常出血、上昇したhCG、過度嘔吐、子癇前症で呈示。テッカ・ルテイン嚢胞は子宮胎盤奇胎に関連する良性ホルモン応答性嚢胞。保存的管理と妊娠後の自然消退を論述。
pmid-38357086.summary_en: Case report of complete hydatidiform mole complicated by theca lutein cysts in teenager. Presented with abnormal bleeding, elevated hCG, hyperemesis, and pregnancy-induced hypertension. Theca lutein cysts are benign, hormonally responsive cysts associated with molar pregnancy and gestational trophoblastic disease. Discusses conservative management and spontaneous resolution after pregnancy.

pmid-38355204.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を有する若い女性における抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。脳脊髄液IgG抗体検査によりNMDARのGluNR1およびGluNR2サブユニットに対する陽性を確認。奇形腫の外科的切除と複数の免疫調整療法で治療。
pmid-38355204.summary_en: Case report of anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis in young woman with ovarian teratoma. Diagnosis confirmed by cerebrospinal fluid IgG antibodies against GluNR1 and GluNR2 subunits of NMDAR. Treated with surgical resection of teratoma and multiple immunomodulatory therapies for management of paraneoplastic encephalitis.

pmid-38350264.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌患者80名が化学療法なしで腫瘍除去後のhCG正常化を達成した多施設国際後方視的研究。中央値50ヶ月のフォローアップ中に再発なし。FIGO/WHOリスクスコア≤6が93.7%のケースに該当。基準センターの厳選された患者における補助化学療法なしの期待的管理が安全なアプローチである可能性が示唆。
pmid-38350264.summary_en: Multicenter international retrospective study of 80 gestational choriocarcinoma patients achieving hCG normalization after tumor removal without chemotherapy. Zero recurrence during median 50-month follow-up. FIGO/WHO risk score ≤6 in 93.7% of cases. Suggests expectant management without adjuvant chemotherapy may be safe approach for highly selected gestational choriocarcinoma patients in reference centers.

pmid-38349599.summary_ja: 治療されていない停留精巣を有する思春期後患者23名(2010-2019年)の後方視的研究。1名(4%)がセミノーマを有していた。停留精巣における正常な精子形成は観察されず、19名が精細管の欠損、3名が成熟停止を示した。片側停留精巣を有する思春期後男性における精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスク低下を目的とした精巣摘除術を支持。
pmid-38349599.summary_en: Retrospective study of 23 post-pubertal patients with untreated cryptorchidism undergoing orchiectomy (2010-2019). One patient (4%) had seminoma. No normal spermatogenesis observed in any undescended testis; 19 patients lacked seminiferous tubules, 3 showed maturation arrest. Results support orchiectomy in post-pubertal males with unilateral cryptorchidism to reduce GCT risk.

pmid-38348386.summary_ja: 停留精巣手術既往と重度乏精子症を有する38歳男性の左精巣における2つの異なる腫瘍(頭側セミノーマ、尾側に胚細胞新生物)の症例報告。精巣摘除術後、腫瘍マーカーとホルモンレベルは正常化し、精液パラメータが改善。片側精巣における2つの腫瘍タイプの報告は初例。
pmid-38348386.summary_en: Case report of 38-year-old male with two distinct tumors in left testis: cranial seminoma with syncytiotrophoblastic cells and caudal mass showing germ cell neoplasia in situ. Patient had severe oligozoospermia with cryptorchidism surgery history. Underwent orchiectomy with tumor marker normalization and improved semen parameters postoperatively. First reported case of two tumor types in unilateral testis.

pmid-38347538.summary_ja: 40歳の46,XX性分化疾患患者の前立腺における卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫成分を有する混合型胚細胞腫瘍の稀な症例。全ゲノムシーケンシングにより高い体細胞変異負荷と46,XX（SRY+）核型が確認された。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇、ゴナドトロピン上昇、テストステロン低値を呈示。
pmid-38347538.summary_en: Rare case of mixed germ cell tumor (with yolk sac tumor and teratoma components) in the prostate of a 40-year-old with 46,XX disorder of sexual development. Whole-genome sequencing revealed high somatic mutational load and confirmed karyotype as 46,XX (SRY+). Patient presented with elevated AFP, elevated gonadotropins, and low testosterone levels. Case advances understanding of genetic and phenotypic profiles.

pmid-38344694.summary_ja: ステージIIIc非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の初回化学療法から4日以内に化学療法誘発性β-hCG上昇により傍腫瘍性甲状腺機能亢進症が生じた21歳男性の初の報告症例。
pmid-38344694.summary_en: First documented case of paraneoplastic hyperthyroidism triggered by chemotherapy-induced surge in β-hCG in a 21-year-old with stage IIIc non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Thyrotoxicosis developed within 4 days of initial chemotherapy. This first peer-reviewed report expands understanding of hCG-mediated endocrine complications in GCT patients during cancer treatment.

pmid-38341381.summary_ja: 卵巣由来腹膜偽粘液腫患者に対する減量手術と腹腔内温熱化学療法のフランス後方視的研究。15例中60%が卵巣奇形腫内またはその由来の粘液性新生物。卵巣奇形腫由来の腹膜偽粘液腫は5年・10年で100%の無病生存率。
pmid-38341381.summary_en: Retrospective French study of cytoreductive surgery and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy for ovarian pseudomyxoma peritonei (OPMP). Among 15 patients, 60% involved mucinous neoplasms arising within or from ovarian teratomas. OPMP of teratomatous origin showed superior disease-free survival (100% at 5 and 10 years).

pmid-38341184.summary_ja: 出生前診断された新生児先天性口腔奇形腫症例。妊娠30週の胎児MRI所見により多職種チーム管理を決定し、予定帝王切開後に速やかに腫瘍摘出術を実施。気道開存を確保し良好な予後を得た。
pmid-38341184.summary_en: Case report of prenatally diagnosed congenital oral teratoma in a neonate. Fetal MRI at 30 weeks guided multidisciplinary management, leading to planned cesarean delivery at 38 weeks. Immediate postnatal surgery ensured airway patency and successful tumor resection with no postoperative complications at three-month follow-up.

pmid-38337762.summary_ja: 未熟仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビュー。成熟型と比較して急速な増殖、高い再発リスク、高い死亡率を特徴とし、出生前診断と適切な治療管理の重要性を強調。
pmid-38337762.summary_en: Case report and extensive literature review of immature sacrococcygeal teratoma. This histological form exhibits rapid growth, higher recurrence risk, and increased mortality compared to mature types. Paper emphasizes importance of prenatal diagnosis and optimal therapeutic management for improving prognosis in immature teratoma cases.

pmid-38337479.summary_ja: 家族性Swyer症候群患者における性腺芽腫症例報告。家族性症例での悪性腫瘍リスクが散発例より高い（66.6% vs 15-45%）ことを示唆。予防的性腺摘出術と長期ホルモン補充療法が推奨される。
pmid-38337479.summary_en: Case report of gonadoblastoma in two siblings with familial Swyer syndrome (46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis). Literature review suggests familial cases have significantly higher gonadal tumor risk (66.6%) compared to sporadic cases (15-45%). Preventive gonadectomy and long-term hormonal replacement therapy are recommended management.

pmid-38332632.summary_ja: 49歳女性の腎門に発生した稀な混合型胚細胞腫瘍（カルチノイドを伴う奇形腫）。組織学的に単純嚢胞内の奇形腫様組織から発生するカルチノイドを確認。この部位での性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の稀有性を強調。
pmid-38332632.summary_en: Rare case report of mixed germ cell tumor (carcinoid with teratoma) arising from renal hilum in 49-year-old woman. Histological examination revealed carcinoid tumor arising from teratomatous tissue within simple cyst. Tumor appeared independent of kidney parenchyma, highlighting rarity of extragonadal GCTs at this site.

pmid-38331649.summary_ja: 頸部奇形腫の外科治療後に発生した後頭環椎回旋脱臼症例。4歳女児が頸部手術後に軸椎亜脱臼を発症。段階的治療により症状改善。小児頭頸部外科における稀有な術後合併症。
pmid-38331649.summary_en: Case report of atlantoaxial rotatory subluxation (AARS) as complication following neck surgery in 4-year-old girl with cervical teratoma. Patient received one month of conservative management with serial treatment, resulting in symptom improvement and resolution of neck tilt. Raises awareness of rare postoperative complication.

pmid-38330895.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者45例の監視コンピュータ断層撮影における撮影プロトコル比較。分割ボーラス単一相プロトコルは放射線量を21.5%削減しながら診断許容性を維持。精巣がんフォローアップにおける放射線安全性を改善。
pmid-38330895.summary_en: Retrospective comparison of CT imaging protocols (split-bolus single-phase vs. single-bolus split-phase) in 45 testicular cancer patients undergoing surveillance imaging. Split-bolus protocol achieved 21.5% radiation dose reduction while maintaining diagnostic acceptability. Demonstrates improved radiation safety in testicular cancer follow-up.

pmid-38322677.summary_ja: 結腸腺癌が卵巣成熟奇形腫に転移した腫瘍間転移症例。41歳女性患者に大腸がんの多臓器転移と左卵巣奇形腫を認定。手術で奇形腫内の転移腺癌を確認。大腸がん患者における奇形腫切除の重要性を示唆。
pmid-38322677.summary_en: Case of tumor-to-tumor metastasis from sigmoid colon adenocarcinoma to mature ovarian teratoma in 41-year-old woman. Patient presented with metastatic colorectal cancer involving liver, lungs, bone, and ovarian teratoma. Exploratory surgery revealed metastatic adenocarcinoma in mature ovarian teratoma. Highlights importance of teratoma resection to prevent secondary metastasis.

pmid-38321801.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患を示唆する胎盤前置として初期管理された3回の帝王切開既往を有する42歳ナイジェリア人女性。帝王切開子宮全摘術で病理組織学的に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断。
pmid-38321801.summary_en: Case report of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) in 42-year-old Nigerian woman with three prior cesarean sections, initially managed conservatively for suspected placenta previa. Cesarean hysterectomy revealed PSTT on histopathology. Case highlights diagnostic challenges of gestational trophoblastic disease mimicking placental abnormalities.

pmid-38321336.summary_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者（異時性24例、同時性16例）40例の多施設後方視的分析。両側疾患は若い年齢で発症し、より進行した疾患を呈し、β-hCG上昇とリンパ節転移がより頻繁。同時性両側胚細胞腫瘍は異時性例より疾患特異的死亡率が18%高かった。
pmid-38321336.summary_en: Multicenter retrospective analysis of 40 patients with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors (24 metachronous, 16 synchronous) compared to unilateral cases. Bilateral disease presented at younger age with more advanced disease, elevated β-hCG levels, and higher nodal involvement. Synchronous bilateral GCT showed 18% higher disease-specific mortality.

pmid-38317250.summary_ja: 18歳未満のがん患者9例における卵巣刺激と卵母細胞凍結保存の症例集積。うち2例は胚細胞腫瘍患者（ディスジャーミノーマ1例、胚細胞腫瘍1例）で、化学療法前の思春期胚細胞腫瘍患者における生殖能温存の実行可能性を示した。
pmid-38317250.summary_en: Case series of controlled ovarian stimulation with oocyte cryopreservation in 9 adolescent cancer patients (<18 years) prior to cancer treatment. Two patients had germ cell tumors (one dysgerminoma, one GCT). Study demonstrates feasibility of fertility preservation in adolescents with GCT before chemotherapy and provides outcome data on oocyte recovery and cryopreservation.

pmid-38316790.summary_ja: 異数性胚盤葉幹細胞由来の奇形腫は、追加変異なしに高いステムネスと不全なプロテアソーム活性を示し転移能を有する。プロテアソーム活性化剤とER応力阻害薬が転移抑制に有効。
pmid-38316790.summary_en: Teratomas derived from aneuploid murine embryonic stem cells demonstrate metastatic capacity through high stemness populations with deficient proteasome activity and ER stress, independent of additional genetic mutations. Proteasome activators and ER stress inhibitors effectively suppress aneuploid teratoma metastasis.

pmid-38314227.summary_ja: 65歳男性の肺原発絨毛癌でβ-hCG産生があり、両側乳房女性化を呈した稀な症例。両側肺病変と脳転移を認め、化学免疫療法で部分奏効を得た。
pmid-38314227.summary_en: Rare case of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma with β-hCG secretion in a 65-year-old male presenting with bilateral gynecomastia. Bilateral pulmonary lesions and brain metastasis identified; treated with carboplatin-etoposide-pembrolizumab achieving partial response.

pmid-38308982.summary_ja: 結核高流行地域で初期に結核と誤診された小児の縦隔奇形腫2症例。開胸手術により成熟奇形腫が確認され、良好な長期転帰が得られ再発はなかった。
pmid-38308982.summary_en: Case series of two children with mediastinal teratoma initially misdiagnosed as tuberculosis in a TB-endemic setting. Both underwent thoracotomy; histopathology confirmed mature teratoma with satisfactory long-term outcomes and no recurrence.

pmid-38306872.summary_ja: 20歳女性の後腹膜成熟奇形腫例。腹痛で発症、画像診断とCA19.9高値で診断。完全切除で治癒、再発なし。
pmid-38306872.summary_en: Case report of 20-year-old female with primary retroperitoneal mature teratoma presenting with abdominal pain. Imaging and elevated CA19.9 were diagnostic; complete surgical resection was curative with excellent postoperative outcome.

pmid-38305430.summary_ja: 臨床病期II精巣がん管理における最近の進歩。選択的セミノーマ患者への一次後腹膜リンパ節郭清と補助化学療法の減量。新規バイオマーカーマイクロRNA-371a-3pによるリスク層別化。
pmid-38305430.summary_en: Review of clinical stage II testicular cancer management advances, including retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for seminoma and adjuvant chemotherapy de-escalation. Discusses novel biomarkers like microRNA-371a-3p for risk stratification and personalized approaches.

pmid-38304749.summary_ja: 小児の両側精巣腫瘍（左卵黄嚢腫、右成熟奇形腫）同時性例。左精巣摘除と右精巣温存手術。後腹膜再発に化学療法実施。
pmid-38304749.summary_en: Pediatric case of synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors with different histologies: left yolk sac tumor and right mature teratoma. Left orchiectomy with right testis-sparing surgery performed; retroperitoneal recurrence treated successfully with chemotherapy.

pmid-38301309.summary_ja: 妊娠性栄養膜疾患の分子プロファイリング。高PD-L1陽性率を確認。治療標的としてWee1、PARP、MEK阻害薬を特定。
pmid-38301309.summary_en: Molecular profiling of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia including choriocarcinoma, epithelioid trophoblastic tumors (ETT), and placental site trophoblastic tumors (PSTT). Identifies high PD-L1 positivity and potential therapeutic targets including Wee1, PARP, and MEK inhibitors.

pmid-38301040.summary_ja: バイオインフォマティクス解析でMAELが精巣胚細胞腫瘍を含む複数のがんで高発現。ccRCCではMAEL発現が予後と関連。低MAEL発現は免疫療法の治療効果利益を示唆。患者選別の有用性。
pmid-38301040.summary_en: Bioinformatic analysis of MAEL expression across human cancers including testicular germ cell tumors. MAEL expression correlates with treatment response and prognosis in various malignancies.

pmid-38300402.summary_ja: 泌尿器悪性腫瘍の総説。精巣セミノーマのリンパ節郭清に関するSEMS試験を含む。
pmid-38300402.summary_en: Review of paradigm-shifting studies in urologic oncology including SEMS trial on retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular seminoma with limited nodal metastases.

pmid-38296531.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞株を用いた研究。バルプロ酸がHIF-1α経由でCGB発現を上昇させ、glucose摂取を抑制。妊娠性栄養膜疾患関連。
pmid-38296531.summary_en: Study using BeWo choriocarcinoma cells investigating valproic acid effects on placental function. VPA elevated chorionic gonadotropin β (CGB) expression and suppressed glucose uptake through HIF-1α-mediated mechanisms relevant to gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-38296184.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍におけるgrowing teratoma syndromの分子およびエピジェネティック特性評価。循環バイオマーカーの特定、成長率による分層、化学療法後に持続する潜在的な非セミノーマ性成分の示唆。
pmid-38296184.summary_en: Molecular and epigenetic characterization of growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) in germ cell tumors. Identifies circulating biomarkers, stratifies GTS by growth rate, and suggests occult non-seminomatous components may persist after chemotherapy in teratomas.

pmid-38293778.summary_ja: CS IIA marker陰性NSGCT患者の監視療法研究。RPLND病理：70%生存癌、26%良性リンパ節、6%奇形腫。
pmid-38293778.summary_en: Prospective study of clinical stage IIA marker-negative NSGCTs managed with surveillance and CT imaging. RPLND histopathology showed 70% viable cancer, 26% benign nodes, and 6% teratoma, identifying patients with occult disease.

pmid-38292806.summary_ja: 腹部腫瘤の奇形腫対胎児内胎児の鑑別診断。画像診断で胎児内胎児と確認。腫瘍マーカー正常。
pmid-38292806.summary_en: Pediatric case of abdominal mass initially suspected to be teratoma or fetus-in-fetu. Imaging confirmed fetus-in-fetu diagnosis; normal serum tumor markers. Illustrates diagnostic differentiation between these entities.

pmid-38292777.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫からの粘液性腺癌例。多房性嚢胞性腫瘍で異常なFDG-PET集積。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化を議論。
pmid-38292777.summary_en: Case report of mucinous carcinoma arising from ovarian mature teratoma showing atypical cytokeratin expression profile. Imaging demonstrates multilocular cystic mass with abnormal FDG-PET uptake. Discusses malignant transformation risk in mature teratomas.

pmid-38285100.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者64例を対象とした後方視的研究で、MLH1およびREV-7の免疫組織化学的発現を予測的マーカーとして検討。REV-7陽性は化学療法耐性と不良予後と強く関連していた。
pmid-38285100.summary_en: Retrospective study of 64 testicular germ cell tumor patients examining immunohistochemical expression of MLH1 and REV-7 as predictive markers. REV-7 positivity strongly associated with chemoresistance and poor prognosis.

pmid-38282269.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫が扁平上皮癌に悪性化した症例。66歳閉経後女性。免疫組織化学によりCK5/6およびP63陽性を確認。高齢および腫瘍の大きさが危険因子。ステージIA患者の予後は良好で化学療法不要。
pmid-38282269.summary_en: Case report of squamous cell carcinoma transformation in mature cystic ovarian teratoma in a 66-year-old woman. Discusses risk factors including advanced age and large tumor size, histopathology findings, and favorable prognosis in stage IA disease without requiring chemotherapy.

pmid-38281986.summary_ja: 70歳女性の縦隔に発見された大型腫瘤が70年以上無症状で経過。右後側方開胸術により完全切除。組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認。血清hCGおよびAFP値は正常。予後は良好。
pmid-38281986.summary_en: Case report of a 70-year-old woman with a voluminous mediastinal mass found incidentally on chest X-ray, remaining asymptomatic for over 70 years. Surgical resection via posterolateral thoracotomy confirmed histologically as mature cystic teratoma with excellent prognosis.

pmid-38281826.summary_ja: 17歳以下女児の卵巣腫瘍の包括的レビュー。疫学、危険因子、臨床症状、診断、鑑別診断、治療選択肢を網羅。妊孕性温存手術と小児・思春期患者への心理的影響に注目。
pmid-38281826.summary_en: Comprehensive review of ovarian tumors in females under 17 years, covering epidemiology, risk factors, clinical presentations, diagnosis, differential diagnosis, and treatment options. Emphasizes fertility-sparing surgery and psychological impacts on children and adolescents.

pmid-38281479.summary_ja: 絨毛膜疾患の稀な亜型3つ（ETT、PSTT、APSN）の診断的特徴、臨床特性、標準治療、妊孕性温存療法を網羅。中間トロホブラストから発生する稀な腫瘍の新しい知見を提供。
pmid-38281479.summary_en: Comprehensive review of epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), and atypical placental site nodule (APSN). Covers diagnostic features, clinical characteristics, standard treatment, and fertility-sparing management strategies.

pmid-38279983.summary_ja: 睾丸がん自己検診に関する一般男性と医師の知識・認識を調査。医師の8.9%しかスクリーニング検査を実施せず、男性の77.5%は自己検診方法を認識しておらず、知識ギャップが明白。
pmid-38279983.summary_en: Survey assessing knowledge and perceptions of testicular self-examination for cancer detection among general practitioners and males aged 15-45. Found significant gaps: only 8.9% of GPs perform screening, and 77.5% of males don't know how to perform self-examination.

pmid-38278693.summary_ja: 病期II精巣がんに対する開腹的対ロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の傾向スコアマッチング分析。ロボット支援アプローチは短い入院期間と低い出血量を示しながら、腫瘍学的有効性を維持していた。神経温存を含む標準的管理アルゴリズムへの組み入れが推奨される。
pmid-38278693.summary_en: Propensity-matched analysis comparing open versus robotic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage II testicular cancer. Robotic approach showed shorter hospital stay and lower blood loss without compromising oncologic efficacy.

pmid-38265529.summary_ja: 日本の病院ベースがん登録における1,767人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ)の分析。病期II-III患者は低容量施設での5年生存率が著明に低く、治療集約化により転帰が改善することを示す。
pmid-38265529.summary_en: Hospital-based cancer registry analysis of 1,767 testicular GCT patients in Japan (seminoma and non-seminoma). Shows stage II-III patients at low-volume institutions had significantly worse 5-year survival, indicating treatment centralization improves outcomes.

pmid-38259260.summary_ja: 新生児仙尾部奇形腫（fetiform type）の症例。腸など完全に形成された構造を含む。組織学的に成熟型であり悪性所見なし。術後14ヶ月で良好に経過。AFP値3.5 μg/L。
pmid-38259260.summary_en: Case report of a 5-day-old neonate with type II sacrococcygeal fetiform teratoma (homunculus). Surgical excision revealed fully formed bowel, bones, and well-defined structures. Histopathology confirmed mature features without malignancy.

pmid-38250128.summary_ja: 小児期から診断された20歳女性患者の仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。緩徐成長する骨盤外腫瘤として、圧迫症状で発症。外科的切除により成熟奇形腫が確認された。悪性転化の危険性は1-2%である。
pmid-38250128.summary_en: Case report of a 20-year-old female with sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed since childhood, presenting as a slowly growing extraperitoneal mass causing compression. Surgical resection confirmed mature teratoma; 1-2% malignant transformation risk noted.

pmid-38244349.summary_ja: オランダ(1989-2019)で診断された12,528人の精巣がん(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ)の分析。青年・若年成人における発生率は著明に増加。放射線療法使用は78%から5%に低下。積極的監視を受けた患者が大半で、20年生存率は90%を超える。
pmid-38244349.summary_en: Analysis of 12,528 testicular cancers (seminoma and non-seminoma) diagnosed in Netherlands (1989-2019) among adolescents and young adults. Incidence increased significantly; radiotherapy declined from 78% to 5%; most received active surveillance with >90% 20-year survival.

pmid-38236556.summary_ja: 39歳男性の転移性精巣セミノーマから生じた頭蓋底軟骨肉腫(体細胞型悪性腫瘍)の症例報告。上横隔膜リンパ節腫大を伴う。胚細胞腫瘍の稀だが重大な合併症で、分子特性が異なり予後不良である。
pmid-38236556.summary_en: Case report of skull base chondrosarcoma arising as somatic-type malignancy from metastatic testicular seminoma in a 39-year-old man with supradiaphragmatic lymphadenopathy. Demonstrates rare but serious complication of GCT with divergent molecular features and poor prognosis.

pmid-38229735.summary_ja: 84歳男性における片側精巣に発生した同時性Leydig細胞腫瘍（性索間質腫瘍）と精子細胞腫瘍（胚細胞腫瘍）の初報告症例。異なる起源を有する両腫瘍が同一精巣で同時に発生することは極めて稀であり、臨床的に重要な症例である。
pmid-38229735.summary_en: First reported case of synchronous Leydig cell tumor (sex cord-stromal tumor) and spermatocytic tumor (germ cell tumor) in a single testis of an 84-year-old male. These tumors rarely coexist due to their different origins.

pmid-38225551.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者においてシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けている際の1年間の監視下身体活動プログラムが癌関連疲労に及ぼす影響を評価する第III相試験プロトコル。腸内微生物叢とその代謝産物の潜在的仲介効果を調査する。
pmid-38225551.summary_en: Phase-III trial protocol evaluating one-year supervised physical activity program's impact on cancer-related fatigue in metastatic testicular germ cell tumor patients receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy, investigating gut microbiota as potential mediator.

pmid-38223403.summary_ja: 精巣純粋絨毛膜癌は生殖細胞腫瘍の中で最も稀で高い悪性度を有し、早期血行性転移を特徴とする。65歳患者の化学療法への部分奏効例を報告し、免疫療法の可能性について検討している。
pmid-38223403.summary_en: Rare case of pure testicular choriocarcinoma in 65-year-old with partial chemotherapy response. Reviews characteristics and therapeutic principles; discusses emerging targeted and immune-based therapies showing potential for maintenance therapy in advanced GCTs.

pmid-38222311.summary_ja: 眼球欠損、四肢奇形を伴う12週齢胎児の前額部成熟嚢胞性奇形腫症例。病理学的診断により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確認され、胎児眼球欠損と四肢奇形症候群と診断された。
pmid-38222311.summary_en: Case report of 12-week fetus with anophthalmia, left upper limb absence, and infratemporal teratoma measuring 4mm. Pathological investigation confirmed mature cystic teratoma. Diagnosed with fetal microphthalmia with limb anomalies.

pmid-38218332.summary_ja: 16,412件の医療記録を49年間調査した結果、300の過誤腫、2つの異所性腫瘍、1つの奇形腫類似病変が口腔領域から確認された。オドントーマが最も一般的で、異所性腫瘍と奇形腫類似病変は稀である。
pmid-38218332.summary_en: 49-year cross-sectional study of 16,412 records found 300 hamartomas (1.83%), 2 choristomas (0.01%), and 1 teratoid lesion (0.01%) in oral cavity. Odontoma most frequent hamartoma. Low occurrence of choristomatous and teratoid lesions.

pmid-38216273.summary_ja: 短い反復配列遺伝子型検査により3例の妊娠関連絨毛膜癌の起源を同定した研究。症例1では10年前の臨床的に診断されなかった完全胞状奇胎が根拠と判明。起源の特定はFIGOスコアシステム決定に重要。
pmid-38216273.summary_en: Short tandem repeat genotyping identified origins of gestational choriocarcinoma in three cases. Case 1: choriocarcinoma originated from previously undiagnosed complete hydatidiform mole 10 years prior. Cases 2-3 confirmed clinically presumed origins.

pmid-38215755.summary_ja: HLA遺伝子欠損と免疫回避因子発現により改変された多能性幹細胞は、T細胞、NK細胞、補体によるバリアを回避できる。これらの改変細胞は免疫能マウスにおいて永続性奇形腫を形成し、細胞治療研究に有用である。
pmid-38215755.summary_en: Genetic ablation of HLA and immune evasion factor expression in pluripotent stem cells led to persistent teratoma formation in wild-type mice despite immune barriers. Demonstrates T cell, NK cell, and complement evasion necessary for preventing immunological rejection.

pmid-38212900.summary_ja: 絨毛膜癌JEG-3細胞におけるLGALS16遺伝子発現はcAMP依存的にp38 MAPKおよびEPAC経路を介して制御される。LGALS16は栄養膜分化と合胞体栄養膜マーカー発現に必要であり、胎盤細胞生物学に重要。
pmid-38212900.summary_en: LGALS16 gene expression in choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells is regulated by cAMP-dependent signaling through p38 MAPK and EPAC pathways. LGALS16 required for trophoblast differentiation and syncytiotrophoblast marker expression.

pmid-38205041.summary_ja: 24歳男性に認められた前立腺原発性胎児性癌の初報告症例。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の極めてまれな形態。患者はシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けたが、外科的切除を拒否したため、疾患再発および短期間での死亡に至った。タイムリーな外科的切除の重要性が示唆される。
pmid-38205041.summary_en: First reported case of primary embryonal carcinoma of prostate in 24-year-old male. Represents extragonadal germ cell tumor. Patient received cisplatin-based chemotherapy but refused surgical treatment, resulting in disease relapse and death.

pmid-38199869.summary_ja: デンマークでの化学療法後後腹膜限定切除術を受けた219人の非セミノーマ精巣がん患者の後方視的集団ベース研究（1990-2015年）。主要罹患率は低く（5%）、10年再発率は5.9%、10年全生存期間は96%。
pmid-38199869.summary_en: Retrospective population-based study of 219 nonseminoma testicular cancer patients undergoing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lumpectomy in Denmark (1990-2015). Low major morbidity (5%), 10-year recurrence rate 5.9%, 10-year overall survival 96%.

pmid-38173625.summary_ja: 炭素コーティングセレン二水化物粒子と近赤外線レーザーの組み合わせは絨毛膜癌細胞の増殖を阻害し、活性酸素産生を通じてアポトーシスを誘導する。低侵襲的光熱療法の新規治療選択肢として有望である。
pmid-38173625.summary_en: Carbon-coated selenium nanoparticles combined with near-infrared laser inhibit choriocarcinoma cell proliferation, induce apoptosis through ROS production. Shows potential for minimally invasive photothermal therapy as alternative to conventional chemotherapy.

pmid-38172961.summary_ja: 13歳患者の卵巣非妊娠性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)で肺への遠隔転移と軽微な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫成分を伴う症例。遠隔転移を伴う初めての症例であり、非妊娠性PSTTが胚細胞由来の別個の腫瘍として認識されるべきことを支持する。
pmid-38172961.summary_en: Case of 13-year-old with non-gestational ovarian placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) with lung metastasis and minor mature cystic teratoma component. First case with distant metastasis; supports recognition of non-gestational PSTT as distinct germ cell-derived neoplasm.

pmid-38171036.summary_ja: セミノーマ33例およびディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）31例における免疫組織化学研究。高いCD45RO浸潤；変動するPD-1/PD-L1発現は抗腫瘍反応有効性と免疫療法の可能性に影響。
pmid-38171036.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of CD45RO memory T cell marker and PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitory molecules in 33 seminoma and 31 dysgerminoma patients. High CD45RO infiltration; variable PD-1/PD-L1 expression impacts anti-tumor response effectiveness and immunotherapy potential.

pmid-38169660.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のMRI見かけ拡散係数ヒストグラムパラメータを用いた良性と悪性の鑑別研究。最大ADCが最も良好な鑑別能を示し、悪性腫瘍の診断における有用な画像バイオマーカーである。
pmid-38169660.summary_en: Retrospective study of apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) histogram parameters for MRI-based differentiation of 45 testicular tumors (7 benign, 39 malignant including seminoma). Maximum ADC performed best in distinguishing benign from malignant lesions.

pmid-38166849.summary_ja: 高レベルβ-hCGを伴う妊娠関連絨毛膜癌の心腔内転移症例。右房、三尖弁、右室に転移巣が位置した。多くの化学療法サイクル後も限定的な奏効で、心腔内腫瘤切除後も急速に再発し、姑息的治療に至った。
pmid-38166849.summary_en: Case of gestational choriocarcinoma with intracardiac metastasis in right atrium, tricuspid valve, and right ventricle (high β-hCG 199,060 mIU/mL). Limited response to eight chemotherapy cycles; intracardiac masses resected but rapidly recurred.

pmid-38165518.summary_ja: 28歳男性の両側精巣前思春期型奇形腫の症例報告。3層由来の成熟組織からなる大型の固液性腫瘤。FISH検査でi(12p)欠失がなく、長期経過にもかかわらず転移なしで良性と確認。
pmid-38165518.summary_en: Case report of bilateral testicular prepubertal-type teratomas in a 28-year-old man. Large solid-cystic masses comprised mature tissues from all three germ layers. FISH confirmed absence of i(12p), establishing benign prepubertal-type teratoma diagnosis despite lifelong tumor burden.

pmid-38161647.summary_ja: 体部型悪性転化を伴う極めて巨大な縦隔未熟奇形腫の一塊切除症例。未熟奇形腫の悪性転化は化学療法感受性に乏しく、完全外科的切除がより良い生存をもたらす可能性がある。
pmid-38161647.summary_en: Case report of en bloc resection of a giant mediastinal immature teratoma with somatic-type malignant transformation. Demonstrates importance of complete surgical resection given poor chemotherapy sensitivity in immature teratomas with malignant somatic components.

pmid-38158258.summary_ja: 乳幼児仙尾部奇形腫355例の多施設研究。再発は11.8%、機能障害後遺症23.4%（肛門直腸、尿路、下肢運動機能障害）。リスク因子は未熟組織学、不完全切除、手術合併症。
pmid-38158258.summary_en: Multi-institutional study of 355 infantile sacrococcygeal teratomas. Recurrence occurred in 11.8%, with 23.4% experiencing functional sequelae (anorectal, urinary, motor dysfunction). Risk factors included immature histology, incomplete resection, and surgical complications.

pmid-38146022.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における悪性転化と良性例のMRI所見比較。悪性転化は固形成分が大きく脂肪成分が低く、有茎性結節、不規則な辺縁、腹膜播種を認めた。
pmid-38146022.summary_en: MRI study comparing imaging features of malignant transformation in mature cystic ovarian teratomas versus benign cases. Malignant transformation showed larger solid components, lower fat occupancy, sessile solid nodules, irregular margins, and peritoneal dissemination.

pmid-38141134.summary_ja: 肉腫様卵黄嚢腫瘍のGATA3およびFOXA2発現の免疫組織化学研究。FOXA2欠失とGATA3焦点発現が認められ、成熟表現型維持遺伝子の下制御が肉腫様化に関与することを示唆。
pmid-38141134.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of GATA3 and FOXA2 expression in sarcomatoid yolk sac tumor postpubertal-type from testicular germ cell tumors. Sarcomatoid YSTpt showed absence of FOXA2 and focal GATA3, suggesting downregulation underlying sarcomatoid transformation.

pmid-38135144.summary_ja: 女性生殖器官の内分泌腫瘍のレビュー。ステロイド産生腫瘍、神経内分泌新生物、ならびに卵巣胚細胞腫瘍および奇形腫に生じる甲状腺濾胞細胞増殖を含む。遺伝的易罹患症候群と転移性悪性腫瘍との鑑別を述べた。
pmid-38135144.summary_en: Review of endocrine tumors in female reproductive tract. Includes steroidogenic tumors, neuroendocrine neoplasms, and thyroid follicular proliferations arising in ovarian germ cell tumors and teratomas. Discusses genetic predisposition syndromes and distinction from metastatic disease.

pmid-38123189.summary_ja: 妊娠性と非妊娠性絨毛癌の包括的なレビュー。非妊娠性絨毛癌は胚細胞由来または体細胞悪性腫瘍に関連。疫学、病因、臨床呈示、管理の相違を検討し、正確な診断と予後のための鑑別を強調。
pmid-38123189.summary_en: Comprehensive review distinguishing gestational from non-gestational choriocarcinoma. Non-gestational choriocarcinoma can be germ cell-derived or associated with somatic malignancy. Discusses epidemiology, pathogenesis, clinical presentation, and management differences for accurate diagnosis and prognosis.

pmid-38099663.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫手術における経膣NOTES対経臍LESS術の前向きランダム化試験。経膣NOTESは手術時間が短く、術後疼痛が少なく、穿孔率が低かった。
pmid-38099663.summary_en: Randomized controlled trial comparing transvaginal NOTES versus transumbilical LESS for ovarian mature cystic teratoma cystectomy in 81 women. Transvaginal NOTES achieved shorter operative time (68 vs 85 minutes), lower postoperative pain, and lower intraoperative rupture rate.

pmid-38097681.summary_ja: 極度に上昇したhCG(>1000 U/L)を示す精原細胞腫患者7人の分子および病理学的特性化。高hCGにもかかわらず純粋精原細胞腫と診断、絨毛膜絨毛下層が認められた。
pmid-38097681.summary_en: Molecular and histopathological characterization of seven seminoma patients with extraordinarily elevated serum hCG levels (>1000 U/L). Despite high hCG, tumors were diagnosed as pure seminoma with syncytiotrophoblast subpopulations by immunohistochemistry and gene expression analysis.

pmid-38092129.summary_ja: 精巣胚胎がん細胞のエストロゲン受容体効果のプロテオミクス解析。17β-エストラジオール処理により遊走、浸潤、アンカリッジ非依存的増殖が増加。
pmid-38092129.summary_en: Proteomic analysis of estrogen receptor effects on human testicular embryonal carcinoma NT2/D1 cells. Treatment with 17β-estradiol and ERβ-selective agonist increased migration, invasion, and anchorage-independent growth, identifying potential therapeutic targets for non-seminomatous management.

pmid-38085711.summary_ja: 2施設研究：非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清中に補助臓器切除を受けた242例。切除臓器の22%のみが実行可能な腫瘍を含有し、39%は奇形腫、39%は壊死のみであった。補助手術の腫瘍学的利益は限定的。
pmid-38085711.summary_en: Two-center study of 242 patients undergoing adjunctive organ resection during postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Only 22% of resected organs contained viable tumor; 39% had teratoma and 39% had only necrosis.

pmid-38074424.summary_ja: 急性腎盂腎炎の精査中に偶然発見された精巣精原細胞腫の症例報告。精巣がんの非典型的な発症と包括的臨床検査の重要性を示唆。
pmid-38074424.summary_en: Case report of testicular seminoma discovered incidentally during evaluation for acute pyelonephritis in a young man. Demonstrates unusual clinical presentation of testicular cancer and importance of thorough physical examination.

pmid-38072736.summary_ja: 435例の精巣がん患者を対象とした機関内研究で、停留精巣治療の有無による腫瘍病理を比較した。停留精巣治療経験のある患者では良性病理がより一般的（15.2% vs 4.7%）であり、混合型胚細胞腫瘍はより低率（18.2% vs 37.3%）であった。
pmid-38072736.summary_en: Institutional study of 435 testicular cancer patients comparing tumor pathology in those with versus without prior cryptorchidism treatment. Benign pathology was significantly more common in previously treated patients (15.2% vs 4.7%); mixed GCT less common (18.2% vs 37.3%).

pmid-38070256.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫切除を受けた36例小児の研究：27例成熟奇形腫、8例未熟奇形腫、1例悪性胚細胞腫瘍。病理組織学的亜型別の監視戦略と再発率を検討し、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)監視慣行の変動を評価した。
pmid-38070256.summary_en: Retrospective study of 36 children undergoing sacrococcygeal teratoma resection: 27 mature, 8 immature, and 1 malignant GCT. Examines surveillance strategies, recurrence rates, and varying AFP monitoring practices across histopathologic subtypes.

pmid-38069497.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者の精子ミトコンドリア機能障害を検討。ATP産生、酸化的リン酸化、酸化ストレスが精巣がん関連の精子異常の基礎となるメカニズムであることを探索した。胚細胞腫瘍患者における精子品質低下の可能性を検討。
pmid-38069497.summary_en: Review examining mitochondrial dysfunction in sperm of testicular cancer patients. Explores ATP production, oxidative phosphorylation, and oxidative stress as mechanisms underlying cancer-associated sperm abnormalities in GCT patients.

pmid-38052712.summary_ja: 55例の精巣がん生存者の前向きコホート研究。シスプラチン併用化学療法後のテロメア長変化と心血管危険因子（代謝症候群、男性ホルモン低下）を治療後5年間のフォローアップで検討した。
pmid-38052712.summary_en: Prospective cohort of 55 testicular cancer survivors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Examines telomere length changes and cardiovascular risk factors including metabolic syndrome and hypogonadism over 5-year follow-up.

pmid-38040333.summary_ja: hCG産生腫瘍55例のモレキュラージェノタイピング有用性を検討。81.2%が妊娠関連（絨毛疾患）。分子検査は診断・治療決定・生存予測を導いた。
pmid-38040333.summary_en: Retrospective study from French Reference Center analyzing molecular genotyping of 55 hCG-producing tumors: 81.2% gestational origin, 12.7% non-gestational. Molecular testing guided diagnosis, treatment decisions, and predicted overall survival in GTD.

pmid-38038079.summary_ja: 48歳男性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍(主にセミノーマ)で後腹膜リンパ節転移を有する症例。持続ミュラー管症候群とtransverse testicular ectopiaに関連し、化学療法および手術で治療された。成人のPMDSとTTEは通常、術中に発見され、ectopic精巣の悪性腫瘍に関連している。
pmid-38038079.summary_en: Case report of a 48-year-old with mixed germ cell tumor (predominantly seminoma) of testis with retroperitoneal nodal metastases. Associated with persistent Müllerian duct syndrome and transverse testicular ectopia, treated with chemotherapy and surgery.

pmid-38019392.summary_ja: 妊娠関連絨毛癌の初の原位置マウスモデル開発。JEG-3細胞を妊娠中マウス胎盤に注射。腫瘍進行と肝脾肺への転移を観察し臨床像を再現。
pmid-38019392.summary_en: First orthotopic animal model of gestational choriocarcinoma using JEG-3 luciferase cells injected into gravid mouse placenta. Studies tumor development and rapid metastasis to liver, spleen, lung, and peritoneum mimicking clinical disease progression.

pmid-38010229.summary_ja: 再発転移性GCT患者43例へのHDC-ASCT実施の回顧的研究。単回および二重移植の治療成績を検討。無病生存率と全生存率を評価。
pmid-38010229.summary_en: Retrospective review of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation for 43 relapsed metastatic GCT patients in Alberta. Examines disease-free and overall survival outcomes comparing second/third-line therapy and single vs. tandem transplants.

pmid-38009817.summary_ja: 828人の日本人男性における精巣微小石灰化と関連する因子を調査した後方視的コホート研究。胚細胞腫瘍の既往が有意に関連(16.7% vs 1.3%)し、血清クレアチニン値の上昇(1.04 vs 0.91 mg/dL)も関連していた。
pmid-38009817.summary_en: Retrospective cohort of 828 Japanese men examining testicular microlithiasis and associated factors. History of germ cell tumor was significantly associated (16.7% vs 1.3% controls), along with elevated serum creatinine levels.

pmid-37993989.summary_ja: 絨毛癌46例の内膜形態を検討。分泌期・非分泌期パターンと臨床病理学的特性を分析。化学療法の影響とhCG受容体発現を評価。
pmid-37993989.summary_en: Histopathologic study of endometrial morphology in 46 choriocarcinoma specimens. Describes diverse secretory and proliferative changes, analyzes relationship to treatment and hCG effects, distinguishing choriocarcinoma from hydatidiform mole endometrium.

pmid-37991604.summary_ja: 28の精巣胚細胞腫瘍症例におけるSerpinB9発現の免疫組織学的研究。非セミノーマにおけるSerpinB9アップレギュレーション、CD8陽性腫瘍浸潤細胞との逆相関を示し、精巣腫瘍における免疫逃避メカニズムを示唆している。
pmid-37991604.summary_en: Immunohistologic study of SerpinB9 expression in 28 testicular GCT cases. Demonstrates SerpinB9 upregulation in non-seminomas with inverse correlation to CD8-positive tumor-infiltrating cells, suggesting immune escape mechanism in testicular tumors.

pmid-37981168.summary_ja: 診断遅延が腫瘍サイズ、病期、および腫瘍マーカーに及ぼす影響を検討した71名の精巣がん患者(セミノーマ39名、非セミノーマ32名)の後方視的研究。遅延は病理学的サイズ増加、αフェトプロテイン/LDH上昇、およびN病期上昇と正の相関を示した。
pmid-37981168.summary_en: Retrospective study of 71 testicular cancer patients (39 seminoma, 32 non-seminoma) examining effect of diagnostic delay on tumor size, stage, and markers. Delay positively correlated with increased pathological size, elevated AFP/LDH, and higher N stage.

pmid-37980196.summary_ja: 小児16例の肝臓転移切除を検討、GCT6例を含む。成熟奇形腫のみが検出された例も認めた。転移GCTの治療成績と安全性を評価。
pmid-37980196.summary_en: Observational study of 16 pediatric patients undergoing hepatic metastasectomy, including 6 with germ cell tumors. Some GCT metastases revealed only mature teratoma, guiding adjuvant therapy. Examines safety and utility of hepatectomy for metastatic pediatric malignancies.

pmid-37977155.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛膜上皮腫瘍スペクトラムの子宮内病変についてのレビュー。診断特性、分子生物学的ツール、予後因子を論述。子宮内絨毛膜癌は無症状から広範転移まで多様な臨床像を示す。
pmid-37977155.summary_en: Reviews intraplacental gestational choriocarcinoma and chorangiocarcinoma, rare gestational trophoblastic neoplasms affecting mothers and fetuses. Discusses diagnostic features, molecular tools, and prognostic factors. IPCs range from asymptomatic to widely metastatic with potential for metastasis even with microscopic disease.

pmid-37967143.summary_ja: 258名の病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者において中央値18ヶ月フォローアップされた再発検出のための血清マイクロRNA-371a-3pを評価。M371テストは100%感度および96.3%特異度を達成し、従来診断法を著しく上回る。しかし、術後M371レベルは将来の再発を予測しなかった。
pmid-37967143.summary_en: Evaluates serum microRNA-371a-3p for detecting relapses in 258 stage I testicular GCT patients followed for median 18 months. M371 test achieved 100% sensitivity and 96.3% specificity, significantly outperforming conventional diagnostics. However, postoperative M371 levels did not predict future relapse.

pmid-37966940.summary_ja: シスプラチン化学療法後の精巣がん生存者358名における長期健康害を調査。神経障害性疼痛、糖尿病、肥満、疲労が生活の質に有意な悪影響を与えることを明らかにした。
pmid-37966940.summary_en: Examines long-term health impacts in 358 testicular cancer survivors receiving cisplatin (median 10.7 years post-treatment). Identifies chemotherapy-induced neuropathic pain, diabetes, obesity, and fatigue as significant factors reducing global mental and physical health outcomes.

pmid-37964485.summary_ja: 低リスクGTN 115名の20年間レジストリ研究。メトトレキサート単剤療法で77%が完全奏効。WHO危険度スコア5-6と高いhCGは治療抵抗性と関連。再発率4.3%。
pmid-37964485.summary_en: 20-year registry study of 115 low-risk GTN patients with 100% survival. 77% achieved complete response to methotrexate monotherapy. WHO risk scores 5-6 and elevated pretreatment hCG associated with higher treatment resistance. Relapse rate 4.3% with successful salvage therapy.

pmid-37956765.summary_ja: 思春期周辺における稀な転移性精巣混合型非精上皮胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。通常と異なる低年齢での広範転移を示す。
pmid-37956765.summary_en: Case report of rare peripubertal mixed nonseminomatous testicular GCT with widespread metastases at presentation, classified as poor-risk disease. Highlights unusual presentation in younger patients compared to typical postpubertal presentation.

pmid-37951820.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者1016例の患者個別データ分析における新しいリスク層別化の提案。腫瘍サイズ、精巣網浸潤、リンパ管侵襲に基づく3段階リスク群で、5年累積再発確率は低リスク8%、中間リスク20%、高リスク44%を報告。
pmid-37951820.summary_en: Individual patient data analysis of 1016 stage I seminoma patients identifying prognostic factors. Proposes new risk stratification based on tumor size, rete testis invasion, and lymphovascular invasion with 5-year relapse probabilities: low-risk 8%, intermediate 20%, high-risk 44%.

pmid-37947355.summary_ja: 思春期・若年成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍管理に関する総説。治療成績の50年間での劇的改善（25%から80%）と化学療法耐性疾患への対応を論述。
pmid-37947355.summary_en: Comprehensive review of testicular GCT management in adolescents and young adults. Discusses treatment advances improving cure rates from 25% in 1970s to nearly 80%. Addresses toxicity, relapsed disease, and platinum-refractory disease management.

pmid-37946365.summary_ja: 思春期前精巣の成熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の稀な混合型の18ヶ月男児症例。AFP上昇。思春期前での成熟奇形腫との組み合わせは報告例が極めて少ない。
pmid-37946365.summary_en: Case of 18-month-old with prepubertal testicular mixed teratoma and yolk sac tumor. Elevated serum AFP (2200 ng/ml). Rare combination of mature teratoma with yolk sac tumor in prepubertal testis with only one prior published case.

pmid-37944943.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫と後腹膜リンパ節転移に対するロボット支援後腹膜リンパ節郭清の日本初報告。小侵襲手術の安全性と有効性を示す。
pmid-37944943.summary_en: First reported robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (R-RPLND) in Japan for 32-year-old with testicular teratoma and para-aortic lymph node metastases. Demonstrates R-RPLND as safe and effective minimally invasive alternative to open RPLND.

pmid-37932157.summary_ja: マーカー陰性ステージIIA/Bの精巣胚細胞腫瘍24名でマイクロRNA-371a-3pによるリンパ節転移予測を検証。感度90.9%、陽性適中率100%。不必要な治療回避に有用。
pmid-37932157.summary_en: Evaluates miR-371a-3p predictive accuracy in 24 marker-negative stage IIA/B TGCT patients for identifying lymph node metastases. miR371 showed 90.9% sensitivity and 100% positive predictive value, useful for avoiding unnecessary treatment and associated toxicity.

pmid-37921603.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍30名の導入化学療法に関する研究。内胚葉腺腫瘍と顆粒層膜細胞腫が大多数。42ヶ月で67%が無病生存。18名で生殖温存手術施行。
pmid-37921603.summary_en: Retrospective study of 30 malignant ovarian GCT patients receiving neoadjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy. Majority had endodermal sinus tumor or dysgerminoma. 67% disease-free survivors at median 42-month follow-up with successful fertility-sparing surgery in 18 patients.

pmid-37916954.summary_ja: 泌尿生殖器悪性腫瘍の液体生検バイオマーカーとしてのマイクロRNAのレビュー。精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではmiR-371a-3pが臨床応用の最終段階に。
pmid-37916954.summary_en: Reviews microRNAs as liquid biopsy biomarkers for genitourinary malignancies. Testicular GCTs have specific target miR-371a-3p with high sensitivity and specificity, approaching clinical implementation. Other GU cancers remain in earlier biomarker development stages.

pmid-37915108.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍80名の化学療法267サイクル分析。高年齢、腎機能低下、第1サイクルが発熱性好中球減少症の独立予測因子として同定。
pmid-37915108.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 80 advanced GCT patients (267 chemotherapy cycles). Identified older age (≥36 years), renal dysfunction (CCr <70), and first chemotherapy cycle as independent predictive factors for febrile neutropenia (15% incidence).

pmid-37898912.summary_ja: 小児頭外胚細胞腫瘍20名でマイクロRNA9種を検討。miR367、371、372、373、302dの臨床的有用性を確認。miR375-3pは悪性GCTと奇形腫で発現なし。
pmid-37898912.summary_en: Study of 20 pediatric extracranial GCT cases examining 9 microRNAs (clusters 302/367, 371-373, 375). miR 367, 371, 372, 373, 302d showed high clinical utility for malignant GCT diagnosis and monitoring. miR 375-3p not expressed in malignant GCT or teratomas.

pmid-37891379.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞のシスプラチン高感受性の分子メカニズムを検証。p53誘導、プロアポトーティックタンパク上昇、ミトコンドリア・Fas/FasL経路の二重活性化を確認。
pmid-37891379.summary_en: Investigates cisplatin-induced apoptotic pathways in testicular GCT cells versus cisplatin-resistant bladder cancer cells. Shows p53 induction, elevated pro-apoptotic Bax/Noxa, and dual mitochondrial and Fas/FasL-mediated apoptotic activation explaining unique cisplatin sensitivity of testicular GCT.

pmid-37882676.summary_ja: 化学療法耐性GTN患者4名に対するイピリムマブとニボルマブ併用試験。奏効率75%。6ヶ月無増悪生存率75%。毒性は忍容範囲内。
pmid-37882676.summary_en: Phase II trial of dual checkpoint blockade (ipilimumab plus nivolumab) in 4 patients with chemotherapy-refractory GTN. Overall response rate 75% (1 CR, 2 PRs) in gestational choriocarcinoma and malignant GTN. 6-month PFS 75% with manageable toxicity profile.

pmid-37881832.summary_ja: KLHL11抗体関連腫瘍随伴神経症候群の症例報告。精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関連する新規バイオマーカー。小脳・脳幹病変と早期治療の重要性を論述。
pmid-37881832.summary_en: Case report of KLHL11 antibody-associated paraneoplastic encephalomyelitis. KLHL11 recently identified as biomarker for paraneoplastic neurological syndromes in GCT patients, particularly seminoma. Reviews cerebellar and brainstem involvement with emphasis on early diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-37872125.summary_ja: 南アフリカの小児成熟奇形腫60名と未熟奇形腫40名の転帰研究（1990-2015）。5年生存率85.4%、ステージに大きく依存。完全切除率高し。標準化ガイドラインの必要性提唱。
pmid-37872125.summary_en: Retrospective study of 60 mature and 40 immature extracranial teratoma cases in South African children (1990-2015). 5-year overall survival 85.4%, highly stage-dependent (Stage I 96.9%, Stage III 38.9%). High complete resection rates. Highlights need for standardized treatment guidelines.

pmid-37867292.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者12例の一次化学療法におけるエトポシド-アプレピタント相互作用の薬物動態研究。臨床的に関連性のある相互作用なく、両薬剤とも安全に併用でき、AUCおよび最大血漿濃度に影響なし。
pmid-37867292.summary_en: Pharmacokinetic study evaluating etoposide-aprepitant interaction in 12 testicular cancer patients receiving first-line chemotherapy. No clinically relevant interaction was found; AUC and Cmax values were similar with and without aprepitant, confirming safe co-administration of both drugs.

pmid-37857140.summary_ja: 病期I精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者5,743例の大規模後方視的研究。監視および化学療法率は時間とともに増加、RPLND使用は低下。RPLND群は化学療法群と比較してがん特異的死亡率が有意に低い。
pmid-37857140.summary_en: Large retrospective study of 5,743 stage I testicular mixed germ cell tumor patients comparing surveillance versus active treatment (chemotherapy/RPLND). Surveillance and chemotherapy rates increased over time while RPLND use declined. RPLND showed significantly lower cancer-specific mortality than chemotherapy in active treatment cohorts.

pmid-37853749.summary_ja: 56例の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者（男性60%、女性40%）の臨床病理学的分析。一般的な部位：縦隔（45%）、仙骨尾骨部（18%）、後腹膜（14%）。組織型は成熟奇形腫（34%）、混合型胚細胞腫瘍（27%）、セミノーマ/ジャーミノーマ（12%）を含む。白金製剤併用化学療法は有意に予後を改善した。
pmid-37853749.summary_en: Clinical-pathological analysis of 56 extragonadal germ cell tumor cases (60% male, 40% female). Common sites: mediastinum (45%), sacrococcyx (18%), retroperitoneum (14%). Histologies included mature teratoma (34%), mixed germ cell tumor (27%), seminoma/germinoma (12%), yolk sac tumor (11%). Platinum-based chemotherapy significantly improved outcomes.

pmid-37839891.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の腹腔内播種後、26年後にダグラス窩に再発した症例。腹腔内溢出物の完全な除去の重要性を強調し、再発予防の手術技法を提唱。
pmid-37839891.summary_en: Case report of benign mature teratoma recurrence in pouch of Douglas 26 years after bilateral ovarian cystectomy. Recurrent lesion was firmly adherent to peritoneal tissues despite normal ovaries. Emphasizes importance of intraoperative irrigation to remove spilled tumor contents and prevent extragonadal recurrence.

pmid-37827125.summary_ja: 妊娠絨毛膜疾患の国家・国際的管理における連携のレビュー。専門センター設置と組織的管理体制が良好な予後に直結。国際的協力が治療プロトコル最適化と生存率向上に不可欠。
pmid-37827125.summary_en: Review of national and international collaboration in gestational trophoblastic disease management. Established expert GTD centers and organized national systems achieve superior disease outcomes. Emphasizes importance of international collaboration for optimizing management protocols and improving survival rates across income levels.

pmid-37820296.summary_ja: 思春期および若年成人における胚細胞腫瘍（精巣および卵巣）は最も一般的な悪性腫瘍。シスプラチン併用化学療法で優れた転帰を達成するが、晩期有害事象軽減のため新治療法開発が急務。悪性胚細胞腫瘍国際コンソーシアムが16か国115名以上専門家参加、分子的リスク層別化と精密腫瘍学試験を展開中。
pmid-37820296.summary_en: Comprehensive review of adolescent and young adult germ cell tumors (testicular and ovarian), the most common malignancies in this age group. Discusses innovations including collaborative clinical trials across pediatric/gynecologic/genitourinary specialties, molecular risk stratification, and precision oncology. The Malignant Germ Cell International Consortium coordinates efforts across 16 countries and 115+ experts.

pmid-37819776.summary_ja: セミノーマ stage IIA の治療戦略（RPLND、化学療法、放射線療法）の費用対効果分析。RPLND が最も費用対効果的。放射線療法と化学療法は高コストと慢性毒性による利益喪失が大きい。
pmid-37819776.summary_en: Cost-effectiveness analysis comparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND), radiotherapy, and chemotherapy for stage IIA seminoma. RPLND was most cost-effective at lifetime horizon ($58,469/patient, 40.61 QALYs) versus radiotherapy ($98,783, 40.70 QALYs) and chemotherapy ($104,096, 39.15 QALYs). RPLND advantage driven by lower toxicity-related costs.

pmid-37798961.summary_ja: 新生児眼窩奇形腫に対する眼窩摘出術の長期管理症例。眼窩尖端での骨硬化症と副鼻腔の過度な気化を4年にわたり観察。発育過程での複雑な骨変化を示唆。
pmid-37798961.summary_en: Case report of neonatal orbital teratoma management via lid and conjunctiva-sparing orbital exenteration with temporalis muscle rotation and dermis-fat graft. Sequential postoperative imaging over 4 years showed progressive hyperostosis in orbital apex and over-pneumatization of paranasal sinuses, demonstrating complex developmental bony changes.

pmid-37793425.summary_ja: アイルランドの仙骨尾骨奇形腫29例の研究。成熟奇形腫76%、未熟奇形腫7%、悪性腫瘍17%。Type IV が28% と Altman 分類より頻度が高く、再評価の必要性を提案。
pmid-37793425.summary_en: Retrospective study of 29 sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients in Ireland (2004-2020), predominantly female (79%). Histology: 22 mature (76%), 2 immature (7%), 5 malignant (17%). Type IV (completely presacral) lesions present in 28% versus 10% in Altman's original series, suggesting Type IV prevalence may be underestimated.

pmid-37792634.summary_ja: 精巣精子細胞腫瘍27例のゲノム解析。2つのサブグループ（diploid RAS/RAF変異型と核分裂相変化型）を同定。悪性転帰は TP53 変異と 12p 領域のゲイン関連で、肉腫様転化と関連。
pmid-37792634.summary_en: Genomic analysis of 27 spermatocytic tumor samples identifying molecular features predicting aggressive behavior. Found two genomic subgroups: diploid with RAS/RAF hotspot mutations and ploidy-shifted without recurrent mutations. Aggressive behavior associated with TP53 mutations and 12p gains; sarcomatoid transformation linked to TP53 mutations.

pmid-37737565.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍患者70人（中央値22.5歳）の妊孕性温存手術後方視的研究（フォローアップ92ヶ月）。未熟奇形腫が最多（32.9%）、両側侵襲稀（1.4%）。5年無病生存/全生存期間(全生存率)：未熟奇形腫91.1%/95.7%、ディスジャーミノーマ94.1%/100%、卵黄嚢82.4%/88.2%。妊娠試行者34人中23人（67.6%）が妊娠成功。
pmid-37737565.summary_en: Retrospective study of 70 fertility-sparing surgery patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, median age 22.5 years (92-month follow-up). Immature teratoma most common (32.9%), bilateral involvement rare (1.4%). 5-year DFS/OS rates: immature teratoma (91.1%/95.7%), dysgerminoma (94.1%/100%), yolk sac (82.4%/88.2%). 67.6% (23/34) attempting conception achieved pregnancy.

pmid-37725930.summary_ja: 胎児心嚢内奇形腫の症例報告。妊娠31週で腫瘍著明増大、胎児腹水・心嚢液貯留。母体ベタメタゾン投与で改善し、妊娠33週で帝王切開・胎児心臓手術施行。良好な転帰。
pmid-37725930.summary_en: Case report of fetal intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed prenatally in second trimester. At 31 weeks, tumor enlargement with fetal ascites and pericardial effusion prompted delivery planning. Maternal low-dose betamethasone therapy reduced fetal ascites and extended gestation to 33 weeks. Neonate underwent ex utero intrapartum treatment and cardiac surgery with good outcome.

pmid-37717783.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ stage II に対する放射線療法73例の検討。de novo CS-II 38例、再発 CS-II 35例。5年無再発生存率は再発例92%、de novo 例73%。全再発が照射野外で、疾患特異的生存率100%。
pmid-37717783.summary_en: Retrospective review of 73 testicular seminoma patients (CS-II stage) treated with modern radiation therapy (2001-2022). De novo CS-II: 38 patients; relapsed CS-II: 35 patients. 5-year RFS: 92% relapsed versus 73% de novo. All recurrences out-of-field; no in-field failures. Disease-specific survival 100%. Two secondary malignancies noted.

pmid-37707243.summary_ja: 2023年修正版AUAガイドラインで早期精巣がんの診断および治療をまとめた。1980年1月から2023年3月の文献を体系的にレビュー。画像検査、セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ管理、臨床病期Iサーベイランス、サバイバーシップをカバー。強度評価（A/B/C）で臨床意思決定をガイド。
pmid-37707243.summary_en: Updated AUA guideline for early-stage testicular cancer diagnosis and treatment (2023 amendment). Systematic literature review (January 1980-March 2023) with evidence-based recommendations. Covers imaging, seminoma and non-seminoma management, stage I surveillance strategies, and survivorship. Strength ratings (A/B/C) guide clinical decision-making.

pmid-37706405.summary_ja: 妊娠中の卵巣嚢胞に対する緊急腹腔鏡下手術48例。成熟奇形腫が最多病理診断。平均手術時間45分、全例成功で胎児母体合併症なし。全例37週以上で妊娠継続。
pmid-37706405.summary_en: Retrospective study of 48 urgent laparoscopic surgeries for ovarian cysts during pregnancy (first/second trimesters). Ovarian torsion most common indication; mature teratoma most frequently identified pathology. Mean operative time 45 minutes with successful completion in all cases, no fetal-maternal complications. All pregnancies continued beyond 37 weeks.

pmid-37696647.summary_ja: III～IV病期卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍および混合型胚細胞腫瘍患者40人の後方視的研究。術前化学療法+間隔減量（n=19）対初期減量手術（n=21）。3年DFS/OSに差なし。術前群は出血少ない（328対1286 mL）、輸血量少ない（1044対3067 mL）、周術期合併症少ない。
pmid-37696647.summary_en: Retrospective study of 40 stage III-IV ovarian yolk sac and mixed germ cell tumor patients comparing neoadjuvant chemotherapy + interval debulking (n=19) versus primary debulking surgery (n=21). No difference in 3-year DFS/OS. Neoadjuvant group had less blood loss (328 vs. 1286 mL), lower transfusion needs (1044 vs. 3067 mL), and fewer perioperative complications.

pmid-37683134.summary_ja: デンマーク臨床病期Iセミノーマ患者924人の研究。精巣網侵襲、リンパ管侵襲、上昇β-hCG、LDHが独立的再発予測因子。5年再発リスクはリスク因子なしで6%、全因子合併時で62%。予後モデルは臨床意思決定を改善する可能性。
pmid-37683134.summary_en: Study of 924 Danish patients with clinical stage I seminoma identifies prognostic factors for relapse including rete testis invasion, lymphovascular invasion, and elevated β-hCG and LDH. A prognostic model showed 5-year relapse risk ranging from 6% to 62% based on risk factor combinations, potentially improving clinical decision-making for risk-adapted treatment strategies.

pmid-37673783.summary_ja: 軽度ライディヒ細胞不全を有する精巣がん生存者69人のランダム化研究。低INSL3およびhCG刺激テストステロン患者はテストステロン補充療法後に脂肪量が減少。これらのバイオマーカーはテストステロン置換の恩恵患者を特定するのに役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-37673783.summary_en: Randomized study of 69 testicular cancer survivors with mild Leydig cell insufficiency found that patients with low INSL3 and hCG-stimulated testosterone showed decreased fat mass after testosterone replacement therapy. These biomarkers may help identify which survivors benefit from testosterone substitution therapy.

pmid-37672753.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが後腹膜に転移した患者45人の後方視的症例集積研究。初期後腹膜リンパ節郭清で患者の96%に生存可能な胚細胞腫瘍を認めた。2年無再発生存率は81%（サーベイランス群）。後腹膜再発なく、低容量転移に対する手術の安全性と効果を実証。
pmid-37672753.summary_en: Retrospective case series of 45 patients with testicular seminoma metastatic to retroperitoneum treated with primary nerve-sparing RPLND. Viable seminoma found in 96% of patients; 2-year recurrence-free survival was 81% with surveillance, with no retroperitoneal recurrences, demonstrating safety and efficacy of surgery for low-volume metastases.

pmid-37632231.summary_ja: 精巣GCT細胞由来のmiRNA含有細胞外小胞が腫瘍微小環境に与える影響を検討。miR-371~373とmiR-302/367クラスターが過剰発現。線維芽細胞や内皮細胞への取り込みでコラーゲン収縮と血管新生を促進。
pmid-37632231.summary_en: Study examining microRNA-containing extracellular vesicles released by testicular GCT cells and their effects on tumor microenvironment cells. TGCT cells overexpressed miR-371~373 and miR-302/367 clusters, released in EVs internalized by stromal cells, promoting collagen contraction and angiogenesis, suggesting GCT-stromal cell communication facilitates tumor progression.

pmid-37603038.summary_ja: 654例の男性における妊娠中の母体喫煙暴露(コチニン測定)と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を調査した入れ子型症例対照研究。母体タバコ暴露と子孫におけるリスク間に有意な関連は認められなかった。
pmid-37603038.summary_en: Nested case-control study of 654 males examining maternal smoking exposure (measured by cotinine) during pregnancy and testicular GCC risk. Found no significant association between maternal tobacco exposure and GCC in offspring, though different patterns observed for seminomas vs. nonseminomas. Includes biomarkers from maternal serum and amniotic fluid.

pmid-37599628.summary_ja: 出生前診断された腫瘍51例。仙尾部奇形腫9例を含む。多学際的管理により予後良好。26.1%が新生児集中治療要。中央値60ヶ月追跡で大多数が無病生存。
pmid-37599628.summary_en: 10-year retrospective study of 51 fetuses with prenatally diagnosed tumors including 9 sacrococcygeal teratomas and other masses. Multidisciplinary prenatal management with 26.1% requiring intensive postnatal care. Median 60-month follow-up showed most children alive and disease-free despite 12 with sequelae.

pmid-37539533.summary_ja: 63歳男性の左腹痛で後腹膜腸原性嚢胞および肝胃間膜脂肪織奇形腫を検出。腸原性嚢胞のみ外科的切除施行。奇形腫は主要血管枝近傍に位置するため非切除とした。病理組織学的検査で粘液腺上皮および線毛円柱上皮を確認。
pmid-37539533.summary_en: Case report of 63-year-old male with left abdominal pain found to have retroperitoneal enterogenous cyst and hepatogastric space teratoma. Surgical resection performed for enterogenous cyst. Teratoma not resected due to proximity to major vessels. Histopathology confirmed mucinous and ciliated epithelium consistent with enterogenous cyst.

pmid-37485958.summary_ja: 絨毛膜性疾患（絨毛膜癌、胎盤部位栄養膜腫瘍）のSEER解析。年齢40歳以上とFIGO III/IVが独立予後因子。多学際的管理と心理社会的支援が重要。
pmid-37485958.summary_en: Study of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) including choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor using SEER database (1975-2016) and single institution data. Cox regression identified age ≥40 years and FIGO stage III/IV as independent prognostic factors. Multidisciplinary care recommended.

pmid-37468341.summary_ja: 非セミノーマGCT患者45例のPC-RPLNDで放射線医学的特性から病理所見を予測。53%が奇形腫。第一次統計値が有意に相関し、低値が陽性病理と関連。化学療法後の残存病変予測に有用。
pmid-37468341.summary_en: Study of 45 patients with nonseminomatous GCT undergoing post-chemotherapy RPLND evaluating radiomic features to predict persistent disease. 53% had teratoma and 4% had viable GCT on pathology. First-order statistics showed significant correlations; lower radiomic signal associated with positive pathology.

pmid-37438222.summary_ja: マーカー陰性臨床病期IIA/Bセミノーマ患者30人を対象とした神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清試験。中央値フォローアップ22ヶ月で、80%がセミノーマ、低い罹患率(13%のClavien-Dindo grade 3a)、10%が再発で全身化学療法により救援。放射線/化学療法への有効な代替法を示す。
pmid-37438222.summary_en: Prospective trial of 30 marker-negative clinical stage IIA/B seminoma patients treated with primary nerve-sparing RPLND. Median follow-up 22 months; 80% had seminoma on histology. Three patients (10%) developed outfield relapse and were salvaged with chemotherapy. Low morbidity (13% Clavien-Dindo grade 3a) provides feasible alternative to radiation or chemotherapy.

pmid-37395935.summary_ja: 精巣GCTサバイバー55例と対照100例のQOL比較。情動・社会・全体スコア低下。悪心、疼痛、呼吸困難、食欲喪失増加。GCT既往の総体的QOL低下を示唆。
pmid-37395935.summary_en: Case-control study of 55 testicular GCT survivors (>2 years disease-free) vs. 100 controls using EORTC QLQ-C30. Survivors had significantly lower emotional, social, and global QOL scores. Greater reported nausea, pain, dyspnea, appetite loss, and financial toxicity. Overall GCT history had detrimental impact on long-term QOL.

pmid-37354024.summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者の化学療法前後の精子DNA メチル化追跡。化学療法後6ヶ月で74個の異なるメチル化領域、24ヶ月後17個が持続。胚発生に重要な遺伝子関連領域の異常で、子孫への影響懸念。
pmid-37354024.summary_en: Longitudinal DNA methylation study of cryopreserved sperm from testicular GCT patient before and up to 24 months after BEP chemotherapy. Among 74 DMRs altered at 6 months, 17 remained altered at 24 months. DMRs associated with genes important for embryonic development, raising concerns about potential epigenetic effects on offspring.

pmid-37292006.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍121個の後方視的病理組織学的分析(108件のGCT、89%)。純粋セミノーマが最も一般的(52%)で、35%が混合型GCTであった。リンパ管/血管浸潤(40%)、精巣網浸潤(26%)、門部軟部組織浸潤(8%)が認められ、3cm以上で有意に増加。
pmid-37292006.summary_en: Retrospective histopathological analysis of 121 testicular tumors (108 GCTs, 89%). Pure seminoma was most common (52% of GCTs); 35% were mixed GCTs. Lymphovascular invasion (40%), rete testis invasion (26%), and hilar soft tissue invasion (8%) were common. LVI and rete testis invasion increased significantly with tumor size ≥3 cm.

pmid-37287245.summary_ja: 卵巣複雑嚢胞性腫瘤と大網肥厚、CA125上昇の患者。卵巣質量のFNACは判定困難。大網生検で結晶物質と異物巨細胞反応。卵巣腫瘤は甲状腺組織のみの奇形腫。
pmid-37287245.summary_en: Case report of middle-aged woman with complex ovarian mass, omental thickening, and elevated CA125. Fine needle aspiration from ovarian mass was inconclusive. Omental biopsy showed calcium oxalate crystals with foreign body giant cell reaction. Ovarian mass resection revealed struma ovarii (teratoma with thyroid tissue), with crystals likely from FNA procedure.

pmid-37255420.summary_ja: 胎盤部位結節（PSN）2例の診断基準についての検討。従来基準はAPSN診断に大きさと組織学的特徴を重視するが、細胞増殖マーカーなしでの区別の妥当性を疑問視。
pmid-37255420.summary_en: Case report and discussion of two incidentally identified placental site nodules >10 mm with corded/nested arrangement potentially categorized as atypical PSNs per current criteria. Questions whether size and histologic features alone adequately distinguish APSNs from typical PSNs without increased cellular proliferation markers.

pmid-37246069.summary_ja: 高リスク精巣胚細胞腫瘍男性293人対対照3157人の全エクソムシーケンシングでNIN、QRSL1の機能喪失バリアント特定。有糸分裂/細胞周期、共訳タンパク質標的化、性決定の3経路との関連を示し、多遺伝子遺伝性と治療可能なターゲットを示唆。
pmid-37246069.summary_en: Exome sequencing of 293 high-risk TGCT men (familial or bilateral) vs. 3157 controls identified genes with loss-of-function variants (NIN, QRSL1). Pathway analysis showed associations with mitosis/cell cycle, co-translational protein targeting, and sex differentiation. Results suggest polygenic heritability and identify potentially druggable targets.

pmid-37170541.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣GCT（ジスゲルミノーマ、未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍）のp16過剰発現。Ki67増殖指数と相関。CDK経路の機能不全が悪性卵巣GCT腫瘍発生に関与示唆。
pmid-37170541.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of p16 expression in malignant ovarian GCTs (5 dysgerminomas, 8 immature teratomas, 9 yolk sac tumors) vs. mature teratomas and normal ovary. p16 overexpressed in all malignant GCTs (p<0.001). Cytoplasmic p16 correlated with Ki67 proliferation index, suggesting CDK pathway dysfunction in tumorigenesis.

pmid-37147893.summary_ja: オーストリアの二次学校生徒337人(平均年齢17.3歳)を対象にした男性生殖系統の解剖と精巣がんに関する知識調査。81%が年齢ピークを正しく特定し、54.9%が自己検査の目的を理解した。平均スコア10.4/15で、学校タイプによるバリエーション。精巣がんリスク認識と検診の知識欠陥を浮き彫りにした。
pmid-37147893.summary_en: Survey of 337 Austrian secondary school students (age 17.3 years) on knowledge of male reproductive anatomy and testicular cancer. 81% correctly identified age peak; 54.9% understood purpose of testicular self-examination. Mean score 10.4/15 with variation by school type. Findings highlight knowledge deficits regarding testicular cancer risk and screening.

pmid-37074092.summary_ja: Swyer症候群（46,XY完全性腺形成不全）はGCTのリスク因子。本報告は12歳女性患者における転移性精細胞腫の稀な症例を呈示。この文脈における精細胞腫は46,XY性腺形成不全患者における性腺監視の必要性を強調。
pmid-37074092.summary_en: Swyer syndrome (46,XY complete gonadal dysgenesis) confers high risk for germ cell tumor development. This case reports a 12-year-old phenotypic female who developed advanced metastatic seminoma, a rare presentation highlighting the necessity of gonadal monitoring and awareness of GCT risk in this population.

pmid-37046379.summary_ja: 18歳女性の卵巣腫瘤と転移病変。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の高悪性度神経外胚層腫瘍で、分子的特徴は小児性膠芽腫様だがGCT化学療法に著効。正確な分類と治療選択の重要性を示唆。
pmid-37046379.summary_en: An 18-year-old with metastatic ovarian mass showed high-grade neuroectodermal tumor arising within mature cystic teratoma. Molecular analysis resembled pediatric glioma, but the patient achieved excellent response to germ cell tumor chemotherapy, demonstrating importance of accurate classification for optimal therapy selection.

pmid-37015215.summary_ja: 停留精巣と先天性低ゴナドトロピン性性腺機能低下症の関連における精巣がんリスクについてのレビュー。孤立した停留精巣では2～8倍のリスク増加が認められるが、低ゴナドトロピン血症合併では3症例のみの報告で、ゴナドトロピン欠乏がリスク保護因子である可能性を示唆する。
pmid-37015215.summary_en: This review examines testicular cancer risk in undescended testes associated with congenital hypogonadotropic hypogonadism. Contrary to isolated cryptorchidism (2-8 fold increased risk), gonadotropin deficiency may provide protection. Only 3 published cases suggest orchidopexy may be deferred in this specific population.

pmid-36861716.summary_ja: 43歳男性が脊椎傍領域に発生した原始的精細胞腫（極めて稀な部位）を呈示。精巣起源を除外後、extragonadal精細胞腫と診断。化学療法5サイクルで完全寛解を達成し再発なし。
pmid-36861716.summary_en: A 43-year-old male presented with primitive extragonadal seminoma in the paravertebral dorsal region, an exceptionally rare anatomical site. After exclusion of testicular origin, diagnosis of extragonadal seminoma was confirmed. Five cycles of chemotherapy achieved complete remission with no evidence of recurrence.

pmid-36823769.summary_ja: 妊娠関連絨毛癌13例の後方視的分析。平均年齢36歳、69%は満期妊娠後。50%で化学療法耐性が発生。このGTD亜型は予後不良と早期転移傾向が特徴で、他のGTNと異なる。
pmid-36823769.summary_en: This bicentric retrospective study analyzed 13 patients with gestational choriocarcinoma (GCC). Median age 36 years; 69% had term pregnancy as antecedent. Chemoresistance occurred in 50%; overall complete response was 69%. GCC exhibits poor prognosis and early metastatic tendency compared to other gestational trophoblastic neoplasias.

pmid-36412989.summary_ja: 19歳男性が下血と高度貧血（Hb 5.8 g/dL）で入院。上部消化管内視鏡で十二指腸潰瘍病変を認識。免疫組織化学はGCTマーカー（CD30、glypican 3、AFP）発現を示唆し、GCTメタスターシスによる消化管出血を確認。
pmid-36412989.summary_en: A 19-year-old male presented with melena and severe anemia (hemoglobin 5.8 g/dL). Endoscopy revealed an ulcerated lesion in the duodenum. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated expression of GCT markers (CD30, glypican 3, alpha-fetoprotein), consistent with metastatic germ cell tumor causing gastrointestinal bleeding.

pmid-36355799.summary_ja: 30週の妊娠中の女性に生じた転移性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍による自発的気胸の症例報告。ビデオ補助胸腔鏡手術と化学的癒着を実施した。帝王切開後、メトトレキサート化学療法により完全奏効を得た。気胸と流産の既往を有する患者では転移性GTNを考慮すべきことを示す。
pmid-36355799.summary_en: A 25-year-old pregnant woman at 30 weeks presented with spontaneous pneumothorax caused by metastatic gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN). Video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery with chemical pleurodesis was performed. Histopathology confirmed gestational trophoblastic metastasis with choriocarcinoma features. After cesarean section and methotrexate chemotherapy, complete remission was achieved.

pmid-36200158.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された先天異常の周産期管理に関するエビデンスに基づく総説。胎児仙尾部奇形腫はハイリスク症例として認識。GCT関連腫瘍を含む異常の最適な新生児予後のため、周産期治療施設での管理が強調。
pmid-36200158.summary_en: This evidence-based review addresses perinatal management of prenatally detected congenital anomalies. Sacrococcygeal teratoma with fetal compromise is identified as requiring preterm delivery consideration. Delivery at tertiary centers with surgical capabilities is emphasized for optimizing outcomes in high-risk GCT-related malformations like sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-37798950.summary_ja: 小児中枢性尿崩症の診断的課題のレビュー。4症例提示：1例は視神経形成不全、3例は後天性原因で生殖細胞腫瘍が2例。腫瘍が最初の臨床症状として出現し、長期監視が必須。
pmid-37798950.summary_en: Pediatric central diabetes insipidus review highlighting diagnostic challenges with diverse etiologies. Presents 4 cases: one septo-optic dysplasia, three acquired causes. Two acquired cases attributed to germ cell tumor and Langerhans cell histiocytosis. Emphasizes CDI as potential first manifestation requiring long-term follow-up investigation.

pmid-37980197.summary_ja: 小児良性卵巣病変82例の腹腔鏡手術。成熟奇形腫46例を含む。焦点は良性病変の卵巣温存手術技術であり、悪性GCT治療ではない。
pmid-37980197.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 82 pediatric females undergoing laparoscopic ovarian-sparing surgery for benign lesions. Included 46 ovarian teratomas (mature), 15 cystadenomas, and 2 granulosa cell tumors. Focuses on surgical technique and ovarian preservation.

pmid-37986706.summary_ja: 抗NMDAR脳炎関連卵巣奇形腫18例と対照奇形腫17例を比較。脳炎関連腫瘍は生殖中心形成が増加。免疫因子が病因と示唆。
pmid-37986706.summary_en: Prospective study comparing genomic and pathologic findings in 18 anti-NMDAR encephalitis-associated teratomas vs 17 control teratomas. Identifies higher germinal center formation in encephalitic teratomas, suggesting immune rather than tumor-intrinsic factors in autoimmunity.

pmid-38019394.summary_ja: Di-8-ANEPPSを用いた蛍光膜標識法で栄養膜融合指数を定量化する方法論論文。絨毛癌細胞株を利用した胎盤研究方法開発であり、GTD疾患研究ではない。
pmid-38019394.summary_en: Methods paper describing fluorescent membrane labeling technique using Di-8-ANEPPS to quantify trophoblast fusion index in choriocarcinoma cell lines. Develops in vitro tools for studying placental development rather than GTD disease.

pmid-38028279.summary_ja: 小児患者の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と巨大漿液性嚢胞腺腫の症例報告。良性卵巣病変の画像診断と鑑別診断に焦点。
pmid-38028279.summary_en: Case report of a pediatric patient with two benign ovarian tumors: mature cystic teratoma and giant serous cystadenoma. Focuses on imaging characteristics and differential diagnosis rather than malignant GCT.

pmid-38043629.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞を用いた3D胎盤マイクロティッシュで抗うつ薬の毒性を研究。絨毛癌細胞は研究ツール的使用であり、GTD疾患そのものが焦点ではない。
pmid-38043629.summary_en: Establishes 3D placental microtissue model using BeWo choriocarcinoma cells and HUVEC to study vortioxetine toxicity. While using choriocarcinoma cells as a research model, the paper focuses on drug toxicology rather than GTD disease itself.

pmid-38072734.summary_ja: 9cm卵巣皮様嚢胞を伴う38歳女性の卵巣捻転急性症例報告。皮様嚢胞は成熟奇形腫だが、論文は急性外科的緊急事態の対応に焦点があり、腫瘍学的管理ではない。
pmid-38072734.summary_en: Case report of a 38-year-old woman with a 9cm ovarian dermoid cyst (mature teratoma) complicated by acute ovarian torsion. While dermoid cyst is identified, the paper focuses on managing the acute surgical emergency rather than GCT oncology.

pmid-38225887.summary_ja: Six1蛋白は正常精巣では高く発現しているが、精巣生殖細胞腫瘍では低く発現している。精巣細胞では細胞質に局在し、幹細胞関連蛋白Bmp4およびCtnnB1との相互作用を介して幹細胞発生に関与する可能性がある。
pmid-38225887.summary_en: Bioinformatic and experimental study shows Six1 protein is highly expressed in normal testis but low in testicular germ cell tumors. Six1 localizes cytoplasmically in testicular cells and potentially interacts with stem cell proteins Bmp4 and CtnnB1.

pmid-38411330.summary_ja: GANP/TREX-2複合体を介した転写関連DNA損傷によるがん化メカニズムの総説。固形腫瘍、リンパ腫、精巣奇形種の発症への関与を述べ、がん予後と化学療法反応の予測因子としての可能性を示した。
pmid-38411330.summary_en: Review of transcription-coupled DNA damage mechanisms in carcinogenesis mediated by GANP/TREX-2 complex. Discusses roles in various solid tumors, lymphomas, and testicular teratoma, with implications for cancer prognosis and chemotherapy response prediction.

pmid-38614951.summary_ja: 小児・思春期卵巣良悪性腫瘤、境界病変の管理についての多学科的教育シンポジウムの概説。がん治療中の生殖能温存についても述べられている。
pmid-38614951.summary_en: Educational symposium summary addressing management of pediatric and adolescent benign and malignant ovarian masses, borderline lesions, and fertility considerations during cancer therapy. Multidisciplinary approach covers various aspects of ovarian lesion management.

pmid-38638925.summary_ja: 成人Hirschsprung病患者に双側卵巣奇形腫が発見された症例。Hirschsprung病の診断的困難さと並発する腹部骨盤疾患の管理が強調されている。
pmid-38638925.summary_en: A 29-year-old woman with adult Hirschsprung's disease was found to have bilateral ovarian dermoid cysts during workup. The case highlights diagnostic challenges of adult-onset Hirschsprung's disease and management of concurrent abdominopelvic conditions.

pmid-38657195.summary_ja: 小児傍腫瘍神経症候群42例の後ろ向き研究。最頻症候は眼球振盪筋間代痙攣（62%）と小脳症候群（26%）。神経芽細胞腫88%、卵巣奇形腫10%。2021診断基準は良好だが抗体陰性例の改善が必要。
pmid-38657195.summary_en: Retrospective review of pediatric paraneoplastic neurologic syndromes (n=42). Most common syndromes: opsoclonus-myoclonus (62%) and cerebellar syndrome (26%). Neuroblastomas predominated (88%), with ovarian teratomas in 10% of cases. 2021 diagnostic criteria performed well but may need refinement for antibody-negative cases.

pmid-38697202.summary_ja: 日本における卵巣がん患者の医療の質に関する11の測定可能な指標を用いた評価研究。580病院から6,611人の卵巣がん患者と1,879人の境界性腫瘍患者を対象。生殖細胞腫瘍II期以上に対するBEP化学療法の遵守率は93.5%。全体的な遵守率は22.6%～93.5%の範囲で、標準化治療実施の知見を提供。
pmid-38697202.summary_en: Quality of care assessment for ovarian cancer patients in Japan using 11 measurable indicators. Study of 6,611 ovarian cancer and 1,879 borderline tumor patients from 580 hospitals. BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) for germ cell tumors stage II and above showed 93.5% adherence. Adherence rates ranged from 22.6% to 93.5%, providing insights into standardized care implementation for ovarian malignancies.

pmid-38772930.summary_ja: 腫瘍随伴性上肢麻痺性対麻痺の後方視的分析。4例中2例がセミノーマ。全例でLUZP4-IgG抗体検出。腫瘍随伴性では運動失調、めまい、炎症性脳脊髄液所見が神経変性型と異なる。
pmid-38772930.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of paraneoplastic brachial amyotrophic diplegia with serological and clinical characterization. Two of four paraneoplastic cases had seminoma; all showed LUZP4-IgG antibody. Paraneoplastic form associated with ataxia, vertigo, and inflammatory CSF findings differing from neurodegenerative cases.

pmid-38903360.summary_ja: 新生児の上顎軟部腫瘤の症例報告で奇形腫が疑われるも、確定診断は明確でない。CT所見から良性先天性発育異常の可能性が示唆された。先天性顔面腫瘤の診断困難性と学際的管理の重要性を強調している。
pmid-38903360.summary_en: Case report of congenital maxillary soft tissue mass in newborn suspected to be teratoma. CT imaging showed soft tissue opacification with underlying bony outgrowth. Diagnosis remains uncertain; paper emphasizes diagnostic challenges in congenital facial lesions and importance of multidisciplinary evaluation.

pmid-39007191.summary_ja: 小児腫瘍手術計画のための仮想現実モデリング。縦隔生殖細胞腫瘍を含む複雑症例で外科医の自信度が向上。
pmid-39007191.summary_en: Virtual reality modeling for surgical planning in 12 complex pediatric oncology cases improved surgical confidence 63% of the time. Mediastinal germ cell tumor was one case studied. VRM helps clarify operative plans for complex pediatric malignancies.

pmid-39028348.summary_ja: 小児CNS腫瘍の放射線誘発海綿状血管腫のシステマティックレビュー。2,487例中325例がRICMを発症。精上皮腫は照射適応の一つ(19例)だが、論文は放射線合併症が主題。
pmid-39028348.summary_en: Systematic review of radiation-induced cavernous malformations in pediatric CNS tumors. Germinomas listed as indications for radiation; mean latency 9.9 years. Paper focuses on radiation complications rather than GCT management.

pmid-39050850.summary_ja: 抗NMDAR脳炎のHLA-KIR多型の遺伝学的関連性研究。卵巣奇形腫との関連が言及されているが、免疫遺伝学が主焦点で奇形腫は主題ではない。
pmid-39050850.summary_en: Genome-wide association study of HLA-KIR polymorphisms in anti-NMDAR encephalitis. Ovarian teratoma mentioned as associated condition but paper focuses on immune genetics rather than tumors themselves.

pmid-39052836.summary_ja: 胎盤栄養膜細胞のHLA-C発現をELF3-NLRP2/NLRP7軸が調節することを示した研究。NLRP2とNLRP7がHLA-C発現に相反する効果を有する。本軸の標的化により反復胞状奇胎や胎児発育不全など妊娠関連障害の治療に応用可能性が示唆されたが、研究の主要対象は妊娠滋養膜疾患ではなく胎盤免疫学。
pmid-39052836.summary_en: Study examining HLA-C expression regulation in placental extravillous trophoblasts by ELF3-NLRP2/NLRP7 axis using choriocarcinoma cells. Describes opposing effects of NLRP2 and NLRP7 on HLA-C expression. Suggests targeting this axis may have therapeutic potential for pregnancy disorders including recurrent hydatidiform moles. Focuses on placental immunology rather than gestational trophoblastic disease as primary subject.

pmid-39071640.summary_ja: 喀血と呼吸困難で発症した47歳女性の肺内成熟嚢胞性奇形腫症例。CT検査で脂肪、石灰化、軟部組織成分を含む腫瘤を認め、左上葉切除後の組織診で脂肪・角質・歯・毛髪を含む成熟奇形腫と確定診断。術後3か月で再発なし。
pmid-39071640.summary_en: Case report of intrapulmonary mature cystic teratoma in 47-year-old female presenting with hemoptysis and dyspnea. CT imaging revealed inhomogeneous mass with fat, calcification, and soft tissue components. Pathological examination after left upper lobe lobectomy confirmed mature teratoma containing fat, keratin, teeth, and hair. No recurrence at 3-month follow-up.

pmid-39109037.summary_ja: 17症例の卵巣衝突腫瘍（異なる組織型が同一腫瘍内に共存）の後向き分析。1症例は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と高悪性度漿液性がんの組み合わせ。平均年齢36.7歳。64.7%がO-RADS score 4の悪性特性を示した。上皮間葉系の組み合わせが最も多かった。
pmid-39109037.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 17 ovarian collision tumors (distinct histologic types coexisting in same mass) with ultrasound and O-RADS evaluation. One case combined mature cystic teratoma with high-grade serous carcinoma. Average age 36.7 years. Most collision tumors (64.7%) had O-RADS score 4 with malignant characteristics. Epithelial-mesenchymal combinations most common.

pmid-39121721.summary_ja: 8ヶ月乳児における稀な先天性咽頭部奇形腫の症例で、断続的な呼吸困難と摂食困難を引き起こした。ゆっくり成長する腫瘍は上気道と消化器官を閉塞した。MRI検査で診断が確認され、手術切除後の組織検査で奇形腫が確診された。早期発見と手術治療が重要。
pmid-39121721.summary_en: Rare case of congenital oropharyngeal teratoma in eight-month-old infant causing intermittent dyspnea and feeding difficulties. Slow-growing mass obstructed upper airway and digestive tract. MRI imaging completed diagnostic assessment. Histopathological examination confirmed teratoma diagnosis after surgical removal. Early recognition and surgical treatment essential for management.

pmid-39319248.summary_ja: ガンビアの小児がん登録。生殖細胞腫瘍は全体の18.2%であるが、本論文は複数のがん型を対象とする広範な疫学研究であり、生殖細胞腫瘍の詳細な臨床情報は限定的である。
pmid-39319248.summary_en: Prospective pediatric cancer registry in Gambia covering 44 children. Wilms tumor was most common (27.3%), followed by leukemia (25.0%) and germ cell tumor (18.2%). Study documents treatment challenges including drug unavailability, inadequate laboratory monitoring, and high treatment abandonment rates.

pmid-39321395.summary_ja: 傍腫瘍性神経症候群の診断基準を評価した研究。KLHL11抗体陽性患者の一部に精巣腫瘍の関連が認められたが、論文の主題は神経学的症候群の診断基準であり、生殖細胞腫瘍管理ではない。
pmid-39321395.summary_en: Retrospective cohort evaluating the 2021 PNS-CARE diagnostic criteria in 212 patients with paraneoplastic neurologic syndrome. Most common autoantibodies were PCA1, KLHL11, and CRMP5. KLHL11-IgG brainstem encephalitis with burned-out testicular tumor was identified in 7 patients with intermediate-risk phenotype.

pmid-39421162.summary_ja: ナイジェリアの婦人科悪性腫瘍10年間の疫学調査（N=441）。子宮頸癌59.4%、卵巣癌24.0%が最多。絨毛がんは7.5%。各組織型の年齢分布とその頻度を検討。
pmid-39421162.summary_en: 10-year retrospective study of gynecological malignancies in Nigeria (N=441). Cervical cancer was most common (59.4%), followed by ovarian cancer (24.0%). Choriocarcinoma accounted for 7.5% of cases. Study characterized histological subtypes and age distribution trends for cancer prevention strategies.

pmid-39422932.summary_ja: 睾丸病変の超音波画像診断の総説。血管障害、外傷、感染、一次・二次悪性腫瘍の画像診断特性を概説。CEUS法と超解像技術により良悪性腫瘍の鑑別が可能。
pmid-39422932.summary_en: Overview of ultra sonographic imaging techniques for testicular disorders including benign and malignant masses. Contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) and super resolution techniques improve microvascular visualization and distinction between benign and malignant testicular lesions, with representative cases from university practice.

pmid-39478483.summary_ja: 妊娠中の付属器捻転の腹腔鏡手術と開腹手術の後ろ向き比較で、腹腔鏡手術で出血量と回復に利点を示し、成熟奇形腫が開腹群で最も一般的な病理所見でした。
