pmid-39478483.summary_en: Retrospective comparison of laparoscopic versus open surgical approaches for adnexal torsion during pregnancy in 155 patients, with mature teratomas being the most common pathological finding in the laparotomy group.

authors: de Lussanet de la Sablonière QG
pmid-39513463.summary_ja: 卵巣原発神経内分泌腫瘍と転移性神経内分泌腫瘍の臨床病理学的および分子生物学的分析で、奇形腫関連卵巣NETと転移性NETで異なるクラスタリングパターンを認めました。
pmid-39513463.summary_en: Comparative clinicopathological and epigenetic analysis of primary ovarian neuroendocrine tumors versus metastases, identifying that teratoma-associated ovarian NETs cluster differently from NET metastases and suggesting different management approaches.

pmid-39702777.summary_ja: 本論文は精巣細胞分化におけるヒストン変異体H3.5の役割を調査しており、セミノーマ検体で高い発現を示し、精巣腫瘍との関連が示唆されていますが、主な焦点はヒストン生物学です。
pmid-39702777.summary_en: This study investigates histone variant H3.5 in testicular cell differentiation, analyzing its expression across cell types and in seminoma specimens. H3-5 copy number gain and elevated expression in seminomas suggest potential link to testicular tumors, though the primary focus is histone biology.

pmid-39712725.summary_ja: 本論文は抗NMDAR脳炎の初期症状としてのカタトニアについて報告しており、卵巣奇形腫が検出されました。しかし治療は脳炎の免疫抑制療法に焦点を当てています。
pmid-39712725.summary_en: This case report details catatonia as initial presentation of anti-NMDAR encephalitis in a 19-year-old female. A left adnexal mass consistent with ovarian teratoma was identified on imaging, but management focused on the autoimmune encephalitis with immunosuppressive therapy.

pmid-39717297.summary_ja: 本論文は抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告であり、卵巣奇形腫は関連する条件として言及されています。論文の主な焦点は自己免疫脳炎の診断と管理です。
pmid-39717297.summary_en: This case report describes anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis with asymmetric temporal lobe involvement in a 24-year-old female. While ovarian teratoma is noted as a potential associated finding in this condition, the paper focuses on the autoimmune encephalitis diagnosis and management.

pmid-40406391.summary_ja: 妊娠22週で診断された巨大エピグナスス（口咽頭奇形腫）。MRIで頭蓋内浸潤なし。37+6週でex-utero術式分娩。病理診断は成熟奇形腫を確認。完全切除後、良好な転帰を達成。
pmid-40406391.summary_en: This case describes prenatal diagnosis of giant epignathus (congenital oropharyngeal teratoma) at 22 weeks gestation. MRI confirmed absence of intracranial extension or CNS involvement. Ex-utero intrapartum treatment at 37+6 weeks was performed. Pathology confirmed mature teratoma; complete resection achieved excellent postnatal outcome.

pmid-40041260.summary_ja: 妊娠中の仙尾部奇形腫（SCT）症例で、出生前画像診断でTerminal myelocystoceleとの鑑別困難。妊娠中絶後、病理学的に成熟嚢胞性SCTを確認。出生前診断確認の重要性を示唆。
pmid-40041260.summary_en: This case presents a pregnant woman with fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) where prenatal imaging differentiation from terminal myelocystocele was difficult. After pregnancy termination, histological examination confirmed mature cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma, highlighting importance of histopathologic verification for accurate prenatal diagnosis and prognosis determination.

pmid-39399296.summary_ja: 本システマティックレビューは思春期後停留精巣の管理を悪性腫瘍リスクの観点から検討した。42人の患者において、セミノーマ、奇形腫、及び上皮内癌が最も一般的な悪性腫瘍であった。本レビューは対側精巣の状態、UDT部位、テストステロン値、患者年齢、及び妊孕性温存への関心を考慮した個別化管理を推奨している。
pmid-39399296.summary_en: This systematic review examined post-pubertal undescended testis management focusing on malignancy risk. Among 42 patients, malignancies found included seminoma, teratoma, and carcinoma in situ. The review recommends individualized management considering contralateral testis condition, UDT location, testosterone levels, patient age, and fertility preservation preferences.

pmid-39034120.summary_ja: 32歳男性が性交時の急性陰嚢痛で発症。超音波とMRIで異質性腫瘤を検出。病理診断で混合型GCT（精細胞腫60%、奇形腫20%、胎児癌20%）。1年フォローアップで再発なし。急性陰嚢症での悪性腫瘍の重要性を示唆。
pmid-39034120.summary_en: A 32-year-old male presented with acute scrotal pain during intercourse. Testicular ultrasound and MRI revealed a heterogeneous mass. Pathology confirmed mixed germ cell tumor: seminoma (60%), teratoma (20%), and embryonal carcinoma (20%). One-year follow-up showed no recurrence, highlighting importance of considering malignancy in acute scrotum differential diagnosis.

pmid-38974059.summary_ja: ナイジェリア大学病院の精巣病理検体430例の後方視的研究。精巣萎縮と捻転が大多数だが、16例の悪性腫瘍中6例がセミノーマ。アフリカ人口におけるGCT疫学データを提供。
pmid-38974059.summary_en: This retrospective clinicopathologic study analyzed 430 testicular specimens from a Nigerian tertiary center. While testicular atrophy (76.3%) and torsion (9.8%) dominated, malignancies comprised 3.7% with 6 seminomas (37.5%). The report provides GCT epidemiologic data in an African population, contributing to understanding geographic variations in testicular GCT incidence.

pmid-38807623.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（dermoid cyst）の悪性転化に関する症例報告と文献総説。腺癌と扁平上皮癌の2症例を呈示。稀だが大型腫瘍と中年女性で多く、腫瘍マーカーと術中診断が治療決定に重要。
pmid-38807623.summary_en: This case report and literature review examines malignant transformation in mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts). Two cases are presented: adenocarcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma. Although rare, malignant transformation occurs more frequently in larger tumors and middle-aged women. Accurate intraoperative diagnosis and tumor marker assessment guide treatment decisions.

pmid-38516509.summary_ja: 妊娠初期の仙尾部奇形腫（Type 2）が12mmから急速増大し、21週で49×37×36mm。男児は38週で帝王切開分娩。生後7日で腫瘍摘出：成熟奇形腫Grade 0で190×160×100 mm、1100g。急速増大にもかかわらず良好な転帰達成。
pmid-38516509.summary_en: This case reports a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma (Type 2) prenatally diagnosed at first trimester (12 mm), progressively enlarging to 49×37×36 mm by 21+6 weeks. The male fetus was delivered by planned cesarean section at 38 weeks. Tumor resection at age 7 days revealed mature teratoma (Grade 0) measuring 190×160×100 mm (1100 g) with excellent outcome.

pmid-38504737.summary_ja: 55歳閉経後女性の大型卵巣dermoidが悪性転化と腸瘻形成で腸閉塞。複数の腸瘻が認められ、子宮全摘、両側卵管卵巣摘出、腸切除施行。悪性奇形腫の破裂と腸瘻形成は極めて稀な合併症。
pmid-38504737.summary_en: A 55-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with large ovarian dermoid complicated by malignant transformation and ileo-dermoid fistula causing intestinal obstruction. Imaging revealed multiple fistulous communications with ileal loops. Management included total hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and bowel resection. Rupture and fistulization of malignant teratoma represents an extremely rare complication.

pmid-38298441.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫手術1年後に卵黄嚢腫瘍を発症した24歳女性の症例。術後定期的なサーベイランスにより早期検出が可能であった。手術、化学療法、および生殖能温存により良好な予後が得られた。
pmid-38298441.summary_en: 24-year-old woman with yolk sac tumor developing one year after mature ovarian teratoma surgery. Demonstrates malignant transformation/recurrence following mature teratoma resection. Early detection through routine surveillance, surgical treatment, chemotherapy, and fertility preservation resulted in favorable prognosis.

pmid-38293700.summary_ja: CTテクスチャ解析と機械学習を用いた精巣腫瘍の鑑別診断。精巣腫瘍の良悪性鑑別（AUC 0.946）およびセミノーマ同定（AUC 0.928）に有用。泌尿器科医の診断判断と治療方針決定を支援。
pmid-38293700.summary_en: Machine learning-based CT texture analysis to differentiate benign from malignant testicular masses and identify seminoma in germ cell tumors. Logistics regression model achieved highest AUC (0.946 for benign/malignant, 0.982 for lymphoma, 0.928 for seminoma identification). Non-invasive diagnostic tool supporting clinical decision-making.

pmid-38292387.summary_ja: 18～45歳のTGCT患者454例を対象としたフランス症例対照研究で、親の職業と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討。父親のサービス業や運輸機械職、母親の中等教育職がリスク増加と関連。セミノーマと非セミノーマで関連職業に差異が認められた。
pmid-38292387.summary_en: French case-control study of 454 TGCT cases examining association between parental occupations at birth and adult testicular GCT risk. Paternal jobs as service workers, transport operators, and farmers associated with increased risk; maternal secondary education jobs linked to TGCT risk. Histological differences noted between seminoma and non-seminoma.

pmid-38289807.summary_ja: 出生前30週に診断された巨大仙尾部奇形腫。新生児第3日目の手術切除を実施。手術部位感染にもかかわらず、良好な転帰が得られた。早期診断と迅速な治療管理が予後改善に重要。
pmid-38289807.summary_en: Giant sacrococcygeal teratoma detected at 30 weeks gestation in fetus. Neonatal surgical excision on day 3 of life. Despite surgical site infection, favorable outcome with normal vital signs, bowel, bladder, and lower extremity function. Early diagnosis and prompt management critical for optimal outcomes.

pmid-38289795.summary_ja: 妊娠20週に診断された左付属器未分化奇形腫（stage 1A, grade 2）の26歳女性。妊娠30週時に転移病変が進行。36週で帝王切開と腹腔鏡検査で高悪性度転移性奇形腫を確認。妊娠中の化学療法により良好な予後。
pmid-38289795.summary_en: 26-year-old pregnant woman with immature teratoma stage 1A, grade 2 diagnosed at 20 weeks gestation. Despite counseling, metastasis developed by 30 weeks. Exploratory laparotomy and cesarean section at 36 weeks revealed grade 3 immature teratoma in metastatic mass. Fertility-sparing surgery with chemotherapy during pregnancy achieved good prognosis.

pmid-38283145.summary_ja: Turner症候群患者のリンパ節転移を伴う卵巣ジスジャーミノーマ（stage IIIc）。KIT遺伝子変異（exon 13）と腫瘍微小環境の詳細な解析。化学療法中に多発性脳梗塞を併発。
pmid-38283145.summary_en: 33-year-old woman with Turner syndrome carrying 46,X, del(Xp22.33-11.23) and del(2)(q11.1-11.2) presenting with dysgerminoma stage IIIc with lymphatic metastases. KIT gene mutation identified in exon 13. Robust CD4+ T lymphocyte and PD-1 expression in tumor microenvironment despite poor clinical outcome.

pmid-38281483.summary_ja: Y染色体物質がないターナー症候群の女性患者に転移性ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を認めた。全エクソムおよびRNA解析により、KIT遺伝子の病原性ゲイン・オブ・ファンクション変異とMTOR遺伝子の変異が明らかになった。これまで異形成腺の悪性転化にはY染色体が必須と考えられていたが、本症例はこの理解に疑問を呈する。
pmid-38281483.summary_en: Turner syndrome female with metastatic dysgerminoma without Y-chromosomal material. Whole exome and RNA sequencing revealed pathogenic gain-of-function KIT mutation and MTOR missense mutation. Questioned current understanding that Y-chromosomal material is essential for malignant transformation in dysgenetic gonad. Patient died 7 months post-diagnosis.
